name: ChoppedPlane.signedForms_zero_eq_C
statement: theorem signedForms_zero_eq_C (f : signedForms K n 0) : f.val = C (f.val.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ : ∃ a : K, C a = f.val := by simpa [signedForms] using f.property
  rw [← ha]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.idealFormPiece_map_eq_quadraticMinorSpace
statement:
theorem idealFormPiece_map_eq_quadraticMinorSpace
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c+1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (h : r+a=c+1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d+2) :
    (idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal B) d).map (Forms K n d).subtype =
      quadraticMinorSpace B h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro f ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩
    have ht : (0 : ℤ)-2+(∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i : ℕ) = d := by
      rw [hdegree]
      omega
    let E : rowCofactorImage (r := r) B hB 0 ≃ₗ[K]
        idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal B) d :=
      (rowCofactorImageEquivSignedIdeal B hB 0).trans
        (signedIdealPieceEquivNatOfEq (maximalMinorIdeal B) d ht)
    let fI : idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal B) d := ⟨g,hg⟩
    let fimage := E.symm fI
    have hE (q : rowCofactorImage (r := r) B hB 0) : (E q).val.val = q.val.val := by
      change ((signedIdealPieceEquivNatOfEq (maximalMinorIdeal B) d ht)
        (rowCofactorImageEquivSignedIdeal B hB 0 q)).val.val = q.val.val
      rw [signedIdealPieceEquivNatOfEq_val,rowCofactorImageEquivSignedIdeal_val]
    have hrep : fimage.val.val = g.val := by
      calc
        _ = (E fimage).val.val := (hE fimage).symm
        _ = fI.val.val := congrArg (fun q : idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal B) d => q.val.val)
          (E.apply_symm_apply fI)
        _ = g.val := rfl
    obtain ⟨⟨v,w⟩,hv⟩ := splitCofactorMap_surjective B h hB 0 fimage
    have hw : w = 0 := by
      funext i
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hh := (w i).property
      simpa [signedForms] using hh
    subst w
    have hcomb : (∑ i : Fin r, signedMaximalMinor B (quadraticRow h i) * (v i).val) =
        g.val := by
      calc
        _ = (splitCofactorMap B h hB 0 (v,0)).val.val :=
          (splitCofactorMap_quadratic_val B h hB 0 v).symm
        _ = fimage.val.val := congrArg (fun q => q.val.val) hv
        _ = g.val := hrep
    change g.val ∈ quadraticMinorSpace B h
    rw [← hcomb]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i _
    rw [signedForms_zero_eq_C (v i),mul_comm,← MvPolynomial.smul_eq_C_mul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i,rfl⟩)
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨i,rfl⟩
    apply Submodule.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨signedMaximalMinor B (quadraticRow h i),
      quadraticMinor_homogeneous B h hB hdegree i⟩,?_,rfl⟩
    change signedMaximalMinor B (quadraticRow h i) ∈ maximalMinorIdeal B
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨quadraticRow h i,rfl⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreeSpace_eq_quadraticMinorSpace
statement:
theorem pointDegreeSpace_eq_quadraticMinorSpace
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c+1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (h : r+a=c+1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d+2)
    (cfg : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hpieces : ∀ t, pointDegreePiece K cfg t = idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal B) t) :
    pointDegreeSpace K cfg d = quadraticMinorSpace B h
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointDegreeSpace,hpieces d]
  exact idealFormPiece_map_eq_quadraticMinorSpace B h hB hdegree

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedIdeal_eq_quadraticMinorIdeal
statement:
theorem choppedIdeal_eq_quadraticMinorIdeal
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c+1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (h : r+a=c+1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d+2)
    (cfg : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hpieces : ∀ t, pointDegreePiece K cfg t = idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal B) t) :
    choppedIdeal K cfg d = quadraticMinorIdeal B h
proof:
:= by
  rw [choppedIdeal,pointDegreeSpace_eq_quadraticMinorSpace B h hB hdegree cfg hpieces]
  exact quadraticMinorSpace_idealSpan B h

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_eq_quadraticMinorIdeal
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_eq_quadraticMinorIdeal
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c+1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (h : r+a=c+1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d+2)
    (cfg : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hpieces : ∀ t, pointDegreePiece K cfg t = idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal B) t)
    (t : ℕ) :
    choppedHilbertFunction cfg d t = idealQuotientHilbertFunction (quadraticMinorIdeal B h) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [choppedHilbertFunction,pointDegreeSpace_eq_quadraticMinorSpace B h hB hdegree cfg hpieces]
  rw [← quadraticMinorSpace_idealSpan]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.eval_chartEvaluationPolynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_chartEvaluationPolynomial {p d : ℕ} (f : Forms K 3 d)
    (i : Fin p) (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    eval a (chartEvaluationPolynomial f i) = pointEvaluation K a d f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEvaluationPolynomial, MvPolynomial.eval_eval₂]
  change eval₂ ((eval a).comp C) (fun j => eval a (![X (i, 0), X (i, 1), 1] j)) f.val = _
  have hc : (eval a).comp C = RingHom.id K := by ext c; simp
  rw [hc]
  congr 1
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [chartPoint]

name: ChoppedPlane.pointEvaluation_isPolynomialFamily
statement:
theorem pointEvaluation_isPolynomialFamily (p d : ℕ) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun a : PointCoordinates K p => pointEvaluation K a d)
proof:
:= by
  apply isPolynomialFamily_linearMap
  intro f
  have hterm (i : Fin p) : IsPolynomialFamily (fun a : PointCoordinates K p =>
      pointEvaluation K a d f i • (Pi.single i 1 : Fin p → K)) := by
    have hi : IsPolynomialFamily (fun a : PointCoordinates K p => pointEvaluation K a d f i) := by
      simpa only [eval_chartEvaluationPolynomial] using
        isPolynomialFamily_eval (chartEvaluationPolynomial f i)
    exact hi.smul (isPolynomialFamily_const (Pi.single i 1))
  have hs := IsPolynomialFamily.sum hterm
  have heq : (fun a : PointCoordinates K p =>
      ∑ i, pointEvaluation K a d f i • (Pi.single i 1 : Fin p → K)) =
      (fun a => pointEvaluation K a d f) := by
    funext a i
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  exact heq ▸ hs

name: ChoppedPlane.generic_pointHilbertFunction_at
statement:
theorem generic_pointHilbertFunction_at [Infinite K] (p d : ℕ) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K,
      (∃ a : PointCoordinates K p, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → pointHilbertFunction K a d = min ((d + 2).choose 2) p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := exists_pointHilbertFunction_maximal (K := K) p d
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := rank_polynomial_principal_open
    (fun a : PointCoordinates K p => pointEvaluation K a d)
    (pointEvaluation_isPolynomialFamily p d) a₀
  refine ⟨D, ⟨a₀, hD⟩, fun a ha => le_antisymm (pointHilbertFunction_le a) ?_⟩
  have hl := hgood a ha
  rw [← pointHilbertFunction_eq_rank, ← pointHilbertFunction_eq_rank, ha₀] at hl
  exact hl

name: ChoppedPlane.pointEvaluation_surjective_above
statement:
theorem pointEvaluation_surjective_above {p q t : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hqt : q ≤ t) (h : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a q)) :
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a t)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h y
  let g : Forms K 3 t := ⟨f.val * X 2 ^ (t - q), by
    have hh := f.property.mul ((isHomogeneous_X (R := K) (2 : Fin 3)).pow (t - q))
    simpa [Nat.add_sub_of_le hqt] using hh⟩
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  ext i
  change eval (chartPoint K a i) (f.val * X 2 ^ (t - q)) = y i
  simpa [chartPoint] using congrFun hf i

name: ChoppedPlane.pointEvaluation_surjective_of_hilbert_eq
statement:
theorem pointEvaluation_surjective_of_hilbert_eq {p q : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (h : pointHilbertFunction K a q = p) :
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a q)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
  apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
  simpa [pointHilbertFunction_eq_rank, Module.finrank_pi_fintype] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_constant_above
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_constant_above {p q t : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hqt : q ≤ t) (h : pointHilbertFunction K a q = p) :
    pointHilbertFunction K a t = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointHilbertFunction_eq_rank,
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (pointEvaluation_surjective_above a hqt
      (pointEvaluation_surjective_of_hilbert_eq a h)), finrank_top]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.point_count_le_forms
statement: theorem point_count_le_forms (p : ℕ) : p ≤ (p + 2).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero => omega
  | succ p ih =>
    have hs : (p + 1 + 2).choose 2 = (p + 2).choose 2 + (p + 2) := by
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using Nat.choose_succ_succ (p + 2) 1
    rw [hs]
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.distinctnessPolynomial_nonempty
statement:
theorem distinctnessPolynomial_nonempty [CharZero K] (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : PointCoordinates K p, eval a (distinctnessPolynomial K p) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun ik => if ik.2 = 0 then (ik.1.val : K) else 0, ?_⟩
  simp only [distinctnessPolynomial, map_prod, map_sub, eval_X]
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro ij _
  simp only [ite_true]
  apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
  exact_mod_cast (ne_of_lt ij.property : ij.val.1.val ≠ ij.val.2.val)

name: ChoppedPlane.distinctPoints_of_polynomial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem distinctPoints_of_polynomial_ne_zero {p : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (h : eval a (distinctnessPolynomial K p) ≠ 0) : DistinctPoints K a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hall : ∀ ij : {ij : Fin p × Fin p // ij.1 < ij.2},
      a (ij.val.1, 0) - a (ij.val.2, 0) ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [distinctnessPolynomial, map_prod, map_sub, eval_X] at h
    intro ij
    exact (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mp h) ij (Finset.mem_univ ij)
  intro i j hij
  by_contra hn
  have heq : a (i, 0) = a (j, 0) := congrArg Prod.fst hij
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hn with hlt | hgt
  · exact hall ⟨(i, j), hlt⟩ (by simp [heq])
  · exact hall ⟨(j, i), hgt⟩ (by simp [heq])

name: ChoppedPlane.generic_pointHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem generic_pointHilbertFunction [CharZero K] (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K,
      (∃ a : PointCoordinates K p, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → DistinctPoints K a ∧
        ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min ((t + 2).choose 2) p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose D hD hgood using fun i : Fin (p + 1) => generic_pointHilbertFunction_at (K := K) p i.val
  let E := distinctnessPolynomial K p * ∏ i, D i
  have hne : E ≠ 0 := by
    apply mul_ne_zero
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := distinctnessPolynomial_nonempty (K := K) p
      intro hz
      simp [hz] at ha
    · apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
      intro i _
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hD i
      intro hz
      simp [hz] at ha
  have hex : ∃ a : PointCoordinates K p, eval a E ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hne (MvPolynomial.funext h)
  refine ⟨E, hex, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  have hparts : eval a (distinctnessPolynomial K p) ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, eval a (D i) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [E, map_mul, map_prod, mul_ne_zero_iff, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff,
      Finset.mem_univ, forall_true_left] using ha
  refine ⟨distinctPoints_of_polynomial_ne_zero a hparts.1, ?_⟩
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t ≤ p
  · exact hgood ⟨t, by omega⟩ a (hparts.2 ⟨t, by omega⟩)
  · have hp : pointHilbertFunction K a p = p := by
      simpa only [min_eq_right (point_count_le_forms p)] using
        hgood ⟨p, by omega⟩ a (hparts.2 ⟨p, by omega⟩)
    have hc := pointHilbertFunction_constant_above a (by omega : p ≤ t) hp
    have hle : p ≤ (t + 2).choose 2 := by
      exact (point_count_le_forms p).trans (Nat.choose_le_choose 2 (by omega))
    simpa only [min_eq_right hle] using hc

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.operatorDifferential_project
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_project (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W)
    (ι : P →ₗ[K] V) (ρ : W →ₗ[K] Q) (t : ℕ) (p : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → P) :
    operatorDifferential (fun i => ρ.comp ((T i).comp ι)) t p =
      fun s => ρ (operatorDifferential T t (fun b => ι (p b)) s)
proof:
:= by
  funext s
  simp only [operatorDifferential_coeff, map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_project
statement:
theorem auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_project (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W)
    (ι : P →ₗ[K] V) (ρ : W →ₗ[K] Q) (t : ℕ) (p : Sym (Fin 3) t → P) :
    auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (fun i => ρ.comp ((T i).comp ι)) t p =
      fun s => ρ (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply T t (fun b => ι (p b)) s)
proof:
:= by
  funext s
  simp only [auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_apply, map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.finiteDirectional_project
statement:
theorem finiteDirectional_project (f : Fin 3 → R) (ι : P →ₗ[K] M) (ρ : M →ₗ[K] Q)
    (t : ℕ) (p : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → P) :
    operatorDifferential (fun i => ρ.comp ((scalarAction (K := K) (f i)).comp ι)) t p =
      fun s => ρ (finiteDirectional f t (fun b => ι (p b)) s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteDirectional_eq_operatorDifferential (K := K)]
  exact operatorDifferential_project _ _ _ _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.finiteMultiply_project
statement:
theorem finiteMultiply_project (f : Fin 3 → R) (ι : P →ₗ[K] M) (ρ : M →ₗ[K] Q)
    (t : ℕ) (p : Sym (Fin 3) t → P) :
    auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (fun i => ρ.comp ((scalarAction (K := K) (f i)).comp ι)) t p =
      fun s => ρ (finiteMultiply f t (fun b => ι (p b)) s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteMultiply_eq_auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K)]
  exact auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_project _ _ _ _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.chartDualZ_cube
statement:
theorem chartDualZ_cube (φ : BinaryRing K →ₐ[K] A) (q : K)
    (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) :
    chartDualZ φ q s ^ 3 = φ (binaryCubic K) • 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartDualZ, cyclicZDual_cube]
  congr 1
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, profileFactors_product q hq s]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.chartU_unit
statement:
theorem chartU_unit (φ : BinaryRing K →ₐ[K] A) (a : A)
    (hu : φ (binaryU K) * a = 1) : chartU φ * chartCoefficient φ a = 1
proof:
:= by
  change cyclicCoefficientHom _ _ * cyclicCoefficientHom _ _ = 1

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.chart_dual_cross_kernel_u
statement:
theorem chart_dual_cross_kernel_u
    (φ : BinaryRing K →ₐ[K] A) (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (a : A) (hu : φ (binaryU K) * a = 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= chartDualModuleStructure φ q hq s
    ∀ P : AuxTensor (R := ChartCubicRing φ) (M := Fin 3 → A),
      tensorChange (chartCrossMatrix φ) P = 0 ↔
        P ∈ LinearMap.range (tensorMultiplyLinear (chartLinearForm φ)) := by
  let _ := chartDualModuleStructure φ q hq s
  exact (chartCrossPresentationU φ a hu).cross_kernel

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.chart_dual_cross_kernel_homogeneous_u
statement:
theorem chart_dual_cross_kernel_homogeneous_u
    (φ : BinaryRing K →ₐ[K] A) (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (a : A) (hu : φ (binaryU K) * a = 1) (n : ℕ) :

proof:

    ∀ P : AuxTensor (R := ChartCubicRing φ) (M := Fin 3 → A),

  let _ := chartDualModuleStructure φ q hq s
  intro P hP hcross
  exact (chartCrossPresentationU φ a hu).cross_kernel_homogeneous hP hcross

name: ChoppedPlane.pointEvaluation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointEvaluation_apply {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Forms K 3 d) (i : Fin p) :
    pointEvaluation K a d f i = eval (chartPoint K a i) f.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_pointDegreePiece
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_pointDegreePiece {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Forms K 3 d) :
    f ∈ pointDegreePiece K a d ↔ ∀ i, eval (chartPoint K a i) f.val = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [pointDegreePiece, LinearMap.mem_ker, funext_iff]

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous
statement:
theorem pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    pointDegreeSpace K a d ≤ Forms K 3 d
proof:
:= by
  rintro f ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  exact g.property

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_eq_rank
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_eq_rank {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    pointHilbertFunction K a d = finrank K (pointEvaluation K a d).range
proof:
:=
  (pointEvaluation K a d).quotKerEquivRange.finrank_eq

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_le
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_le {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    pointHilbertFunction K a d ≤ min ((d + 2).choose 2) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointHilbertFunction_eq_rank]
  apply le_min
  · simpa [finrank_plane_forms] using (pointEvaluation K a d).finrank_range_le
  · have h := Submodule.finrank_le (pointEvaluation K a d).range
    simpa [Module.finrank_pi_fintype] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.sub_substitution_mem
statement:
theorem sub_substitution_mem (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) (q : Fin 3 → Poly K 3)
    (hq : ∀ i, X i - q i ∈ I) (f : Poly K 3) :
    f - eval₂ C q f ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  let π := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  have heq : π.comp (eval₂Hom C q) = π := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      simp [π]
    · intro i
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, eval₂Hom_X']
      exact (Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr (hq i)).symm
  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp
  exact (congrArg (fun h : Poly K 3 →+* Poly K 3 ⧸ I => h f) heq).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_mem_singlePointIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneous_mem_singlePointIdeal_iff {d : ℕ} (a b : K)
    (f : Forms K 3 d) :
    f.val ∈ singlePointIdeal K a b ↔ eval ![a, b, 1] f.val = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I := singlePointIdeal K a b
  let v : Fin 3 → K := ![a, b, 1]
  let q : Fin 3 → Poly K 3 := fun i => X 2 * C (v i)
  have hq : ∀ i, X i - q i ∈ I := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp [q, v, mul_comm])
    · exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp [q, v, mul_comm])
    · simp [q, v, I]
  have hs : eval₂ C q f.val = X 2 ^ d * C (eval v f.val) := by
    rw [homogeneous_eval₂_scale f.property C (fun i => C (v i)) (X 2)]
    congr 1
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using (MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp_left C (RingHom.id K) v f.val).symm
  constructor
  · intro hf
    have hle : I ≤ RingHom.ker (eval v) := by
      apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      rintro g (rfl | rfl) <;> simp [v]
    exact hle hf
  · intro hf
    change eval v f.val = 0 at hf
    have hz : eval₂ C q f.val = 0 := by simpa [hf] using hs
    have hh := sub_substitution_mem I q hq f.val
    simpa [hz, I] using hh

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Forms K 3 d) :
    f.val ∈ pointIdeal K a ↔ f ∈ pointDegreePiece K a d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pointIdeal, Ideal.mem_iInf, mem_pointDegreePiece]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro i
  exact homogeneous_mem_singlePointIdeal_iff _ _ f

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedIdeal_le_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem choppedIdeal_le_pointIdeal {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    choppedIdeal K a d ≤ pointIdeal K a
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  rintro f ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  exact (homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff a g).mpr hg

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_eq_zero_of_chart_evaluations
statement:
theorem homogeneous_eq_zero_of_chart_evaluations [Infinite K] {d : ℕ}
    (f : Forms K 3 d) (h : ∀ a b : K, eval ![a, b, 1] f.val = 0) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (X 2 : Poly K 3) * f.val = 0 := by
    apply MvPolynomial.funext
    intro v
    simp only [map_mul, eval_X, map_zero]
    by_cases hv : v 2 = 0
    · simp [hv]
    · have he : (fun i : Fin 3 => v 2 * (![v 0 / v 2, v 1 / v 2, 1] : Fin 3 → K) i) = v := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hv]
      have hs := homogeneous_eval_scale f.property
        (![v 0 / v 2, v 1 / v 2, 1] : Fin 3 → K) (v 2)
      rw [he, h] at hs
      simp [hs]
  have hf : f.val = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero 2)
  exact Subtype.ext hf

name: ChoppedPlane.chart_evaluations_span_dual
statement:
theorem chart_evaluations_span_dual [Infinite K] (d : ℕ) :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun u : Fin 2 → K =>
      evaluationLinear K 3 d ![u 0, u 1, 1])) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_eq_top_of_ne_zero
  intro f hf
  by_contra! h
  apply hf
  apply homogeneous_eq_zero_of_chart_evaluations f
  intro a b
  exact h (evaluationLinear K 3 d ![a, b, 1]) ⟨![a, b], by simp⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_independent_chart_evaluations
statement:
theorem exists_independent_chart_evaluations [Infinite K] (d q : ℕ)
    (hq : q ≤ (d + 2).choose 2) :
    ∃ u : Fin q → Fin 2 → K,
      LinearIndependent K (fun i => evaluationLinear K 3 d ![u i 0, u i 1, 1])
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction q with
  | zero => exact ⟨Fin.elim0, linearIndependent_empty_type⟩
  | succ q ih =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := ih (by omega)
      let W := Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun i => evaluationLinear K 3 d ![u i 0, u i 1, 1]))
      have hW : finrank K W = q := by
        simp [W, finrank_span_eq_card hu]
      have hproper : W ≠ ⊤ := by
        intro heq
        have ht : finrank K W = (d + 2).choose 2 := by
          rw [heq, finrank_top, Subspace.dual_finrank_eq, finrank_plane_forms]
        omega
      have hex : ∃ v : Fin 2 → K, evaluationLinear K 3 d ![v 0, v 1, 1] ∉ W := by
        by_contra! h
        have hle : Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun v : Fin 2 → K =>
            evaluationLinear K 3 d ![v 0, v 1, 1])) ≤ W := by
          apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
          rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
          exact h v
        rw [chart_evaluations_span_dual d] at hle
        exact hproper (top_le_iff.mp hle)
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hex
      let u' : Fin (q + 1) → Fin 2 → K := Fin.snoc u v
      refine ⟨u', ?_⟩
      have heq : (fun i : Fin (q + 1) =>
          evaluationLinear K 3 d ![u' i 0, u' i 1, 1]) =
          Fin.snoc (fun i => evaluationLinear K 3 d ![u i 0, u i 1, 1])
            (evaluationLinear K 3 d ![v 0, v 1, 1]) := by
        funext i
        refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> simp [u']
      rw [heq]
      exact linearIndependent_finSnoc.mpr ⟨hu, hv⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_pointHilbertFunction_maximal
statement:
theorem exists_pointHilbertFunction_maximal [Infinite K] (p d : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : PointCoordinates K p,
      pointHilbertFunction K a d = min ((d + 2).choose 2) p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := min ((d + 2).choose 2) p
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_independent_chart_evaluations (K := K) d q (min_le_left _ _)
  let a : PointCoordinates K p := fun ik =>
    if h : ik.1.val < q then u ⟨ik.1.val, h⟩ ik.2 else 0
  refine ⟨a, le_antisymm (pointHilbertFunction_le a) ?_⟩
  rw [pointHilbertFunction_eq_rank, ← LinearMap.finrank_range_dualMap_eq_finrank_range]
  have hle : Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun i =>
      evaluationLinear K 3 d ![u i 0, u i 1, 1])) ≤ (pointEvaluation K a d).dualMap.range := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨LinearMap.proj (Fin.castLE (min_le_right _ _) i), ?_⟩
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro f
    have ha : chartPoint K a (Fin.castLE (min_le_right _ _) i) = ![u i 0, u i 1, 1] := by
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [chartPoint, a, i.isLt]
    simp [LinearMap.dualMap_apply, pointEvaluation, evaluationLinear, ha]
  have hdim := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
  simpa only [finrank_span_eq_card hu, Fintype.card_fin] using hdim

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_combination_adjugate_chart
statement:
theorem polynomial_combination_adjugate_chart
    (r : α → (ι → K) → V) (l : κ → (ι → K) → V)
    (hr : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (r i))
    (hl : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (l i))
    (a₀ : ι → K)
    (h₀ : Function.Bijective
      (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a₀) (fun i => l i a₀)))) :
    ∃ (D : MvPolynomial ι K)
      (R : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] (Sum α κ → K))),
      eval a₀ D = 1 ∧ IsPolynomialFamily R ∧
      ∀ a,
        (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a) (fun i => l i a))).comp
          (R a) = (eval a D) • LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F (a : ι → K) :=
    finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a) (fun i => l i a))
  let bS := Pi.basisFun K (Sum α κ)
  let e : (Sum α κ → K) ≃ₗ[K] V := LinearEquiv.ofBijective (F a₀) h₀
  let bV := bS.map e
  have hF : IsPolynomialFamily F := by
    apply finiteCombination_isPolynomialFamily
    intro i
    cases i with
    | inl j => exact hr j
    | inr j => exact hl j
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := polynomial_matrix_representation bS bV F hF
  let D : MvPolynomial ι K := P.det
  let R (a : ι → K) : V →ₗ[K] (Sum α κ → K) :=
    Matrix.toLin bV bS (P.adjugate.map (eval a))
  have hR : IsPolynomialFamily R := isPolynomialFamily_matrix_toLin bV bS P.adjugate
  have hD (a : ι → K) : eval a D = (LinearMap.toMatrix bS bV (F a)).det := by
    dsimp [D]
    rw [(eval a).map_det]
    change (P.map (eval a)).det = _
    rw [hP]
  have hP₀ : LinearMap.toMatrix bS bV (F a₀) = 1 := by
    ext i j
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    change bV.repr (bV j) i = _
    simp only [Basis.repr_self_apply, Matrix.one_apply, eq_comm]
  refine ⟨D, R, ?_, hR, ?_⟩
  · rw [hD, hP₀, Matrix.det_one]
  · intro a
    have hs := congrArg (Matrix.toLin bV bV)
      (Matrix.mul_adjugate (LinearMap.toMatrix bS bV (F a)))
    have hadj : P.adjugate.map (eval a) = (P.map (eval a)).adjugate :=
      (eval a).map_adjugate P
    dsimp [R]
    rw [hadj, hP]
    rw [Matrix.toLin_mul bV bS bV, Matrix.toLin_toMatrix, map_smul,
      Matrix.toLin_one, ← hD] at hs
    exact hs

name: ChoppedPlane.combined_quotient_coordinates
statement:
theorem combined_quotient_coordinates
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module K A]
    (q : V →ₗ[K] A) (r : α → V) (l : κ → V) (b : Basis κ K A)
    (hr : ∀ i, q (r i) = 0) (hl : ∀ i, q (l i) = b i)
    (c : Sum α κ → K) (k : κ) :
    b.repr (q (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim r l) c)) k = c (.inr k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finiteCombination_apply, map_sum, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp only [map_smul, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, hr, hl, smul_zero,
    Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
  exact congrFun (b.repr_sum_self (fun i => c (.inr i))) k

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_relations_for_quotient_basis
statement:
theorem polynomial_relations_for_quotient_basis
    {U W : Type*} [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [FiniteDimensional K U]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (E : (ι → K) → (U →ₗ[K] V)) (hE : IsPolynomialFamily E)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (q : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (hker : LinearMap.range (E a₀) = LinearMap.ker q)
    (b : Basis κ K W) (l : κ → V) (hl : ∀ i, q (l i) = b i) :
    ∃ r : Fin (finrank K (LinearMap.range (E a₀))) → (ι → K) → V,
      (∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (r i)) ∧
      (∀ a i, r i a ∈ LinearMap.range (E a)) ∧
      Function.Bijective
        (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a₀) l))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let bR := Module.finBasis K (LinearMap.range (E a₀))
  choose u hu using fun i => (bR i).property
  let r (i : Fin (finrank K (LinearMap.range (E a₀)))) (a : ι → K) := E a (u i)
  have hr (i) : r i a₀ = (bR i).val := hu i
  let F := finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a₀) l)
  have hs : Function.Surjective F := by
    intro v
    let c : κ → K := fun i => b.repr (q v) i
    let w := v - ∑ i, c i • l i
    have hw : w ∈ LinearMap.range (E a₀) := by
      rw [hker]
      change q w = 0
      simp only [w, map_sub, map_sum, map_smul, hl, c, b.sum_repr, sub_self]
    let wR : LinearMap.range (E a₀) := ⟨w, hw⟩
    refine ⟨Sum.elim (fun i => bR.repr wR i) c, ?_⟩
    change finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a₀) l) _ = v
    rw [finiteCombination_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, hr]
    have hsum : ∑ i, bR.repr wR i • (bR i).val = w := by
      simpa only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul] using
        congrArg Subtype.val (bR.sum_repr wR)
    rw [hsum]
    exact sub_add_cancel v _
  have hsq : Function.Surjective q := by
    intro w
    refine ⟨∑ i, b.repr w i • l i, ?_⟩
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, hl, b.sum_repr]
  have hdim := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker q
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsq, finrank_top, ← hker,
    Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b] at hdim
  have heqdim : finrank K
      (Sum (Fin (finrank K (LinearMap.range (E a₀)))) κ → K) = finrank K V := by
    simp only [Module.finrank_pi, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  have hi : Function.Injective F :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank heqdim).mpr hs
  exact ⟨r, fun i => hE.linear_comp (LinearMap.applyₗ (R := K) (u i)),
    fun a i => ⟨u i, rfl⟩, hi, hs⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_quotient_multiplication_chart
statement:
theorem polynomial_quotient_multiplication_chart
    (H₀ : MvPolynomial ι K)
    (b : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 → Basis κ K (A a))
    (q : ∀ a, V →ₗ[K] A a)
    (r : α → (ι → K) → V) (l : κ → (ι → K) → V)
    (p : κ → κ → (ι → K) → V)
    (hrpoly : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (r i))
    (hlpoly : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (l i))
    (hppoly : ∀ i j, IsPolynomialFamily (p i j))
    (hr : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 → ∀ i, q a (r i a) = 0)
    (hl : ∀ a (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) i, q a (l i a) = b a ha i)
    (hp : ∀ a (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) i j,
      q a (p i j a) = b a ha i * b a ha j)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hH₀ : eval a₀ H₀ ≠ 0)
    (h₀ : Function.Bijective
      (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a₀) (fun i => l i a₀)))) :
    ∃ (H : MvPolynomial ι K)
      (M : κ → Matrix κ κ (MvPolynomial ι K)),
      eval a₀ H ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ a, eval a H ≠ 0 → eval a H₀ ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0),
        ∀ i, (M i).map (eval a) = (eval a H) •
          Algebra.leftMulMatrix (b a ha) (b a ha i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, R, hD₀, hR, hFR⟩ :=
    polynomial_combination_adjugate_chart r l hrpoly hlpoly a₀ h₀
  have hmPoly (i j k : κ) :
      IsPolynomialFamily (fun a => R a (p i j a) (.inr k)) := by
    have h := hR.bilinear (hppoly i j) (LinearMap.id :
      (V →ₗ[K] (Sum α κ → K)) →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] (Sum α κ → K))
    exact h.linear_comp (LinearMap.proj (.inr k))
  choose m hm using fun i j k => hmPoly i j k LinearMap.id
  let N : κ → Matrix κ κ (MvPolynomial ι K) := fun i k j => m i j k
  have hN (a : ι → K) (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) (i : κ) :
      (N i).map (eval a) = (eval a D) •
        Algebra.leftMulMatrix (b a ha) (b a ha i) := by
    ext k j
    rw [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Algebra.leftMulMatrix_eq_repr_mul]
    have hc := combined_quotient_coordinates (q a) (fun i => r i a)
      (fun i => l i a) (b a ha) (hr a ha) (hl a ha) (R a (p i j a)) k
    have hf := LinearMap.congr_fun (hFR a) (p i j a)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at hf
    rw [hf, map_smul, hp a ha i j, map_smul] at hc
    simpa only [N, LinearMap.id_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using
      (hm i j k a).trans hc.symm
  refine ⟨H₀ * D, fun i => H₀ • N i, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_mul, hD₀, mul_one]
    exact hH₀
  · intro a ha
    exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simpa only [map_mul] using ha)).1
  · intro a ha i
    rw [Matrix.map_smul' (eval a) H₀ (N i) (eval a).map_mul,
      hN a ha i, smul_smul, ← map_mul]

name: ChoppedPlane.reduced_principal_open_of_polynomial_quotient_chart
statement:
theorem reduced_principal_open_of_polynomial_quotient_chart
    (H₀ : MvPolynomial ι K)
    (b : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 → Basis κ K (A a))
    (q : ∀ a, V →ₗ[K] A a)
    (r : α → (ι → K) → V) (l : κ → (ι → K) → V)
    (p : κ → κ → (ι → K) → V)
    (hrpoly : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (r i))
    (hlpoly : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (l i))
    (hppoly : ∀ i j, IsPolynomialFamily (p i j))
    (hr : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 → ∀ i, q a (r i a) = 0)
    (hl : ∀ a (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) i, q a (l i a) = b a ha i)
    (hp : ∀ a (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) i j,
      q a (p i j a) = b a ha i * b a ha j)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hH₀ : eval a₀ H₀ ≠ 0)
    (h₀ : Function.Bijective
      (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a₀) (fun i => l i a₀))))
    (e : A a₀ ≃ₐ[K] (κ → K)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → IsReduced (A a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨H, M, hH, hH₀chart, hM⟩ :=
    polynomial_quotient_multiplication_chart A H₀ b q r l p
      hrpoly hlpoly hppoly hr hl hp a₀ hH₀ h₀
  let bH (a : ι → K) (ha : eval a H ≠ 0) : Basis κ K (A a) :=
    b a (hH₀chart a ha)
  exact reduced_principal_open_of_split_chart A M H bH
    (fun a ha i => hM a (hH₀chart a ha) i) a₀ hH e

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointHilbertFunction_below_generatingDegree
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_below_generatingDegree (δ : Fin (c+1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (hδ : ∀ i, δ i = 1 ∨ δ i = 2) (hsum : (∑ i, δ i) = d+2)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t < d) :
    pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates δ α β) t = N t
proof:
:= by
  have h := pointHilbertFunction_formula δ α β hα hβ t
  rw [hsum] at h
  have hnat : (t : ℤ) < d := by exact_mod_cast ht
  have hneg : (t : ℤ) - ((d+2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < 0 := by omega
  have hi (i : Fin (c+1)) : N₂ ((t : ℤ) - ((d+2 : ℕ) : ℤ) + δ i) = 0 := by
    apply N₂_neg
    rcases hδ i with hh | hh <;> rw [hh] <;> omega
  simp_rw [hi] at h
  rw [N₂_neg hneg,N₂_nat] at h
  simp only [Finset.sum_const_zero,sub_zero,mul_zero,add_zero] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointHilbertFunction_at_generatingDegree
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_at_generatingDegree (δ : Fin (c+1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (hδ : ∀ i, δ i = 1 ∨ δ i = 2) (hsum : (∑ i, δ i) = d+2)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ) = N d - quadraticRowCount δ) :
    pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates δ α β) d = Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := pointHilbertFunction_formula δ α β hα hβ d
  rw [hsum] at h
  have hneg : (d : ℤ) - ((d+2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < 0 := by omega
  have hi (i : Fin (c+1)) :
      N₂ ((d : ℤ) - ((d+2 : ℕ) : ℤ) + δ i) = if δ i = 2 then 1 else 0 := by
    rcases hδ i with hh | hh
    · rw [hh]
      have ht : (d : ℤ) - ((d+2 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 = -1 := by omega
      norm_num [ht,N₂]
    · rw [hh]
      have ht : (d : ℤ) - ((d+2 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 2 = 0 := by omega
      norm_num [ht,N₂,N]
  simp_rw [hi] at h
  rw [N₂_neg hneg,N₂_nat] at h
  have hcount : (∑ i : Fin (c+1), if δ i = 2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) =
      (quadraticRowCount δ : ℤ) := by
    simp [quadraticRowCount]
  rw [hcount] at h
  simp only [mul_zero,add_zero] at h
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointEvaluation_surjective_at_generatingDegree
statement:
theorem pointEvaluation_surjective_at_generatingDegree (δ : Fin (c+1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (hδ : ∀ i, δ i = 1 ∨ δ i = 2) (hsum : (∑ i, δ i) = d+2)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ) = N d - quadraticRowCount δ) :
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K (pointCoordinates δ α β) d)
proof:
:=
  pointEvaluation_surjective_of_hilbert_eq _
    (pointHilbertFunction_at_generatingDegree δ α β hα hβ hδ hsum hcard)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.fullPointHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem fullPointHilbertFunction (δ : Fin (c+1) → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (hδ : ∀ i, δ i = 1 ∨ δ i = 2) (hsum : (∑ i, δ i) = d+2)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ) = N d - quadraticRowCount δ) (t : ℕ) :
    pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates δ α β) t =
      min (N t) (Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : t < d
  · have hf := pointHilbertFunction_below_generatingDegree δ α β hα hβ hδ hsum ht
    have hle := pointHilbertFunction_le (d := t) (pointCoordinates δ α β)
    change _ ≤ min (N t) _ at hle
    rw [hf] at hle ⊢
    exact le_antisymm hle (min_le_left _ _)
  · have hf := pointHilbertFunction_constant_above (pointCoordinates δ α β)
      (Nat.le_of_not_gt ht) (pointHilbertFunction_at_generatingDegree δ α β hα hβ hδ hsum hcard)
    have hle := pointHilbertFunction_le (d := t) (pointCoordinates δ α β)
    change _ ≤ min (N t) _ at hle
    rw [hf] at hle ⊢
    exact le_antisymm hle (min_le_right _ _)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.selected_card_one_two
statement:
theorem selected_card_one_two (δ : Fin (c+1) → ℕ)
    (hδ : ∀ i, δ i = 1 ∨ δ i = 2) (hsum : (∑ i, δ i) = d+2) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ) = N d - quadraticRowCount δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hi (i : Fin (c+1)) : δ i ^ 2 = δ i + 2 * (if δ i = 2 then 1 else 0) := by
    rcases hδ i with hh | hh <;> simp [hh]
  have hsquares : (∑ i, δ i ^ 2) = d+2+2*quadraticRowCount δ := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i, (δ i + 2 * (if δ i = 2 then 1 else 0)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact hi i
      _ = (∑ i, δ i) + 2 * ∑ i, (if δ i = 2 then 1 else 0) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = _ := by simp [hsum,quadraticRowCount]
  exact selected_card_of_sums δ d (quadraticRowCount δ) hsum hsquares

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointEvaluation_surjective_one_two
statement:
theorem pointEvaluation_surjective_one_two (δ : Fin (c+1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (hδ : ∀ i, δ i = 1 ∨ δ i = 2) (hsum : (∑ i, δ i) = d+2) :
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K (pointCoordinates δ α β) d)
proof:
:=
  pointEvaluation_surjective_at_generatingDegree δ α β hα hβ hδ hsum
    (selected_card_one_two δ hδ hsum)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.fullPointHilbertFunction_one_two
statement:
theorem fullPointHilbertFunction_one_two (δ : Fin (c+1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (hδ : ∀ i, δ i = 1 ∨ δ i = 2) (hsum : (∑ i, δ i) = d+2) (t : ℕ) :
    pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates δ α β) t =
      min (N t) (Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ))
proof:
:=
  fullPointHilbertFunction δ α β hα hβ hδ hsum (selected_card_one_two δ hδ hsum) t

name: ChoppedPlane.N_monotone
statement: lemma N_monotone : Monotone N
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  exact Nat.choose_mono 2 (by omega : a + 2 ≤ b + 2)

name: ChoppedPlane.N_strictMono
statement: lemma N_strictMono : StrictMono N
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro t
  rw [N_succ]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.expectedSyzygyDegree_spec
statement:
lemma expectedSyzygyDegree_spec (p : ℕ) :
    IsExpectedSyzygyDegree (expectedSyzygyDegree p) p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · unfold expectedSyzygyDegree
    exact Nat.find_spec (p := fun d => p ≤ N d) _
  · intro t ht
    unfold expectedSyzygyDegree at ht
    exact Nat.lt_of_not_ge (Nat.find_min (p := fun d => p ≤ N d) _ ht)

name: ChoppedPlane.isExpectedSyzygyDegree_lower
statement:
lemma isExpectedSyzygyDegree_lower {d p : ℕ} (h : IsExpectedSyzygyDegree d p)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) : N (d - 1) < p
proof: := h.2 _ (by omega)

name: ChoppedPlane.koszulCoefficient_zero
statement: lemma koszulCoefficient_zero (d t : ℕ) : koszulCoefficient d 0 t = N t
proof:
:= by
  simp [koszulCoefficient]

name: ChoppedPlane.koszulCoefficient_small
statement:
lemma koszulCoefficient_small (d r t : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ 2) :
    koszulCoefficient d r t = completeIntersectionCoefficient d r t
proof:
:= by
  interval_cases r <;>
    norm_num [koszulCoefficient, completeIntersectionCoefficient,
      Finset.sum_range_succ] <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.koszulCoefficient_before_second
statement:
lemma koszulCoefficient_before_second {d r t : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (ht : t < 2 * d) :
    koszulCoefficient d r t = N t - (r : ℤ) * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - d)
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℕ → ℤ := fun k =>
    (-1 : ℤ)^k * (r.choose k : ℤ) * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - (k : ℤ) * d)
  have hsum : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range 2, F k) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), F k := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (show 2 ≤ r + 1 by omega))
    intro k hk hknot
    have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hknot; omega
    have hkd : 2 * d ≤ k * d := Nat.mul_le_mul_right d hk2
    have hnegative : (t : ℤ) - (k : ℤ) * d < 0 := by
      have hcast : (t : ℤ) < (k : ℤ) * d := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : t < k * d)
      omega
    simp [F, N₂_neg hnegative]
  change (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), F k) = _
  rw [← hsum]
  simp [F, Finset.sum_range_succ, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: ChoppedPlane.koszulCoefficient_at_excess_before_second
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulCoefficient_before_second hr (by omega)]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, add_sub_cancel_left, N₂_nat]
  dsimp [residual]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.koszulCoefficient_below_degree
statement:
lemma koszulCoefficient_below_degree {d r t : ℕ} (ht : t < d) :
    koszulCoefficient d r t = N t
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℕ → ℤ := fun k =>
    (-1 : ℤ)^k * (r.choose k : ℤ) * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - (k : ℤ) * d)
  have hsum : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range 1, F k) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), F k := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (show 1 ≤ r + 1 by omega))
    intro k hk hknot
    have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hknot; omega
    have hkd : d ≤ k * d := by simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_right d hk1
    have hnegative : (t : ℤ) - (k : ℤ) * d < 0 := by
      have hcast : (t : ℤ) < (k : ℤ) * d := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : t < k * d)
      omega
    simp [F, N₂_neg hnegative]
  change (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), F k) = _
  rw [← hsum]
  simp [F]

name: ChoppedPlane.koszulPrefixHit_iff_cutoff_le
statement:
lemma koszulPrefixHit_iff_cutoff_le {d p : ℕ}
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d)
    (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p) (e : ℕ) :
    koszulPrefixHit d p e ↔ cutoff d (N d - p) ≤ e
proof:
:= by
  let r := N d - p
  have hr' : 3 ≤ r := hr
  have hrd := (generator_count_bounds (by omega) hlo hhi).2
  have hcut : cutoff d r < d := cutoff_lt_degree hd hr' hrd
  have hcast : (N d : ℤ) - r = (p : ℤ) := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hhi.le]
    ring
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, hqe, hhit⟩
    by_cases hqd : q < d
    · rw [koszulCoefficient_at_excess_before_second (by omega : 1 ≤ r) hqd,
        hcast] at hhit
      exact ((residual_nonpos_iff_cutoff_le hr' hq).mp (by omega)).trans hqe
    · change cutoff d r ≤ e
      omega
  · intro he
    refine ⟨cutoff d r, cutoff_pos d r, he, ?_⟩
    rw [koszulCoefficient_at_excess_before_second (by omega : 1 ≤ r) hcut, hcast]
    have := residual_nonpos_at_cutoff (d := d) hr'
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.completeIntersectionCoefficient_one_excess
statement:
lemma completeIntersectionCoefficient_one_excess (d e : ℕ) :
    completeIntersectionCoefficient d 1 (d + e) = (N d : ℤ) - 1 + (d : ℤ) * e
proof:
:= by
  have h := twice_residual d 1 e
  simp only [Nat.cast_one] at h
  have hc : completeIntersectionCoefficient d 1 (d + e) =
      (N d : ℤ) - 1 + residual d 1 e := by
    simp only [completeIntersectionCoefficient, Nat.cast_add, add_sub_cancel_left,
      N₂_nat]
    norm_num
    rw [show (d : ℤ) + e = ((d + e : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; rfl, N₂_nat]
    dsimp [residual]
    ring
  rw [hc]
  nlinarith

name: ChoppedPlane.completeIntersectionCoefficient_two_late
statement:
lemma completeIntersectionCoefficient_two_late {d e : ℕ} (he : d ≤ e) :
    completeIntersectionCoefficient d 2 (d + e) = (d : ℤ)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : ((d + e : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * d = ((e - d : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub he]
    push_cast
    ring
  have h0 := twice_N (d + e)
  have h1 := twice_N e
  have h2 := twice_N (e - d)
  rw [Nat.cast_sub he] at h2
  push_cast at h0
  simp only [completeIntersectionCoefficient]
  rw [hshift, show ((d + e : ℕ) : ℤ) - d = (e : ℤ) by push_cast; ring,
    N₂_nat, N₂_nat, N₂_nat]
  norm_num
  nlinarith

name: ChoppedPlane.completeIntersectionCoefficient_two_ge_point
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 2 ≤ N d := by have := N_ge_degree_add_one d; omega
  have hp : (p : ℤ) = (N d : ℤ) - 2 := by
    rw [hcount, Nat.cast_sub hn]
    norm_num
  by_cases he : e < d
  · rw [← koszulCoefficient_small d 2 (d + e) (by decide),
      koszulCoefficient_at_excess_before_second (by decide) he]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rw [← hp]
    have h := twice_residual d 2 e
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_one, sub_self, sub_zero] at h
    have hdZ : 2 ≤ (d : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
    have heZ : (e : ℤ) ≤ (d : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hfactor : 0 ≤ 2 * (d : ℤ) - 3 - e := by omega
    have hproduct := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ (e : ℤ) by omega) hfactor
    nlinarith
  · rw [completeIntersectionCoefficient_two_late (by omega)]
    have h := twice_N d
    have hdZ : 2 ≤ (d : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
    rw [hp]
    nlinarith

name: ChoppedPlane.completeIntersectionCoefficient_two_hit_degree
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 2 ≤ N d := by have := N_ge_degree_add_one d; omega
  have hp : (p : ℤ) = (N d : ℤ) - 2 := by
    rw [hcount, Nat.cast_sub hn]
    norm_num
  by_cases hqd : q < d
  · rw [← koszulCoefficient_small d 2 (d + q) (by decide),
      koszulCoefficient_at_excess_before_second (by decide) hqd] at hhit
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hhit
    rw [← hp] at hhit
    have h := twice_residual d 2 q
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_one, sub_self, sub_zero] at h
    have hqZ : 0 < (q : ℤ) := by omega
    have hf : 2 * (d : ℤ) - 3 - q ≤ 0 := by
      apply nonpos_of_mul_nonpos_right _ hqZ
      nlinarith
    omega
  · rw [completeIntersectionCoefficient_two_late (by omega), hp] at hhit
    have h := twice_N d
    have hdZ : 2 ≤ (d : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
    have hle : d ≤ 2 := by nlinarith
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.completeIntersectionCoefficient_two_quadrics
statement:
lemma completeIntersectionCoefficient_two_quadrics {e : ℕ} (he : 1 ≤ e) :
    completeIntersectionCoefficient 2 2 (2 + e) = 4
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he2 : 2 ≤ e
  · rw [completeIntersectionCoefficient_two_late he2]
    norm_num
  · have : e = 1 := by omega
    subst e
    norm_num [completeIntersectionCoefficient, N₂, N]
    decide

name: ChoppedPlane.koszulPrefixHit_none_of_full_count
statement:
lemma koszulPrefixHit_none_of_full_count {d p : ℕ} (hcount : p = N d) (e : ℕ) :
    ¬ koszulPrefixHit d p e
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨q, hq, _, hhit⟩
  rw [hcount, Nat.sub_self, koszulCoefficient_zero] at hhit
  have hlt : N d < N (d + q) := N_strictMono (by omega)
  exact (by exact_mod_cast hlt : (N d : ℤ) < N (d + q)).not_ge hhit

name: ChoppedPlane.koszulPrefixHit_none_of_one_generator
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨q, hq, _, hhit⟩
  rw [hr, koszulCoefficient_small d 1 (d + q) (by decide),
    completeIntersectionCoefficient_one_excess] at hhit
  have hp : (N d : ℤ) - 1 = (p : ℤ) := by omega
  rw [hp] at hhit
  have hprod : 0 < (d : ℤ) * q := mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.koszulCoefficient_small_ge_point
statement:
lemma koszulCoefficient_small_ge_point {d p : ℕ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hupper : p ≤ N d)
    (hr : N d - p ≤ 2) (e : ℕ) :
    (p : ℤ) ≤ koszulCoefficient d (N d - p) (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr0 : N d - p = 0
  · rw [hr0, koszulCoefficient_zero]
    exact_mod_cast hupper.trans (N_monotone (by omega : d ≤ d + e))
  by_cases hr1 : N d - p = 1
  · rw [hr1, koszulCoefficient_small d 1 (d + e) (by decide),
      completeIntersectionCoefficient_one_excess]
    have hp : (N d : ℤ) - 1 = (p : ℤ) := by omega
    have : 0 ≤ (d : ℤ) * e := mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
    omega
  · have hr2 : N d - p = 2 := by omega
    have hhi : p < N d := by omega
    have hbound := (generator_count_bounds hd hlo hhi).2
    have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by omega
    rw [hr2, koszulCoefficient_small d 2 (d + e) (by decide)]
    exact completeIntersectionCoefficient_two_ge_point hd2 (by omega)

name: ChoppedPlane.koszulCoefficient_eq_point_of_small_hit
statement:
lemma koszulCoefficient_eq_point_of_small_hit {d p e : ℕ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hupper : p ≤ N d)
    (hr : N d - p ≤ 2) (hhit : koszulPrefixHit d p e) :
    koszulCoefficient d (N d - p) (d + e) = p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr0 : N d - p = 0
  · exact False.elim (koszulPrefixHit_none_of_full_count (by omega) e hhit)
  by_cases hr1 : N d - p = 1
  · exact False.elim (koszulPrefixHit_none_of_one_generator hd hr1 e hhit)
  have hr2 : N d - p = 2 := by omega
  have hhi : p < N d := by omega
  have hbound := (generator_count_bounds hd hlo hhi).2
  have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by omega
  rcases hhit with ⟨q, hq, hqe, hhit⟩
  rw [hr2, koszulCoefficient_small d 2 (d + q) (by decide)] at hhit
  have hdEq := completeIntersectionCoefficient_two_hit_degree hd2 (by omega) hq hhit
  subst d
  have hp : p = 4 := by norm_num [N, Nat.choose] at hr2; omega
  rw [hr2, koszulCoefficient_small 2 2 (2 + e) (by decide),
    completeIntersectionCoefficient_two_quadrics (by omega), hp]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.expectedSyzygyCoefficient_small_excess
statement:
lemma expectedSyzygyCoefficient_small_excess {d p : ℕ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hupper : p ≤ N d)
    (hr : N d - p ≤ 2) (e : ℕ) :
    expectedSyzygyCoefficient d p (d + e) =
      completeIntersectionCoefficient d (N d - p) (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [expectedSyzygyCoefficient, show ¬d + e < d by omega, ite_false,
    Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  by_cases hhit : koszulPrefixHit d p e
  · rw [ite_eq_left hhit, ← koszulCoefficient_small d (N d - p) (d + e) hr,
      koszulCoefficient_eq_point_of_small_hit hd hlo hupper hr hhit]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hhit, koszulCoefficient_small d (N d - p) (d + e) hr]

name: ChoppedPlane.expectedSyzygyCoefficient_many_excess
statement:
lemma expectedSyzygyCoefficient_many_excess {d p : ℕ}
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d)
    (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p) (e : ℕ) :
    expectedSyzygyCoefficient d p (d + e) =
      ((max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e) : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r := N d - p
  have hr' : 3 ≤ r := hr
  have hrd := (generator_count_bounds (by omega) hlo hhi).2
  have hcut : cutoff d r < d := cutoff_lt_degree hd hr' hrd
  have hp : (N d : ℤ) - r = (p : ℤ) := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hhi.le]
    ring
  have hraw : (N (d + e) : ℤ) - (r : ℤ) * N e =
      (p : ℤ) + residual d r e := by dsimp [residual]; omega
  rw [cast_max_sub]
  change expectedSyzygyCoefficient d p (d + e) =
    max (p : ℤ) ((N (d + e) : ℤ) - (r : ℤ) * N e)
  rw [hraw]
  simp only [expectedSyzygyCoefficient, show ¬d + e < d by omega, ite_false,
    Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  by_cases hhit : koszulPrefixHit d p e
  · rw [ite_eq_left hhit]
    have he := (koszulPrefixHit_iff_cutoff_le hd hlo hhi hr e).mp hhit
    have hn := (residual_nonpos_iff_cutoff_le hr' ((cutoff_pos d r).trans he)).mpr he
    omega
  · rw [ite_eq_right hhit]
    have he : e < cutoff d r := by
      have := (koszulPrefixHit_iff_cutoff_le hd hlo hhi hr e).not.mp hhit
      change ¬cutoff d r ≤ e at this
      omega
    rw [koszulCoefficient_at_excess_before_second (by omega : 1 ≤ r) (by omega), hp]
    by_cases he0 : e = 0
    · subst e
      simp
    · have hpos := (residual_pos_iff_lt_cutoff hr' (by omega : 1 ≤ e)).mpr he
      omega

name: ChoppedPlane.expectedSyzygyCoefficient_eq_expectedChoppedHilbertFunction
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ht : t < d
  · simp [expectedSyzygyCoefficient, expectedChoppedHilbertFunction, ht]
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (by omega : d ≤ t)
  have hlo := isExpectedSyzygyDegree_lower hmin hd
  by_cases hhi : N d ≤ p
  · have hcount : p = N d := Nat.le_antisymm hmin.1 hhi
    have hr0 : N d - p = 0 := by omega
    simp [expectedSyzygyCoefficient, expectedChoppedHilbertFunction,
      show ¬d + e < d by omega, hhi, hr0,
      koszulPrefixHit_none_of_full_count hcount e, koszulCoefficient_zero]
  have hhi' : p < N d := by omega
  have hlofalse : ¬p ≤ N (d - 1) := by omega
  by_cases hr : N d - p ≤ 2
  · rw [expectedSyzygyCoefficient_small_excess hd hlo hmin.1 hr]
    simp only [expectedChoppedHilbertFunction, show ¬d + e < d by omega,
      ite_false, hhi, hlofalse, hr, ite_true]
    have hn := koszulCoefficient_small_ge_point hd hlo hmin.1 hr e
    rw [koszulCoefficient_small d (N d - p) (d + e) hr] at hn
    exact (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)).symm
  · have hr' : 3 ≤ N d - p := by omega
    have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by
      have := (generator_count_bounds hd hlo hhi').2
      omega
    rw [expectedSyzygyCoefficient_many_excess hd2 hlo hhi' hr']
    simp [expectedChoppedHilbertFunction, show ¬d + e < d by omega,
      hhi, hlofalse, hr]

name: ChoppedPlane.expectedSyzygyConclusion_of_mainConclusion
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hmin, hmain.1, hmain.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro t
  rw [hmain.2.2.1 t, ← expectedSyzygyCoefficient_eq_expectedChoppedHilbertFunction hd hmin t]

name: ChoppedPlane.expectedSyzygyCoefficient_degree_zero_one
statement:
lemma expectedSyzygyCoefficient_degree_zero_one (t : ℕ) :
    expectedSyzygyCoefficient 0 1 t = N t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : ¬koszulPrefixHit 0 1 t :=
    koszulPrefixHit_none_of_full_count (d := 0) (p := 1) (by simp) t
  simp [expectedSyzygyCoefficient, hn, koszulCoefficient_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.expectedSyzygyConclusion_degree_zero
statement:
theorem expectedSyzygyConclusion_degree_zero (a : PointCoordinates K 1) :
    ExpectedSyzygyConclusion a 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨by simp, by intro t ht; omega⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j h
    exact Subsingleton.elim i j
  · intro t
    have hdim : pointHilbertFunction K a t = 1 := by
      have h0 : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a 0) := by
        intro y
        refine ⟨⟨MvPolynomial.C (y 0), MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C _ _⟩, ?_⟩
        ext i
        have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        subst i
        simp
      have ht := pointEvaluation_surjective_above a (Nat.zero_le t) h0
      rw [pointHilbertFunction_eq_rank, LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr ht,
        finrank_top]
      simp
    have hn := N_ge_degree_add_one t
    omega
  · intro t
    rw [choppedHilbertFunction_zero a (by decide), expectedSyzygyCoefficient_degree_zero_one]

name: ChoppedPlane.genericExpectedSyzygyConclusion_degree_one
statement:
theorem genericExpectedSyzygyConclusion_degree_one [CharZero K]
    (p : ℕ) (hmin : IsExpectedSyzygyDegree 1 p) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K,
      (∃ a, MvPolynomial.eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, MvPolynomial.eval a D ≠ 0 → ExpectedSyzygyConclusion (K := K) a 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 1 ≤ p := by have := hmin.2 0 (by decide); simp only [N_zero] at this; omega
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := genericChoppedConclusion_degree_one (K := K) p hp
  exact ⟨D, hD, fun a ha => expectedSyzygyConclusion_of_mainConclusion
    (by decide) hmin (hgood a ha)⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.genericExpectedSyzygyConclusion_of_mainStatement
statement:
theorem genericExpectedSyzygyConclusion_of_mainStatement {K : Type} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (hmain : MainStatement) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    GenericExpectedSyzygyConclusion K p
proof:
:= by
  let d := expectedSyzygyDegree p
  have hmin : IsExpectedSyzygyDegree d p := expectedSyzygyDegree_spec p
  by_cases hd0 : d = 0
  · have hp1 : p = 1 := by have := hmin.1; rw [hd0, N_zero] at this; omega
    subst p
    refine ⟨1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨fun _ => 0, by simp⟩
    · intro a ha
      change ExpectedSyzygyConclusion a d
      rw [hd0]
      exact expectedSyzygyConclusion_degree_zero a
  by_cases hd1 : d = 1
  · obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := genericExpectedSyzygyConclusion_degree_one
      (K := K) p (hd1 ▸ hmin)
    refine ⟨D, hD, ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    change ExpectedSyzygyConclusion a d
    rw [hd1]
    exact hgood a ha
  · have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by omega
    obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := hmain K d p hd2 hp
    exact ⟨D, hD, fun a ha => expectedSyzygyConclusion_of_mainConclusion
      (by omega) hmin (hgood a ha)⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.koszulIdealCoefficient_eq
statement:
lemma koszulIdealCoefficient_eq (d r t : ℕ) :
    koszulIdealCoefficient d r t = (N t : ℤ) - koszulCoefficient d r t
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℕ → ℤ := fun k =>
    (-1 : ℤ)^k * (r.choose k : ℤ) * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - (k : ℤ) * d)
  have hsign : koszulIdealCoefficient d r t = -(∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, F (k + 1)) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    have hs : (-1 : ℤ)^(k + 2) = -((-1 : ℤ)^(k + 1)) := by
      rw [show k + 2 = (k + 1) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
      ring
    dsimp [F]
    rw [hs]
    ring
  rw [hsign]
  change -(∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, F (k + 1)) =
    (N t : ℤ) - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), F k
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp [F]

name: ChoppedPlane.expectedSyzygyIdealCoefficient_eq
statement:
lemma expectedSyzygyIdealCoefficient_eq (d p e : ℕ) :
    expectedSyzygyIdealCoefficient d p e =
      (N (d + e) : ℤ) - expectedSyzygyCoefficient d p (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [expectedSyzygyIdealCoefficient, expectedSyzygyCoefficient,
    show ¬d + e < d by omega, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  split_ifs <;> simp [koszulIdealCoefficient_eq]

name: ChoppedPlane.expectedSyzygyConclusion_idealCoefficient
statement:
theorem expectedSyzygyConclusion_idealCoefficient {d p : ℕ}
    {a : PointCoordinates K p} (h : ExpectedSyzygyConclusion a d) (e : ℕ) :
    (Module.finrank K (idealFormPiece (choppedIdeal K a d) (d + e)) : ℤ) =
      expectedSyzygyIdealCoefficient d p e
proof:
:= by
  have hdim := (idealFormPiece (choppedIdeal K a d) (d + e)).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  rw [finrank_idealFormQuotient, idealQuotientHilbertFunction_choppedIdeal,
    finrank_plane_forms] at hdim
  have hcast : (choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) : ℤ) +
      Module.finrank K (idealFormPiece (choppedIdeal K a d) (d + e)) = N (d + e) := by
    exact_mod_cast hdim
  rw [h.2.2.2 (d + e)] at hcast
  rw [expectedSyzygyIdealCoefficient_eq]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.koszulPositiveCutoff_isLeast
proof:
:= by
  have hprefix := (koszulPrefixHit_iff_cutoff_le hd hlo hhi hr
    (cutoff d (N d - p))).mpr le_rfl
  rcases hprefix with ⟨q, hq, hqcut, hhit⟩
  have hcutq := (koszulPrefixHit_iff_cutoff_le hd hlo hhi hr q).mp
    ⟨q, hq, le_rfl, hhit⟩
  have hqeq : q = cutoff d (N d - p) := Nat.le_antisymm hqcut hcutq
  subst q
  refine ⟨⟨cutoff_pos d (N d - p), hhit⟩, ?_⟩
  intro e he
  exact (koszulPrefixHit_iff_cutoff_le hd hlo hhi hr e).mp ⟨e, he.1, le_rfl, he.2⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.expectedSyzygyCoefficient_degree_zero_empty
statement:
lemma expectedSyzygyCoefficient_degree_zero_empty (t : ℕ) :
    expectedSyzygyCoefficient 0 0 t = 0
proof:

name: ChoppedPlane.expectedSyzygyConclusion_empty
statement:
theorem expectedSyzygyConclusion_empty (a : PointCoordinates K 0) :

    simp

name: ChoppedPlane.genericExpectedSyzygyConclusion_empty
statement: theorem genericExpectedSyzygyConclusion_empty : GenericExpectedSyzygyConclusion K 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : expectedSyzygyDegree 0 = 0 := by

    by_contra hnonzero

    simp at this

name: ChoppedPlane.expectedSyzygyStatement_of_mainStatement

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDifferential_surjective_iff_positiveDifferential
statement:
theorem profileDifferential_surjective_iff_positiveDifferential
    (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential (gradedProfileOperators q s r) t) ↔
      Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential (K := K)
        (V := positiveGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) r)
        (W := positiveGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1))
        (profilePositiveOperators q s r) t)
proof:
:= by
  apply operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_of_equiv (K := K)
    (V := GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) r)
    (W := GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) (r+1))
    (V' := positiveGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) r)
    (W' := positiveGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1))
    (gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv (generatorWeights s) r)
    (gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv (generatorWeights s) (r+1))
  intro i v
  simp [profilePositiveOperators]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDifferential_surjective_iff_negativeMultiply_injective
statement:
theorem profileDifferential_surjective_iff_negativeMultiply_injective [CharZero K]
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential (gradedProfileOperators q s r) t) ↔
      Function.Injective (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K)
      (W' := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1))
      (V' := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) r)
      (profileNegativeOperators q hq s r) t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [profileDifferential_surjective_iff_positiveDifferential]
  exact operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_auxiliaryMultiply_injective (K := K)
    (fun i => (generatorWeights s i : ℤ)) r
    (profilePositiveOperators q s r) (profileNegativeOperators q hq s r)
    (profileOperators_residue_adjoint q hq s r) t

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileNegativeMultiply_chart_formula
statement:
theorem profileNegativeMultiply_chart_formula
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) t → negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1)) :
    (fun b => (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K)
      (W' := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1))
      (V' := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) r)
      (profileNegativeOperators q hq s r) t c b).val) =
      fun b => freeNegativePart (freeLaurentEquiv.symm
        (chartFiniteMultiply binaryChartLaurentMap q hq s t
          (fun j => freeLaurentEquiv (c j).val) b))
proof:
:= by
  letI := chartDualModuleStructure (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) q hq s
  letI := cyclicModuleScalarTower (K := K)
    (binaryChartLaurentMap (binaryCubic K))
    (chartDualZ binaryChartLaurentMap q s)
    (chartDualZ_cube binaryChartLaurentMap q hq s)
  let ι : negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1) →ₗ[K]
      (Fin 3 → BinaryLaurent K) :=
    freeLaurentEquiv.toLinearMap.comp (negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1)).subtype
  let ρ : (Fin 3 → BinaryLaurent K) →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K (Fin 3) :=
    freeNegativePart.comp freeLaurentEquiv.symm.toLinearMap
  have hL : (fun i : Fin 3 => (negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) r).subtype.comp
        (profileNegativeOperators q hq s r i)) =
      (fun i : Fin 3 => ρ.comp ((scalarAction (K := K) (chartLinearForm (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) i)).comp ι)) := by
    funext i
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro p
    change freeNegativePart (rawLaurentProfileDualOperators q s i p.val) =
      freeNegativePart (freeLaurentEquiv.symm
        (scalarAction (K := K) (chartLinearForm (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) i)
          (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)))
    rw [← rawLaurentProfileDualOperators_chart_action q hq s i p.val,
      LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hpost := auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_project (K := K)
    (V := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1))
    (W := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) r)
    (P := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1))
    (Q := FreeLaurent K (Fin 3))
    (profileNegativeOperators q hq s r)
    (LinearMap.id : negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1) →ₗ[K] _)
    (negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) r).subtype t c
  have hpost' : (fun b => (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K)
      (W' := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1))
      (V' := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) r)
      (profileNegativeOperators q hq s r) t c b).val) =
      auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (fun i : Fin 3 => (negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) r).subtype.comp
        (profileNegativeOperators q hq s r i)) t c := by
    simpa using hpost.symm
  rw [hpost', hL]
  have hproj := finiteMultiply_project (K := K)
    (R := ChartCubicRing (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)))
    (M := Fin 3 → BinaryLaurent K)
    (P := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1))
    (Q := FreeLaurent K (Fin 3)) (chartLinearForm (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K))) ι ρ t c
  simpa only [ι, ρ, chartFiniteMultiply, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Submodule.subtype_apply] using hproj

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileTopCoefficientEquiv_multiply
statement:
theorem profileTopCoefficientEquiv_multiply
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ)
    (p : topGrade (K := K) (auxiliaryDualWeights s t) (-(r+1))) :
    profileTopCoefficientEquiv s r (t+1) (profileLaurentTopMultiply q hq s r t p) =
      auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K)
      (W' := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1))
      (V' := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) r)
      (profileNegativeOperators q hq s r) t
        (profileTopCoefficientEquiv s (r+1) t p)
proof:
:= by
  funext b
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hr := congrFun (profileNegativeMultiply_chart_formula q hq s r t
    (profileTopCoefficientEquiv s (r+1) t p)) b
  rw [hr]
  have hc : (fun j => freeLaurentEquiv
      (profileTopCoefficientEquiv s (r+1) t p j).val) =
      auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv p.val := by
    funext j
    exact profileTopCoefficientEquiv_vector s (r+1) t p j
  rw [hc]
  have he : (profileTopCoefficientEquiv s r (t+1)
      (profileLaurentTopMultiply q hq s r t p) b).val =
      freeLaurentEquiv.symm (auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv
        (profileLaurentTopMultiply q hq s r t p).val b) := by
    apply freeLaurentEquiv.injective
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact profileTopCoefficientEquiv_vector s r (t+1) _ b
  rw [he, profileLaurentTopMultiply_val,
    auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_freeNegativePart,
    auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_profileLaurentMultiply]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileNegativeMultiply_injective_iff_topMultiply_injective
statement:
theorem profileNegativeMultiply_injective_iff_topMultiply_injective
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K)
      (W' := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) (r+1))
      (V' := negativeGrade (K := K) (profileLaurentWeights s) r)
      (profileNegativeOperators q hq s r) t) ↔
      Function.Injective (profileLaurentTopMultiply q hq s r t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h p p' hp
    apply (profileTopCoefficientEquiv s (r+1) t).injective
    apply h
    rw [← profileTopCoefficientEquiv_multiply, ← profileTopCoefficientEquiv_multiply, hp]
  · intro h c c' hc
    obtain ⟨p,rfl⟩ := (profileTopCoefficientEquiv s (r+1) t).surjective c
    obtain ⟨p',rfl⟩ := (profileTopCoefficientEquiv s (r+1) t).surjective c'
    apply congrArg (profileTopCoefficientEquiv s (r+1) t)
    apply h
    apply (profileTopCoefficientEquiv s r (t+1)).injective
    rw [profileTopCoefficientEquiv_multiply, profileTopCoefficientEquiv_multiply]
    exact hc

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDifferential_surjective_iff_topMultiply_injective
statement:
theorem profileDifferential_surjective_iff_topMultiply_injective [CharZero K]
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential (gradedProfileOperators q s r) t) ↔
      Function.Injective (profileLaurentTopMultiply q hq s r t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [profileDifferential_surjective_iff_negativeMultiply_injective,
    profileNegativeMultiply_injective_iff_topMultiply_injective]
