statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_y_at_y_succ (p : Poly K 3) (h j k : ℕ) :
    (X 1 * p).coeff (planeExponent h (j+1) k) = p.coeff (planeExponent h j k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [planeExponent_succ_y, coeff_X_mul]

name: ChoppedPlane.coeff_z_at_z_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_z_at_z_succ (p : Poly K 3) (h j k : ℕ) :
    (X 2 * p).coeff (planeExponent h j (k+1)) = p.coeff (planeExponent h j k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [planeExponent_succ_z, coeff_X_mul]

name: ChoppedPlane.toeplitz_x_zero_coeff
statement:
theorem toeplitz_x_zero_coeff {a t : ℕ} (f : ℕ → Poly K 3)
    (heq : ∀ i < a, X 0 * f i + X 1 * f (i+1) + X 2 * f (i+2) = 0)
    (hta : t < a) (i : ℕ) (hia : i ≤ a) (j : ℕ) (hjt : j ≤ t) :
    (f (i+1)).coeff (planeExponent 0 j (t-j)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℕ → ℕ → K := fun i j => (f (i+1)).coeff (planeExponent 0 j (t-j))
  apply binary_coeff_boundary_zero A _ _ _ hta i hia j hjt
  · intro i hi
    have h := congrArg (fun p : Poly K 3 => p.coeff (planeExponent 0 0 (t+1)))
      (heq i hi)
    simpa [A, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Nat.add_assoc] using h
  · intro i hi
    have h := congrArg (fun p : Poly K 3 => p.coeff (planeExponent 0 (t+1) 0))
      (heq i hi)
    simpa [A, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add] using h
  · intro i hi j hj
    have h := congrArg (fun p : Poly K 3 => p.coeff (planeExponent 0 (j+1) (t-j)))
      (heq i hi)
    have hk : t-j = (t-(j+1))+1 := by omega
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.zero_apply, coeff_x_at_x_zero,
      coeff_y_at_y_succ, zero_add] at h
    rw [hk, coeff_z_at_z_succ] at h
    rw [← hk] at h
    simpa only [A, Nat.add_assoc] using (add_comm _ _).trans h

name: ChoppedPlane.planeExponent_coordinates
statement:
theorem planeExponent_coordinates (e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    planeExponent (e 0) (e 1) (e 2) = e
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp

name: ChoppedPlane.x_dvd_of_coeff_x_zero
statement:
theorem x_dvd_of_coeff_x_zero (p : Poly K 3)
    (hz : ∀ j k, p.coeff (planeExponent 0 j k) = 0) : X 0 ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_dvd_iff_modMonomial_eq_zero]
  ext e
  by_cases he : e 0 = 0
  · have hle : ¬ Finsupp.single 0 1 ≤ e := by
      intro h
      have hh := h 0
      simp [he] at hh
    rw [coeff_modMonomial_of_not_le p hle, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
    have h := hz (e 1) (e 2)
    simpa only [← he, planeExponent_coordinates] using h
  · rw [coeff_modMonomial_of_le p, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
    simpa only [Finsupp.single_le_iff] using Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr he

name: ChoppedPlane.toeplitz_noninitial_x_dvd
statement:
theorem toeplitz_noninitial_x_dvd {a t : ℕ} (f : ℕ → Poly K 3)
    (hf : ∀ i ≤ a+1, (f i).IsHomogeneous t)
    (heq : ∀ i < a, X 0 * f i + X 1 * f (i+1) + X 2 * f (i+2) = 0)
    (hta : t < a) (i : ℕ) (hia : i ≤ a) : X 0 ∣ f (i+1)
proof:
:= by
  apply x_dvd_of_coeff_x_zero
  intro j k
  by_cases hjk : j+k = t
  · have hh : t-j = k := by omega
    simpa only [hh] using toeplitz_x_zero_coeff f heq hta i hia j (by omega)
  · exact (hf (i+1) (by omega)).coeff_eq_zero (by simpa using hjk)

name: ChoppedPlane.toeplitz_syzygy_zero
statement:
theorem toeplitz_syzygy_zero {a t : ℕ} (f : ℕ → Poly K 3)
    (hf : ∀ i ≤ a+1, (f i).IsHomogeneous t)
    (heq : ∀ i < a, X 0 * f i + X 1 * f (i+1) + X 2 * f (i+2) = 0)
    (hta : t < a) : ∀ i ≤ a+1, f i = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction a generalizing t f with
  | zero => omega
  | succ a ih =>
    have hdiv : ∀ i ≤ a+1, X 0 ∣ f (i+1) :=
      fun i hi => toeplitz_noninitial_x_dvd f hf heq hta i hi
    have htail : ∀ i ≤ a+1, f (i+1) = 0 := by
      cases t with
      | zero =>
        intro i hi
        exact homogeneous_zero_of_x_dvd (f (i+1)) (hf (i+1) (by omega)) (hdiv i hi)
      | succ t =>
        let g : ℕ → Poly K 3 := fun i => (f (i+1)).divMonomial (Finsupp.single 0 1)
        have hfg : ∀ i ≤ a+1, X 0 * g i = f (i+1) :=
          fun i hi => x_mul_div_of_x_dvd (f (i+1)) (hdiv i hi)
        have hgh : ∀ i ≤ a+1, (g i).IsHomogeneous t :=
          fun i hi => homogeneous_div_x (f (i+1)) (hf (i+1) (by omega))
        have hgeq : ∀ i < a, X 0 * g i + X 1 * g (i+1) + X 2 * g (i+2) = 0 := by
          intro i hi
          have h := heq (i+1) (by omega)
          rw [← hfg i (by omega), ← hfg (i+1) (by omega),
            ← hfg (i+2) (by omega)] at h
          apply (mul_eq_zero.mp (show X 0 *
            (X 0 * g i + X 1 * g (i+1) + X 2 * g (i+2)) = 0 from ?_)).resolve_left
              (X_ne_zero 0)
          convert h using 1; ring
        have hgz := ih g hgh hgeq (by omega)
        intro i hi
        rw [← hfg i hi, hgz i hi, mul_zero]
    have hf0 : f 0 = 0 := by
      have h := heq 0 (by omega)
      simp only [zero_add, htail 0 (by omega), htail 1 (by omega), mul_zero,
        add_zero] at h
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (X_ne_zero 0)
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => exact hf0
    | succ i => exact htail i (by omega)

name: ChoppedPlane.toeplitzMatrix_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem toeplitzMatrix_val {a : ℕ} (i : Fin a) (j : Fin (a+2)) :
    (toeplitzMatrix K a i j).val =
      (if j = (⟨i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (a+2)) then X 0 else 0) +
      (if j = (⟨i.val+1, by omega⟩ : Fin (a+2)) then X 1 else 0) +
      (if j = (⟨i.val+2, by omega⟩ : Fin (a+2)) then X 2 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold toeplitzMatrix
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.toeplitzMatrix_map_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem toeplitzMatrix_map_val {a t : ℕ}
    (v : MatrixSource K (a+2) t) (i : Fin a) :
    (linearMatrixMap (toeplitzMatrix K a) t v i).val =
      X 0 * (v ⟨i.val, by omega⟩).val +
      X 1 * (v ⟨i.val+1, by omega⟩).val +
      X 2 * (v ⟨i.val+2, by omega⟩).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [linearMatrixMap_val, toeplitzMatrix_val, add_mul, ite_mul, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.toeplitzMatrix_injective
statement:
theorem toeplitzMatrix_injective {a t : ℕ} (hta : t < a) :
    Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap (toeplitzMatrix K a) t)
proof:
:= by
  intro v w hvw
  have hzero : linearMatrixMap (toeplitzMatrix K a) t (v-w) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hvw, sub_self]
  let f : ℕ → Poly K 3 := fun i =>
    if h : i < a+2 then ((v-w) ⟨i,h⟩).val else 0
  have hf : ∀ i ≤ a+1, (f i).IsHomogeneous t := by
    intro i hi
    simp only [f, dite_eq_left (by omega : i < a+2)]
    exact ((v-w) ⟨i,by omega⟩).property
  have heq : ∀ i < a, X 0 * f i + X 1 * f (i+1) + X 2 * f (i+2) = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have h := congrArg (fun u : MatrixTarget K a t => (u ⟨i,hi⟩).val) hzero
    simpa only [toeplitzMatrix_map_val, Pi.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, f,
      dite_eq_left (by omega : i < a+2), dite_eq_left (by omega : i+1 < a+2),
      dite_eq_left (by omega : i+2 < a+2)] using h
  have hz := toeplitz_syzygy_zero f hf heq hta
  funext i
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := hz i.val (by omega)
  simpa only [f, dite_eq_left i.isLt, Pi.sub_apply, Submodule.coe_zero] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.toeplitzMatrix_maximalRank
statement:
theorem toeplitzMatrix_maximalRank {a : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank (toeplitzMatrix K a) t
proof:
:=
  linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_two_extra_columns (toeplitzMatrix K a) ha
    (toeplitzMatrix_injective (by omega))

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_two_extra_columns_maximalRank
statement:
theorem exists_two_extra_columns_maximalRank (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ L : LinearMatrix K a (a+2), ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:=
  ⟨toeplitzMatrix K a, toeplitzMatrix_maximalRank ha⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cofactorMap_apply (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R)
    (v : Fin (c + 1) → R) : cofactorMap B v = ∑ i, signedMaximalMinor B i * v i
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorMap_mulVec
statement:
theorem cofactorMap_mulVec (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (w : Fin c → R) :
    cofactorMap B (B.mulVec w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cofactorMap_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [← mul_assoc, ← Finset.sum_mul, signedMaximalMinor_relation,
    zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.range_mulVec_le_ker_cofactorMap
statement:
theorem range_mulVec_le_ker_cofactorMap (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) :
    B.mulVecLin.range ≤ (cofactorMap B).ker
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  exact cofactorMap_mulVec B w

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorMap_range_eq_span
statement:
theorem cofactorMap_range_eq_span (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) :
    (cofactorMap B).range = Submodule.span R (Set.range (signedMaximalMinor B))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    change (∑ i, signedMaximalMinor B i * v i) ∈
      Submodule.span R (Set.range (signedMaximalMinor B))
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i _
    have h := (Submodule.span R (Set.range (signedMaximalMinor B))).smul_mem
      (v i) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using h
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Pi.single i 1, ?_⟩
    simp [cofactorMap_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.maximalMinor_map
statement:
theorem maximalMinor_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    maximalMinor (B.map φ) i = φ (maximalMinor B i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [maximalMinor]
  rw [RingHom.map_det]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.signedMaximalMinor_map
statement:
theorem signedMaximalMinor_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    signedMaximalMinor (B.map φ) i = φ (signedMaximalMinor B i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [signedMaximalMinor, maximalMinor_map]

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorMap_map
statement:
theorem cofactorMap_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (v : Fin (c + 1) → R) :
    cofactorMap (B.map φ) (fun i => φ (v i)) = φ (cofactorMap B v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cofactorMap_apply, signedMaximalMinor_map]

name: ChoppedPlane.mulVec_injective_of_maximalMinor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mulVec_injective_of_maximalMinor_ne_zero
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) K) (i : Fin (c + 1))
    (h : maximalMinor B i ≠ 0) : Function.Injective B.mulVec
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hsub : (B.submatrix i.succAbove id).mulVec x =
      (B.submatrix i.succAbove id).mulVec y := by
    funext j
    exact congrFun hxy (i.succAbove j)
  apply (Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit
    (A := B.submatrix i.succAbove id)).mpr
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr h))
  exact hsub

name: ChoppedPlane.ker_cofactorMap_eq_range_field
statement:
theorem ker_cofactorMap_eq_range_field
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) K)
    (hminor : ∃ i, maximalMinor B i ≠ 0) :
    (cofactorMap B).ker = B.mulVecLin.range
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ (range_mulVec_le_ker_cofactorMap B)
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hminor
  let M := B.submatrix i.succAbove id
  let w : Fin c → K := M⁻¹.mulVec (fun j => v (i.succAbove j))
  have hdet : IsUnit M.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hi
  have hsub : M.mulVec w = fun j => v (i.succAbove j) := by
    dsimp [w]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hdet, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hothers (j : Fin c) : B.mulVec w (i.succAbove j) = v (i.succAbove j) :=
    congrFun hsub j
  have hc : signedMaximalMinor B i ≠ 0 := by
    simp [signedMaximalMinor, hi]
  have hzero : cofactorMap B (B.mulVec w - v) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, cofactorMap_mulVec]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hv.symm
  have hsum := hzero
  rw [cofactorMap_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ i] at hsum
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, hothers, sub_self, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero,
    add_zero] at hsum
  have hmain : B.mulVec w i = v i := sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hsum).resolve_left hc)
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst j
    exact hmain
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hj
    exact hothers k

name: ChoppedPlane.reduced_den_dvd_of_integer_multiple
statement:
theorem reduced_den_dvd_of_integer_multiple (x : F) (m : R)
    (h : IsInteger R (algebraMap R F m * x)) : (den R x : R) ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h
  have hx : x * algebraMap R F (den R x) = algebraMap R F (num R x) :=
    (num_mul_den_eq_num_iff_eq (A := R)).mpr rfl
  have hrel : m * num R x = r * (den R x : R) := by
    apply IsFractionRing.injective R F
    calc
      algebraMap R F (m * num R x) = algebraMap R F m * algebraMap R F (num R x) := map_mul _ _ _
      _ = algebraMap R F m * (x * algebraMap R F (den R x)) := by rw [hx]
      _ = (algebraMap R F m * x) * algebraMap R F (den R x) := by ring
      _ = algebraMap R F r * algebraMap R F (den R x) := by rw [hr]
      _ = algebraMap R F (r * (den R x : R)) := (map_mul _ _ _).symm
  apply (num_den_reduced R x).symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  exact ⟨r, by simpa only [mul_comm] using hrel⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.maximalMinor_mul_solution_integer
statement:
theorem maximalMinor_mul_solution_integer
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (v : Fin (c + 1) → R) (w : Fin c → F)
    (h : (B.map (algebraMap R F)).mulVec w = fun i => algebraMap R F (v i))
    (i : Fin (c + 1)) (k : Fin c) :
    IsInteger R (algebraMap R F (maximalMinor B i) * w k)
proof:
:= by
  let M := B.submatrix i.succAbove id
  let u : Fin c → R := fun j => v (i.succAbove j)
  have hsub : (M.map (algebraMap R F)).mulVec w = fun j => algebraMap R F (u j) := by
    funext j
    exact congrFun h (i.succAbove j)
  have hadj : M.adjugate.map (algebraMap R F) = (M.map (algebraMap R F)).adjugate :=
    (algebraMap R F).map_adjugate M
  have hAdj := congrArg (fun z => (M.map (algebraMap R F)).adjugate.mulVec z) hsub
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.adjugate_mul, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    Matrix.one_mulVec] at hAdj
  have hdet : (M.map (algebraMap R F)).det = algebraMap R F M.det :=
    ((algebraMap R F).map_det M).symm
  rw [hdet] at hAdj
  refine ⟨M.adjugate.mulVec u k, ?_⟩
  rw [(algebraMap R F).map_mulVec, hadj]
  exact (congrFun hAdj k).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_pair
statement:
theorem primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_pair
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (i j : Fin (c + 1))
    (h : IsRelPrime (maximalMinor B i) (maximalMinor B j)) : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  exact h (hd i) (hd j)

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_maximalMinor_ne_zero_of_primitive
statement:
theorem exists_maximalMinor_ne_zero_of_primitive
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (h : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) :
    ∃ i, maximalMinor B i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  have hzero : IsUnit (0 : R) := h 0 (fun i => by rw [hn i])
  exact not_isUnit_zero hzero

name: ChoppedPlane.ker_cofactorMap_eq_range
statement:
theorem ker_cofactorMap_eq_range
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) :
    (cofactorMap B).ker = B.mulVecLin.range
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ (range_mulVec_le_ker_cofactorMap B)
  intro v hv
  let F := FractionRing R
  let φ : R →+* F := algebraMap R F
  have hφ : Function.Injective φ := IsFractionRing.injective R F
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_maximalMinor_ne_zero_of_primitive B hprimitive
  have hminor : ∃ i, maximalMinor (B.map φ) i ≠ 0 := by
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    rw [maximalMinor_map]
    exact (map_ne_zero_iff φ hφ).mpr hi
  have hvF : (fun i => φ (v i)) ∈ (cofactorMap (B.map φ)).ker := by
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, cofactorMap_map, hv, map_zero]
  rw [ker_cofactorMap_eq_range_field (B.map φ) hminor] at hvF
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hvF
  change (B.map φ).mulVec w = fun i => φ (v i) at hw
  have hinteger (k : Fin c) : IsInteger R (w k) := by
    apply isInteger_of_isUnit_den
    apply hprimitive
    intro i
    apply reduced_den_dvd_of_integer_multiple
    exact maximalMinor_mul_solution_integer B v w hw i k
  choose u hu using hinteger
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  funext i
  apply hφ
  change φ (B.mulVec u i) = φ (v i)
  rw [φ.map_mulVec]
  change (B.map φ).mulVec (φ ∘ u) i = φ (v i)
  have hcoord : φ ∘ u = w := by
    funext k
    exact hu k
  rw [hcoord]
  exact congrFun hw i

name: ChoppedPlane.mulVec_injective_of_primitive
statement:
theorem mulVec_injective_of_primitive
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) :
    Function.Injective B.mulVec
proof:
:= by
  let F := FractionRing R
  let φ : R →+* F := algebraMap R F
  have hφ : Function.Injective φ := IsFractionRing.injective R F
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_maximalMinor_ne_zero_of_primitive B hprimitive
  have hiF : maximalMinor (B.map φ) i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [maximalMinor_map]
    exact (map_ne_zero_iff φ hφ).mpr hi
  intro u v huv
  have hmap : (B.map φ).mulVec (φ ∘ u) = (B.map φ).mulVec (φ ∘ v) := by
    funext j
    rw [← φ.map_mulVec, ← φ.map_mulVec, huv]
  have hcoords := mulVec_injective_of_maximalMinor_ne_zero (B.map φ) i hiF hmap
  funext j
  exact hφ (congrFun hcoords j)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDifferential_injective
statement:
theorem profileDifferential_injective (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ)
    (ht : ∀ k : Fin 3, 4*r+profileMultiplicity s <
      2 * ((t+1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + (generatorWeights s k : ℤ)) :
    Function.Injective (operatorDifferential (gradedProfileOperators q s r) t)
proof:
:= by
  letI := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZ (profileFactors q s))
    (profileZ_cube q hq s)
  apply operatorDifferential_injective_of_tensor_kernel
    (gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) r)
    (gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) (r+1))
    (profileDirection (K := K)) (gradedProfileOperators q s r)
    (gradedProfileOperators_direction q hq s r) t
  intro c hδ
  have hzero := profile_directional_kernel_zero q hq s (t+1) r ht
    (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) r) (t+1) c)
    (finiteDirectionalSynthesis_homogeneous _ _ _)
    (finiteDirectionalSynthesis_weighted (generatorWeights s) r (t+1) c) hδ
  apply finiteDirectionalSynthesis_injective
    (R := CyclicCubicRing (BinaryRing K) (binaryCubic K))
    (gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) r)
    (gradedBinaryVectorVal_injective (generatorWeights s) r) (t+1)
  simpa using hzero

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDualDifferential_injective
statement:
theorem profileDualDifferential_injective (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ)
    (ht : ∀ k : Fin 3, 4*r-profileMultiplicity s <
      2 * ((t+1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + (dualGeneratorWeights s k : ℤ)) :
    Function.Injective (operatorDifferential (gradedProfileDualOperators q s r) t)
proof:
:= by
  letI := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s))
    (profileZDual_cube q hq s)
  apply operatorDifferential_injective_of_tensor_kernel
    (gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) r)
    (gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) (r+1))
    (profileDirection (K := K)) (gradedProfileDualOperators q s r)
    (gradedProfileDualOperators_direction q hq s r) t
  intro c hδ
  have hzero := profileDual_directional_kernel_zero q hq s (t+1) r ht
    (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) r) (t+1) c)
    (finiteDirectionalSynthesis_homogeneous _ _ _)
    (finiteDirectionalSynthesis_weighted (dualGeneratorWeights s) r (t+1) c) hδ
  apply finiteDirectionalSynthesis_injective
    (R := CyclicCubicRing (BinaryRing K) (binaryCubic K))
    (gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) r)
    (gradedBinaryVectorVal_injective (dualGeneratorWeights s) r) (t+1)
  simpa using hzero

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_of_extension_witnesses
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_of_extension_witnesses [CharZero K]
    (k : K →+* L) (d p : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d) (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p)
    (hw : ∀ e, e ≤ cutoff d (N d - p) →
      ∃ a : PointCoordinates L p,
        Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation L a d) ∧
        choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) ≤
          max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e)) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c := cutoff d (N d - p)
  choose a₀ hs hupper using fun j : Fin (c + 1) =>
    hw j.val (by have hj := j.isLt; dsimp [c] at *; omega)
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := choppedHilbertFunction_descend k (show p ≤ (d + 2).choose 2 from hhi.le)
    (fun j : Fin (c + 1) => j.val) a₀ hs
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hgeneral⟩ := generic_pointHilbertFunction (K := K) p
  have hDne : D ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hD
    intro hz
    rw [hz, map_zero] at ha
    exact ha rfl
  have hGne : G ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hG
    intro hz
    rw [hz, map_zero] at ha
    exact ha rfl
  have hex : ∃ a : PointCoordinates K p, eval a (D * G) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! hz
    exact mul_ne_zero hDne hGne (MvPolynomial.funext hz)
  refine ⟨D * G, hex, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  have hparts : eval a D ≠ 0 ∧ eval a G ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_mul, mul_ne_zero_iff] using ha
  obtain ⟨hsa, hlea⟩ := hgood a hparts.1
  obtain ⟨hdist, hpoint⟩ := hgeneral a hparts.2
  have hpoint' : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p := by
    simpa only [N] using hpoint
  have hfinite : ∀ e, e ≤ cutoff d (N d - p) →
      choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) =
        max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e) := by
    intro e he
    let j : Fin (c + 1) := ⟨e, by dsimp [c]; omega⟩
    have hu := (hlea j).trans (hupper j)
    have hpd : pointHilbertFunction K a d = p := by
      rw [hpoint', min_eq_right hhi.le]
    have hk : finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = N d - p := by
      rw [pointDegreePiece_finrank, hpd]
      rfl
    have hl := choppedHilbertFunction_lower_bounds (d := d) (e := e) a
    rw [pointHilbertFunction_above_intermediate a hhi hpoint', hk] at hl
    exact le_antisymm hu hl
  exact mainConclusion_of_intermediate_formula a hd hlo hhi hr hdist hpoint'
    (intermediate_formula_of_finite_witness a hhi hr hpoint' hsa hfinite)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.eq_zero_of_grid_eval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_grid_eval_eq_zero {m n : ℕ} (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (P : K[X][Y]) (hY : P.natDegree < n)
    (hX : ∀ j : ℕ, (P.coeff j).natDegree < m)
    (hv : ∀ i j, P.evalEval (α i) (β j) = 0) : P = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmap (i : Fin m) : P.map (evalRingHom (α i)) = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero _ hβ
    · intro j
      simpa only [map_evalRingHom_eval] using hv i j
    · simpa using lt_of_le_of_lt (natDegree_map_le) hY
  apply Polynomial.ext
  intro j
  apply eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero _ hα
  · intro i
    have hi := congrArg (fun Q : K[X] => Q.coeff j) (hmap i)
    simpa only [coeff_map, coeff_zero, coe_evalRingHom] using hi
  · simpa using hX j

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.eq_of_grid_eval_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_grid_eval_eq {m n : ℕ} (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (P Q : K[X][Y]) (hY : max P.natDegree Q.natDegree < n)
    (hX : ∀ j : ℕ, max (P.coeff j).natDegree (Q.coeff j).natDegree < m)
    (hv : ∀ i j, P.evalEval (α i) (β j) = Q.evalEval (α i) (β j)) : P = Q
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_grid_eval_eq_zero α β hα hβ (P - Q)
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (natDegree_sub_le _ _) hY
  · intro j
    rw [coeff_sub]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (natDegree_sub_le _ _) (hX j)
  · intro i j
    simpa only [evalEval_sub, sub_eq_zero] using hv i j

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.gridRemainder_coeff_vanish
statement:
theorem gridRemainder_coeff_vanish {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K)
    (P : K[X][Y]) (hP : TotalDegreeLE d P) (i j : ℕ) (hij : d ≤ i ∨ d ≤ j) :
    ((gridRemainder α β P).coeff j).coeff i = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gridRemainder, coeff_sub, coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    firstEquation_coeff_coeff, secondEquation_coeff_coeff]
  by_cases hx : i = d ∧ j = 0
  · rcases hx with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    simp [Nat.ne_of_gt hd]
  by_cases hy : i = 0 ∧ j = d
  · rcases hy with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    simp [Nat.ne_of_gt hd]
  have hcoeff : (P.coeff j).coeff i = 0 := hP i j (by omega)
  have hfirst : (if j = 0 then (coordinatePolynomial α).coeff i else 0) = 0 := by
    split_ifs with hj
    · exact coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by rw [coordinatePolynomial_natDegree]; omega)
    · rfl
  have hsecond : (if i = 0 then (coordinatePolynomial β).coeff j else 0) = 0 := by
    split_ifs with hi
    · exact coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by rw [coordinatePolynomial_natDegree]; omega)
    · rfl
  rw [hcoeff, hfirst, hsecond]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.grid_kernel
statement:
theorem grid_kernel {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (P : K[X][Y]) (hP : TotalDegreeLE d P) :
    (∀ i j, P.evalEval (α i) (β j) = 0) ↔
      ∃ a b : K, P = a • firstEquation α + b • secondEquation β
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hzero : gridRemainder α β P = 0 := by
      apply eq_zero_of_grid_eval_eq_zero α β hα hβ
      · have hle : (gridRemainder α β P).natDegree ≤ d - 1 := by
          apply natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
          intro j hj
          apply Polynomial.ext
          intro i
          simpa only [coeff_zero] using gridRemainder_coeff_vanish hd α β P hP i j
            (Or.inr (by omega))
        omega
      · intro j
        have hle : ((gridRemainder α β P).coeff j).natDegree ≤ d - 1 := by
          apply natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
          intro i hi
          exact gridRemainder_coeff_vanish hd α β P hP i j (Or.inl (by omega))
        omega
      · intro i j
        simp only [gridRemainder, evalEval_sub, evalEval_smul, firstEquation,
          secondEquation, evalEval_C, evalEval_map_C, coordinatePolynomial_eval,
          smul_zero, sub_zero, hv]
    refine ⟨(P.coeff 0).coeff d, (P.coeff d).coeff 0, ?_⟩
    rw [gridRemainder, sub_sub] at hzero
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero
  · rintro ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ i j
    simp only [evalEval_add, evalEval_smul, firstEquation, secondEquation,
      evalEval_C, evalEval_map_C, coordinatePolynomial_eval, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.grid_equations_independent
statement:
theorem grid_equations_independent {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K)
    {a b : K} (h : a • firstEquation α + b • secondEquation β = 0) :
    a = 0 ∧ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx := congrArg (fun P : K[X][Y] => (P.coeff 0).coeff d) h
  have hy := congrArg (fun P : K[X][Y] => (P.coeff d).coeff 0) h
  simp only [coeff_add, coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul, coeff_zero,
    firstEquation_coeff_coeff, secondEquation_coeff_coeff,
    coordinatePolynomial_coeff_degree] at hx hy
  simpa [Nat.ne_of_gt hd] using And.intro hx hy

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.graded_preimage
statement:
theorem graded_preimage
    (G : ℤ → Submodule K U) (H : ℤ → Submodule K V)
    (pU : ℤ → U →ₗ[K] U) (pV : ℤ → V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hpU : ∀ k u, pU k u ∈ G k)
    (hpV : ∀ k v, v ∈ H k → pV k v = v)
    (L : U →ₗ[K] V) (Q : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (hexact : ∀ v, Q v = 0 ↔ v ∈ LinearMap.range L)
    (a b : ℤ) (hcomm : L.comp (pU a) = (pV b).comp L)
    (v : V) (hv : v ∈ H b) (hq : Q v = 0) :
    ∃ u : U, u ∈ G a ∧ L u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (hexact v).mp hq
  refine ⟨pU a u, hpU a u, ?_⟩
  have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun hcomm u
  change L (pU a u) = pV b (L u) at hc
  rw [hc, hu, hpV b v hv]

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.graded_preimage_of_kernel_range
statement:
theorem graded_preimage_of_kernel_range
    (G : ℤ → Submodule K U) (H : ℤ → Submodule K V)
    (pU : ℤ → U →ₗ[K] U) (pV : ℤ → V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hpU : ∀ k u, pU k u ∈ G k)
    (hpV : ∀ k v, v ∈ H k → pV k v = v)
    (L : U →ₗ[K] V) (Q : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (hexact : LinearMap.ker Q = LinearMap.range L)
    (a b : ℤ) (hcomm : L.comp (pU a) = (pV b).comp L)
    (v : V) (hv : v ∈ H b) (hq : Q v = 0) :
    ∃ u : U, u ∈ G a ∧ L u = v
proof:
:= by
  apply graded_preimage G H pU pV hpU hpV L Q _ a b hcomm v hv hq
  intro w
  rw [← LinearMap.mem_ker, hexact]

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.gradedRestriction_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedRestriction_val (L : U →ₗ[K] V)
    (G : Submodule K U) (H : Submodule K V)
    (hL : ∀ u, u ∈ G → L u ∈ H) (u : G) :
    (gradedRestriction L G H hL u).val = L u.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.graded_kernel_range
statement:
theorem graded_kernel_range
    (G : ℤ → Submodule K U) (H : ℤ → Submodule K V)
    (pU : ℤ → U →ₗ[K] U) (pV : ℤ → V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hpU : ∀ k u, pU k u ∈ G k)
    (hpV : ∀ k v, v ∈ H k → pV k v = v)
    (L : U →ₗ[K] V) (Q : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (hexact : ∀ v, Q v = 0 ↔ v ∈ LinearMap.range L)
    (a b : ℤ) (hcomm : L.comp (pU a) = (pV b).comp L)
    (hL : ∀ u, u ∈ G a → L u ∈ H b) :
    LinearMap.ker (Q.domRestrict (H b)) =
      LinearMap.range (gradedRestriction L (G a) (H b) hL)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
  change Q v.val = 0 ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hlu⟩ := graded_preimage G H pU pV hpU hpV L Q hexact
      a b hcomm v.val v.property hv
    exact ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, Subtype.ext hlu⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact (hexact _).mpr ⟨u.val, rfl⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.graded_preimage_of_shift
statement:
theorem graded_preimage_of_shift
    (G : ℤ → Submodule K U) (H : ℤ → Submodule K V)
    (pU : ℤ → U →ₗ[K] U) (pV : ℤ → V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hpU : ∀ k u, pU k u ∈ G k)
    (hpV : ∀ k v, v ∈ H k → pV k v = v)
    (L : U →ₗ[K] V) (Q : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (hexact : ∀ v, Q v = 0 ↔ v ∈ LinearMap.range L)
    (d : ℤ) (hcomm : ∀ k, L.comp (pU k) = (pV (k + d)).comp L)
    (k : ℤ) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ H k) (hq : Q v = 0) :
    ∃ u : U, u ∈ G (k - d) ∧ L u = v
proof:
:= by
  apply graded_preimage G H pU pV hpU hpV L Q hexact (k - d) k _ v hv hq
  simpa using hcomm (k - d)

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.uChart_preimage_by_projection
statement:
theorem uChart_preimage_by_projection
    (g : ι → ℤ) (h : κ → ℤ)
    (L : FreeLaurent K ι →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K κ)
    (hL : ∀ j x, x ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) g j →
      L x ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) h (j + 1))
    (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K κ) (hp : p ∈ uChartGrade (K := K) h k)
    (hpreimage : ∃ x : FreeLaurent K ι,
      x ∈ LinearMap.range (uFreeEmbedding (K := K) (ι := ι)) ∧ L x = p) :
    ∃ x : FreeLaurent K ι, x ∈ uChartGrade (K := K) g (k - 1) ∧ L x = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hlx⟩ := hpreimage
  refine ⟨gradeProjection g (k - 1) x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply gradeProjection_preserves_uChartSupport g (k - 1) x
    simpa only [range_uFreeEmbedding] using hx
  · have hc : gradeProjection h k (L x) = L (gradeProjection g (k - 1) x) := by
      have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun
        (gradeProjection_commutes_of_degree_shift g h 1 L hL (k - 1)) x
      simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, sub_add_cancel] using hc
    rw [← hc, hlx]
    exact (mem_overlapGrade_iff_gradeProjection_eq h k p).mp
      (uChartGrade_le_overlapGrade (K := K) h k hp)

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.vChart_preimage_by_projection
statement:
theorem vChart_preimage_by_projection
    (g : ι → ℤ) (h : κ → ℤ)
    (L : FreeLaurent K ι →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K κ)
    (hL : ∀ j x, x ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) g j →
      L x ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) h (j + 1))
    (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K κ) (hp : p ∈ vChartGrade (K := K) h k)
    (hpreimage : ∃ x : FreeLaurent K ι,
      x ∈ LinearMap.range (vFreeEmbedding (K := K) (ι := ι)) ∧ L x = p) :
    ∃ x : FreeLaurent K ι, x ∈ vChartGrade (K := K) g (k - 1) ∧ L x = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hlx⟩ := hpreimage
  refine ⟨gradeProjection g (k - 1) x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply gradeProjection_preserves_vChartSupport g (k - 1) x
    simpa only [range_vFreeEmbedding] using hx
  · have hc : gradeProjection h k (L x) = L (gradeProjection g (k - 1) x) := by
      have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun
        (gradeProjection_commutes_of_degree_shift g h 1 L hL (k - 1)) x
      simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, sub_add_cancel] using hc
    rw [← hc, hlx]
    exact (mem_overlapGrade_iff_gradeProjection_eq h k p).mp
      (vChartGrade_le_overlapGrade (K := K) h k hp)

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.uChart_graded_local_preimage
statement:
theorem uChart_graded_local_preimage
    (g : ι → ℤ) (h : κ → ℤ)
    (L : FreeLaurent K ι →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K κ)
    (Q : FreeLaurent K κ →ₗ[K] W)
    (hL : ∀ j x, x ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) g j →
      L x ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) h (j + 1))
    (hexact : ∀ p : FreeLaurent K κ,
      p ∈ LinearMap.range (uFreeEmbedding (K := K) (ι := κ)) → Q p = 0 →
      ∃ x : FreeLaurent K ι,
        x ∈ LinearMap.range (uFreeEmbedding (K := K) (ι := ι)) ∧ L x = p)
    (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K κ) (hp : p ∈ uChartGrade (K := K) h k)
    (hq : Q p = 0) :
    ∃ x : FreeLaurent K ι, x ∈ uChartGrade (K := K) g (k - 1) ∧ L x = p
proof:
:= by
  apply uChart_preimage_by_projection g h L hL k p hp
  apply hexact p _ hq
  rw [uChartGrade_eq_overlap_inf_range] at hp
  exact hp.2

name: ChoppedPlane.GradedLocalExactness.vChart_graded_local_preimage
statement:
theorem vChart_graded_local_preimage
    (g : ι → ℤ) (h : κ → ℤ)
    (L : FreeLaurent K ι →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K κ)
    (Q : FreeLaurent K κ →ₗ[K] W)
    (hL : ∀ j x, x ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) g j →

      ∃ x : FreeLaurent K ι,
        x ∈ LinearMap.range (vFreeEmbedding (K := K) (ι := ι)) ∧ L x = p)
    (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K κ) (hp : p ∈ vChartGrade (K := K) h k)
    (hq : Q p = 0) :
    ∃ x : FreeLaurent K ι, x ∈ vChartGrade (K := K) g (k - 1) ∧ L x = p

  exact hp.2

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_equiv_apply
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_equiv_apply
    (E : V ≃ₗ[K] V') (F : W ≃ₗ[K] W')
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (T' : Fin 3 → V' →ₗ[K] W')
    (h : ∀ i v, F (T i v) = T' i (E v)) (t : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) (t+1) → V) :
    (fun s => F (operatorDifferential T t c s)) =
      operatorDifferential T' t (fun s => E (c s))
proof:
:= by
  funext s
  simp only [operatorDifferential_coeff, map_sum, map_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b hb
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [h]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_of_equiv
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_of_equiv
    (E : V ≃ₗ[K] V') (F : W ≃ₗ[K] W')
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (T' : Fin 3 → V' →ₗ[K] W')
    (h : ∀ i v, F (T i v) = T' i (E v)) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential T t) ↔
      Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential T' t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs y
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hs (fun s => F.symm (y s))
    refine ⟨fun s => E (x s), ?_⟩
    rw [← operatorDifferential_equiv_apply E F T T' h t x, hx]
    funext s
    exact F.apply_symm_apply _
  · intro hs y
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hs (fun s => F (y s))
    refine ⟨fun s => E.symm (x s), ?_⟩
    have he := operatorDifferential_equiv_apply E F T T' h t
      (fun s => E.symm (x s))
    have hex : (fun s => E (E.symm (x s))) = x := by
      funext s
      exact E.apply_symm_apply _
    rw [hex, hx] at he
    funext s
    exact F.injective (congrFun he s)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_binary_cubic
statement:
theorem quartic_binary_cubic (u v : A) :
    quarticU u v ^ 3 + quarticV u v ^ 3 =
      (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  unfold quarticU quarticV
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_preserves_cubic
statement:
theorem quartic_preserves_cubic (u v z : A) (hz : z ^ 3 = u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) :
    quarticU u v ^ 3 + quarticV u v ^ 3 = quarticZ u v z ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [quartic_binary_cubic]
  unfold quarticZ
  rw [mul_pow, hz]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_bezout_u
statement:
theorem quartic_bezout_u (u v : A) :
    (3 * u ^ 3 + 2 * v ^ 3) * quarticU u v +
      4 * u * v ^ 2 * quarticV u v = 3 * u ^ 7
proof:
:= by
  unfold quarticU quarticV
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_bezout_v
statement:
theorem quartic_bezout_v (u v : A) :
    -4 * u ^ 2 * v * quarticU u v -
      (3 * v ^ 3 + 2 * u ^ 3) * quarticV u v = 3 * v ^ 7
proof:
:= by
  unfold quarticU quarticV
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_quadratic_syzygy_one
statement:
theorem quartic_quadratic_syzygy_one (u v z : A) :
    quarticU u v * (v * z) + quarticV u v * (z * u) +
      quarticZ u v z * (u * v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold quarticU quarticV quarticZ
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_quadratic_syzygy_two
statement:
theorem quartic_quadratic_syzygy_two (u v z : A)
    (hz : z ^ 3 = u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) :
    quarticU u v * u ^ 2 + quarticV u v * v ^ 2 -
      quarticZ u v z * z ^ 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold quarticU quarticV quarticZ
  calc
    _ = (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3 - z ^ 3) := by ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [hz]; ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quadratic_minor_u
statement:
theorem quadratic_minor_u (u v z : A) (hz : z ^ 3 = u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) :
    (z * u) * (-z ^ 2) - (u * v) * v ^ 2 = -quarticU u v
proof:
:= by
  unfold quarticU
  calc
    _ = -u * z ^ 3 - u * v ^ 3 := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hz]; ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quadratic_minor_v
statement:
theorem quadratic_minor_v (u v z : A) (hz : z ^ 3 = u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) :
    (u * v) * u ^ 2 - (v * z) * (-z ^ 2) = -quarticV u v
proof:
:= by
  unfold quarticV
  calc
    _ = u ^ 3 * v + v * z ^ 3 := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hz]; ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quadratic_minor_z
statement:
theorem quadratic_minor_z (u v z : A) :
    (v * z) * v ^ 2 - (z * u) * u ^ 2 = -quarticZ u v z
proof:
:= by
  unfold quarticZ
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cube_eq_one
statement: theorem cube_eq_one (q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) : q ^ 3 = 1
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (q - 1) * hq

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_factor_zero
statement:
theorem quartic_factor_zero (u v : A) :
    quarticU u v + quarticV u v = (u + v) * (u - v) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  unfold quarticU quarticV
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_factor_of_cube
statement:
theorem quartic_factor_of_cube (u v q : A) (hq3 : q ^ 3 = 1) :
    quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v =
      (u + q * v) * (u - q * v) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hq4 : q ^ 4 = q := by
    calc
      q ^ 4 = q ^ 3 * q := by ring
      _ = q := by rw [hq3]; ring
  unfold quarticU quarticV
  ring_nf
  rw [hq3, hq4]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_factor_one
statement:
theorem quartic_factor_one (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v =
      (u + q * v) * (u - q * v) ^ 3
proof:
:=
  quartic_factor_of_cube u v q (cube_eq_one q hq)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_factor_two
statement:
theorem quartic_factor_two (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v =
      (u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u - q ^ 2 * v) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  apply quartic_factor_of_cube
  rw [← pow_mul, show 2 * 3 = 3 * 2 from by omega, pow_mul,
    cube_eq_one q hq, one_pow]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binary_cubic_factor
statement:
theorem binary_cubic_factor (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    (u - v) * (u - q * v) * (u - q ^ 2 * v) = u ^ 3 - v ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hq3 : q ^ 3 = 1 := cube_eq_one q hq
  calc
    _ = u ^ 3 - u ^ 2 * v * (q ^ 2 + q + 1) +
        u * v ^ 2 * (q ^ 3 + q ^ 2 + q) - q ^ 3 * v ^ 3 := by ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [hq3]
      linear_combination (-u ^ 2 * v + u * v ^ 2) * hq

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.intertwiner_zero
statement:
theorem intertwiner_zero (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    (u + v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * weightZero u v q =
      (quarticU u v + quarticV u v) * weightOne u v q
proof:
:= by
  rw [quartic_factor_zero, ← binary_cubic_factor u v q hq]
  unfold weightZero weightOne
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.intertwiner_one
statement:
theorem intertwiner_one (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    (u + q * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * weightOne u v q =
      (quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v) * weightTwo u v q
proof:
:= by
  rw [quartic_factor_one u v q hq, ← binary_cubic_factor u v q hq]
  unfold weightOne weightTwo
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.intertwiner_two
statement:
theorem intertwiner_two (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    (u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * weightTwo u v q =
      (quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v) * weightZero u v q
proof:
:= by
  rw [quartic_factor_two u v q hq, ← binary_cubic_factor u v q hq]
  unfold weightTwo weightZero
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.dual_intertwiners
statement:
theorem dual_intertwiners (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    let d0
proof:
:= u - v
    let d1 := u - q * v
    let d2 := u - q ^ 2 * v
    let f0 := quarticU u v + quarticV u v
    let f1 := quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v
    let f2 := quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v
    ((u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d1 * d2 ^ 2) =
        f2 * (d0 * d1 ^ 2)) ∧
    ((u + v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d2 * d0 ^ 2) =
        f0 * (d1 * d2 ^ 2)) ∧
    ((u + q * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d0 * d1 ^ 2) =
        f1 * (d2 * d0 ^ 2)) := by
  dsimp
  rw [quartic_factor_zero, quartic_factor_one u v q hq,
    quartic_factor_two u v q hq, ← binary_cubic_factor u v q hq]
  constructor
  · ring
  constructor <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.shifted_two_intertwiners
statement:
theorem shifted_two_intertwiners (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    let d0
proof:
:= u - v
    let d1 := u - q * v
    let d2 := u - q ^ 2 * v
    let f0 := quarticU u v + quarticV u v
    let f1 := quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v
    let f2 := quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v
    ((u + v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * d0 ^ 2 = f0 * (d1 * d2)) ∧
    ((u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d1 * d2) = d2 ^ 2 * d0 * d1 ^ 2) ∧
    ((u + q * v) * (u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) *
        (d2 ^ 2 * d0 * d1 ^ 2) = f1 * f2 * d0 ^ 2) := by
  dsimp
  rw [quartic_factor_zero, quartic_factor_one u v q hq,
    quartic_factor_two u v q hq, ← binary_cubic_factor u v q hq]
  constructor
  · ring
  constructor <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.shifted_two_dual_intertwiners
statement:
theorem shifted_two_dual_intertwiners (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    let d0
proof:
:= u - v
    let d1 := u - q * v
    let d2 := u - q ^ 2 * v
    let f0 := quarticU u v + quarticV u v
    let f1 := quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v
    let f2 := quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v
    ((u + q * v) * (u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) *
        (d1 ^ 2 * d2 ^ 2) = f1 * f2 * d0) ∧
    ((u + v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d1 * d2 * d0 ^ 2) =
        f0 * (d1 ^ 2 * d2 ^ 2)) ∧
    ((u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * d0 = d1 * d2 * d0 ^ 2) := by
  dsimp
  rw [quartic_factor_zero, quartic_factor_one u v q hq,
    quartic_factor_two u v q hq, ← binary_cubic_factor u v q hq]
  constructor
  · ring
  constructor <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.shifted_one_intertwiners
statement:
theorem shifted_one_intertwiners (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    let d0
proof:
:= u - v
    let d1 := u - q * v
    let d2 := u - q ^ 2 * v
    let f0 := quarticU u v + quarticV u v
    let f1 := quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v
    let f2 := quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v
    ((u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * d1 = d0 * d1 ^ 2 * d2) ∧
    ((u + q * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d0 * d1 ^ 2 * d2) =
        f1 * (d0 ^ 2 * d2 ^ 2)) ∧
    ((u + v) * (u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) *
        (d0 ^ 2 * d2 ^ 2) = f0 * f2 * d1) := by
  dsimp
  rw [quartic_factor_zero, quartic_factor_one u v q hq,
    quartic_factor_two u v q hq, ← binary_cubic_factor u v q hq]
  constructor
  · ring
  constructor <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.shifted_one_dual_intertwiners
statement:
theorem shifted_one_dual_intertwiners (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    let d0
proof:
:= u - v
    let d1 := u - q * v
    let d2 := u - q ^ 2 * v
    let f0 := quarticU u v + quarticV u v
    let f1 := quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v
    let f2 := quarticU u v + q ^ 2 * quarticV u v
    ((u + v) * (u + q ^ 2 * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) *
        (d0 ^ 2 * d1 * d2 ^ 2) = f0 * f2 * d1 ^ 2) ∧
    ((u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (d0 * d2) = d0 ^ 2 * d1 * d2 ^ 2) ∧
    ((u + q * v) * (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * d1 ^ 2 = f1 * (d0 * d2)) := by
  dsimp
  rw [quartic_factor_zero, quartic_factor_one u v q hq,
    quartic_factor_two u v q hq, ← binary_cubic_factor u v q hq]
  constructor
  · ring
  constructor <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_apply
    (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × S)) (j : S) (i : Fin 3) :
    auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv p j i = freeLaurentEquiv p (i,j)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_coeff
    (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × S)) (j : S) (i : Fin 3) (e : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv p j i).coeff e = p ((i,j),e)
proof:
:= by
  exact freeLaurentEquiv_coeff p (i,j) e

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_component_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_component_coeff
    (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × S)) (j : S) (i : Fin 3) (e : ℤ × ℤ) :
    freeLaurentEquiv.symm (auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv p j) (i,e) = p ((i,j),e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← freeLaurentEquiv_coeff _ i e, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_coeff p j i e

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_supported_iff
statement:
theorem auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_supported_iff
    (P : Fin 3 → (ℤ × ℤ) → Prop) (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × S)) :
    p ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {e | P e.1.1 e.2} ↔
      ∀ j : S, freeLaurentEquiv.symm (auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv p j) ∈
        Finsupp.supported K K {e | P e.1 e.2}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finsupp.mem_supported']
  constructor
  · intro hp j e he
    rw [auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_component_coeff]
    exact hp ((e.1,j),e.2) he
  · intro hp e he
    rw [← auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_component_coeff p e.1.2 e.1.1 e.2]
    exact hp e.1.2 (e.1.1,e.2) he

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_overlap_iff
statement:
theorem auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_overlap_iff
    (g : Fin 3 → ℤ) (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × S)) :
    p ∈ overlapGrade (fun i => g i.1) k ↔
      ∀ j : S, auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv p j ∈ vectorOverlapGrade g k
proof:
:=
  auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_supported_iff (fun i e => e.1 + e.2 + g i = k) p

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_uChart_iff
statement:
theorem auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_uChart_iff
    (g : Fin 3 → ℤ) (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × S)) :
    p ∈ uChartGrade (fun i => g i.1) k ↔
      ∀ j : S, auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv p j ∈ vectorUChartGrade g k
proof:
:=
  auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_supported_iff
    (fun i e => (e.1 + e.2 + g i = k) ∧ 0 ≤ e.2) p

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_vChart_iff
statement:
theorem auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_vChart_iff
    (g : Fin 3 → ℤ) (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × S)) :
    p ∈ vChartGrade (fun i => g i.1) k ↔
      ∀ j : S, auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv p j ∈ vectorVChartGrade g k
proof:
:=
  auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_supported_iff
    (fun i e => (e.1 + e.2 + g i = k) ∧ 0 ≤ e.1) p

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_profileLaurentCross
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_profileLaurentCross
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (n : ℕ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × Sym (Fin 3) n)) :
    auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv (profileLaurentCross q hq s n p) =
      chartFiniteCross binaryChartLaurentMap q hq s n (auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv p)
proof:
:= by
  simp [profileLaurentCross]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_profileLaurentMultiply
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_profileLaurentMultiply
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (n : ℕ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × Sym (Fin 3) n)) :
    auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv (profileLaurentMultiply q hq s n p) =
      chartFiniteMultiply binaryChartLaurentMap q hq s n (auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv p)
proof:
:= by
  simp [profileLaurentMultiply]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_profileLaurentDirectional
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_profileLaurentDirectional
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (n : ℕ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × Sym (Fin 3) (n + 1))) :
    auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv (profileLaurentDirectional q hq s n p) =
      chartFiniteDirectional binaryChartLaurentMap q hq s n (auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv p)
proof:

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowMatrix_points_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalRowMatrix_points_principal_open [Infinite K]
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hdegree : 0 < ∑ i, δ i) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      (∃ u, eval u D ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) ∧
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors (universalInfinityMatrix δ u) ∧
        (∀ f : Forms K 2 (2 * ∑ i, δ i),
          f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal (universalInfinityMatrix δ u)) ∧
        IsReduced (AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)))) ∧
        Module.Finite K (AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)))) ∧
        finrank K (AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)))) =
            Fintype.card (Ferrers.SelectedIndex δ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let α := Ferrers.canonicalRoots (K := K) δ
  have hα : Function.Injective α := Ferrers.canonicalRoots_injective δ
  let a₀ := rowMatrixCoordinates δ (ferrersHomogeneousRowMatrix δ α α)
  obtain ⟨H₀, hH₀, hbase⟩ := universalRowMatrix_primitive_cut_principal_open δ hdegree α α
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := universalRowMatrix_reduced_principal_open δ
    (2 * ∑ i, δ i) H₀ a₀ hH₀
    (fun u hu => (hbase u hu).1)
    (fun u hu => (hbase u hu).2.1)
    (fun u hu => (hbase u hu).2.2)
    (ferrersRowMatrix_splitWitness δ α α hα hα)
  refine ⟨D, ⟨a₀, hD⟩, fun u hu => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hHu, hred, hfinite, hlen⟩ := hgood u hu
  obtain ⟨hprim, hbinary, hcut⟩ := hbase u hHu
  exact ⟨hprim, hbinary, hcut, hred, hfinite, hlen⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowMatrix_actual_points_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalRowMatrix_actual_points_principal_open [Infinite K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hdegree : 0 < ∑ i, δ i) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      (∃ u, eval u D ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) ∧
        ∃ a : PointCoordinates K (Fintype.card (Ferrers.SelectedIndex δ)),
          DistinctPoints K a ∧
          ∀ t, pointDegreePiece K a t = idealFormPiece
            (maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u))) t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := universalRowMatrix_points_principal_open (K := K) δ hdegree
  refine ⟨D, hD, fun u hu => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hprim, hbinary, hcut, hred, hfinite, hlen⟩ := hgood u hu
  let I := maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u))
  let : IsReduced (AffineCoordinateAlgebra I) := hred
  have hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K) :=
    maximalMinorIdeal_homogeneous δ _ (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ _)
  have hsat : ∀ f : Poly K 3, X 2 * f ∈ I → f ∈ I :=
    rowMatrix_z_saturated δ _ hbinary
  have hCut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 (2 * ∑ i, δ i), f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2} :=
    rowMatrix_form_cut_of_binary δ _ _ hcut
  obtain ⟨a, hdist, hpieces, _⟩ := exists_projective_chart_points I hI hsat
    (2 * ∑ i, δ i) hCut hlen
  exact ⟨hprim, a, hdist, hpieces⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorTensorDifferential_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorTensorDifferential_tmul
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (f : Aux K) (v : V) :
    operatorTensorDifferential T (f ⊗ₜ[K] v) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, pderiv i f ⊗ₜ[K] T i v
proof:
:= by
  simp [operatorTensorDifferential]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorTensorDifferential_coeff
statement:
theorem operatorTensorDifferential_coeff
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (P : AuxTensor (R := K) (M := V))
    (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    tensorCoefficients (operatorTensorDifferential T P) s =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ((s i + 1 : ℕ) : K) •
        T i (tensorCoefficients P (s + Finsupp.single i 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction P using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul f v =>
    simp only [operatorTensorDifferential_tmul, map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
      tensorCoefficients_tmul, coeff_pderiv, map_smul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp [smul_smul, mul_comm]
  | add P Q hP hQ =>
    simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hP, hQ, smul_add,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorTensorDifferential_homogeneous
statement:
theorem operatorTensorDifferential_homogeneous
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) {t : ℕ}
    (P : AuxTensor (R := K) (M := V)) (hP : TensorHomogeneous (t + 1) P) :
    TensorHomogeneous t (operatorTensorDifferential T P)
proof:
:= by
  apply (tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients t _).mpr
  intro s hs
  rw [operatorTensorDifferential_coeff]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  have hdegree : (s + Finsupp.single i 1).degree ≠ t + 1 := by
    simp only [map_add, Finsupp.degree_single]
    omega
  rw [(tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients (t + 1) P).mp hP
    (s + Finsupp.single i 1) hdegree, map_zero, smul_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorTensorDifferential_synthesis_coefficients
statement:
theorem operatorTensorDifferential_synthesis_coefficients
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) (x : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → V) :
    homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector t
        (operatorTensorDifferential T (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (t + 1) x)) =
      operatorDifferential T t x
proof:
:= by
  funext s
  simp only [homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector, homogeneousTensorSynthesis,
    map_sum, operatorTensorDifferential_tmul, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
    tensorCoefficients_tmul, operatorDifferential_coeff]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorTensorDifferential_synthesis
statement:
theorem operatorTensorDifferential_synthesis
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) (x : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → V) :
    operatorTensorDifferential T (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (t + 1) x) =
      homogeneousTensorSynthesis t (operatorDifferential T t x)
proof:
:= by
  have hhom := operatorTensorDifferential_homogeneous T
    (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (t + 1) x)
    (homogeneousTensorSynthesis_homogeneous (t + 1) x)
  calc
    _ = homogeneousTensorSynthesis t (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector t
        (operatorTensorDifferential T (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (t + 1) x))) :=
      (homogeneousTensorSynthesis_coefficients t _ hhom).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [operatorTensorDifferential_synthesis_coefficients]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_val
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ)
    (P : homogeneousTensorSubmodule (R := K) (M := V) (t + 1)) :
    (operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential T t P).val =
      operatorTensorDifferential T P.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_coordinates
statement:
theorem operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_coordinates
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ)
    (P : homogeneousTensorSubmodule (R := K) (M := V) (t + 1)) :
    homogeneousTensorCoordinates t (operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential T t P) =
      operatorDifferential T t (homogeneousTensorCoordinates (t + 1) P)
proof:
:= by
  change homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector t (operatorTensorDifferential T P.val) =
    operatorDifferential T t (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (t + 1) P.val)
  calc
    _ = homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector t (operatorTensorDifferential T
        (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (t + 1)
          (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (t + 1) P.val))) := by
      rw [homogeneousTensorSynthesis_coefficients (t + 1) P.val P.property]
    _ = _ := operatorTensorDifferential_synthesis_coefficients T t _

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_injective_iff
statement:
theorem operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_injective_iff
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential T t) ↔
      Function.Injective (operatorDifferential T t)
proof:
:= by
  let S := homogeneousTensorCoordinates (R := K) (M := V) (t + 1)
  let E := homogeneousTensorCoordinates (R := K) (M := W) t
  have hcoord (P : homogeneousTensorSubmodule (R := K) (M := V) (t + 1)) :
      E (operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential T t P) = operatorDifferential T t (S P) :=
    operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_coordinates T t P
  constructor
  · intro hF x y hxy
    obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := S.surjective x
    obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ := S.surjective y
    exact congrArg S (hF (E.injective (by rw [hcoord, hcoord]; exact hxy)))
  · intro hF P Q hPQ
    apply S.injective
    apply hF
    rw [← hcoord, ← hcoord, hPQ]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_surjective_iff
statement:
theorem operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_surjective_iff
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential T t) ↔
      Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential T t)
proof:
:= by
  let S := homogeneousTensorCoordinates (R := K) (M := V) (t + 1)
  let E := homogeneousTensorCoordinates (R := K) (M := W) t
  have hcoord (P : homogeneousTensorSubmodule (R := K) (M := V) (t + 1)) :
      E (operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential T t P) = operatorDifferential T t (S P) :=
    operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_coordinates T t P
  constructor
  · intro hF y
    obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ := E.surjective y
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hF Q
    refine ⟨S P, ?_⟩
    rw [← hcoord, hP]
  · intro hF Q
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hF (E Q)
    obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := S.surjective x
    refine ⟨P, E.injective ?_⟩
    rw [hcoord, hx]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_injective_iff_linearMatrixMap_surjective
statement:
theorem operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_injective_iff_linearMatrixMap_surjective
    [CharZero K] {a c : ℕ} (bV : Basis (Fin a) K V) (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential T t) ↔
      Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t)
proof:
:=
  (operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_injective_iff T t).trans
    (operatorDifferential_injective_iff_linearMatrixMap_surjective bV bW T t)

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_surjective_iff_linearMatrixMap_injective
statement:
theorem operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_surjective_iff_linearMatrixMap_injective
    [CharZero K] {a c : ℕ} (bV : Basis (Fin a) K V) (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential T t) ↔
      Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t)
proof:
:=
  (operatorHomogeneousTensorDifferential_surjective_iff T t).trans
    (operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_linearMatrixMap_injective bV bW T t)

name: ChoppedPlane.ker_residualMap
statement:
theorem ker_residualMap (A : E →ₗ[K] V × W) (φ : V × W →ₗ[K] M)
    (hexact : LinearMap.ker φ = LinearMap.range A) :
    LinearMap.ker (residualMap φ) =
      LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.snd K V W).comp A)
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  constructor
  · intro hw
    have hw' : φ (0, w) ∈ choppedSubmodule φ := by
      simpa [LinearMap.mem_ker, residualMap] using hw
    rcases hw' with ⟨v, hv⟩
    have hker : (-v, w) ∈ LinearMap.ker φ := by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      have hdecomp : (-v, w) = (0, w) - (v, 0) := by simp
      rw [hdecomp, map_sub]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hv.symm
    rw [hexact] at hker
    rcases hker with ⟨e, he⟩
    exact ⟨e, by simpa using congrArg Prod.snd he⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    have hAe : φ (A e) = 0 := by
      have : A e ∈ LinearMap.range A := ⟨e, rfl⟩
      rw [← hexact, LinearMap.mem_ker] at this
      exact this
    have hdecomp : (0, w) = A e - ((A e).1, 0) := by
      ext <;> simp_all
    have hw' : φ (0, w) ∈ choppedSubmodule φ := by
      refine ⟨-(A e).1, ?_⟩
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.inl_apply]
      rw [hdecomp, map_sub, hAe, zero_sub]
      have : (-(A e).1, (0 : W)) = -((A e).1, (0 : W)) := by simp
      rw [this, map_neg]
    simpa [LinearMap.mem_ker, residualMap] using hw'

name: ChoppedPlane.residualMap_surjective
statement:
theorem residualMap_surjective (φ : V × W →ₗ[K] M)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective φ) : Function.Surjective (residualMap φ)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | _ m =>
    rcases hsurj m with ⟨⟨v, w⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
    change (Submodule.Quotient.mk (φ (0, w)) : M ⧸ choppedSubmodule φ) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (φ (v, w))
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).mpr
    have hdecomp : φ (0, w) - φ (v, w) = φ (-v, 0) := by
      rw [← map_sub]
      congr 1
      ext <;> simp
    rw [hdecomp]
    exact ⟨-v, rfl⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedQuotientEquiv_residualMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem choppedQuotientEquiv_residualMap (A : E →ₗ[K] V × W)
    (φ : V × W →ₗ[K] M) (hsurj : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hexact : LinearMap.ker φ = LinearMap.range A) (w : W) :
    choppedQuotientEquiv A φ hsurj hexact (residualMap φ w) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk w
proof:
:= by
  apply (choppedQuotientEquiv A φ hsurj hexact).symm.injective
  simp [choppedQuotientEquiv]

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_choppedQuotient
statement:
theorem finrank_choppedQuotient [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : E →ₗ[K] V × W) (φ : V × W →ₗ[K] M)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hexact : LinearMap.ker φ = LinearMap.range A) :
    Module.finrank K (M ⧸ choppedSubmodule φ) =
      Module.finrank K W -
        Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.snd K V W).comp A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [(choppedQuotientEquiv A φ hsurj hexact).finrank_eq]
  exact Submodule.finrank_quotient _

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_choppedQuotient_of_maximalRank
statement:
theorem finrank_choppedQuotient_of_maximalRank
    [FiniteDimensional K E] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : E →ₗ[K] V × W) (φ : V × W →ₗ[K] M)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hexact : LinearMap.ker φ = LinearMap.range A)
    (hmax : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.snd K V W).comp A)) =
      min (Module.finrank K E) (Module.finrank K W)) :
    Module.finrank K (M ⧸ choppedSubmodule φ) =
      Module.finrank K W - Module.finrank K E
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_choppedQuotient A φ hsurj hexact, hmax]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorCoefficients_baseChange
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorCoefficients_baseChange (ψ : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] M) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    tensorCoefficients (tensorBaseChange ψ P) s = ψ (tensorCoefficients P s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [tensorBaseChange]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBaseChange_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorBaseChange_tmul (ψ : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (m : M) :
    tensorBaseChange ψ (P ⊗ₜ[R] m) = MvPolynomial.map θ P ⊗ₜ[S] ψ m
proof:
:= by
  apply tensorCoefficients.injective
  ext s
  simp [ψ.map_smulₛₗ, coeff_map]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBaseChange_injective
statement:
theorem tensorBaseChange_injective (ψ : M →ₛₗ[θ] N) (hψ : Function.Injective ψ) :
    Function.Injective (tensorBaseChange (σ := σ) ψ)
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q h
  apply tensorCoefficients.injective
  ext s
  apply hψ
  simpa using congrArg (fun A => tensorCoefficients A s) h

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBaseChange_homogeneous
statement:
theorem tensorBaseChange_homogeneous (ψ : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    {n : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] M} (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    TensorHomogeneous n (tensorBaseChange ψ P)
proof:
:= by
  apply (tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients n _).mpr
  intro s hs
  rw [tensorCoefficients_baseChange, (tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients n _).mp hP s hs,
    map_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBaseChange_substitution
statement:
theorem tensorBaseChange_substitution (ψ : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (L : σ → MvPolynomial τ R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] M) :
    tensorBaseChange ψ ((aeval L).toLinearMap.rTensor M P) =
      (aeval (fun i => MvPolynomial.map θ (L i))).toLinearMap.rTensor N (tensorBaseChange ψ P)
proof:
:= by
  induction P using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul P m =>
    simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, tensorBaseChange_tmul]
    congr 1
    change MvPolynomial.map θ (eval₂ C L P) =
      eval₂ C (MvPolynomial.map θ ∘ L) (MvPolynomial.map θ P)
    exact map_eval₂ θ L P
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp only [map_add, hP, hQ]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_substitution_scale
statement:
theorem tensor_substitution_scale (a : R) (L : σ → MvPolynomial τ R)
    {n : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] M) (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    (aeval (fun i => a • L i)).toLinearMap.rTensor M P =
      a ^ n • (aeval L).toLinearMap.rTensor M P
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (aeval (fun i => a • L i)).toLinearMap.comp (homogeneousComponent n) =
      (a ^ n • (aeval L : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R).toLinearMap).comp (homogeneousComponent n) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro Q
    change aeval (fun i => a • L i) (homogeneousComponent n Q) =
      a ^ n • aeval L (homogeneousComponent n Q)
    simpa only [aeval_def, algebraMap_eq, C_mul', ← map_pow] using
      ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_eval₂_scale (homogeneousComponent_isHomogeneous n Q)
        C L (C a)
  have ht := congrArg (fun T : MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial τ R => T.rTensor M) hs
  simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_comp, LinearMap.rTensor_smul] at ht
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun ht P
  dsimp only [TensorHomogeneous] at hP
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hP] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBaseChange_directional
statement:
theorem tensorBaseChange_directional (ψ : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (f : Fin 3 → R) (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorBaseChange ψ (tensorDirectional f P) =
      tensorDirectional (fun i => θ (f i)) (tensorBaseChange ψ P)
proof:
:= by
  apply tensorCoefficients.injective
  ext s
  simp only [tensorCoefficients_baseChange, tensorCoefficients_directional,
    map_sum, ψ.map_smulₛₗ, map_mul, map_natCast]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryCoefficients_baseChange
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryCoefficients_baseChange (ψ : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (n : ℕ) (P : BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M)) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    binaryCoefficients n (tensorBaseChange ψ P) j = ψ (binaryCoefficients n P j)
proof:
:=
  tensorCoefficients_baseChange ψ P _

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBaseChange_kernelSynthesis
statement:
theorem tensorBaseChange_kernelSynthesis (ψ : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    tensorBaseChange ψ (kernelSynthesis A n c) =
      kernelSynthesis (A.map θ) n (fun j => ψ (c j))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kernelSynthesis, map_sum, tensorBaseChange_tmul]
  congr 1
  ext j
  congr 1
  simp [linearForm, map_sum, map_mul, map_pow]
