name: ChoppedPlane.castPointCoordinates_properties
statement:
private theorem castPointCoordinates_properties (h : p = q) (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (d n : ℕ) :
    (DistinctPoints K (castPointCoordinates h a) ∧
      Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K (castPointCoordinates h a) d) ∧
      choppedIdeal K (castPointCoordinates h a) d = pointIdeal K (castPointCoordinates h a) ∧
      (∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K (castPointCoordinates h a) t = min (N t) n) ∧
      (∀ t, choppedHilbertFunction (castPointCoordinates h a) d t = min (N t) n)) ↔
    (DistinctPoints K a ∧ Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d) ∧
      choppedIdeal K a d = pointIdeal K a ∧
      (∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) n) ∧
      (∀ t, choppedHilbertFunction a d t = min (N t) n))
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.canonicalColumnCoordinates_properties
statement:
theorem canonicalColumnCoordinates_properties {d r : ℕ}
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hupper : r ≤ d + 1) (hlower : d + 2 ≤ 2 * r) :
    DistinctPoints K (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) ∧
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) d) ∧
    choppedIdeal K (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) d =
      pointIdeal K (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) ∧
    (∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) t =
      min (N t) (N d - r)) ∧
    (∀ t, choppedHilbertFunction (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) d t =
      min (N t) (N d - r))
proof:
:= by
  let ε := columnProfile (r - 1) (d + 1 - r)
  let α : RootIndex ε → K := Ferrers.canonicalRoots ε
  have hα : Function.Injective α := Ferrers.canonicalRoots_injective ε
  have hε : ∀ j, 0 < ε j := columnProfile_pos _ _
  have hq : d + 1 - r ≤ r - 1 := by omega
  have hsum : (∑ j, ε j) = d := by
    dsimp [ε]
    rw [columnProfile_sum _ _ hq]
    omega
  have hc : r - 1 + 1 = r := by omega
  have hcount : Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = N d - r :=
    columnProfile_selected_card hr hupper hlower
  have hcard : Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = N (∑ j, ε j) - (r - 1 + 1) := by
    rw [hsum, hc]
    exact hcount
  have hfull (t : ℕ) : pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates ε α α) t =
      min (N t) (N d - r) := by
    rw [fullPointHilbertFunction ε α α hα hα hε hcard t, hcount]
  change DistinctPoints K (pointCoordinates ε α α) ∧
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K (pointCoordinates ε α α) d) ∧
    choppedIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α α) d = pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α α) ∧
    (∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates ε α α) t = min (N t) (N d - r)) ∧
    (∀ t, choppedHilbertFunction (pointCoordinates ε α α) d t = min (N t) (N d - r))
  refine ⟨distinct_pointCoordinates ε α α hα hα, ?_, ?_, hfull, ?_⟩
  · exact hsum ▸ pointEvaluation_surjective_at_generatingDegree ε α α hα hα hε hcard
  · simpa only [hsum] using choppedIdeal_eq_pointIdeal ε α α hα hα
  · intro t
    have hh := choppedHilbertFunction_eq_pointHilbertFunction ε α α hα hα t
    rw [hsum] at hh
    exact hh.trans (hfull t)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.columnSeedCoordinates_properties
statement:
theorem columnSeedCoordinates_properties {d r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hupper : r ≤ d + 1) (hlower : d + 2 ≤ 2 * r) :
    DistinctPoints K (columnSeedCoordinates (K := K) d r hr hupper hlower) ∧
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K (columnSeedCoordinates (K := K) d r hr hupper hlower) d) ∧
    choppedIdeal K (columnSeedCoordinates (K := K) d r hr hupper hlower) d =
      pointIdeal K (columnSeedCoordinates (K := K) d r hr hupper hlower) ∧
    (∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K (columnSeedCoordinates (K := K) d r hr hupper hlower) t =
      min (N t) (N d - r)) ∧
    (∀ t, choppedHilbertFunction (columnSeedCoordinates (K := K) d r hr hupper hlower) d t =
      min (N t) (N d - r))
proof:
:= by
  exact (castPointCoordinates_properties (columnProfile_selected_card hr hupper hlower)
    (canonicalColumnCoordinates (K := K) d r) d (N d - r)).mpr
    (canonicalColumnCoordinates_properties (K := K) hr hupper hlower)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.exists_columnSeedWitness
statement:
theorem exists_columnSeedWitness {d r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hupper : r ≤ d + 1) (hlower : d + 2 ≤ 2 * r) :
    ∃ a : PointCoordinates K (N d - r), DistinctPoints K a ∧
      Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d) ∧
      choppedIdeal K a d = pointIdeal K a ∧
      (∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) (N d - r)) ∧
      (∀ t, choppedHilbertFunction a d t = min (N t) (N d - r))
proof:
:=
  ⟨columnSeedCoordinates d r hr hupper hlower,
    columnSeedCoordinates_properties hr hupper hlower⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.formsBasis_val_tensorExponent
statement:
theorem formsBasis_val_tensorExponent (n : ℕ) (s : Sym (Fin 3) n) :
    (formsBasis K 3 n s).val = monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent n s) 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [homogeneousTensorExponent, homogeneousTensorExponentEquiv, exponentEquiv]
    using formsBasis_val_monomial K 3 n s

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorDifferential_coeff (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ)
    (x : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → V) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t) :
    operatorDifferential T t x s = ∑ b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1), ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (pderiv i (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) 1 : Poly K 3)).coeff
          (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) • T i (x b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [operatorDifferential, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorLinearMatrix_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorLinearMatrix_val (bV : Basis (Fin a) K V)
    (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W) (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (k : Fin a) (j : Fin c) :
    (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T k j).val =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, C (bW.repr (T i (bV k)) j) * X i
proof:
:= by
  simp [operatorLinearMatrix, smul_eq_C_mul]

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomialVectorCoefficient_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialVectorCoefficient_apply {n : ℕ} (k : Fin a)
    (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (g : Fin a → Forms K 3 n) :
    polynomialVectorCoefficient k s g = (g k).val.coeff s
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorFactorialDualMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorFactorialDualMap_apply (b : Basis (Fin a) K V) (n : ℕ)
    (x : Sym (Fin 3) n → V) (g : Fin a → Forms K 3 n) :
    operatorFactorialDualMap b n x g = ∑ s : Sym (Fin 3) n, ∑ k : Fin a,
      factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent n s) * b.repr (x s) k *
        (g k).val.coeff (homogeneousTensorExponent n s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [operatorFactorialDualMap, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorFactorialDualMap_single_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorFactorialDualMap_single_basis
    (b : Basis (Fin a) K V) (n : ℕ) (x : Sym (Fin 3) n → V)
    (k : Fin a) (s : Sym (Fin 3) n) :
    operatorFactorialDualMap b n x (Pi.single k (formsBasis K 3 n s)) =
      factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent n s) * b.repr (x s) k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [operatorFactorialDualMap_apply]
  calc
    _ = ∑ q : Sym (Fin 3) n,
        factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent n q) * b.repr (x q) k *
          (formsBasis K 3 n s).val.coeff (homogeneousTensorExponent n q) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro q _
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
      · simp only [Pi.single_eq_same]
      · intro j _ hj
        simp [hj]
      · simp
    _ = _ := by
      simp [formsBasis_val_tensorExponent, coeff_monomial,
        (homogeneousTensorExponent_injective n).eq_iff]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorFactorialDualMap_injective
statement:
theorem operatorFactorialDualMap_injective [CharZero K]
    (b : Basis (Fin a) K V) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (operatorFactorialDualMap b n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  funext s
  apply b.repr.injective
  ext k
  have htest := congrArg (fun f => f (Pi.single k (formsBasis K 3 n s))) h
  simp only [operatorFactorialDualMap_single_basis] at htest
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (factorialWeight_ne_zero K _) htest

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorFactorialDual_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorFactorialDual_apply [CharZero K] (b : Basis (Fin a) K V)
    (n : ℕ) (x : Sym (Fin 3) n → V) :
    operatorFactorialDual b n x = operatorFactorialDualMap b n x
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorDifferential_single (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ)
    (b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1)) (v : V) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t) :
    operatorDifferential T t (Pi.single b v) s = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (pderiv i (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) 1 : Poly K 3)).coeff
        (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) • T i v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [operatorDifferential_coeff, Finset.sum_eq_single b]
  · simp only [Pi.single_eq_same]
  · intro q _ hq
    simp [hq]
  · simp

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_single_repr
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorDifferential_single_repr (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) (b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1))
    (v : V) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t) (j : Fin c) :
    bW.repr (operatorDifferential T t (Pi.single b v) s) j = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (pderiv i (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) 1 : Poly K 3)).coeff
        (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) * bW.repr (T i v) j
proof:
:= by
  rw [operatorDifferential_single]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorFactorialDualMap_single_module_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorFactorialDualMap_single_module_basis
    (b : Basis (Fin a) K V) (n : ℕ) (s : Sym (Fin 3) n)
    (k : Fin a) (g : Fin a → Forms K 3 n) :
    operatorFactorialDualMap b n (Pi.single s (b k)) g =
      factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent n s) *
        (g k).val.coeff (homogeneousTensorExponent n s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [operatorFactorialDualMap_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single s]
  · simp [Pi.single_eq_same, Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
  · intro q _ hq
    simp [hq]
  · simp

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorLinearMatrix_mul_single_coeff
statement:
theorem operatorLinearMatrix_mul_single_coeff
    (bV : Basis (Fin a) K V) (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) (j : Fin c) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t)
    (k : Fin a) (b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1)) :
    (linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t
      (Pi.single j (formsBasis K 3 t s)) k).val.coeff
        (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      bW.repr (T i (bV k)) j *
        (X i * monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) 1 : Poly K 3).coeff
          (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hval : (linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t
      (Pi.single j (formsBasis K 3 t s)) k).val =
      (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T k j).val * (formsBasis K 3 t s).val := by
    rw [linearMatrixMap_val, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
    · simp only [Pi.single_eq_same]
    · intro l _ hl
      simp [hl]
    · simp
  rw [hval]
  rw [operatorLinearMatrix_val, formsBasis_val_tensorExponent, Finset.sum_mul, coeff_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [mul_assoc, coeff_C_mul]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorFactorialDual_adjoint
statement:
theorem operatorFactorialDual_adjoint [CharZero K]
    (bV : Basis (Fin a) K V) (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) :
    (operatorFactorialDual bW t).toLinearMap.comp (operatorDifferential T t) =
      (linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t).dualMap.comp
        (operatorFactorialDual bV (t + 1)).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply LinearMap.pi_ext'
  intro b
  apply bV.ext
  intro k
  apply LinearMap.pi_ext'
  intro j
  apply (formsBasis K 3 t).ext
  intro s
  change operatorFactorialDualMap bW t
      (operatorDifferential T t (Pi.single b (bV k))) (Pi.single j (formsBasis K 3 t s)) =
    operatorFactorialDualMap bV (t + 1) (Pi.single b (bV k))
      (linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t (Pi.single j (formsBasis K 3 t s)))
  rw [operatorFactorialDualMap_single_basis, operatorFactorialDualMap_single_module_basis,
    operatorDifferential_single_repr, operatorLinearMatrix_mul_single_coeff,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  calc
    _ = (factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) *
        (pderiv i (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) 1 : Poly K 3)).coeff
          (homogeneousTensorExponent t s)) * bW.repr (T i (bV k)) j := by ring
    _ = (factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) *
        (X i * monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) 1 : Poly K 3).coeff
          (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b)) * bW.repr (T i (bV k)) j := by
      rw [factorialWeight_pderiv_monomial_pair]
    _ = _ := by ring

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_injective_iff_linearMatrixMap_surjective
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_injective_iff_linearMatrixMap_surjective [CharZero K]
    (bV : Basis (Fin a) K V) (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (operatorDifferential T t) ↔
      Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t)
proof:
:= by
  let S := operatorFactorialDual bV (t + 1)
  let E := operatorFactorialDual bW t
  let F := linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t
  have hadj (x : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → V) : E (operatorDifferential T t x) = F.dualMap (S x) :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun (operatorFactorialDual_adjoint bV bW T t) x
  constructor
  · intro hD
    apply LinearMap.dualMap_injective_iff.mp
    intro f g hfg
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := S.surjective f
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := S.surjective g
    have hxy : operatorDifferential T t x = operatorDifferential T t y :=
      E.injective (by rw [hadj, hadj]; exact hfg)
    exact congrArg S (hD hxy)
  · intro hF x y hxy
    apply S.injective
    apply (LinearMap.dualMap_injective_iff.mpr hF)
    rw [← hadj, ← hadj, hxy]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_linearMatrixMap_injective
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_linearMatrixMap_injective [CharZero K]
    (bV : Basis (Fin a) K V) (bW : Basis (Fin c) K W)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential T t) ↔
      Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t)
proof:
:= by
  let S := operatorFactorialDual bV (t + 1)
  let E := operatorFactorialDual bW t
  let F := linearMatrixMap (operatorLinearMatrix bV bW T) t
  have hadj (x : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → V) : E (operatorDifferential T t x) = F.dualMap (S x) :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun (operatorFactorialDual_adjoint bV bW T t) x
  constructor
  · intro hD
    apply LinearMap.dualMap_surjective_iff.mp
    intro g
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := E.surjective g
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hD z
    refine ⟨S x, ?_⟩
    rw [← hadj, hx, hz]
  · intro hF z
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (LinearMap.dualMap_surjective_iff.mpr hF) (E z)
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := S.surjective g
    refine ⟨x, E.injective ?_⟩
    rw [hadj, hg]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorRaisedIndex_exponent
statement:
@[simp] theorem operatorRaisedIndex_exponent (t : ℕ) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t) (i : Fin 3) :
    homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) (operatorRaisedIndex t s i) =
      homogeneousTensorExponent t s + Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [operatorRaisedIndex, homogeneousTensorExponent]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_apply
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_apply (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (t : ℕ)
    (x : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → V) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t) :
    operatorDifferential T t x s = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (((homogeneousTensorExponent t s) i + 1 : ℕ) : K) •
        T i (x (operatorRaisedIndex t s i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [operatorDifferential_coeff, Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [coeff_pderiv, coeff_monomial]
  rw [← operatorRaisedIndex_exponent t s i]
  simp only [(homogeneousTensorExponent_injective (t + 1)).eq_iff, ite_mul,
    one_mul, zero_mul, ite_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.vFiniteCross_multiply_zero
statement:
theorem vFiniteCross_multiply_zero (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (n : ℕ) (c : VChartFiniteVector K n) :
    vFiniteCross q hq s (n + 1) (vFiniteMultiply q hq s n c) = 0

name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_eval
statement:
theorem affineDehom_eval (f : Poly K 3) (a : Fin 2 → K) :
    eval ![a 0, a 1, 1] f = eval a (affineDehom f)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (aeval a).comp (affineDehom (K := K)) =
      aeval ![a 0, a 1, 1] := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [affineDehom, AlgHom.comp_apply]
  exact (AlgHom.congr_fun h f).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_projective_chart_points
statement:
theorem exists_projective_chart_points [IsAlgClosed K] {p : ℕ}
    (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hsat : ∀ f, (X 2 : Poly K 3) * f ∈ I → f ∈ I)
    (N : ℕ) (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2})
    [IsReduced (AffineCoordinateAlgebra I)]
    (hlen : finrank K (AffineCoordinateAlgebra I) = p) :
    ∃ a : PointCoordinates K p, DistinctPoints K a ∧
      (∀ t, pointDegreePiece K a t = idealFormPiece I t) ∧
      (∀ t, N ≤ t → Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a t))
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Finite K (AffineCoordinateAlgebra I) :=
    affineCoordinateAlgebra_finite I hI N hcut
  let e : AffineCoordinateAlgebra I ≃ₐ[K] (Fin p → K) :=
    finiteReducedAlgebraFinEquiv (K := K) p hlen
  let φ : Poly K 2 →ₐ[K] (Fin p → K) :=
    e.toAlgHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K (I.map (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom))
  let a := affinePresentationCoordinates φ
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := e.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmap (t : ℕ) : pointEvaluation K a t =
      e.toLinearMap.comp (formChartMap (affineQuotientMap I) t) := by
    ext f i
    exact (affinePresentation_plane_apply φ f.val i).symm
  refine ⟨a, affinePresentation_distinct φ hφ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t
    ext f
    change pointEvaluation K a t f = 0 ↔ f.val ∈ I
    rw [hmap, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    change e (affineQuotientMap I f.val) = 0 ↔ f.val ∈ I
    rw [← map_zero e, e.injective.eq_iff]
    exact affineQuotientMap_form_eq_zero_iff I hI hsat t f
  · intro t hNt
    rw [hmap]
    exact e.surjective.comp
      (formChartMap_surjective_of_le (affineQuotientMap I) (affineQuotientMap_surjective I)
        (affineQuotientMap_z I) I hI
        (fun _ hf => affineQuotientMap_eq_zero_of_mem I hf) N t hNt hcut)

    (hpieces : ∀ t, pointDegreePiece K a t = idealFormPiece I t) (t : ℕ) :
    pointHilbertFunction K a t = finrank K (Forms K 3 t ⧸ idealFormPiece I t)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (hpieces t)).finrank_eq

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.selectedGridIndex_injective
statement:
theorem selectedGridIndex_injective (δ : Fin m → ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (selectedGridIndex δ)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  have hx := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).injective (congrArg Prod.fst h)
  have hy := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).injective (congrArg Prod.snd h)
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨i,j⟩, hij⟩, a,b⟩ := s
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨i',j'⟩, hij'⟩, a',b'⟩ := t
  change (⟨i,a⟩ : RootIndex δ) = ⟨i',a'⟩ at hx
  change (⟨j,b⟩ : RootIndex δ) = ⟨j',b'⟩ at hy
  cases hx
  cases hy
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.selectedAffineEvaluation_surjective
statement:
theorem selectedAffineEvaluation_surjective (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Function.Surjective (selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (selectedGridIndex_injective δ).surjective_comp_right (γ := K) v
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_surjective
    (flatRoots δ α) (flatRoots δ β)
    (flatRoots_injective δ α hα) (flatRoots_injective δ β hβ) w
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  ext s
  rw [selectedAffineEvaluation_eq_full, hf]
  exact congrFun hw s

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.affineCofactorIdeal_le_selectedAffineEvaluation_ker
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  rintro f ⟨j,rfl⟩
  change selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β (affineDehom (cofactorProduct δ α β j)) = 0
  ext s
  simpa [selectedAffineEvaluation_apply, eval_affineDehom] using
    cofactorProduct_eval_selected δ α β s j

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.selectedAffineEvaluation_ker
statement:
theorem selectedAffineEvaluation_ker {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    RingHom.ker (selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β).toRingHom = affineCofactorIdeal δ α β
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    have hker : RingHom.ker
        (Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (flatRoots δ α) (flatRoots δ β)) ≤
        affineCofactorIdeal δ α β := by
      rw [Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_ker _ _ (flatRoots_injective δ α hα)
        (flatRoots_injective δ β hβ)]
      exact mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal δ α β
    apply mem_ideal_of_vanish_on_selected
      (Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (flatRoots δ α) (flatRoots δ β))
      (Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_surjective _ _ (flatRoots_injective δ α hα)
        (flatRoots_injective δ β hβ))
      (affineCofactorIdeal δ α β) hker (selectedGridSet δ)
      (affineCofactor_separator δ α β hα hβ)
    intro ij hij
    let u := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).symm ij.1
    let v := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).symm ij.2
    have huv : u.1 < v.1 := hij
    let s : SelectedIndex δ := ⟨⟨(u.1,v.1),huv⟩,(u.2,v.2)⟩
    have hh := congrFun (show selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β f = 0 from hf) s
    simpa [Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_apply, flatRoots, selectedAffineEvaluation_apply,
      selectedX,selectedY,s,u,v] using hh
  · exact affineCofactorIdeal_le_selectedAffineEvaluation_ker δ α β

statement:

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRow_linearBlock_allTwists_open

      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 → ∀ t,
        LinearMatrixMaximalRank (universalPositiveLinearBlock (by omega : 0 < r) u) t

  linearMatrixFamily_allTwists_principal_open_of_surjective

      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 → ∀ t,
        LinearMatrixMaximalRank
          (universalPositiveLinearBlock (by omega : 0 < 2 * q + 1) u) t
proof:
:= by
  have hc : positiveRowColumns (2 * q + 1) a = a + 2 * q := by
    unfold positiveRowColumns
    omega
  apply positiveRow_linearBlock_allTwists_open (by omega : 2 ≤ 2 * q + 1)

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRowProfile_sum
statement:
theorem positiveRowProfile_sum (r a : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∑ i, positiveRowProfile r a i) = 2 * r + a
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ i, positiveRowProfile r a i) =
        ∑ i : Fin (r + a), Ferrers.positiveProfile r a i :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv (finCongr (positiveRowColumns_rows r a hr)) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
    _ = 2 * r + a := Ferrers.positiveProfile_sum r a

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRowProfile_function_sum
statement:
theorem positiveRowProfile_function_sum (r a : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (g : ℕ → ℤ) :
    (∑ i, g (positiveRowProfile r a i)) = (r : ℤ) * g 2 + (a : ℤ) * g 1
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (∑ i, g (positiveRowProfile r a i)) =
      ∑ i : Fin (r + a), g (Ferrers.positiveProfile r a i) :=
    Fintype.sum_equiv (finCongr (positiveRowColumns_rows r a hr)) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
  rw [heq, Fin.sum_univ_add]
  have hfirst (i : Fin r) : Ferrers.positiveProfile r a (Fin.castAdd a i) = 2 := by
    simp [Ferrers.positiveProfile, i.isLt]
  have hlast (i : Fin a) : Ferrers.positiveProfile r a (Fin.natAdd r i) = 1 := by
    simp [Ferrers.positiveProfile]
  simp_rw [hfirst, hlast]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRow_counts

theorem positiveRow_counts {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    aCount (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) r = a ∧
      cCount (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) r = positiveRowColumns r a
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [aCount, cCount, positiveRowGeneratorDegree, positiveRowColumns]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRow_minorHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem positiveRow_minorHilbertFunction
    {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K (positiveRowProfile r a))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B))
    (t : ℤ) :
    (minorHilbertFunction (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B) t : ℤ) =
      hbCoefficient (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) r t
proof:
:= by
  rw [minorHilbertFunction_at_degree _ _
    (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous _ B) hprimitive, positiveRowProfile_sum r a hr]
  rw [positiveRowProfile_function_sum r a hr
    (fun j => N₂ (t - ((2 * r + a : ℕ) : ℤ) + (j : ℤ)))]
  obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := positiveRow_counts (a := a) hr
  have hd : (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a : ℤ) = 2 * r + a - 2 := by
    unfold positiveRowGeneratorDegree
    omega
  dsimp [hbCoefficient]
  rw [ha, hc, hd]
  have h₂ : t - (2 * (r : ℤ) + a) + 2 = t - (2 * (r : ℤ) + a - 2) := by ring
  have h₁ : t - (2 * (r : ℤ) + a) + 1 = t - (2 * (r : ℤ) + a - 2) - 1 := by ring
  have h₀ : t - (2 * (r : ℤ) + a) = t - (2 * (r : ℤ) + a - 2) - 2 := by ring
  rw [h₂, h₁, h₀]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRow_minorHilbertFunction_formula
statement:
theorem positiveRow_minorHilbertFunction_formula
    {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K (positiveRowProfile r a))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B))
    (t : ℤ) :
    (minorHilbertFunction (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B) t : ℤ) =
      if t < (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a : ℤ) then N₂ t
        else (N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) : ℤ) - r
proof:
:= by
  rw [positiveRow_minorHilbertFunction hr B hprimitive, hbCoefficient_formula]

name: ChoppedPlane.finiteCombination_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteCombination_apply (v : κ → V) (c : κ → K) :
    finiteCombination (K := K) v c = ∑ i, c i • v i
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteCombination]

name: ChoppedPlane.quotient_lifts_surjective
statement:
theorem quotient_lifts_surjective (Q : Submodule K V) (r : α → V) (b : κ → V)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ∈ Q)
    (h : Function.Surjective (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim r b))) :
    Function.Surjective (Q.mkQ.comp (finiteCombination (K := K) b))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Q.mkQ_surjective x
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h v
  refine ⟨fun i => c (.inr i), ?_⟩
  have hre : Q.mkQ (∑ i, c (.inl i) • r i) = 0 := by
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero Q).mpr
    exact Q.sum_mem fun i _ => Q.smul_mem _ (hr i)
  have hs := congrArg Q.mkQ hc
  rw [finiteCombination_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, map_add] at hs
  simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hs
  rw [hre, zero_add] at hs
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, finiteCombination_apply] using hs

name: ChoppedPlane.quotientBasisOfCombined_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBasisOfCombined_apply [DecidableEq κ]
    (Q : Submodule K V) (r : α → V) (b : κ → V) (hr) (h) (hdim) (i : κ) :
    quotientBasisOfCombined Q r b hr h hdim i = Q.mkQ (b i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold quotientBasisOfCombined
  rw [Basis.map_apply, LinearEquiv.ofBijective_apply, Pi.basisFun_apply]
  change Q.mkQ (finiteCombination (K := K) b (Pi.single i 1)) = Q.mkQ (b i)
  simp [finiteCombination_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.finiteCombination_isPolynomialFamily
statement:
theorem finiteCombination_isPolynomialFamily
    (v : κ → (ι → K) → V) (hv : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (v i)) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun a => finiteCombination (K := K) (fun i => v i a))
proof:
:= by
  apply isPolynomialFamily_linearMap
  intro c
  have hs := IsPolynomialFamily.sum fun i =>
    (isPolynomialFamily_const (c i)).smul (hv i)
  simpa only [finiteCombination_apply] using hs

name: ChoppedPlane.quotient_basis_principal_open
statement:
theorem quotient_basis_principal_open
    (Q : (ι → K) → Submodule K V)
    (r : α → (ι → K) → V) (b : κ → V)
    (hrpoly : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (r i))
    (hrQ : ∀ a i, r i a ∈ Q a)
    (a₀ : ι → K)
    (h₀ : Function.Bijective (finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a₀) b))) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
      finrank K (V ⧸ Q a) = Fintype.card κ →
      ∃ B : Basis κ K (V ⧸ Q a), ∀ i, B i = (Q a).mkQ (b i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F (a : ι → K) := finiteCombination (K := K) (Sum.elim (fun i => r i a) b)
  have hF : IsPolynomialFamily F := by
    apply finiteCombination_isPolynomialFamily
    intro i
    cases i with
    | inl j => exact hrpoly j
    | inr j => exact isPolynomialFamily_const (b j)
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hprop⟩ := rank_polynomial_principal_open F hF a₀
  refine ⟨D, hD, fun a ha hdim => ?_⟩
  have hs : Function.Surjective (F a) := by
    apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
    apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
    have hn := hprop a ha
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr h₀.2, finrank_top] at hn
    exact le_antisymm (Submodule.finrank_le _) hn
  exact ⟨quotientBasisOfCombined (Q a) (fun i => r i a) b (hrQ a) hs hdim,
    fun i => quotientBasisOfCombined_apply _ _ _ _ _ _ i⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_principal_pointDegreeSpace
statement:
theorem exists_principal_pointDegreeSpace (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hdim : finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = 1) :
    ∃ f : Forms K 3 d, f.val ≠ 0 ∧
      pointDegreeSpace K a d = Submodule.span K {f.val}
proof:
:= by
  have hne : pointDegreePiece K a d ≠ ⊥ :=
    (Submodule.isAtom_iff_finrank_eq_one.mpr hdim).ne_bot
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfzero⟩ := (pointDegreePiece K a d).ne_bot_iff.mp hne
  have hspan := eq_span_singleton_of_mem_of_finrank_eq_one hdim hf hfzero
  refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    apply hfzero
    exact Subtype.ext h
  · rw [pointDegreeSpace, hspan, Submodule.map_span]
    simp only [Set.image_singleton, Submodule.subtype_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.nonzero_form_regular_singleton
statement:
theorem nonzero_form_regular_singleton (f : Forms K 3 d) (hf : f.val ≠ 0)
    (hd : 0 < d) : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) [f.val]
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff (Poly K 3) f.val).mpr ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro x hx
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hx).resolve_left hf
  · change (⊤ : Ideal (Poly K 3)) ≠ Ideal.ofList [f.val] * ⊤
    rw [Ideal.mul_top, Ideal.ofList_singleton]
    intro htop
    have hu : IsUnit f.val := Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mp htop.symm
    have hzero := (MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff_totalDegree_of_isReduced.mp hu).2
    have hdeg := f.property.totalDegree hf
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedIdeal_eq_singleton_of_space_eq
statement:
theorem choppedIdeal_eq_singleton_of_space_eq (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Forms K 3 d)
    (hspan : pointDegreeSpace K a d = Submodule.span K {f.val}) :
    choppedIdeal K a d = Ideal.span {f.val}

name: ChoppedPlane.principal_chop_hilbert_coefficients
statement:
theorem principal_chop_hilbert_coefficients (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Forms K 3 d) (hf : f.val ≠ 0)
    (hspan : pointDegreeSpace K a d = Submodule.span K {f.val}) (t : ℕ) :
    (choppedHilbertFunction a d t : ℤ) = N₂ t - N₂ ((t : ℤ) - d)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : t < d
  · rw [choppedHilbertFunction_below_degree a ht, N₂_nat,
      N₂_neg (by omega : (t : ℤ) - d < 0)]
    simp [N]
  · have hdt : d ≤ t := by omega
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hdt
    have hN : N e ≤ N (d + e) := Nat.choose_le_choose 2 (by omega)
    have heZ : ((d + e : ℕ) : ℤ) - d = (e : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [heZ, N₂_nat, N₂_nat]
    change (generatedHilbertFunction (pointDegreeSpace K a d) (d + e) : ℤ) = _
    rw [hspan, single_generator_hilbertFunction f hf]
    change ((N (d + e) - N e : ℕ) : ℤ) = _
    exact Nat.cast_sub hN

name: ChoppedPlane.principal_chop_conclusion
statement:
theorem principal_chop_conclusion (a : PointCoordinates K p) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdim : finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = 1) :
    ∃ f : Forms K 3 d,
      f.val ≠ 0 ∧
      pointDegreeSpace K a d = Submodule.span K {f.val} ∧
      choppedIdeal K a d = Ideal.span {f.val} ∧
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) [f.val] ∧
      ∀ t : ℕ, (choppedHilbertFunction a d t : ℤ) = N₂ t - N₂ ((t : ℤ) - d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hspan⟩ := exists_principal_pointDegreeSpace a hdim
  exact ⟨f, hf, hspan, choppedIdeal_eq_singleton_of_space_eq a f hspan,
    nonzero_form_regular_singleton f hf hd,
    principal_chop_hilbert_coefficients a f hf hspan⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.principal_chop_regular_generators
statement:
theorem principal_chop_regular_generators (a : PointCoordinates K p) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdim : finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = 1) :
    ∃ f : Fin 1 → Forms K 3 d,
      Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i => (f i).val)) = choppedIdeal K a d ∧
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) (List.ofFn (fun i => (f i).val))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hspan, hIdeal, hregular, hcoeff⟩ := principal_chop_conclusion a hd hdim
  refine ⟨fun _ => f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hIdeal.symm
  · simpa using hregular

name: ChoppedPlane.principal_chop_hilbert_coefficients_nat
statement:
theorem principal_chop_hilbert_coefficients_nat (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Forms K 3 d) (hf : f.val ≠ 0)
    (hspan : pointDegreeSpace K a d = Submodule.span K {f.val}) (t : ℕ) :
    choppedHilbertFunction a d t = (N₂ t - N₂ ((t : ℤ) - d)).toNat
proof:
:= by
  simpa using congrArg Int.toNat (principal_chop_hilbert_coefficients a f hf hspan t)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.polynomialLaurentGrade_mul
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported.mpr
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_add.mp
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.support_coeff_mul_subset p q hc)
  have ha' := AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported.mp hp ha
  have hb' := AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported.mp hq hb
  change 0 ≤ a.1 + b.1 ∧ 0 ≤ a.2 + b.2 ∧
    (a.1 + b.1) + (a.2 + b.2) = d + e
  change 0 ≤ a.1 ∧ 0 ≤ a.2 ∧ a.1 + a.2 = d at ha'
  change 0 ≤ b.1 ∧ 0 ≤ b.2 ∧ b.1 + b.2 = e at hb'
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.polynomialLaurentGrade_single
statement:
theorem polynomialLaurentGrade_single (e : ℤ × ℤ) (c : K)
    (he : 0 ≤ e.1 ∧ 0 ≤ e.2) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single e c ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade (e.1 + e.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported.mpr
  intro a ha
  have h := Finsupp.support_single_subset ha
  have : a = e := Finset.mem_singleton.mp h
  subst a
  exact ⟨he.1, he.2, rfl⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.U_mem_polynomialLaurentGrade
statement: theorem U_mem_polynomialLaurentGrade : (U : BinaryLaurent K) ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade 1
proof:
:=
  polynomialLaurentGrade_single (1, 0) 1 (by norm_num)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.V_mem_polynomialLaurentGrade
statement: theorem V_mem_polynomialLaurentGrade : (V : BinaryLaurent K) ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade 1
proof:
:=
  polynomialLaurentGrade_single (0, 1) 1 (by norm_num)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.one_mem_polynomialLaurentGrade
statement: theorem one_mem_polynomialLaurentGrade : (1 : BinaryLaurent K) ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade 0
proof:
:= by
  change AddMonoidAlgebra.single (0, 0) 1 ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade 0
  exact polynomialLaurentGrade_single (0, 0) (1 : K) (by norm_num)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cubicLinearFactors_laurent_mem
statement:
theorem cubicLinearFactors_laurent_mem (q : K) (i : Fin 3) :
    binaryLaurentEmbedding (cubicLinearFactors q i) ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade 1
proof:
:= by
  have hu := U_mem_polynomialLaurentGrade (K := K)
  have hv := V_mem_polynomialLaurentGrade (K := K)
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [cubicLinearFactors, binaryU, binaryV, binaryLaurentEmbedding] using
      (polynomialLaurentGrade (K := K) 1).add_mem hu hv
  · simpa [cubicLinearFactors, binaryU, binaryV, binaryLaurentEmbedding, Algebra.smul_def] using
      (polynomialLaurentGrade (K := K) 1).add_mem hu
        ((polynomialLaurentGrade (K := K) 1).smul_mem q hv)
  · simpa [cubicLinearFactors, binaryU, binaryV, binaryLaurentEmbedding, Algebra.smul_def] using
      (polynomialLaurentGrade (K := K) 1).add_mem hu
        ((polynomialLaurentGrade (K := K) 1).smul_mem (q ^ 2) hv)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileFactors_laurent_mem
statement:
theorem profileFactors_laurent_mem (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (i : Fin 3) :
    binaryLaurentEmbedding (profileFactors q s i) ∈
      polynomialLaurentGrade (profileFactorDegrees s i : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> fin_cases i
  · exact cubicLinearFactors_laurent_mem q 0
  · exact cubicLinearFactors_laurent_mem q 1
  · exact cubicLinearFactors_laurent_mem q 2
  · exact cubicLinearFactors_laurent_mem q 0
  · simpa [profileFactors, profileFactorDegrees] using one_mem_polynomialLaurentGrade (K := K)
  · simpa [profileFactors, profileFactorDegrees, map_mul] using
      polynomialLaurentGrade_mul (cubicLinearFactors_laurent_mem q 1)
        (cubicLinearFactors_laurent_mem q 2)
  · simpa [profileFactors, profileFactorDegrees] using one_mem_polynomialLaurentGrade (K := K)
  · exact cubicLinearFactors_laurent_mem q 1
  · simpa [profileFactors, profileFactorDegrees, map_mul] using
      polynomialLaurentGrade_mul (cubicLinearFactors_laurent_mem q 0)
        (cubicLinearFactors_laurent_mem q 2)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.freeLaurentEquiv_laurentOperator
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeLaurentEquiv_laurentOperator (γ : ι → BinaryLaurent K)
    (σ : ι → ι) (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (i : ι) :
    freeLaurentEquiv (laurentOperator γ σ p) i = γ i * freeLaurentEquiv p (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [laurentOperator]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.laurentOperator_supported
statement:
theorem laurentOperator_supported (γ : ι → BinaryLaurent K) (σ : ι → ι)
    (g h : ι → ℤ) (d : ℤ) (δ : ι → ℤ)
    (hγ : ∀ i, γ i ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade (δ i))
    (hdegree : ∀ i, δ i + h i = d + g (σ i))
    (P : ℤ × ℤ → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ a b : ℤ × ℤ, 0 ≤ a.1 → 0 ≤ a.2 → P b → P (a + b))
    (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K ι)
    (hp : p ∈ Finsupp.supported K K
      {e : ι × (ℤ × ℤ) | e.2.1 + e.2.2 + g e.1 = k ∧ P e.2}) :
    laurentOperator γ σ p ∈ Finsupp.supported K K
      {e : ι × (ℤ × ℤ) | e.2.1 + e.2.2 + h e.1 = k + d ∧ P e.2}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Finsupp.mem_supported K _).mpr
  intro e he
  have he' : e.2 ∈ (γ e.1 * freeLaurentEquiv p (σ e.1)).coeff.support := by
    rw [← freeLaurentEquiv_laurentOperator, Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
    simpa only [freeLaurentEquiv_coeff] using (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp he)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Finset.mem_add.mp
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.support_coeff_mul_subset _ _ he')
  have ha' := AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported.mp (hγ e.1) ha
  have hb' : (σ e.1, b) ∈ p.support := by
    simpa only [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, freeLaurentEquiv_coeff] using hb
  have hp' := (Finsupp.mem_supported K p).mp hp hb'
  change 0 ≤ a.1 ∧ 0 ≤ a.2 ∧ a.1 + a.2 = δ e.1 at ha'
  change b.1 + b.2 + g (σ e.1) = k ∧ P b at hp'
  change e.2.1 + e.2.2 + h e.1 = k + d ∧ P e.2
  have hh := hdegree e.1
  rw [← hab]
  exact ⟨by change a.1 + b.1 + (a.2 + b.2) + h e.1 = k + d; omega,
    hP a b ha'.1 ha'.2.1 hp'.2⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.laurentOperator_mem_overlapGrade
statement:
theorem laurentOperator_mem_overlapGrade (γ : ι → BinaryLaurent K) (σ : ι → ι)
    (g h : ι → ℤ) (d : ℤ) (δ : ι → ℤ)
    (hγ : ∀ i, γ i ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade (δ i))
    (hdegree : ∀ i, δ i + h i = d + g (σ i))
    (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (hp : p ∈ overlapGrade g k) :
    laurentOperator γ σ p ∈ overlapGrade h (k + d)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [overlapGrade, gradeIndices, and_true] using
    laurentOperator_supported γ σ g h d δ hγ hdegree (fun _ => True)
      (by intros; trivial) k p
        (by simpa only [overlapGrade, gradeIndices, and_true] using hp)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.laurentOperator_mem_uChartGrade
statement:
theorem laurentOperator_mem_uChartGrade (γ : ι → BinaryLaurent K) (σ : ι → ι)
    (g h : ι → ℤ) (d : ℤ) (δ : ι → ℤ)
    (hγ : ∀ i, γ i ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade (δ i))
    (hdegree : ∀ i, δ i + h i = d + g (σ i))
    (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (hp : p ∈ uChartGrade g k) :
    laurentOperator γ σ p ∈ uChartGrade h (k + d)
proof:
:=
  laurentOperator_supported γ σ g h d δ hγ hdegree (fun e => 0 ≤ e.2)
    (by intro a b ha hb h; change 0 ≤ a.2 + b.2; omega) k p hp

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.laurentOperator_mem_vChartGrade
statement:
theorem laurentOperator_mem_vChartGrade (γ : ι → BinaryLaurent K) (σ : ι → ι)
    (g h : ι → ℤ) (d : ℤ) (δ : ι → ℤ)
    (hγ : ∀ i, γ i ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade (δ i))
    (hdegree : ∀ i, δ i + h i = d + g (σ i))
    (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (hp : p ∈ vChartGrade g k) :
    laurentOperator γ σ p ∈ vChartGrade h (k + d)
proof:
:=
  laurentOperator_supported γ σ g h d δ hγ hdegree (fun e => 0 ≤ e.1)
    (by intro a b ha hb h; change 0 ≤ a.1 + b.1; omega) k p hp

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.laurentOperator_projection_commutes
statement:
theorem laurentOperator_projection_commutes (γ : ι → BinaryLaurent K) (σ : ι → ι)
    (g h : ι → ℤ) (d : ℤ) (δ : ι → ℤ)
    (hγ : ∀ i, γ i ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade (δ i))
    (hdegree : ∀ i, δ i + h i = d + g (σ i)) (k : ℤ) :
    (gradeProjection h (k + d)).comp (laurentOperator γ σ) =
      (laurentOperator γ σ).comp (gradeProjection g k)
proof:
:=
  gradeProjection_commutes_of_degree_shift g h d _
    (laurentOperator_mem_overlapGrade γ σ g h d δ hγ hdegree) k

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.freeLaurentEquiv_laurentScalar
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeLaurentEquiv_laurentScalar (c : BinaryLaurent K)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (i : ι) :

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.freeLaurentEquiv_symm_scalar

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.laurentScalar_mem_overlapGrade
statement:
theorem laurentScalar_mem_overlapGrade (c : BinaryLaurent K) (d : ℤ)
    (hc : c ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade d) (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (hp : p ∈ overlapGrade g k) :
    laurentScalar c p ∈ overlapGrade g (k + d)

  laurentOperator_mem_overlapGrade _ _ g g d (fun _ => d) (fun _ => hc)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.laurentScalar_mem_uChartGrade
statement:
theorem laurentScalar_mem_uChartGrade (c : BinaryLaurent K) (d : ℤ)
    (hc : c ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade d) (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (hp : p ∈ uChartGrade g k) :
    laurentScalar c p ∈ uChartGrade g (k + d)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.laurentScalar_mem_vChartGrade
statement:
theorem laurentScalar_mem_vChartGrade (c : BinaryLaurent K) (d : ℤ)
    (hc : c ∈ polynomialLaurentGrade d) (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (hp : p ∈ vChartGrade g k) :
    laurentScalar c p ∈ vChartGrade g (k + d)

      (homogeneousTensorExponent n s) = ν (c s)
proof:
:=
  congrFun (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_synthesis n (fun s => ν (c s))) s

name: ChoppedPlane.finiteDirectionalSynthesis_injective
statement:
theorem finiteDirectionalSynthesis_injective (ν : V →ₗ[K] M)
    (hν : Function.Injective ν) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (R := R) ν n)
proof:
:= by
  intro c d h
  funext s
  apply hν

name: ChoppedPlane.finiteDirectionalSynthesis_zero
statement:

proof:
:= by
