name: ChoppedPlane.tensorDirectional_homogeneous_succ
statement:
theorem tensorDirectional_homogeneous_succ (f : Fin 3 → R) (t : ℕ)
    {P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)} (hP : TensorHomogeneous (t+1) P) :
    TensorHomogeneous t (tensorDirectional f P)
proof:
:= by
  apply (tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients t _).mpr
  intro s hs
  rw [tensorCoefficients_directional]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  have hraise : (s + Finsupp.single i 1).degree ≠ t+1 := by
    simp only [map_add, Finsupp.degree_single]
    omega
  rw [(tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients (t+1) P).mp hP _ hraise, smul_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.finiteDirectionalSynthesis_derivative_coefficient
statement:
theorem finiteDirectionalSynthesis_derivative_coefficient
    (ν : V →ₗ[K] M) (μ : W →ₗ[K] M) (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (hT : ∀ i v, μ (T i v) = f i • ν v)
    (t : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) (t+1) → V) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t) :
    tensorCoefficients (tensorDirectional f (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (R := R) ν (t+1) c))
      (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) = μ (operatorDifferential T t c s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorCoefficients_directional, operatorDifferential_apply, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← operatorRaisedIndex_exponent, finiteDirectionalSynthesis_coefficient,
    map_smul, hT]
  rw [mul_comm, mul_smul]
  simp only [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]

name: ChoppedPlane.finiteDirectionalSynthesis_derivative
statement:
theorem finiteDirectionalSynthesis_derivative
    (ν : V →ₗ[K] M) (μ : W →ₗ[K] M) (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (hT : ∀ i v, μ (T i v) = f i • ν v)
    (t : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) (t+1) → V) :
    tensorDirectional f (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (R := R) ν (t+1) c) =
      finiteDirectionalSynthesis (R := R) μ t (operatorDifferential T t c)
proof:
:= by
  apply tensorCoefficients.injective
  ext e
  by_cases he : e.degree = t
  · obtain ⟨s,rfl⟩ := exists_homogeneousTensorExponent t e he
    rw [finiteDirectionalSynthesis_coefficient]
    exact finiteDirectionalSynthesis_derivative_coefficient ν μ f T hT t c s
  · rw [(tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients t _).mp
      (tensorDirectional_homogeneous_succ f t (finiteDirectionalSynthesis_homogeneous ν (t+1) c)) e he,
      (tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients t _).mp
        (finiteDirectionalSynthesis_homogeneous μ t _) e he]

name: ChoppedPlane.finiteDirectionalSynthesis_derivative_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finiteDirectionalSynthesis_derivative_eq_zero_iff
    (ν : V →ₗ[K] M) (μ : W →ₗ[K] M) (hμ : Function.Injective μ) (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (hT : ∀ i v, μ (T i v) = f i • ν v)
    (t : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) (t+1) → V) :
    tensorDirectional f (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (R := R) ν (t+1) c) = 0 ↔
      operatorDifferential T t c = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteDirectionalSynthesis_derivative ν μ f T hT t c]
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply finiteDirectionalSynthesis_injective (R := R) μ hμ t
    simpa using h
  · intro h
    simp [h]

name: ChoppedPlane.operatorDifferential_injective_of_tensor_kernel
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_injective_of_tensor_kernel
    (ν : V →ₗ[K] M) (μ : W →ₗ[K] M) (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (hT : ∀ i v, μ (T i v) = f i • ν v)
    (t : ℕ)
    (hkernel : ∀ c : Sym (Fin 3) (t+1) → V,
      tensorDirectional f (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (R := R) ν (t+1) c) = 0 → c = 0) :
    Function.Injective (operatorDifferential T t)
proof:
:= by
  intro c d h
  have hd : operatorDifferential T t (c-d) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, h, sub_self]
  have hzero : tensorDirectional f (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (R := R) ν (t+1) (c-d)) = 0 := by
    rw [finiteDirectionalSynthesis_derivative ν μ f T hT t, hd]
    simp
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hkernel (c-d) hzero)

name: MonomialOrder.sum_ne_zero_of_degree_injOn
statement:
theorem sum_ne_zero_of_degree_injOn (m : MonomialOrder σ)
    (s : Finset α) (f : α → MvPolynomial σ R) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hnz : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (fun i => m.degree (f i)) (s : Set α)) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image s
    (fun j => m.toSyn (m.degree (f j))) hs
  have hcoeff : (∑ j ∈ s, f j).coeff (m.degree (f i)) = m.leadingCoeff (f i) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · rfl
    · intro j hj hji
      apply m.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt
      apply lt_of_le_of_ne (hmax j hj)
      intro heq
      exact hji (hinj hj hi (m.toSyn.injective heq))
    · exact fun h => False.elim (h hi)
  intro hz
  have hlead := m.leadingCoeff_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hnz i hi)
  apply hlead
  rw [← hcoeff, hz]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_cyclic_kernel_zero
statement:
theorem quartic_cyclic_kernel_zero
    (dual : Bool) (γ : Fin 3 → BinaryRing K)
    (hγ : γ 0 * γ 1 * γ 2 = binaryCubic K) (w : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hgraded : ∀ (t : ℤ) (m : BinaryVector K), WeightedVector w t m →
      WeightedVector w (t + 1) (quarticCyclicZ dual γ m))
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (ht : ∀ k : Fin 3, t < 2 * (n : ℤ) + (w k : ℤ)) :
    let Z
proof:
:= quarticCyclicZ dual γ
    let hZ : Z ^ 3 = binaryCubic K • 1 :=
      (quarticCyclicZ_cube dual γ).trans (by rw [hγ])
    let := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) Z hZ
    ∀ (P : AuxTensor (R := CyclicCubicRing (BinaryRing K) (binaryCubic K))
        (M := BinaryVector K)), TensorHomogeneous n P →
      (∀ (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3), tensorCoefficients P α i ∈
        signedForms K 2 (t - w i)) →
      tensorDirectional (quarticRow
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryU K))
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryV K))
        (cyclicRoot (binaryCubic K))) P = 0 → P = 0 := by
  dsimp only
  let Z := quarticCyclicZ dual γ
  have hZ : Z ^ 3 = binaryCubic K • 1 :=
    (quarticCyclicZ_cube dual γ).trans (by rw [hγ])
  let := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) Z hZ
  intro P haux hweighted hδ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := quartic_cyclic_kernel_descends dual γ hγ P haux hδ
  apply symmetric_kernel_zero_of_weighted_columns (binaryCubic K) Z hZ w t n
    (quarticKernelMatrixU
      (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryU K))
      (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryV K))
      (cyclicRoot (binaryCubic K)) 0) _ ht P hweighted c hc
  intro j k α i
  rw [tensorCoefficients_tmul]
  change (((quadraticSymmetricPolynomial (binaryCubic K) n j).coeff α •
    (Pi.single k (1 : BinaryRing K) : BinaryVector K)) : BinaryVector K) i ∈
      signedForms K 2 (2 * (n : ℤ) + (w k : ℤ) - w i)
  exact cyclic_quadraticSymmetric_coefficient_degree (binaryCubic K) Z hZ w hgraded n j α i k

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_profile_kernel_zero
statement:
theorem quartic_profile_kernel_zero (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (dual : Bool) (n : ℕ) (t : ℤ)
    (ht : ∀ k : Fin 3, t < 2 * (n : ℤ) + (quarticProfileWeights dual s k : ℤ)) :
    let Z
proof:
:= quarticCyclicZ dual (profileFactors q s)
    let hZ : Z ^ 3 = binaryCubic K • 1 :=
      (quarticCyclicZ_cube dual (profileFactors q s)).trans (by
        rw [profileFactors_product q hq])
    let := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) Z hZ
    ∀ (P : AuxTensor (R := CyclicCubicRing (BinaryRing K) (binaryCubic K))
        (M := BinaryVector K)), TensorHomogeneous n P →
      (∀ (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3), tensorCoefficients P α i ∈
        signedForms K 2 (t - quarticProfileWeights dual s i)) →
      tensorDirectional (quarticRow
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryU K))
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryV K))
        (cyclicRoot (binaryCubic K))) P = 0 → P = 0 := by
  dsimp only
  apply quartic_cyclic_kernel_zero dual (profileFactors q s)
    (profileFactors_product q hq s) (quarticProfileWeights dual s) _ n t ht
  intro a m hm
  cases dual
  · exact weightedVector_profileZ q s hm
  · exact weightedVector_profileZDual q s hm

name: ChoppedPlane.minorHilbertFunction_nat
statement:
theorem minorHilbertFunction_nat
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (t : ℕ) :
    minorHilbertFunction B (t : ℤ) =
      idealQuotientHilbertFunction (maximalMinorIdeal B) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold minorHilbertFunction minorFormToRingQuotient
  rw [signedForms_nat]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_eq_minor_of_pieces
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_eq_minor_of_pieces
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hpieces : ∀ t, pointDegreePiece K a t = idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal B) t)
    (t : ℕ) : pointHilbertFunction K a t = minorHilbertFunction B (t : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointHilbertFunction_eq_of_idealFormPiece _ a hpieces,
    finrank_idealFormQuotient, minorHilbertFunction_nat]

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRowProfile_selected_card
statement:
theorem positiveRowProfile_selected_card (r a : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    Fintype.card (Ferrers.SelectedIndex (positiveRowProfile r a)) =
      N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r
proof:
:= by
  apply Ferrers.selected_card_of_sums
  · rw [positiveRowProfile_sum r a hr]
    unfold positiveRowGeneratorDegree
    omega
  · have hsq : (∑ i, positiveRowProfile r a i ^ 2) = 4 * r + a := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ i : Fin (r + a), Ferrers.positiveProfile r a i ^ 2 :=
          Fintype.sum_equiv (finCongr (positiveRowColumns_rows r a hr)) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
        _ = _ := Ferrers.positiveProfile_square_sum r a
    rw [hsq]
    unfold positiveRowGeneratorDegree
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRow_points_properties
statement:
theorem positiveRow_points_properties
    {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K (positiveRowProfile r a))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B))
    (z : PointCoordinates K (N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r))
    (hpieces : ∀ t, pointDegreePiece K z t =
      idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B)) t) :
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K z (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a)) ∧
      ∀ e, pointHilbertFunction K z (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + e) =
        N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r
proof:
:= by
  have hf (e : ℕ) : pointHilbertFunction K z (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + e) =
      N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r := by
    have h := positiveRow_minorHilbertFunction_formula hr B hprimitive
      ((positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + e : ℕ) : ℤ)
    rw [← pointHilbertFunction_eq_minor_of_pieces _ z hpieces] at h
    have ht : ¬ ((positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + e : ℕ) : ℤ) <
        (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a : ℤ) := by omega
    rw [ite_eq_right ht] at h
    have hle : r ≤ N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) := by
      have hd : r ≤ positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + 1 := by
        unfold positiveRowGeneratorDegree
        omega
      have hN : positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + 1 ≤ N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) := by
        have hN := twice_N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a)
        nlinarith
      exact hd.trans hN
    rw [← Nat.cast_sub hle] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  refine ⟨pointEvaluation_surjective_of_hilbert_eq z ?_, hf⟩
  simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using hf 0

name: ChoppedPlane.signedFormsEquivNatOfEq_val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.signedFormsEquivNatOfEq_symm_val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.positive_linearRow_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem positive_linearRow_eq (hr : 0 < r) (i : Fin a) :
    linearRow (positiveRowColumns_rows r a hr).symm i = positiveLinearRowIndex hr i
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRowMatrix_standard_homogeneous
statement:
theorem positiveRowMatrix_standard_homogeneous (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K
    (positiveRowProfile r a)) :
    ∀ i j, (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B i j).IsHomogeneous
      (standardRowDegrees r (positiveRowColumns r a) i)
proof:
:=
  fun i j => (B i j).property

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRowLinearBlock_maximalRank
statement:
theorem positiveRowLinearBlock_maximalRank (hr : 0 < r)
    (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K (positiveRowProfile r a))
    (hmax : ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank (positiveLinearBlock hr B) t) (e : ℕ) :
    finrank K (rowLinearBlockMap (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B)
        (positiveRowColumns_rows r a hr).symm (positiveRowMatrix_standard_homogeneous B)
        (e : ℤ)).range =
      min (finrank K (Fin (positiveRowColumns r a) → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 2)))
        (finrank K (Fin a → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := rowLinearBlockMap (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B)
    (positiveRowColumns_rows r a hr).symm (positiveRowMatrix_standard_homogeneous B) (e : ℤ)
  change finrank K f.range = _
  by_cases he : 2 ≤ e
  · let t := e - 2
    have hs : (e : ℤ) - 2 = (t : ℤ) := by dsimp [t]; omega
    have ht : (e : ℤ) - 1 = ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by dsimp [t]; omega
    let S : (Fin (positiveRowColumns r a) → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 2)) ≃ₗ[K]
        MatrixSource K (positiveRowColumns r a) t :=
      LinearEquiv.piCongrRight (fun _ => signedFormsEquivNatOfEq t hs)
    let T : (Fin a → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 1)) ≃ₗ[K] MatrixTarget K a t :=
      LinearEquiv.piCongrRight (fun _ => signedFormsEquivNatOfEq (t + 1) ht)
    have hmap : T.toLinearMap.comp (f.comp S.symm.toLinearMap) =
        linearMatrixMap (positiveLinearBlock hr B) t := by
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro v
      funext i
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
        linearMatrixMap_val, positiveLinearBlock_val]
      change (f (S.symm v) i).val = _
      simp only [f, rowLinearBlockMap_val, rowMatrixVal,
        S, LinearEquiv.piCongrRight_symm, LinearEquiv.piCongrRight_apply,
        signedFormsEquivNatOfEq_symm_val]
      rw [positive_linearRow_eq hr i]
    have hgr : (linearMatrixMap (positiveLinearBlock hr B) t).range = f.range.map T.toLinearMap := by
      rw [← hmap, LinearMap.range_comp,
        LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top f S.symm.range]
    have hrank : finrank K (linearMatrixMap (positiveLinearBlock hr B) t).range =
        finrank K f.range := by rw [hgr]; exact T.finrank_map_eq f.range
    rw [← hrank, hmax t, S.finrank_eq, T.finrank_eq]
  · have hs : ¬ (0 : ℤ) ≤ (e : ℤ) - 2 := by omega
    have hzero : finrank K (Fin (positiveRowColumns r a) → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 2)) = 0 := by
      rw [show signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 2) = ⊥ from ite_eq_right hs]
      simp [Module.finrank_pi_fintype]
    have hle := LinearMap.finrank_range_le f
    rw [hzero] at hle
    rw [hzero, min_eq_left (Nat.zero_le _)]
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.selected_card
statement:
theorem selected_card (δ : Fin m → ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ) =
      ∑ ij : {ij : Fin m × Fin m // ij.1 < ij.2}, δ ij.val.1 * δ ij.val.2
proof:
:= by
  simp [SelectedIndex, Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_prod]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.rowFirst_homogeneous
statement:
theorem rowFirst_homogeneous (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α : RootIndex δ → K) (i : Fin m) :
    (rowFirst δ α i).IsHomogeneous (δ i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [rowFirst, Grid.planeFirst] using
    Grid.planeFirst_homogeneous (fun a : Fin (δ i) => α ⟨i, a⟩)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.rowSecond_homogeneous
statement:
theorem rowSecond_homogeneous (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (β : RootIndex δ → K) (i : Fin m) :
    (rowSecond δ β i).IsHomogeneous (δ i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [rowSecond, Grid.planeSecond] using
    Grid.planeSecond_homogeneous (fun b : Fin (δ i) => β ⟨i, b⟩)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorProduct_homogeneous
statement:
theorem cofactorProduct_homogeneous (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (j : Fin m) :
    (cofactorProduct δ α β j).IsHomogeneous
      ((∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i < j), δ i) +
       (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => j < i), δ i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (IsHomogeneous.prod _ _ _ (fun i _ => rowFirst_homogeneous δ α i)).mul
    (IsHomogeneous.prod _ _ _ (fun i _ => rowSecond_homogeneous δ β i))

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.rowFirst_eval_root
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowFirst_eval_root (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α : RootIndex δ → K)
    (u : RootIndex δ) (y : K) :
    eval ![α u, y, 1] (rowFirst δ α u.1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [rowFirst, map_prod, map_sub, map_mul, eval_X, eval_C]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_two ]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ u.2) (by simp)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.rowSecond_eval_root
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowSecond_eval_root (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (u : RootIndex δ) (x : K) :
    eval ![x, β u, 1] (rowSecond δ β u.1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [rowSecond, map_prod, map_sub, map_mul, eval_X, eval_C]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two ]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ u.2) (by simp)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorProduct_eval_selected
statement:
theorem cofactorProduct_eval_selected (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (s : SelectedIndex δ) (k : Fin m) :
    eval ![selectedX δ α s, selectedY δ β s, 1] (cofactorProduct δ α β k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [cofactorProduct, map_mul, map_prod]
  by_cases h : s.1.val.1 < k
  · apply mul_eq_zero_of_left
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩
    · exact rowFirst_eval_root δ α ⟨s.1.val.1, s.2.1⟩ _
  · apply mul_eq_zero_of_right
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, by
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_of_not_gt h) s.1.property⟩
    · exact rowSecond_eval_root δ β ⟨s.1.val.2, s.2.2⟩ _

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.selected_injective
statement:
theorem selected_injective (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Function.Injective (fun s : SelectedIndex δ => (selectedX δ α s, selectedY δ β s))
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  have hx := hα (congrArg Prod.fst h)
  have hy := hβ (congrArg Prod.snd h)
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨i,j⟩, hij⟩, a,b⟩ := s
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨i',j'⟩, hij'⟩, a',b'⟩ := t
  change (⟨i,a⟩ : RootIndex δ) = ⟨i',a'⟩ at hx
  change (⟨j,b⟩ : RootIndex δ) = ⟨j',b'⟩ at hy
  cases hx
  cases hy
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointCoordinates_first
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointCoordinates_first (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ))) :
    pointCoordinates δ α β (i, 0) =
      selectedX δ α ((Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex δ)).symm i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [pointCoordinates]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointCoordinates_second
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointCoordinates_second (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ))) :
    pointCoordinates δ α β (i, 1) =
      selectedY δ β ((Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex δ)).symm i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [pointCoordinates]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.distinct_pointCoordinates
statement:
theorem distinct_pointCoordinates (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    DistinctPoints K (pointCoordinates δ α β)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  apply (Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex δ)).symm.injective
  apply selected_injective δ α β hα hβ
  simpa only [pointCoordinates_first, pointCoordinates_second] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_deletedRow_det
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_deletedRow_det {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (j : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (seedMatrix δ α β |>.submatrix j.succAbove id).det = cofactorProduct δ α β j
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [seedMatrix, ferrersDeletedRow, cofactorProduct, Fin.lt_def] using
    ferrersDeletedRow_det (rowFirst δ α) (rowSecond δ β) j

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorIdeal_le_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_le_pointIdeal (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    cofactorIdeal δ α β ≤ pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates δ α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  rintro f ⟨j, rfl⟩
  change cofactorProduct δ α β j ∈ pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates δ α β)
  apply Ideal.mem_iInf.mpr
  intro i
  apply (homogeneous_mem_singlePointIdeal_iff _ _
    ⟨cofactorProduct δ α β j, cofactorProduct_homogeneous δ α β j⟩).mpr
  simp only [pointCoordinates_first, pointCoordinates_second]
  exact cofactorProduct_eval_selected δ α β
    ((Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex δ)).symm i) j

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.rowFirst_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rowFirst_eval_ne_zero (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (u : RootIndex δ) (i : Fin m)
    (hi : i ≠ u.1) (y : K) :
    eval ![α u, y, 1] (rowFirst δ α i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [rowFirst, map_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro a _
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, eval_X, eval_C]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_two]
  have hneq : α u ≠ α ⟨i,a⟩ := by
    intro h
    exact hi (congrArg Sigma.fst (hα h)).symm
  simpa using sub_ne_zero.mpr hneq

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.rowSecond_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rowSecond_eval_ne_zero (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hβ : Function.Injective β) (v : RootIndex δ) (i : Fin m)
    (hi : i ≠ v.1) (x : K) :
    eval ![x, β v, 1] (rowSecond δ β i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [rowSecond, map_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro b _
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, eval_X, eval_C]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two]
  have hneq : β v ≠ β ⟨i,b⟩ := by
    intro h
    exact hi (congrArg Sigma.fst (hβ h)).symm
  simpa using sub_ne_zero.mpr hneq

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorProducts_vanish_iff_selected
statement:
theorem cofactorProducts_vanish_iff_selected (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (u v : RootIndex δ) :
    (∀ j, eval ![α u, β v, 1] (cofactorProduct δ α β j) = 0) ↔ u.1 < v.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hall
    by_contra hn
    have hh : eval ![α u, β v, 1] (cofactorProduct δ α β v.1) ≠ 0 := by
      classical
      simp only [cofactorProduct, map_mul, map_prod]
      apply mul_ne_zero
      · apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
        intro i hi
        have hil := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        exact rowFirst_eval_ne_zero δ α hα u i (by
          intro heq
          subst i
          exact hn hil) _
      · apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
        intro i hi
        have hil := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        exact rowSecond_eval_ne_zero δ β hβ v i (ne_of_gt hil) _
    exact hh (hall v.1)
  · intro huv j
    exact cofactorProduct_eval_selected δ α β ⟨⟨(u.1,v.1),huv⟩,(u.2,v.2)⟩ j

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorProduct_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem cofactorProduct_zero {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    cofactorProduct δ α β 0 =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => 0 < i), rowSecond δ β i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [cofactorProduct]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorProduct_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem cofactorProduct_last {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    cofactorProduct δ α β (Fin.last c) =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => i < Fin.last c), rowFirst δ α i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => Fin.last c < i) = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr
    intro i hi
    exact not_lt.mpr (Fin.le_last i)
  rw [cofactorProduct, hfilter, Finset.prod_empty, mul_one]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.firstProducts_relPrime_secondProducts
statement:
theorem firstProducts_relPrime_secondProducts (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (s t : Finset (Fin m)) :
    IsRelPrime (∏ i ∈ s, rowFirst δ α i) (∏ j ∈ t, rowSecond δ β j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply IsRelPrime.prod_left
  intro i hi
  rw [rowFirst]
  apply IsRelPrime.prod_left
  intro a ha
  apply (Grid.first_linear_irreducible (α ⟨i,a⟩)).isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
  intro hdvd
  have hh := map_dvd (eval ![0,1,0]) hdvd
  simp [rowSecond] at hh

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_primitive
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_primitive {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (seedMatrix δ α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_pair _ (Fin.last c) 0
  have hlast : maximalMinor (seedMatrix δ α β) (Fin.last c) =
      cofactorProduct δ α β (Fin.last c) := seedMatrix_deletedRow_det δ α β (Fin.last c)
  have hzero : maximalMinor (seedMatrix δ α β) 0 = cofactorProduct δ α β 0 :=
    seedMatrix_deletedRow_det δ α β 0
  rw [hlast, hzero, cofactorProduct_last, cofactorProduct_zero]
  exact firstProducts_relPrime_secondProducts δ α β _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal (seedMatrix δ α β) = cofactorIdeal δ α β
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal_eq_span_maximalMinor]
  have h : maximalMinor (seedMatrix δ α β) = cofactorProduct δ α β := by
    funext i
    exact seedMatrix_deletedRow_det δ α β i
  rw [h]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pureSeed_primitive
statement:
theorem pureSeed_primitive {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R] {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (x y : R) (hxy : IsRelPrime x y) :
    PrimitiveMaximalMinors
      (ferrersBidiagonal (fun i => x ^ δ i) (fun i => y ^ δ i))
proof:
:= by
  apply primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_pair _ (Fin.last c) 0
  change IsRelPrime
    ((ferrersDeletedRow (fun i => x ^ δ i) (fun i => y ^ δ i) (Fin.last c)).det)
    ((ferrersDeletedRow (fun i => x ^ δ i) (fun i => y ^ δ i) 0).det)
  rw [ferrersDeletedRow_det, ferrersDeletedRow_det]
  have hafter : Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => (Fin.last c).val < i.val) = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr
    intro i hi
    have := i.isLt
    simp only [Fin.val_last]
    omega
  have hbefore : Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => i.val < (0 : Fin (c + 1)).val) = ∅ := by
    simp
  simp only [hafter, hbefore, Finset.prod_empty, mul_one, one_mul]
  apply IsRelPrime.prod_left
  intro i hi
  apply IsRelPrime.prod_right
  intro j hj
  exact hxy.pow_left.pow_right

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.canonicalRoots_injective
statement:
theorem canonicalRoots_injective [Infinite K] (δ : Fin m → ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (canonicalRoots (K := K) δ)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  apply (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).injective
  apply Fin.ext
  exact (Infinite.natEmbedding K).injective huv

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.infinityMap_rowFirst
statement:
@[simp] theorem infinityMap_rowFirst {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α : RootIndex δ → K) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    infinityMap (rowFirst δ α i) = (X 0 : Poly K 2) ^ δ i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [infinityMap, rowFirst]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.infinityMap_rowSecond
statement:
@[simp] theorem infinityMap_rowSecond {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (β : RootIndex δ → K) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    infinityMap (rowSecond δ β i) = (X 1 : Poly K 2) ^ δ i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [infinityMap, rowSecond]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_map_infinity
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_map_infinity {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (seedMatrix δ α β).map infinityMap =
      ferrersBidiagonal (fun i => (X 0 : Poly K 2) ^ δ i)
        (fun i => (X 1 : Poly K 2) ^ δ i)
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  change infinityMap (if i.val = j.val then rowFirst δ α i
    else if i.val = j.val + 1 then rowSecond δ β i else 0) = _
  split_ifs <;> simp [ferrersBidiagonal, *]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.binary_X_relPrime
statement: theorem binary_X_relPrime : IsRelPrime (X 0 : Poly K 2) (X 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : Irreducible (X 0 : Poly K 2) := by
    have hh := irreducible_mul_X_add (1 : Poly K 2) 0 (0 : Fin 2)
      one_ne_zero (by simp) (by simp) isRelPrime_one_left
    simpa using hh
  apply hx.isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
  intro hdvd
  have hh := map_dvd (eval ![0,1]) hdvd
  simp at hh

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_primitive_atInfinity
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_primitive_atInfinity {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    PrimitiveMaximalMinors ((seedMatrix δ α β).map infinityMap)
proof:
:= by
  rw [seedMatrix_map_infinity]
  exact pureSeed_primitive δ _ _ binary_X_relPrime

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.infinityMap_surjective
statement: theorem infinityMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (infinityMap (K := K))
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (infinityMap (K := K)).comp (rename Fin.castSucc).toRingHom =
      RingHom.id (Poly K 2) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      simp [infinityMap]
    · intro i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [infinityMap]
  intro p
  refine ⟨rename Fin.castSucc p, ?_⟩
  exact congrArg (fun f : Poly K 2 →+* Poly K 2 => f p) hcomp

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.infinityMap_ker
statement: theorem infinityMap_ker : RingHom.ker (infinityMap (K := K)) = Ideal.span {X 2}
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal (Poly K 3) := Ideal.span {X 2}
  let q : Fin 3 → Poly K 3 := ![X 0, X 1, 0]
  have hq : ∀ i, X i - q i ∈ I := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simp [q]
    · simp [q]
    · change X (2 : Fin 3) - 0 ∈ I
      rw [sub_zero]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton (X (2 : Fin 3) : Poly K 3))
  have hcomp : (rename Fin.castSucc).toRingHom.comp (infinityMap (K := K)) =
      eval₂Hom C q := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      simp [infinityMap]
    · intro i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [infinityMap, q]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    have hz : infinityMap f = 0 := hf
    have hzero : eval₂ C q f = 0 := by
      have hh := congrArg (fun h : Poly K 3 →+* Poly K 3 => h f) hcomp
      change rename Fin.castSucc (infinityMap f) = eval₂ C q f at hh
      rw [hz, map_zero] at hh
      exact hh.symm
    have hmem := sub_substitution_mem I q hq f
    simpa [hzero, I] using hmem
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro f rfl
    simp [infinityMap]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorIdeal_z_saturated
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_z_saturated {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (n : ℕ) (p : Poly K 3) :
    X 2 ^ n * p ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β ↔ p ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β
proof:
:= by
  rw [← seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal]
  exact pow_mul_mem_cofactorIdeal_iff (seedMatrix δ α β) (X 2) (X_ne_zero _)
    infinityMap infinityMap_surjective infinityMap_ker
    (seedMatrix_primitive_atInfinity δ α β) n p

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_homogeneous
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_homogeneous {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (i : Fin (c + 1)) (j : Fin c) :
    (seedMatrix δ α β i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold seedMatrix ferrersBidiagonal
  split_ifs
  · exact rowFirst_homogeneous δ α i
  · exact rowSecond_homogeneous δ β i
  · exact isHomogeneous_zero (Fin 3) K (δ i)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorIdeal_homogeneous
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_homogeneous (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (cofactorIdeal δ α β).IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.homogeneous_span
  rintro f ⟨j,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨_,cofactorProduct_homogeneous δ α β j⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointIdeal_homogeneous
statement:
theorem pointIdeal_homogeneous {p : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    (pointIdeal K a).IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.IsHomogeneous.iInf
  intro i
  apply Ideal.homogeneous_span
  rintro f (rfl | rfl)
  · exact ⟨1,(isHomogeneous_X K 0).sub (isHomogeneous_C_mul_X (a (i,0)) 2)⟩
  · exact ⟨1,(isHomogeneous_X K 1).sub (isHomogeneous_C_mul_X (a (i,1)) 2)⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.totalFirst_mem
statement:
theorem totalFirst_mem {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (∏ i, rowFirst δ α i) ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.erase (Fin.last c) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => i < Fin.last c) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true,
      Finset.mem_filter, true_and]
    exact ⟨fun hi => lt_of_le_of_ne (Fin.le_last i) hi, fun hi => ne_of_lt hi⟩
  have hmem : cofactorProduct δ α β (Fin.last c) ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β :=
    Ideal.subset_span ⟨Fin.last c,rfl⟩
  rw [cofactorProduct_last, ← hfilter] at hmem
  have hh := (cofactorIdeal δ α β).mul_mem_left (rowFirst δ α (Fin.last c)) hmem
  rwa [Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (rowFirst δ α) (Finset.mem_univ _)] at hh

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.totalSecond_mem
statement:
theorem totalSecond_mem {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (∏ i, rowSecond δ β i) ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.erase (0 : Fin (c + 1)) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => 0 < i) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true,
      Finset.mem_filter, true_and]
    exact ⟨fun hi => lt_of_le_of_ne (Fin.zero_le i) hi.symm, fun hi => ne_of_gt hi⟩
  have hmem : cofactorProduct δ α β 0 ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β :=
    Ideal.subset_span ⟨0,rfl⟩
  rw [cofactorProduct_zero, ← hfilter] at hmem
  have hh := (cofactorIdeal δ α β).mul_mem_left (rowSecond δ β 0) hmem
  rwa [Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (rowSecond δ β) (Finset.mem_univ _)] at hh

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.flatRoots_injective
statement:
theorem flatRoots_injective (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) : Function.Injective (flatRoots δ α)
proof:
:=
  hα.comp (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).symm.injective

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.totalFirst_eq_planeFirst
statement:
theorem totalFirst_eq_planeFirst (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (∏ i, rowFirst δ α i) = Grid.planeFirst (flatRoots δ α)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs : (∏ u : RootIndex δ, (X 0 - C (α u) * X 2 : Poly K 3)) =
      ∏ i, rowFirst δ α i := by
    rw [Fintype.prod_sigma]
    rfl
  rw [← hs]
  exact Fintype.prod_equiv (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)) _ _ (by
    intro u
    simp [flatRoots])

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.totalSecond_eq_planeSecond
statement:
theorem totalSecond_eq_planeSecond (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (∏ i, rowSecond δ β i) = Grid.planeSecond (flatRoots δ β)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs : (∏ u : RootIndex δ, (X 1 - C (β u) * X 2 : Poly K 3)) =
      ∏ i, rowSecond δ β i := by
    rw [Fintype.prod_sigma]
    rfl
  rw [← hs]
  exact Fintype.prod_equiv (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)) _ _ (by
    intro u
    simp [flatRoots])

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.eval_affineDehom
statement:
theorem eval_affineDehom (f : Poly K 3) (x y : K) :
    eval ![x,y] (affineDehom f) = eval ![x,y,1] f
proof:
:= by
  have h : (aeval ![x,y]).comp (affineDehom (K := K)) = aeval ![x,y,1] := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [affineDehom, AlgHom.comp_apply]
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun h f

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal
statement:
theorem mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    Grid.mvAffineGridIdeal (flatRoots δ α) (flatRoots δ β) ≤ affineCofactorIdeal δ α β
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  rintro f (rfl | rfl)
  · have hh := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom
      (totalFirst_mem δ α β)
    rw [totalFirst_eq_planeFirst] at hh
    simpa [Grid.planeFirst, Grid.affineFirstProduct, affineDehom, affineCofactorIdeal] using hh
  · have hh := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom
      (totalSecond_mem δ α β)
    rw [totalSecond_eq_planeSecond] at hh
    simpa [Grid.planeSecond, Grid.affineSecondProduct, affineDehom, affineCofactorIdeal] using hh

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.affineCofactor_separator
statement:
theorem affineCofactor_separator {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (ij : Fin (Fintype.card (RootIndex δ)) × Fin (Fintype.card (RootIndex δ)))
    (hij : ij ∉ selectedGridSet δ) :
    ∃ f ∈ affineCofactorIdeal δ α β,
      Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (flatRoots δ α) (flatRoots δ β) f ij ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let u := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).symm ij.1
  let v := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).symm ij.2
  have hn : ¬u.1 < v.1 := hij
  have hnot : ¬∀ j, eval ![α u,β v,1] (cofactorProduct δ α β j) = 0 := by
    intro hall
    exact hn ((cofactorProducts_vanish_iff_selected δ α β hα hβ u v).mp hall)
  push Not at hnot
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hnot
  refine ⟨affineDehom (cofactorProduct δ α β j),
    Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom
      (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j,rfl⟩), ?_⟩
  simpa only [Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_apply, flatRoots, eval_affineDehom] using hj

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.homogeneous_mem_cofactorIdeal_of_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem homogeneous_mem_cofactorIdeal_of_pointIdeal {c t : ℕ}
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (f : Forms K 3 t) (hf : f.val ∈ pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates δ α β)) :
    f.val ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β
proof:
:= by
  have hsat : ∀ p : Poly K 3, X 2 * p ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β →
      p ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β := by
    intro p hp
    exact (cofactorIdeal_z_saturated δ α β 1 p).mp (by simpa using hp)
  apply (affineDehom_mem_map_iff (cofactorIdeal δ α β)
    (cofactorIdeal_homogeneous δ α β) hsat f.property).mp
  have hker : RingHom.ker
      (Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (flatRoots δ α) (flatRoots δ β)) ≤
      affineCofactorIdeal δ α β := by
    rw [Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_ker _ _ (flatRoots_injective δ α hα)
      (flatRoots_injective δ β hβ)]
    exact mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal δ α β
  apply mem_ideal_of_vanish_on_selected
    (Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (flatRoots δ α) (flatRoots δ β))
    (Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_surjective _ _ (flatRoots_injective δ α hα)
      (flatRoots_injective δ β hβ))
    (affineCofactorIdeal δ α β) hker (selectedGridSet δ)
    (affineCofactor_separator δ α β hα hβ)
  intro ij hij
  let u := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).symm ij.1
  let v := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).symm ij.2
  have huv : u.1 < v.1 := hij
  let s : SelectedIndex δ := ⟨⟨(u.1,v.1),huv⟩,(u.2,v.2)⟩
  have hh := (mem_pointDegreePiece (pointCoordinates δ α β) f).mp
    ((homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff (pointCoordinates δ α β) f).mp hf)
    (Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex δ) s)
  change eval ![pointCoordinates δ α β (Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex δ) s,0),
    pointCoordinates δ α β (Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex δ) s,1),1] f.val = 0 at hh
  simp only [pointCoordinates_first, pointCoordinates_second, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at hh
  simpa [Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_apply, flatRoots, eval_affineDehom,
    selectedX,selectedY,s,u,v] using hh

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.cofactorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    cofactorIdeal δ α β = pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates δ α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (cofactorIdeal_le_pointIdeal δ α β)
  intro f hf
  apply (mem_iff_homogeneousComponent_mem (cofactorIdeal_homogeneous δ α β) f).mpr
  intro t
  exact homogeneous_mem_cofactorIdeal_of_pointIdeal δ α β hα hβ
    ⟨homogeneousComponent t f,homogeneousComponent_mem t f⟩
    (homogeneousComponent_mem_of_mem (pointIdeal_homogeneous (pointCoordinates δ α β)) hf t)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.affineCofactorIdeal_quotient_reduced
statement:
theorem affineCofactorIdeal_quotient_reduced {c : ℕ} (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    IsReduced (Poly K 2 ⧸ affineCofactorIdeal δ α β)
proof:
:=
  Grid.quotient_reduced_of_mvAffineGridIdeal_le (flatRoots δ α) (flatRoots δ β)
    (flatRoots_injective δ α hα) (flatRoots_injective δ β hβ)
    (affineCofactorIdeal δ α β) (mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal δ α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_u
statement:
@[simp] theorem quarticSubstitution_u :
    quarticSubstitution K (binaryU K) = quarticU (binaryU K) (binaryV K)
proof:
:= by
  simp [quarticSubstitution, binaryU]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_v
statement:
@[simp] theorem quarticSubstitution_v :
    quarticSubstitution K (binaryV K) = quarticV (binaryU K) (binaryV K)
proof:
:= by
  simp [quarticSubstitution, binaryV]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem quarticSubstitution_C (s : K) :
    quarticSubstitution K (C s) = C s
proof:
:= by
  simp [quarticSubstitution]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticU_homogeneous
statement:
theorem quarticU_homogeneous :
    (quarticU (binaryU K) (binaryV K)).IsHomogeneous 4
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (X (R := K) (0 : Fin 2)).IsHomogeneous 1 := isHomogeneous_X K 0
  have hu3 : ((X (0 : Fin 2) : BinaryRing K) ^ 3).IsHomogeneous 3 := isHomogeneous_X_pow _ _
  have hv3 : ((X (1 : Fin 2) : BinaryRing K) ^ 3).IsHomogeneous 3 := isHomogeneous_X_pow _ _
  simpa [quarticU, binaryU, binaryV, map_ofNat] using hu.mul (hu3.add (hv3.C_mul (2 : K)))

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticV_homogeneous
statement:
theorem quarticV_homogeneous :
    (quarticV (binaryU K) (binaryV K)).IsHomogeneous 4
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (X (R := K) (1 : Fin 2)).IsHomogeneous 1 := isHomogeneous_X K 1
  have hu3 : ((X (0 : Fin 2) : BinaryRing K) ^ 3).IsHomogeneous 3 := isHomogeneous_X_pow _ _
  have hv3 : ((X (1 : Fin 2) : BinaryRing K) ^ 3).IsHomogeneous 3 := isHomogeneous_X_pow _ _
  simpa [quarticV, binaryU, binaryV, map_ofNat] using hv.neg.mul ((hu3.C_mul (2 : K)).add hv3)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_homogeneous
statement:
theorem quarticSubstitution_homogeneous {p : BinaryRing K} {d : ℕ}
    (hp : p.IsHomogeneous d) : (quarticSubstitution K p).IsHomogeneous (4 * d)
proof:
:= by
  apply hp.aeval
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · change (quarticU (binaryU K) (binaryV K)).IsHomogeneous 4
    exact quarticU_homogeneous
  · change (quarticV (binaryU K) (binaryV K)).IsHomogeneous 4
    exact quarticV_homogeneous

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryLex_lt_of_first
statement:
private theorem binaryLex_lt_of_first {s t : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ} (h : s 0 < t 0) :
    s ≺[binaryLex] t
proof:
:= by
  apply MonomialOrder.lex_lt_iff.mpr
  apply Finsupp.Lex.lt_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨0, ?_, h⟩
  intro j hj
  have : ¬j < (0 : Fin 2) := by omega
  exact False.elim (this hj)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticU_monomials
statement:
private theorem quarticU_monomials :
    quarticU (binaryU K) (binaryV K) =
      monomial (Finsupp.single 0 4) (1 : K) +
      monomial (Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 1 3) (2 : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [monomial_add_single]
  simp only [monomial_eq, Finsupp.prod_single_index, pow_zero, C_1, one_mul]
  simp only [quarticU, binaryU, binaryV, map_ofNat]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticV_monomials
statement:
private theorem quarticV_monomials :
    quarticV (binaryU K) (binaryV K) =
      monomial (Finsupp.single 0 3 + Finsupp.single 1 1) (-2 : K) +
      monomial (Finsupp.single 1 4) (-1 : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [monomial_add_single]
  simp only [monomial_eq, Finsupp.prod_single_index, pow_zero, pow_one,
    C_neg, map_ofNat, C_1]
  simp only [quarticV, binaryU, binaryV]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticU_lower_degree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [MonomialOrder.degree_monomial, MonomialOrder.degree_monomial]
  simp only [show (2 : K) ≠ 0 by norm_num, one_ne_zero, ite_false]
  apply binaryLex_lt_of_first
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticV_lower_degree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [MonomialOrder.degree_monomial, MonomialOrder.degree_monomial]
  simp only [show (-2 : K) ≠ 0 by norm_num, neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero, ite_false]
  apply binaryLex_lt_of_first
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticU_degree
statement:
private theorem quarticU_degree :
    binaryLex.degree (quarticU (binaryU K) (binaryV K)) = Finsupp.single 0 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [quarticU_monomials, MonomialOrder.degree_add_of_lt quarticU_lower_degree]
  classical
  simp [MonomialOrder.degree_monomial]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticV_degree
proof:
:= by
  rw [quarticV_monomials, MonomialOrder.degree_add_of_lt quarticV_lower_degree]
  classical
  simp [MonomialOrder.degree_monomial]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticU_leadingCoeff
statement:
private theorem quarticU_leadingCoeff :
    binaryLex.leadingCoeff (quarticU (binaryU K) (binaryV K)) = (1 : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quarticU_monomials, MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_add_of_lt quarticU_lower_degree]
  exact binaryLex.leadingCoeff_monomial _

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticV_leadingCoeff
statement:
private theorem quarticV_leadingCoeff :
    binaryLex.leadingCoeff (quarticV (binaryU K) (binaryV K)) = (-2 : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quarticV_monomials, MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_add_of_lt quarticV_lower_degree]
  exact binaryLex.leadingCoeff_monomial _

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticExponent_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem quarticExponent_zero (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    quarticExponent d 0 = 4 * d 0 + 3 * d 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [quarticExponent, mul_comm]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticExponent_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem quarticExponent_one (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    quarticExponent d 1 = d 1
proof: := by simp [quarticExponent]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticExponent_injective
statement: theorem quarticExponent_injective : Function.Injective quarticExponent
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  have h0 := congrArg (fun q : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => q 0) h
  have h1 := congrArg (fun q : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => q 1) h
  simp only [quarticExponent_zero, quarticExponent_one] at h0 h1
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · change s 0 = t 0
    omega
  · change s 1 = t 1
    exact h1

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_monomial
statement:
private theorem quarticSubstitution_monomial (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (s : K) :
    quarticSubstitution K (monomial d s) = C s *
      (quarticU (binaryU K) (binaryV K) ^ d 0 *
        quarticV (binaryU K) (binaryV K) ^ d 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quarticSubstitution, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial]
  rw [Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (fun _ => pow_zero _), Fin.prod_univ_two]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_monomial_leadingCoeff
statement:
private theorem quarticSubstitution_monomial_leadingCoeff
    (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (s : K) :
    binaryLex.leadingCoeff (quarticSubstitution K (monomial d s)) = s * (-2) ^ d 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [quarticSubstitution_monomial]
  simp only [MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_mul, MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_pow,
    MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_C, quarticU_leadingCoeff, quarticV_leadingCoeff,
    one_pow, one_mul]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_monomial_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem quarticSubstitution_monomial_ne_zero
    (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) {s : K} (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    quarticSubstitution K (monomial d s) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_ne_zero_iff.mp
  rw [quarticSubstitution_monomial_leadingCoeff]
  exact mul_ne_zero hs (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_monomial_degree
statement:
private theorem quarticSubstitution_monomial_degree
    (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) {s : K} (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    binaryLex.degree (quarticSubstitution K (monomial d s)) = quarticExponent d
proof:
:= by
  have hu : quarticU (binaryU K) (binaryV K) ≠ 0 := by
    apply MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_ne_zero_iff.mp
    rw [quarticU_leadingCoeff]
    exact one_ne_zero
  have hv : quarticV (binaryU K) (binaryV K) ≠ 0 := by
    apply MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_ne_zero_iff.mp
    rw [quarticV_leadingCoeff]
    norm_num
  rw [quarticSubstitution_monomial,
    MonomialOrder.degree_mul (MvPolynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr hs)
      (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hu) (pow_ne_zero _ hv)),
    MonomialOrder.degree_mul (pow_ne_zero _ hu) (pow_ne_zero _ hv),
    MonomialOrder.degree_pow, MonomialOrder.degree_pow,
    MonomialOrder.degree_C, zero_add, quarticU_degree, quarticV_degree]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_ne_zero
statement:
theorem quarticSubstitution_ne_zero {p : BinaryRing K} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    quarticSubstitution K p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [p.as_sum, map_sum]
  apply MonomialOrder.sum_ne_zero_of_degree_injOn binaryLex p.support
  · exact MvPolynomial.support_nonempty.mpr hp
  · intro d hd
    exact quarticSubstitution_monomial_ne_zero d (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hd)
  · intro d hd e he h
    apply quarticExponent_injective
    change binaryLex.degree (quarticSubstitution K (monomial d (p.coeff d))) =
      binaryLex.degree (quarticSubstitution K (monomial e (p.coeff e))) at h
    rw [quarticSubstitution_monomial_degree d (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hd),
      quarticSubstitution_monomial_degree e (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp he)] at h
    exact h

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_injective
statement: theorem quarticSubstitution_injective : Function.Injective (quarticSubstitution K)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  by_contra h
  apply quarticSubstitution_ne_zero h
  rw [map_sub, hpq, sub_self]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.chartFiniteDirectional_kernel_u
statement:
theorem chartFiniteDirectional_kernel_u (φ : BinaryRing K →ₐ[K] A)
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile)
    (a : A) (hu : φ (binaryU K) * a = 1) (n : ℕ)
    (c : ChartFiniteVector A (n + 1)) :
    chartFiniteDirectional φ q hq s n c = 0 ↔
      c ∈ LinearMap.range (chartFiniteCross φ q hq s (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let := chartDualModuleStructure φ q hq s
  constructor
  · intro hc
    have hd : tensorDirectional (chartLinearForm φ)
        (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (n + 1) c) = 0 := by
      rw [← synthesis_finiteDirectional]
      change homogeneousTensorSynthesis n (chartFiniteDirectional φ q hq s n c) = 0
      rw [hc]
      exact (homogeneousTensorSynthesisMap n).map_zero
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, heq⟩ := chart_dual_cross_range_homogeneous_u φ q hq s a hu
      (n + 1) _ (homogeneousTensorSynthesis_homogeneous (n + 1) c) hd
    refine ⟨homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (n + 1) Q, ?_⟩
    change homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (n + 1)
      (tensorChange (chartCrossMatrix φ)
        (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (n + 1)
          (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (n + 1) Q))) = c
    rw [homogeneousTensorSynthesis_coefficients (n + 1) Q hQ, heq,
      homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_synthesis]
  · rintro ⟨d, rfl⟩
    exact chartFiniteDirectional_cross_zero φ q hq s n d

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.chartFiniteDirectional_kernel_v

        (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (n + 1) c) = 0 := by
      rw [← synthesis_finiteDirectional]
      change homogeneousTensorSynthesis n (chartFiniteDirectional φ q hq s n c) = 0
      rw [hc]
      exact (homogeneousTensorSynthesisMap n).map_zero
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, heq⟩ := chart_dual_cross_range_homogeneous_v φ q hq s a hv
      (n + 1) _ (homogeneousTensorSynthesis_homogeneous (n + 1) c) hd
    refine ⟨homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (n + 1) Q, ?_⟩
    change homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (n + 1)
      (tensorChange (chartCrossMatrix φ)
        (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (n + 1)
          (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (n + 1) Q))) = c
    rw [homogeneousTensorSynthesis_coefficients (n + 1) Q hQ, heq,
      homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_synthesis]
  · rintro ⟨d, rfl⟩
    exact chartFiniteDirectional_cross_zero φ q hq s n d

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicZ_cube
statement:
theorem cyclicZ_cube (γ : Fin 3 → A) :
    cyclicZ γ ^ 3 = (γ 0 * γ 1 * γ 2) • (1 : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A))
proof:
:= by
  ext m i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [cyclicZ, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply] <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicZDual_cube
statement:

theorem cyclic_pairing_transpose (γ : Fin 3 → A) (m d : Fin 3 → A) :
    (∑ i, cyclicZ γ m i * d i) = ∑ i, m i * cyclicZDual γ d i
proof:
:= by
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, cyclicZ, cyclicZDual]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicRoot_cube
statement:
theorem cyclicRoot_cube (F : A) :
    cyclicRoot F ^ 3 = cyclicCoefficientHom F F
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : cyclicCubicEquation F ∈ Ideal.span {cyclicCubicEquation F} :=
    Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
  have hz : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {cyclicCubicEquation F})
      (cyclicCubicEquation F) = 0 := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hmem
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  change (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {cyclicCubicEquation F}) Polynomial.X) ^ 3 -
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {cyclicCubicEquation F}) (Polynomial.C F) = 0
  rw [← map_pow, ← map_sub]
  exact hz

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicActionHom_root
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclicActionHom_root (F : A) (Z : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = F • 1) : cyclicActionHom F Z hZ (cyclicRoot F) = Z
proof:
:= by
  simp [cyclicActionHom, cyclicRoot]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicActionHom_coefficient

@[simp] theorem cyclicActionHom_coefficient (F : A) (Z : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = F • 1) (b : A) :
    cyclicActionHom F Z hZ (cyclicCoefficientHom F b) = b • 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cyclicActionHom, cyclicCoefficientHom, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicModule_root_smul
statement:
theorem cyclicModule_root_smul (F : A) (Z : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = F • 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure F Z hZ
    ∀ m : Fin 3 → A, cyclicRoot F • m = Z m := by
  intro m
  change cyclicActionHom F Z hZ (cyclicRoot F) m = Z m
  rw [cyclicActionHom_root]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicModule_coefficient_smul
statement:
theorem cyclicModule_coefficient_smul (F : A) (Z : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = F • 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure F Z hZ
    ∀ (b : A) (m : Fin 3 → A), cyclicCoefficientHom F b • m = b • m := by
  intro b m
  change cyclicActionHom F Z hZ (cyclicCoefficientHom F b) m = b • m
  rw [cyclicActionHom_coefficient]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.semilinear_polynomial_aeval
statement:
theorem semilinear_polynomial_aeval
    (φ : A →+* A') (T : (Fin 3 → A) →ₛₗ[φ] (Fin 3 → A'))
    (Z : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A)) (Z' : Module.End A' (Fin 3 → A'))
    (hT : ∀ m, T (Z m) = Z' (T m)) (p : Polynomial A) (m : Fin 3 → A) :
    T (Polynomial.aeval Z p m) = Polynomial.aeval Z' (p.map φ) (T m)
proof:
:= by
  have hpow (n : ℕ) (v : Fin 3 → A) : T ((Z ^ n) v) = (Z' ^ n) (T v) := by
    induction n generalizing v with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, ih, hT,
        ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ]
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    simp only [map_add, Polynomial.map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hp, hq]
  | monomial n a =>
    simp [Polynomial.aeval_monomial,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, hpow]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicActionHom_baseChange
statement:
theorem cyclicActionHom_baseChange
    (φ : A →+* A') (F : A)
    (T : (Fin 3 → A) →ₛₗ[φ] (Fin 3 → A'))
    (Z : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A)) (Z' : Module.End A' (Fin 3 → A'))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = F • 1) (hZ' : Z' ^ 3 = φ F • 1)
    (hT : ∀ m, T (Z m) = Z' (T m))
    (r : CyclicCubicRing A F) (m : Fin 3 → A) :
    T (cyclicActionHom F Z hZ r m) =
      cyclicActionHom (φ F) Z' hZ' (cyclicBaseChangeHom φ F r) (T m)
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' r ?_
  intro p
  change T (Polynomial.aeval Z p m) =
    Polynomial.aeval Z' (p.map φ) (T m)
  exact semilinear_polynomial_aeval φ T Z Z' hT p m

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicModuleBaseChange_apply

@[simp] theorem cyclicModuleBaseChange_apply
    (φ : A →+* A') (F : A)

    (Z : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A)) (Z' : Module.End A' (Fin 3 → A'))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = F • 1) (hZ' : Z' ^ 3 = φ F • 1)

    cyclicModuleBaseChange φ F T Z Z' hZ hZ' hT m = T m
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cubicActionHom_coefficient
statement:
@[simp] theorem cubicActionHom_coefficient
    (Z : Module.End (BinaryRing K) (BinaryVector K))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = binaryCubic K • 1) (b : BinaryRing K) :
    cubicActionHom Z hZ (cubicCoefficient K b) = b • 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cubicActionHom, cubicCoefficient, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cubicModule_root_smul
statement:
theorem cubicModule_root_smul
    (Z : Module.End (BinaryRing K) (BinaryVector K))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = binaryCubic K • 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= cubicModuleStructure Z hZ
    ∀ m : BinaryVector K, cubicRoot K • m = Z m := by
  intro m
  change cubicActionHom Z hZ (cubicRoot K) m = Z m
  rw [cubicActionHom_root]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cubicModule_coefficient_smul
statement:
theorem cubicModule_coefficient_smul
    (Z : Module.End (BinaryRing K) (BinaryVector K))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = binaryCubic K • 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= cubicModuleStructure Z hZ
    ∀ (b : BinaryRing K) (m : BinaryVector K), cubicCoefficient K b • m = b • m := by
  intro b m
  change cubicActionHom Z hZ (cubicCoefficient K b) m = b • m
  rw [cubicActionHom_coefficient]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cubicLinearFactors_product
statement:
theorem cubicLinearFactors_product (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) :
    cubicLinearFactors q 0 * cubicLinearFactors q 1 * cubicLinearFactors q 2 =
      binaryCubic K
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : (C q : BinaryRing K) ^ 2 + C q + 1 = 0 := by
    simpa using congrArg (C : K →+* BinaryRing K) hq
  have h := binary_cubic_factor (binaryU K) (-binaryV K) (C q) hq'
  change (binaryU K + binaryV K) * (binaryU K + C q * binaryV K) *
    (binaryU K + C (q ^ 2) * binaryV K) = binaryU K ^ 3 + binaryV K ^ 3
  rw [map_pow]
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileFactors_product
statement:
theorem profileFactors_product (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) :
    profileFactors q s 0 * profileFactors q s 1 * profileFactors q s 2 =
      binaryCubic K
proof:
:= by
  have h := cubicLinearFactors_product q hq
  cases s with
  | degreeThree => exact h
  | degreeTwo =>
    change cubicLinearFactors q 0 * 1 *
      (cubicLinearFactors q 1 * cubicLinearFactors q 2) = _
    simpa only [mul_one, mul_assoc] using h
  | degreeOne =>
    change 1 * cubicLinearFactors q 1 *
      (cubicLinearFactors q 0 * cubicLinearFactors q 2) = _
    calc
      _ = cubicLinearFactors q 0 * cubicLinearFactors q 1 * cubicLinearFactors q 2 := by ring
      _ = _ := h

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.chartLaurentU_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartLaurentU_smul (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (m : Fin 3 → BinaryLaurent K) :
    letI
proof:
:= chartDualModuleStructure (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) q hq s
    chartU (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) • m = fun i => U * m i := by
  let := chartDualModuleStructure (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) q hq s
  change cyclicCoefficientHom ((binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) (binaryCubic K))
    ((binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) (binaryU K)) • m = _

  funext i

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.chartLaurentZ_smul
statement:

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.chartLaurentLinearForm_degree_one
statement:
private theorem chartLaurentLinearForm_degree_one
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile)
    (G : ℤ → Submodule K (Fin 3 → BinaryLaurent K))
    (hU : ∀ k m, m ∈ G k → (fun i => U * m i) ∈ G (k + 1))
    (hV : ∀ k m, m ∈ G k → (fun i => V * m i) ∈ G (k + 1))
    (hZ : ∀ k m, m ∈ G k →
      cyclicZDual (fun i => binaryLaurentEmbedding (profileFactors q s i)) m ∈ G (k + 1)) :
    letI
proof:
:= chartDualModuleStructure (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) q hq s
    ∀ k i m, m ∈ G k → chartLinearForm (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) i • m ∈ G (k + 1) := by
  let := chartDualModuleStructure (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) q hq s
  intro k i m hm
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [chartLinearForm] using hU k m hm
  · simpa [chartLinearForm] using hV k m hm
  · simpa [chartLinearForm] using hZ k m hm

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_coordinate_functionals
statement:
theorem exists_coordinate_functionals {r : ℕ} (q : Fin r → V)
    (hq : LinearIndependent K q) :
    ∃ dual : Fin r → V →ₗ[K] K, ∀ i j, dual i (q j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (Finsupp.linearCombination K q).exists_leftInverse_of_injective
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hq)
  refine ⟨fun i => (Finsupp.lapply i).comp g, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hg (Finsupp.single j 1)
  have hj : g (q j) = Finsupp.single j 1 := by simpa using h
  simp [hj, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: ChoppedPlane.eval_polynomialOfLinear
statement:
theorem eval_polynomialOfLinear [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (L : (ι → K) →ₗ[K] K) (a : ι → K) :
    eval a (polynomialOfLinear L) = L a
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg L ((Pi.basisFun K ι).sum_equivFun a)
  simpa [polynomialOfLinear, map_sum, Pi.basisFun_apply, Pi.basisFun_equivFun,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using h

theorem IsPolynomialFamily.linear_comp {f : (ι → K) → V}
