proof:
:= by
  intro ell
  exact hf (ell.comp L)

name: ChoppedPlane.IsPolynomialFamily.add
proof:
:= by
  intro ell
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf ell
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hg ell
  exact ⟨p + q, fun a => by rw [map_add, hp, hq, map_add]⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.IsPolynomialFamily.smul
proof:
:= by
  intro ell
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf LinearMap.id
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hg ell
  refine ⟨p * q, fun a => ?_⟩
  simp only [map_mul, hp, hq, LinearMap.id_apply, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: ChoppedPlane.IsPolynomialFamily.sum
statement:
theorem IsPolynomialFamily.sum {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    {f : J → (ι → K) → V} (hf : ∀ j, IsPolynomialFamily (f j)) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun a => ∑ j, f j a)
proof:
:= by
  intro ell
  choose p hp using fun j => hf j ell
  refine ⟨∑ j, p j, fun a => ?_⟩
  simp only [map_sum, hp]

name: ChoppedPlane.IsPolynomialFamily.bilinear
statement:
theorem IsPolynomialFamily.bilinear [FiniteDimensional K V]
    {f : (ι → K) → V} {g : (ι → K) → W}
    (hf : IsPolynomialFamily f) (hg : IsPolynomialFamily g) (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] U) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun a => B (f a) (g a))
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.finBasis K V
  have hterm (j : Fin (Module.finrank K V)) :
      IsPolynomialFamily (fun a => (b.repr (f a) j) • B (b j) (g a)) :=
    (hf.linear_comp (b.coord j)).smul (hg.linear_comp (B (b j)))
  have hsum := IsPolynomialFamily.sum hterm
  have heq : (fun a => ∑ j, b.repr (f a) j • B (b j) (g a)) =
      (fun a => B (f a) (g a)) := by
    funext a
    conv_rhs => rw [← b.sum_repr (f a)]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  rw [heq] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: ChoppedPlane.IsPolynomialFamily.prod_mk
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hf.linear_comp (LinearMap.inl K V W)).add
    (hg.linear_comp (LinearMap.inr K V W))
  simpa only [LinearMap.inl_apply, LinearMap.inr_apply, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.isPolynomialFamily_linearMap
statement:
theorem isPolynomialFamily_linearMap [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (A : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] W))
    (hA : ∀ x : V, IsPolynomialFamily (fun a => A a x)) : IsPolynomialFamily A
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.finBasis K V
  let T (j : Fin (Module.finrank K V)) : W →ₗ[K] (V →ₗ[K] W) :=
    { toFun := LinearMap.smulRight (b.coord j)
      map_add' := by intro x y; ext v; simp [LinearMap.smulRight_apply, smul_add]
      map_smul' := by
        intro r x
        ext v
        change b.repr v j • (r • x) = r • (b.repr v j • x)
        exact smul_comm _ _ _ }
  have h := IsPolynomialFamily.sum (fun j => (hA (b j)).linear_comp (T j))
  have heq : (fun a => ∑ j, T j (A a (b j))) = A := by
    funext a
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro v
    simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply]
    change (∑ j, b.repr v j • A a (b j)) = A a v
    conv_rhs => rw [← b.sum_repr v]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

name: ChoppedPlane.independent_polynomial_principal_open
statement:
theorem independent_polynomial_principal_open {r : ℕ}
    (q : Fin r → (ι → K) → V) (hqpoly : ∀ i, IsPolynomialFamily (q i))
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hq : LinearIndependent K (fun i => q i a₀)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → LinearIndependent K (fun i => q i a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨dual, hdual⟩ := exists_coordinate_functionals (fun i => q i a₀) hq
  choose p hp using fun i j => hqpoly j (dual i)
  let M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) (MvPolynomial ι K) := p
  have heval (a : ι → K) : eval a M.det = (Matrix.of fun i j => dual i (q j a)).det := by
    rw [(eval a).map_det]
    congr 1
    ext i j
    exact hp i j a
  refine ⟨M.det, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [heval]
    have hM : (Matrix.of fun i j => dual i (q j a₀)) = (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) K) := by
      ext i j
      simp [hdual, Matrix.one_apply]
    rw [hM, Matrix.det_one]
    exact one_ne_zero
  · intro a ha
    rw [heval] at ha
    let L : V →ₗ[K] (Fin r → K) := LinearMap.pi dual
    exact LinearIndependent.of_comp L (Matrix.linearIndependent_cols_of_det_ne_zero ha)

name: ChoppedPlane.rank_polynomial_principal_open
statement:
theorem rank_polynomial_principal_open [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] W)) (hA : IsPolynomialFamily A) (a₀ : ι → K) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
      finrank K (LinearMap.range (A a₀)) ≤ finrank K (LinearMap.range (A a))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R := LinearMap.range (A a₀)
  let b := Module.finBasis K R
  have hb : LinearIndependent K (fun i => (b i).val) :=
    b.linearIndependent.map' R.subtype (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (Submodule.injective_subtype _))
  have hpre : ∀ i, ∃ x, A a₀ x = (b i).val := fun i => (b i).property
  choose x hx using hpre
  let q : Fin (finrank K R) → (ι → K) → W := fun i a => A a (x i)
  have hqpoly (i) : IsPolynomialFamily (q i) :=
    hA.linear_comp (LinearMap.applyₗ (R := K) (M₂ := W) (x i))
  have hq : LinearIndependent K (fun i => q i a₀) := by simpa only [q, hx] using hb
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hfamily⟩ := independent_polynomial_principal_open q hqpoly a₀ hq
  refine ⟨D, hD, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  have hle : Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun i => q i a)) ≤ LinearMap.range (A a) := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x i, rfl⟩
  have h := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
  rwa [finrank_span_eq_card (hfamily a ha), Fintype.card_fin] at h

name: ChoppedPlane.injective_polynomial_principal_open
statement:
theorem injective_polynomial_principal_open [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] W)) (hA : IsPolynomialFamily A) (a₀ : ι → K)
    (ha₀ : Function.Injective (A a₀)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
      Function.Injective (A a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, h⟩ := rank_polynomial_principal_open A hA a₀
  refine ⟨D, hD, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  have hr := h a ha
  rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj ha₀] at hr
  have hk := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (A a)
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  exact Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp (by omega)

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_maximum_rank
statement:
theorem exists_maximum_rank [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] W)) :
    ∃ a₀ : ι → K, ∀ a, finrank K (LinearMap.range (A a)) ≤
      finrank K (LinearMap.range (A a₀))
proof:
:= by
  let ranks : Set ℕ := Set.range (fun a => finrank K (LinearMap.range (A a)))
  have hb : BddAbove ranks := by
    refine ⟨finrank K W, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.finrank_le _
  have hn : ranks.Nonempty := ⟨_, ⟨fun _ => 0, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hmax⟩ := hb.exists_isGreatest_of_nonempty hn
  obtain ⟨a₀, rfl⟩ := hr
  exact ⟨a₀, fun a => hmax ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.maximum_rank_polynomial_principal_open
statement:
theorem maximum_rank_polynomial_principal_open [FiniteDimensional K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] W)) (hA : IsPolynomialFamily A) :
    ∃ (a₀ : ι → K) (D : MvPolynomial ι K),
      eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ a, finrank K (LinearMap.range (A a)) ≤
        finrank K (LinearMap.range (A a₀))) ∧
      (∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → finrank K (LinearMap.range (A a)) =
        finrank K (LinearMap.range (A a₀)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a₀, hmax⟩ := exists_maximum_rank A
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hlow⟩ := rank_polynomial_principal_open A hA a₀
  exact ⟨a₀, D, hD, hmax, fun a ha => le_antisymm (hmax a) (hlow a ha)⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.nonempty_principal_intersection
statement:
theorem nonempty_principal_intersection [Infinite K] {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (D : J → MvPolynomial ι K) (hD : ∀ j, D j ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a : ι → K, ∀ j, eval a (D j) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : (∏ j, D j) ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j _ => hD j)
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hp
  apply MvPolynomial.funext
  intro a
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h a
  simp only [map_prod, map_zero]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j) hj

name: ChoppedPlane.simultaneous_principal_properties
statement:
theorem simultaneous_principal_properties [Infinite K] {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (P : J → (ι → K) → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ j, ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → P j a) :
    ∃ a : ι → K, ∀ j, P j a
proof:
:= by
  choose D hD hprop using hP
  have hne (j) : D j ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hD j
    intro h
    simp [h] at ha
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := nonempty_principal_intersection D hne
  exact ⟨a, fun j => hprop j a (ha j)⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.simultaneous_maximum_rank_principal_open
statement:
theorem simultaneous_maximum_rank_principal_open [Infinite K]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (A : J → (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] W)) (hA : ∀ j, IsPolynomialFamily (A j)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → ∀ j b,
        finrank K (LinearMap.range (A j b)) ≤ finrank K (LinearMap.range (A j a))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose a₀ D hD hmax heq using
    fun j => maximum_rank_polynomial_principal_open (A j) (hA j)
  have hne (j) : D j ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    simpa [hz] using hD j
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := nonempty_principal_intersection D hne
  refine ⟨∏ j, D j, ⟨a, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [map_prod] using
      Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j _ => ha j)
  · intro b hb j c
    have hj : eval b (D j) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [map_prod] at hb
      exact (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mp hb) j (Finset.mem_univ j)
    rw [heq j b hj]
    exact hmax j c

name: ChoppedPlane.ideal_span_homogeneous
statement:
theorem ideal_span_homogeneous {ι : Type*} (f : ι → Poly K n) (δ : ι → ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ i, (f i).IsHomogeneous (δ i)) :
    (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.homogeneous_span
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨δ i, hf i⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal_homogeneous_rows
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_homogeneous_rows
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i)) :
    (cofactorIdeal B).IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) K)
proof:
:= by
  exact ideal_span_homogeneous (signedMaximalMinor B) (fun i => (∑ j, δ j) - δ i)
    (signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_total B δ hB)

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal_homogeneous_columns
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_homogeneous_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)) :
    (cofactorIdeal B).IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) K)
proof:
:= by
  exact ideal_span_homogeneous (signedMaximalMinor B) (fun _ => ∑ j, ε j)
    (signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_columns B ε hB)

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeightNat_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem factorialWeightNat_zero : factorialWeightNat 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorialWeightNat]

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem factorialWeight_zero (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K] :
    factorialWeight K 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorialWeight]

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight_eq_cast
statement:
@[simp] theorem factorialWeight_eq_cast (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]
    (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    factorialWeight K s = (factorialWeightNat s : K)
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorialWeight, factorialWeightNat]

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeightNat_ne_zero
statement:
theorem factorialWeightNat_ne_zero (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    factorialWeightNat s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro i hi
  exact Nat.factorial_ne_zero (s i)

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight_ne_zero
statement:
theorem factorialWeight_ne_zero (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K] [CharZero K]
    (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) : factorialWeight K s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [factorialWeight_eq_cast]
  exact_mod_cast factorialWeightNat_ne_zero s

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeightNat_add_single
statement:
theorem factorialWeightNat_add_single (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    factorialWeightNat (s + Finsupp.single i 1) = (s i + 1) * factorialWeightNat s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hprod :
      (∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i : Finset (Fin 3)),
        ((s + Finsupp.single i 1 : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) j).factorial) =
        ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i : Finset (Fin 3)), (s j).factorial := by
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hji : j ≠ i := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
    simp [hji]
  unfold factorialWeightNat
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ
    (fun j : Fin 3 => ((s + Finsupp.single i 1 : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) j).factorial)
      (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ
    (fun j : Fin 3 => (s j).factorial) (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [hprod]
  simp [Nat.factorial_succ, mul_assoc]

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight_add_single
statement:
theorem factorialWeight_add_single (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]
    (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    factorialWeight K (s + Finsupp.single i 1) =
      ((s i + 1 : ℕ) : K) * factorialWeight K s
proof:
:= by
  rw [factorialWeight_eq_cast, factorialWeightNat_add_single, Nat.cast_mul,
    factorialWeight_eq_cast]

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight_add_single_comm
statement:
theorem factorialWeight_add_single_comm (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]
    (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    factorialWeight K (s + Finsupp.single i 1) =
      factorialWeight K s * ((s i + 1 : ℕ) : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [factorialWeight_add_single, mul_comm]

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight_mul_coeff_pderiv
statement:
theorem factorialWeight_mul_coeff_pderiv (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]
    (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K) :
    factorialWeight K s * (pderiv i f).coeff s =
      factorialWeight K (s + Finsupp.single i 1) *
        f.coeff (s + Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_pderiv, factorialWeight_add_single]
  push_cast
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight_pderiv_monomial_pair
statement:
theorem factorialWeight_pderiv_monomial_pair (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]
    (s b : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    factorialWeight K s *
        (pderiv i (monomial b 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K)).coeff s =
      factorialWeight K b *
        (X i * monomial s 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K).coeff b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [factorialWeight_mul_coeff_pderiv]
  simp only [X, monomial_mul_monomial, one_mul, coeff_monomial]
  by_cases h : b = s + Finsupp.single i 1
  · subst b
    simp [add_comm]
  · have hs : Finsupp.single i 1 + s ≠ b := by
      simpa [add_comm] using Ne.symm h
    simp [h, hs]

name: ChoppedPlane.N_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem N_zero : N 0 = 1
proof: := by norm_num [N]

name: ChoppedPlane.N₂_nat
statement: @[simp] theorem N₂_nat (t : ℕ) : N₂ (t : ℤ) = (N t : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [N₂]

name: ChoppedPlane.N₂_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem N₂_neg {t : ℤ} (h : t < 0) : N₂ t = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [N₂, not_le.mpr h]

name: ChoppedPlane.N_succ
statement: theorem N_succ (t : ℕ) : N (t + 1) = N t + (t + 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [N]
  have h := Nat.choose_succ_succ (t + 2) 1
  simpa only [Nat.choose_one_right, Nat.add_comm] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.twice_N
statement: theorem twice_N (t : ℕ) : 2 * (N t : ℤ) = (t + 1) * (t + 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [N_succ]
    push_cast
    nlinarith

name: ChoppedPlane.twice_residual
statement:
theorem twice_residual (d r e : ℕ) :
    2 * residual d r e = (e : ℤ) *
      (2 * (d : ℤ) + 3 - 3 * (r : ℤ) - ((r : ℤ) - 1) * (e : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hd := twice_N d
  have he := twice_N e
  have hde := twice_N (d + e)
  push_cast at hde
  dsimp [residual]
  nlinarith

name: ChoppedPlane.residual_as_half
statement:
theorem residual_as_half (d r e : ℕ) :
    residual d r e = ((e : ℤ) *
      (2 * (d : ℤ) + 3 - 3 * (r : ℤ) - ((r : ℤ) - 1) * (e : ℤ))) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← twice_residual]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.residual_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem residual_zero (d r : ℕ) : residual d r 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [residual]

name: ChoppedPlane.count_relation
statement: theorem count_relation (d r : ℕ) : (r : ℤ) + aCount d r = cCount d r + 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [aCount, cCount]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.count_difference
statement: theorem count_difference (d r : ℕ) : cCount d r - aCount d r = (r : ℤ) - 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [aCount, cCount]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.twice_N₂
statement:
theorem twice_N₂ {t : ℤ} (h : 0 ≤ t) :
    2 * N₂ t = (t + 1) * (t + 2)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := twice_N t.toNat
  simpa [N₂, h, Int.toNat_of_nonneg h] using ht

name: ChoppedPlane.twice_N₂_ge_neg_two
statement:
theorem twice_N₂_ge_neg_two {t : ℤ} (h : -2 ≤ t) :
    2 * N₂ t = (t + 1) * (t + 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t
  · exact twice_N₂ ht
  · have cases : t = -2 ∨ t = -1 := by omega
    rcases cases with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num [N₂]

name: ChoppedPlane.block_dimension_identity
statement:
theorem block_dimension_identity (d r e : ℕ) :
    aCount d r * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 1) - cCount d r * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 2) =
      residual d r e
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := twice_N₂_ge_neg_two (t := (e : ℤ) - 1) (by omega)
  have h₂ := twice_N₂_ge_neg_two (t := (e : ℤ) - 2) (by omega)
  have h₃ := twice_residual d r e
  dsimp [aCount, cCount]
  nlinarith

name: ChoppedPlane.residual_nonpos_of_aCount_nonpos
proof:
:= by
  have h := twice_residual d r e
  have hlin : 2 * (d : ℤ) + 3 - 3 * (r : ℤ) -
      ((r : ℤ) - 1) * (e : ℤ) ≤ 0 := by
    dsimp [aCount] at ha
    have hr' : 3 ≤ (r : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hr
    have he' : 1 ≤ (e : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast he
    nlinarith
  have he' : 0 ≤ (e : ℤ) := by omega
  have := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos he' hlin
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_pos
statement: theorem cutoff_pos (d r : ℕ) : 1 ≤ cutoff d r
proof: := le_max_left _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_as_intceil
statement:
theorem cutoff_as_intceil (d r : ℕ) :
    cutoff d r = max 1 (⌈residualThreshold d r⌉.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_le_iff
statement:
theorem cutoff_le_iff {d r e : ℕ} (he : 1 ≤ e) :
    cutoff d r ≤ e ↔ residualThreshold d r ≤ (e : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cutoff, max_le_iff, he, true_and, Nat.ceil_le]

name: ChoppedPlane.residual_nonpos_iff_cutoff_le
statement:
theorem residual_nonpos_iff_cutoff_le {d r e : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) (he : 1 ≤ e) :
    residual d r e ≤ 0 ↔ cutoff d r ≤ e
proof:
:= by
  have heZ : 0 < (e : ℤ) := by omega
  have hrQ : 0 < (r : ℚ) - 1 := by
    have hrQ' : 3 ≤ (r : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hr
    linarith
  have hsign : residual d r e ≤ 0 ↔
      2 * (d : ℤ) + 3 - 3 * (r : ℤ) - ((r : ℤ) - 1) * (e : ℤ) ≤ 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      apply nonpos_of_mul_nonpos_right _ heZ
      rw [← twice_residual]
      omega
    · intro h
      have hmul := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos heZ.le h
      rw [← twice_residual] at hmul
      omega
  rw [hsign, cutoff_le_iff he]
  dsimp [residualThreshold]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hrQ]
  have hcast :
      (2 * (d : ℤ) + 3 - 3 * (r : ℤ) - ((r : ℤ) - 1) * (e : ℤ) ≤ 0) ↔
      (2 * (d : ℚ) + 3 - 3 * (r : ℚ) - ((r : ℚ) - 1) * (e : ℚ) ≤ 0) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Iff.rfl :
      (2 * (d : ℤ) + 3 - 3 * (r : ℤ) - ((r : ℤ) - 1) * (e : ℤ) ≤ 0) ↔
      (2 * (d : ℤ) + 3 - 3 * (r : ℤ) - ((r : ℤ) - 1) * (e : ℤ) ≤ 0))
  rw [hcast]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

name: ChoppedPlane.residual_pos_iff_lt_cutoff
statement:
theorem residual_pos_iff_lt_cutoff {d r e : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) (he : 1 ≤ e) :
    0 < residual d r e ↔ e < cutoff d r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_le, residual_nonpos_iff_cutoff_le hr he, not_le]

name: ChoppedPlane.residual_nonpos_at_cutoff
statement:
theorem residual_nonpos_at_cutoff {d r : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) :
    residual d r (cutoff d r) ≤ 0
proof:
:=
  (residual_nonpos_iff_cutoff_le hr (cutoff_pos d r)).mpr le_rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_is_least
statement:
theorem cutoff_is_least {d r : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) :
    IsLeast {e : ℕ | 1 ≤ e ∧ residual d r e ≤ 0} (cutoff d r)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨cutoff_pos d r, residual_nonpos_at_cutoff hr⟩, ?_⟩
  intro e he
  exact (residual_nonpos_iff_cutoff_le hr he.1).mp he.2

name: ChoppedPlane.residualThreshold_le
statement:
theorem residualThreshold_le {d r : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) :
    residualThreshold d r ≤ (d : ℚ) - 3
proof:
:= by
  have hrQ : 3 ≤ (r : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hdQ : 0 ≤ (d : ℚ) := by positivity
  dsimp [residualThreshold]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < (r : ℚ) - 1)]
  nlinarith

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_lt_degree
statement:
theorem cutoff_lt_degree {d r : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hrd : r ≤ d) :
    cutoff d r < d
proof:
:= by
  have hd3 : 3 ≤ d := by omega
  have hcast : ((d - 3 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (d : ℚ) - 3 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hd3]
    norm_num
  have hceil : ⌈residualThreshold d r⌉₊ ≤ d - 3 := by
    rw [Nat.ceil_le, hcast]
    exact residualThreshold_le hr
  dsimp [cutoff]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.hilbert_max_identity
statement:
theorem hilbert_max_identity (d r e : ℕ) :
    max ((N d : ℤ) - r) ((N (d + e) : ℤ) - (r : ℤ) * (N e : ℤ)) =
      ((N d : ℤ) - r) + max (residual d r e) 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [residual]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.hilbertBurch_coefficient_identity
statement:
theorem hilbertBurch_coefficient_identity (d r e : ℕ) :
    (N (d + e) : ℤ) - (r : ℤ) * (N e : ℤ) -
      aCount d r * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 1) +
      cCount d r * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 2) = (N d : ℤ) - r
proof:
:= by
  have h := block_dimension_identity d r e
  dsimp [residual] at h
  linarith

name: ChoppedPlane.block_max_identity
statement:
theorem block_max_identity (d r e : ℕ) :
    max (aCount d r * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 1) -
      cCount d r * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 2)) 0 = max (residual d r e) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [block_dimension_identity]

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_eq_one_of_aCount_nonpos
statement:
theorem cutoff_eq_one_of_aCount_nonpos {d r : ℕ}
    (hr : 3 ≤ r) (ha : aCount d r ≤ 0) : cutoff d r = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := residual_nonpos_of_aCount_nonpos hr ha (e := 1) le_rfl
  have hcut := (residual_nonpos_iff_cutoff_le hr (e := 1) le_rfl).mp h
  exact le_antisymm hcut (cutoff_pos d r)

name: ChoppedPlane.generator_count_bounds
statement:
theorem generator_count_bounds {d p : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d) :
    1 ≤ N d - p ∧ N d - p ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : d ≠ 0)
  subst d
  have hdim : N n.succ = N n + n + 2 := by
    simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using N_succ n
  simp only [Nat.succ_sub_one] at hlo
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.max_residual_eq_zero_of_cutoff_le
statement:
theorem max_residual_eq_zero_of_cutoff_le {d r e : ℕ}
    (hr : 3 ≤ r) (he : cutoff d r ≤ e) : max (residual d r e) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hepos : 1 ≤ e := (cutoff_pos d r).trans he
  exact max_eq_right ((residual_nonpos_iff_cutoff_le hr hepos).mpr he)

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_before_second_koszul
statement:
theorem cutoff_before_second_koszul {d r : ℕ}
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hrd : r ≤ d) : d + cutoff d r < 2 * d
proof:
:= by
  have h := cutoff_lt_degree hd hr hrd
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.hbCoefficient_below_degree
statement:
theorem hbCoefficient_below_degree {d r : ℕ} {t : ℤ} (ht : t < (d : ℤ)) :
    hbCoefficient d r t = N₂ t
proof:
:= by
  have h₀ : t - (d : ℤ) < 0 := by omega
  have h₁ : t - (d : ℤ) - 1 < 0 := by omega
  have h₂ : t - (d : ℤ) - 2 < 0 := by omega
  simp [hbCoefficient, N₂_neg h₀, N₂_neg h₁, N₂_neg h₂]

name: ChoppedPlane.hbCoefficient_at_or_above_degree
statement:
theorem hbCoefficient_at_or_above_degree (d r e : ℕ) :
    hbCoefficient d r (d + e) = (N d : ℤ) - r
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [hbCoefficient]
  have h₀ : (d : ℤ) + (e : ℤ) - (d : ℤ) = (e : ℤ) := by ring
  rw [h₀, N₂_nat]
  rw [show (d : ℤ) + (e : ℤ) = ((d + e : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; rfl, N₂_nat]
  exact hilbertBurch_coefficient_identity d r e

name: ChoppedPlane.hbCoefficient_formula
statement:
theorem hbCoefficient_formula (d r : ℕ) (t : ℤ) :
    hbCoefficient d r t = if t < (d : ℤ) then N₂ t else (N d : ℤ) - r
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · exact hbCoefficient_below_degree h
  · have hnonneg : 0 ≤ t - (d : ℤ) := by omega
    have hrepr : t = (d : ℤ) + ((t - (d : ℤ)).toNat : ℤ) := by omega
    rw [hrepr]
    exact hbCoefficient_at_or_above_degree d r (t - (d : ℤ)).toNat

name: ChoppedPlane.column_count_sum
statement:
theorem column_count_sum (d r : ℕ) :
    linearColumnCount d r + quadraticColumnCount d r = (r : ℤ) - 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [linearColumnCount, quadraticColumnCount]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.column_degree_sum
statement:
theorem column_degree_sum (d r : ℕ) :
    linearColumnCount d r + 2 * quadraticColumnCount d r = (d : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [linearColumnCount, quadraticColumnCount]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.nonpositive_hbCoefficient
statement:
theorem nonpositive_hbCoefficient (d r : ℕ) (t : ℤ) :
    N₂ t - (r : ℤ) * N₂ (t - d) +
      linearColumnCount d r * N₂ (t - d - 1) +
      quadraticColumnCount d r * N₂ (t - d - 2) =
      if t < (d : ℤ) then N₂ t else (N d : ℤ) - r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hbCoefficient_formula]
  dsimp [linearColumnCount, quadraticColumnCount, hbCoefficient, aCount, cCount]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.first_minor_degree
statement: theorem first_minor_degree (d r : ℕ) : 2 * ((r : ℤ) - 1) + aCount d r = (d : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [aCount]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.second_minor_degree
statement: theorem second_minor_degree (d r : ℕ) : 2 * (r : ℤ) + aCount d r - 1 = (d : ℤ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [aCount]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.cCount_pos
statement: theorem cCount_pos {d r : ℕ} (hrd : r ≤ d) : 0 < cCount d r
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [cCount]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.linearColumnCount_nonneg
statement:
theorem linearColumnCount_nonneg {d r : ℕ} (ha : aCount d r ≤ 0) :
    0 ≤ linearColumnCount d r
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [linearColumnCount, aCount] at *
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.quadraticColumnCount_pos
statement:
theorem quadraticColumnCount_pos {d r : ℕ} (hrd : r ≤ d) :
    0 < quadraticColumnCount d r
proof:
:= by
  exact cCount_pos hrd

name: ChoppedPlane.residual_pos_iff_lt_threshold
statement:
theorem residual_pos_iff_lt_threshold {d r e : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) (he : 1 ≤ e) :
    0 < residual d r e ↔ (e : ℚ) < residualThreshold d r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_le, residual_nonpos_iff_cutoff_le hr he, cutoff_le_iff he, not_le]

name: ChoppedPlane.cast_max_sub
statement:
theorem cast_max_sub (p n m : ℕ) :
    ((max p (n - m) : ℕ) : ℤ) = max (p : ℤ) ((n : ℤ) - (m : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : m ≤ n
  · simp [Nat.cast_max, Nat.cast_sub h]
  · have hn : n - m = 0 := by omega
    have hi : (n : ℤ) - (m : ℤ) ≤ (p : ℤ) := by omega
    simp [hn, max_eq_left hi]

name: ChoppedPlane.hilbert_max_nat_identity
statement:
theorem hilbert_max_nat_identity {d r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ N d) (e : ℕ) :
    ((max (N d - r) (N (d + e) - r * N e) : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      ((N d : ℤ) - r) + max (residual d r e) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [cast_max_sub, Nat.cast_sub hr, Nat.cast_mul]
  exact hilbert_max_identity d r e

name: ChoppedPlane.N_ge_degree_add_one
statement: theorem N_ge_degree_add_one (t : ℕ) : t + 1 ≤ N t
proof:
:= by
  have h := twice_N t
  have ht : 0 ≤ (t : ℤ) := by positivity
  have hi : (t : ℤ) + 1 ≤ (N t : ℤ) := by nlinarith
  exact_mod_cast hi

name: ChoppedPlane.point_count_positive
statement: theorem point_count_positive {d r : ℕ} (hrd : r ≤ d) : 1 ≤ N d - r
proof:
:= by
  have h := N_ge_degree_add_one d
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.residual_one
statement: @[simp] theorem residual_one (d r : ℕ) : residual d r 1 = aCount d r
proof:
:= by
  have h := twice_residual d r 1
  dsimp [aCount]
  norm_num at h
  linarith

name: ChoppedPlane.block_rank_gap
statement: theorem block_rank_gap {d r : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) : 2 ≤ cCount d r - aCount d r
proof:
:= by
  rw [count_difference]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.cutoff_le_max
statement:
theorem cutoff_le_max {d r : ℕ} (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hr : 3 ≤ r) :
    cutoff d r ≤ max 1 (d - 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hceil : ⌈residualThreshold d r⌉₊ ≤ d - 3 := by
    rw [Nat.ceil_le, Nat.cast_sub hd]
    norm_num
    exact residualThreshold_le hr
  exact max_le_max le_rfl hceil

name: ChoppedPlane.universalLinearMatrix_coordinates
statement:
@[simp] theorem universalLinearMatrix_coordinates {a c : ℕ} (L : LinearMatrix K a c) :
    universalLinearMatrix K a c (linearMatrixCoordinates K L) = L
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  change (∑ b, (formsBasis K 3 1).repr (L i j) b • formsBasis K 3 1 b) = L i j
  exact (formsBasis K 3 1).sum_repr (L i j)

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMap_polynomial_family
proof:
:= by
  apply isPolynomialFamily_linearMap
  intro v
  exact hF.linear_comp (linearMatrixApplyParameter t v)

name: ChoppedPlane.universalLinearMatrixMap_isPolynomialFamily
statement:
theorem universalLinearMatrixMap_isPolynomialFamily (a c t : ℕ) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun u : LinearMatrixParameter a c → K =>
      linearMatrixMap (universalLinearMatrix K a c u) t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply isPolynomialFamily_linearMap
  intro v
  exact isPolynomialFamily_linear
    ((linearMatrixApplyParameter t v).comp (universalLinearMatrix K a c))

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixFamily_allTwists_principal_open
statement:
theorem linearMatrixFamily_allTwists_principal_open {ι : Type*}
    (F : (ι → K) → LinearMatrix K a c) (hF : IsPolynomialFamily F)
    (hac : a < c) (u₀ : ι → K) (h₀ : ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank (F u₀) t) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval u₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 → ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank (F u) t
proof:
:= by
  let q := linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c
  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀, hleft⟩ := rank_polynomial_principal_open
    (fun u => linearMatrixMap (F u) (q - 1))
    (linearMatrixMap_polynomial_family F hF (q - 1)) u₀
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁, hright⟩ := rank_polynomial_principal_open
    (fun u => linearMatrixMap (F u) q)
    (linearMatrixMap_polynomial_family F hF q) u₀
  have hmax (t : ℕ) {u : ι → K}
      (h : finrank K (linearMatrixMap (F u₀) t).range ≤
        finrank K (linearMatrixMap (F u) t).range) :
      LinearMatrixMaximalRank (F u) t := by
    have hw := h₀ t
    dsimp [LinearMatrixMaximalRank] at hw ⊢
    rw [hw] at h
    exact le_antisymm
      (le_min (LinearMap.finrank_range_le _) (Submodule.finrank_le _)) h
  refine ⟨D₀ * D₁, by simpa using mul_ne_zero hD₀ hD₁, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  have hu₀ : eval u D₀ ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using hu)).1
  have hu₁ : eval u D₁ ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using hu)).2
  exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_numeric_critical_checks _ hac
    (fun _ => hmax (q - 1) (hleft u hu₀)) (hmax q (hright u hu₁))

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixFamily_allTwists_principal_open_of_surjective
statement:
theorem linearMatrixFamily_allTwists_principal_open_of_surjective {ι : Type*}
    (F : (ι → K) → LinearMatrix K a c) (hF : IsPolynomialFamily F)
    (hFsurj : Function.Surjective F) (hac : a < c)
    (hw : ∃ L : LinearMatrix K a c, ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, (∃ u, eval u D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 → ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank (F u) t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hw
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀⟩ := hFsurj L
  obtain ⟨D, hD, h⟩ := linearMatrixFamily_allTwists_principal_open F hF hac u₀
    (by simpa only [hu₀] using hL)
  exact ⟨D, ⟨u₀, hD⟩, h⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.universalLinearMatrix_maximalRank_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalLinearMatrix_maximalRank_principal_open
    (L : LinearMatrix K a c) (t : ℕ) (hL : LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (LinearMatrixParameter a c) K,
      eval (linearMatrixCoordinates K L) D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        LinearMatrixMaximalRank (universalLinearMatrix K a c u) t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, h⟩ := rank_polynomial_principal_open
    (fun u => linearMatrixMap (universalLinearMatrix K a c u) t)
    (universalLinearMatrixMap_isPolynomialFamily a c t) (linearMatrixCoordinates K L)
  refine ⟨D, hD, fun u hu => ?_⟩
  have hlow := h u hu
  rw [universalLinearMatrix_coordinates] at hlow
  dsimp [LinearMatrixMaximalRank] at hL ⊢
  rw [hL] at hlow
  exact le_antisymm
    (le_min (LinearMap.finrank_range_le _) (Submodule.finrank_le _)) hlow

name: ChoppedPlane.universalLinearMatrix_critical_maximum_open
statement:
theorem universalLinearMatrix_critical_maximum_open [Infinite K] (a c : ℕ) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (LinearMatrixParameter a c) K,
      (∃ u, eval u D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 → ∀ L : LinearMatrix K a c,
        (finrank K (linearMatrixMap L (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c - 1)).range ≤
          finrank K (linearMatrixMap (universalLinearMatrix K a c u)
            (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c - 1)).range) ∧
        (finrank K (linearMatrixMap L (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c)).range ≤
          finrank K (linearMatrixMap (universalLinearMatrix K a c u)
            (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c)).range)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c
  obtain ⟨u₀, D₀, hD₀, hmax₀, heq₀⟩ := maximum_rank_polynomial_principal_open
    (fun u => linearMatrixMap (universalLinearMatrix K a c u) (q - 1))
    (universalLinearMatrixMap_isPolynomialFamily a c (q - 1))
  obtain ⟨u₁, D₁, hD₁, hmax₁, heq₁⟩ := maximum_rank_polynomial_principal_open
    (fun u => linearMatrixMap (universalLinearMatrix K a c u) q)
    (universalLinearMatrixMap_isPolynomialFamily a c q)
  have hz₀ : D₀ ≠ 0 := by intro hz; simp [hz] at hD₀
  have hz₁ : D₁ ≠ 0 := by intro hz; simp [hz] at hD₁
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := nonempty_principal_intersection
    (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then D₀ else D₁)
    (fun i => by split_ifs <;> assumption)
  have hu₀ : eval u D₀ ≠ 0 := by simpa using hu 0
  have hu₁ : eval u D₁ ≠ 0 := by simpa using hu 1
  refine ⟨D₀ * D₁, ⟨u, by simpa using mul_ne_zero hu₀ hu₁⟩, ?_⟩
  intro v hv L
  have hv₀ : eval v D₀ ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using hv)).1
  have hv₁ : eval v D₁ ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using hv)).2
  constructor
  · rw [heq₀ v hv₀]
    have h := hmax₀ (linearMatrixCoordinates K L)
    rw [universalLinearMatrix_coordinates] at h
    exact h
  · rw [heq₁ v hv₁]
    have h := hmax₁ (linearMatrixCoordinates K L)
    rw [universalLinearMatrix_coordinates] at h
    exact h

name: ChoppedPlane.universalLinearMatrix_allTwists_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalLinearMatrix_allTwists_principal_open
    (hac : a < c) (L : LinearMatrix K a c)
    (hL : ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (LinearMatrixParameter a c) K,
      eval (linearMatrixCoordinates K L) D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 → ∀ t,
        LinearMatrixMaximalRank (universalLinearMatrix K a c u) t
proof:
:= by
  let q := linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c
  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀, h₀⟩ := universalLinearMatrix_maximalRank_principal_open L
    (q - 1) (hL (q - 1))
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁, h₁⟩ := universalLinearMatrix_maximalRank_principal_open L q (hL q)
  refine ⟨D₀ * D₁, by simpa using mul_ne_zero hD₀ hD₁, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  have hu₀ : eval u D₀ ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using hu)).1
  have hu₁ : eval u D₁ ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using hu)).2
  exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_numeric_critical_checks _ hac
    (fun _ => h₀ u hu₀) (h₁ u hu₁)

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_allTwists_principal_open_of_witness
statement:
theorem exists_allTwists_principal_open_of_witness
    (hac : a < c) (h : ∃ L : LinearMatrix K a c, ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (LinearMatrixParameter a c) K,
      (∃ u, eval u D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 → ∀ t,
        LinearMatrixMaximalRank (universalLinearMatrix K a c u) t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hprop⟩ := universalLinearMatrix_allTwists_principal_open hac L hL
  exact ⟨D, ⟨_, hD⟩, hprop⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_even_allTwists_principal_open
statement:
theorem exists_even_allTwists_principal_open (a q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (LinearMatrixParameter a (a + 2 * q)) K,
      (∃ u, eval u D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 → ∀ t,
        LinearMatrixMaximalRank (universalLinearMatrix K a (a + 2 * q) u) t
proof:
:=
  exists_allTwists_principal_open_of_witness (by omega)
    (exists_even_extra_columns_maximalRank a q hq)

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_many_columns_allTwists_principal_open
statement:
theorem exists_many_columns_allTwists_principal_open (a c : ℕ)
    (hac : a < c) (hcolumns : 3 * a ≤ c) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (LinearMatrixParameter a c) K,
      (∃ u, eval u D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 → ∀ t,
        LinearMatrixMaximalRank (universalLinearMatrix K a c u) t
proof:
:=
  exists_allTwists_principal_open_of_witness hac
    (exists_many_columns_maximalRank a c hcolumns)

name: ChoppedPlane.signedMaximalMinor_relation
statement:
theorem signedMaximalMinor_relation (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (j : Fin c) :
    ∑ i, signedMaximalMinor B i * B i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin (c + 1)) R :=
    fun i k => Fin.cases (B i j) (B i) k
  have hzero : M.det = 0 := by
    apply Matrix.det_zero_of_column_eq (i := 0) (j := j.succ)
    · exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm
    · intro i
      simp [M]
  rw [Matrix.det_succ_column_zero] at hzero
  have hm (i : Fin (c + 1)) : M.submatrix i.succAbove Fin.succ = B.submatrix i.succAbove id := by
    ext k l
    change Fin.cases (B (i.succAbove k) j) (B (i.succAbove k)) l.succ = B (i.succAbove k) l
    exact Fin.cases_succ l
  simpa [signedMaximalMinor, maximalMinor, hm, M, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hzero

name: ChoppedPlane.determinant_homogeneous_rows
statement:
theorem determinant_homogeneous_rows {K : Type*} [Field K] {n m : ℕ}
    (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (Poly K n)) (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i)) :
    B.det.IsHomogeneous (∑ i, δ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Matrix.det_apply]
  apply (Forms K n (∑ i, δ i)).sum_mem
  intro σ _
  have hp : (∏ i, B (σ i) i).IsHomogeneous (∑ i, δ i) := by
    have h := MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.prod Finset.univ (fun i => B (σ i) i)
      (fun i => δ (σ i)) (fun i _ => hB (σ i) i)
    simpa only [Equiv.sum_comp σ] using h
  change (σ.sign : ℤ) • (∏ i, B (σ i) i) ∈ (Forms K n (∑ i, δ i)).toAddSubgroup
  exact (Forms K n (∑ i, δ i)).toAddSubgroup.zsmul_mem hp (σ.sign : ℤ)

name: ChoppedPlane.maximalMinor_homogeneous
statement:
theorem maximalMinor_homogeneous {K : Type*} [Field K] {n : ℕ}
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i)) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (maximalMinor B i).IsHomogeneous (∑ j : Fin c, δ (i.succAbove j))
proof:
:= by
  exact determinant_homogeneous_rows _ _ (fun j k => hB (i.succAbove j) k)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.weightedPairs_square
statement:
theorem weightedPairs_square (δ : Fin m → ℕ) :
    (∑ i, δ i) ^ 2 = (∑ i, δ i ^ 2) + 2 * weightedPairs δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let w := fun ij : Fin m × Fin m => δ ij.1 * δ ij.2
  have hpoint (ij : Fin m × Fin m) : w ij =
      (if ij.1 = ij.2 then δ ij.1 ^ 2 else 0) +
      (if ij.1 < ij.2 then w ij else 0) +
      (if ij.2 < ij.1 then w ij else 0) := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy ij.1 ij.2 with h | h | h
    · simp [h, ne_of_lt h, not_lt_of_gt h]
    · simp [h, w, pow_two]
    · simp [h, ne_of_gt h, not_lt_of_gt h]
  have hsum : (∑ ij, w ij) =
      (∑ ij : Fin m × Fin m, if ij.1 = ij.2 then δ ij.1 ^ 2 else 0) +
      (∑ ij : Fin m × Fin m, if ij.1 < ij.2 then w ij else 0) +
      (∑ ij : Fin m × Fin m, if ij.2 < ij.1 then w ij else 0) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ ij : Fin m × Fin m,
          ((if ij.1 = ij.2 then δ ij.1 ^ 2 else 0) +
           (if ij.1 < ij.2 then w ij else 0) +
           (if ij.2 < ij.1 then w ij else 0)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro ij _
        exact hpoint ij
      _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hdiag : (∑ ij : Fin m × Fin m, if ij.1 = ij.2 then δ ij.1 ^ 2 else 0) =
      ∑ i, δ i ^ 2 := by simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  have hlt : (∑ ij : Fin m × Fin m, if ij.1 < ij.2 then w ij else 0) = weightedPairs δ := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    exact Finset.sum_subtype _ (by simp) _
  have hgt : (∑ ij : Fin m × Fin m, if ij.2 < ij.1 then w ij else 0) = weightedPairs δ := by
    rw [← hlt]
    exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.prodComm _ _) _ _ (by intro ij; simp [w, mul_comm])
  have htot : (∑ ij : Fin m × Fin m, w ij) = (∑ i, δ i) ^ 2 := by
    rw [pow_two, Fintype.sum_mul_sum]
    exact Fintype.sum_prod_type _
  rw [htot, hdiag, hlt, hgt] at hsum
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.selected_card_square
statement:
theorem selected_card_square (δ : Fin m → ℕ) :
    (∑ i, δ i) ^ 2 = (∑ i, δ i ^ 2) + 2 * Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [selected_card]
  exact weightedPairs_square δ

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.selected_card_of_sums
statement:
theorem selected_card_of_sums (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (d r : ℕ)
    (hsum : (∑ i, δ i) = d + 2)
    (hsquares : (∑ i, δ i ^ 2) = d + 2 + 2 * r) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ) = (d + 2).choose 2 - r
proof:
:= by
  have hsq := selected_card_square δ
  rw [hsum, hsquares] at hsq
  have hN : 2 * N d = (d + 1) * (d + 2) := by exact_mod_cast twice_N d
  have hcount : Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ) + r = N d := by nlinarith
  change Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ) = N d - r
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.positiveProfile_pos
statement:
theorem positiveProfile_pos (r a : ℕ) (i : Fin (r + a)) :
    0 < positiveProfile r a i
proof:
:= by
  unfold positiveProfile
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.positiveProfile_sum
statement:
theorem positiveProfile_sum (r a : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, positiveProfile r a i) = 2 * r + a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
  have hfirst (i : Fin r) : positiveProfile r a (Fin.castAdd a i) = 2 := by
    simp [positiveProfile, i.isLt]
  have hsecond (i : Fin a) : positiveProfile r a (Fin.natAdd r i) = 1 := by
    simp [positiveProfile]
  simp_rw [hfirst, hsecond]
  simp [mul_comm]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.positiveProfile_square_sum
statement:
theorem positiveProfile_square_sum (r a : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, positiveProfile r a i ^ 2) = 4 * r + a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
  have hfirst (i : Fin r) : positiveProfile r a (Fin.castAdd a i) = 2 := by
    simp [positiveProfile, i.isLt]
  have hsecond (i : Fin a) : positiveProfile r a (Fin.natAdd r i) = 1 := by
    simp [positiveProfile]
  simp_rw [hfirst, hsecond]
  norm_num [mul_comm]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.positiveProfile_row_count
statement:
theorem positiveProfile_row_count {d r : ℕ} (h : 2 * r ≤ d + 2) :
    r + (d + 2 - 2 * r) = d + 2 - r
proof: := by omega

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.positiveProfile_selected_card
statement:
theorem positiveProfile_selected_card {d r : ℕ} (h : 2 * r ≤ d + 2) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex (positiveProfile r (d + 2 - 2 * r))) =
      (d + 2).choose 2 - r
proof:
:= by
  let a := d + 2 - 2 * r
  have ha : 2 * r + a = d + 2 := by dsimp [a]; omega
  have hsq := selected_card_square (positiveProfile r a)
  rw [positiveProfile_sum, positiveProfile_square_sum] at hsq
  have hN : 2 * N d = (d + 1) * (d + 2) := by exact_mod_cast twice_N d
  have hcount : Fintype.card (SelectedIndex (positiveProfile r a)) + r = N d := by
    nlinarith [hsq, ha, hN]
  change Fintype.card (SelectedIndex (positiveProfile r a)) = N d - r
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_eq
statement:
private theorem endpointProfile_eq (r a : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (i : Fin (r + a)) :
    endpointProfile r a i = positiveProfile r a (endpointPermutation r a hr i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b : Fin (r + a) := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
  let l : Fin (r + a) := ⟨r + a - 1, by omega⟩
  change endpointProfile r a i = positiveProfile r a (Equiv.swap b l i)
  by_cases hib : i = b
  · subst i
    rw [Equiv.swap_apply_left]
    simp only [endpointProfile, positiveProfile, b, l]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  by_cases hil : i = l
  · subst i
    rw [Equiv.swap_apply_right]
    simp only [endpointProfile, positiveProfile, b, l]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hib hil]
  have hvb : i.val ≠ r - 1 := by intro h; apply hib; exact Fin.ext h
  have hvl : i.val ≠ r + a - 1 := by intro h; apply hil; exact Fin.ext h
  simp only [endpointProfile, positiveProfile]
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_pos
statement:
theorem endpointProfile_pos (r a : ℕ) (i : Fin (r + a)) :
    0 < endpointProfile r a i
proof:
:= by
  unfold endpointProfile
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_first
statement:
theorem endpointProfile_first {r a : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) (i : Fin (r + a))
    (hi : i.val = 0) : endpointProfile r a i = 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [endpointProfile, hi, show 0 < r - 1 by omega]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_last
statement:
theorem endpointProfile_last {r a : ℕ} (i : Fin (r + a)) (hi : i.val + 1 = r + a) :
    endpointProfile r a i = 2
proof: := by simp [endpointProfile, hi]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_sum
statement:
theorem endpointProfile_sum (r a : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∑ i, endpointProfile r a i) = 2 * r + a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [endpointProfile_eq r a hr]
  rw [Equiv.sum_comp]
  exact positiveProfile_sum r a

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_square_sum
statement:
theorem endpointProfile_square_sum (r a : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∑ i, endpointProfile r a i ^ 2) = 4 * r + a
proof:
:= by
  exact (Fintype.sum_equiv (endpointPermutation r a hr)
    (fun i => endpointProfile r a i ^ 2) (fun i => positiveProfile r a i ^ 2)
    (fun i => congrArg (fun n : ℕ => n ^ 2) (endpointProfile_eq r a hr i))).trans
    (positiveProfile_square_sum r a)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.endpointProfile_selected_card
statement:
theorem endpointProfile_selected_card {d r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : 2 * r ≤ d + 2) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex (endpointProfile r (d + 2 - 2 * r))) =
      (d + 2).choose 2 - r
proof:
:= by
  apply selected_card_of_sums _ d r
  · rw [endpointProfile_sum r _ hr]
    omega
  · rw [endpointProfile_square_sum r _ hr]
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.exists_cubic_parameter
statement: theorem exists_cubic_parameter : ∃ q : K, q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0 ∧ q ≠ 0 ∧ q ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (-3 : K) (by decide : 0 < 2)
  have htwo : (2 : K) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have hq : ((w-1)/2)^2 + (w-1)/2 + 1 = 0 := by
    field_simp
    linear_combination hw
  refine ⟨(w-1)/2, hq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    rw [h] at hq
    norm_num at hq
  · intro h
    rw [h] at hq
    norm_num at hq

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.homogeneousTensorExponent_degree
statement:
@[simp] theorem homogeneousTensorExponent_degree (n : ℕ) (i : Sym (Fin 3) n) :
    (homogeneousTensorExponent n i).degree = n
proof:
:=
  (homogeneousTensorExponentEquiv n i).property

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.homogeneousTensorExponent_injective
statement:
theorem homogeneousTensorExponent_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (homogeneousTensorExponent n)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  apply (homogeneousTensorExponentEquiv n).injective
  exact Subtype.ext h

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.exists_homogeneousTensorExponent
statement:
theorem exists_homogeneousTensorExponent (n : ℕ) (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ)
    (hs : s.degree = n) : ∃ i : Sym (Fin 3) n, homogeneousTensorExponent n i = s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(homogeneousTensorExponentEquiv n).symm ⟨s,hs⟩, ?_⟩
  simp [homogeneousTensorExponent]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.mem_homogeneousTensorSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_homogeneousTensorSubmodule (n : ℕ) (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    P ∈ homogeneousTensorSubmodule n ↔ TensorHomogeneous n P
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_tmul (n : ℕ) (P : Aux R)
    (m : M) (i : Sym (Fin 3) n) :
    homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector n (P ⊗ₜ[R] m) i =
      P.coeff (homogeneousTensorExponent n i) • m
proof:
:= by
  simp [homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_synthesis
statement:
@[simp] theorem homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_synthesis (n : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) :
    homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector n (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (R := R) n c) = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext i
  simp only [homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector, homogeneousTensorSynthesis,
    map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, tensorCoefficients_monomial, Finsupp.single_apply]
  simp only [(homogeneousTensorExponent_injective n).eq_iff,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.homogeneousTensorSynthesis_homogeneous
statement:
theorem homogeneousTensorSynthesis_homogeneous (n : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) :
    TensorHomogeneous n (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (R := R) n c)
proof:
:= by
  apply (tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients n _).mpr
  intro s hs
  classical
  simp only [homogeneousTensorSynthesis, map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
    tensorCoefficients_monomial, Finsupp.single_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  have h : homogeneousTensorExponent n i ≠ s := by
    intro heq
    exact hs (heq ▸ homogeneousTensorExponent_degree n i)
  simp [h]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.homogeneousTensorSynthesis_coefficients
statement:
theorem homogeneousTensorSynthesis_coefficients (n : ℕ)
    (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    homogeneousTensorSynthesis n (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector n P) = P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply tensorCoefficients.injective
  ext s
  by_cases hs : s.degree = n
  · obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := exists_homogeneousTensorExponent n s hs
    exact congrFun (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_synthesis n
      (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector n P)) i
  · rw [(tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients n _).mp
      (homogeneousTensorSynthesis_homogeneous n _) s hs,
      (tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients n _).mp hP s hs]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.homogeneousTensorCoordinates_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem homogeneousTensorCoordinates_apply (n : ℕ)
    (P : homogeneousTensorSubmodule (R := R) (M := M) n) (i : Sym (Fin 3) n) :
    homogeneousTensorCoordinates n P i = tensorCoefficients P.val (homogeneousTensorExponent n i)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.homogeneousTensorCoordinates_symm_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem homogeneousTensorCoordinates_symm_val (n : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) :
    ((homogeneousTensorCoordinates (R := R) n).symm c).val =
      ∑ i, (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent n i) 1 : Aux R) ⊗ₜ[R] c i
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_forms_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem pair_forms_linearIndependent (q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hq : (q 0).val ≠ 0) (hcop : IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val) :
    LinearIndependent K q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mpr
  intro c hc i
  let a : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 0 := fun j => ⟨C (c j), isHomogeneous_C _ _⟩
  have ham : multiplication q a = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hh := congrArg Subtype.val hc
    rw [multiplication_val, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    change (q 0).val * C (c 0) + (q 1).val * C (c 1) = 0
    rw [mul_comm (q 0).val (C (c 0)), mul_comm (q 1).val (C (c 1)),
      MvPolynomial.C_mul', MvPolynomial.C_mul']
    simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
      Submodule.coe_zero] using hh
  have ha : a = 0 := (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mp
    (pair_multiplication_injective_below q hq hcop (by omega : 0 < d)) a ham
  have hh := congrArg (fun a : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 0 => (a i).val) ha
  simpa [a] using hh

name: ChoppedPlane.mainConclusion_two_generator
statement:
theorem mainConclusion_two_generator (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d) (hr : N d - p = 2)
    (hdist : DistinctPoints K a)
    (hpoint : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p)
    (q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d) (hspace : generatorSpace q = pointDegreeSpace K a d)
    (hq : (q 0).val ≠ 0) (hcop : IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val) :
    MainConclusion K a d
proof:
:= by
  have hregular : ChopHasRegularGenerators K a d 2 := by
    refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [choppedIdeal, ← hspace, generatorSpace]
      exact (Submodule.span_span_of_tower K (Poly K 3) (Set.range (fun i => (q i).val))).symm
    · have hs := homogeneous_regular_pair (by omega : 0 < d) (q 0) (q 1) hq hcop
      simpa [List.ofFn_succ] using hs
  refine ⟨hdist, hpoint, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t
    by_cases ht : t < d
    · simpa only [expectedChoppedHilbertFunction, ht, ite_true, N] using
        choppedHilbertFunction_below_degree a ht
    · have hseries := congrArg Int.toNat (pair_generatedHilbertFunction q hq hcop t)
      rw [hspace] at hseries
      simpa [choppedHilbertFunction, expectedChoppedHilbertFunction, ht,
        not_le.mpr hhi, not_le.mpr hlo, hr, completeIntersectionCoefficient] using hseries
  · intro h; omega
  · intro h; omega
  · intro _ _
    dsimp only
    rw [hr]
    constructor
    · intro _; exact hregular
    · intro h; omega

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_two_generator_witness
statement:
theorem exists_two_generator_witness [CharZero K] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ (a : PointCoordinates K ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2)) (q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d),
      pointDegreePiece K a d = Submodule.span K (Set.range q) ∧
      LinearIndependent K q ∧ (q 0).val ≠ 0 ∧ IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let α : Fin d → K := fun i => (i.val : K)
  have hα : Function.Injective α := by intro i j hij; exact Fin.ext (Nat.cast_injective hij)
  obtain ⟨a, _, hkernel, _⟩ := Grid.exists_grid_subset hd α α hα hα
  let q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d := ![Grid.firstForm α, Grid.secondForm α]
  refine ⟨a, q, ?_, Grid.first_second_linearIndependent hd α α,
    Grid.planeFirst_ne_zero α, Grid.plane_equations_relPrime α α⟩
  ext f
  rw [mem_pointDegreePiece, hkernel]
  have hrange : Set.range q = {Grid.firstForm α, Grid.secondForm α} :=
    Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty _ _ _
  rw [hrange, Submodule.mem_span_pair]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b,c,h⟩; exact ⟨b,c,h.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨b,c,h⟩; exact ⟨b,c,h.symm⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.regular_pair_point_principal_open
statement:
theorem regular_pair_point_principal_open [CharZero K] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2) × Fin 2) K,
      (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
      ∃ q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d,
        generatorSpace q = pointDegreeSpace K a d ∧ (q 0).val ≠ 0 ∧
          IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let p := (d + 2).choose 2 - 2
  obtain ⟨a₀, q₀, hkernel₀, hlin₀, hq₀, hcop₀⟩ := exists_two_generator_witness (K := K) d hd
  have hdim₀ : finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a₀ d) = 2 := by
    rw [hkernel₀, finrank_span_eq_card hlin₀, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hsurj₀ : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a₀ d) := by
    apply pointEvaluation_surjective_of_hilbert_eq a₀
    have hh := (pointDegreePiece K a₀ d).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
    rw [hdim₀, finrank_plane_forms] at hh
    change pointHilbertFunction K a₀ d + 2 = _ at hh
    omega
  obtain ⟨D₀, C, hC, hD₀, hker, hchart, hfix⟩ := polynomial_kernel_chart
    (fun a : PointCoordinates K p => pointEvaluation K a d)
    (pointEvaluation_isPolynomialFamily p d) a₀ hsurj₀
  let q (a : PointCoordinates K p) : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d := fun i => C a (q₀ i)
  have hqpoly : IsPolynomialFamily q := by
    intro ell
    exact hC
      { toFun := fun T => ell (fun i => T (q₀ i))
        map_add' := by
          intro T T'
          change ell ((fun i => T (q₀ i)) + (fun i => T' (q₀ i))) = _
          exact ell.map_add _ _
        map_smul' := by
          intro c T
          change ell (c • (fun i => T (q₀ i))) = c • ell (fun i => T (q₀ i))
          exact ell.map_smul c _ }
  have hq₀mem (i : Fin 2) : q₀ i ∈ (pointEvaluation K a₀ d).ker := by
    change q₀ i ∈ pointDegreePiece K a₀ d
    rw [hkernel₀]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i,rfl⟩
  have hqfix : q a₀ = q₀ := by funext i; exact hfix _ (hq₀mem i)
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁, hpair⟩ := pair_regular_principal_open hd q hqpoly a₀
    (by simpa [hqfix] using hq₀) (by simpa [hqfix] using hcop₀)
  refine ⟨D₀ * D₁, ⟨a₀, by rw [map_mul, hD₀, one_mul]; exact hD₁⟩, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  have hparts : eval a D₀ ≠ 0 ∧ eval a D₁ ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_mul, mul_ne_zero_iff] using ha
  obtain ⟨hcop, _, _⟩ := hpair a hparts.2
  have hq : (q a 0).val ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hunit : IsUnit (q a 1).val := hcop (by simp only [hz]; exact dvd_zero _) dvd_rfl
    have hc := MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff_totalDegree_of_isReduced.mp hunit
    have ht := (q a 1).property.totalDegree (IsUnit.ne_zero hunit)
    omega
  have hlin := pair_forms_linearIndependent (q a) hd hq hcop
  have hspanle : Submodule.span K (Set.range (q a)) ≤ pointDegreePiece K a d := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i,rfl⟩
    exact hker a ⟨q₀ i,rfl⟩
  have hdim : finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = 2 := by
    have h₀ := (pointEvaluation K a₀ d).finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
    have h₁ := (pointEvaluation K a d).finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj₀, finrank_top] at h₀
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (hchart a hparts.1).2, finrank_top] at h₁
    change _ + finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a₀ d) = _ at h₀
    change _ + finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = _ at h₁
    omega
  have hspan : Submodule.span K (Set.range (q a)) = pointDegreePiece K a d := by
    apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hspanle
    rw [finrank_span_eq_card hlin, Fintype.card_fin, hdim]
  refine ⟨q a, ?_, hq, hcop⟩
  rw [pointDegreeSpace, ← hspan, Submodule.map_span]
  rw [generatorSpace, ← Set.range_comp]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_two_generator
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_two_generator [CharZero K]
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (_hp : 1 ≤ p) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d)
    (hr : N d - p = 2) : GenericChoppedConclusion K d p
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p = (d + 2).choose 2 - 2 := by dsimp [N] at hhi hr; omega
  subst p
  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀, hpoint⟩ := generic_pointHilbertFunction (K := K) ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2)
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁, hpair⟩ := regular_pair_point_principal_open (K := K) d (by omega)
  have hD₀ne : D₀ ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hD₀
  have hD₁ne : D₁ ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hD₁
  have hprodne : D₀ * D₁ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hD₀ne hD₁ne
  have hex : ∃ a, eval a (D₀ * D₁) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hprodne (MvPolynomial.funext h)
  refine ⟨D₀ * D₁, hex, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  have hparts : eval a D₀ ≠ 0 ∧ eval a D₁ ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_mul, mul_ne_zero_iff] using ha
  obtain ⟨hdist, hpoint⟩ := hpoint a hparts.1
  obtain ⟨q, hspace, hq, hcop⟩ := hpair a hparts.2
  exact mainConclusion_two_generator a hd hlo hhi hr hdist (by simpa only [N] using hpoint)
    q hspace hq hcop

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRow_point_matrix_principal_open
statement:
theorem positiveRow_point_matrix_principal_open [Infinite K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    {r a : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (hw : ∃ M : LinearMatrix K a (positiveRowColumns r a),
      ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank M t) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter (positiveRowProfile r a)) K,
      (∃ u, eval u D ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors
          (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) (universalRowMatrix _ u)) ∧
        ∃ z : PointCoordinates K (N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r),
          DistinctPoints K z ∧
          (∀ t, pointDegreePiece K z t = idealFormPiece
            (maximalMinorIdeal
              (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) (universalRowMatrix _ u))) t) ∧
          (∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank
            (universalPositiveLinearBlock (by omega : 0 < r) u) t) ∧
          Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K z (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a)) ∧
          ∀ e, pointHilbertFunction K z (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + e) =
            N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by omega
  have hdegree : 0 < ∑ i, positiveRowProfile r a i := by
    rw [positiveRowProfile_sum r a hrpos]
    omega
  obtain ⟨P, ⟨uP, huP⟩, hpoints⟩ :=
    universalRowMatrix_actual_points_principal_open (K := K)
      (positiveRowProfile r a) hdegree
  obtain ⟨Q, ⟨uQ, huQ⟩, hrank⟩ := positiveRow_linearBlock_allTwists_open hr hw
  have hP : P ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, map_zero] at huP
    exact huP rfl
  have hQ : Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, map_zero] at huQ
    exact huQ rfl
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀⟩ := nonempty_principal_intersection ![P, Q]
    (fun i => by fin_cases i <;> assumption)
  refine ⟨P * Q, ⟨u₀, ?_⟩, fun u hu => ?_⟩
  · simpa only [map_mul, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] using
      mul_ne_zero (hu₀ 0) (hu₀ 1)
  · have hparts : eval u P ≠ 0 ∧ eval u Q ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simpa only [map_mul] using hu)
    obtain ⟨hprimitive, hcoords⟩ := hpoints u hparts.1
    rw [positiveRowProfile_selected_card r a hrpos] at hcoords
    obtain ⟨z, hdist, hpieces⟩ := hcoords
    obtain ⟨hsurj, hconstant⟩ := positiveRow_points_properties hrpos
      (universalRowMatrix (positiveRowProfile r a) u) hprimitive z hpieces
    exact ⟨hprimitive, z, hdist, hpieces, hrank u hparts.2, hsurj, hconstant⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRow_exists_point_matrix_witness
statement:
theorem positiveRow_exists_point_matrix_witness [Infinite K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    {r a : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (hw : ∃ M : LinearMatrix K a (positiveRowColumns r a),
      ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank M t) :
    ∃ (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K (positiveRowProfile r a))
      (z : PointCoordinates K (N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r)),
      PrimitiveMaximalMinors
        (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B) ∧
      DistinctPoints K z ∧
      (∀ t, pointDegreePiece K z t = idealFormPiece
        (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B)) t) ∧
      (∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank
        (positiveLinearBlock (by omega : 0 < r) B) t) ∧
      Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K z (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a)) ∧
      ∀ e, pointHilbertFunction K z (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + e) =
        N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, ⟨u, hu⟩, hgood⟩ := positiveRow_point_matrix_principal_open hr hw
  obtain ⟨hprimitive, z, hdist, hpieces, hrank, hsurj, hconstant⟩ := hgood u hu
  exact ⟨universalRowMatrix (positiveRowProfile r a) u, z, hprimitive,
    hdist, hpieces, hrank, hsurj, hconstant⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileLaurentTopMultiply_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem profileLaurentTopMultiply_val (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (p : topGrade (K := K) (auxiliaryDualWeights s n) (-(r + 1))) :
    (profileLaurentTopMultiply q hq s r n p).val =
      freeNegativePart (profileLaurentMultiply q hq s n p.val)

:=
