name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileLaurentCross_uChart_graded_preimage
statement:
theorem profileLaurentCross_uChart_graded_preimage
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × Sym (Fin 3) (n + 1)))
    (hp : p ∈ uChartGrade (auxiliaryDualWeights s (n + 1)) k)
    (hQp : profileLaurentCross q hq s (n + 1) p = 0) :
    ∃ x, x ∈ uChartGrade (auxiliaryDualWeights s n) (k - 1) ∧
      profileLaurentMultiply q hq s n x = p
proof:
:= by
  apply uChart_preimage_by_projection (auxiliaryDualWeights s n)
    (auxiliaryDualWeights s (n + 1)) (profileLaurentMultiply q hq s n)
    (profileLaurentMultiply_mem_overlapGrade q hq s n) k p hp
  apply profileLaurentCross_uChart_preimage q hq s n p _ hQp
  rw [uChartGrade_eq_overlap_inf_range] at hp
  exact hp.2

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileLaurentCross_vChart_graded_preimage
statement:
theorem profileLaurentCross_vChart_graded_preimage
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × Sym (Fin 3) (n + 1)))
    (hp : p ∈ vChartGrade (auxiliaryDualWeights s (n + 1)) k)
    (hQp : profileLaurentCross q hq s (n + 1) p = 0) :
    ∃ x, x ∈ vChartGrade (auxiliaryDualWeights s n) (k - 1) ∧
      profileLaurentMultiply q hq s n x = p
proof:
:= by
  apply vChart_preimage_by_projection (auxiliaryDualWeights s n)
    (auxiliaryDualWeights s (n + 1)) (profileLaurentMultiply q hq s n)
    (profileLaurentMultiply_mem_overlapGrade q hq s n) k p hp
  apply profileLaurentCross_vChart_preimage q hq s n p _ hQp
  rw [vChartGrade_eq_overlap_inf_range] at hp
  exact hp.2

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileLaurentTopMultiply_injective_of_dualDifferential
statement:
theorem profileLaurentTopMultiply_injective_of_dualDifferential
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      (operatorDifferential (gradedProfileDualOperators q s ((n + 1 : ℕ) - r)) n)) :
    Function.Injective (profileLaurentTopMultiply q hq s r n)
proof:
:= by
  apply topMap_injective_of_cross
    (auxiliaryDualWeights s n) (auxiliaryDualWeights s (n + 1))
    (auxiliaryDualWeights s (n + 1)) (-(r + 1)) (-r) ((n + 1 : ℕ) - r)
    (profileLaurentMultiply q hq s n) (profileLaurentCross q hq s (n + 1))
    (profileLaurentDirectional q hq s n)
  · intro p hp
    have hd : -r + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - r := by omega
    simpa only [hd] using profileLaurentCross_mem_uChartGrade q hq s (n + 1) (-r) p hp
  · intro p hp
    have hd : -r + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - r := by omega
    simpa only [hd] using profileLaurentCross_mem_vChartGrade q hq s (n + 1) (-r) p hp
  · exact profileLaurentCross_multiply_zero q hq s n
  · exact profileLaurentDirectional_cross_zero q hq s n
  · intro p hp hzero
    exact profileLaurentMultiply_injective q hq s n (hzero.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  · exact profileLaurentDirectional_positive_kernel_zero q hq s ((n + 1 : ℕ) - r) n hinj
  · intro p hp hzero
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hLx⟩ := profileLaurentCross_uChart_graded_preimage q hq s n (-r) p hp hzero
    refine ⟨x, ?_, hLx⟩
    have hd : -r - 1 = -(r + 1) := by omega
    simpa only [hd] using hx
  · intro p hp hzero
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hLx⟩ := profileLaurentCross_vChart_graded_preimage q hq s n (-r) p hp hzero
    refine ⟨x, ?_, hLx⟩
    have hd : -r - 1 = -(r + 1) := by omega
    simpa only [hd] using hx

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileLaurentTopMultiply_critical_injective
statement:
theorem profileLaurentTopMultiply_critical_injective
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℕ)
    (hn : 0 < profileCriticalDegree s r) :
    Function.Injective (profileLaurentTopMultiply q hq s (r : ℤ)
      (profileCriticalDegree s r - 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply profileLaurentTopMultiply_injective_of_dualDifferential
  have hd : ((profileCriticalDegree s r - 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      (profileCriticalDegree s r : ℤ) := by omega
  rw [hd]
  exact profileCriticalDualDifferential_injective q hq s r hn

name: ChoppedPlane.formsMap_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem formsMap_val (k : K →+* L) (f : Forms K n d) :
    (formsMap k f).val = map k f.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.formsMap_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem formsMap_basis (k : K →+* L) (i : Sym (Fin n) d) :
    formsMap k (formsBasis K n d i) = formsBasis L n d i
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact formsBasis_map K n d k i

name: ChoppedPlane.formsMap_coordinates
statement:
theorem formsMap_coordinates (k : K →+* L) (f : Forms K n d) (i : Sym (Fin n) d) :
    (formsBasis L n d).repr (formsMap k f) i = k ((formsBasis K n d).repr f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hform : formsMap k f =
      ∑ j, k ((formsBasis K n d).repr f j) • formsBasis L n d j := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← (formsBasis K n d).sum_repr f]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smulₛₗ, formsMap_basis]
  rw [hform]
  simp [Finsupp.single_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.pointPolynomialMatrix_eval
statement:
theorem pointPolynomialMatrix_eval (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates L p) :
    polynomialMatrixEval k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d) =
      LinearMap.toMatrix (formsBasis L 3 d) (Pi.basisFun L (Fin p))
        (pointEvaluation L a d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  simp only [Pi.basisFun_repr, pointEvaluation_apply]
  change eval₂ k a (chartEvaluationPolynomial (formsBasis K 3 d j) i) =
    eval (chartPoint L a i) (formsBasis L 3 d j).val
  rw [chartEvaluationPolynomial]
  change (eval₂Hom k a) (eval₂ C ![X (i,0), X (i,1), 1]
    (formsBasis K 3 d j).val) = _
  rw [eval₂_comp_left]
  have hk : (eval₂Hom k a).comp C = k := by ext c; simp
  rw [hk]
  have hv : (eval₂Hom k a) ∘ ![X (i,0), X (i,1), 1] = chartPoint L a i := by
    funext t
    fin_cases t <;> simp [chartPoint]
  rw [hv, ← eval_map, formsBasis_map]

name: ChoppedPlane.pointPolynomialMatrix_coordinates
statement:
theorem pointPolynomialMatrix_coordinates (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates L p)
    (f : Forms L 3 d) :
    (polynomialMatrixEval k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d)).mulVecLin
      ((formsBasis L 3 d).equivFun f) = pointEvaluation L a d f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply _root_.funext
  intro i
  have hh := congrFun (LinearMap.toMatrix_mulVec_repr (formsBasis L 3 d)
    (Pi.basisFun L (Fin p)) (pointEvaluation L a d) f) i
  rw [← pointPolynomialMatrix_eval k a] at hh
  simpa only [Basis.equivFun_apply, Pi.basisFun_repr, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply] using hh

name: ChoppedPlane.pointPolynomialMatrix_surjective_iff
statement:
theorem pointPolynomialMatrix_surjective_iff (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates L p) :
    Function.Surjective (polynomialMatrixEval k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d)).mulVecLin ↔
      Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation L a d)
proof:
:= by
  let b := formsBasis L 3 d
  constructor
  · intro hs y
    obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := hs y
    refine ⟨b.equivFun.symm c, ?_⟩
    rw [← pointPolynomialMatrix_coordinates k a, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hc
  · intro hs y
    obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hs y
    exact ⟨b.equivFun f, (pointPolynomialMatrix_coordinates k a f).trans hf⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.pointPolynomialMatrix_rank
statement:
theorem pointPolynomialMatrix_rank (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates L p) :
    (polynomialMatrixEval k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d)).rank =
      pointHilbertFunction L a d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [pointPolynomialMatrix_eval,
    Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin _ (Pi.basisFun L (Fin p)) (formsBasis L 3 d),
    Matrix.toLin_toMatrix, pointHilbertFunction_eq_rank]

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_baseChange
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_baseChange (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    pointHilbertFunction L (k ∘ a) d = pointHilbertFunction K a d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pointPolynomialMatrix_rank k (k ∘ a),
    polynomialMatrixEval_rank_map_parameter,
    pointPolynomialMatrix_rank (RingHom.id K) a]

name: ChoppedPlane.formProductCoordinates_map
statement:
theorem formProductCoordinates_map (k : K →+* L) :
    (formProductCoordinates K d e).map k = formProductCoordinates L d e
proof:
:= by
  ext t ij
  have hp : formsMap k (formProductBilinear (formsBasis K 3 d ij.1)
      (formsBasis K 3 e ij.2)) =
      formProductBilinear (formsBasis L 3 d ij.1) (formsBasis L 3 e ij.2) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [formsMap_val, formProductBilinear_val, map_mul, formsBasis_map]
  change k ((formsBasis K 3 (d + e)).repr _ t) = _
  rw [← formsMap_coordinates, hp]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProductPolynomialMatrix_eval
statement:
theorem kernelProductPolynomialMatrix_eval {ι : Type*} (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → L)
    (C : Matrix (Sym (Fin 3) d) (Sym (Fin 3) d) (MvPolynomial ι K))
    (t : Sym (Fin 3) (d + e)) (ij : Sym (Fin 3) d × Sym (Fin 3) e) :
    polynomialMatrixEval k a (kernelProductPolynomialMatrix C e) t ij =
      (formsBasis L 3 (d + e)).repr
        (formProductBilinear (coordinateForm L d (polynomialMatrixEval k a C) ij.1)
          (formsBasis L 3 e ij.2)) t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoeff (s : Sym (Fin 3) d) := congrFun
    (congrFun (formProductCoordinates_map (d := d) (e := e) k) t) (s,ij.2)
  simp only [polynomialMatrixEval, Matrix.map_apply, kernelProductPolynomialMatrix,
    map_sum, map_mul, eval₂Hom_C]
  rw [coordinateForm, Basis.equivFun_symm_apply, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, Finsupp.coe_finsetSum,
    Finset.sum_apply, Finsupp.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s _
  exact congrArg (fun c : L => eval₂Hom k a (C s ij.1) * c) (hcoeff s)

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProductSpace_span_basis
statement:
theorem kernelProductSpace_span_basis {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (q : J → Forms K 3 d) :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun ij : J × Sym (Fin 3) e =>
      formProductBilinear (q ij.1) (formsBasis K 3 e ij.2))) =
      kernelProductSpace (formProductBilinear (K := K) (n := 3) (d := d) (e := e))
        (Submodule.span K (Set.range q))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := formProductBilinear (K := K) (n := 3) (d := d) (e := e)
  rw [← range_kernelProductMap_eq B q _ rfl]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨⟨i,j⟩,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Pi.single i (formsBasis K 3 e j), kernelProductMap_single B q i _⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨w,rfl⟩
    rw [kernelProductMap_apply]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i _
    rw [← (formsBasis K 3 e).sum_repr (w i), map_sum]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro j _
    rw [map_smul]
    apply Submodule.smul_mem
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨(i,j),rfl⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProductPolynomialMatrix_rank
statement:
theorem kernelProductPolynomialMatrix_rank {ι : Type*} (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → L)
    (C : Matrix (Sym (Fin 3) d) (Sym (Fin 3) d) (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    (polynomialMatrixEval k a (kernelProductPolynomialMatrix C e)).rank =
      finrank L (kernelProductSpace
        (formProductBilinear (K := L) (n := 3) (d := d) (e := e))
        (Submodule.span L (Set.range
          (coordinateForm L d (polynomialMatrixEval k a C)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := coordinateForm L d (polynomialMatrixEval k a C)
  let v : Sym (Fin 3) d × Sym (Fin 3) e → Forms L 3 (d + e) :=
    fun ij => formProductBilinear (q ij.1) (formsBasis L 3 e ij.2)
  let b := formsBasis L 3 (d + e)
  have hcol : (polynomialMatrixEval k a (kernelProductPolynomialMatrix C e)).col =
      fun ij => b.equivFun (v ij) := by
    funext ij t
    exact kernelProductPolynomialMatrix_eval k a C t ij
  have hspan : Submodule.span L (Set.range (fun ij => b.equivFun (v ij))) =
      (Submodule.span L (Set.range v)).map b.equivFun.toLinearMap := by
    rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  rw [Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_cols, hcol, hspan,
    LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq, kernelProductSpace_span_basis]

name: ChoppedPlane.point_kernel_chart_columns_span
statement:
theorem point_kernel_chart_columns_span (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates L p)
    (S : Matrix (Sym (Fin 3) d) (Fin p) (MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K))
    (hdet : eval₂ k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d * S).det ≠ 0) :
    Submodule.span L (Set.range (coordinateForm L d (polynomialMatrixEval k a
      (matrixKernelChart (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d) S)))) = pointDegreePiece L a d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := polynomialMatrixEval k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d)
  let C := polynomialMatrixEval k a (matrixKernelChart (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d) S)
  let b := formsBasis L 3 d
  have hcoord (f : Forms L 3 d) : E.mulVecLin (b.equivFun f) = pointEvaluation L a d f := by
    exact pointPolynomialMatrix_coordinates k a f
  have hker : (LinearMap.ker E.mulVecLin).map b.equivFun.symm.toLinearMap =
      pointDegreePiece L a d := by
    ext f
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c,hc,rfl⟩
      change pointEvaluation L a d (b.equivFun.symm c) = 0
      rw [← hcoord, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hc
    · intro hf
      refine ⟨b.equivFun f, ?_, b.equivFun.symm_apply_apply f⟩
      change E.mulVecLin (b.equivFun f) = 0
      rw [hcoord]
      exact hf
  have hchart := (polynomial_kernel_chart_baseChange k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d) S hdet).1
  change LinearMap.range C.mulVecLin = LinearMap.ker E.mulVecLin at hchart
  rw [← hker, ← hchart, Matrix.range_mulVecLin, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_add_matrix_rank
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_add_matrix_rank (k : K →+* L) (a : PointCoordinates L p)
    (S : Matrix (Sym (Fin 3) d) (Fin p) (MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K))
    (hdet : eval₂ k a (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d * S).det ≠ 0) (e : ℕ) :
    choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) +
      (polynomialMatrixEval k a (kernelProductPolynomialMatrix
        (matrixKernelChart (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d) S) e)).rank =
      (d + e + 2).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [kernelProductPolynomialMatrix_rank, point_kernel_chart_columns_span k a S hdet,
    kernelProductSpace_eq_generatedProducts]
  have hh := (generatedProducts (d := d) (pointDegreeSpace L a d) e).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  rw [generated_finrank_eq_hilbertFunction _ (pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous a) e,
    finrank_plane_forms] at hh
  exact hh

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_extension_witnesses
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_extension_witnesses [Infinite K]
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (k : K →+* L)
    (S : Matrix (Sym (Fin 3) d) (Fin p) (MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K))
    (hQ : (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d * S).det ≠ 0)
    (e : J → ℕ) (a₀ : J → PointCoordinates L p)
    (hdet : ∀ j, eval₂ k (a₀ j) (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d * S).det ≠ 0) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K, (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d) ∧
        ∀ j, choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e j) ≤
          choppedHilbertFunction (a₀ j) d (d + e j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := pointPolynomialMatrix K p d
  let C := matrixKernelChart E S
  let F (j : J) := kernelProductPolynomialMatrix C (e j)
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hprop⟩ := polynomial_matrix_ranks_descent k F a₀ (E * S).det hQ
  refine ⟨D, hD, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨hQa,hrank⟩ := hprop a ha
  have hs := (polynomial_kernel_chart_baseChange (RingHom.id K) a E S hQa).2
  have hpoint : pointHilbertFunction K a d = p := by
    rw [← pointPolynomialMatrix_rank (RingHom.id K) a]
    change finrank K (LinearMap.range (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a E).mulVecLin) = p
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hs, finrank_top, finrank_pi, Fintype.card_fin]
  refine ⟨pointEvaluation_surjective_of_hilbert_eq a hpoint, ?_⟩
  intro j
  have hK := choppedHilbertFunction_add_matrix_rank (RingHom.id K) a S hQa (e j)
  have hL := choppedHilbertFunction_add_matrix_rank k (a₀ j) S (hdet j) (e j)
  have hr := hrank j
  change _ + (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a (F j)).rank = _ at hK
  change _ + (polynomialMatrixEval k (a₀ j) (F j)).rank = _ at hL
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_extension_witnesses_of_surjective
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_extension_witnesses_of_surjective [Infinite K]
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (k : K →+* L)
    (S : Matrix (Sym (Fin 3) d) (Fin p) (MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K))
    (hQ : (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d * S).det ≠ 0)
    (e : J → ℕ) (a₀ : J → PointCoordinates L p)
    (hsurj : ∀ j, Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation L (a₀ j) d)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K, (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d) ∧
        ∀ j, choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e j) ≤
          choppedHilbertFunction (a₀ j) d (d + e j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Infinite L := Infinite.of_injective k k.injective
  let Q := (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d * S).det
  have hQL : map k Q ≠ 0 := fun hz => hQ (MvPolynomial.map_injective k k.injective
    (by simpa only [map_zero] using hz))
  have hchoose (j : J) : ∃ b : PointCoordinates L p, eval₂ k b Q ≠ 0 ∧
      choppedHilbertFunction b d (d + e j) ≤ choppedHilbertFunction (a₀ j) d (d + e j) := by
    obtain ⟨D,hD,hupper⟩ := choppedHilbertFunction_principal_upper (a₀ j) (hsurj j) (e j)
    have hDne : D ≠ 0 := by intro hz; simp only [hz,map_zero,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false] at hD
    have hprod : map k Q * D ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hQL hDne
    have hex : ∃ b : PointCoordinates L p, eval b (map k Q * D) ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! hz
      exact hprod (MvPolynomial.funext hz)
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hex
    have hparts : eval b (map k Q) ≠ 0 ∧ eval b D ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [map_mul, mul_ne_zero_iff] using hb
    exact ⟨b, by simpa only [eval_map] using hparts.1, (hupper b hparts.2).2⟩
  choose b hb hle using hchoose
  obtain ⟨D,hD,hprop⟩ := choppedHilbertFunction_extension_witnesses k S hQ e b hb
  refine ⟨D,hD,fun a ha => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hs,hr⟩ := hprop a ha
  exact ⟨hs,fun j => (hr j).trans (hle j)⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_descend
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_descend [Infinite K]
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (k : K →+* L) (hp : p ≤ (d + 2).choose 2)
    (e : J → ℕ) (a₀ : J → PointCoordinates L p)
    (hsurj : ∀ j, Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation L (a₀ j) d)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K, (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d) ∧
        ∀ j, choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e j) ≤
          choppedHilbertFunction (a₀ j) d (d + e j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a,hha⟩ := exists_pointHilbertFunction_maximal (K := K) p d
  rw [min_eq_right hp] at hha
  have hs := pointEvaluation_surjective_of_hilbert_eq a hha
  obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := exists_matrix_kernel_chart (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d) a
    ((pointPolynomialMatrix_surjective_iff (RingHom.id K) a).mpr hs)
  have hQ : (pointPolynomialMatrix K p d * S).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz,map_zero] at hS
    exact zero_ne_one hS
  exact choppedHilbertFunction_extension_witnesses_of_surjective k S hQ e a₀ hsurj

name: ChoppedPlane.generatorSpace_le
statement:
theorem generatorSpace_le (q : Fin r → Forms K n d) :
    generatorSpace q ≤ Forms K n d
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact (q i).property

name: ChoppedPlane.multiplication_val
statement:
theorem multiplication_val (q : Fin r → Forms K n d) (a : Fin r → Forms K n e) :
    (multiplication q a).val = ∑ i, (q i).val * (a i).val
proof:
:= by
  simp [multiplication, mulForm]

name: ChoppedPlane.range_ambient_multiplication
statement:
theorem range_ambient_multiplication (q : Fin r → Forms K n d) :
    LinearMap.range ((Forms K n (d + e)).subtype.comp (multiplication q)) =
      generatorSpace q * Forms K n e
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro p ⟨a, rfl⟩
    change (multiplication q a).val ∈ _
    rw [multiplication_val]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i _
    exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩) (a i).property
  · apply Submodule.mul_le.mpr
    intro f hf a ha
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun K).mp hf
    refine ⟨fun i => c i • (⟨a, ha⟩ : Forms K n e), ?_⟩
    change (multiplication q (fun i => c i • (⟨a, ha⟩ : Forms K n e))).val = _
    simp [multiplication_val, Finset.sum_mul]

name: ChoppedPlane.range_multiplication
statement:
theorem range_multiplication (q : Fin r → Forms K n d) :
    LinearMap.range (multiplication (e := e) q) = generatedProducts (d := d) (generatorSpace q) e
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun P : Submodule K (Poly K n) =>
      P.comap (Forms K n (d + e)).subtype) (range_ambient_multiplication (e := e) q)
  rw [LinearMap.range_comp,
    Submodule.comap_map_eq_of_injective (Submodule.injective_subtype _)] at h
  exact h

name: ChoppedPlane.generatedHilbertFunction_add_rank
statement:
theorem generatedHilbertFunction_add_rank (q : Fin r → Forms K n d) :
    generatedHilbertFunction (generatorSpace q) (d + e) +
      finrank K (LinearMap.range (multiplication (e := e) q)) =
        finrank K (Forms K n (d + e))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← generated_finrank_eq_hilbertFunction _ (generatorSpace_le q) e,
    range_multiplication]
  exact (generatedProducts (d := d) (generatorSpace q) e).finrank_quotient_add_finrank

name: ChoppedPlane.multiplication_rank_le
statement:
theorem multiplication_rank_le (q : Fin r → Forms K n d) :
    finrank K (LinearMap.range (multiplication (e := e) q)) ≤
      r * finrank K (Forms K n e)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Module.finrank_pi_fintype] using
    LinearMap.finrank_range_le (multiplication (e := e) q)

name: ChoppedPlane.generatedHilbertFunction_lower_bound
statement:
theorem generatedHilbertFunction_lower_bound (q : Fin r → Forms K n d) :
    finrank K (Forms K n (d + e)) - r * finrank K (Forms K n e) ≤
      generatedHilbertFunction (generatorSpace q) (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  have h := generatedHilbertFunction_add_rank (e := e) q
  have h' := multiplication_rank_le (e := e) q
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileSquareDifferential_injective
statement:
theorem profileSquareDifferential_injective
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (r : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (operatorDifferential
      (gradedProfileOperators q .degreeThree (r : ℤ))
      (profileCriticalDegree .degreeThree r - 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply profileDifferential_injective q hq .degreeThree (r : ℤ)
    (profileCriticalDegree .degreeThree r - 1)
  intro k
  have hn : 0 < profileCriticalDegree .degreeThree r := by
    norm_num [profileCriticalDegree, profileRows, profileIndex]
    omega
  have he : ((profileCriticalDegree .degreeThree r - 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      (profileCriticalDegree .degreeThree r : ℤ) := by omega
  simpa [he, profileMultiplicity] using profile_square_degree_bound r k

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileSquare_matrix_dimensions
statement:
theorem profileSquare_matrix_dimensions (K : Type*) [Field K] (r : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank K (MatrixSource K (profileRows .degreeThree r+3)
      (profileCriticalDegree .degreeThree r-1)) =
    Module.finrank K (MatrixTarget K (profileRows .degreeThree r)
      (profileCriticalDegree .degreeThree r-1))
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · apply (matrixSource_le_target_iff K _ _ _).mpr
    norm_num [profileCriticalDegree, profileRows, profileIndex]
    have he : (2*(3*r+3)/3-1) = 2*r+1 := by omega
    rw [he]
    nlinarith
  · apply (matrixTarget_le_source_iff K _ _ _).mpr
    norm_num [profileCriticalDegree, profileRows, profileIndex]
    have he : (2*(3*r+3)/3-1) = 2*r+1 := by omega
    rw [he]
    nlinarith

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileSquareDifferential_surjective
statement:
theorem profileSquareDifferential_surjective
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (r : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential
      (gradedProfileOperators q .degreeThree (r : ℤ))
      (profileCriticalDegree .degreeThree r - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hinj := profileSquareDifferential_injective q hq r
  have hsurj := (operatorDifferential_injective_iff_linearMatrixMap_surjective
    (profileSourceBasis .degreeThree r) (profileTargetBasis .degreeThree r)
    (gradedProfileOperators q .degreeThree (r : ℤ))
    (profileCriticalDegree .degreeThree r-1)).mp hinj
  have hmatrixinj := (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank
    (profileSquare_matrix_dimensions K r)).mpr hsurj
  exact (operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_linearMatrixMap_injective
    (profileSourceBasis .degreeThree r) (profileTargetBasis .degreeThree r)
    (gradedProfileOperators q .degreeThree (r : ℤ))
    (profileCriticalDegree .degreeThree r-1)).mpr hmatrixinj

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.auxCoefficientBaseChange_coefficients
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxCoefficientBaseChange_coefficients (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] M) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    tensorCoefficients (auxCoefficientBaseChange T P) s = T (tensorCoefficients P s)
proof:
:=
  tensorCoefficients_baseChange T P s

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.auxCoefficientBaseChange_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxCoefficientBaseChange_tmul (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (m : M) :
    auxCoefficientBaseChange T (P ⊗ₜ[R] m) = MvPolynomial.map θ P ⊗ₜ[S] T m
proof:
:=
  tensorBaseChange_tmul T P m

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.auxCoefficientBaseChange_homogeneous
statement:
theorem auxCoefficientBaseChange_homogeneous (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    {n : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] M} (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    TensorHomogeneous n (auxCoefficientBaseChange T P)
proof: := tensorBaseChange_homogeneous T hP

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.map_linearForm
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_linearForm (θ : R →+* S) (f : Fin 3 → R) :
    MvPolynomial.map θ (linearForm f) = linearForm (fun i => θ (f i))
proof:
:= by
  simp [linearForm]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.map_linearChange
statement:
theorem map_linearChange (θ : R →+* S) (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (P : Aux R) :
    MvPolynomial.map θ (linearChange A P) =
      linearChange (A.map θ) (MvPolynomial.map θ P)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (MvPolynomial.map θ).comp (linearChange A).toRingHom =
      (linearChange (A.map θ)).toRingHom.comp (MvPolynomial.map θ) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro r
      change MvPolynomial.map θ (linearChange A (C r)) =
        linearChange (A.map θ) (MvPolynomial.map θ (C r))
      simp only [linearChange_C, map_C]
    · intro i
      change MvPolynomial.map θ (linearChange A (X i)) =
        linearChange (A.map θ) (MvPolynomial.map θ (X i))
      simp only [linearChange_X, map_X, map_linearForm]
      rfl
  exact congrArg (fun f : Aux R →+* Aux S => f P) h

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBaseChange_change
statement:
theorem tensorBaseChange_change (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorBaseChange T (FiniteCech.tensorChange A P) =
      FiniteCech.tensorChange (A.map θ) (tensorBaseChange T P)
proof:
:= by
  induction P using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul P m =>
    simp only [FiniteCech.tensorChange, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
      AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, tensorBaseChange_tmul, map_linearChange]
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp only [map_add, hP, hQ]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBaseChange_multiplyLinear
statement:
theorem tensorBaseChange_multiplyLinear (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (f : Fin 3 → R) (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorBaseChange T (FiniteCech.tensorMultiplyLinear f P) =
      FiniteCech.tensorMultiplyLinear (fun i => θ (f i)) (tensorBaseChange T P)
proof:
:= by
  induction P using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul P m =>
    simp only [FiniteCech.tensorMultiplyLinear, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
      LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, tensorBaseChange_tmul, map_mul, map_linearForm]
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp only [map_add, hP, hQ]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_baseChange
statement:
@[simp] theorem homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_baseChange (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (n : ℕ) (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector n (tensorBaseChange T P) =
      fun i => T (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector n P i)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  exact tensorCoefficients_baseChange T P _

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBaseChange_homogeneousSynthesis
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorBaseChange_homogeneousSynthesis (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (n : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) :
    tensorBaseChange T (homogeneousTensorSynthesis n c) =
      homogeneousTensorSynthesis n (fun i => T (c i))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [homogeneousTensorSynthesis, map_sum, tensorBaseChange_tmul,
    map_monomial, map_one]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteCoefficientBaseChange_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteCoefficientBaseChange_apply (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (n : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) (i : Sym (Fin 3) n) :
    finiteCoefficientBaseChange T n c i = T (c i)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteCross_baseChange
statement:
theorem finiteCross_baseChange (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (n : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) :
    finiteCoefficientBaseChange T n (finiteCross A n c) =
      finiteCross (A.map θ) n (finiteCoefficientBaseChange T n c)
proof:
:= by
  change (fun i => T (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector n
    (tensorChange A (homogeneousTensorSynthesis n c)) i)) = _
  rw [← homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_baseChange, tensorBaseChange_change,
    tensorBaseChange_homogeneousSynthesis]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteMultiply_baseChange
statement:
theorem finiteMultiply_baseChange (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (f : Fin 3 → R) (n : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) :
    finiteCoefficientBaseChange T (n + 1) (finiteMultiply f n c) =
      finiteMultiply (fun i => θ (f i)) n (finiteCoefficientBaseChange T n c)
proof:
:= by
  change (fun i => T (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (n + 1)
    (tensorMultiplyLinear f (homogeneousTensorSynthesis n c)) i)) = _
  rw [← homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_baseChange, tensorBaseChange_multiplyLinear,
    tensorBaseChange_homogeneousSynthesis]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteDirectional_baseChange
statement:
theorem finiteDirectional_baseChange (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (f : Fin 3 → R) (n : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) (n + 1) → M) :
    finiteCoefficientBaseChange T n (finiteDirectional f n c) =
      finiteDirectional (fun i => θ (f i)) n (finiteCoefficientBaseChange T (n + 1) c)
proof:
:= by
  change (fun i => T (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector n
    (tensorDirectional f (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (n + 1) c)) i)) = _
  rw [← homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_baseChange, tensorBaseChange_directional,
    tensorBaseChange_homogeneousSynthesis]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteCoefficientBaseChange_cross
statement:
theorem finiteCoefficientBaseChange_cross (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (n : ℕ) :
    (finiteCoefficientBaseChange T n).comp (finiteCross A n) =
      (finiteCross (A.map θ) n).comp (finiteCoefficientBaseChange T n)
proof:
:= by
  ext c i
  exact congrFun (finiteCross_baseChange T A n c) i

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteCoefficientBaseChange_multiply
statement:
theorem finiteCoefficientBaseChange_multiply (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (f : Fin 3 → R) (n : ℕ) :
    (finiteCoefficientBaseChange T (n + 1)).comp (finiteMultiply f n) =
      (finiteMultiply (fun i => θ (f i)) n).comp (finiteCoefficientBaseChange T n)
proof:
:= by
  ext c i
  exact congrFun (finiteMultiply_baseChange T f n c) i

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteCoefficientBaseChange_directional
statement:
theorem finiteCoefficientBaseChange_directional (T : M →ₛₗ[θ] N)
    (f : Fin 3 → R) (n : ℕ) :
    (finiteCoefficientBaseChange T n).comp (finiteDirectional f n) =
      (finiteDirectional (fun i => θ (f i)) n).comp (finiteCoefficientBaseChange T (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  ext c i
  exact congrFun (finiteDirectional_baseChange T f n c) i

name: ChoppedPlane.multiplyLinear_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem multiplyLinear_val (q : Forms K 3 1) (f : Forms K 3 t) :
    (multiplyLinear q f).val = q.val * f.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMap_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearMatrixMap_val (L : LinearMatrix K a c) (t : ℕ)
    (v : MatrixSource K c t) (i : Fin a) :
    (linearMatrixMap L t v i).val = ∑ j, (L i j).val * (v j).val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_matrixSource
statement:
theorem finrank_matrixSource (K : Type*) [Field K] (c t : ℕ) :
    finrank K (MatrixSource K c t) = c * (t + 2).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [MatrixSource, Module.finrank_pi_fintype, finrank_plane_forms]

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_matrixTarget
statement:
theorem finrank_matrixTarget (K : Type*) [Field K] (a t : ℕ) :
    finrank K (MatrixTarget K a t) = a * (t + 3).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [MatrixTarget, Module.finrank_pi_fintype, finrank_plane_forms, Nat.add_assoc]

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMap_multiplyVector
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMap_multiplyVector (L : LinearMatrix K a c)
    (q : Forms K 3 1) (v : MatrixSource K c t) :
    linearMatrixMap L (t + 1) (multiplyVector q v) =
      multiplyVector q (linearMatrixMap L t v)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [linearMatrixMap, multiplyVector, multiplyLinear, Finset.mul_sum,
    mul_left_comm]

name: ChoppedPlane.multiplyVector_injective
statement:
theorem multiplyVector_injective {b : ℕ} (q : Forms K 3 1) (hq : q.val ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (multiplyVector (b := b) (t := t) q)
proof:
:= by
  intro v w h
  funext i
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hq (congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun h i))

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMap_injective_of_succ
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMap_injective_of_succ (L : LinearMatrix K a c)
    (h : Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap L (t + 1))) :
    Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap L t)
proof:
:= by
  let q : Forms K 3 1 := ⟨X 0, isHomogeneous_X K 0⟩
  have hq : q.val ≠ 0 := X_ne_zero 0
  intro v w hvw
  apply multiplyVector_injective q hq
  apply h
  rw [linearMatrixMap_multiplyVector, linearMatrixMap_multiplyVector, hvw]

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMap_injective_downward
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMap_injective_downward (L : LinearMatrix K a c)
    {s t : ℕ} (hst : s ≤ t) (h : Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap L t)) :
    Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap L s)
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing s with
  | zero =>
    have hs : s = 0 := by omega
    subst s
    exact h
  | succ t ih =>
    by_cases hs : s = t + 1
    · subst s
      exact h
    · apply ih (by omega : s ≤ t)
      exact linearMatrixMap_injective_of_succ L h

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMap_surjective_succ
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMap_surjective_succ (L : LinearMatrix K a c)
    (h : Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L t)) :
    Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L (t + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsingle (i : Fin a) (p : Poly K 3) (hp : p ∈ Forms K 3 (t + 1 + 1)) :
      Pi.single i (⟨p, hp⟩ : Forms K 3 (t + 1 + 1)) ∈
        (linearMatrixMap L (t + 1)).range := by
    have heq : Forms K 3 1 * Forms K 3 (t + 1) = Forms K 3 (t + 1 + 1) := by
      simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using
        (forms_mul_forms (K := K) (n := 3) (d := 1) (e := t + 1))
    have hprod : p ∈ Forms K 3 1 * Forms K 3 (t + 1) := by rw [heq]; exact hp
    have hresult : ∀ q : Poly K 3, q ∈ Forms K 3 1 * Forms K 3 (t + 1) →
        ∀ hq : q ∈ Forms K 3 (t + 1 + 1),
          Pi.single i (⟨q, hq⟩ : Forms K 3 (t + 1 + 1)) ∈
            (linearMatrixMap L (t + 1)).range := by
      intro q hq
      refine Submodule.mul_induction_on'
        (M := Forms K 3 1) (N := Forms K 3 (t + 1))
        (C := fun q _ => ∀ hq : q ∈ Forms K 3 (t + 1 + 1),
          Pi.single i (⟨q, hq⟩ : Forms K 3 (t + 1 + 1)) ∈
            (linearMatrixMap L (t + 1)).range) ?_ ?_ hq
      · intro f hf g hg hfg
        obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h (Pi.single i (⟨g, hg⟩ : Forms K 3 (t + 1)))
        refine ⟨multiplyVector (⟨f, hf⟩ : Forms K 3 1) v, ?_⟩
        rw [linearMatrixMap_multiplyVector, hv]
        funext j
        apply Subtype.ext
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · subst j
          simp [multiplyVector, multiplyLinear]
        · simp [multiplyVector, multiplyLinear, hji]
      · intro q hq r hr hq_ih hr_ih hqr
        have hq' : q ∈ Forms K 3 (t + 1 + 1) := by rw [← heq]; exact hq
        have hr' : r ∈ Forms K 3 (t + 1 + 1) := by rw [← heq]; exact hr
        obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hq_ih hq'
        obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hr_ih hr'
        refine ⟨v + w, ?_⟩
        rw [map_add, hv, hw]
        funext j
        apply Subtype.ext
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · subst j
          simp
        · simp [hji]
    exact hresult p hprod hp
  intro y
  have hy : y ∈ (linearMatrixMap L (t + 1)).range := by
    have hsum := (linearMatrixMap L (t + 1)).range.sum_mem
      (t := Finset.univ) (f := fun i => Pi.single i (y i))
      (fun i _ => hsingle i (y i).val (y i).property)
    have heq : (∑ i : Fin a, Pi.single i (y i)) = y := by
      funext i
      simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    rwa [heq] at hsum
  exact hy

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMap_surjective_upward
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMap_surjective_upward (L : LinearMatrix K a c)
    {s t : ℕ} (hst : s ≤ t) (h : Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L s)) :
    Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t, hst using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact h
  | succ t hst ih => exact linearMatrixMap_surjective_succ L ih

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_injective
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_injective (L : LinearMatrix K a c) (t : ℕ)
    (h : Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap L t)) : LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:= by
  have hr := LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj h
  have hle := Submodule.finrank_le (linearMatrixMap L t).range
  rw [hr] at hle
  exact hr.trans (min_eq_left hle).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective (L : LinearMatrix K a c) (t : ℕ)
    (h : Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L t)) : LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:= by
  have hr : (linearMatrixMap L t).range = ⊤ := LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr h
  have hdim := LinearMap.finrank_range_le (linearMatrixMap L t)
  rw [hr, finrank_top] at hdim
  dsimp [LinearMatrixMaximalRank]
  rw [hr, finrank_top, min_eq_right hdim]

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_injective
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_injective (L : LinearMatrix K a c) (t : ℕ)
    (hsize : finrank K (MatrixSource K c t) ≤ finrank K (MatrixTarget K a t)) :
    LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t ↔ Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap L t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    dsimp [LinearMatrixMaximalRank] at h
    rw [min_eq_left hsize] at h
    have hk := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (linearMatrixMap L t)
    apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
    apply Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp
    omega
  · exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_injective L t

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_surjective
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_surjective (L : LinearMatrix K a c) (t : ℕ)
    (hsize : finrank K (MatrixTarget K a t) ≤ finrank K (MatrixSource K c t)) :
    LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t ↔ Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    dsimp [LinearMatrixMaximalRank] at h
    rw [min_eq_right hsize] at h
    apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
    exact Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq h
  · exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective L t

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff (L : LinearMatrix K a c) (t : ℕ) :
    LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t ↔
      Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap L t) ∨
        Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hs : finrank K (MatrixSource K c t) ≤ finrank K (MatrixTarget K a t)
    · exact Or.inl ((linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_injective L t hs).mp h)
    · exact Or.inr ((linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_surjective L t (by omega)).mp h)
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_injective L t h
    · exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective L t h

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_linearMatrixCokernel
statement:
theorem finrank_linearMatrixCokernel (L : LinearMatrix K a c) (t : ℕ)
    (h : LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t) :
    finrank K (LinearMatrixCokernel L t) =
      a * (t + 3).choose 2 - c * (t + 2).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  have hquot := (linearMatrixMap L t).range.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  dsimp [LinearMatrixMaximalRank] at h
  rw [h, finrank_matrixSource, finrank_matrixTarget] at hquot
  dsimp [LinearMatrixCokernel]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_two_checks
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_two_checks (L : LinearMatrix K a c)
    (t₀ : ℕ) (hinj : Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap L t₀))
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L (t₀ + 1))) :
    ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t ≤ t₀
  · exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_injective L t
      (linearMatrixMap_injective_downward L ht hinj)
  · exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective L t
      (linearMatrixMap_surjective_upward L (by omega) hsurj)

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_critical_checks
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_critical_checks (L : LinearMatrix K a c)
    (t₀ : ℕ)
    (hsmall : finrank K (MatrixSource K c t₀) ≤ finrank K (MatrixTarget K a t₀))
    (hlarge : finrank K (MatrixTarget K a (t₀ + 1)) ≤
      finrank K (MatrixSource K c (t₀ + 1)))
    (hleft : LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t₀)
    (hright : LinearMatrixMaximalRank L (t₀ + 1)) :
    ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:=
  linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_two_checks L t₀
    ((linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_injective L t₀ hsmall).mp hleft)
    ((linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_surjective L (t₀ + 1) hlarge).mp hright)

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_bijective
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_bijective (L : LinearMatrix K a c)
    (t₀ : ℕ) (h : Function.Bijective (linearMatrixMap L t₀)) :
    ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t ≤ t₀
  · exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_injective L t
      (linearMatrixMap_injective_downward L ht h.1)
  · exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective L t
      (linearMatrixMap_surjective_upward L (by omega) h.2)

name: ChoppedPlane.two_extra_columns_crossing
statement:
theorem two_extra_columns_crossing (K : Type*) [Field K] {a : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    finrank K (MatrixSource K (a + 2) (a - 1)) =
      finrank K (MatrixTarget K a (a - 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_matrixSource, finrank_matrixTarget]
  have h₁ : a - 1 + 2 = a + 1 := by omega
  have h₂ : a - 1 + 3 = a + 2 := by omega
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  have h := Nat.choose_mul_succ_eq (a + 1) 2
  have hsub : a + 1 + 1 - 2 = a := by omega
  simpa only [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.one_add, hsub, Nat.mul_comm] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_two_extra_columns
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_two_extra_columns
    (L : LinearMatrix K a (a + 2)) (ha : 0 < a)
    (h : Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap L (a - 1))) :
    ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:= by
  have hdim := two_extra_columns_crossing K ha
  have hmax := linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_injective L (a - 1) h
  have hsurj := (linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_surjective L (a - 1) hdim.ge).mp hmax
  exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_bijective L (a - 1) ⟨h, hsurj⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.matrixSource_le_target_iff
statement:
theorem matrixSource_le_target_iff (K : Type*) [Field K] (a c t : ℕ) :
    finrank K (MatrixSource K c t) ≤ finrank K (MatrixTarget K a t) ↔
      c * (t + 1) ≤ a * (t + 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_matrixSource, finrank_matrixTarget]
  have hpos : 0 < (t + 2).choose 2 := Nat.choose_pos (by omega)
  have hchoose : (t + 3).choose 2 * (t + 1) = (t + 2).choose 2 * (t + 3) := by
    have h := Nat.choose_mul_succ_eq (t + 2) 2
    have hsub : t + 2 + 1 - 2 = t + 1 := by omega
    simpa only [Nat.add_assoc, hsub] using h.symm
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (t + 1) h
    have h' : c * (t + 1) * (t + 2).choose 2 ≤
        a * (t + 3) * (t + 2).choose 2 := by
      calc
        c * (t + 1) * (t + 2).choose 2 = c * (t + 2).choose 2 * (t + 1) := by ring
        _ ≤ a * (t + 3).choose 2 * (t + 1) := hmul
        _ = a * ((t + 3).choose 2 * (t + 1)) := by ring
        _ = a * ((t + 2).choose 2 * (t + 3)) := by rw [hchoose]
        _ = a * (t + 3) * (t + 2).choose 2 := by ring
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right h' hpos
  · intro h
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ((t + 2).choose 2) h
    have h' : c * (t + 2).choose 2 * (t + 1) ≤
        a * (t + 3).choose 2 * (t + 1) := by
      calc
        c * (t + 2).choose 2 * (t + 1) = c * (t + 1) * (t + 2).choose 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ a * (t + 3) * (t + 2).choose 2 := hmul
        _ = a * ((t + 2).choose 2 * (t + 3)) := by ring
        _ = a * ((t + 3).choose 2 * (t + 1)) := by rw [hchoose]
        _ = a * (t + 3).choose 2 * (t + 1) := by ring
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right h' (by omega)

name: ChoppedPlane.matrixTarget_le_source_iff
statement:
theorem matrixTarget_le_source_iff (K : Type*) [Field K] (a c t : ℕ) :
    finrank K (MatrixTarget K a t) ≤ finrank K (MatrixSource K c t) ↔
      a * (t + 3) ≤ c * (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_matrixSource K c t, finrank_matrixTarget K a t]
  have hpos : 0 < (t + 2).choose 2 := Nat.choose_pos (by omega)
  have hchoose : (t + 3).choose 2 * (t + 1) = (t + 2).choose 2 * (t + 3) := by
    have h := Nat.choose_mul_succ_eq (t + 2) 2
    have hsub : t + 2 + 1 - 2 = t + 1 := by omega
    simpa only [Nat.add_assoc, hsub] using h.symm
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (t + 1) h
    have h' : a * (t + 3) * (t + 2).choose 2 ≤
        c * (t + 1) * (t + 2).choose 2 := by
      calc
        a * (t + 3) * (t + 2).choose 2 = a * ((t + 2).choose 2 * (t + 3)) := by ring
        _ = a * ((t + 3).choose 2 * (t + 1)) := by rw [hchoose]
        _ = a * (t + 3).choose 2 * (t + 1) := by ring
        _ ≤ c * (t + 2).choose 2 * (t + 1) := hmul
        _ = c * (t + 1) * (t + 2).choose 2 := by ring
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right h' hpos
  · intro h
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ((t + 2).choose 2) h
    have h' : a * (t + 3).choose 2 * (t + 1) ≤
        c * (t + 2).choose 2 * (t + 1) := by
      calc
        a * (t + 3).choose 2 * (t + 1) = a * ((t + 3).choose 2 * (t + 1)) := by ring
        _ = a * ((t + 2).choose 2 * (t + 3)) := by rw [hchoose]
        _ = a * (t + 3) * (t + 2).choose 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ c * (t + 1) * (t + 2).choose 2 := hmul
        _ = c * (t + 2).choose 2 * (t + 1) := by ring
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right h' (by omega)

name: ChoppedPlane.criticalTwist_target_le_source
statement:
theorem criticalTwist_target_le_source (K : Type*) [Field K] {a c : ℕ} (hac : a < c) :
    finrank K (MatrixTarget K a (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c)) ≤
      finrank K (MatrixSource K c (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixTarget_le_source_iff]
  have hpos : 0 < c - a := by omega
  have hbound := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (2 * a) hpos
  have hc : c = a + (c - a) := by omega
  dsimp [linearMatrixCriticalTwist]
  nlinarith

name: ChoppedPlane.before_criticalTwist_source_le_target
statement:
theorem before_criticalTwist_source_le_target (K : Type*) [Field K] {a c : ℕ}
    (hac : a < c) (hpos : 0 < linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c) :
    finrank K (MatrixSource K c (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c - 1)) ≤
      finrank K (MatrixTarget K a (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c - 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixSource_le_target_iff]
  have hbound := Nat.div_mul_le_self (2 * a) (c - a)
  have hc : c = a + (c - a) := by omega
  have hsub : linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c - 1 + 1 = linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c := by omega
  rw [hsub]
  have hsub' : linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c - 1 + 3 = linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c + 2 := by omega
  rw [hsub']
  dsimp [linearMatrixCriticalTwist] at *
  nlinarith

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_numeric_critical_checks
statement:
theorem linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_numeric_critical_checks
    (L : LinearMatrix K a c) (hac : a < c)
    (hleft : 0 < linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c →
      LinearMatrixMaximalRank L (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c - 1))
    (hright : LinearMatrixMaximalRank L (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c)) :
    ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : 0 < linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c
  · have hlarge := criticalTwist_target_le_source K hac
    have hsmall := before_criticalTwist_source_le_target K hac hq
    have hsucc : linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c - 1 + 1 = linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c := by omega
    apply linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_critical_checks L
      (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c - 1) hsmall
    · rwa [hsucc]
    · exact hleft hq
    · rwa [hsucc]
  · have hzero : linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c = 0 := by omega
    have hlarge := criticalTwist_target_le_source K hac
    have hsurj := (linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_surjective L
      (linearMatrixCriticalTwist a c) hlarge).mp hright
    rw [hzero] at hsurj
    intro t
    exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective L t
      (linearMatrixMap_surjective_upward L (Nat.zero_le t) hsurj)

name: ChoppedPlane.IsPolynomialFamily.sub
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, sub_eq_add_neg] using
    hf.add (hg.linear_comp (-LinearMap.id))

name: ChoppedPlane.isPolynomialFamily_matrix_toLin
statement:
theorem isPolynomialFamily_matrix_toLin
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (bV : Basis n K V) (bU : Basis m K U)
    (P : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun a => Matrix.toLin bV bU (P.map (eval a)))
proof:
:= by
  apply isPolynomialFamily_linearMap
  intro x
  have hterm (i : m) (j : n) :
      IsPolynomialFamily (fun a => (eval a (P i j) * bV.repr x j) • bU i) := by
    have h := (isPolynomialFamily_eval (P i j * C (bV.repr x j))).smul
      (isPolynomialFamily_const (bU i))
    have heq : (fun a : ι → K => eval a (P i j * C (bV.repr x j)) • bU i) =
        (fun a => (eval a (P i j) * bV.repr x j) • bU i) := by
      funext a
      rw [eval_mul, eval_C]
    rw [heq] at h
    exact h
  have h := IsPolynomialFamily.sum (fun i => IsPolynomialFamily.sum (hterm i))
  simpa only [Matrix.toLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply,
    Finset.sum_smul] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_matrix_representation
statement:
theorem polynomial_matrix_representation [FiniteDimensional K V]
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (bV : Basis n K V) (bU : Basis m K U)
    (E : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] U)) (hE : IsPolynomialFamily E) :
    ∃ P : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K),
      ∀ a, P.map (eval a) = LinearMap.toMatrix bV bU (E a)
proof:
:= by
  have hpoly (i : m) (j : n) :=
    (hE.linear_comp (LinearMap.applyₗ (R := K) (M₂ := U) (bV j))).linear_comp (bU.coord i)
  choose p hp using fun i j => hpoly i j LinearMap.id
  let P : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K) := p
  refine ⟨P, fun a => ?_⟩
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.map_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  simpa only [P, LinearMap.id_apply, LinearMap.applyₗ_apply_apply, Basis.coord_apply] using hp i j a

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_kernel_chart
statement:
theorem polynomial_kernel_chart [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K U]
    (E : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] U)) (hE : IsPolynomialFamily E)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hsurj : Function.Surjective (E a₀)) :
    ∃ (D : MvPolynomial ι K) (C : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] V)),
      IsPolynomialFamily C ∧ eval a₀ D = 1 ∧
      (∀ a, LinearMap.range (C a) ≤ LinearMap.ker (E a)) ∧
      (∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → LinearMap.range (C a) = LinearMap.ker (E a) ∧
        Function.Surjective (E a)) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ LinearMap.ker (E a₀) → C a₀ v = v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := (E a₀).exists_rightInverse_of_surjective
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj)
  let b := Module.finBasis K U
  have hEL : IsPolynomialFamily (fun a => (E a).comp L) := by
    apply isPolynomialFamily_linearMap
    intro x
    exact hE.linear_comp (LinearMap.applyₗ (R := K) (M₂ := U) (L x))
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := polynomial_matrix_representation b b
    (fun a => (E a).comp L) hEL
  let D : MvPolynomial ι K := P.det
  let R (a : ι → K) : U →ₗ[K] U := Matrix.toLin b b (P.adjugate.map (eval a))
  let C (a : ι → K) : V →ₗ[K] V :=
    (eval a D) • LinearMap.id - L.comp ((R a).comp (E a))
  have hR : IsPolynomialFamily R := isPolynomialFamily_matrix_toLin b b P.adjugate
  have hRE : IsPolynomialFamily (fun a => (R a).comp (E a)) :=
    hR.bilinear hE (LinearMap.llcomp K V U U)
  have hC : IsPolynomialFamily C := by
    apply (isPolynomialFamily_eval D).smul (isPolynomialFamily_const LinearMap.id) |>.sub
    exact hRE.linear_comp ((LinearMap.llcomp K V U V) L)
  have hD (a : ι → K) : eval a D = (LinearMap.toMatrix b b ((E a).comp L)).det := by
    dsimp [D]
    rw [(eval a).map_det]
    change (P.map (eval a)).det = _
    rw [hP]
  have hD₀ : eval a₀ D = 1 := by
    rw [hD, hL]
    simp
  have hcomp (a : ι → K) : ((E a).comp L).comp (R a) =
      (eval a D) • LinearMap.id := by
    change ((E a).comp L).comp (Matrix.toLin b b (P.adjugate.map (eval a))) = _
    have hadj : P.adjugate.map (eval a) = (P.map (eval a)).adjugate :=
      (eval a).map_adjugate P
    rw [hadj, hP]
    have hs := congrArg (Matrix.toLin b b)
      (Matrix.mul_adjugate (LinearMap.toMatrix b b ((E a).comp L)))
    rw [Matrix.toLin_mul b b b, Matrix.toLin_toMatrix, map_smul, Matrix.toLin_one,
      ← hD] at hs
    exact hs
  have hker (a : ι → K) : LinearMap.range (C a) ≤ LinearMap.ker (E a) := by
    rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    change E a (C a v) = 0
    have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun (hcomp a) (E a v)
    simpa only [C, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, map_sub, map_smul, sub_eq_zero] using hc.symm
  have hfix (a : ι → K) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ LinearMap.ker (E a)) :
      C a v = (eval a D) • v := by
    have hz : E a v = 0 := hv
    simp [C, hz]
  refine ⟨D, C, hC, hD₀, hker, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha
    constructor
    · apply le_antisymm (hker a)
      intro v hv
      refine ⟨(eval a D)⁻¹ • v, ?_⟩
      rw [map_smul, hfix a v hv, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]
    · intro u
      refine ⟨(eval a D)⁻¹ • L (R a u), ?_⟩
      have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun (hcomp a) u
      simpa only [map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        LinearMap.id_apply, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul] using
        congrArg ((eval a D)⁻¹ • ·) hc
  · intro v hv
    rw [hfix a₀ v hv, hD₀, one_smul]

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProduct_surjective_principal_open
statement:
theorem kernelProduct_surjective_principal_open
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K U]
    [FiniteDimensional K W] [FiniteDimensional K T]
    (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] T)
    (E : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] U)) (hE : IsPolynomialFamily E)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hsurj : Function.Surjective (E a₀)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (E a) ∧
        finrank K (LinearMap.ker (E a)) = finrank K (LinearMap.ker (E a₀)) ∧
        finrank K (kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a₀))) ≤
          finrank K (kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D₀, C, hC, hD₀, hker, hchart, hfix⟩ := polynomial_kernel_chart E hE a₀ hsurj
  have hD₀ne : eval a₀ D₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [hD₀]; exact one_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁, hprod⟩ := kernelProduct_range_polynomial_principal_open
    B E C hC hker a₀ (hchart a₀ hD₀ne).1
  refine ⟨D₀ * D₁, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [map_mul] using mul_ne_zero hD₀ne hD₁
  · intro a ha
    have hparts : eval a D₀ ≠ 0 ∧ eval a D₁ ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [map_mul, mul_ne_zero_iff] using ha
    have hs := (hchart a hparts.1).2
    refine ⟨hs, ?_, hprod a hparts.2⟩
    have h₀ := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (E a₀)
    have h₁ := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (E a)
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj, finrank_top] at h₀
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hs, finrank_top] at h₁
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.rowMatrixVal_ferrers
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowMatrixVal_ferrers (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : Ferrers.RootIndex δ → K) :
    rowMatrixVal δ (ferrersHomogeneousRowMatrix δ α β) = Ferrers.seedMatrix δ α β
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowMatrix_primitive_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalRowMatrix_primitive_principal_open
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hdegree : 0 < ∑ i, δ i)
    (α β : Ferrers.RootIndex δ → K) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      eval (rowMatrixCoordinates δ (ferrersHomogeneousRowMatrix δ α β)) D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a₀ := rowMatrixCoordinates δ (ferrersHomogeneousRowMatrix δ α β)
  let j : Fin 2 → Fin (c + 1) := fun i => if i = 0 then Fin.last c else 0
  let g : Fin 2 → Poly K 3 := fun i => if i = 0 then Ferrers.rowFirst δ α (Fin.last c)
    else Ferrers.rowSecond δ β 0
  have hg (i : Fin 2) : (g i).IsHomogeneous (δ (j i)) := by
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · simpa [g, j, hi] using Ferrers.rowFirst_homogeneous δ α (Fin.last c)
    · simpa [g, j, hi] using Ferrers.rowSecond_homogeneous δ β 0
  let q : (RowMatrixParameter δ → K) → Fin 2 → Forms K 3 (∑ i, δ i) :=
    fun u i => ⟨signedMaximalMinor (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) (j i) * g i,
      by
        change (signedMaximalMinor (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) (j i) * g i).IsHomogeneous _
        have hh := (universalRowCofactorForm δ u (j i)).property.mul (hg i)
        have hle : δ (j i) ≤ ∑ i, δ i := Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ _)
        simpa only [universalRowCofactorForm, Nat.sub_add_cancel hle] using hh⟩
  have hpoly : IsPolynomialFamily q := by
    apply IsPolynomialFamily.finite_pi
    intro i
    let P : Poly K 3 →ₗ[K] Forms K 3 (∑ i, δ i) :=
      (homogeneousComponent (∑ i, δ i)).codRestrict _ (homogeneousComponent_mem _)
    have h := ((universalSignedCofactor_isPolynomialFamily (K := K) δ (j i)).linear_comp
      (polynomialMulRight 3 (g i))).linear_comp P
    convert h using 1
    funext u
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (homogeneousComponent_eq_self (q u i).property).symm
  have hq : ∀ u i, (q u i).val ∈ cofactorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) := by
    intro u i
    apply Ideal.mul_mem_right
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j i, rfl⟩
  have hq₀ : (q a₀ 0).val =
      (-1 : Poly K 3) ^ c * ∏ i, Ferrers.rowFirst δ α i := by
    simp only [q, a₀, j, g, ite_eq_left rfl, universalRowMatrix_coordinates,
      rowMatrixVal_ferrers, signedMaximalMinor, Fin.val_last, maximalMinor,
      Ferrers.seedMatrix_deletedRow_det, Ferrers.cofactorProduct_last]
    rw [mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => i < Fin.last c) =
        Finset.univ.erase (Fin.last c) := by
      ext i
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_erase,
        and_true, ne_eq]
      exact lt_iff_le_and_ne.trans (by simp [Fin.le_last])
    rw [hfilter, Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  have hq₁ : (q a₀ 1).val = ∏ i, Ferrers.rowSecond δ β i := by
    simp only [q, a₀, j, g, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, ite_false,
      universalRowMatrix_coordinates, rowMatrixVal_ferrers, signedMaximalMinor,
      Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, maximalMinor,
      Ferrers.seedMatrix_deletedRow_det, Ferrers.cofactorProduct_zero]
    have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => (0 : Fin (c + 1)) < i) =
        Finset.univ.erase 0 := by
      ext i
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_erase,
        and_true, ne_eq]
      exact lt_iff_le_and_ne.trans (by simp [ne_comm])
    rw [hfilter, Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  have hcop : IsRelPrime (q a₀ 0).val (q a₀ 1).val := by
    rw [hq₀, hq₁]
    apply (isRelPrime_mul_unit_left_left ((isUnit_neg_one : IsUnit (-1 : Poly K 3)).pow _)).mpr
    exact Ferrers.firstProducts_relPrime_secondProducts δ α β _ _
  have hnonzero : (q a₀ 0).val ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hq₀]
    apply mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero))
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro i hi hz
    have h := congrArg (eval ![1,0,0]) hz
    simp [Ferrers.rowFirst] at h
  exact primitiveMaximalMinors_principal_open_of_ideal_pair
    (fun u => rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) q hpoly hq
    hdegree a₀ hnonzero hcop

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowMatrix_primitive_cut_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalRowMatrix_primitive_cut_principal_open
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hdegree : 0 < ∑ i, δ i)
    (α β : Ferrers.RootIndex δ → K) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      eval (rowMatrixCoordinates δ (ferrersHomogeneousRowMatrix δ α β)) D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) ∧
        PrimitiveMaximalMinors (universalInfinityMatrix δ u) ∧
        ∀ f : Forms K 2 (2 * ∑ i, δ i),
          f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal (universalInfinityMatrix δ u)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hprim⟩ := universalRowMatrix_primitive_principal_open δ hdegree α β
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hcut⟩ := universalInfinity_degree_cut_principal_open δ
    (2 * ∑ i, δ i) (ferrersHomogeneousRowMatrix δ α β) (by
      simpa only [rowMatrixVal_ferrers] using
        Ferrers.seed_infinity_gradedCofactorMap_surjective δ α β)
  refine ⟨G * H, by simpa only [map_mul] using mul_ne_zero hG hH, fun u hu => ?_⟩
  have hparts := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simpa only [map_mul] using hu)
  have hbinary : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (universalInfinityMatrix δ u) := by
    apply primitiveMaximalMinors_of_binary_degree_cut _ _
      (fun f => hcut u hparts.2 f) Ferrers.binary_X_relPrime
  exact ⟨hprim u hparts.1, hbinary, hcut u hparts.2⟩
