name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.chartDirectional_gradedDual
statement:
theorem chartDirectional_gradedDual (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) (n+1) → GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s) r) :
    chartFiniteDirectional binaryChartLaurentMap q hq s n
      (fun b => gradedChartEmbedding (dualGeneratorWeights s) r (c b)) =
    fun b => gradedChartEmbedding (dualGeneratorWeights s) (r+1)
      (operatorDifferential (gradedProfileDualOperators q s r) n c b)
proof:
:= by
  letI := chartDualModuleStructure (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) q hq s
  letI := cyclicModuleScalarTower (K := K)
    (binaryChartLaurentMap (binaryCubic K))
    (chartDualZ binaryChartLaurentMap q s)
    (chartDualZ_cube binaryChartLaurentMap q hq s)
  have hact (i : Fin 3)
      (m : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s) r) :
      scalarAction (K := K) (chartLinearForm (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) i)
        (gradedChartEmbedding (dualGeneratorWeights s) r m) =
      gradedChartEmbedding (dualGeneratorWeights s) (r+1)
        (gradedProfileDualOperators q s r i m) := by
    rw [scalarAction_apply]
    fin_cases i
    · change cyclicCoefficientHom _ (binaryChartLaurentMap (binaryU K)) • _ = _
      rw [cyclicModule_coefficient_smul]
      funext j
      simp [gradedChartEmbedding_apply, gradedProfileDualOperators,
        gradedBinaryMultiply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        binaryChartLaurentMap_eq_binaryLaurentEmbedding]
    · change cyclicCoefficientHom _ (binaryChartLaurentMap (binaryV K)) • _ = _
      rw [cyclicModule_coefficient_smul]
      funext j
      simp [gradedChartEmbedding_apply, gradedProfileDualOperators,
        gradedBinaryMultiply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        binaryChartLaurentMap_eq_binaryLaurentEmbedding]
    · change cyclicRoot _ • _ = _
      rw [cyclicModule_root_smul]
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;>
        simp [chartDualZ, cyclicZDual, gradedChartEmbedding_apply,
          gradedProfileDualOperators, gradedProfileZDual,
          gradedBinaryVectorVal, binaryChartLaurentMap_eq_binaryLaurentEmbedding]
  change finiteDirectional (chartLinearForm binaryChartLaurentMap) n
      (fun b => gradedChartEmbedding (dualGeneratorWeights s) r (c b)) = _
  rw [finiteDirectional_eq_operatorDifferential (K := K)]
  funext b
  simp only [operatorDifferential_coeff, map_sum, map_smul, hact]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileLaurentDirectional_positive_kernel_zero
statement:
theorem profileLaurentDirectional_positive_kernel_zero
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (operatorDifferential (gradedProfileDualOperators q s r) n))
    (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × Sym (Fin 3) (n+1)))
    (hp : p ∈ positiveGrade (auxiliaryDualWeights s (n+1)) r)
    (hd : profileLaurentDirectional q hq s n p = 0) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  let p' : positiveGrade (K := K)
      (fun i : Fin 3 × Sym (Fin 3) (n+1) => (dualGeneratorWeights s i.1 : ℤ)) r := ⟨p,hp⟩
  let c := fun b => (gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s) r).symm
    (positiveGradeSplit (fun i => (dualGeneratorWeights s i : ℤ)) r p' b)
  have hemb : auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv p =
      fun b => gradedChartEmbedding (dualGeneratorWeights s) r (c b) := by
    funext b
    apply (freeLaurentEquiv (K := K) (ι := Fin 3)).symm.injective
    have hc := (gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s) r).apply_symm_apply
      (positiveGradeSplit (fun i => (dualGeneratorWeights s i : ℤ)) r p' b)
    have hcval := congrArg Subtype.val hc
    change binaryVectorLaurent (gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) r (c b)) =
      splitFreeLaurentEquiv p b at hcval
    simp only [gradedChartEmbedding, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [hcval]
    ext e
    rw [auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_component_coeff, splitFreeLaurentEquiv_apply]
  have hcder : operatorDifferential (gradedProfileDualOperators q s r) n c = 0 := by
    have hraw := congrArg auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv hd
    rw [auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv_profileLaurentDirectional, hemb,
      chartDirectional_gradedDual] at hraw
    funext b
    apply gradedChartEmbedding_injective (dualGeneratorWeights s) (r+1)
    simpa only [map_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hraw b
  have hc0 : c = 0 := hinj (hcder.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  apply auxiliaryLaurentVectorEquiv.injective
  rw [hemb, hc0]
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply, map_zero]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileLaurentDirectional_critical_kernel_zero
statement:
theorem profileLaurentDirectional_critical_kernel_zero [CharZero K]
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r n : ℕ)
    (hn : profileCriticalDegree s r = n+1)
    (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3 × Sym (Fin 3) (n+1)))
    (hp : p ∈ positiveGrade (auxiliaryDualWeights s (n+1))
      (((n+1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (r : ℤ)))
    (hd : profileLaurentDirectional q hq s n p = 0) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply profileLaurentDirectional_positive_kernel_zero q hq s _ n _ p hp hd
  apply profileDualDifferential_injective q hq s
    (((n+1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (r : ℤ)) n
  intro i
  have hm : (profileMultiplicity s : ℤ) = 3 - (profileIndex s : ℤ) := by
    cases s <;> rfl
  simpa only [hm, hn] using profile_left_dual_degree_bound s r i

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cubic_scalar_free_expansion
statement:
theorem cubic_scalar_free_expansion :
    let
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure F Z hZ
    ∀ (r : Cubic) (m : BinaryVector K) (i : Fin 3),
      (r • m) i = ∑ k : Fin 3, (r • (Pi.single k 1 : BinaryVector K)) i * m k := by
  dsimp only
  let := cyclicModuleStructure F Z hZ
  intro r m i
  classical
  let T := cyclicActionHom F Z hZ r
  have hm : m = ∑ k : Fin 3, m k • Pi.single k 1 := by
    funext j
    simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  change T m i = _
  conv_lhs => rw [hm]
  simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.map_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.symmetric_kernel_zero_of_weighted_columns
statement:
theorem symmetric_kernel_zero_of_weighted_columns :
    let
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure F Z hZ
    ∀ (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (t : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) Cubic)
    (_hcolumn : ∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)) (k : Fin 3) (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3),
      tensorCoefficients
        ((linearForm (A 1) ^ j.val * linearForm (A 2) ^ (n - j.val)) ⊗ₜ[Cubic]
          (Pi.single k 1 : BinaryVector K)) α i ∈
        signedForms K 2 (2 * (n : ℤ) + (w k : ℤ) - w i))
    (_ht : ∀ k : Fin 3, t < 2 * (n : ℤ) + (w k : ℤ))
    (P : AuxTensor (R := Cubic) (M := BinaryVector K))
    (_hP : ∀ (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3),
      tensorCoefficients P α i ∈ signedForms K 2 (t - w i))
    (c : Fin (n + 1) → BinaryVector K), kernelSynthesis A n c = P → P = 0 := by
  dsimp only
  let := cyclicModuleStructure F Z hZ
  intro w t n A hcolumn ht P hP c hc
  classical
  apply tensorCoefficients.injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_zero]
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro α
  funext i
  let Bα : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (n + 1) × Fin 3) (BinaryRing K) :=
    fun i jk => tensorCoefficients
      ((linearForm (A 1) ^ jk.1.val * linearForm (A 2) ^ (n - jk.1.val)) ⊗ₜ[Cubic]
        (Pi.single jk.2 1 : BinaryVector K)) α i
  have heq : Bα.mulVec (fun jk => c jk.1 jk.2) = tensorCoefficients P α := by
    funext i
    rw [← hc]
    simp only [kernelSynthesis]
    simp only [tensorCoefficients_sum, Finset.sum_apply, tensorCoefficients_tmul]
    dsimp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Bα]
    simp only [tensorCoefficients_tmul]
    change ∑ jk : Fin (n + 1) × Fin 3,
      _ = ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), _
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    exact (cubic_scalar_free_expansion F Z hZ
      ((linearForm (A 1) ^ j.val * linearForm (A 2) ^ (n - j.val)).coeff α) (c j) i).symm
  have hz : tensorCoefficients P α = 0 :=
    ChoppedPlane.weighted_homogeneous_vector_zero_of_lower_degree
      Bα (fun i => (w i : ℤ)) (fun jk => 2 * (n : ℤ) + (w jk.2 : ℤ)) t
      (fun i jk => hcolumn jk.1 jk.2 α i)
      (fun jk => ht jk.2)
      (tensorCoefficients P α) (hP α) (fun jk => c jk.1 jk.2) heq
  exact congrFun hz i

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorCoefficients_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorCoefficients_tmul (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (m : M) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    tensorCoefficients (P ⊗ₜ[R] m) s = P.coeff s • m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change TensorProduct.finsuppScalarLeft R M (σ →₀ ℕ)
    ((basisMonomials σ R).repr P ⊗ₜ[R] m) s = _
  rw [TensorProduct.finsuppScalarLeft_apply_tmul_apply]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorCoefficients_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorCoefficients_monomial (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (m : M) :
    tensorCoefficients ((monomial s 1 : MvPolynomial σ R) ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      Finsupp.single s m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext t
  simp [coeff_monomial, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_smul]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorCoefficients_symm_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorCoefficients_symm_single (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (m : M) :
    tensorCoefficients.symm (Finsupp.single s m) =
      (monomial s 1 : MvPolynomial σ R) ⊗ₜ[R] m
proof:
:= by
  apply tensorCoefficients.injective
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorCoefficients_sum
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorCoefficients_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (P : ι → MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] M) (α : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    tensorCoefficients (∑ j ∈ s, P j) α = ∑ j ∈ s, tensorCoefficients (P j) α
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_as_sum_monomials
statement:
theorem tensor_as_sum_monomials (P : MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] M) :
    P = (tensorCoefficients P).sum (fun s m => (monomial s 1) ⊗ₜ[R] m)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (tensorCoefficients P).sum (fun s m => Finsupp.single s m) =
      tensorCoefficients P := Finsupp.sum_single _
  apply_fun (tensorCoefficients (R := R) (M := M) (σ := σ)).symm at h
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, tensorCoefficients_symm_single,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at h
  exact h.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorCoefficients_component
statement:
theorem tensorCoefficients_component (n : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] M)
    (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    tensorCoefficients ((homogeneousComponent n).rTensor M P) s =
      if s.degree = n then tensorCoefficients P s else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction P using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul P m => simp [coeff_homogeneousComponent, ite_smul]
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp [hP, hQ, ite_add_ite]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients
statement:
theorem tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients (n : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] M) :
    TensorHomogeneous n P ↔ ∀ s : σ →₀ ℕ, s.degree ≠ n → tensorCoefficients P s = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hP s hs
    have h := congrArg (fun Q => tensorCoefficients Q s) hP
    rw [tensorCoefficients_component, ite_eq_right hs] at h
    exact h.symm
  · intro h
    apply tensorCoefficients.injective
    ext s
    rw [tensorCoefficients_component]
    split_ifs with hs
    · rfl
    · exact (h s hs).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryExponent_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryExponent_zero (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    binaryExponent n j 0 = j.val
proof: := by simp [binaryExponent]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryExponent_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryExponent_one (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    binaryExponent n j 1 = n - j.val
proof: := by simp [binaryExponent]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryExponent_degree
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryExponent_degree (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (binaryExponent n j).degree = n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [binaryExponent, map_add, Finsupp.degree_single]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryExponent_injective
statement: theorem binaryExponent_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (binaryExponent n)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  apply Fin.ext
  simpa using congrArg (fun s : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => s 0) h

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binary_degree
statement: theorem binary_degree (s : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) : s.degree = s 0 + s 1
proof:
:= by
  change s.sum (fun _ n => n) = _
  rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype]
  · simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  · simp

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.exists_binaryExponent
statement:
theorem exists_binaryExponent (n : ℕ) (s : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (hs : s.degree = n) :
    ∃ j : Fin (n + 1), binaryExponent n j = s
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : s 0 + s 1 = n := (binary_degree s).symm.trans hs
  refine ⟨⟨s 0, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · simp
  · change binaryExponent n ⟨s 0, _⟩ (1 : Fin 2) = s 1
    rw [binaryExponent_one]
    change n - s 0 = s 1
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryCoefficients_synthesis
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryCoefficients_synthesis (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    binaryCoefficients n (binarySynthesis (R := R) n c) = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext j
  simp only [binaryCoefficients, binarySynthesis, map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
    tensorCoefficients_monomial, Finsupp.single_apply]
  simp only [(binaryExponent_injective n).eq_iff, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
    Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binarySynthesis_homogeneous
statement:
theorem binarySynthesis_homogeneous (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    TensorHomogeneous n (binarySynthesis (R := R) n c)
proof:
:= by
  apply (tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients n _).mpr
  intro s hs
  classical
  simp only [binarySynthesis, map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
    tensorCoefficients_monomial, Finsupp.single_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j hj
  have h : binaryExponent n j ≠ s := by
    intro heq
    exact hs (heq ▸ binaryExponent_degree n j)
  simp [h]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binarySynthesis_coefficients
statement:
theorem binarySynthesis_coefficients (n : ℕ) (P : BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M))
    (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    binarySynthesis n (binaryCoefficients n P) = P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply tensorCoefficients.injective
  ext s
  by_cases hs : s.degree = n
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := exists_binaryExponent n s hs
    exact congrFun (binaryCoefficients_synthesis n (binaryCoefficients n P)) j
  · rw [(tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients n _).mp
      (binarySynthesis_homogeneous n _) s hs,
      (tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients n _).mp hP s hs]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.directional_apply
statement:
theorem directional_apply (f : Fin 3 → R) (P : Aux R) :
    directional f P = ∑ i, f i • pderiv i P
proof:
:= by
  have hlin := congrArg Derivation.toLinearMap (directional_eq_sum f)
  rw [Derivation.coe_sum_linearMap] at hlin
  simp only [Derivation.coe_smul_linearMap] at hlin
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hlin P
  simpa only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Derivation.coeFn_coe] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.coeff_directional
statement:
theorem coeff_directional (f : Fin 3 → R) (P : Aux R) (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    (directional f P).coeff s =
      ∑ i, (f i * (s i + 1 : ℕ)) * P.coeff (s + Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [directional_apply, coeff_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [coeff_smul, coeff_pderiv]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorCoefficients_directional
statement:
theorem tensorCoefficients_directional (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    tensorCoefficients (tensorDirectional f P) s =
      ∑ i, (f i * (s i + 1 : ℕ)) • tensorCoefficients P (s + Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction P using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul P m =>
    simp only [tensorDirectional, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, Derivation.coeFn_coe,
      tensorCoefficients_tmul, coeff_directional, Finset.sum_smul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact mul_smul _ _ _
  | add P Q hP hQ =>
    simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hP, hQ, smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryExponent_monomial
statement:
theorem binaryExponent_monomial (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (monomial (binaryExponent n j) 1 : Binary R) = X 0 ^ j.val * X 1 ^ (n - j.val)
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_pow_eq_monomial, X_pow_eq_monomial, monomial_mul_monomial, one_mul]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.kernelEmbedding_synthesis
statement:
theorem kernelEmbedding_synthesis (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    kernelEmbedding A (binarySynthesis n c) = kernelSynthesis A n c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [binarySynthesis, kernelSynthesis, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  change linearChange A (binaryEmbedding (monomial (binaryExponent n j) 1)) ⊗ₜ[R] c j = _
  rw [binaryExponent_monomial, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow]
  have hx0 : binaryEmbedding (X 0 : Binary R) = (X 1 : Aux R) := by simp [binaryEmbedding]
  have hx1 : binaryEmbedding (X 1 : Binary R) = (X 2 : Aux R) := by simp [binaryEmbedding]
  rw [hx0, hx1, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, linearChange_X, linearChange_X]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.kernelSynthesis_injective
statement:
theorem kernelSynthesis_injective (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (hAB : A * B = 1)
    (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (kernelSynthesis (M := M) A n)
proof:
:= by
  intro c c' h
  have h' := congrArg (kernelCoordinates (M := M) B) h
  rw [← kernelEmbedding_synthesis, ← kernelEmbedding_synthesis,
    kernelCoordinates_embedding A B hAB, kernelCoordinates_embedding A B hAB] at h'
  have hc := congrArg (binaryCoefficients (R := R) n) h'
  simpa using hc

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_directional_finite_kernel
statement:
theorem tensor_directional_finite_kernel
    (f : Fin 3 → R) (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (hAB : A * B = 1) (hBA : B * A = 1)
    (hA : ∀ i, ∑ j, f j * A i j = if i = 0 then 1 else 0)
    {n : ℕ} (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    tensorDirectional f P = 0 ↔
      ∃! c : Fin (n + 1) → M, kernelSynthesis A n c = P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hD
    obtain ⟨Q, ⟨hhom, hQ⟩, huniq⟩ :=
      (tensor_directional_homogeneous_kernel (K := K) f A B hAB hBA hA P hP).mp hD
    refine ⟨binaryCoefficients n Q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change kernelSynthesis A n (binaryCoefficients n Q) = P
      rw [← kernelEmbedding_synthesis, binarySynthesis_coefficients n Q hhom]
      exact hQ
    · intro c hc
      exact kernelSynthesis_injective A B hAB n (hc.trans (by
        rw [← kernelEmbedding_synthesis, binarySynthesis_coefficients n Q hhom]
        exact hQ.symm))
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, huniq⟩
    apply (tensor_directional_homogeneous_kernel (K := K) f A B hAB hBA hA P hP).mpr
    refine ⟨binarySynthesis n c, ⟨binarySynthesis_homogeneous n c, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [kernelEmbedding_synthesis]
      exact hc
    · intro Q hQ
      have hcoord := congrArg (kernelCoordinates (M := M) B) hQ.2
      rw [kernelCoordinates_embedding A B hAB] at hcoord
      rw [← hc, ← kernelEmbedding_synthesis, kernelCoordinates_embedding A B hAB] at hcoord
      exact hcoord

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensorHomogeneous_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorHomogeneous_tmul {n : ℕ} {P : Aux R} (hP : P.IsHomogeneous n) (m : M) :
    TensorHomogeneous n (P ⊗ₜ[R] m)
proof:
:= by
  change ((homogeneousComponent n).rTensor M) (P ⊗ₜ[R] m) = _
  simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, homogeneousComponent_eq_self hP]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensorHomogeneous_sum
statement:
lemma tensorHomogeneous_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    {n : ℕ} (P : ι → AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M))
    (hP : ∀ i ∈ s, TensorHomogeneous n (P i)) : TensorHomogeneous n (∑ i ∈ s, P i)
proof:
:= by
  change ((homogeneousComponent n).rTensor M) _ = _
  simp only [map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl hP

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensorMultiplyLinear_homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  rw [← homogeneousTensorSynthesis_coefficients n P hP]
  change TensorHomogeneous (n + 1)
    (((LinearMap.mulLeft R (linearForm f)).rTensor M) (∑ i,
      (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent n i) 1 : Aux R) ⊗ₜ[R]
        homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector n P i))
  rw [map_sum]
  apply tensorHomogeneous_sum
  intro i hi
  rw [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul]
  apply tensorHomogeneous_tmul
  simpa [Nat.add_comm] using (linearForm_homogeneous f).mul
    (isHomogeneous_monomial (1 : R) (homogeneousTensorExponent_degree n i))

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.directional_homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  rw [directional_eq_sum]
  change (∑ i : Fin 3, f i • pderiv i P).IsHomogeneous n
  apply IsHomogeneous.sum
  intro i hi
  apply (mem_homogeneousSubmodule n _).mp
  apply (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) R n).smul_mem
  apply (mem_homogeneousSubmodule n _).mpr
  simpa using hP.pderiv (i := i)

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensorDirectional_homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  rw [← homogeneousTensorSynthesis_coefficients (n + 1) P hP]
  change TensorHomogeneous n
    ((directional f).toLinearMap.rTensor M (∑ i,
      (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent (n + 1) i) 1 : Aux R) ⊗ₜ[R]
        homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (n + 1) P i))
  rw [map_sum]
  apply tensorHomogeneous_sum
  intro i hi
  rw [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul]
  apply tensorHomogeneous_tmul
  exact directional_homogeneous f
    (isHomogeneous_monomial (1 : R) (homogeneousTensorExponent_degree (n + 1) i))

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.synthesis_finiteCross
statement:
@[simp] theorem synthesis_finiteCross (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) :
    homogeneousTensorSynthesis n (finiteCross A n c) =
      tensorChange A (homogeneousTensorSynthesis n c)
proof:
:= by
  exact homogeneousTensorSynthesis_coefficients n _
    (tensorChange_homogeneous A (homogeneousTensorSynthesis_homogeneous n c))

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.synthesis_finiteMultiply
statement:
@[simp] theorem synthesis_finiteMultiply (f : Fin 3 → R) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) :
    homogeneousTensorSynthesis (n + 1) (finiteMultiply f n c) =
      tensorMultiplyLinear f (homogeneousTensorSynthesis n c)
proof:
:= by
  exact homogeneousTensorSynthesis_coefficients (n + 1) _
    (tensorMultiplyLinear_homogeneous f (homogeneousTensorSynthesis_homogeneous n c))

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.synthesis_finiteDirectional
statement:
@[simp] theorem synthesis_finiteDirectional (f : Fin 3 → R) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) (n + 1) → M) :
    homogeneousTensorSynthesis n (finiteDirectional f n c) =
      tensorDirectional f (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (n + 1) c)
proof:
:= by
  exact homogeneousTensorSynthesis_coefficients n _
    (tensorDirectional_homogeneous f (homogeneousTensorSynthesis_homogeneous (n + 1) c))

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteCross_apply
statement:
theorem finiteCross_apply (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) (j : Sym (Fin 3) n) :
    finiteCross A n c j = ∑ i : Sym (Fin 3) n,
      (linearChange A (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent n i) 1)).coeff
        (homogeneousTensorExponent n j) • c i
proof:
:= by
  change tensorCoefficients (((linearChange A).toLinearMap.rTensor M)
    (∑ i, (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent n i) 1 : Aux R) ⊗ₜ[R] c i))
      (homogeneousTensorExponent n j) = _
  simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
    tensorCoefficients_tmul, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensorCoefficients_multiplyLinear
statement:
theorem tensorCoefficients_multiplyLinear (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    tensorCoefficients (tensorMultiplyLinear f P) s =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, if i ∈ s.support then
        f i • tensorCoefficients P (s - Finsupp.single i 1) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction P using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul Q m =>
    simp only [tensorMultiplyLinear, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
      tensorCoefficients_tmul, linearForm, Finset.sum_mul, coeff_sum,
      mul_assoc, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_mul', Finset.sum_smul, mul_smul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | add P Q hP hQ =>
    simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hP, hQ]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    split_ifs <;> simp [smul_add]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.CrossPresentation.finite_cross_kernel
statement:
theorem finite_cross_kernel (n : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) (n + 1) → M) :
    finiteCross (crossMatrix u v z) (n + 1) c = 0 ↔
      c ∈ LinearMap.range (finiteMultiply ![u,v,z] n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hc
    have hcross : tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z)
        (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (n + 1) c) = 0 := by
      rw [← synthesis_finiteCross, hc]
      exact (homogeneousTensorSynthesisMap (n + 1)).map_zero
    obtain ⟨Q,hQ,heq⟩ := T.cross_kernel_homogeneous
      (homogeneousTensorSynthesis_homogeneous (n + 1) c) hcross
    refine ⟨homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector n Q, ?_⟩
    change homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (n + 1)
      (tensorMultiplyLinear ![u,v,z]
        (homogeneousTensorSynthesis n (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector n Q))) = c
    rw [homogeneousTensorSynthesis_coefficients n Q hQ, heq,
      homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector_synthesis]
  · rintro ⟨d,rfl⟩
    change homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (n + 1)
      (tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z)
        (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (n + 1) (finiteMultiply ![u,v,z] n d))) = 0
    rw [synthesis_finiteMultiply]
    have hcross := (T.cross_kernel (tensorMultiplyLinear ![u,v,z]
      (homogeneousTensorSynthesis n d))).mpr
      ⟨homogeneousTensorSynthesis n d, rfl⟩
    rw [hcross]
    exact (homogeneousTensorCoefficientMap (n + 1)).map_zero

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.CrossPresentation.finiteMultiply_injective
statement:
theorem finiteMultiply_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (finiteMultiply (M := M) ![u,v,z] n)
proof:
:= by
  intro c d h
  have ht := congrArg (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (R := R) (n + 1)) h
  rw [synthesis_finiteMultiply, synthesis_finiteMultiply] at ht
  have hc := T.multiply_injective ht
  simpa using congrArg (homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (R := R) n) hc

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.finiteDirectional_monomial_coefficients
statement:
theorem finiteDirectional_monomial_coefficients (f : Fin 3 → R) (t : ℕ)
    (p : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → M) (s : Sym (Fin 3) t) :
    finiteDirectional f t p s = ∑ b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1), ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (pderiv i (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R)).coeff
        (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) • (f i • p b)
proof:
:= by
  change tensorCoefficients (((directional f).toLinearMap.rTensor M)
    (∑ b, (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R) ⊗ₜ[R] p b))
      (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) = _
  simp only [map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, tensorCoefficients_tmul,
    Derivation.coeFn_coe, directional_apply, coeff_sum, coeff_smul,
    Finset.sum_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b hb
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.finiteMultiply_monomial_coefficients
statement:
theorem finiteMultiply_monomial_coefficients (f : Fin 3 → R) (t : ℕ)
    (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → M) (b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1)) :
    finiteMultiply f t q b = ∑ s : Sym (Fin 3) t, ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (X i * monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R).coeff
        (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) • (f i • q s)
proof:
:= by
  change tensorCoefficients (((LinearMap.mulLeft R (linearForm f)).rTensor M)
    (∑ s, (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R) ⊗ₜ[R] q s))
      (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) = _
  simp only [map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
    tensorCoefficients_tmul, linearForm, Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc, coeff_sum,
    coeff_C_mul, Finset.sum_smul, mul_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.scalarAction_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem scalarAction_apply (a : R) (m : M) : scalarAction (K := K) a m = a • m
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.algebraMap_pderiv_monomial_coeff
statement:
theorem algebraMap_pderiv_monomial_coeff (s b : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    algebraMap K R ((pderiv i (monomial b 1 : Poly K 3)).coeff s) =
      (pderiv i (monomial b 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R)).coeff s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_map]
  rw [← pderiv_map]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.algebraMap_X_monomial_coeff
statement:
theorem algebraMap_X_monomial_coeff (s b : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    algebraMap K R ((X i * monomial s 1 : Poly K 3).coeff b) =
      (X i * monomial s 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R).coeff b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_map]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.finiteDirectional_eq_operatorDifferential
statement:
theorem finiteDirectional_eq_operatorDifferential (f : Fin 3 → R) (t : ℕ)
    (p : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → M) :
    finiteDirectional f t p = operatorDifferential (fun i => scalarAction (K := K) (f i)) t p
proof:
:= by
  funext s
  rw [finiteDirectional_monomial_coefficients, operatorDifferential_coeff]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b hb
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [scalarAction_apply, ← algebraMap_pderiv_monomial_coeff (K := K)]
  exact algebraMap_smul R _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.finiteMultiply_eq_auxiliaryOperatorMultiply
statement:
theorem finiteMultiply_eq_auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (f : Fin 3 → R) (t : ℕ)
    (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → M) :
    finiteMultiply f t q = auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (fun i => scalarAction (K := K) (f i)) t q
proof:
:= by
  funext b
  rw [finiteMultiply_monomial_coefficients, auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [scalarAction_apply, ← algebraMap_X_monomial_coeff (K := K)]
  exact algebraMap_smul R _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selectedGridIndex_injective
statement:
theorem selectedGridIndex_injective (δ : Fin m → ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (selectedGridIndex δ)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  have hx := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).injective (congrArg Prod.fst h)
  have hy := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).injective (congrArg Prod.snd h)
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨i,j⟩, hij⟩, a,b⟩ := s
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨i',j'⟩, hij'⟩, a',b'⟩ := t
  change (⟨i,a⟩ : RootIndex δ) = ⟨i',a'⟩ at hx
  change (⟨j,b⟩ : RootIndex δ) = ⟨j',b'⟩ at hy
  cases hx
  cases hy
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selectedGridIndex_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem selectedGridIndex_mem (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (s : SelectedIndex δ) :
    selectedGridIndex δ s ∈ selectedGridSet δ
proof:
:= by
  simpa [selectedGridIndex, selectedGridSet] using s.1.property

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selectedAffineEvaluation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem selectedAffineEvaluation_apply (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (f : Poly K 2) (s : SelectedIndex δ) :
    selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β f s = eval ![selectedX δ α s, selectedY δ β s] f
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selectedAffineEvaluation_eq_full
statement:
theorem selectedAffineEvaluation_eq_full (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (f : Poly K 2) (s : SelectedIndex δ) :
    selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β f s =
      Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (Ferrers.flatRoots δ α) (Ferrers.flatRoots δ β) f (selectedGridIndex δ s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_apply, selectedGridIndex, Ferrers.flatRoots,
    selectedX, selectedY]

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selectedAffineEvaluation_surjective
statement:
theorem selectedAffineEvaluation_surjective (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Function.Surjective (selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (selectedGridIndex_injective δ).surjective_comp_right (γ := K) v
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_surjective
    (Ferrers.flatRoots δ α) (Ferrers.flatRoots δ β)
    (Ferrers.flatRoots_injective δ α hα) (Ferrers.flatRoots_injective δ β hβ) w
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  ext s
  rw [selectedAffineEvaluation_eq_full, hf]
  exact congrFun hw s

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.affineCofactorIdeal_le_selectedAffineEvaluation_ker
statement:
theorem affineCofactorIdeal_le_selectedAffineEvaluation_ker 
    (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    affineCofactorIdeal δ α β ≤ RingHom.ker (selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  rintro f ⟨j,rfl⟩
  change selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β (affineDehom (cofactorProduct δ α β j)) = 0
  ext s
  simpa [selectedAffineEvaluation_apply, Ferrers.eval_affineDehom] using
    cofactorProduct_eval_selected δ α β s j

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selectedAffineEvaluation_ker
statement:
theorem selectedAffineEvaluation_ker (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    RingHom.ker (selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β).toRingHom = affineCofactorIdeal δ α β
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    have hker : RingHom.ker
        (Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (Ferrers.flatRoots δ α) (Ferrers.flatRoots δ β)) ≤
        affineCofactorIdeal δ α β := by
      rw [Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_ker _ _ (Ferrers.flatRoots_injective δ α hα)
        (Ferrers.flatRoots_injective δ β hβ)]
      exact mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal δ α β
    apply mem_ideal_of_vanish_on_selected
      (Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (Ferrers.flatRoots δ α) (Ferrers.flatRoots δ β))
      (Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_surjective _ _ (Ferrers.flatRoots_injective δ α hα)
        (Ferrers.flatRoots_injective δ β hβ))
      (affineCofactorIdeal δ α β) hker (selectedGridSet δ)
      (affineCofactor_separator δ α β hα hβ)
    intro ij hij
    let u := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).symm ij.1
    let v := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex δ)).symm ij.2
    have huv : u.1 ≤ v.1 := hij
    let s : SelectedIndex δ := ⟨⟨(u.1,v.1),huv⟩,(u.2,v.2)⟩
    have hh := congrFun (show selectedAffineEvaluation δ α β f = 0 from hf) s
    simpa [Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_apply, Ferrers.flatRoots, selectedAffineEvaluation_apply,
      selectedX,selectedY,s,u,v] using hh
  · exact affineCofactorIdeal_le_selectedAffineEvaluation_ker δ α β

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.affineCofactorQuotient_finite
statement:
theorem affineCofactorQuotient_finite (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Module.Finite K (Poly K 2 ⧸ affineCofactorIdeal δ α β)
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.of_surjective (affineCofactorQuotientAlgEquiv δ α β hα hβ).symm.toLinearMap
    (affineCofactorQuotientAlgEquiv δ α β hα hβ).symm.surjective

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.affineCofactorQuotient_finrank
statement:
theorem affineCofactorQuotient_finrank (δ : Fin m → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Module.finrank K (Poly K 2 ⧸ affineCofactorIdeal δ α β) = Fintype.card (SelectedIndex δ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(affineCofactorQuotientAlgEquiv δ α β hα hβ).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.formChartMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem formChartMap_apply (π : Poly K 3 →ₐ[K] A) (N : ℕ)
    (f : Forms K 3 N) : formChartMap π N f = π f.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_form_descent
statement:
theorem exists_form_descent (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2})
    (f : Forms K 3 N) :
    ∃ g : Forms K 3 (N - 1), f.val - X 2 * g.val ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp (hcut f)
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hb
  let g : Forms K 3 (N - 1) := ⟨homogeneousComponent (N - 1) p,
    homogeneousComponent_mem _ _⟩
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  have hc := congrArg (homogeneousComponent N) hab
  have hm : homogeneousComponent N b = X 2 * g.val := by
    rw [hp]
    have hh := homogeneousComponent_mul_form (N - 1) (X (R := K) 2) p
      (isHomogeneous_X K 2)
    simpa [g, show 1 + (N - 1) = N by omega] using hh
  rw [map_add, homogeneousComponent_eq_self f.property, hm] at hc
  have haN := homogeneousComponent_mem_of_mem hI ha N
  rw [← hc, add_sub_cancel_right]
  exact haN

name: ChoppedPlane.form_zero_mem_of_cut
statement:
theorem form_zero_mem_of_cut (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 0, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2})
    (f : Forms K 3 0) : f.val ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp (hcut f)
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hb
  have hc := congrArg (homogeneousComponent 0) hab
  have hm : homogeneousComponent 0 b = 0 := by
    rw [hp]
    exact homogeneousComponent_mul_eq_zero_of_lt 0 (by omega)
      (X (R := K) 2) p (isHomogeneous_X K 2)
  rw [map_add, homogeneousComponent_eq_self f.property, hm, add_zero] at hc
  exact hc ▸ homogeneousComponent_mem_of_mem hI ha 0

name: ChoppedPlane.constant_mem_range_formChartMap
statement:
theorem constant_mem_range_formChartMap (π : Poly K 3 →ₐ[K] A)
    (hz : π (X 2) = 1) (N : ℕ) (a : K) :
    algebraMap K A a ∈ LinearMap.range (formChartMap π N)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨C a * X 2 ^ N, (isHomogeneous_X_pow 2 N).C_mul a⟩, ?_⟩
  simp [formChartMap_apply, hz]

name: ChoppedPlane.variable_mul_mem_range_formChartMap
statement:
theorem variable_mul_mem_range_formChartMap (π : Poly K 3 →ₐ[K] A)
    (hz : π (X 2) = 1) (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hker : ∀ f ∈ I, π f = 0) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2})
    (i : Fin 3) (f : Forms K 3 N) :
    π (X i) * formChartMap π N f ∈ LinearMap.range (formChartMap π N)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hN : N = 0
  · subst N
    have hf := hker f.val (form_zero_mem_of_cut I hI hcut f)
    simp [formChartMap_apply, hf]
  · obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_form_descent I hI N (by omega) hcut f
    have heq : π f.val = π g.val := by
      have heq := hker (f.val - X 2 * g.val) hg
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul, hz, sub_eq_zero] using heq
    refine ⟨⟨X i * g.val, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · simpa [show 1 + (N - 1) = N by omega] using (isHomogeneous_X K i).mul g.property
    · simp [formChartMap_apply, map_mul, heq]

name: ChoppedPlane.formChartMap_surjective
statement:
theorem formChartMap_surjective (π : Poly K 3 →ₐ[K] A)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hz : π (X 2) = 1)
    (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hker : ∀ f ∈ I, π f = 0) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2}) :
    Function.Surjective (formChartMap π N)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ p : Poly K 3, π p ∈ LinearMap.range (formChartMap π N) := by
    intro p
    induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
    | C a => simpa using constant_mem_range_formChartMap π hz N a
    | add p q hp hq => simpa only [map_add] using (LinearMap.range _).add_mem hp hq
    | mul_X p i hp =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hp
      simpa [map_mul, hf, mul_comm] using
        variable_mul_mem_range_formChartMap π hz I hI hker N hcut i f
  intro a
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hπ a
  exact hmem p

name: ChoppedPlane.finite_of_form_cut
statement:
theorem finite_of_form_cut (π : Poly K 3 →ₐ[K] A)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hz : π (X 2) = 1)
    (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hker : ∀ f ∈ I, π f = 0) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2}) :
    Module.Finite K A
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.of_surjective (formChartMap π N)
    (formChartMap_surjective π hπ hz I hI hker N hcut)

name: ChoppedPlane.form_cut_of_le
proof:
:= by
  have hf : f.val ∈ Forms K 3 N * Forms K 3 (t - N) := by
    rw [forms_mul_forms, Nat.add_sub_of_le hNt]
    exact f.property
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hf ?_ ?_
  · intro p hp q hq
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hcut ⟨p, hp⟩)
  · intro p q hp hq
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ hp hq

name: ChoppedPlane.formChartMap_surjective_of_le
statement:
theorem formChartMap_surjective_of_le (π : Poly K 3 →ₐ[K] A)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hz : π (X 2) = 1)
    (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hker : ∀ f ∈ I, π f = 0) (N t : ℕ) (hNt : N ≤ t)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2}) :
    Function.Surjective (formChartMap π t)
proof:
:=
  formChartMap_surjective π hπ hz I hI hker t (form_cut_of_le I N t hNt hcut)

name: ChoppedPlane.form_cut_of_map
statement:
theorem form_cut_of_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (φ : Poly K 3 →+* S) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2})
    (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, φ f.val ∈ I.map φ) :
    ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2}
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  have hf : f.val ∈ (I.map φ).comap φ := hcut f
  rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective' φ hφ I, hker] at hf
  exact hf

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_idealFormPiece
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_idealFormPiece (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) (N : ℕ)
    (f : Forms K 3 N) : f ∈ idealFormPiece I N ↔ f.val ∈ I
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.ker_formChartMap
statement:
theorem ker_formChartMap (π : Poly K 3 →ₐ[K] A) (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) (N : ℕ)
    (hker : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, π f.val = 0 ↔ f.val ∈ I) :
    LinearMap.ker (formChartMap π N) = idealFormPiece I N
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  exact hker f

name: ChoppedPlane.formChartQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem formChartQuotientEquiv_mk (π : Poly K 3 →ₐ[K] A)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hz : π (X 2) = 1)
    (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hker : ∀ f ∈ I, π f = 0) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2})
    (hexact : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, π f.val = 0 ↔ f.val ∈ I) (f : Forms K 3 N) :
    formChartQuotientEquiv π hπ hz I hI hker N hcut hexact ((idealFormPiece I N).mkQ f) =
      π f.val
proof:
:= by
  simp only [formChartQuotientEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
    Submodule.quotEquivOfEq_mk, LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective_apply_mk,
    formChartMap_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_formChartQuotient
statement:
theorem finrank_formChartQuotient (π : Poly K 3 →ₐ[K] A)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hz : π (X 2) = 1)
    (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hker : ∀ f ∈ I, π f = 0) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2})
    (hexact : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, π f.val = 0 ↔ f.val ∈ I) :
    Module.finrank K (Forms K 3 N ⧸ idealFormPiece I N) = Module.finrank K A
proof:
:=
  (formChartQuotientEquiv π hπ hz I hI hker N hcut hexact).finrank_eq

name: ChoppedPlane.affineQuotientMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineQuotientMap_apply (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) (f : Poly K 3) :
    affineQuotientMap I f = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (affineDehom f)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.affineQuotientMap_z
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineQuotientMap_z (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) :
    affineQuotientMap I (X 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [affineQuotientMap, AlgHom.comp_apply, affineDehom_X_two, map_one]

name: ChoppedPlane.affineQuotientMap_surjective
statement:
theorem affineQuotientMap_surjective (I : Ideal (Poly K 3)) :
    Function.Surjective (affineQuotientMap I)
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective K _).comp affineDehom_surjective

name: ChoppedPlane.affineQuotientMap_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem affineQuotientMap_eq_zero_of_mem (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    {f : Poly K 3} (hf : f ∈ I) : affineQuotientMap I f = 0
proof:
:=
  Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf)

name: ChoppedPlane.affineFormMap_surjective
statement:
theorem affineFormMap_surjective (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K)) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2}) :
    Function.Surjective (formChartMap (affineQuotientMap I) N)
proof:
:=
  formChartMap_surjective (affineQuotientMap I) (affineQuotientMap_surjective I)
    (affineQuotientMap_z I) I hI (fun _ hf => affineQuotientMap_eq_zero_of_mem I hf) N hcut

name: ChoppedPlane.affineCoordinateAlgebra_finite
statement:
theorem affineCoordinateAlgebra_finite (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K)) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2}) :
    Module.Finite K (AffineCoordinateAlgebra I)
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.of_surjective _ (affineFormMap_surjective I hI N hcut)

name: ChoppedPlane.affineQuotientMap_form_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem affineQuotientMap_form_eq_zero_iff (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hsat : ∀ p, (X 2 : Poly K 3) * p ∈ I → p ∈ I) (N : ℕ)
    (f : Forms K 3 N) : affineQuotientMap I f.val = 0 ↔ f.val ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineQuotientMap_apply, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  exact affineDehom_mem_map_iff I hI hsat f.property

name: ChoppedPlane.affineFormQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineFormQuotientEquiv_mk (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hsat : ∀ p, (X 2 : Poly K 3) * p ∈ I → p ∈ I) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2})
    (f : Forms K 3 N) :
    affineFormQuotientEquiv I hI hsat N hcut ((idealFormPiece I N).mkQ f) =
      affineQuotientMap I f.val
proof:
:= by
  exact formChartQuotientEquiv_mk _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_affineCoordinateAlgebra
statement:
theorem finrank_affineCoordinateAlgebra (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hsat : ∀ p, (X 2 : Poly K 3) * p ∈ I → p ∈ I) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2}) :
    Module.finrank K (AffineCoordinateAlgebra I) =
      Module.finrank K (Forms K 3 N ⧸ idealFormPiece I N)
proof:
:=
  (affineFormQuotientEquiv I hI hsat N hcut).finrank_eq.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.signedIdealPieceEquivOfEq_val

@[simp] theorem signedIdealPieceEquivOfEq_val (I : Ideal (Poly K n))

name: ChoppedPlane.signedIdealPieceNatEquiv_val

name: ChoppedPlane.signedIdealPieceNatEquiv_symm_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem signedIdealPieceNatEquiv_symm_val (I : Ideal (Poly K n))

name: ChoppedPlane.signedIdealPieceEquivNatOfEq_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem signedIdealPieceEquivNatOfEq_val (I : Ideal (Poly K n))
    {u : ℤ} (t : ℕ) (h : u = (t : ℤ)) (f : signedIdealPiece I u) :

proof:
:= by

name: ChoppedPlane.signedIdealPieceNatEquiv_map_residual
statement:
theorem signedIdealPieceNatEquiv_map_residual (J I : Ideal (Poly K n)) (t : ℕ) :
    ((signedIdealPiece J (t : ℤ)).comap (signedIdealPiece I (t : ℤ)).subtype).map
      (signedIdealPieceNatEquiv I t).toLinearMap =
      (idealFormPiece J t).comap (idealFormPiece I t).subtype
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact hg
  · intro hf
    refine ⟨(signedIdealPieceNatEquiv I t).symm f, hf, ?_⟩
    exact (signedIdealPieceNatEquiv I t).apply_symm_apply f

name: ChoppedPlane.signedIdealResidualPieceNatEquiv_mk

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_signedIdealResidualPiece_nat

name: ChoppedPlane.signedIdealPiece_mono
statement:
theorem signedIdealPiece_mono {J I : Ideal (Poly K n)} (hJI : J ≤ I) (t : ℤ) :
