proof: := fun _ hf => hJI hf

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeFirst_homogeneous
statement:
theorem planeFirst_homogeneous {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) :
    (planeFirst α).IsHomogeneous d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_one, planeFirst] using
    IsHomogeneous.prod (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin d))
      (fun i => X 0 - C (α i) * X 2) (fun _ => 1)
      (fun i _ => (isHomogeneous_X K 0).sub (isHomogeneous_C_mul_X (α i) 2))

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeSecond_homogeneous
statement:
theorem planeSecond_homogeneous {d : ℕ} (β : Fin d → K) :
    (planeSecond β).IsHomogeneous d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_one, planeSecond] using
    IsHomogeneous.prod (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin d))
      (fun i => X 1 - C (β i) * X 2) (fun _ => 1)
      (fun i _ => (isHomogeneous_X K 1).sub (isHomogeneous_C_mul_X (β i) 2))

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeFirst_eval
statement:
@[simp] theorem planeFirst_eval {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) (a b : K) :
    eval ![a,b,1] (planeFirst α) = (coordinatePolynomial α).eval a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [planeFirst, coordinatePolynomial, Polynomial.eval_prod]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeSecond_eval
statement:
@[simp] theorem planeSecond_eval {d : ℕ} (β : Fin d → K) (a b : K) :
    eval ![a,b,1] (planeSecond β) = (coordinatePolynomial β).eval b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [planeSecond, coordinatePolynomial, Polynomial.eval_prod]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeFirst_eval_infinity
statement:
@[simp] theorem planeFirst_eval_infinity {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) :
    eval ![1,0,0] (planeFirst α) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [planeFirst]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeSecond_eval_infinity
statement:
@[simp] theorem planeSecond_eval_infinity {d : ℕ} (β : Fin d → K) :
    eval ![0,1,0] (planeSecond β) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [planeSecond]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeFirst_ne_zero
statement: theorem planeFirst_ne_zero {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) : planeFirst α ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := planeFirst_eval_infinity α
  simp [h] at this

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeSecond_ne_zero
statement: theorem planeSecond_ne_zero {d : ℕ} (β : Fin d → K) : planeSecond β ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := planeSecond_eval_infinity β
  simp [h] at this

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.first_linear_irreducible
statement:
theorem first_linear_irreducible (a : K) :
    Irreducible (X 0 - C a * X 2 : Poly K 3)
proof:
:= by
  have h := irreducible_mul_X_add (1 : Poly K 3) (-C a * X 2) (0 : Fin 3)
    one_ne_zero (by simp) (by
      simp only [neg_mul, vars_neg]
      intro hz
      have hsub := vars_mul (C a : Poly K 3) (X 2) hz
      simp at hsub) isRelPrime_one_left
  simpa only [one_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_mul] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.plane_equations_relPrime
statement:
theorem plane_equations_relPrime {d : ℕ} (α β : Fin d → K) :
    IsRelPrime (planeFirst α) (planeSecond β)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply IsRelPrime.prod_left
  intro i _
  apply (first_linear_irreducible (α i)).isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
  intro h
  have he := map_dvd (eval ![0,1,0]) h
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, eval_X, eval_C] at he
  simp at he

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.plane_regular_mod_first
statement:
theorem plane_regular_mod_first {d : ℕ} (α β : Fin d → K) (P : Poly K 3)
    (h : planeFirst α ∣ planeSecond β * P) : planeFirst α ∣ P
proof:
:=
  (plane_equations_relPrime α β).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_eval
statement:
@[simp] theorem dehom_eval (P : Poly K 3) (a b : K) :
    (dehom P).evalEval a b = MvPolynomial.eval ![a,b,1] P
proof:
:= by
  change (Polynomial.evalEvalRingHom a b) (dehom P) = _
  rw [dehom, MvPolynomial.map_eval₂Hom]
  have hcoeff : (Polynomial.evalEvalRingHom a b).comp
      (Polynomial.C.comp Polynomial.C) = RingHom.id K := by
    ext r
    simp
  rw [hcoeff]
  have hvar : (fun i : Fin 3 => (Polynomial.evalEvalRingHom a b)
      (![Polynomial.C Polynomial.X, Polynomial.X, 1] i)) = ![a,b,1] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  rw [hvar]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_first
statement:
@[simp] theorem dehom_first {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → K) :
    dehom (planeFirst α) = firstEquation α
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [planeFirst, dehom, firstEquation, coordinatePolynomial]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_second
statement:
@[simp] theorem dehom_second {d : ℕ} (β : Fin d → K) :
    dehom (planeSecond β) = secondEquation β
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [planeSecond, dehom, secondEquation, coordinatePolynomial, Polynomial.map_prod]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_injective
statement:
theorem dehom_injective [Infinite K] {d : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (fun f : Forms K 3 d => dehom f.val)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g hfg
  have hzero : f - g = 0 := by
    apply homogeneous_eq_zero_of_chart_evaluations
    intro a b
    have h := congrArg (fun P : K[X][Y] => P.evalEval a b) hfg
    simpa only [dehom_eval, Submodule.coe_sub, map_sub,
      sub_eq_zero] using h
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_monomial_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem dehom_monomial_coeff (e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (r : K) (i j : ℕ) :
    ((dehom (MvPolynomial.monomial e r)).coeff j).coeff i =
      if j = e 1 ∧ i = e 0 then r else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heq : dehom (MvPolynomial.monomial e r) =
      Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C r * Polynomial.X ^ e 0) * Polynomial.X ^ e 1 := by
    simp [dehom, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial,
      Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (fun _ => pow_zero _), Fin.prod_univ_three, mul_assoc]
  rw [heq, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  by_cases hj : j = e 1
  · simp [hj]
  · simp [hj]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_totalDegreeLE_aux
statement:
theorem dehom_totalDegreeLE_aux {d : ℕ} (P : Poly K 3)
    (hP : P.IsHomogeneous d) : TotalDegreeLE d (dehom P)
proof:
:= by
  induction hP using MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    intro i j hij
    simp
  | add p q hp hq ihp ihq =>
    intro i j hij
    simp only [map_add, Polynomial.coeff_add, ihp i j hij, ihq i j hij, zero_add]
  | monomial e r he =>
    intro i j hij
    rw [dehom_monomial_coeff]
    split_ifs with hij'
    · have hdeg : e 0 + e 1 + e 2 = d := by
        have he' : e.sum (fun _ c => c) = d := by
          simpa [Finsupp.weight_apply, smul_eq_mul] using he
        rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (fun _ => rfl)] at he'
        simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_three] using he'
      omega
    · rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_totalDegreeLE
statement:
theorem dehom_totalDegreeLE {d : ℕ} (f : Forms K 3 d) :
    TotalDegreeLE d (dehom f.val)
proof: := dehom_totalDegreeLE_aux f.val f.property

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.dehom_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem dehom_smul (c : K) (P : Poly K 3) :
    dehom (c • P) = c • dehom P
proof:
:= by
  ext j i
  simp [dehom, MvPolynomial.smul_eq_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.grid_forms_kernel
statement:
theorem grid_forms_kernel [Infinite K] {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) (f : Forms K 3 d) :
    (∀ i j, MvPolynomial.eval ![α i,β j,1] f.val = 0) ↔
      ∃ a b : K, f = a • firstForm α + b • secondForm β
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨a,b,hab⟩ := (grid_kernel hd α β hα hβ (dehom f.val)
      (dehom_totalDegreeLE f)).mp (by simpa only [dehom_eval] using hv)
    refine ⟨a,b,dehom_injective ?_⟩
    simpa only [Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul, map_add, dehom_smul,
      firstForm, secondForm, dehom_first, dehom_second] using hab
  · rintro ⟨a,b,rfl⟩ i j
    simp [MvPolynomial.smul_eq_C_mul, firstForm, secondForm]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileLinearMatrix_maximalRank
statement:
theorem profileLinearMatrix_maximalRank
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℕ) :
    ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank (profileLinearMatrix q s r) t
proof:
:= by
  apply profileLinearMatrix_maximalRank_of_differential_checks
  · exact profileCriticalDifferential_injective q hq s r
  · intro hn
    exact (profileDifferential_surjective_iff_topMultiply_injective q hq s
      (r : ℤ) (profileCriticalDegree s r - 1)).mpr
      (profileLaurentTopMultiply_critical_injective q hq s r hn)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.exists_three_extra_columns_maximalRank
statement:
theorem exists_three_extra_columns_maximalRank [IsAlgClosed K] (a : ℕ) :
    ∃ L : LinearMatrix K a (a+3), ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q,hq,_,_⟩ := exists_cubic_parameter (K := K)
  exact exists_three_extra_columns_maximalRank_of_profile_matrices q
    (profileLinearMatrix_maximalRank q hq) a

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.exists_linearMatrix_maximalRank
statement:
theorem exists_linearMatrix_maximalRank [IsAlgClosed K]
    (a c : ℕ) (hac : a < c) (hgap : 2 ≤ c-a) :
    ∃ L : LinearMatrix K a c, ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:=
  exists_linearMatrix_maximalRank_of_three
    (exists_three_extra_columns_maximalRank (K := K)) a c hac hgap

name: ChoppedPlane.uniformLinearMatrixWitness
statement: theorem uniformLinearMatrixWitness : UniformLinearMatrixWitness K
proof:
:= by
  intro a c hac hgap
  exact QWeyl.exists_linearMatrix_maximalRank a c hac hgap

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.uChartGrade_le_overlapGrade
statement:
theorem uChartGrade_le_overlapGrade (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    uChartGrade (K := K) g k ≤ overlapGrade (K := K) g k
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.supported_mono fun _ h => h.1

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.vChartGrade_le_overlapGrade
statement:
theorem vChartGrade_le_overlapGrade (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    vChartGrade (K := K) g k ≤ overlapGrade (K := K) g k
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.supported_mono fun _ h => h.1

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.chart_intersection
statement:
theorem chart_intersection (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    uChartGrade (K := K) g k ⊓ vChartGrade (K := K) g k = positiveGrade (K := K) g k
proof:
:= by
  rw [uChartGrade, vChartGrade, ← Finsupp.supported_inter, positiveGrade]
  congr 1
  ext e
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, uChartIndices, vChartIndices, gradeIndices,
    positiveIndices, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  tauto

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.positiveGrade_le_uChartGrade
statement:
theorem positiveGrade_le_uChartGrade (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    positiveGrade (K := K) g k ≤ uChartGrade (K := K) g k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← chart_intersection]
  exact inf_le_left

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.positiveGrade_le_vChartGrade
statement:
theorem positiveGrade_le_vChartGrade (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    positiveGrade (K := K) g k ≤ vChartGrade (K := K) g k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← chart_intersection]
  exact inf_le_right

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.chartDifference_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartDifference_val (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : uChartGrade (K := K) g k × vChartGrade (K := K) g k) :
    (chartDifference (K := K) g k p).val = p.1.val - p.2.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.chartDiagonal_val_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartDiagonal_val_fst (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g k) : (chartDiagonal (K := K) g k p).1.val = p.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.chartDiagonal_val_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartDiagonal_val_snd (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g k) : (chartDiagonal (K := K) g k p).2.val = p.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.chartDifference_diagonal
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartDifference_diagonal (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g k) : chartDifference (K := K) g k (chartDiagonal (K := K) g k p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.chartDifference_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem chartDifference_eq_zero_iff (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : uChartGrade (K := K) g k × vChartGrade (K := K) g k) :
    chartDifference (K := K) g k p = 0 ↔ p.1.val = p.2.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Subtype.val_inj]
  change p.1.val - p.2.val = 0 ↔ _
  exact sub_eq_zero

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.ker_chartDifference
statement:
theorem ker_chartDifference (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    LinearMap.ker (chartDifference (K := K) g k) = LinearMap.range (chartDiagonal (K := K) g k)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, chartDifference_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hm : p.1.val ∈ positiveGrade (K := K) g k := by
      rw [← chart_intersection]
      exact ⟨p.1.property, hp.symm ▸ p.2.property⟩
    refine ⟨⟨p.1.val, hm⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · rfl
    · exact hp
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.positiveGrade_eq_bot_of_lt
statement:
theorem positiveGrade_eq_bot_of_lt (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) (hk : ∀ i, k < g i) :
    positiveGrade (K := K) g k = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hs : positiveIndices g k = ∅ := by
    ext e
    simp only [positiveIndices, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    intro h
    have hi := hk e.1
    omega
  rw [positiveGrade, hs, Finsupp.supported_empty]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.positiveGrade_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem positiveGrade_zero_of_lt (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) (hk : ∀ i, k < g i)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g k) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have heq := positiveGrade_eq_bot_of_lt (K := K) g k hk
  have hp : (p.val : FreeLaurent K ι) ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K (FreeLaurent K ι)) :=
    heq ▸ p.property
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hp

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.chartDifference_injective_of_lt
statement:
theorem chartDifference_injective_of_lt (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) (hk : ∀ i, k < g i) :
    Function.Injective (chartDifference (K := K) g k)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  have h : p.1.val - p.2.val = q.1.val - q.2.val :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hpq
  have heq : p.1.val - q.1.val = p.2.val - q.2.val := by
    calc
      p.1.val - q.1.val =
          (p.1.val - p.2.val) - (q.1.val - q.2.val) + (p.2.val - q.2.val) := by abel
      _ = p.2.val - q.2.val := by rw [h, sub_self, zero_add]
  have hm : p.1.val - q.1.val ∈ positiveGrade (K := K) g k := by
    rw [← chart_intersection]
    exact ⟨(uChartGrade (K := K) g k).sub_mem p.1.property q.1.property,
      heq.symm ▸ (vChartGrade (K := K) g k).sub_mem p.2.property q.2.property⟩
  have hz : p.1.val - q.1.val = 0 := by
    have hb : p.1.val - q.1.val ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K (FreeLaurent K ι)) :=
      positiveGrade_eq_bot_of_lt (K := K) g k hk ▸ hm
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hb
  apply Prod.ext <;> apply Subtype.ext
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp (heq.symm.trans hz)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.chart_sum_eq_supported
statement:
theorem chart_sum_eq_supported (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    uChartGrade (K := K) g k ⊔ vChartGrade (K := K) g k =
      Finsupp.supported K K
        {e | e ∈ gradeIndices g k ∧ (0 ≤ e.2.2 ∨ 0 ≤ e.2.1)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [uChartGrade, vChartGrade, ← Finsupp.supported_union]
  congr 1
  ext e
  simp only [Set.mem_union, uChartIndices, vChartIndices, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  tauto

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.chartDifference_mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem chartDifference_mem_range_iff (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : overlapGrade (K := K) g k) :
    p ∈ LinearMap.range (chartDifference (K := K) g k) ↔
      p.val ∈ uChartGrade (K := K) g k ⊔ vChartGrade (K := K) g k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    rw [chartDifference_val]
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using
      Submodule.add_mem_sup q.1.property ((vChartGrade (K := K) g k).neg_mem q.2.property)
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hp
    refine ⟨(⟨u, hu⟩, ⟨-v, (vChartGrade (K := K) g k).neg_mem hv⟩), ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa using huv

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.topGrade_le_overlapGrade
statement:
theorem topGrade_le_overlapGrade (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    topGrade (K := K) g k ≤ overlapGrade (K := K) g k
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.supported_mono fun _ h => h.1

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.topProjection_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem topProjection_coeff (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : overlapGrade (K := K) g k) (e : ι × (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    (topProjection (K := K) g k p).val e = if e ∈ topIndices g k then p.val e else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (p.val.filter (· ∈ topIndices g k)) e = _
  simp [Finsupp.filter]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.topProjection_surjective
statement:
theorem topProjection_surjective (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    Function.Surjective (topProjection (K := K) g k)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  refine ⟨⟨p.val, topGrade_le_overlapGrade (K := K) g k p.property⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext e
  by_cases he : e ∈ topIndices g k
  · simp [he]
  · simp [he, (Finsupp.mem_supported' K _).mp p.property e he]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.topProjection_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem topProjection_eq_zero_iff (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : overlapGrade (K := K) g k) :
    topProjection (K := K) g k p = 0 ↔ p.val ∈ uChartGrade (K := K) g k ⊔ vChartGrade (K := K) g k
proof:
:= by
  rw [chart_sum_eq_supported, Finsupp.mem_supported']
  constructor
  · intro hp e he
    by_cases hg : e ∈ gradeIndices g k
    · have hn : e ∈ topIndices g k := by
        change e ∈ gradeIndices g k ∧ e.2.1 < 0 ∧ e.2.2 < 0
        change ¬(e ∈ gradeIndices g k ∧ (0 ≤ e.2.2 ∨ 0 ≤ e.2.1)) at he
        have hnn : ¬(0 ≤ e.2.2 ∨ 0 ≤ e.2.1) := fun hn => he ⟨hg, hn⟩
        exact ⟨hg, by omega⟩
      have hz := congrArg (fun z : topGrade (K := K) g k => z.val e) hp
      simpa [hn] using hz
    · exact (Finsupp.mem_supported' K _).mp p.property e hg
  · intro hp
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext e
    by_cases he : e ∈ topIndices g k
    · have hn : e ∉ {e | e ∈ gradeIndices g k ∧ (0 ≤ e.2.2 ∨ 0 ≤ e.2.1)} := by
        obtain ⟨_, ha, hb⟩ := he
        change ¬(_ ∧ (0 ≤ e.2.2 ∨ 0 ≤ e.2.1))
        omega
      simp [he, hp e hn]
    · simp [he]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.ker_topProjection
statement:
theorem ker_topProjection (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    LinearMap.ker (topProjection (K := K) g k) = LinearMap.range (chartDifference (K := K) g k)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, topProjection_eq_zero_iff, chartDifference_mem_range_iff]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.topGrade_eq_negativeGrade
statement:
theorem topGrade_eq_negativeGrade (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    topGrade (K := K) g k = negativeGrade (fun i => 2 - g i) (-k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [topGrade, negativeGrade]
  congr 1
  ext e
  simp only [topIndices, gradeIndices, negativeIndices, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.topGrade_dual_shift_eq
statement:
theorem topGrade_dual_shift_eq (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) :
    topGrade (K := K) (fun i => 2 - g i) (-r) = negativeGrade (K := K) g r
proof:
:= by
  rw [topGrade, negativeGrade]
  congr 1
  ext e
  simp only [topIndices, gradeIndices, negativeIndices, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.gradeProjection_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradeProjection_coeff (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (e : ι × (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    gradeProjection g k p e = if e ∈ gradeIndices g k then p e else 0
proof:
:= by
  change (p.filter (· ∈ gradeIndices g k)) e = _
  simp [Finsupp.filter]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.gradeProjection_mem_overlapGrade
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_mem_overlapGrade (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K ι) :
    gradeProjection g k p ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) g k
proof:
:=
  (Finsupp.restrictDom K K (gradeIndices g k) p).property

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.mem_overlapGrade_iff_gradeProjection_eq
statement:
theorem mem_overlapGrade_iff_gradeProjection_eq (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι) :
    p ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) g k ↔ gradeProjection g k p = p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    ext e
    by_cases he : e ∈ gradeIndices g k
    · simp [he]
    · simp [he, (Finsupp.mem_supported' K p).mp hp e he]
  · intro hp
    rw [← hp]
    exact gradeProjection_mem_overlapGrade g k p

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.gradeProjection_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradeProjection_single (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (e : ι × (ℤ × ℤ)) (c : K) :
    gradeProjection g k (Finsupp.single e c) =
      if e ∈ gradeIndices g k then Finsupp.single e c else 0
proof:
:= by
  change (Finsupp.single e c).filter (· ∈ gradeIndices g k) = _
  by_cases he : e ∈ gradeIndices g k
  · rw [Finsupp.filter_single_of_pos (· ∈ gradeIndices g k) he, ite_eq_left he]
  · rw [Finsupp.filter_single_of_neg (· ∈ gradeIndices g k) he, ite_eq_right he]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.gradeProjection_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_zero_of_ne (g : ι → ℤ) {j k : ℤ} (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (hp : p ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) g j) :
    gradeProjection g k p = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  by_cases he : e ∈ gradeIndices g k
  · have hj : e ∉ gradeIndices g j := by
      intro hj
      exact hjk (hj.symm.trans he)
    simp [he, (Finsupp.mem_supported' K p).mp hp e hj]
  · simp [he]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.gradeProjection_preserves_uChartSupport
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_preserves_uChartSupport (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι)
    (hp : p ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {e : ι × (ℤ × ℤ) | 0 ≤ e.2.2}) :
    gradeProjection g k p ∈ uChartGrade (K := K) g k
proof:
:= by
  apply (Finsupp.mem_supported' K _).mpr
  intro e he
  by_cases hg : e ∈ gradeIndices g k
  · have hu : ¬0 ≤ e.2.2 := by
      intro hu
      exact he ⟨hg, hu⟩
    simp [hg, (Finsupp.mem_supported' K p).mp hp e hu]
  · simp [hg]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.gradeProjection_preserves_vChartSupport
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_preserves_vChartSupport (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι)
    (hp : p ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {e : ι × (ℤ × ℤ) | 0 ≤ e.2.1}) :
    gradeProjection g k p ∈ vChartGrade (K := K) g k
proof:
:= by
  apply (Finsupp.mem_supported' K _).mpr
  intro e he
  by_cases hg : e ∈ gradeIndices g k
  · have hv : ¬0 ≤ e.2.1 := by
      intro hv
      exact he ⟨hg, hv⟩
    simp [hg, (Finsupp.mem_supported' K p).mp hp e hv]
  · simp [hg]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.gradeProjection_commutes_of_degree_shift
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_commutes_of_degree_shift {κ : Type*}
    (g : ι → ℤ) (h : κ → ℤ) (d : ℤ)
    (T : FreeLaurent K ι →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K κ)
    (hT : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ p : FreeLaurent K ι,
      p ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) g j → T p ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) h (j + d))
    (k : ℤ) :
    (gradeProjection h (k + d)).comp T = T.comp (gradeProjection g k)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro p
  change gradeProjection h (k + d) (T p) = T (gradeProjection g k p)
  induction p using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  | single e c =>
      have hm : Finsupp.single e c ∈ overlapGrade (K := K) g
          (e.2.1 + e.2.2 + g e.1) :=
        Finsupp.single_mem_supported K c rfl
      have ht := hT _ _ hm
      by_cases he : e ∈ gradeIndices g k
      · have heq : e.2.1 + e.2.2 + g e.1 = k := he
        rw [heq] at ht
        rw [gradeProjection_single, ite_eq_left he]
        exact (mem_overlapGrade_iff_gradeProjection_eq h (k + d) _).mp ht
      · have hne : e.2.1 + e.2.2 + g e.1 + d ≠ k + d := by
          intro hh
          apply he
          change e.2.1 + e.2.2 + g e.1 = k
          omega
        rw [gradeProjection_zero_of_ne h hne _ ht, gradeProjection_single, ite_eq_right he, map_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.freeLaurentEquiv_uFreeEmbedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeLaurentEquiv_uFreeEmbedding (p : ι → URing K) (i : ι) :
    freeLaurentEquiv (uFreeEmbedding p) i = uEmbedding (p i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [uFreeEmbedding]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.freeLaurentEquiv_vFreeEmbedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeLaurentEquiv_vFreeEmbedding (p : ι → VRing K) (i : ι) :
    freeLaurentEquiv (vFreeEmbedding p) i = vEmbedding (p i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vFreeEmbedding]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.uFreeEmbedding_injective
statement: theorem uFreeEmbedding_injective : Function.Injective (uFreeEmbedding (K := K) (ι := ι))
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  funext i
  apply uEmbedding_injective
  have hi := congrArg (fun f => freeLaurentEquiv f i) hpq
  simpa using hi

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.vFreeEmbedding_injective
statement: theorem vFreeEmbedding_injective : Function.Injective (vFreeEmbedding (K := K) (ι := ι))
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  funext i
  apply vEmbedding_injective
  have hi := congrArg (fun f => freeLaurentEquiv f i) hpq
  simpa using hi

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.range_uFreeEmbedding
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    apply (Finsupp.mem_supported' K _).mpr
    intro e he
    have hi : uEmbedding (q e.1) ∈ chartU := by
      rw [← range_uEmbedding]
      exact ⟨q e.1, rfl⟩
    have hz := AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported'.mp hi e.2 he
    have hc := freeLaurentEquiv_coeff (uFreeEmbedding q) e.1 e.2
    rw [freeLaurentEquiv_uFreeEmbedding] at hc
    exact hc.symm.trans hz
  · intro hp
    have hi : ∀ i, freeLaurentEquiv p i ∈ chartU := by
      intro i
      apply AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported'.mpr
      intro e he
      rw [freeLaurentEquiv_coeff]
      exact (Finsupp.mem_supported' K _).mp hp (i, e) he
    have hr : ∀ i, ∃ q : URing K, uEmbedding q = freeLaurentEquiv p i := by
      intro i
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (show freeLaurentEquiv p i ∈ LinearMap.range (uEmbedding (K := K)).toLinearMap from ((range_uEmbedding (K := K)).symm ▸ hi i))
      exact ⟨q, hq⟩
    choose q hq using hr
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    apply freeLaurentEquiv.injective
    funext i
    simpa using hq i

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.range_vFreeEmbedding
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    apply (Finsupp.mem_supported' K _).mpr
    intro e he
    have hi : vEmbedding (q e.1) ∈ chartV := by
      rw [← range_vEmbedding]
      exact ⟨q e.1, rfl⟩
    have hz := AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported'.mp hi e.2 he
    have hc := freeLaurentEquiv_coeff (vFreeEmbedding q) e.1 e.2
    rw [freeLaurentEquiv_vFreeEmbedding] at hc
    exact hc.symm.trans hz
  · intro hp
    have hi : ∀ i, freeLaurentEquiv p i ∈ chartV := by
      intro i
      apply AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported'.mpr
      intro e he
      rw [freeLaurentEquiv_coeff]
      exact (Finsupp.mem_supported' K _).mp hp (i, e) he
    have hr : ∀ i, ∃ q : VRing K, vEmbedding q = freeLaurentEquiv p i := by
      intro i
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (show freeLaurentEquiv p i ∈ LinearMap.range (vEmbedding (K := K)).toLinearMap from ((range_vEmbedding (K := K)).symm ▸ hi i))
      exact ⟨q, hq⟩
    choose q hq using hr
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    apply freeLaurentEquiv.injective
    funext i
    simpa using hq i

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.uChartGrade_eq_overlap_inf_range
statement:
theorem uChartGrade_eq_overlap_inf_range (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    uChartGrade (K := K) g k = overlapGrade (K := K) g k ⊓ LinearMap.range uFreeEmbedding
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_uFreeEmbedding, overlapGrade, ← Finsupp.supported_inter, uChartGrade]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.vChartGrade_eq_overlap_inf_range
statement:
theorem vChartGrade_eq_overlap_inf_range (g : ι → ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    vChartGrade (K := K) g k = overlapGrade (K := K) g k ⊓ LinearMap.range vFreeEmbedding
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_vFreeEmbedding, overlapGrade, ← Finsupp.supported_inter, vChartGrade]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneousComponent_mul_form
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mul_form (e : ℕ) (f p : Poly K n)
    (hf : f.IsHomogeneous d) :
    homogeneousComponent (d + e) (f * p) = f * homogeneousComponent e p
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial a c =>
      have ha : (monomial a c : Poly K n).IsHomogeneous a.degree :=
        isHomogeneous_monomial c rfl
      rw [homogeneousComponent_of_mem (hf.mul ha), homogeneousComponent_of_mem ha]
      by_cases h : a.degree = e
      · simp [h]
      · simp [Ne.symm h]
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [mul_add, map_add, hp, hq]

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneousComponent_mem_products
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mem_products (e : ℕ) (W : Submodule K (Poly K n))
    (hW : W ≤ Forms K n d) {p : Poly K n}
    (hp : p ∈ Ideal.span (W : Set (Poly K n))) :
    homogeneousComponent (d + e) p ∈ W * Forms K n e
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ a : Poly K n, homogeneousComponent (d + e) (a * p) ∈ W * Forms K n e := by
    induction hp using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem f hf =>
        intro a
        rw [mul_comm a f, homogeneousComponent_mul_form e f a (hW hf)]
        exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul hf (homogeneousComponent_mem e a)
    | zero => intro a; simp
    | add p q hp hq ihp ihq =>
        intro a
        rw [mul_add, map_add]
        exact (W * Forms K n e).add_mem (ihp a) (ihq a)
    | smul b p hp ih =>
        intro a
        change homogeneousComponent (d + e) (a * (b * p)) ∈ W * Forms K n e
        rw [← mul_assoc]
        exact ih (a * b)
  simpa using hall 1

name: ChoppedPlane.form_mem_ideal_iff
statement:
theorem form_mem_ideal_iff (e : ℕ) (W : Submodule K (Poly K n))
    (hW : W ≤ Forms K n d) (p : Forms K n (d + e)) :
    p.val ∈ Ideal.span (W : Set (Poly K n)) ↔ p.val ∈ W * Forms K n e
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have h := homogeneousComponent_mem_products e W hW hp
    rwa [homogeneousComponent_eq_self p.property] at h
  · intro hp
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hp ?_ ?_
    · intro f hf a ha
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span hf)
    · intro f g hf hg
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg

name: ChoppedPlane.ker_formToRingQuotient
statement:
theorem ker_formToRingQuotient (W : Submodule K (Poly K n))
    (hW : W ≤ Forms K n d) (e : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.ker (formToRingQuotient (d + e) W) = generatedProducts W e
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (W : Set (Poly K n))) p.val = 0 ↔
    p.val ∈ W * Forms K n e
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  exact form_mem_ideal_iff e W hW p

name: ChoppedPlane.generated_finrank_eq_hilbertFunction
statement:
theorem generated_finrank_eq_hilbertFunction (W : Submodule K (Poly K n))
    (hW : W ≤ Forms K n d) (e : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank K (Forms K n (d + e) ⧸ generatedProducts W e) =
      generatedHilbertFunction W (d + e)
proof:
:=
  (generatedQuotientEquivImage W hW e).finrank_eq

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneousComponent_mul_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mul_eq_zero_of_lt (j : ℕ) (hj : j < d)
    (f p : Poly K n) (hf : f.IsHomogeneous d) :
    homogeneousComponent j (f * p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial a c =>
      have ha : (monomial a c : Poly K n).IsHomogeneous a.degree :=
        isHomogeneous_monomial c rfl
      rw [homogeneousComponent_of_mem (hf.mul ha)]
      simp [show j ≠ d + a.degree by omega]
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [mul_add, map_add, hp, hq, add_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneousComponent_ideal_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ a : Poly K n, homogeneousComponent j (a * p) = 0 := by
    induction hp using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem f hf =>
        intro a
        rw [mul_comm]
        exact homogeneousComponent_mul_eq_zero_of_lt j hj f a (hW hf)
    | zero => intro a; simp
    | add p q hp hq ihp ihq => intro a; simp [mul_add, ihp, ihq]
    | smul b p hp ih => intro a; exact (mul_assoc a b p).symm ▸ ih (a * b)
  simpa using hall 1

name: ChoppedPlane.formToRingQuotient_injective_of_lt
statement:
theorem formToRingQuotient_injective_of_lt (j : ℕ) (hj : j < d)
    (W : Submodule K (Poly K n)) (hW : W ≤ Forms K n d) :
    Function.Injective (formToRingQuotient j W)
proof:
:= by
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr
  intro p hp
  have hpI : p.val ∈ Ideal.span (W : Set (Poly K n)) := by
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hp
  have hz := homogeneousComponent_ideal_eq_zero j hj W hW hpI
  rw [homogeneousComponent_eq_self p.property] at hz
  exact Subtype.ext hz

name: ChoppedPlane.generatedHilbertFunction_below_degree
statement:
theorem generatedHilbertFunction_below_degree (j : ℕ) (hj : j < d)
    (W : Submodule K (Poly K n)) (hW : W ≤ Forms K n d) :
    generatedHilbertFunction W j = (n + j - 1).choose j
proof:
:=
  (LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (formToRingQuotient_injective_of_lt j hj W hW)).trans
    (finrank_forms K n j)

name: ChoppedPlane.formToRingQuotient_eq_zero_of_forms_le
statement:
theorem formToRingQuotient_eq_zero_of_forms_le (j : ℕ) (hj : d ≤ j)
    (W : Submodule K (Poly K n)) (hW : Forms K n d ≤ W) :
    formToRingQuotient j W = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
  change p.val ∈ Ideal.span (W : Set (Poly K n))
  have hp : p.val ∈ Forms K n d * Forms K n (j - d) := by
    rw [forms_mul_forms, Nat.add_sub_of_le hj]
    exact p.property
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hp ?_ ?_
  · intro f hf a ha
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span (hW hf))
  · intro f g hf hg
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg

name: ChoppedPlane.generatedHilbertFunction_zero_of_forms_le
statement:

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticKernelSynthesis_charts
statement:
theorem quarticKernelSynthesis_charts {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

    kernelSynthesis (quarticKernelMatrixU u v z a) n c =
      kernelSynthesis (quarticKernelMatrixV u v z b) n c
proof:

  simp only [kernelSynthesis, quarticKernelMatrixU, quarticKernelMatrixV,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two]
