name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_kernel_descends
statement:
theorem quartic_kernel_descends
    (u v : B) (Z : End B (Fin 3 → B)) (Z' : End F (Fin 3 → F))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) • 1)
    (hZ' : Z' ^ 3 = (algebraMap B F (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3)) • 1)
    (hT : ∀ m, cyclicVectorBaseChange (algebraMap B F) (Z m) =
      Z' (cyclicVectorBaseChange (algebraMap B F) m))
    (hu : quarticU u v ≠ 0) (hv : quarticV u v ≠ 0)
    (hcop : IsRelPrime (quarticU u v) (quarticV u v)) :
    let
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) Z hZ
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (P : AuxTensor (R := CyclicCubicRing B (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3))
        (M := Fin 3 → B)), TensorHomogeneous n P →
      tensorDirectional (quarticRow
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) u)
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) v)
        (cyclicRoot (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3))) P = 0 →
      ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 3 → B,
        kernelSynthesis (quarticKernelMatrixU
          (cyclicCoefficientHom (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) u)
          (cyclicCoefficientHom (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) v)
          (cyclicRoot (u ^ 3 + v ^ 3)) 0) n c = P := by
  dsimp only
  let G := u ^ 3 + v ^ 3
  let φ : B →+* F := algebraMap B F
  let R₀ := CyclicCubicRing B G
  let R₁ := CyclicCubicRing F (φ G)
  let := cyclicModuleStructure G Z hZ
  let := cyclicModuleStructure (φ G) Z' hZ'
  let θ : R₀ →+* R₁ := cyclicBaseChangeHom φ G
  let ψ : (Fin 3 → B) →ₛₗ[θ] (Fin 3 → F) :=
    cyclicModuleBaseChange φ G (cyclicVectorBaseChange φ) Z Z' hZ hZ' hT
  let u₀ : R₀ := cyclicCoefficientHom G u
  let v₀ : R₀ := cyclicCoefficientHom G v
  let z₀ : R₀ := cyclicRoot G
  let u₁ : R₁ := cyclicCoefficientHom (φ G) (φ u)
  let v₁ : R₁ := cyclicCoefficientHom (φ G) (φ v)
  let z₁ : R₁ := cyclicRoot (φ G)
  have hθu : θ u₀ = u₁ := cyclicBaseChangeHom_coefficient φ G u
  have hθv : θ v₀ = v₁ := cyclicBaseChangeHom_coefficient φ G v
  have hθz : θ z₀ = z₁ := cyclicBaseChangeHom_root φ G
  have hz : z₁ ^ 3 = u₁ ^ 3 + v₁ ^ 3 := by
    simpa only [u₁, v₁, z₁, G, map_add, map_pow] using cyclicRoot_cube (φ G)
  have hfu : quarticU u₁ v₁ = cyclicCoefficientHom (φ G) (φ (quarticU u v)) := by
    simp only [u₁, v₁, quarticU, map_mul, map_add, map_pow, map_ofNat]
  have hfv : quarticV u₁ v₁ = cyclicCoefficientHom (φ G) (φ (quarticV u v)) := by
    simp only [u₁, v₁, quarticV, map_mul, map_add, map_pow, map_ofNat, map_neg]
  let a := cyclicCoefficientHom (φ G) ((φ (quarticU u v))⁻¹)
  let b := cyclicCoefficientHom (φ G) ((φ (quarticV u v))⁻¹)
  have ha : quarticU u₁ v₁ * a = 1 := by
    rw [hfu, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by
      simpa only [map_zero] using (IsFractionRing.injective B F).ne hu), map_one]
  have hb : quarticV u₁ v₁ * b = 1 := by
    rw [hfv, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by
      simpa only [map_zero] using (IsFractionRing.injective B F).ne hv), map_one]
  let A := quarticKernelMatrixU u₁ v₁ z₁ a
  let A' := quarticKernelMatrixV u₁ v₁ z₁ b
  let D := quarticKernelInverseU u₁ v₁ z₁ a
  let D' := quarticKernelInverseV u₁ v₁ z₁ b
  have hAD : A * D = 1 := quarticKernelMatrixU_mul_inverse _ _ _ _ hz ha
  have hA'D' : A' * D' = 1 := quarticKernelMatrixV_mul_inverse _ _ _ _ hz hb
  intro n P hP hδ
  let P' := tensorBaseChange ψ P
  have hP' : TensorHomogeneous n P' := tensorBaseChange_homogeneous ψ hP
  have hδ' : tensorDirectional (quarticRow u₁ v₁ z₁) P' = 0 := by
    have hd := congrArg (tensorBaseChange ψ) hδ
    rw [tensorBaseChange_directional, map_zero] at hd
    have hr : (fun i => θ (quarticRow u₀ v₀ z₀ i)) = quarticRow u₁ v₁ z₁ := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [quarticRow, quarticU, quarticV, quarticZ,
        map_ofNat, hθu, hθv, hθz]
    rw [hr] at hd
    exact hd
  obtain ⟨c, hc, huniq⟩ :=
    (tensor_directional_finite_kernel (K := K) _ A D hAD
      (mul_eq_one_comm.mp hAD)
      (quarticKernelMatrixU_direction _ _ _ _ hz ha) P' hP').mp hδ'
  have hcU : kernelCoordinates D P' = binarySynthesis n c := by
    rw [← hc, ← kernelEmbedding_synthesis, kernelCoordinates_embedding _ _ hAD]
  have hcV : kernelCoordinates D' P' = binarySynthesis n c := by
    rw [← hc, quarticKernelSynthesis_charts _ _ _ _ b,
      ← kernelEmbedding_synthesis, kernelCoordinates_embedding _ _ hA'D']
  let CU := (aeval (quarticClearU u₀ v₀ z₀)).toLinearMap.rTensor (Fin 3 → B) P
  let CV := (aeval (quarticClearV u₀ v₀ z₀)).toLinearMap.rTensor (Fin 3 → B) P
  have hCU : tensorBaseChange ψ CU =
      (aeval (quarticClearU u₁ v₁ z₁)).toLinearMap.rTensor (Fin 3 → F) P' := by
    rw [tensorBaseChange_substitution, quarticClearU_map, hθu, hθv, hθz]
  have hCV : tensorBaseChange ψ CV =
      (aeval (quarticClearV u₁ v₁ z₁)).toLinearMap.rTensor (Fin 3 → F) P' := by
    rw [tensorBaseChange_substitution, quarticClearV_map, hθu, hθv, hθz]
  have hclearU := quarticCoordinatesU_clear u₁ v₁ z₁ a ha P' hP'
  have hclearV := quarticCoordinatesV_clear u₁ v₁ z₁ b hb P' hP'
  rw [hcU, ← hCU] at hclearU
  rw [hcV, ← hCV] at hclearV
  have huInt (j : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin 3) :
      IsLocalization.IsInteger B (φ (quarticU u v ^ n) * c j i) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun Q : BinaryTensor (R := R₁) (M := Fin 3 → F) =>
      binaryCoefficients n Q j) hclearU
    have hs (r : R₁) (Q : BinaryTensor (R := R₁) (M := Fin 3 → F)) :
        binaryCoefficients n (r • Q) j = r • binaryCoefficients n Q j := by
      simp only [binaryCoefficients, LinearEquiv.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply]
    rw [hs, binaryCoefficients_synthesis, binaryCoefficients_baseChange,
      hfu, ← map_pow, ← map_pow, cyclicModule_coefficient_smul] at h
    have hi := congrFun h i
    exact ⟨binaryCoefficients n CU j i, hi.symm⟩
  have hvInt (j : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin 3) :
      IsLocalization.IsInteger B (φ (quarticV u v ^ n) * c j i) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun Q : BinaryTensor (R := R₁) (M := Fin 3 → F) =>
      binaryCoefficients n Q j) hclearV
    have hs (r : R₁) (Q : BinaryTensor (R := R₁) (M := Fin 3 → F)) :
        binaryCoefficients n (r • Q) j = r • binaryCoefficients n Q j := by
      simp only [binaryCoefficients, LinearEquiv.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply]
    rw [hs, binaryCoefficients_synthesis, binaryCoefficients_baseChange,
      hfv, ← map_pow, ← map_pow, cyclicModule_coefficient_smul] at h
    have hi := congrFun h i
    exact ⟨binaryCoefficients n CV j i, hi.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ChoppedPlane.free_coefficients_coprime_descent
    (fun ji : Fin (n + 1) × Fin 3 => c ji.1 ji.2)
    (quarticU u v) (quarticV u v) hcop
    (fun ji => ⟨⟨n, huInt ji.1 ji.2⟩, ⟨n, hvInt ji.1 ji.2⟩⟩)
  let c₀ : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 3 → B := fun j i => d (j, i)
  have hψc (j : Fin (n + 1)) : ψ (c₀ j) = c j := by
    funext i
    exact hd (j, i)
  refine ⟨c₀, ?_⟩
  apply tensorBaseChange_injective ψ (by
    intro m m' hm
    funext i
    apply IsFractionRing.injective B F
    exact congrFun hm i)
  rw [tensorBaseChange_kernelSynthesis]
  have hmatrix : (quarticKernelMatrixU u₀ v₀ z₀ 0).map θ =
      quarticKernelMatrixU u₁ v₁ z₁ 0 := by
    ext i j
    change θ (quarticKernelMatrixU u₀ v₀ z₀ 0 i j) = _
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [quarticKernelMatrixU, quadraticOne, quadraticTwo, hθu, hθv, hθz]
  rw [hmatrix]
  simp only [hψc]
  rw [quarticKernelSynthesis_lift _ _ _ 0 a]
  exact hc

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_eq_point_of_piece_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (formToRingQuotient t (pointDegreeSpace K a d)) =
      pointDegreePiece K a t := by
    ext f
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (choppedIdeal K a d) f.val = 0 ↔
      f ∈ pointDegreePiece K a t
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, h f, homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff]
  change finrank K (LinearMap.range (formToRingQuotient t (pointDegreeSpace K a d))) = _
  rw [pointHilbertFunction, ← hker]
  exact (formToRingQuotient t (pointDegreeSpace K a d)).quotKerEquivRange.finrank_eq.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreeSpace_eq_chop_generating_degree
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    exact ⟨pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous a hf, Ideal.subset_span hf⟩
  · intro f hf
    rw [pointDegreeSpace_eq_idealDegreeSpace]
    exact ⟨hf.1, choppedIdeal_le_pointIdeal a hf.2⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.chopEqualsPointPiece_of_interpolation
statement:
theorem chopEqualsPointPiece_of_interpolation {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a (d - 1))) :
    ∀ t, d ≤ t → ChopEqualsPointPiece K a d t
proof:
:= by
  have hall := pointDegreeSpace_eq_of_degree_eq a hd hsurj
    (choppedIdeal K a d) (choppedIdeal_le_pointIdeal a)
    (pointDegreeSpace_eq_chop_generating_degree a)
  intro t ht f
  have heq := hall t ht
  rw [pointDegreeSpace_eq_idealDegreeSpace] at heq
  have hh := congrArg (fun U : Submodule K (Poly K 3) => f.val ∈ U) heq
  simpa [idealDegreeSpace, f.property] using hh.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.N_pred_lt
statement: theorem N_pred_lt {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) : N (d - 1) < N d
proof:
:= by
  have hs := N_succ (d - 1)
  rw [show d - 1 + 1 = d by omega] at hs
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.mainConclusion_of_small_point_count
statement:
theorem mainConclusion_of_small_point_count {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hp : p ≤ N (d - 1)) (hdist : DistinctPoints K a)
    (hpoint : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p) :
    MainConclusion K a d
proof:
:= by
  have hpNd : p < N d := hp.trans_lt (N_pred_lt hd)
  have hprev : pointHilbertFunction K a (d - 1) = p := by
    rw [hpoint, min_eq_right hp]
  have hsurj := pointEvaluation_surjective_of_hilbert_eq a hprev
  have hequal := chopEqualsPointPiece_of_interpolation a hd hsurj
  refine ⟨hdist, hpoint, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t
    by_cases ht : t < d
    · rw [choppedHilbertFunction_below_degree a ht]
      simp [expectedChoppedHilbertFunction, ht, N]
    · rw [choppedHilbertFunction_eq_point_of_piece_eq a (hequal t (by omega))]
      have hconst := pointHilbertFunction_constant_above a
        (show d - 1 ≤ t by omega) hprev
      simpa [expectedChoppedHilbertFunction, ht, not_le.mpr hpNd, hp] using hconst
  · intro hn
    omega
  · intro _
    exact hequal
  · intro hn
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.mainConclusion_of_large_point_count
statement:
theorem mainConclusion_of_large_point_count {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hp : N d ≤ p) (hdist : DistinctPoints K a)
    (hpoint : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p) :
    MainConclusion K a d
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : pointHilbertFunction K a d = (d + 2).choose 2 := by
    rw [hpoint, min_eq_left hp]
    rfl
  have hi : Function.Injective (pointEvaluation K a d) := by
    apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
    apply Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp
    change finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = 0
    rw [pointDegreePiece_finrank, hdim, Nat.sub_self]
  have hpPrev : N (d - 1) < p := (N_pred_lt hd).trans_le hp
  refine ⟨hdist, hpoint, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t
    rw [choppedHilbertFunction_of_injective a hi]
    by_cases ht : t < d
    · simp [expectedChoppedHilbertFunction, ht, N]
    · rw [expectedChoppedHilbertFunction, ite_eq_right ht, ite_eq_left hp]
      rfl
  · intro _
    exact choppedIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective a hi
  · intro hn
    omega
  · intro _ hn
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_outside_intermediate
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_outside_intermediate [CharZero K]
    (d p : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (houtside : p ≤ N (d - 1) ∨ N d ≤ p) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := generic_pointHilbertFunction (K := K) p
  refine ⟨D, hD, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨hdist, hpoint⟩ := hgood a ha
  have hh : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p := by
    simpa [N] using hpoint
  rcases houtside with hp | hp
  · exact mainConclusion_of_small_point_count a hd hp hdist hh
  · exact mainConclusion_of_large_point_count a hd hp hdist hh

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv_apply [Finite J] [CharZero K]
    (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ)
    (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → negativeGrade (K := K) g r)
    (p : Sym (Fin 3) t → positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv g r t q p =
      auxiliaryCoefficientPair (residuePair g r) t q p
proof:
:= by
  change auxiliaryResiduePair g r t ((negativeGradeSplit g r).symm q)
    ((positiveGradeSplit g r).symm p) = _
  simpa only [auxiliaryGeneratorWeights, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
    (auxiliaryResiduePair_eq_coefficientPair (K := K) g r t
      ((negativeGradeSplit g r).symm q) ((positiveGradeSplit g r).symm p))

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.first_second_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem first_second_linearIndependent {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K) :
    LinearIndependent K (![firstForm α, secondForm β] : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d)
proof:
:= by
  apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mpr
  intro c hc i
  have hc' : c 0 • firstEquation α + c 1 • secondEquation β = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : Forms K 3 d => dehom f.val) hc
    simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul, Submodule.coe_zero, map_add, map_zero, firstForm, secondForm,
      dehom_smul, dehom_first, dehom_second] using h
  obtain ⟨h0,h1⟩ := grid_equations_independent hd α β hc'
  fin_cases i <;> assumption

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.grid_span_coannihilator
statement:
theorem grid_span_coannihilator {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    (span K (Set.range (gridEvaluation α β))).dualCoannihilator =
      span K ({firstForm α,secondForm β} : Set (Forms K 3 d))
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.coe_dualCoannihilator_span]
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.forall_mem_range, gridEvaluation,
    evaluationLinear_apply, Prod.forall, mem_span_pair]
  exact (grid_forms_kernel hd α β hα hβ f).trans (by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a,b,h⟩
      exact ⟨a,b,h.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨a,b,h⟩
      exact ⟨a,b,h.symm⟩)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.grid_span_finrank
statement:
theorem grid_span_finrank {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    finrank K (span K (Set.range (gridEvaluation α β))) = (d + 2).choose 2 - 2
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : Set.range (![firstForm α, secondForm β] : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d) =
      ({firstForm α,secondForm β} : Set (Forms K 3 d)) := by
    ext f
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i,rfl⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨0,rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1,rfl⟩
  have hk : finrank K (span K ({firstForm α,secondForm β} : Set (Forms K 3 d))) = 2 := by
    rw [← hrange, finrank_span_eq_card (first_second_linearIndependent hd α β)]
    simp
  have hdim := Subspace.finrank_add_finrank_dualCoannihilator_eq
    (span K (Set.range (gridEvaluation α β)))
  rw [grid_span_coannihilator hd α β hα hβ, hk, finrank_plane_forms] at hdim
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.exists_spanning_grid_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_spanning_grid_coordinates {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    ∃ sel : Fin ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2) → Fin d × Fin d,
      Function.Injective sel ∧
      span K (Set.range (gridEvaluation α β ∘ sel)) =
        span K (Set.range (gridEvaluation α β))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨κ,a,ha,hspan,hli⟩ := exists_linearIndependent' K (gridEvaluation α β)
  have : Finite κ := Finite.of_injective a ha
  have : Fintype κ := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  have hcard : Fintype.card κ = (d + 2).choose 2 - 2 := by
    rw [← finrank_span_eq_card hli, hspan]
    exact grid_span_finrank hd α β hα hβ
  let e : Fin ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2) ≃ κ := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard).symm
  refine ⟨a ∘ e,ha.comp e.injective,?_⟩
  have hset : Set.range (gridEvaluation α β ∘ (a ∘ e)) =
      Set.range (gridEvaluation α β ∘ a) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i,rfl⟩
      exact ⟨e i,rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨k,rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := e.surjective k
      exact ⟨i,rfl⟩
  rw [hset]
  exact hspan

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.exists_grid_subset
statement:
theorem exists_grid_subset {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    ∃ coords : PointCoordinates K ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2),
      DistinctPoints K coords ∧
      (∀ f : Forms K 3 d,
        (∀ i, MvPolynomial.eval (chartPoint K coords i) f.val = 0) ↔
          ∃ a b : K, f = a • firstForm α + b • secondForm β) ∧
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) [planeFirst α,planeSecond β]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨sel,hsel,hspan⟩ := exists_spanning_grid_coordinates hd α β hα hβ
  let coords : PointCoordinates K ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2) :=
    fun ic => ![α (sel ic.1).1,β (sel ic.1).2] ic.2
  refine ⟨coords,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    apply hsel
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply hα
      simpa only [coords, Matrix.cons_val_zero] using congrArg Prod.fst hij
    · apply hβ
      simpa [coords] using congrArg Prod.snd hij
  · intro f
    have hvan : (∀ i, (gridEvaluation α β ∘ sel) i f = 0) ↔
        ∀ ij, gridEvaluation α β ij f = 0 := by
      have hco := congrArg Submodule.dualCoannihilator hspan
      have hf := congrArg (fun W : Submodule K (Forms K 3 d) => f ∈ W) hco
      simpa only [← SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.coe_dualCoannihilator_span,
        Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.forall_mem_range] using (eq_iff_iff.mp hf)
    have hleft : (∀ i, MvPolynomial.eval (chartPoint K coords i) f.val = 0) ↔
        ∀ i, (gridEvaluation α β ∘ sel) i f = 0 := by
      simp only [coords, chartPoint, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Function.comp_apply, gridEvaluation, evaluationLinear_apply]
    rw [hleft,hvan]
    simpa only [gridEvaluation, evaluationLinear_apply, Prod.forall] using
      grid_forms_kernel hd α β hα hβ f
  · exact homogeneous_regular_pair hd (firstForm α) (secondForm β)
      (planeFirst_ne_zero α) (plane_equations_relPrime α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeFirst_eval_other_infinity
statement:
@[simp] theorem planeFirst_eval_other_infinity {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α : Fin d → K) :
    eval ![0,1,0] (planeFirst α) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [planeFirst, Finset.prod_const, Nat.ne_of_gt hd]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.planeSecond_eval_other_infinity
statement:
@[simp] theorem planeSecond_eval_other_infinity {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (β : Fin d → K) :
    eval ![1,0,0] (planeSecond β) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [planeSecond, Finset.prod_const, Nat.ne_of_gt hd]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.lower_form_eq_zero_of_grid_kernel
statement:
theorem lower_form_eq_zero_of_grid_kernel {p d t : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (α β : Fin d → K) (coords : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hkernel : ∀ f : Forms K 3 d,
      (∀ i, eval (chartPoint K coords i) f.val = 0) ↔
        ∃ a b : K, f = a • firstForm α + b • secondForm β)
    (ht : t < d) (h : Forms K 3 t)
    (hv : ∀ i, eval (chartPoint K coords i) h.val = 0) : h = 0
proof:
:= by
  let lifted : Forms K 3 d := ⟨X 2 ^ (d - t) * h.val, by
    change (X 2 ^ (d - t) * h.val).IsHomogeneous d
    have hh := (isHomogeneous_X_pow (R := K) (2 : Fin 3) (d - t)).mul h.property
    simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_of_lt ht)] using hh⟩
  have hvl : ∀ i, eval (chartPoint K coords i) lifted.val = 0 := by
    intro i
    simp [lifted, hv i]
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab⟩ := (hkernel lifted).mp hvl
  have ha : a = 0 := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun f : Forms K 3 d => eval ![1,0,0] f.val) hab
    simpa [lifted, firstForm, secondForm, planeSecond_eval_other_infinity hd,
      Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt ht), MvPolynomial.smul_eq_C_mul] using hh.symm
  have hb : b = 0 := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun f : Forms K 3 d => eval ![0,1,0] f.val) hab
    simpa [lifted, firstForm, secondForm, planeFirst_eval_other_infinity hd,
      Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt ht), MvPolynomial.smul_eq_C_mul] using hh.symm
  have hz : lifted = 0 := by simpa only [ha,hb,zero_smul,zero_add] using hab
  have hval : X 2 ^ (d - t) * h.val = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hz
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hval).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ (X_ne_zero (2 : Fin 3)))

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.exists_two_generator_witness
statement:
theorem exists_two_generator_witness (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ (coords : PointCoordinates K ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2))
      (f g : Forms K 3 d),
      DistinctPoints K coords ∧
      (∀ h : Forms K 3 d,
        (∀ i, eval (chartPoint K coords i) h.val = 0) ↔
          ∃ a b : K, h = a • f + b • g) ∧
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) [f.val,g.val] ∧
      (∀ t : ℕ, t < d → ∀ h : Forms K 3 t,
        (∀ i, eval (chartPoint K coords i) h.val = 0) → h = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let α : Fin d → K := fun i => Infinite.natEmbedding K i.val
  have hα : Function.Injective α :=
    (Infinite.natEmbedding K).injective.comp Fin.val_injective
  obtain ⟨coords,hcoords,hkernel,hreg⟩ := exists_grid_subset hd α α hα hα
  refine ⟨coords,firstForm α,secondForm α,hcoords,hkernel,hreg,?_⟩
  intro t ht h hv
  exact lower_form_eq_zero_of_grid_kernel hd α α coords hkernel ht h hv

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.grid_equation_span_finrank
statement:
theorem grid_equation_span_finrank {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (α β : Fin d → K) :
    finrank K (span K ({firstForm α,secondForm β} : Set (Forms K 3 d))) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : Set.range (![firstForm α, secondForm β] : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d) =
      ({firstForm α,secondForm β} : Set (Forms K 3 d)) := by
    ext f
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i,rfl⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨0,rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1,rfl⟩
  rw [← hrange, finrank_span_eq_card (first_second_linearIndependent hd α β)]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.degree_piece_eq_grid_span
statement:
theorem degree_piece_eq_grid_span {p d : ℕ} (α β : Fin d → K)
    (coords : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hkernel : ∀ f : Forms K 3 d,
      (∀ i, eval (chartPoint K coords i) f.val = 0) ↔
        ∃ a b : K, f = a • firstForm α + b • secondForm β) :
    pointDegreePiece K coords d =
      span K ({firstForm α,secondForm β} : Set (Forms K 3 d))
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [mem_pointDegreePiece,mem_span_pair]
  exact (hkernel f).trans (by
    constructor <;> rintro ⟨a,b,h⟩ <;> exact ⟨a,b,h.symm⟩)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.grid_subset_evaluation_surjective
statement:
theorem grid_subset_evaluation_surjective {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (α β : Fin d → K) (coords : PointCoordinates K ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2))
    (hkernel : ∀ f : Forms K 3 d,
      (∀ i, eval (chartPoint K coords i) f.val = 0) ↔
        ∃ a b : K, f = a • firstForm α + b • secondForm β) :
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K coords d)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : finrank K (pointEvaluation K coords d).ker = 2 := by
    change finrank K (pointDegreePiece K coords d) = 2
    rw [degree_piece_eq_grid_span α β coords hkernel]
    exact grid_equation_span_finrank hd α β
  have hdim := (pointEvaluation K coords d).finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [hk,finrank_plane_forms] at hdim
  apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
  apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
  simp only [Module.finrank_pi_fintype, finrank_self, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.exists_two_generator_rank_witness
statement:
theorem exists_two_generator_rank_witness (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ (coords : PointCoordinates K ((d + 2).choose 2 - 2)) (f g : Forms K 3 d),
      DistinctPoints K coords ∧
      pointDegreePiece K coords d = span K ({f,g} : Set (Forms K 3 d)) ∧
      finrank K (pointDegreePiece K coords d) = 2 ∧
      Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K coords d) ∧
      (∀ t : ℕ, t < d → Function.Injective (pointEvaluation K coords t)) ∧
      f.val ≠ 0 ∧ IsRelPrime f.val g.val ∧
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) [f.val,g.val]
proof:
:= by
  let α : Fin d → K := fun i => Infinite.natEmbedding K i.val
  have hα : Function.Injective α :=
    (Infinite.natEmbedding K).injective.comp Fin.val_injective
  obtain ⟨coords,hcoords,hkernel,hreg⟩ := exists_grid_subset hd α α hα hα
  refine ⟨coords,firstForm α,secondForm α,hcoords,
    degree_piece_eq_grid_span α α coords hkernel,?_,
    grid_subset_evaluation_surjective hd α α coords hkernel,?_,
    planeFirst_ne_zero α,plane_equations_relPrime α α,hreg⟩
  · rw [degree_piece_eq_grid_span α α coords hkernel]
    exact grid_equation_span_finrank hd α α
  · intro t ht
    apply (injective_iff_map_eq_zero (pointEvaluation K coords t)).mpr
    intro h hh
    apply lower_form_eq_zero_of_grid_kernel hd α α coords hkernel ht h
    intro i
    have hhi := congrFun hh i
    simpa only [pointEvaluation_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using hhi

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowMatrix_coordinates
statement:
@[simp] theorem universalRowMatrix_coordinates (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K δ) :
    universalRowMatrix δ (rowMatrixCoordinates δ B) = B
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  exact (formsBasis K 3 (δ i)).sum_repr (B i j)

name: ChoppedPlane.rowMatrixVal_homogeneous
statement:
theorem rowMatrixVal_homogeneous (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K δ) :
    ∀ i j, (rowMatrixVal δ B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i)
proof: := fun i j => (B i j).property

name: ChoppedPlane.coefficientSpecialization_isPolynomialFamily
proof:
:= by
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r => simpa [coefficientSpecialization] using
      (isPolynomialFamily_const (ι := ι) r)
  | add P Q hP hQ => simpa only [map_add] using hP.add hQ
  | mul_X P i hP =>
      simpa [coefficientSpecialization, Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm] using
        (isPolynomialFamily_coordinate (K := K) i).smul hP

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowEntryPolynomial_specialize
statement:
@[simp] theorem universalRowEntryPolynomial_specialize (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K) (i : Fin (c + 1)) (j : Fin c) :
    coefficientSpecialization u (universalRowEntryPolynomial δ i j) =
      rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u) i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientSpecialization, universalRowEntryPolynomial, rowMatrixVal,
    universalRowMatrix, Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]

name: ChoppedPlane.universalSignedCofactorPolynomial_specialize
statement:
@[simp] theorem universalSignedCofactorPolynomial_specialize
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    coefficientSpecialization u (universalSignedCofactorPolynomial δ i) =
      signedMaximalMinor (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [universalSignedCofactorPolynomial, signedMaximalMinor, map_mul,
    map_pow, map_neg, map_one, maximalMinor, RingHom.map_det]
  apply congrArg (fun p : Poly K 3 => (-1) ^ i.val * p)
  apply congrArg Matrix.det
  funext j k
  exact universalRowEntryPolynomial_specialize δ u _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.universalSignedCofactor_isPolynomialFamily
statement:
theorem universalSignedCofactor_isPolynomialFamily (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K =>
      signedMaximalMinor (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [universalSignedCofactorPolynomial_specialize] using
    coefficientSpecialization_isPolynomialFamily (K := K)
      (universalSignedCofactorPolynomial (K := K) δ i)

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowCofactorForm_isPolynomialFamily
statement:
theorem universalRowCofactorForm_isPolynomialFamily (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K =>
      universalRowCofactorForm δ u i)
proof:
:= by
  let P : Poly K 3 →ₗ[K] Forms K 3 ((∑ j, δ j) - δ i) :=
    (homogeneousComponent ((∑ j, δ j) - δ i)).codRestrict _
      (homogeneousComponent_mem _)
  have h := (universalSignedCofactor_isPolynomialFamily δ i).linear_comp P
  convert h using 1
  funext u
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (homogeneousComponent_eq_self
    (universalRowCofactorForm δ u i).property).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.maximalMinorIdeal_homogeneous
statement:
theorem maximalMinorIdeal_homogeneous {n : ℕ}
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i)) :
    (maximalMinorIdeal B).IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.homogeneous_span
  rintro f ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨_, signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_total B δ hB i⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.signedProjection_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem signedProjection_self (n : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (f : signedForms K n t) :
    signedProjection n t f.val = f
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact signedComponent_self t f

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowCofactorMap_isPolynomialFamily
statement:
theorem universalRowCofactorMap_isPolynomialFamily (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (e : ℤ) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K =>
      gradedCofactorMap (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) δ
        (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ _) e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply isPolynomialFamily_linearMap
  intro v
  have h := IsPolynomialFamily.sum (fun i =>
    (universalSignedCofactor_isPolynomialFamily δ i).linear_comp
      (polynomialMulRight 3 (v i).val))
  have hp := h.linear_comp (signedProjection 3 (e + ∑ i, δ i))
  convert hp using 1
  funext u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change _ = signedComponent _
    (gradedCofactorMap (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) δ
      (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ _) e v).val
  exact (signedComponent_self _
    (gradedCofactorMap (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) δ
      (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ _) e v)).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.infinityMap_homogeneous
statement:
theorem infinityMap_homogeneous {t : ℕ} {f : Poly K 3} (hf : f.IsHomogeneous t) :
    (Ferrers.infinityMap f).IsHomogeneous t
proof:
:= by
  change (eval₂ (C : K →+* Poly K 2) ![X 0, X 1, 0] f).IsHomogeneous t
  have h : (eval₂ (C : K →+* Poly K 2) ![X 0, X 1, 0] f).IsHomogeneous (1 * t) :=
    hf.eval₂ (C : K →+* Poly K 2) ![X 0, X 1, 0]
      (fun k => MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C (σ := Fin 2) k)
      (fun i => by
        fin_cases i
        · exact isHomogeneous_X K 0
        · exact isHomogeneous_X K 1
        · exact isHomogeneous_zero (Fin 2) K 1)
  rw [Nat.one_mul] at h
  exact h

name: ChoppedPlane.universalInfinityMatrix_homogeneous
statement:
theorem universalInfinityMatrix_homogeneous (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K) :
    ∀ i j, (universalInfinityMatrix δ u i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i)
proof:
:=
  fun i j => infinityMap_homogeneous (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ _ i j)

name: ChoppedPlane.universalInfinitySignedCofactor_isPolynomialFamily
statement:
theorem universalInfinitySignedCofactor_isPolynomialFamily
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K =>
      signedMaximalMinor (universalInfinityMatrix δ u) i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [universalInfinityMatrix, signedMaximalMinor_map, infinityLinear,
    LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk] using
    (universalSignedCofactor_isPolynomialFamily δ i).linear_comp infinityLinear

name: ChoppedPlane.universalInfinityCofactorMap_isPolynomialFamily
statement:
theorem universalInfinityCofactorMap_isPolynomialFamily
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (e : ℤ) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K =>
      gradedCofactorMap (universalInfinityMatrix δ u) δ
        (universalInfinityMatrix_homogeneous δ u) e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply isPolynomialFamily_linearMap
  intro v
  have h := IsPolynomialFamily.sum (fun i =>
    (universalInfinitySignedCofactor_isPolynomialFamily δ i).linear_comp
      (polynomialMulRight 2 (v i).val))
  have hp := h.linear_comp (signedProjection 2 (e + ∑ i, δ i))
  convert hp using 1
  funext u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change _ = signedComponent _
    (gradedCofactorMap (universalInfinityMatrix δ u) δ
      (universalInfinityMatrix_homogeneous δ u) e v).val
  exact (signedComponent_self _
    (gradedCofactorMap (universalInfinityMatrix δ u) δ
      (universalInfinityMatrix_homogeneous δ u) e v)).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.surjective_polynomial_principal_open
statement:
theorem surjective_polynomial_principal_open {ι V W : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] W)) (hA : IsPolynomialFamily A)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (h₀ : Function.Surjective (A a₀)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (A a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, h⟩ := rank_polynomial_principal_open A hA a₀
  refine ⟨D, hD, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
  apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
  apply le_antisymm (Submodule.finrank_le _)
  have hr := h a ha
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr h₀, finrank_top] at hr
  exact hr

name: ChoppedPlane.universalInfinity_surjective_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalInfinity_surjective_principal_open
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (e : ℤ) (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K δ)
    (hB : Function.Surjective
      (gradedCofactorMap ((rowMatrixVal δ B).map Ferrers.infinityMap) δ
        (fun i j => infinityMap_homogeneous (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ B i j)) e)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      eval (rowMatrixCoordinates δ B) D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        Function.Surjective (gradedCofactorMap (universalInfinityMatrix δ u) δ
          (universalInfinityMatrix_homogeneous δ u) e)
proof:
:= by
  apply surjective_polynomial_principal_open _
    (universalInfinityCofactorMap_isPolynomialFamily δ e) (rowMatrixCoordinates δ B)
  simpa only [universalInfinityMatrix, universalRowMatrix_coordinates] using hB

name: ChoppedPlane.universalInfinity_degree_cut_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalInfinity_degree_cut_principal_open
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K δ)
    (hB : Function.Surjective
      (gradedCofactorMap ((rowMatrixVal δ B).map Ferrers.infinityMap) δ
        (fun i j => infinityMap_homogeneous (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ B i j))
        ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i))) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      eval (rowMatrixCoordinates δ B) D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 →
        ∀ f : Forms K 2 N, f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal (universalInfinityMatrix δ u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, h⟩ := universalInfinity_surjective_principal_open δ
    ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i) B hB
  refine ⟨D, hD, fun u hu f => ?_⟩
  have hmem : f.val ∈ signedForms K 2 ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i + ∑ i, δ i) := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel, signedForms_nat] using f.property
  let f' : signedForms K 2 ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i + ∑ i, δ i) := ⟨f.val, hmem⟩
  have hr : f' ∈ (gradedCofactorMap (universalInfinityMatrix δ u) δ
      (universalInfinityMatrix_homogeneous δ u) ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i)).range := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (h u hu)]
    trivial
  rw [gradedCofactorMap_range_eq_idealPiece] at hr
  exact hr

name: ChoppedPlane.generatedHilbertFunction_eq_pointHilbertFunction_of_ideal_eq
statement:
theorem generatedHilbertFunction_eq_pointHilbertFunction_of_ideal_eq
    (a : PointCoordinates K p) (U : Submodule K (Poly K 3))
    (hI : Ideal.span (U : Set (Poly K 3)) = pointIdeal K a) (t : ℕ) :
    generatedHilbertFunction U t = pointHilbertFunction K a t
proof:
:= by
  have hker : (formToRingQuotient t U).ker = pointDegreePiece K a t := by
    ext f
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (U : Set (Poly K 3))) f.val = 0 ↔
      f ∈ pointDegreePiece K a t
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem,hI]
    exact homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff a f
  have h := (formToRingQuotient t U).quotKerEquivRange.finrank_eq
  rw [hker] at h
  exact h.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction_of_ideal_eq
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction_of_ideal_eq
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c+1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hI : maximalMinorIdeal B = pointIdeal K a) (t : ℕ) :
    pointHilbertFunction K a t = minorHilbertFunction B (t : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← generatedHilbertFunction_minorGeneratorSpace]
  symm
  apply generatedHilbertFunction_eq_pointHilbertFunction_of_ideal_eq
  rw [minorGeneratorSpace_idealSpan,hI]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seedMatrix_maximalMinorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_maximalMinorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal (δ : Fin (c+1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    maximalMinorIdeal (seedMatrix δ α β) = pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates δ α β)
proof:
:= by
  change ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal (seedMatrix δ α β) = _
  rw [seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal,cofactorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal δ α β hα hβ]

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction (δ : Fin (c+1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (t : ℕ) :
    pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates δ α β) t =
      minorHilbertFunction (seedMatrix δ α β) (t : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction_of_ideal_eq _ _
    (seedMatrix_maximalMinorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal δ α β hα hβ) t

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.pointHilbertFunction_formula
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_formula (δ : Fin (c+1) → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex δ → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) (t : ℕ) :
    (pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates δ α β) t : ℤ) = N₂ t -
      (∑ i, N₂ ((t : ℤ) - (∑ j, δ j) + δ i)) +
      (c : ℤ) * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction δ α β hα hβ]
  exact minorHilbertFunction_at_degree _ δ (seedMatrix_homogeneous δ α β)
    (seedMatrix_primitive δ α β) t

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_maximalMinorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_maximalMinorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex ε → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    maximalMinorIdeal (seedMatrix ε α β) = pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α β)
proof:
:= by
  change ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal (seedMatrix ε α β) = _
  rw [seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal,cofactorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal ε α β hα hβ]

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex ε → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (t : ℕ) :
    pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates ε α β) t =
      minorHilbertFunction (seedMatrix ε α β) (t : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction_of_ideal_eq _ _
    (seedMatrix_maximalMinorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal ε α β hα hβ) t

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pointHilbertFunction_formula
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_formula (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) (t : ℕ) :
    (pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates ε α β) t : ℤ) = N₂ t -
      ((c : ℤ)+1) * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - ∑ j, ε j) +
      ∑ j, N₂ ((t : ℤ) - (∑ k, ε k) - ε j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointHilbertFunction_eq_minorHilbertFunction ε α β hα hβ]
  exact minorHilbertFunction_columns_at_degree _ ε (seedMatrix_homogeneous ε α β)
    (seedMatrix_primitive ε α β) t

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.choppedIdeal_eq_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem choppedIdeal_eq_pointIdeal (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    choppedIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α β) (∑ j, ε j) =
      pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (choppedIdeal_le_pointIdeal _)
  rw [← cofactorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal ε α β hα hβ]
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  rintro f ⟨k,rfl⟩
  apply Ideal.subset_span
  let g : Forms K 3 (∑ j, ε j) :=
    ⟨cofactorProduct ε α β k,cofactorProduct_homogeneous ε α β k⟩
  change g.val ∈ (pointDegreePiece K (pointCoordinates ε α β) (∑ j, ε j)).map
    (Forms K 3 (∑ j, ε j)).subtype
  apply Submodule.mem_map.mpr
  refine ⟨g,?_,rfl⟩
  apply (homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff _ g).mp
  exact cofactorIdeal_le_pointIdeal ε α β (Ideal.subset_span ⟨k,rfl⟩)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.choppedHilbertFunction_eq_pointHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_eq_pointHilbertFunction (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex ε → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (t : ℕ) :
    choppedHilbertFunction (pointCoordinates ε α β) (∑ j, ε j) t =
      pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates ε α β) t
proof:
:=
  generatedHilbertFunction_eq_pointHilbertFunction_of_ideal_eq _ _
    (choppedIdeal_eq_pointIdeal ε α β hα hβ) t

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pointHilbertFunction_below_generatingDegree
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_below_generatingDegree (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex ε → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t < ∑ j, ε j) :
    pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates ε α β) t = N t
proof:
:= by
  have h := pointHilbertFunction_formula ε α β hα hβ t
  have hnat : (t : ℤ) < ((∑ j, ε j : ℕ) : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast ht
  have hneg : (t : ℤ) - ((∑ j, ε j : ℕ) : ℤ) < 0 := sub_neg.mpr hnat
  have hj (j : Fin c) : N₂ ((t : ℤ) - (∑ k, ε k) - ε j) = 0 :=
    N₂_neg (by have := ε j; omega)
  simp_rw [hj] at h
  rw [N₂_neg hneg,N₂_nat] at h
  simp only [mul_zero,sub_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero,add_zero] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pointHilbertFunction_at_generatingDegree
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_at_generatingDegree (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex ε → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (hε : ∀ j, 0 < ε j)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = N (∑ j, ε j) - (c+1)) :
    pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates ε α β) (∑ j, ε j) =
      Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε)
proof:
:= by
  have h := pointHilbertFunction_formula ε α β hα hβ (∑ j, ε j)
  have hj (j : Fin c) : N₂ (-(ε j : ℤ)) = 0 := by
    apply N₂_neg
    have hh : (0 : ℤ) < ε j := by exact_mod_cast hε j
    omega
  simp only [sub_self,zero_sub] at h
  simp_rw [hj] at h
  have hz : N₂ (0 : ℤ) = 1 := by norm_num [N₂,N]
  rw [hz,N₂_nat] at h
  simp only [Finset.sum_const_zero,add_zero,mul_one] at h
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pointEvaluation_surjective_at_generatingDegree
statement:
theorem pointEvaluation_surjective_at_generatingDegree (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex ε → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (hε : ∀ j, 0 < ε j)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = N (∑ j, ε j) - (c+1)) :
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K (pointCoordinates ε α β) (∑ j, ε j))
proof:
:=
  pointEvaluation_surjective_of_hilbert_eq _
    (pointHilbertFunction_at_generatingDegree ε α β hα hβ hε hcard)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.fullPointHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem fullPointHilbertFunction (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) (hε : ∀ j, 0 < ε j)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = N (∑ j, ε j) - (c+1)) (t : ℕ) :
    pointHilbertFunction K (pointCoordinates ε α β) t =
      min (N t) (Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : t < ∑ j, ε j
  · have hf := pointHilbertFunction_below_generatingDegree ε α β hα hβ ht
    have hle := pointHilbertFunction_le (d := t) (pointCoordinates ε α β)
    change _ ≤ min (N t) _ at hle
    rw [hf] at hle ⊢
    exact le_antisymm hle (min_le_left _ _)
  · have hf := pointHilbertFunction_constant_above (pointCoordinates ε α β)
      (Nat.le_of_not_gt ht) (pointHilbertFunction_at_generatingDegree ε α β hα hβ hε hcard)
    have hle := pointHilbertFunction_le (d := t) (pointCoordinates ε α β)
    change _ ≤ min (N t) _ at hle
    rw [hf] at hle ⊢
    exact le_antisymm hle (min_le_right _ _)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativePart_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem negativePart_coeff (p : BinaryLaurent K) (e : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (negativePart p).coeff e = if e.1 < 0 ∧ e.2 < 0 then p.coeff e else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (p.coeff.filter (· ∈ negativeExponents)) e = _
  by_cases he : e.1 < 0 ∧ e.2 < 0 <;>
    simp [Finsupp.filter, negativeExponents, he]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativePart_mem
statement: theorem negativePart_mem (p : BinaryLaurent K) : negativePart p ∈ negativeSpace
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported'.mpr
  intro e he
  rw [negativePart_coeff]
  exact ite_eq_right he

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativePart_eq_self
statement:
theorem negativePart_eq_self {p : BinaryLaurent K} (hp : p ∈ negativeSpace) :
    negativePart p = p
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  by_cases he : e.1 < 0 ∧ e.2 < 0
  · simp [he]
  · have hz := AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported'.mp hp e he
    simp [he, hz]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.chart_sup_eq_supported
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chartU, chartV, AddMonoidAlgebra.supported_eq_map,
    ← Submodule.map_sup, ← Finsupp.supported_union]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.ker_negativePart
statement: theorem ker_negativePart : LinearMap.ker (negativePart (K := K)) = chartU ⊔ chartV
proof:
:= by
  rw [chart_sup_eq_supported]
  ext p
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported']
  constructor
  · intro hp e he
    have he' : e.1 < 0 ∧ e.2 < 0 := by change ¬(0 ≤ e.2 ∨ 0 ≤ e.1) at he; omega
    have hz := congrArg (fun q : BinaryLaurent K => q.coeff e) hp
    simpa [he'] using hz
  · intro hp
    ext e
    by_cases he : e.1 < 0 ∧ e.2 < 0
    · have he' : e ∉ {e : ℤ × ℤ | 0 ≤ e.2 ∨ 0 ≤ e.1} := by simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]; omega
      simp [he, hp e he']
    · simp [he]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativeProjection_surjective
statement: theorem negativeProjection_surjective : Function.Surjective (negativeProjection (K := K))
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  refine ⟨p.val, Subtype.ext (negativePart_eq_self p.property)⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.ker_negativeProjection
statement: theorem ker_negativeProjection : LinearMap.ker (negativeProjection (K := K)) = chartU ⊔ chartV
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ker_negativePart]
  ext p
  change negativeProjection p = 0 ↔ negativePart p = 0
  exact Subtype.ext_iff

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativeQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem negativeQuotientEquiv_mk (p : BinaryLaurent K) :
    negativeQuotientEquiv ((chartU ⊔ chartV).mkQ p) = negativeProjection p
proof:
:= by
  simp [negativeQuotientEquiv]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.freeLaurentEquiv_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeLaurentEquiv_coeff [Finite ι] (p : FreeLaurent K ι)
    (i : ι) (e : ℤ × ℤ) : (freeLaurentEquiv p i).coeff e = p (i, e)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.positiveCoordinates_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveCoordinates_apply (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    positiveCoordinates g r p e = p.val e.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativeCoordinates_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem negativeCoordinates_apply (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (p : negativeGrade (K := K) g r) (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    negativeCoordinates g r p e = p.val (complementIndex g r e).val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.positiveBasis_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveBasis_val (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    (positiveBasis (K := K) g r e).val = Finsupp.single e.val 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_single (positiveIndices g r) e 1

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.residuePair_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem residuePair_basis [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g r) (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    residuePair g r q (positiveBasis g r e) = q.val (complementIndex g r e).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (positiveBasis g r).toDualEquiv
    ((positiveCoordinates g r).symm (negativeCoordinates g r q)) (positiveBasis g r e) = _
  rw [Basis.toDualEquiv_apply, Basis.toDual_apply_left]
  change positiveCoordinates g r ((positiveCoordinates g r).symm (negativeCoordinates g r q)) e = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact negativeCoordinates_apply g r q e

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.shift_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_apply (m : ℤ × ℤ) (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (i : ι) (e : ℤ × ℤ) :
    shift m p (i,e) = p (i,(e.1-m.1,e.2-m.2))
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.freeNegativePart_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeNegativePart_apply (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (i : ι) (e : ℤ × ℤ) :
    freeNegativePart p (i,e) = if e.1 < 0 ∧ e.2 < 0 then p (i,e) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (p.filter (fun e => e.2.1 < 0 ∧ e.2.2 < 0)) (i,e) = _
  by_cases he : e.1 < 0 ∧ e.2 < 0 <;> simp [Finsupp.filter, he]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.positiveShift_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveShift_apply (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (m : ℕ × ℕ)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) (i : ι) (e : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (positiveShift g r m p).val (i,e) = p.val (i,(e.1-m.1,e.2-m.2))
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativeShift_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem negativeShift_apply (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (m : ℕ × ℕ)
    (p : negativeGrade (K := K) g (r+m.1+m.2)) (i : ι) (e : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (negativeShift g r m p).val (i,e) =
      if e.1 < 0 ∧ e.2 < 0 then p.val (i,(e.1-m.1,e.2-m.2)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  exact freeNegativePart_apply _ i e

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.positiveShift_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveShift_basis (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (m : ℕ × ℕ)
    (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    positiveShift g r m (positiveBasis (K := K) g r e) =
      positiveBasis g (r+m.1+m.2) (positiveIndexShift g r m e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Subtype.ext
  change shift _ (positiveBasis g r e).val = _
  rw [positiveBasis_val, positiveBasis_val]
  exact Finsupp.domLCongr_single (exponentTranslate _) e.val 1

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.residuePair_shift
statement:
theorem residuePair_shift [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (m : ℕ × ℕ)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g (r+m.1+m.2)) (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    residuePair g (r+m.1+m.2) q (positiveShift g r m p) =
      residuePair g r (negativeShift g r m q) p
proof:
:= by
  have h : (residuePair g (r+m.1+m.2) q).comp (positiveShift g r m) =
      residuePair g r (negativeShift g r m q) := by
    apply (positiveBasis g r).ext
    intro e
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, positiveShift_basis, residuePair_basis, residuePair_basis,
      negativeShift_apply]
    have hn : -1 - e.val.2.1 < 0 ∧ -1 - e.val.2.2 < 0 := by
      obtain ⟨ha,hb,hab⟩ := e.property
      omega
    change q.val (e.val.1,(-1-(e.val.2.1+m.1),-1-(e.val.2.2+m.2))) =
      if -1-e.val.2.1 < 0 ∧ -1-e.val.2.2 < 0 then
        q.val (e.val.1,((-1-e.val.2.1)-m.1,(-1-e.val.2.2)-m.2)) else 0
    rw [ite_eq_left hn]
    exact congrArg (fun z : ℤ × ℤ => q.val (e.val.1,z))
      (Prod.ext (by omega) (by omega))
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h p

name: ChoppedPlane.formProductBilinear_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem formProductBilinear_val (f : Forms K n d) (g : Forms K n e) :
    (formProductBilinear f g).val = f.val * g.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProductSpace_eq_generatedProducts
statement:
theorem kernelProductSpace_eq_generatedProducts (Q : Submodule K (Forms K n d)) :
    kernelProductSpace (formProductBilinear (K := K) (n := n) (d := d) (e := e)) Q =
      generatedProducts (d := d) (Q.map (Forms K n d).subtype) e
proof:
:= by
  let B := formProductBilinear (K := K) (n := n) (d := d) (e := e)
  let P := kernelProductSpace B Q
  have hmap : P.map (Forms K n (d + e)).subtype =
      Q.map (Forms K n d).subtype * Forms K n e := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · change (kernelProductSpace B Q).map _ ≤ _
      rw [kernelProductSpace, Submodule.map_span]
      apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      rintro _ ⟨w, ⟨f, hf, g, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ g.property
    · apply Submodule.mul_le.mpr
      rintro f ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ g hg
      exact ⟨B f ⟨g, hg⟩, mem_kernelProductSpace B Q hf ⟨g, hg⟩, rfl⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun U : Submodule K (Poly K n) =>
    U.comap (Forms K n (d + e)).subtype) hmap
  rw [Submodule.comap_map_eq_of_injective (Submodule.injective_subtype _)] at h
  exact h

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_principal_upper
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_principal_upper
    (a₀ : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hs : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a₀ d)) (e : ℕ) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
        Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d) ∧
        choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) ≤ choppedHilbertFunction a₀ d (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hprop⟩ := kernelProduct_surjective_principal_open
    (formProductBilinear (K := K) (n := 3) (d := d) (e := e))
    (fun a : PointCoordinates K p => pointEvaluation K a d)
    (pointEvaluation_isPolynomialFamily p d) a₀ hs
  refine ⟨D, hD, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hsa, _, hdim⟩ := hprop a ha
  refine ⟨hsa, ?_⟩
  change finrank K (kernelProductSpace _ (pointDegreePiece K a₀ d)) ≤
    finrank K (kernelProductSpace _ (pointDegreePiece K a d)) at hdim
  rw [kernelProductSpace_eq_generatedProducts, kernelProductSpace_eq_generatedProducts] at hdim
  change finrank K (generatedProducts (d := d) (pointDegreeSpace K a₀ d) e) ≤
    finrank K (generatedProducts (d := d) (pointDegreeSpace K a d) e) at hdim
  have h₀ := (generatedProducts (d := d) (pointDegreeSpace K a₀ d) e).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  have h₁ := (generatedProducts (d := d) (pointDegreeSpace K a d) e).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  rw [generated_finrank_eq_hilbertFunction _ (pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous a₀) e] at h₀
  rw [generated_finrank_eq_hilbertFunction _ (pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous a) e] at h₁
  change generatedHilbertFunction _ _ ≤ generatedHilbertFunction _ _
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pointCoordinates_first
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointCoordinates_first (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε))) :
    pointCoordinates ε α β (i,0) = selectedX ε α ((Fintype.equivFin _).symm i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [pointCoordinates]

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pointCoordinates_second
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointCoordinates_second (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε))) :
    pointCoordinates ε α β (i,1) = selectedY ε β ((Fintype.equivFin _).symm i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [pointCoordinates]

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selected_card
statement:
theorem selected_card (ε : Fin c → ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) =
      ∑ ij : {ij : Fin c × Fin c // ij.1 ≤ ij.2}, ε ij.val.1 * ε ij.val.2
proof:
:= by
  simp [SelectedIndex, Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_prod]

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selected_injective
statement:
theorem selected_injective (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Function.Injective (fun s : SelectedIndex ε => (selectedX ε α s,selectedY ε β s))
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  have hx := hα (congrArg Prod.fst h)
  have hy := hβ (congrArg Prod.snd h)
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨i,j⟩,hij⟩,a,b⟩ := s
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨i',j'⟩,hij'⟩,a',b'⟩ := t
  change (⟨i,a⟩ : RootIndex ε) = ⟨i',a'⟩ at hx
  change (⟨j,b⟩ : RootIndex ε) = ⟨j',b'⟩ at hy
  cases hx
  cases hy
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.distinct_pointCoordinates
statement:
theorem distinct_pointCoordinates (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    DistinctPoints K (pointCoordinates ε α β)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  apply (Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex ε)).symm.injective
  apply selected_injective ε α β hα hβ
  simpa only [pointCoordinates_first,pointCoordinates_second] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.deleted_before
statement:
private theorem deleted_before {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f g : Fin c → R)
    (k : Fin (c+1)) (i j : Fin c) (hi : i.val < k.val) :
    (bidiagonal f g).submatrix k.succAbove id i j =
      if i.val = j.val then f j else if i.val = j.val+1 then g j else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply,Fin.succAbove_of_castSucc_lt]
  · rfl
  · exact hi

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.deleted_after
statement:
private theorem deleted_after {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f g : Fin c → R)
    (k : Fin (c+1)) (i j : Fin c) (hi : ¬i.val < k.val) :
    (bidiagonal f g).submatrix k.succAbove id i j =
      if i.val+1 = j.val then f j else if i.val = j.val then g j else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply,Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc]
  · simp [bidiagonal]
  · exact Nat.le_of_not_gt hi

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.bidiagonal_deletedRow_det
statement:
theorem bidiagonal_deletedRow_det {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f g : Fin c → R)
    (k : Fin (c+1)) :
    ((bidiagonal f g).submatrix k.succAbove id).det =
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => j.val < k.val), f j) *
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => k.val ≤ j.val), g j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A := (bidiagonal f g).submatrix k.succAbove id
  let p : Fin c → Prop := fun i => i.val < k.val
  have hsplit : ∀ i, ¬p i → ∀ j, p j → A i j = 0 := by
    intro i hi j hj
    change (bidiagonal f g).submatrix k.succAbove id i j = 0
    rw [deleted_after f g k i j hi]
    have hij : i.val ≠ j.val := by dsimp [p] at *; omega
    have hij' : i.val+1 ≠ j.val := by dsimp [p] at *; omega
    simp [hij,hij']
  rw [Matrix.twoBlockTriangular_det A p hsplit]
  have hl : (A.toSquareBlockProp p).IsLowerTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    change (bidiagonal f g).submatrix k.succAbove id i.val j.val = 0
    rw [deleted_before f g k i.val j.val i.property]
    have hv : i.val.val < j.val.val := hij
    have hne : i.val.val ≠ j.val.val := by omega
    have hne' : i.val.val ≠ j.val.val+1 := by omega
    simp [hne,hne']
  have hr : (A.toSquareBlockProp (fun i => ¬p i)).IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    change (bidiagonal f g).submatrix k.succAbove id i.val j.val = 0
    rw [deleted_after f g k i.val j.val i.property]
    have hv : j.val.val < i.val.val := hij
    have hne : i.val.val ≠ j.val.val := by omega
    have hne' : i.val.val+1 ≠ j.val.val := by omega
    simp [hne,hne']
  rw [Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular _ hl,Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular hr]
  have hleft : (∏ i : {i : Fin c // p i}, A i.val i.val) =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i.val < k.val), f i := by
    calc
      _ = ∏ i : {i : Fin c // p i}, f i.val := by
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro i _
        change (bidiagonal f g).submatrix k.succAbove id i.val i.val = f i.val
        rw [deleted_before f g k i.val i.val i.property]
        simp
      _ = _ := (Finset.prod_subtype _ (by simp [p]) f).symm
  have hright : (∏ i : {i : Fin c // ¬p i}, A i.val i.val) =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => k.val ≤ i.val), g i := by
    calc
      _ = ∏ i : {i : Fin c // ¬p i}, g i.val := by
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro i _
        change (bidiagonal f g).submatrix k.succAbove id i.val i.val = g i.val
        rw [deleted_after f g k i.val i.val i.property]
        simp
      _ = _ := (Finset.prod_subtype _ (by simp [p]) g).symm
  exact congrArg₂ (· * ·) hleft hright

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_deletedRow_det
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_deletedRow_det (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (k : Fin (c+1)) :
    ((seedMatrix ε α β).submatrix k.succAbove id).det = cofactorProduct ε α β k
proof:
:=
  bidiagonal_deletedRow_det _ _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_homogeneous
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_homogeneous (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (i : Fin (c+1)) (j : Fin c) : (seedMatrix ε α β i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold seedMatrix bidiagonal
  split_ifs
  · exact Ferrers.rowFirst_homogeneous ε α j
  · exact Ferrers.rowSecond_homogeneous ε β j
  · exact isHomogeneous_zero (Fin 3) K (ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorProduct_homogeneous
statement:
theorem cofactorProduct_homogeneous (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (k : Fin (c+1)) : (cofactorProduct ε α β k).IsHomogeneous (∑ j, ε j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← seedMatrix_deletedRow_det]
  exact maximalMinor_homogeneous_columns (seedMatrix ε α β) ε
    (seedMatrix_homogeneous ε α β) k

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorProduct_eval_selected
statement:
theorem cofactorProduct_eval_selected (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (s : SelectedIndex ε) (k : Fin (c+1)) :
    eval ![selectedX ε α s,selectedY ε β s,1] (cofactorProduct ε α β k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [cofactorProduct,map_mul,map_prod]
  by_cases h : s.1.val.1.val < k.val
  · apply mul_eq_zero_of_left
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := s.1.val.1)
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,h⟩
    · exact Ferrers.rowFirst_eval_root ε α ⟨s.1.val.1,s.2.1⟩ _
  · apply mul_eq_zero_of_right
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := s.1.val.2)
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,by
        have := s.1.property
        simp only [Fin.le_def] at this
        omega⟩
    · exact Ferrers.rowSecond_eval_root ε β ⟨s.1.val.2,s.2.2⟩ _

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorIdeal_le_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_le_pointIdeal (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    cofactorIdeal ε α β ≤ pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  rintro f ⟨j,rfl⟩
  apply Ideal.mem_iInf.mpr
  intro i
  apply (homogeneous_mem_singlePointIdeal_iff _ _
    ⟨cofactorProduct ε α β j,cofactorProduct_homogeneous ε α β j⟩).mpr
  simp only [pointCoordinates_first,pointCoordinates_second]
  exact cofactorProduct_eval_selected ε α β ((Fintype.equivFin _).symm i) j

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorProducts_vanish_iff_selected
statement:
theorem cofactorProducts_vanish_iff_selected (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex ε → K) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (u v : RootIndex ε) :
    (∀ k, eval ![α u,β v,1] (cofactorProduct ε α β k) = 0) ↔ u.1 ≤ v.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hall
    by_contra hn
    let k : Fin (c+1) := u.1.castSucc
    have hh : eval ![α u,β v,1] (cofactorProduct ε α β k) ≠ 0 := by
      classical
      simp only [cofactorProduct,map_mul,map_prod]
      apply mul_ne_zero
      · apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
        intro i hi
        have hil := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        exact Ferrers.rowFirst_eval_ne_zero ε α hα u i (by
          intro heq
          subst i
          change u.1.val < u.1.val at hil
          omega) _
      · apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
        intro i hi
        have hil := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        exact Ferrers.rowSecond_eval_ne_zero ε β hβ v i (by
          intro heq
          subst i
          change u.1.val ≤ v.1.val at hil
          exact hn hil) _
    exact hh (hall k)
  · intro huv k
    exact cofactorProduct_eval_selected ε α β ⟨⟨(u.1,v.1),huv⟩,(u.2,v.2)⟩ k

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorProduct_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem cofactorProduct_zero (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    cofactorProduct ε α β 0 = ∏ j, Ferrers.rowSecond ε β j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [cofactorProduct]

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorProduct_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem cofactorProduct_last (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    cofactorProduct ε α β (Fin.last c) = ∏ j, Ferrers.rowFirst ε α j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hl : Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin c => j.val < (Fin.last c).val) = Finset.univ := by
    apply Finset.filter_eq_self.mpr
    intro j _
    exact j.isLt
  have hr : Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin c => (Fin.last c).val ≤ j.val) = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr
    intro j _ hj
    exact Nat.not_le_of_lt j.isLt hj
  rw [cofactorProduct,hl,hr,Finset.prod_empty,mul_one]

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_primitive
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_primitive (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    PrimitiveMaximalMinors (seedMatrix ε α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_pair _ (Fin.last c) 0
  change IsRelPrime
    (((seedMatrix ε α β).submatrix (Fin.last c).succAbove id).det)
    (((seedMatrix ε α β).submatrix (0 : Fin (c+1)).succAbove id).det)
  rw [seedMatrix_deletedRow_det,seedMatrix_deletedRow_det,
    cofactorProduct_last,cofactorProduct_zero]
  exact Ferrers.firstProducts_relPrime_secondProducts ε α β _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal (seedMatrix ε α β) = cofactorIdeal ε α β
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal_eq_span_maximalMinor]
  have h : maximalMinor (seedMatrix ε α β) = cofactorProduct ε α β := by
    funext i
    exact seedMatrix_deletedRow_det ε α β i
  rw [h]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.pureSeed_primitive
statement:
theorem pureSeed_primitive {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R] (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (x y : R) (hxy : IsRelPrime x y) :
    PrimitiveMaximalMinors (bidiagonal (fun j => x ^ ε j) (fun j => y ^ ε j))
proof:
:= by
  apply primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_pair _ (Fin.last c) 0
  change IsRelPrime
    (((bidiagonal (fun j => x ^ ε j) (fun j => y ^ ε j)).submatrix
      (Fin.last c).succAbove id).det)
    (((bidiagonal (fun j => x ^ ε j) (fun j => y ^ ε j)).submatrix
      (0 : Fin (c+1)).succAbove id).det)
  rw [bidiagonal_deletedRow_det,bidiagonal_deletedRow_det]
  have hl : Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin c => j.val < (Fin.last c).val) = Finset.univ := by
    apply Finset.filter_eq_self.mpr
    intro j _
    exact j.isLt
  have hr : Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin c => (Fin.last c).val ≤ j.val) = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr
    intro j _ hj
    exact Nat.not_le_of_lt j.isLt hj
  classical
  simp only [hl,hr,Finset.prod_empty,mul_one]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero,Nat.not_lt_zero,Finset.filter_false,Finset.prod_empty,
    Nat.zero_le,Finset.filter_true,one_mul]
  apply IsRelPrime.prod_left
  intro i _
  apply IsRelPrime.prod_right
  intro j _
  exact hxy.pow_left.pow_right

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_map_infinity
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_map_infinity (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    (seedMatrix ε α β).map Ferrers.infinityMap =
      bidiagonal (fun j => (X 0 : Poly K 2)^ε j) (fun j => (X 1 : Poly K 2)^ε j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext i j
  change Ferrers.infinityMap (if i.val = j.val then Ferrers.rowFirst ε α j
    else if i.val = j.val+1 then Ferrers.rowSecond ε β j else 0) = _
  split_ifs <;> simp [bidiagonal,Ferrers.infinityMap,Ferrers.rowFirst,Ferrers.rowSecond, *]

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.seedMatrix_primitive_atInfinity
statement:
theorem seedMatrix_primitive_atInfinity (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    PrimitiveMaximalMinors ((seedMatrix ε α β).map Ferrers.infinityMap)
proof:
:= by
  rw [seedMatrix_map_infinity]
  exact pureSeed_primitive ε _ _ Ferrers.binary_X_relPrime

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorIdeal_z_saturated
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_z_saturated (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (n : ℕ) (p : Poly K 3) :
    X 2 ^ n * p ∈ cofactorIdeal ε α β ↔ p ∈ cofactorIdeal ε α β
proof:
:= by
  rw [← seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal]
  exact pow_mul_mem_cofactorIdeal_iff (seedMatrix ε α β) (X 2) (X_ne_zero _)
    Ferrers.infinityMap Ferrers.infinityMap_surjective Ferrers.infinityMap_ker
    (seedMatrix_primitive_atInfinity ε α β) n p

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorIdeal_homogeneous
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_homogeneous (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    (cofactorIdeal ε α β).IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.homogeneous_span
  rintro f ⟨j,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨_,cofactorProduct_homogeneous ε α β j⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal
statement:
theorem mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex ε → K) :
    Grid.mvAffineGridIdeal (Ferrers.flatRoots ε α) (Ferrers.flatRoots ε β) ≤
      affineCofactorIdeal ε α β
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  rintro f (rfl | rfl)
  · have hmem : cofactorProduct ε α β (Fin.last c) ∈ cofactorIdeal ε α β :=
      Ideal.subset_span ⟨Fin.last c,rfl⟩
    have hh := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom hmem
    rw [cofactorProduct_last,Ferrers.totalFirst_eq_planeFirst] at hh
    simpa [Grid.planeFirst,Grid.affineFirstProduct,affineDehom,affineCofactorIdeal] using hh
  · have hmem : cofactorProduct ε α β 0 ∈ cofactorIdeal ε α β :=
      Ideal.subset_span ⟨0,rfl⟩
    have hh := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom hmem
    rw [cofactorProduct_zero,Ferrers.totalSecond_eq_planeSecond] at hh
    simpa [Grid.planeSecond,Grid.affineSecondProduct,affineDehom,affineCofactorIdeal] using hh

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.affineCofactor_separator
statement:
theorem affineCofactor_separator (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (ij : Fin (Fintype.card (RootIndex ε)) × Fin (Fintype.card (RootIndex ε)))
    (hij : ij ∉ selectedGridSet ε) :
    ∃ f ∈ affineCofactorIdeal ε α β,
      Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (Ferrers.flatRoots ε α) (Ferrers.flatRoots ε β) f ij ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let u := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex ε)).symm ij.1
  let v := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex ε)).symm ij.2
  have hn : ¬u.1 ≤ v.1 := hij
  have hnot : ¬∀ j, eval ![α u,β v,1] (cofactorProduct ε α β j) = 0 := by
    intro hall
    exact hn ((cofactorProducts_vanish_iff_selected ε α β hα hβ u v).mp hall)
  push Not at hnot
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hnot
  refine ⟨affineDehom (cofactorProduct ε α β j),
    Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom
      (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j,rfl⟩),?_⟩
  simpa only [Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_apply,Ferrers.flatRoots,
    Ferrers.eval_affineDehom] using hj

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.homogeneous_mem_cofactorIdeal_of_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem homogeneous_mem_cofactorIdeal_of_pointIdeal {t : ℕ}
    (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (f : Forms K 3 t) (hf : f.val ∈ pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α β)) :
    f.val ∈ cofactorIdeal ε α β
proof:
:= by
  have hsat : ∀ p : Poly K 3, X 2 * p ∈ cofactorIdeal ε α β →
      p ∈ cofactorIdeal ε α β := by
    intro p hp
    exact (cofactorIdeal_z_saturated ε α β 1 p).mp (by simpa using hp)
  apply (affineDehom_mem_map_iff (cofactorIdeal ε α β)
    (cofactorIdeal_homogeneous ε α β) hsat f.property).mp
  have hker : RingHom.ker
      (Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (Ferrers.flatRoots ε α) (Ferrers.flatRoots ε β)) ≤
      affineCofactorIdeal ε α β := by
    rw [Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_ker _ _ (Ferrers.flatRoots_injective ε α hα)
      (Ferrers.flatRoots_injective ε β hβ)]
    exact mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal ε α β
  apply mem_ideal_of_vanish_on_selected
    (Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation (Ferrers.flatRoots ε α) (Ferrers.flatRoots ε β))
    (Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_surjective _ _ (Ferrers.flatRoots_injective ε α hα)
      (Ferrers.flatRoots_injective ε β hβ))
    (affineCofactorIdeal ε α β) hker (selectedGridSet ε)
    (affineCofactor_separator ε α β hα hβ)
  intro ij hij
  let u := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex ε)).symm ij.1
  let v := (Fintype.equivFin (RootIndex ε)).symm ij.2
  have huv : u.1 ≤ v.1 := hij
  let s : SelectedIndex ε := ⟨⟨(u.1,v.1),huv⟩,(u.2,v.2)⟩
  have hh := (mem_pointDegreePiece (pointCoordinates ε α β) f).mp
    ((homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff (pointCoordinates ε α β) f).mp hf)
    (Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex ε) s)
  change eval ![pointCoordinates ε α β (Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex ε) s,0),
    pointCoordinates ε α β (Fintype.equivFin (SelectedIndex ε) s,1),1] f.val = 0 at hh
  simp only [pointCoordinates_first,pointCoordinates_second,Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at hh
  simpa [Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_apply,Ferrers.flatRoots,Ferrers.eval_affineDehom,
    selectedX,selectedY,s,u,v] using hh

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.cofactorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_eq_pointIdeal (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    cofactorIdeal ε α β = pointIdeal K (pointCoordinates ε α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (cofactorIdeal_le_pointIdeal ε α β)
  intro f hf
  apply (mem_iff_homogeneousComponent_mem (cofactorIdeal_homogeneous ε α β) f).mpr
  intro t
  exact homogeneous_mem_cofactorIdeal_of_pointIdeal ε α β hα hβ
    ⟨homogeneousComponent t f,homogeneousComponent_mem t f⟩
    (homogeneousComponent_mem_of_mem (Ferrers.pointIdeal_homogeneous
      (pointCoordinates ε α β)) hf t)

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.affineCofactorIdeal_quotient_reduced
statement:
theorem affineCofactorIdeal_quotient_reduced (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (α β : RootIndex ε → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    IsReduced (Poly K 2 ⧸ affineCofactorIdeal ε α β)
proof:
:=
  Grid.quotient_reduced_of_mvAffineGridIdeal_le (Ferrers.flatRoots ε α)
    (Ferrers.flatRoots ε β) (Ferrers.flatRoots_injective ε α hα)
    (Ferrers.flatRoots_injective ε β hβ) (affineCofactorIdeal ε α β)
    (mvAffineGridIdeal_le_affineCofactorIdeal ε α β)

name: ChoppedPlane.binary_degree_cut_of_pure_powers
statement:
theorem binary_degree_cut_of_pure_powers (I : Ideal (Poly K 2)) (D t : ℕ)
    (hx : (X 0 : Poly K 2) ^ D ∈ I) (hy : (X 1 : Poly K 2) ^ D ∈ I)
    (ht : 2 * D ≤ t) (f : Forms K 2 t) : f.val ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [f.val.as_sum]
  apply I.sum_mem
  intro d hd
  have hdegree : d.degree = t := by
    simpa only [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one, Pi.one_def] using
      f.property (mem_support_iff.mp hd)
  have hsum : d 0 + d 1 = t := by
    simpa [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_two] using hdegree
  have hdvd (i : Fin 2) (hi : D ≤ d i) :
      (X i : Poly K 2) ^ D ∣ monomial d (f.val.coeff d) := by
    rw [X_pow_eq_monomial, monomial_dvd_monomial]
    exact ⟨Or.inr (Finsupp.single_le_iff.mpr hi), one_dvd _⟩
  by_cases hxdeg : D ≤ d 0
  · exact I.mem_of_dvd (hdvd 0 hxdeg) hx
  · have hydeg : D ≤ d 1 := by omega
    exact I.mem_of_dvd (hdvd 1 hydeg) hy

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.infinityMap_mem_maximalMinorIdeal
statement:
theorem infinityMap_mem_maximalMinorIdeal (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) {p : Poly K 3} (hp : p ∈ cofactorIdeal δ α β) :
    infinityMap p ∈ maximalMinorIdeal ((seedMatrix δ α β).map infinityMap)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← seedMatrix_cofactorIdeal] at hp
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (mem_cofactorIdeal_iff (seedMatrix δ α β) p).mp hp
  change infinityMap p ∈ ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal ((seedMatrix δ α β).map infinityMap)
  apply (mem_cofactorIdeal_iff _ _).mpr
  exact ⟨fun i => infinityMap (v i), by rw [cofactorMap_map, hv]⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seed_infinity_X_zero_pow_mem
statement:
theorem seed_infinity_X_zero_pow_mem (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (X 0 : Poly K 2) ^ (∑ i, δ i) ∈
      maximalMinorIdeal ((seedMatrix δ α β).map infinityMap)
proof:
:= by
  have h := infinityMap_mem_maximalMinorIdeal δ α β (totalFirst_mem δ α β)
  simpa only [map_prod, infinityMap_rowFirst, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seed_infinity_X_one_pow_mem
statement:
theorem seed_infinity_X_one_pow_mem (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    (X 1 : Poly K 2) ^ (∑ i, δ i) ∈
      maximalMinorIdeal ((seedMatrix δ α β).map infinityMap)
proof:
:= by
  have h := infinityMap_mem_maximalMinorIdeal δ α β (totalSecond_mem δ α β)
  simpa only [map_prod, infinityMap_rowSecond, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seed_binary_degree_cut
statement:
theorem seed_binary_degree_cut (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (f : Forms K 2 (2 * ∑ i, δ i)) :
    f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal ((seedMatrix δ α β).map infinityMap)
proof:
:= by
  exact binary_degree_cut_of_pure_powers _ _ _
    (seed_infinity_X_zero_pow_mem δ α β) (seed_infinity_X_one_pow_mem δ α β)
    le_rfl f

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seed_infinity_homogeneous
statement:
theorem seed_infinity_homogeneous (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) (i : Fin (c + 1)) (j : Fin c) :
    (((seedMatrix δ α β).map infinityMap) i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [seedMatrix_map_infinity]
  unfold ferrersBidiagonal
  split_ifs
  · exact isHomogeneous_X_pow _ _
  · exact isHomogeneous_X_pow _ _
  · exact isHomogeneous_zero (Fin 2) K (δ i)

name: ChoppedPlane.Ferrers.seed_infinity_gradedCofactorMap_surjective
statement:
theorem seed_infinity_gradedCofactorMap_surjective (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : RootIndex δ → K) :
    Function.Surjective (gradedCofactorMap ((seedMatrix δ α β).map infinityMap)
      δ (seed_infinity_homogeneous δ α β)
      (((2 * ∑ i, δ i : ℕ) : ℤ) - (∑ i, δ i : ℕ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
  rw [gradedCofactorMap_range_eq_idealPiece]
  apply top_unique
  intro f _
  change f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal ((seedMatrix δ α β).map infinityMap)
  have hshift : (((2 * ∑ i, δ i : ℕ) : ℤ) - (∑ i, δ i : ℕ)) +
      (∑ i, δ i : ℕ) = ((2 * ∑ i, δ i : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
  have hf : f.val ∈ Forms K 2 (2 * ∑ i, δ i) := by
    simpa only [hshift, signedForms_nat] using f.property
  exact seed_binary_degree_cut δ α β ⟨f.val, hf⟩
