name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_ker
statement:
theorem affineDehom_ker : RingHom.ker (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom =
    Ideal.span {(X 2 : Poly K 3) - 1}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let J : Ideal (Poly K 3) := Ideal.span {(X 2 : Poly K 3) - 1}
  let q : Poly K 3 →ₐ[K] (Poly K 3 ⧸ J) := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K J
  let φ : Poly K 2 →ₐ[K] (Poly K 3 ⧸ J) :=
    MvPolynomial.aeval ![q (X 0), q (X 1)]
  have hqz : q (X 2) = 1 := by
    have hzmem : (X 2 : Poly K 3) - 1 ∈ J :=
      Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
    have hz : q ((X 2 : Poly K 3) - 1) = 0 :=
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hzmem
    simpa only [map_sub, map_one, sub_eq_zero] using hz
  have hfactor : φ.comp (affineDehom (K := K)) = q := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [φ, hqz]
  have hle : J ≤ RingHom.ker (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro p (rfl : p = (X 2 : Poly K 3) - 1)
    change affineDehom ((X 2 : Poly K 3) - 1) = 0
    simp
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    change p ∈ J
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    have hp0 : affineDehom p = 0 := hp
    have h := AlgHom.congr_fun hfactor p
    simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply, hp0, map_zero, q, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk] using h.symm
  · exact hle

name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_eq_iff
statement:
theorem affineDehom_eq_iff (f g : Poly K 3) :
    affineDehom f = affineDehom g ↔ (X 2 - 1 : Poly K 3) ∣ f - g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub]
  change f - g ∈ RingHom.ker (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom ↔ _
  rw [affineDehom_ker, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]

name: ChoppedPlane.binary_coeff_lower_left
statement:
theorem binary_coeff_lower_left {a t : ℕ} (A : ℕ → ℕ → K)
    (hleft : ∀ i < a, A (i + 1) 0 = 0)
    (hrec : ∀ i < a, ∀ j < t, A (i + 1) (j + 1) + A i j = 0)
    (j : ℕ) (hjt : j ≤ t) (i : ℕ) (hia : i ≤ a) (hji : j < i) :
    A i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction j generalizing i with
  | zero =>
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : i ≠ 0)
      exact hleft r (by omega)
  | succ j ih =>
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : i ≠ 0)
      have hprev : A r j = 0 := ih (by omega) r (by omega) (by omega)
      have h := hrec r (by omega) j (by omega)
      simpa only [hprev, add_zero] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.binary_coeff_upper_right
statement:
theorem binary_coeff_upper_right {a t : ℕ} (A : ℕ → ℕ → K)
    (hright : ∀ i < a, A i t = 0)
    (hrec : ∀ i < a, ∀ j < t, A (i + 1) (j + 1) + A i j = 0)
    (k : ℕ) (hkt : k ≤ t) (i : ℕ) (hik : i + k < a) :
    A i (t - k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing i with
  | zero =>
      simpa only [Nat.sub_zero] using hright i (by omega)
  | succ k ih =>
      have hprev : A (i + 1) (t - k) = 0 :=
        ih (by omega) (i + 1) (by omega)
      have hcol : t - k = (t - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hcol] at hprev
      have h := hrec i (by omega) (t - (k + 1)) (by omega)
      simpa only [hprev, zero_add] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.binary_coeff_boundary_zero
statement:
theorem binary_coeff_boundary_zero {a t : ℕ} (A : ℕ → ℕ → K)
    (hleft : ∀ i < a, A (i + 1) 0 = 0)
    (hright : ∀ i < a, A i t = 0)
    (hrec : ∀ i < a, ∀ j < t, A (i + 1) (j + 1) + A i j = 0)
    (hta : t < a) (i : ℕ) (hia : i ≤ a) (j : ℕ) (hjt : j ≤ t) :
    A i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hji : j < i
  · exact binary_coeff_lower_left A hleft hrec j hjt i hia hji
  · have h := binary_coeff_upper_right A hright hrec (t - j) (by omega)
        i (by omega)
    have hcol : t - (t - j) = j := by omega
    simpa only [hcol] using h

proof:
:= by

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_apply (L : Fin 3 → W' →ₗ[K] V') (t : ℕ)
    (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → W') (b : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1)) :
    auxiliaryOperatorMultiply L t q b = ∑ s : Sym (Fin 3) t, ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (X i * monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) 1 : Poly K 3).coeff
        (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) • L i (q s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [auxiliaryOperatorMultiply, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryResiduePair_eq_coefficientPair
statement:
theorem auxiliaryResiduePair_eq_coefficientPair [Finite J] [CharZero K]
    (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) (auxiliaryGeneratorWeights g t) r)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) (auxiliaryGeneratorWeights g t) r) :
    auxiliaryResiduePair g r t q p =
      auxiliaryCoefficientPair (residuePair g r) t
        (negativeGradeSplit g r q) (positiveGradeSplit g r p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite J
  change weightedResiduePair _ _ _ _ q p = _
  rw [weightedResiduePair_eq_vectorResidue, vectorResidueFunctional_apply]
  unfold auxiliaryCoefficientPair
  simp only [residuePair_eq_vectorResidue, vectorResidueFunctional_apply, one_mul,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  change factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) *
      (freeLaurentEquiv q.val (j,s) * freeLaurentEquiv p.val (j,s)).coeff (-1,-1) = _
  rw [freeLaurentEquiv_split, freeLaurentEquiv_split]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryCoefficientPair_adjoint
statement:
theorem auxiliaryCoefficientPair_adjoint
    (α : V' →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] K) (β : W' →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] K)
    (T : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] W) (L : Fin 3 → W' →ₗ[K] V')
    (h : ∀ i q p, β q (T i p) = α (L i q) p) (t : ℕ)
    (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → W') (p : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → V) :
    auxiliaryCoefficientPair β t q (operatorDifferential T t p) =
      auxiliaryCoefficientPair α (t + 1) (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply L t q) p
proof:
:= by
  unfold auxiliaryCoefficientPair
  simp only [operatorDifferential_coeff, auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_apply,
    map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b hb
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [h]
  calc
    _ = (factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) *
        (pderiv i (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) 1 : Poly K 3)).coeff
          (homogeneousTensorExponent t s)) * α (L i (q s)) (p b) := by ring
    _ = (factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) *
        (X i * monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) 1 : Poly K 3).coeff
          (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b)) * α (L i (q s)) (p b) := by
      rw [factorialWeight_pderiv_monomial_pair]
    _ = _ := by ring

name: ChoppedPlane.universalRowMatrix_reduced_principal_open
statement:
theorem universalRowMatrix_reduced_principal_open
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (N : ℕ)
    (H₀ : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K)
    (a₀ : RowMatrixParameter δ → K) (hH₀ : eval a₀ H₀ ≠ 0)
    (hprimitive : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 →
      PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ a)))
    (hbinary : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 →
      PrimitiveMaximalMinors (universalInfinityMatrix δ a))
    (hcut : ∀ a, eval a H₀ ≠ 0 → ∀ f : Forms K 2 N,
      f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal (universalInfinityMatrix δ a))
    (splitWitness :
      AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
        (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ a₀))) ≃ₐ[K] (κ → K)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
        eval a H₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        IsReduced (AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ a)))) ∧
        Module.Finite K (AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ a)))) ∧
        finrank K (AffineCoordinateAlgebra (maximalMinorIdeal
          (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ a)))) = Fintype.card κ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I (a : RowMatrixParameter δ → K) :=
    maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ a))
  let A (a : RowMatrixParameter δ → K) := AffineCoordinateAlgebra (I a)
  let q (t : ℕ) (a : RowMatrixParameter δ → K) :=
    formChartMap (affineQuotientMap (I a)) t
  have hI (a) : (I a).IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K) :=
    maximalMinorIdeal_homogeneous δ _ (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ _)
  have hsat (a) (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) :
      ∀ p : Poly K 3, X 2 * p ∈ I a → p ∈ I a :=
    rowMatrix_z_saturated δ _ (hbinary a ha)
  have hCut (a) (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) :
      ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈ I a ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2} :=
    rowMatrix_form_cut_of_binary δ _ N (hcut a ha)
  have hfinite (a) (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) : Module.Finite K (A a) :=
    affineCoordinateAlgebra_finite (I a) (hI a) N (hCut a ha)
  let : Module.Finite K (A a₀) := hfinite a₀ hH₀
  let b₀ : Basis κ K (A a₀) := (Pi.basisFun K κ).map splitWitness.symm.toLinearEquiv
  have hdim₀ : finrank K (A a₀) = Fintype.card κ :=
    Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b₀
  have hdimQ₀ : finrank K (Forms K 3 N ⧸ idealFormPiece (I a₀) N) =
      Fintype.card κ :=
    (affineFormQuotientEquiv (I a₀) (hI a₀) (hsat a₀ hH₀) N
      (hCut a₀ hH₀)).finrank_eq.trans hdim₀
  have hdimQ (a) (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) :
      finrank K (Forms K 3 N ⧸ idealFormPiece (I a) N) = Fintype.card κ :=
    (rowMatrix_quotient_finrank_eq δ _ _ (hprimitive a ha)
      (hprimitive a₀ hH₀) N).trans hdimQ₀
  have hdimA (a) (ha : eval a H₀ ≠ 0) : finrank K (A a) = Fintype.card κ :=
    (finrank_affineCoordinateAlgebra (I a) (hI a) (hsat a ha) N
      (hCut a ha)).trans (hdimQ a ha)
  have hsurj₀ : Function.Surjective (q N a₀) :=
    affineFormMap_surjective (I a₀) (hI a₀) N (hCut a₀ hH₀)
  choose v hv using fun i => hsurj₀ (b₀ i)
  have hker (t : ℕ) : (universalDegreeCofactorMap δ t a₀).range =
      (q t a₀).ker := by
    rw [universalDegreeCofactorMap_range]
    exact (ker_formChartMap (affineQuotientMap (I a₀)) (I a₀) t
      (affineQuotientMap_form_eq_zero_iff (I a₀) (hI a₀) (hsat a₀ hH₀) t)).symm
  obtain ⟨r, hrpoly, hrmem, hrbij⟩ := polynomial_relations_for_quotient_basis
    (fun a => universalDegreeCofactorMap δ N a)
    (universalDegreeCofactorMap_isPolynomialFamily δ N) a₀ (q N a₀)
    (hker N) b₀ v hv
  obtain ⟨G, hG₀, hG⟩ := quotient_basis_principal_open
    (fun a => idealFormPiece (I a) N) r v hrpoly
    (fun a i => by rw [← universalDegreeCofactorMap_range]; exact hrmem a i)
    a₀ hrbij
  let H := H₀ * G
  have hH (a) (ha : eval a H ≠ 0) : eval a H₀ ≠ 0 ∧ eval a G ≠ 0 := by
    exact mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simpa only [H, map_mul] using ha)
  have hH₀' : eval a₀ H ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [H, map_mul] using mul_ne_zero hH₀ hG₀
  have hbases (a) (ha : eval a H ≠ 0) :
      ∃ b : Basis κ K (A a), ∀ i, b i = q N a (v i) := by
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hG a (hH a ha).2 (hdimQ a (hH a ha).1)
    let e := affineFormQuotientEquiv (I a) (hI a) (hsat a (hH a ha).1) N
      (hCut a (hH a ha).1)
    refine ⟨b.map e, fun i => ?_⟩
    rw [Basis.map_apply, hb]
    exact affineFormQuotientEquiv_mk (I a) (hI a) (hsat a (hH a ha).1) N
      (hCut a (hH a ha).1) (v i)
  choose b hb using hbases
  let l (i : κ) : Forms K 3 (2 * N) :=
    ⟨(v i).val * X 2 ^ N, by
      simpa only [Forms, mem_homogeneousSubmodule, ← Nat.two_mul] using
        (v i).property.mul (isHomogeneous_X_pow 2 N)⟩
  let p (i j : κ) : Forms K 3 (2 * N) :=
    ⟨(v i).val * (v j).val, by
      simpa only [Forms, mem_homogeneousSubmodule, ← Nat.two_mul] using
        (v i).property.mul (v j).property⟩
  have hl (a) (ha : eval a H ≠ 0) (i) : q (2 * N) a (l i) = b a ha i := by
    rw [hb a ha]
    simp only [q, l, formChartMap_apply, map_mul, map_pow,
      affineQuotientMap_z, one_pow, mul_one]
  have hp (a) (ha : eval a H ≠ 0) (i j) :
      q (2 * N) a (p i j) = b a ha i * b a ha j := by
    rw [hb a ha, hb a ha]
    simp only [q, p, formChartMap_apply, map_mul]
  obtain ⟨s, hspoly, hsmem, hsbij⟩ := polynomial_relations_for_quotient_basis
    (fun a => universalDegreeCofactorMap δ (2 * N) a)
    (universalDegreeCofactorMap_isPolynomialFamily δ (2 * N)) a₀ (q (2 * N) a₀)
    (hker (2 * N)) (b a₀ hH₀') l (hl a₀ hH₀')
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hred⟩ := reduced_principal_open_of_polynomial_quotient_chart
    A H b (q (2 * N)) s (fun i _ => l i) (fun i j _ => p i j) hspoly
    (fun i => isPolynomialFamily_const (l i))
    (fun i j => isPolynomialFamily_const (p i j))
    (fun a ha i => by
      apply affineQuotientMap_eq_zero_of_mem
      have hs := hsmem a i
      rw [universalDegreeCofactorMap_range] at hs
      exact hs)
    hl hp a₀ hH₀' hsbij splitWitness
  refine ⟨H₀ * D, ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  · simpa only [map_mul] using mul_ne_zero hH₀ hD
  · have hparts : eval a H₀ ≠ 0 ∧ eval a D ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simpa only [map_mul] using ha)
    exact ⟨hparts.1, hred a hparts.2, hfinite a hparts.1, hdimA a hparts.1⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.determinant_homogeneous_columns
statement:
theorem determinant_homogeneous_columns {m : ℕ}
    (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)) :
    B.det.IsHomogeneous (∑ j, ε j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := determinant_homogeneous_rows B.transpose ε (fun i j => hB j i)
  simpa only [Matrix.det_transpose] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.maximalMinor_homogeneous_columns
statement:
theorem maximalMinor_homogeneous_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (maximalMinor B i).IsHomogeneous (∑ j, ε j)
proof:
:=
  determinant_homogeneous_columns _ ε (fun j k => hB (i.succAbove j) k)

name: ChoppedPlane.signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_columns
statement:
theorem signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (signedMaximalMinor B i).IsHomogeneous (∑ j, ε j)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := maximalMinor_homogeneous_columns B ε hB i
  have hconst : ((-1 : Poly K n) ^ i.val).IsHomogeneous 0 := by
    simpa using (isHomogeneous_C (σ := Fin n) (-1 : K)).pow i.val
  simpa [signedMaximalMinor] using hconst.mul hm

name: ChoppedPlane.signedVectorComponent_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem signedVectorComponent_self (m : ℕ) (e : ℤ)
    (v : Fin m → signedForms K n e) :
    signedVectorComponent m e (signedVectorVal v) = v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact signedComponent_self e (v i)

name: ChoppedPlane.signedComponent_mulVec_columns
statement:
theorem signedComponent_mulVec_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (e : ℤ) (w : Fin c → Poly K n) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    signedComponent e (B.mulVec w i) =
      B.mulVec (columnFormsVal (columnFormsComponent ε e w)) i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  change signedComponent e (B i j * w j) =
    B i j * signedComponent (e - ε j) (w j)
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using
    signedComponent_mul_form (e - ε j) (B i j) (w j) (hB i j)

name: ChoppedPlane.signedComponent_cofactorMap_columns
statement:
theorem signedComponent_cofactorMap_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (e : ℤ) (v : Fin (c + 1) → Poly K n) :
    signedComponent (e + ∑ j, ε j) (cofactorMap B v) =
      cofactorMap B (signedVectorVal (signedVectorComponent (c + 1) e v))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cofactorMap_apply, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact signedComponent_mul_form e (signedMaximalMinor B i) (v i)
    (signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_columns B ε hB i)

name: ChoppedPlane.columnGraded_ker_cofactor_eq_range
statement:
theorem columnGraded_ker_cofactor_eq_range
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (columnGradedCofactorMap B ε hB e).ker = (columnGradedMatrixMap B ε hB e).range
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro v hv
    have hpoly : signedVectorVal v ∈ (cofactorMap B).ker := congrArg Subtype.val hv
    rw [ker_cofactorMap_eq_range B hprimitive] at hpoly
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hpoly
    change B.mulVec w = signedVectorVal v at hw
    refine ⟨columnFormsComponent ε e w, ?_⟩
    funext i
    apply Subtype.ext
    change B.mulVec (columnFormsVal (columnFormsComponent ε e w)) i = (v i).val
    rw [← signedComponent_mulVec_columns B ε hB, hw]
    exact signedComponent_self e (v i)
  · rintro v ⟨w, rfl⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact cofactorMap_mulVec B (columnFormsVal w)

name: ChoppedPlane.columnGradedMatrixMap_injective
statement:
theorem columnGradedMatrixMap_injective
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (columnGradedMatrixMap B ε hB e)
proof:
:= by
  intro w u h
  have hpoly : B.mulVec (columnFormsVal w) = B.mulVec (columnFormsVal u) :=
    congrArg signedVectorVal h
  have hcoeff := mulVec_injective_of_primitive B hprimitive hpoly
  funext j
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrFun hcoeff j

name: ChoppedPlane.columnGradedCofactorMap_range_eq_idealPiece
statement:
theorem columnGradedCofactorMap_range_eq_idealPiece
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)) (e : ℤ) :
    (columnGradedCofactorMap B ε hB e).range = columnMinorIdealPiece B ε e
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro f ⟨v, rfl⟩
    change cofactorMap B (signedVectorVal v) ∈
      Submodule.span (Poly K n) (Set.range (signedMaximalMinor B))
    rw [← cofactorMap_range_eq_span]
    exact ⟨signedVectorVal v, rfl⟩
  · intro f hf
    have hfpoly : f.val ∈ (cofactorMap B).range := by
      rw [cofactorMap_range_eq_span]
      exact hf
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hfpoly
    refine ⟨signedVectorComponent (c + 1) e v, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change cofactorMap B (signedVectorVal (signedVectorComponent (c + 1) e v)) = f.val
    rw [← signedComponent_cofactorMap_columns B ε hB, hv]
    exact signedComponent_self _ f

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_columnPlaneForms
statement:
theorem finrank_columnPlaneForms (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (e : ℤ) :
    (finrank K (columnForms K 3 ε e) : ℤ) = ∑ j, N₂ (e - ε j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_pi_fintype, Nat.cast_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact finrank_signedPlaneForms (e - ε j)

name: ChoppedPlane.columnMinorIdealPiece_finrank
statement:
theorem columnMinorIdealPiece_finrank
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (finrank K (columnMinorIdealPiece B ε e) : ℤ) =
      ((c : ℤ) + 1) * N₂ e - ∑ j, N₂ (e - ε j)
proof:
:= by
  have hdim := (columnGradedCofactorMap B ε hB e).finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [columnGraded_ker_cofactor_eq_range B ε hB hprimitive,
    LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (columnGradedMatrixMap_injective B ε hB hprimitive e),
    columnGradedCofactorMap_range_eq_idealPiece B ε hB] at hdim
  have hmid : (finrank K (Fin (c + 1) → signedForms K 3 e) : ℤ) =
      ((c : ℤ) + 1) * N₂ e := by
    rw [Module.finrank_pi_fintype]
    simp [finrank_signedPlaneForms]
  have hcast := congrArg (fun j : ℕ => (j : ℤ)) hdim
  rw [Nat.cast_add, finrank_columnPlaneForms, hmid] at hcast
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.columnMinorQuotient_finrank
statement:
theorem columnMinorQuotient_finrank
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (finrank K ((signedForms K 3 (e + ∑ j, ε j)) ⧸ columnMinorIdealPiece B ε e) : ℤ) =
      N₂ (e + ∑ j, ε j) - ((c : ℤ) + 1) * N₂ e + ∑ j, N₂ (e - ε j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (columnMinorIdealPiece B ε e).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  have hcast := congrArg (fun j : ℕ => (j : ℤ)) h
  rw [Nat.cast_add, finrank_signedPlaneForms, columnMinorIdealPiece_finrank B ε hB hprimitive] at hcast
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.minorFormToRingQuotient_ker_columns
statement:
theorem minorFormToRingQuotient_ker_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (e : ℤ) :
    (minorFormToRingQuotient B (e + ∑ j, ε j)).ker = columnMinorIdealPiece B ε e
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalMinorIdeal B) f.val = 0 ↔ f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal B
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem

name: ChoppedPlane.minorHilbertFunction_columns_formula
statement:
theorem minorHilbertFunction_columns_formula
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (minorHilbertFunction B (e + ∑ j, ε j) : ℤ) =
      N₂ (e + ∑ j, ε j) - ((c : ℤ) + 1) * N₂ e + ∑ j, N₂ (e - ε j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (minorFormToRingQuotient B (e + ∑ j, ε j)).quotKerEquivRange.finrank_eq
  rw [minorFormToRingQuotient_ker_columns] at h
  dsimp only [minorHilbertFunction]
  rw [← h]
  exact columnMinorQuotient_finrank B ε hB hprimitive e

name: ChoppedPlane.minorHilbertFunction_columns_at_degree
statement:
theorem minorHilbertFunction_columns_at_degree
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (t : ℤ) :
    (minorHilbertFunction B t : ℤ) = N₂ t - ((c : ℤ) + 1) * N₂ (t - ∑ j, ε j) +
      ∑ j, N₂ (t - (∑ k, ε k) - ε j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := minorHilbertFunction_columns_formula B ε hB hprimitive (t - ∑ j, ε j)
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.minorGeneratorSpace_idealSpan
statement:
theorem minorGeneratorSpace_idealSpan
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) :
    Ideal.span (minorGeneratorSpace B : Set (Poly K n)) = maximalMinorIdeal B
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_span_of_tower K (Poly K n) _

name: ChoppedPlane.generatedHilbertFunction_minorGeneratorSpace
statement:
theorem generatedHilbertFunction_minorGeneratorSpace
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (t : ℕ) :
    generatedHilbertFunction (minorGeneratorSpace B) t = minorHilbertFunction B t
proof:
:= by
  let E : Forms K n t ≃ₗ[K] signedForms K n (t : ℤ) :=
    LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (signedForms_nat t).symm
  let ψ := (minorFormToRingQuotient B (t : ℤ)).comp E.toLinearMap
  have hker : (formToRingQuotient t (minorGeneratorSpace B)).ker = ψ.ker := by
    ext f
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (minorGeneratorSpace B : Set (Poly K n))) f.val = 0 ↔
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalMinorIdeal B) (E f).val = 0
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    change f.val ∈ Ideal.span (minorGeneratorSpace B : Set (Poly K n)) ↔ f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal B
    rw [minorGeneratorSpace_idealSpan]
  have h₁ := (formToRingQuotient t (minorGeneratorSpace B)).finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have h₂ := ψ.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [hker] at h₁
  have hψ : ψ.range = (minorFormToRingQuotient B (t : ℤ)).range :=
    LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _ (LinearEquiv.range E)
  dsimp only [generatedHilbertFunction, minorHilbertFunction]
  rw [← hψ]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.minorGeneratorSpace_homogeneous_columns
statement:
theorem minorGeneratorSpace_homogeneous_columns
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j)) :
    minorGeneratorSpace B ≤ Forms K n (∑ j, ε j)
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_columns B ε hB i

name: ChoppedPlane.generatedHilbertFunction_columns_formula
statement:
theorem generatedHilbertFunction_columns_formula
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (ε : Fin c → ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (ε j))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (t : ℕ) :
    (generatedHilbertFunction (minorGeneratorSpace B) t : ℤ) = N₂ t -
      ((c : ℤ) + 1) * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - ∑ j, ε j) +
      ∑ j, N₂ ((t : ℤ) - (∑ k, ε k) - ε j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [generatedHilbertFunction_minorGeneratorSpace]
  exact minorHilbertFunction_columns_at_degree B ε hB hprimitive t

name: ChoppedPlane.ConcreteCech.overlapMap_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem overlapMap_val (g : ι → ℤ) (h : κ → ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
    (L : FreeLaurent K ι →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K κ)
    (hL : ∀ p ∈ overlapGrade g a, L p ∈ overlapGrade h b)
    (p : overlapGrade (K := K) g a) : (overlapMap g h a b L hL p).val = L p.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.ConcreteCech.topMap_val
statement:
theorem topMap_val (g : ι → ℤ) (h : κ → ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
    (L : FreeLaurent K ι →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K κ)
    (hL : ∀ p ∈ overlapGrade g a, L p ∈ overlapGrade h b)
    (p : topGrade (K := K) g a) :
    (topMap g h a b L hL p).val = freeNegativePart (L p.val)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext e
  change (topProjection h b
    (overlapMap g h a b L hL
      (Submodule.inclusion (topGrade_le_overlapGrade g a) p))).val e = _
  rw [topProjection_coeff, overlapMap_val]
  rcases e with ⟨i,e⟩
  rw [freeNegativePart_apply]
  by_cases hg : (i,e) ∈ gradeIndices h b
  · simp only [topIndices, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hg, true_and]
    rfl
  · have hz : L p.val (i,e) = 0 :=
      (Finsupp.mem_supported' K _).mp
        (hL p.val (topGrade_le_overlapGrade g a p.property)) (i,e) hg
    simp [topIndices, hg, hz]

name: ChoppedPlane.ConcreteCech.topProjection_inclusion
statement:
theorem topProjection_inclusion (g : ι → ℤ) (a : ℤ) (p : topGrade (K := K) g a) :
    topProjection g a (Submodule.inclusion (topGrade_le_overlapGrade g a) p) = p
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext e
  rw [topProjection_coeff]
  by_cases he : e ∈ topIndices g a
  · simp [he]
  · simp [he, (Finsupp.mem_supported' K _).mp p.property e he]

name: ChoppedPlane.ConcreteCech.overlap_preimage_of_cross
statement:
theorem overlap_preimage_of_cross
    (g : ι → ℤ) (h : κ → ℤ) (j : η → ℤ) (a b c : ℤ)
    (L : FreeLaurent K ι →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K κ)
    (Q : FreeLaurent K κ →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K η)
    (D : FreeLaurent K η →ₗ[K] N)
    (hQU : ∀ p ∈ uChartGrade h b, Q p ∈ uChartGrade j c)
    (hQV : ∀ p ∈ vChartGrade h b, Q p ∈ vChartGrade j c)
    (hQL : ∀ p, Q (L p) = 0)
    (hDQ : ∀ p, D (Q p) = 0)
    (hLinj : ∀ p ∈ overlapGrade g a, L p = 0 → p = 0)
    (hglobal : ∀ p ∈ positiveGrade j c, D p = 0 → p = 0)
    (hlocalU : ∀ p ∈ uChartGrade h b, Q p = 0 →
      ∃ x ∈ uChartGrade g a, L x = p)
    (hlocalV : ∀ p ∈ vChartGrade h b, Q p = 0 →
      ∃ x ∈ vChartGrade g a, L x = p)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (hp : p ∈ overlapGrade g a)
    (hLp : L p ∈ uChartGrade h b ⊔ vChartGrade h b) :
    p ∈ uChartGrade g a ⊔ vChartGrade g a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,hu,v,hv,huv⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hLp
  have hsum : Q u + Q v = 0 := by
    rw [← map_add, huv]
    exact hQL p
  have hQuPoly : Q u ∈ positiveGrade j c := by
    rw [← chart_intersection]
    refine ⟨hQU u hu, ?_⟩
    have heq : Q u = -(Q v) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hsum
    rw [heq]
    exact (vChartGrade (K := K) j c).neg_mem (hQV v hv)
  have hQu : Q u = 0 := hglobal (Q u) hQuPoly (hDQ u)
  have hQv : Q v = 0 := by simpa [hQu] using hsum
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hxL⟩ := hlocalU u hu hQu
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hyL⟩ := hlocalV v hv hQv
  have hzgrade : p - (x + y) ∈ overlapGrade g a :=
    (overlapGrade (K := K) g a).sub_mem hp
      ((overlapGrade (K := K) g a).add_mem
        (uChartGrade_le_overlapGrade g a hx) (vChartGrade_le_overlapGrade g a hy))
  have hzL : L (p - (x + y)) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_add, hxL, hyL, huv, sub_self]
  have hz := hLinj _ hzgrade hzL
  have heq : p = x + y := sub_eq_zero.mp hz
  rw [heq]
  exact Submodule.add_mem_sup hx hy

name: ChoppedPlane.ConcreteCech.topMap_injective_of_cross
statement:
theorem topMap_injective_of_cross
    (g : ι → ℤ) (h : κ → ℤ) (j : η → ℤ) (a b c : ℤ)
    (L : FreeLaurent K ι →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K κ)
    (Q : FreeLaurent K κ →ₗ[K] FreeLaurent K η)
    (D : FreeLaurent K η →ₗ[K] N)
    (hL : ∀ p ∈ overlapGrade g a, L p ∈ overlapGrade h b)
    (hQU : ∀ p ∈ uChartGrade h b, Q p ∈ uChartGrade j c)
    (hQV : ∀ p ∈ vChartGrade h b, Q p ∈ vChartGrade j c)
    (hQL : ∀ p, Q (L p) = 0)
    (hDQ : ∀ p, D (Q p) = 0)
    (hLinj : ∀ p ∈ overlapGrade g a, L p = 0 → p = 0)
    (hglobal : ∀ p ∈ positiveGrade j c, D p = 0 → p = 0)
    (hlocalU : ∀ p ∈ uChartGrade h b, Q p = 0 →
      ∃ x ∈ uChartGrade g a, L x = p)
    (hlocalV : ∀ p ∈ vChartGrade h b, Q p = 0 →
      ∃ x ∈ vChartGrade g a, L x = p) :
    Function.Injective (topMap g h a b L hL)
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ∀ p : topGrade (K := K) g a, topMap g h a b L hL p = 0 → p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    have hLp : L p.val ∈ uChartGrade h b ⊔ vChartGrade h b := by
      exact (topProjection_eq_zero_iff h b
        (overlapMap g h a b L hL
          (Submodule.inclusion (topGrade_le_overlapGrade g a) p))).mp hp
    have hpSum := overlap_preimage_of_cross g h j a b c L Q D
      hQU hQV hQL hDQ hLinj hglobal hlocalU hlocalV
      p.val (topGrade_le_overlapGrade g a p.property) hLp
    have hpTop : topProjection g a
        (Submodule.inclusion (topGrade_le_overlapGrade g a) p) = 0 :=
      (topProjection_eq_zero_iff g a _).mpr hpSum
    rw [topProjection_inclusion] at hpTop
    exact hpTop
  intro p q hpq
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply hz
  rw [map_sub, hpq, sub_self]

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_syzygy_relPrime
statement:
theorem pair_syzygy_relPrime (f g u v : Poly K n) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hcop : IsRelPrime f g) (h : f * u + g * v = 0) :
    ∃ w, u = -g * w ∧ v = f * w
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd : f ∣ g * v := ⟨-u, by linear_combination h⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdvd
  refine ⟨w, ?_, hw⟩
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hf
  rw [hw] at h
  linear_combination h

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_multiplication_injective_below
statement:
theorem pair_multiplication_injective_below (q : Fin 2 → Forms K n d)
    (hq : (q 0).val ≠ 0) (hcop : IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val)
    (hed : e < d) : Function.Injective (multiplication (e := e) q)
proof:
:= by
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr
  intro a ha
  have hs : (q 0).val * (a 0).val + (q 1).val * (a 1).val = 0 := by
    simpa only [multiplication_val, Fin.sum_univ_two, Submodule.coe_zero] using congrArg Subtype.val ha
  obtain ⟨w, hw₀, hw₁⟩ := pair_syzygy_relPrime _ _ _ _ hq hcop hs
  have hv : (a 1).val = 0 := by
    have hc := congrArg (homogeneousComponent e) hw₁
    rw [homogeneousComponent_eq_self (a 1).property,
      homogeneousComponent_mul_eq_zero_of_lt e hed _ _ (q 0).property] at hc
    exact hc
  have hu : (a 0).val = 0 := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hq
    simpa [hv] using hs
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact Subtype.ext hu
  · exact Subtype.ext hv

name: ChoppedPlane.pairKoszul_injective
statement:
theorem pairKoszul_injective (q : Fin 2 → Forms K n d) (hed : d ≤ e)
    (hq : (q 0).val ≠ 0) : Function.Injective (pairKoszul q hed)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := congrArg (fun a : Fin 2 → Forms K n e => (a 1).val) huv
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hq h

name: ChoppedPlane.range_pairKoszul
statement:
theorem range_pairKoszul (q : Fin 2 → Forms K n d) (hed : d ≤ e)
    (hq : (q 0).val ≠ 0) (hcop : IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val) :
    (pairKoszul q hed).range = (multiplication (e := e) q).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [multiplication_val, Fin.sum_univ_two, pairKoszul]
    ring
  · intro a ha
    have hs : (q 0).val * (a 0).val + (q 1).val * (a 1).val = 0 := by
      simpa only [multiplication_val, Fin.sum_univ_two, Submodule.coe_zero] using
        congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp ha)
    obtain ⟨w, hw₀, hw₁⟩ := pair_syzygy_relPrime _ _ _ _ hq hcop hs
    let w' : Forms K n (e - d) := ⟨homogeneousComponent (e - d) w, homogeneousComponent_mem _ _⟩
    have hv : (a 1).val = (q 0).val * w'.val := by
      have hh := congrArg (homogeneousComponent e) hw₁
      rw [homogeneousComponent_eq_self (a 1).property] at hh
      have heq : e = d + (e - d) := (Nat.add_sub_of_le hed).symm
      conv_rhs at hh => rw [heq]
      rw [homogeneousComponent_mul_form (e - d) _ _ (q 0).property] at hh
      exact hh
    have hu : (a 0).val = -(q 1).val * w'.val := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hq
      rw [hv] at hs
      linear_combination hs
    refine ⟨w', ?_⟩
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact Subtype.ext hu.symm
    · exact Subtype.ext hv.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_hilbert_below_double
statement:
theorem pair_hilbert_below_double (q : Fin 2 → Forms K n d)
    (hq : (q 0).val ≠ 0) (hcop : IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val)
    (hed : e < d) :
    generatedHilbertFunction (generatorSpace q) (d + e) +
      2 * finrank K (Forms K n e) = finrank K (Forms K n (d + e))
proof:
:= by
  have h := generatedHilbertFunction_add_rank (e := e) q
  rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (pair_multiplication_injective_below q hq hcop hed),
    Module.finrank_pi_fintype] at h
  simpa using h

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_hilbert_above_double
statement:
theorem pair_hilbert_above_double (q : Fin 2 → Forms K n d) (hed : d ≤ e)
    (hq : (q 0).val ≠ 0) (hcop : IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val) :
    generatedHilbertFunction (generatorSpace q) (d + e) +
      2 * finrank K (Forms K n e) =
      finrank K (Forms K n (d + e)) + finrank K (Forms K n (e - d))
proof:
:= by
  have h := generatedHilbertFunction_add_rank (e := e) q
  have hk := (multiplication (e := e) q).finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [← range_pairKoszul q hed hq hcop,
    LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (pairKoszul_injective q hed hq),
    Module.finrank_pi_fintype] at hk
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at hk
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_relPrime_of_multiplication_injective
statement:
theorem pair_relPrime_of_multiplication_injective (q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d)
    (hq : (q 0).val ≠ 0)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (multiplication (e := d - 1) q)) :
    IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro h h₀ h₁
  by_contra hnu
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h₀
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h₁
  have hhn : h ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hq (by simpa only [hz, zero_mul] using hu)
  have hun : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hq (by simpa only [hz, mul_zero] using hu)
  have hhdeg : 0 < h.totalDegree := by
    by_contra! hz
    have hc : h = C (h.coeff 0) := totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.mp (by omega)
    have hcn : h.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := by intro hr; simp [hr] at hc; exact hhn hc
    exact hnu (isUnit_iff_totalDegree_of_isReduced.mpr ⟨isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hcn, by omega⟩)
  have hudeg : u.totalDegree < d := by
    have ht := congrArg MvPolynomial.totalDegree hu
    rw [(q 0).property.totalDegree hq, totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain hhn hun] at ht
    omega
  have hex : ∃ j ≤ u.totalDegree, homogeneousComponent j u ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! hz
    apply hun
    rw [← sum_homogeneousComponent u]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    exact hz j (by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hj)
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjn⟩ := hex
  have hjd : j ≤ d - 1 := by omega
  have hr : (q 0).val * v - (q 1).val * u = 0 := by rw [hu, hv]; ring
  have hc : (q 0).val * homogeneousComponent j v -
      (q 1).val * homogeneousComponent j u = 0 := by
    have hc := congrArg (homogeneousComponent (d + j)) hr
    simpa only [map_sub, map_zero,
      homogeneousComponent_mul_form j _ _ (q 0).property,
      homogeneousComponent_mul_form j _ _ (q 1).property] using hc
  let z : Poly K 3 := X 2 ^ (d - 1 - j)
  have hz : z ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero 2)
  have hzdeg : z.IsHomogeneous (d - 1 - j) := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using (isHomogeneous_X K 2).pow (d - 1 - j)
  let a : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 (d - 1) := ![
    ⟨homogeneousComponent j v * z, by
      simpa only [Forms, mem_homogeneousSubmodule, Nat.add_sub_of_le hjd]
        using (homogeneousComponent_mem j v).mul hzdeg⟩,
    ⟨-homogeneousComponent j u * z, by
      simpa only [Forms, mem_homogeneousSubmodule, Nat.add_sub_of_le hjd, neg_mul]
        using ((homogeneousComponent_mem j u).mul hzdeg).neg⟩]
  have ham : multiplication q a = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [multiplication_val, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    change (q 0).val * (homogeneousComponent j v * z) +
      (q 1).val * (-homogeneousComponent j u * z) = 0
    linear_combination hc * z
  have ha : a = 0 := (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mp hinj a ham
  have hcun : -homogeneousComponent j u * z = 0 :=
    congrArg (fun b : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 (d - 1) => (b 1).val) ha
  exact (mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hjn) hz) hcun

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_relPrime_iff_multiplication_injective
statement:
theorem pair_relPrime_iff_multiplication_injective (q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hq : (q 0).val ≠ 0) :
    IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val ↔
      Function.Injective (multiplication (e := d - 1) q)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => pair_multiplication_injective_below q hq h (by omega),
    pair_relPrime_of_multiplication_injective q hq⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_first_ne_zero_of_multiplication_injective
statement:
theorem pair_first_ne_zero_of_multiplication_injective (q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (multiplication (e := e) q)) : (q 0).val ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hq
  let z : Forms K 3 e := ⟨X 2 ^ e, by simpa using (isHomogeneous_X K 2).pow e⟩
  let a : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 e := ![z, 0]
  have ham : multiplication q a = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [multiplication_val, Fin.sum_univ_two, a, hq]
  have ha : a = 0 := (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mp hinj a ham
  have hz : (X 2 : Poly K 3) ^ e = 0 :=
    congrArg (fun b : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 e => (b 0).val) ha
  exact pow_ne_zero e (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero 2) hz

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_generatedHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem pair_generatedHilbertFunction (q : Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d)
    (hq : (q 0).val ≠ 0) (hcop : IsRelPrime (q 0).val (q 1).val) (t : ℕ) :
    (generatedHilbertFunction (generatorSpace q) t : ℤ) =
      N₂ (t : ℤ) - 2 * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - d) + N₂ ((t : ℤ) - 2 * d)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases htd : t < d
  · rw [generatedHilbertFunction_below_degree t htd _ (generatorSpace_le q)]
    rw [N₂_nat, N₂_neg (by omega : (t : ℤ) - d < 0),
      N₂_neg (by omega : (t : ℤ) - 2 * d < 0)]
    simp only [mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero, N]
    congr 1
    have hsym := Nat.choose_symm (by omega : t ≤ t + 2)
    simpa only [show 3 + t - 1 = t + 2 by omega, show t + 2 - t = 2 by omega] using hsym.symm
  · let e := t - d
    have hte : t = d + e := by dsimp [e]; omega
    have h₁ : N₂ ((t : ℤ) - d) = (N e : ℤ) := by
      have heq : (t : ℤ) - d = (e : ℤ) := by dsimp [e]; omega
      rw [heq, N₂_nat]
    by_cases hed : e < d
    · have h₂ : N₂ ((t : ℤ) - 2 * d) = 0 := N₂_neg (by omega)
      have hh := pair_hilbert_below_double q hq hcop hed
      rw [finrank_plane_forms, finrank_plane_forms] at hh
      rw [← hte] at hh
      rw [N₂_nat, h₁, h₂]
      dsimp [N]
      omega
    · have h₂ : N₂ ((t : ℤ) - 2 * d) = (N (e - d) : ℤ) := by
        have heq : (t : ℤ) - 2 * d = ((e - d : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
        rw [heq, N₂_nat]
      have hh := pair_hilbert_above_double q (by omega : d ≤ e) hq hcop
      rw [finrank_plane_forms, finrank_plane_forms, finrank_plane_forms] at hh
      rw [← hte] at hh
      rw [N₂_nat, h₁, h₂]
      dsimp [N]
      omega

name: ChoppedPlane.pair_regular_principal_open
statement:
theorem pair_regular_principal_open {ι : Type*} (hd : 0 < d)
    (q : (ι → K) → (Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d)) (hpoly : IsPolynomialFamily q)
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hq₀ : (q a₀ 0).val ≠ 0)
    (hcop₀ : IsRelPrime (q a₀ 0).val (q a₀ 1).val) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
      IsRelPrime (q a 0).val (q a 1).val ∧
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K 3) [(q a 0).val, (q a 1).val] ∧
      ∀ t, (generatedHilbertFunction (generatorSpace (q a)) t : ℤ) =
        N₂ (t : ℤ) - 2 * N₂ ((t : ℤ) - d) + N₂ ((t : ℤ) - 2 * d)
proof:
:= by
  let A := fun a : ι → K => multiplication (e := d - 1) (q a)
  have hA : IsPolynomialFamily A := by
    intro ell
    exact hpoly
      { toFun := fun qs => ell (multiplication (e := d - 1) qs)
        map_add' := by
          intro qs qs'
          rw [show multiplication (e := d - 1) (qs + qs') =
            multiplication qs + multiplication qs' from
            (multiplicationLinear (K := K) (n := 3) (d := d) (r := 2) (d - 1)).map_add qs qs',
            map_add]
        map_smul' := by
          intro c qs
          rw [show multiplication (e := d - 1) (c • qs) =
            c • multiplication qs from
            (multiplicationLinear (K := K) (n := 3) (d := d) (r := 2) (d - 1)).map_smul c qs,
            map_smul]
          rfl }
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := injective_polynomial_principal_open A hA a₀
    (pair_multiplication_injective_below (q a₀) hq₀ hcop₀ (by omega : d - 1 < d))
  refine ⟨D, hD, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  have hinj := hgood a ha
  have hq := pair_first_ne_zero_of_multiplication_injective (q a) hinj
  have hcop := pair_relPrime_of_multiplication_injective (q a) hq hinj
  exact ⟨hcop, homogeneous_regular_pair hd _ _ hq hcop,
    pair_generatedHilbertFunction (q a) hq hcop⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticKernelMatrixU_direction
statement:
theorem quarticKernelMatrixU_direction (u v z a : R)
    (hz : z ^ 3 = u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) (ha : quarticU u v * a = 1) :
    ∀ i, ∑ j, quarticRow u v z j * quarticKernelMatrixU u v z a i j =
      if i = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, quarticRow, quarticKernelMatrixU] using ha
  · simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, quarticRow, quarticKernelMatrixU, quadraticOne, add_assoc] using
      quartic_quadratic_syzygy_one u v z
  · simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, quarticRow, quarticKernelMatrixU, quadraticTwo,
      sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc] using quartic_quadratic_syzygy_two u v z hz

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticKernelMatrixV_direction
statement:
theorem quarticKernelMatrixV_direction (u v z a : R)
    (hz : z ^ 3 = u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) (ha : quarticV u v * a = 1) :
    ∀ i, ∑ j, quarticRow u v z j * quarticKernelMatrixV u v z a i j =
      if i = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, quarticRow, quarticKernelMatrixV] using ha
  · simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, quarticRow, quarticKernelMatrixV, quadraticOne, add_assoc] using
      quartic_quadratic_syzygy_one u v z
  · simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, quarticRow, quarticKernelMatrixV, quadraticTwo,
      sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc] using quartic_quadratic_syzygy_two u v z hz

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticKernelMatrixU_mul_inverse
statement:
theorem quarticKernelMatrixU_mul_inverse (u v z a : R)
    (hz : z ^ 3 = u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) (ha : quarticU u v * a = 1) :
    quarticKernelMatrixU u v z a * quarticKernelInverseU u v z a = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, quarticKernelMatrixU,
      quarticKernelInverseU, quadraticOne, quadraticTwo]
  · simpa [mul_comm] using ha
  · simpa [mul_comm, add_assoc] using quartic_quadratic_syzygy_one u v z
  · have h : z * u * (z ^ 2 * a) + u * v * (v ^ 2 * a) = quarticU u v * a := by
      unfold quarticU
      calc
        _ = (u * z ^ 3 + u * v ^ 3) * a := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hz]; ring
    exact h.trans ha
  · ring
  · simpa [mul_comm, add_assoc, sub_eq_add_neg] using quartic_quadratic_syzygy_two u v z hz
  · ring
  · have h : v ^ 2 * (u * v * a) + z ^ 2 * (z * u * a) = quarticU u v * a := by
      unfold quarticU
      calc
        _ = (u * z ^ 3 + u * v ^ 3) * a := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hz]; ring
    exact h.trans ha

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticKernelMatrixV_mul_inverse
statement:
theorem quarticKernelMatrixV_mul_inverse (u v z a : R)
    (hz : z ^ 3 = u ^ 3 + v ^ 3) (ha : quarticV u v * a = 1) :
    quarticKernelMatrixV u v z a * quarticKernelInverseV u v z a = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, quarticKernelMatrixV,
      quarticKernelInverseV, quadraticOne, quadraticTwo]
  · simpa [mul_comm] using ha
  · simpa [mul_comm, add_assoc] using quartic_quadratic_syzygy_one u v z
  · have h : -(v * z * (z ^ 2 * a)) - u * v * (u ^ 2 * a) = quarticV u v * a := by
      unfold quarticV
      calc
        _ = -(v * z ^ 3 + u ^ 3 * v) * a := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hz]; ring
    convert h.trans ha using 1; ring
  · ring
  · simpa [mul_comm, add_assoc, sub_eq_add_neg] using quartic_quadratic_syzygy_two u v z hz
  · ring
  · have h : -(u ^ 2 * (u * v * a)) - z ^ 2 * (v * z * a) = quarticV u v * a := by
      unfold quarticV
      calc
        _ = -(v * z ^ 3 + u ^ 3 * v) * a := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hz]; ring
    convert h.trans ha using 1; ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticCoordinatesU_substitution
statement:
theorem quarticCoordinatesU_substitution (u v z a : R) :
    binaryRestriction.comp (linearChange (quarticKernelInverseU u v z a)) =
      aeval (fun i => a • quarticClearU u v z i)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, linearChange_X]
  have h1 : (Fin.cases (0 : Binary R) X (1 : Fin 3)) = X 0 := rfl
  have h2 : (Fin.cases (0 : Binary R) X (2 : Fin 3)) = X 1 := rfl
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [linearForm, Fin.sum_univ_succ, binaryRestriction, h1, h2,
      quarticKernelInverseU, quarticClearU,
      Algebra.smul_def, algebraMap_eq, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg] <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticCoordinatesV_substitution
statement:
theorem quarticCoordinatesV_substitution (u v z a : R) :
    binaryRestriction.comp (linearChange (quarticKernelInverseV u v z a)) =
      aeval (fun i => a • quarticClearV u v z i)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, linearChange_X]
  have h1 : (Fin.cases (0 : Binary R) X (1 : Fin 3)) = X 0 := rfl
  have h2 : (Fin.cases (0 : Binary R) X (2 : Fin 3)) = X 1 := rfl
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [linearForm, Fin.sum_univ_succ, binaryRestriction, h1, h2,
      quarticKernelInverseV, quarticClearV,
      Algebra.smul_def, algebraMap_eq, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg] <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticCoordinatesU_clear
statement:
theorem quarticCoordinatesU_clear (u v z a : R) (ha : quarticU u v * a = 1)
    {n : ℕ} (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    quarticU u v ^ n • kernelCoordinates (quarticKernelInverseU u v z a) P =
      (aeval (quarticClearU u v z)).toLinearMap.rTensor M P
proof:
:= by
  have hs : kernelCoordinates (quarticKernelInverseU u v z a) P =
      (aeval (fun i => a • quarticClearU u v z i)).toLinearMap.rTensor M P := by
    have h := congrArg (fun T : Aux R →ₐ[R] Binary R => T.toLinearMap.rTensor M)
      (quarticCoordinatesU_substitution u v z a)
    simpa [kernelCoordinates, tensorBinaryRestriction, AlgHom.comp_toLinearMap,
      LinearMap.rTensor_comp] using LinearMap.congr_fun h P
  rw [hs, tensor_substitution_scale a _ P hP, smul_smul, ← mul_pow, ha, one_pow, one_smul]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticCoordinatesV_clear
statement:
theorem quarticCoordinatesV_clear (u v z a : R) (ha : quarticV u v * a = 1)
    {n : ℕ} (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    quarticV u v ^ n • kernelCoordinates (quarticKernelInverseV u v z a) P =
      (aeval (quarticClearV u v z)).toLinearMap.rTensor M P
proof:
:= by
  have hs : kernelCoordinates (quarticKernelInverseV u v z a) P =
      (aeval (fun i => a • quarticClearV u v z i)).toLinearMap.rTensor M P := by
    have h := congrArg (fun T : Aux R →ₐ[R] Binary R => T.toLinearMap.rTensor M)
      (quarticCoordinatesV_substitution u v z a)
    simpa [kernelCoordinates, tensorBinaryRestriction, AlgHom.comp_toLinearMap,
      LinearMap.rTensor_comp] using LinearMap.congr_fun h P
  rw [hs, tensor_substitution_scale a _ P hP, smul_smul, ← mul_pow, ha, one_pow, one_smul]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_binary_relPrime
statement:
theorem quartic_binary_relPrime :
    IsRelPrime (quarticU (X 0 : ChoppedPlane.Poly K 2) (X 1))
      (quarticV (X 0 : ChoppedPlane.Poly K 2) (X 1))
proof:
:= by
  have huv : IsRelPrime (X 0 : ChoppedPlane.Poly K 2) (X 1) := by
    apply (MvPolynomial.X_prime (i := (0 : Fin 2))).irreducible.isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
    intro h
    have he := map_dvd (eval ![0,1]) h
    simp at he
  have h3 : IsUnit (3 : ChoppedPlane.Poly K 2) := by
    rw [show (3 : ChoppedPlane.Poly K 2) = C (3 : K) from (map_ofNat C 3).symm]
    exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by norm_num : (3 : K) ≠ 0)).map
      (C : K →+* ChoppedPlane.Poly K 2)
  intro c hcu hcv
  have hu : c ∣ 3 * (X 0 : ChoppedPlane.Poly K 2) ^ 7 := by
    rw [← quartic_bezout_u (X 0) (X 1)]
    exact dvd_add (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hcu _) (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hcv _)
  have hv : c ∣ 3 * (X 1 : ChoppedPlane.Poly K 2) ^ 7 := by
    rw [← quartic_bezout_v (X 0) (X 1)]
    exact dvd_sub (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hcu _) (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hcv _)
  exact (huv.pow (m := 7) (n := 7)) ((h3.dvd_mul_left).mp hu) ((h3.dvd_mul_left).mp hv)

name: ChoppedPlane.affinePresentation_apply
statement:
theorem affinePresentation_apply
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] (Fin p → K))
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) (i : Fin p) :
    φ f i = eval (fun j => affinePresentationCoordinates φ (i, j)) f
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Pi.evalAlgHom K (fun _ : Fin p => K) i).comp φ =
      aeval (fun j => affinePresentationCoordinates φ (i, j)) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro j
    simp [affinePresentationCoordinates]
  exact congrArg (fun g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] K => g f) h

name: ChoppedPlane.affinePresentation_distinct
statement:
theorem affinePresentation_distinct
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] (Fin p → K))
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) : DistinctPoints K (affinePresentationCoordinates φ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro i j hij
  have hc : (fun k => affinePresentationCoordinates φ (i, k)) =
      (fun k => affinePresentationCoordinates φ (j, k)) := by
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · exact congrArg Prod.fst hij
    · exact congrArg Prod.snd hij
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hφ (Pi.single i 1)
  have he : φ f i = φ f j := by
    rw [affinePresentation_apply, affinePresentation_apply, hc]
  rw [hf] at he
  simp [Ne.symm hne] at he

name: ChoppedPlane.affinePresentation_ker
statement:
theorem affinePresentation_ker
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] (Fin p → K))
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) :
    φ f = 0 ↔ ∀ i, eval (fun j => affinePresentationCoordinates φ (i, j)) f = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [funext_iff, Pi.zero_apply, affinePresentation_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_affine_point_presentation
statement:
theorem exists_affine_point_presentation [IsAlgClosed K]
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K))
    [Module.Finite K (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ⧸ I)]
    [IsReduced (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ⧸ I)]
    (h : Module.finrank K (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ⧸ I) = p) :
    ∃ φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] (Fin p → K),
      Function.Surjective φ ∧ DistinctPoints K (affinePresentationCoordinates φ) ∧
      ∀ f, φ f = 0 ↔ f ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  let e := finiteReducedAlgebraFinEquiv (K := K) p h
  let φ := e.toAlgHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K I)
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := e.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  refine ⟨φ, hφ, affinePresentation_distinct φ hφ, ?_⟩
  intro f
  change e (Ideal.Quotient.mk I f) = 0 ↔ f ∈ I
  rw [← map_zero e, e.injective.eq_iff]
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileRows_pos
statement: theorem profileRows_pos (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℕ) : 0 < profileRows s r
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> simp only [profileRows, profileIndex] <;> omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileRows_succ
statement:
theorem profileRows_succ (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℕ) :
    profileRows s (r+1) = profileRows s r+3
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> simp only [profileRows, profileIndex] <;> omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.finrank_gradedProfile_eq_rows
statement:
theorem finrank_gradedProfile_eq_rows (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℕ) :
    finrank K (GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) (r : ℤ)) =
      profileRows s r
proof: := finrank_gradedProfile_nat s r

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.exists_profileRows
statement:
theorem exists_profileRows (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ s : CubicProfile, ∃ r : ℕ, profileRows s r = a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : a%3 = 0
  · refine ⟨.degreeThree, a/3-1, ?_⟩
    simp only [profileRows, profileIndex]
    omega
  · by_cases h1 : a%3 = 1
    · refine ⟨.degreeOne, a/3, ?_⟩
      simp only [profileRows, profileIndex]
      omega
    · refine ⟨.degreeTwo, a/3, ?_⟩
      simp only [profileRows, profileIndex]
      omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profile_right_degree_bound
statement:
theorem profile_right_degree_bound (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    4*(r : ℤ)+(3-(profileIndex s : ℤ)) <
      2*((profileCriticalDegree s r : ℤ)+1)+(generatorWeights s i : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> fin_cases i <;>
    norm_num [profileCriticalDegree, profileRows, profileIndex, generatorWeights] <;> omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profile_left_dual_degree_bound
statement:
theorem profile_left_dual_degree_bound (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    4*((profileCriticalDegree s r : ℤ)-(r : ℤ))-(3-(profileIndex s : ℤ)) <
      2*(profileCriticalDegree s r : ℤ)+(dualGeneratorWeights s i : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> fin_cases i <;>
    norm_num [profileCriticalDegree, profileRows, profileIndex, dualGeneratorWeights, generatorWeights] <;> omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profile_square_degree_bound
statement:
theorem profile_square_degree_bound (r : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    4*(r : ℤ)+3 < 2*(profileCriticalDegree .degreeThree r : ℤ)+
      (generatorWeights .degreeThree i : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    norm_num [profileCriticalDegree, profileRows, profileIndex, generatorWeights] <;> omega

name: ChoppedPlane.isInteger_of_coprime_integer_multiples
statement:
theorem isInteger_of_coprime_integer_multiples (x : F) (u v : R)
    (huv : IsRelPrime u v)
    (hu : IsInteger R (algebraMap R F u * x))
    (hv : IsInteger R (algebraMap R F v * x)) : IsInteger R x
proof:
:= by
  apply isInteger_of_isUnit_den
  exact huv (reduced_den_dvd_of_integer_multiple x u hu)
    (reduced_den_dvd_of_integer_multiple x v hv)

name: ChoppedPlane.isInteger_of_coprime_powers
statement:
theorem isInteger_of_coprime_powers (x : F) (u v : R)
    (huv : IsRelPrime u v) (m n : ℕ)
    (hu : IsInteger R (algebraMap R F (u ^ m) * x))
    (hv : IsInteger R (algebraMap R F (v ^ n) * x)) : IsInteger R x
proof:
:= by
  exact isInteger_of_coprime_integer_multiples x _ _ (huv.pow (m := m) (n := n)) hu hv

name: ChoppedPlane.free_coefficients_coprime_descent
statement:
theorem free_coefficients_coprime_descent {ι : Type*} (x : ι → F) (u v : R)
    (huv : IsRelPrime u v)
    (h : ∀ i, (∃ m, IsInteger R (algebraMap R F (u ^ m) * x i)) ∧
      (∃ n, IsInteger R (algebraMap R F (v ^ n) * x i))) :
    ∃ y : ι → R, ∀ i, algebraMap R F (y i) = x i
proof:
:= by
  have hi (i : ι) : IsInteger R (x i) := by
    obtain ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, ⟨n, hn⟩⟩ := h i
    exact isInteger_of_coprime_powers (x i) u v huv m n hm hn
  exact Classical.axiomOfChoice hi

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.topAuxiliaryResidueMap_surjective
statement:
theorem topAuxiliaryResidueMap_surjective [Finite J] [CharZero K]
    (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (topAuxiliaryResidueMap (K := K) g r t)
proof:
:=
  (topGradeAuxiliaryResidueDualEquiv g r t).surjective.comp
    (topProjection_surjective (fun i : J × Sym (Fin 3) t => 2 - g i.1) (-r))

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentChartComplex.ker_topAuxiliaryResidueMap
statement:
theorem ker_topAuxiliaryResidueMap [Finite J] [CharZero K]
    (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.ker (topAuxiliaryResidueMap (K := K) g r t) =
      LinearMap.range (chartDifference (K := K)
        (fun i : J × Sym (Fin 3) t => 2 - g i.1) (-r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ker_topProjection]
  ext p
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, topAuxiliaryResidueMap, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  exact (topGradeAuxiliaryResidueDualEquiv g r t).map_eq_zero_iff

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_nonpositive
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_nonpositive
    (d p : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d)
    (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p) (ha : aCount d (N d - p) ≤ 0) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r := N d - p
  have hrd : r ≤ d := (generator_count_bounds (by omega) hlo hhi).2
  have hpr : N d - r = p := by dsimp [r]; omega
  have hlow : d + 2 ≤ 2 * r := by dsimp [r, aCount] at *; omega
  obtain ⟨b, _, hs, _, _, hb⟩ := ColumnFerrers.exists_columnSeedWitness
    (K := K) (show 1 ≤ r from by dsimp [r]; omega) (show r ≤ d + 1 by omega) hlow
  let a : PointCoordinates K p := castPointCoordinates hpr b
  have hsa : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d) := by
    simpa only [a, surjective_castPointCoordinates] using hs
  have hcut : cutoff d (N d - p) = 1 := cutoff_eq_one_of_aCount_nonpos hr ha
  apply genericChoppedConclusion_intermediate_of_witness d p hd hlo hhi hr a hsa
  intro e he
  have hchop : choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) = p := by
    rw [show choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) = choppedHilbertFunction b d (d + e) from
      choppedHilbertFunction_castPointCoordinates hpr b d (d + e), hb, hpr]
    apply min_eq_right
    exact hhi.le.trans (by dsimp [N]; exact Nat.choose_le_choose 2 (by omega))
  rw [hchop]
  by_cases he0 : e = 0
  · subst e
    simp [N]
    dsimp [N] at hhi
    omega
  · exact ((intermediate_max_eq_point_iff hhi hr (by omega)).mpr (by rw [hcut]; omega)).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.mem_signedBinaryForms_iff_coeff
statement:
theorem mem_signedBinaryForms_iff_coeff (t : ℤ) (f : BinaryRing K) :
    f ∈ signedForms K 2 t ↔ ∀ s : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ,
      f.coeff s ≠ 0 → (s.degree : ℤ) = t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t
  · simp only [signedForms, ite_eq_left ht]
    constructor
    · intro hf s hs
      have h := hf hs
      have hnat : s.degree = t.toNat := by
        simpa only [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one, Pi.one_def] using h
      omega
    · intro h
      change f.IsHomogeneous t.toNat
      intro s hs
      have hnat : s.degree = t.toNat := by have h' := h s hs; omega
      simpa only [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one, Pi.one_def] using hnat
  · simp only [signedForms, ite_eq_right ht, Submodule.mem_bot]
    constructor
    · intro hf s hs
      simp [hf] at hs
    · intro h
      apply MvPolynomial.ext
      intro s
      by_contra hs
      have h' := h s (by simpa using hs)
      omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryVectorCoefficients_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryVectorCoefficients_apply (m : BinaryVector K)
    (i : Fin 3) (s : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    binaryVectorCoefficients m (i,s) = (m i).coeff s
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryVectorExponent_injective
statement: theorem binaryVectorExponent_injective : Function.Injective binaryVectorExponent
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have hi : a.1 = b.1 := by
    simpa only [binaryVectorExponent] using congrArg Prod.fst h
  have h0 : a.2 0 = b.2 0 := by
    have h' := congrArg (fun e : Fin 3 × (ℤ × ℤ) => e.2.1) h
    simpa only [binaryVectorExponent, Int.natCast_inj] using h'
  have h1 : a.2 1 = b.2 1 := by
    have h' := congrArg (fun e : Fin 3 × (ℤ × ℤ) => e.2.2) h
    simpa only [binaryVectorExponent, Int.natCast_inj] using h'
  apply Prod.ext hi
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact h0
  · exact h1

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.mem_range_binaryVectorExponent
statement:
theorem mem_range_binaryVectorExponent (e : Fin 3 × (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    e ∈ Set.range binaryVectorExponent ↔ 0 ≤ e.2.1 ∧ 0 ≤ e.2.2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨i,s⟩,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Int.natCast_nonneg _,Int.natCast_nonneg _⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha,hb⟩
    refine ⟨(e.1,Finsupp.single 0 e.2.1.toNat+Finsupp.single 1 e.2.2.toNat),?_⟩
    ext <;> simp [binaryVectorExponent, Int.toNat_of_nonneg ha, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hb]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryVectorLaurent_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryVectorLaurent_coeff (m : BinaryVector K)
    (i : Fin 3) (s : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    binaryVectorLaurent m (binaryVectorExponent (i,s)) = (m i).coeff s
proof:
:= by
  change (Finsupp.mapDomain binaryVectorExponent (binaryVectorCoefficients m))
    (binaryVectorExponent (i,s)) = _
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective binaryVectorExponent_injective]
  exact binaryVectorCoefficients_apply m i s

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryVectorLaurent_injective
statement: theorem binaryVectorLaurent_injective : Function.Injective (binaryVectorLaurent (K := K))
proof:
:=
  (Finsupp.mapDomain_injective binaryVectorExponent_injective).comp
    binaryVectorCoefficients.injective

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryVectorLaurent_mem_positiveGrade
statement:
theorem binaryVectorLaurent_mem_positiveGrade (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (t : ℤ)
    (m : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) w t) :
    binaryVectorLaurent (gradedBinaryVectorVal w t m) ∈
      positiveGrade (fun i => (w i : ℤ)) t
proof:
:= by
  apply (Finsupp.mem_supported K _).mpr
  intro e he
  have hn : binaryVectorLaurent (gradedBinaryVectorVal w t m) e ≠ 0 :=
    Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp he
  obtain ⟨⟨i,s⟩,rfl⟩ := Finsupp.mem_range_of_mapDomain_ne_zero hn
  have hs : (m i).val.coeff s ≠ 0 := by
    change (binaryVectorLaurent (gradedBinaryVectorVal w t m))
      (binaryVectorExponent (i,s)) ≠ 0 at hn
    rw [binaryVectorLaurent_coeff] at hn
    exact hn
  have hdeg := (mem_signedBinaryForms_iff_coeff (t-(w i : ℤ)) (m i).val).mp
    (m i).property s hs
  have hb := ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binary_degree s
  change 0 ≤ (s 0 : ℤ) ∧ 0 ≤ (s 1 : ℤ) ∧
    (s 0 : ℤ)+(s 1 : ℤ)+(w i : ℤ) = t
  exact ⟨Int.natCast_nonneg _,Int.natCast_nonneg _,by omega⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedBinaryLaurentMap_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedBinaryLaurentMap_val (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (t : ℤ)
    (m : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) w t) :
    (gradedBinaryLaurentMap w t m).val = binaryVectorLaurent (gradedBinaryVectorVal w t m)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedBinaryLaurentMap_injective
statement:
theorem gradedBinaryLaurentMap_injective (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (t : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (gradedBinaryLaurentMap (K := K) w t)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h
  apply gradedBinaryVectorVal_injective w t
  apply binaryVectorLaurent_injective
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedBinaryLaurentMap_surjective
statement:
theorem gradedBinaryLaurentMap_surjective (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (t : ℤ) :
    Function.Surjective (gradedBinaryLaurentMap (K := K) w t)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  have hrange : p.val ∈ Set.range (Finsupp.mapDomain binaryVectorExponent) := by
    apply (Finsupp.mem_range_mapDomain_iff binaryVectorExponent
      binaryVectorExponent_injective p.val).mpr
    intro e he
    by_contra hn
    have hp := (Finsupp.mem_supported K p.val).mp p.property
      (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hn)
    exact he ((mem_range_binaryVectorExponent e).mpr ⟨hp.1,hp.2.1⟩)
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := hrange
  let v := binaryVectorCoefficients.symm c
  have hv : binaryVectorLaurent v = p.val := by
    change Finsupp.mapDomain binaryVectorExponent
      (binaryVectorCoefficients (binaryVectorCoefficients.symm c)) = p.val
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hc
  have hgrade (i : Fin 3) : v i ∈ signedForms K 2 (t-(w i : ℤ)) := by
    apply (mem_signedBinaryForms_iff_coeff _ _).mpr
    intro s hs
    have hpne : p.val (binaryVectorExponent (i,s)) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← hv, binaryVectorLaurent_coeff]
      exact hs
    have hp := (Finsupp.mem_supported K p.val).mp p.property
      (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hpne)
    have hb := ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binary_degree s
    change 0 ≤ (s 0 : ℤ) ∧ 0 ≤ (s 1 : ℤ) ∧
      (s 0 : ℤ)+(s 1 : ℤ)+(w i : ℤ)=t at hp
    omega
  refine ⟨fun i => ⟨v i,hgrade i⟩,?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hv

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv_apply (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (t : ℤ)
    (m : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) w t) :
    (gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv w t m).val = binaryVectorLaurent (gradedBinaryVectorVal w t m)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.pointIdeal_empty
statement: theorem pointIdeal_empty (a : PointCoordinates K 0) : pointIdeal K a = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp [pointIdeal]

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreePiece_empty
statement:
theorem pointDegreePiece_empty (a : PointCoordinates K 0) (d : ℕ) :
    pointDegreePiece K a d = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  simp [mem_pointDegreePiece]

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreeSpace_empty
statement:
theorem pointDegreeSpace_empty (a : PointCoordinates K 0) (d : ℕ) :
    pointDegreeSpace K a d = Forms K 3 d
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointDegreeSpace, pointDegreePiece_empty, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]

name: ChoppedPlane.idealSpan_forms_eq_idealOfVars_pow
statement:
theorem idealSpan_forms_eq_idealOfVars_pow (n d : ℕ) :
    Ideal.span (Forms K n d : Set (Poly K n)) = idealOfVars (Fin n) K ^ d
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro f hf
    change f ∈ idealOfVars (Fin n) K ^ d
    rw [MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff]
    intro x hx
    have hdeg : x.degree = d := by
      have h := hf (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hx)
      simpa only [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one, Pi.one_def] using h
    exact hdeg.ge
  · rw [MvPolynomial.pow_idealOfVars_eq_span]
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    apply Ideal.subset_span
    have hdeg : x.degree = d := hx
    exact MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_monomial 1 hdeg

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedIdeal_empty
statement:
theorem choppedIdeal_empty (a : PointCoordinates K 0) (d : ℕ) :
    choppedIdeal K a d = idealOfVars (Fin 3) K ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [choppedIdeal, pointDegreeSpace_empty, idealSpan_forms_eq_idealOfVars_pow]

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_empty
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_empty (a : PointCoordinates K 0) (t : ℕ) :
    pointHilbertFunction K a t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointHilbertFunction, Submodule.finrank_quotient, pointDegreePiece_empty]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.form_mem_choppedIdeal_empty
statement:
theorem form_mem_choppedIdeal_empty (a : PointCoordinates K 0)
    (d t : ℕ) (ht : d ≤ t) (f : Forms K 3 t) :
    f.val ∈ choppedIdeal K a d
proof:
:= by
  rw [choppedIdeal_empty, MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff]
  intro x hx
  have hdeg : x.degree = t := by
    have h := f.property (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hx)
    simpa only [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one, Pi.one_def] using h
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_empty_above
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_empty_above (a : PointCoordinates K 0)
    (d t : ℕ) (ht : d ≤ t) : choppedHilbertFunction a d t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz : formToRingQuotient t (pointDegreeSpace K a d) = 0 := by
    ext f
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (choppedIdeal K a d) f.val = 0
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    exact form_mem_choppedIdeal_empty a d t ht f
  simp [choppedHilbertFunction, generatedHilbertFunction, hz]

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_empty
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_empty (a : PointCoordinates K 0) (d t : ℕ) :
    choppedHilbertFunction a d t = if t < d then N t else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : t < d
  · simpa [ht, N] using choppedHilbertFunction_below_degree a ht
  · simpa [ht] using choppedHilbertFunction_empty_above a d t (by omega)

name: ChoppedPlane.mainConclusion_empty
statement:
theorem mainConclusion_empty (a : PointCoordinates K 0) (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    MainConclusion K a d
proof:
:= by
  apply mainConclusion_of_small_point_count a hd (Nat.zero_le _)
  · intro i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  · intro t
    simp only [pointHilbertFunction_empty, min_eq_right (Nat.zero_le _)]

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_empty
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_empty (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d 0
proof:
:= by
  let a : PointCoordinates K 0 := fun i => Fin.elim0 i.1
  refine ⟨1, ⟨a, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
  intro b _
  exact mainConclusion_empty b d hd

name: ChoppedPlane.pointEvaluation_zero_injective
statement:
theorem pointEvaluation_zero_injective {p : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) : Function.Injective (pointEvaluation K a 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    change f = 0
    have hC : f.val = C (f.val.coeff 0) :=
      MvPolynomial.totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.mp
        (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero f.property.totalDegree_le)
    have hi : (0 : ℕ) < p := by omega
    have heval : eval (chartPoint K a ⟨0, hi⟩) f.val = 0 := by
      change f ∈ pointDegreePiece K a 0 at hf
      exact (mem_pointDegreePiece a f).mp hf ⟨0, hi⟩
    have hcoeff : f.val.coeff 0 = 0 := by
      rw [hC, MvPolynomial.eval_C] at heval
      exact heval
    apply Subtype.ext
    change f.val = 0
    rw [hC, hcoeff, map_zero]
  · exact bot_le

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreeSpace_zero
statement:
theorem pointDegreeSpace_zero {p : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    pointDegreeSpace K a 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [pointDegreeSpace, pointDegreePiece,
    LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (pointEvaluation_zero_injective a hp)]

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedIdeal_zero
statement:
theorem choppedIdeal_zero {p : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    choppedIdeal K a 0 = ⊥
proof:
:=
  choppedIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective a (pointEvaluation_zero_injective a hp)

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_zero
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_zero {p : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (t : ℕ) : choppedHilbertFunction a 0 t = N t
proof:
:=
  choppedHilbertFunction_of_injective a (pointEvaluation_zero_injective a hp) t

name: ChoppedPlane.generic_degree_zero_chop
statement:
theorem generic_degree_zero_chop [CharZero K] (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (Fin p × Fin 2) K,
      (∃ a, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
        DistinctPoints K a ∧
        (∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p) ∧
        choppedIdeal K a 0 = ⊥ ∧
        (∀ t, choppedHilbertFunction a 0 t = N t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := generic_pointHilbertFunction (K := K) p
  refine ⟨D, hD, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨hdist, hpoint⟩ := hgood a ha
  exact ⟨hdist, by simpa only [N] using hpoint,
    choppedIdeal_zero a hp, choppedHilbertFunction_zero a hp⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.coefficientGrade_zero
statement:
lemma coefficientGrade_zero (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) (k : ℤ) :
    CoefficientGrade G k (0 : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M))
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  simp only [map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
  exact (G k).zero_mem

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.coefficientGrade_sum
statement:
lemma coefficientGrade_sum {ι : Type*} (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) (k : ℤ)
    (s : Finset ι) (P : ι → AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M))
    (hP : ∀ i ∈ s, CoefficientGrade G k (P i)) :
    CoefficientGrade G k (∑ i ∈ s, P i)
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  simp only [map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  exact (G k).sum_mem fun i hi => hP i hi e

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.coefficientGrade_constant
statement:
lemma coefficientGrade_constant (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) (k : ℤ)
    (m : M) (hm : m ∈ G k) :
    CoefficientGrade G k ((monomial 0 1 : Aux R) ⊗ₜ[R] m)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  rw [tensorCoefficients_monomial]
  by_cases hs : (0 : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) = s
  · subst s
    simpa using hm
  · simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right hs]
    exact (G k).zero_mem

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.coefficientGrade_multiplyLinear
statement:
theorem coefficientGrade_multiplyLinear (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M)
    (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (hf : ∀ k i m, m ∈ G k → f i • m ∈ G (k + 1))
    (k : ℤ) {P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)} (hP : CoefficientGrade G k P) :
    CoefficientGrade G (k + 1) (tensorMultiplyLinear f P)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  rw [tensorCoefficients_multiplyLinear]
  apply (G (k + 1)).sum_mem
  intro i hi
  split_ifs
  · exact hf k i _ (hP _)
  · exact (G (k + 1)).zero_mem

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensorMultiplyLinear_iterate_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorMultiplyLinear_iterate_tmul (f : Fin 3 → R) (d : ℕ)
    (P : Aux R) (m : M) :
    (tensorMultiplyLinear f)^[d] (P ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      (linearForm f ^ d * P) ⊗ₜ[R] m
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => simp
  | succ d hd =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hd]
    change (linearForm f * (linearForm f ^ d * P)) ⊗ₜ[R] m = _
    apply congrArg (fun Q : Aux R => Q ⊗ₜ[R] m)
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.coefficientGrade_multiplyLinear_iterate
statement:
lemma coefficientGrade_multiplyLinear_iterate (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M)
    (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (hf : ∀ k i m, m ∈ G k → f i • m ∈ G (k + 1))
    (k : ℤ) (d : ℕ) {P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)}
    (hP : CoefficientGrade G k P) :
    CoefficientGrade G (k + d) ((tensorMultiplyLinear f)^[d] P)
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => simpa using hP
  | succ d hd =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    convert coefficientGrade_multiplyLinear G f hf (k + d) hd using 1
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.coefficientGrade_change_monomial
statement:
theorem coefficientGrade_change_monomial (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (hA : ∀ k i j m, m ∈ G k → A i j • m ∈ G (k + 1))
    (k : ℤ) (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ G k) :
    CoefficientGrade G (k + s.degree)
      (linearChange A (monomial s 1) ⊗ₜ[R] m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero =>
    simpa using coefficientGrade_constant G k m hm
  | @single_add i d s hi hd ih =>
    have heq : linearChange A (monomial (Finsupp.single i d + s) 1) ⊗ₜ[R] m =
        (tensorMultiplyLinear (A i))^[d]
          (linearChange A (monomial s 1) ⊗ₜ[R] m) := by
      rw [tensorMultiplyLinear_iterate_tmul]
      congr 1
      rw [add_comm (Finsupp.single i d) s, monomial_add_single, map_mul,
        map_pow, linearChange_X, mul_comm]
    rw [heq]
    have h := coefficientGrade_multiplyLinear_iterate G (A i)
      (fun k j m hm => hA k i j m hm) (k + s.degree) d ih
    convert h using 1
    simp only [map_add, Finsupp.degree_single, Nat.cast_add]
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.coefficientGrade_synthesis
statement:
theorem coefficientGrade_synthesis (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ G k) :
    CoefficientGrade G k (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (R := R) n c)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  change tensorCoefficients
    (∑ i, (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent n i) 1 : Aux R) ⊗ₜ[R] c i) s ∈ _
  simp only [map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, tensorCoefficients_monomial]
  apply (G k).sum_mem
  intro i hi
  by_cases heq : homogeneousTensorExponent n i = s
  · simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, heq, ite_true]
    exact hc i
  · simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right heq]
    exact (G k).zero_mem

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteMultiply_mem_coefficientGrade
statement:
theorem finiteMultiply_mem_coefficientGrade (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M)
    (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (hf : ∀ k i m, m ∈ G k → f i • m ∈ G (k + 1))
    (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ G k) :
    ∀ j, finiteMultiply f n c j ∈ G (k + 1)
proof:
:=
  fun j => coefficientGrade_multiplyLinear G f hf k
    (coefficientGrade_synthesis G k n c hc) (homogeneousTensorExponent (n + 1) j)

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.coefficientGrade_directional
statement:
theorem coefficientGrade_directional (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M)
    (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (hf : ∀ k i m, m ∈ G k → f i • m ∈ G (k + 1))
    (k : ℤ) {P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)} (hP : CoefficientGrade G k P) :
    CoefficientGrade G (k + 1) (tensorDirectional f P)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  rw [tensorCoefficients_directional]
  apply (G (k + 1)).sum_mem
  intro i hi
  rw [mul_smul, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  exact hf k i _ ((G k).nsmul_mem (hP _) (s i + 1))

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteDirectional_mem_coefficientGrade
statement:
theorem finiteDirectional_mem_coefficientGrade (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M)
    (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (hf : ∀ k i m, m ∈ G k → f i • m ∈ G (k + 1))
    (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) (n + 1) → M) (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ G k) :
    ∀ j, finiteDirectional f n c j ∈ G (k + 1)
proof:
:=
  fun j => coefficientGrade_directional G f hf k
    (coefficientGrade_synthesis G k (n + 1) c hc) (homogeneousTensorExponent n j)

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteCross_mem_coefficientGrade
statement:
theorem finiteCross_mem_coefficientGrade (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (hA : ∀ k i j m, m ∈ G k → A i j • m ∈ G (k + 1))
    (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ G k) :
    ∀ j, finiteCross A n c j ∈ G (k + n)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : CoefficientGrade G (k + n)
      (tensorChange A (homogeneousTensorSynthesis n c)) := by
    change CoefficientGrade G (k + n)
      (((linearChange A).toLinearMap.rTensor M)
        (∑ i, (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent n i) 1 : Aux R) ⊗ₜ[R] c i))
    rw [map_sum]
    apply coefficientGrade_sum
    intro i hi
    rw [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul]
    simpa only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, homogeneousTensorExponent_degree] using
      coefficientGrade_change_monomial G A hA k
        (homogeneousTensorExponent n i) (c i) (hc i)
  exact fun j => hsum (homogeneousTensorExponent n j)

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.crossMatrix_degree_one
statement:
theorem crossMatrix_degree_one (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) (u v z : R)
    (hf : ∀ k i m, m ∈ G k → (![u,v,z] : Fin 3 → R) i • m ∈ G (k + 1)) :
    ∀ k i j m, m ∈ G k → crossMatrix u v z i j • m ∈ G (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro k i j m hm
  have hu : u • m ∈ G (k + 1) := by simpa using hf k 0 m hm
  have hv : v • m ∈ G (k + 1) := by simpa using hf k 1 m hm
  have hz : z • m ∈ G (k + 1) := by simpa using hf k 2 m hm
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [crossMatrix, neg_smul] <;> assumption

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteCross_crossMatrix_mem_coefficientGrade
statement:
theorem finiteCross_crossMatrix_mem_coefficientGrade (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup M)
    (u v z : R)
    (hf : ∀ k i m, m ∈ G k → (![u,v,z] : Fin 3 → R) i • m ∈ G (k + 1))
    (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ G k) :
    ∀ j, finiteCross (crossMatrix u v z) n c j ∈ G (k + n)
proof:
:=
  finiteCross_mem_coefficientGrade G (crossMatrix u v z)
    (crossMatrix_degree_one G u v z hf) k n c hc

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal_le_principal_of_common_divisor
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  change signedMaximalMinor B i ∈ Ideal.span ({u} : Set R)
  apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr
  exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (hu i) ((-1) ^ i.val)

name: ChoppedPlane.primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_ideal_pair
statement:
theorem primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_ideal_pair
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R)
    (f g : R) (hf : f ∈ cofactorIdeal B) (hg : g ∈ cofactorIdeal B)
    (hcop : IsRelPrime f g) : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  have hle := cofactorIdeal_le_principal_of_common_divisor B u hu
  exact hcop ((Ideal.mem_span_singleton).mp (hle hf))
    ((Ideal.mem_span_singleton).mp (hle hg))

name: ChoppedPlane.primitiveMaximalMinors_principal_open_of_pair
statement:
theorem primitiveMaximalMinors_principal_open_of_pair {ι : Type*}
    (F : (ι → K) → Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3))
    (q : (ι → K) → Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d) (hpoly : IsPolynomialFamily q)
    (i j : Fin (c + 1))
    (hqi : ∀ a, (q a 0).val = maximalMinor (F a) i)
    (hqj : ∀ a, (q a 1).val = maximalMinor (F a) j)
    (hd : 0 < d) (a₀ : ι → K)
    (h₀ : (q a₀ 0).val ≠ 0)
    (hcop₀ : IsRelPrime (q a₀ 0).val (q a₀ 1).val) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → PrimitiveMaximalMinors (F a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := pair_regular_principal_open hd q hpoly a₀ h₀ hcop₀
