  refine ⟨D, hD, fun a ha => primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_pair (F a) i j ?_⟩
  rw [← hqi a, ← hqj a]
  exact (hgood a ha).1

name: ChoppedPlane.primitiveMaximalMinors_principal_open_of_ideal_pair
statement:
theorem primitiveMaximalMinors_principal_open_of_ideal_pair {ι : Type*}
    (F : (ι → K) → Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3))
    (q : (ι → K) → Fin 2 → Forms K 3 d) (hpoly : IsPolynomialFamily q)
    (hq : ∀ a i, (q a i).val ∈ cofactorIdeal (F a))
    (hd : 0 < d) (a₀ : ι → K)
    (h₀ : (q a₀ 0).val ≠ 0)
    (hcop₀ : IsRelPrime (q a₀ 0).val (q a₀ 1).val) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → PrimitiveMaximalMinors (F a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := pair_regular_principal_open hd q hpoly a₀ h₀ hcop₀
  exact ⟨D, hD, fun a ha => primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_ideal_pair (F a)
    _ _ (hq a 0) (hq a 1) (hgood a ha).1⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.primitiveMaximalMinors_of_binary_degree_cut
statement:
theorem primitiveMaximalMinors_of_binary_degree_cut
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 2)) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 2 N, f.val ∈ cofactorIdeal B)
    (hcop : IsRelPrime (X (R := K) (0 : Fin 2)) (X (R := K) (1 : Fin 2))) :
    PrimitiveMaximalMinors B
proof:
:= by
  apply primitiveMaximalMinors_of_relPrime_ideal_pair B (X 0 ^ N) (X 1 ^ N)
  · exact hcut ⟨_, isHomogeneous_X_pow (0 : Fin 2) N⟩
  · exact hcut ⟨_, isHomogeneous_X_pow (1 : Fin 2) N⟩
  · exact hcop.pow

name: ChoppedPlane.universalDegreeCofactorMap_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem universalDegreeCofactorMap_val (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (N : ℕ)
    (u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K) (v : rowForms K 3 δ ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i)) :
    (universalDegreeCofactorMap δ N u v).val =
      (gradedCofactorMap (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) δ
        (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ _) ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i) v).val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.universalDegreeCofactorMap_isPolynomialFamily
statement:
theorem universalDegreeCofactorMap_isPolynomialFamily (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (N : ℕ) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K =>
      universalDegreeCofactorMap δ N u)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply isPolynomialFamily_linearMap
  intro v
  have h := (universalRowCofactorMap_isPolynomialFamily (K := K) δ
    ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i)).linear_comp
      (LinearMap.applyₗ (R := K) v)
  have hval := h.linear_comp (signedForms K 3
    ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i + ∑ i, δ i)).subtype
  let P : Poly K 3 →ₗ[K] Forms K 3 N :=
    (homogeneousComponent N).codRestrict _ (fun p => homogeneousComponent_mem N p)
  have hp := hval.linear_comp P
  convert hp using 1
  funext u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change _ = homogeneousComponent N _
  simpa only [universalDegreeCofactorMap_val, LinearMap.applyₗ_apply_apply,
    Submodule.subtype_apply] using
      (homogeneousComponent_eq_self (universalDegreeCofactorMap δ N u v).property).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.universalDegreeCofactorMap_range
statement:
theorem universalDegreeCofactorMap_range (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (N : ℕ)
    (u : RowMatrixParameter δ → K) :
    (universalDegreeCofactorMap δ N u).range =
      idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u))) N
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    have hv : gradedCofactorMap (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) δ
        (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ _) ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i) v ∈
        (gradedCofactorMap (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) δ
          (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ _) ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i)).range := ⟨v, rfl⟩
    rw [gradedCofactorMap_range_eq_idealPiece] at hv
    change (gradedCofactorMap (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) δ
      (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ _) ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i) v).val ∈
        maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) at hv
    simpa only [mem_idealFormPiece, universalDegreeCofactorMap_val] using hv
  · intro hf
    let f' : signedForms K 3 ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i + ∑ i, δ i) :=
      ⟨f.val, by simpa only [sub_add_cancel, signedForms_nat] using f.property⟩
    have hf' : f' ∈ (gradedCofactorMap (rowMatrixVal δ (universalRowMatrix δ u)) δ
        (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ _) ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i)).range := by
      rw [gradedCofactorMap_range_eq_idealPiece]
      exact hf
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hf'
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun x : signedForms K 3
      ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i + ∑ i, δ i) => x.val) hv

name: ChoppedPlane.maximalMinorIdeal_map
statement:
theorem maximalMinorIdeal_map {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (φ : Poly K 3 →+* R) (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) :
    (maximalMinorIdeal B).map φ =
      Ideal.span (Set.range (signedMaximalMinor (B.map φ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [maximalMinorIdeal, Ideal.map_span]
  congr 1
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i, signedMaximalMinor_map φ B i⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨signedMaximalMinor B i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, (signedMaximalMinor_map φ B i).symm⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.rowMatrix_quotient_finrank_eq
statement:
theorem rowMatrix_quotient_finrank_eq (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (B C : HomogeneousRowMatrix K δ)
    (hB : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ B))
    (hC : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal δ C)) (N : ℕ) :
    finrank K (Forms K 3 N ⧸ idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ B)) N) =
      finrank K (Forms K 3 N ⧸ idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ C)) N)
proof:
:= by
  have hdegree : ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i) + ∑ i, δ i = (N : ℤ) := by omega
  have hb := gradedMinorQuotient_finrank (rowMatrixVal δ B) δ
    (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ B) hB ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i)
  have hc := gradedMinorQuotient_finrank (rowMatrixVal δ C) δ
    (rowMatrixVal_homogeneous δ C) hC ((N : ℤ) - ∑ i, δ i)
  unfold gradedMinorIdealPiece at hb hc
  rw [hdegree, signedForms_nat] at hb hc
  exact_mod_cast hb.trans hc.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.rowMatrix_z_saturated
statement:
theorem rowMatrix_z_saturated (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K δ)
    (hB : PrimitiveMaximalMinors ((rowMatrixVal δ B).map Ferrers.infinityMap)) :
    ∀ p : Poly K 3, X 2 * p ∈ maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ B) →
      p ∈ maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ B)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  exact mem_cofactorIdeal_of_mul (rowMatrixVal δ B) (X 2) (X_ne_zero _)
    Ferrers.infinityMap Ferrers.infinityMap_surjective Ferrers.infinityMap_ker hB p hp

name: ChoppedPlane.rowMatrix_form_cut_of_binary
statement:
theorem rowMatrix_form_cut_of_binary (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix K δ) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ f : Forms K 2 N,
      f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal ((rowMatrixVal δ B).map Ferrers.infinityMap)) :
    ∀ f : Forms K 3 N, f.val ∈
      maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal δ B) ⊔ Ideal.span {X (R := K) 2}
proof:
:= by
  apply form_cut_of_map Ferrers.infinityMap Ferrers.infinityMap_surjective
    Ferrers.infinityMap_ker
  intro f
  have hf := hcut ⟨Ferrers.infinityMap f.val, infinityMap_homogeneous f.property⟩
  rw [maximalMinorIdeal_map]
  exact hf

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedBinaryMultiply_val

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedProfileOperators_zero_val

@[simp] theorem gradedProfileOperators_zero_val (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℤ)
    (m : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) t) :

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedProfileOperators_one_val

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedProfileOperators_two_val

@[simp] theorem gradedProfileOperators_two_val (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℤ)
    (m : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) t) :
    gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) (t+1) (gradedProfileOperators q s t 2 m) =

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_cofactorIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cofactorIdeal_iff (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (p : R) :
    p ∈ cofactorIdeal B ↔ ∃ v, cofactorMap B v = p
proof:
:= by
  change p ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range (signedMaximalMinor B)) ↔ _
  rw [← cofactorMap_range_eq_span]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.cofactorIdeal_eq_span_maximalMinor
statement:
theorem cofactorIdeal_eq_span_maximalMinor
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) :
    cofactorIdeal B = Ideal.span (Set.range (maximalMinor B))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact (Ideal.span (Set.range (maximalMinor B))).mul_mem_left _
      (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have hunit : IsUnit ((-1 : R) ^ i.val) := isUnit_neg_one.pow i.val
    apply ((cofactorIdeal B).mul_unit_mem_iff_mem hunit).mp
    have hs : signedMaximalMinor B i ∈ cofactorIdeal B := Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simpa only [signedMaximalMinor, mul_comm] using hs

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_cofactorIdeal_of_mul
statement:
theorem mem_cofactorIdeal_of_mul
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (z : R) (hz : z ≠ 0)
    (φ : R →+* S) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span {z}) (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (B.map φ))
    (p : R) (hp : z * p ∈ cofactorIdeal B) : p ∈ cofactorIdeal B
proof:
:= by
  have hzker : z ∈ RingHom.ker φ := by
    rw [hker]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton z)
  have hφz : φ z = 0 := RingHom.mem_ker.mp hzker
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (mem_cofactorIdeal_iff B (z * p)).mp hp
  have hvS : (fun i => φ (v i)) ∈ (cofactorMap (B.map φ)).ker := by
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, cofactorMap_map, hv, map_mul, hφz, zero_mul]
  rw [ker_cofactorMap_eq_range (B.map φ) hprimitive] at hvS
  obtain ⟨wS, hwS⟩ := hvS
  change (B.map φ).mulVec wS = fun i => φ (v i) at hwS
  choose w hw using (fun j : Fin c => hφ (wS j))
  have hcoords : φ ∘ w = wS := by
    funext j
    exact hw j
  have hdiv (i : Fin (c + 1)) : z ∣ v i - B.mulVec w i := by
    have hi : v i - B.mulVec w i ∈ RingHom.ker φ := by
      change φ (v i - B.mulVec w i) = 0
      rw [map_sub, φ.map_mulVec, hcoords, hwS]
      exact sub_self _
    rwa [hker, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hi
  choose u hu using hdiv
  have hdiff : v - B.mulVec w = z • u := by
    funext i
    exact hu i
  apply (mem_cofactorIdeal_iff B p).mpr
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hz
  calc
    z * cofactorMap B u = cofactorMap B (z • u) := (map_smul (cofactorMap B) z u).symm
    _ = cofactorMap B (v - B.mulVec w) := by rw [hdiff]
    _ = cofactorMap B v := by rw [map_sub, cofactorMap_mulVec, sub_zero]
    _ = z * p := hv

name: ChoppedPlane.mul_mem_cofactorIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mul_mem_cofactorIdeal_iff
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (z : R) (hz : z ≠ 0)
    (φ : R →+* S) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span {z}) (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (B.map φ))
    (p : R) : z * p ∈ cofactorIdeal B ↔ p ∈ cofactorIdeal B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact mem_cofactorIdeal_of_mul B z hz φ hφ hker hprimitive p
  · intro hp
    exact (cofactorIdeal B).mul_mem_left z hp

name: ChoppedPlane.pow_mul_mem_cofactorIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem pow_mul_mem_cofactorIdeal_iff
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) R) (z : R) (hz : z ≠ 0)
    (φ : R →+* S) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span {z}) (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (B.map φ))
    (n : ℕ) (p : R) : z ^ n * p ∈ cofactorIdeal B ↔ p ∈ cofactorIdeal B
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, mul_mem_cofactorIdeal_iff B z hz φ hφ hker hprimitive]
    exact ih

name: ChoppedPlane.mainConclusion_one_generator
statement:
theorem mainConclusion_one_generator (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d)
    (hr : N d - p = 1) (hdist : DistinctPoints K a)
    (hpoint : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p) :
    MainConclusion K a d
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = 1 := by
    rw [pointDegreePiece_finrank, hpoint d, min_eq_right hhi.le]
    exact hr
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hspace, hIdeal, hregular, hcoeff⟩ :=
    principal_chop_conclusion a (by omega : 0 < d) hdim
  refine ⟨hdist, hpoint, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t
    by_cases ht : t < d
    · simpa only [expectedChoppedHilbertFunction, ht, ite_true, N] using
        choppedHilbertFunction_below_degree a ht
    · have hseries := congrArg Int.toNat (hcoeff t)
      simpa [expectedChoppedHilbertFunction, ht, not_le.mpr hhi,
        not_le.mpr hlo, hr, completeIntersectionCoefficient] using hseries
  · intro h
    omega
  · intro h
    omega
  · intro _ _
    dsimp only
    rw [hr]
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact principal_chop_regular_generators a (by omega : 0 < d) hdim
    · intro h
      omega

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_one_generator
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_one_generator [CharZero K]
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (_hp : 1 ≤ p) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d)
    (hr : N d - p = 1) : GenericChoppedConclusion K d p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hgood⟩ := generic_pointHilbertFunction (K := K) p
  refine ⟨D, hD, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨hdist, hpoint⟩ := hgood a ha
  apply mainConclusion_one_generator a hd hlo hhi hr hdist
  simpa only [N] using hpoint

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.range_uIndex
statement: theorem range_uIndex : Set.range uIndex = {e : ℤ × ℤ | 0 ≤ e.2}
proof:
:= by
  ext e

  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact Int.natCast_nonneg p.2

name: ChoppedPlane.BinaryChartRings.range_uEmbedding
statement: theorem range_uEmbedding : LinearMap.range (uEmbedding (K := K)).toLinearMap = chartU
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    apply AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported'.mpr
    intro e he
    change q.coeff.mapDomain uIndex e = 0
    exact Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range q.coeff e (by simpa [range_uIndex] using he)
  · intro hp
    have hs : (p.coeff.support : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) ⊆ Set.range uIndex := by
      intro e he
      rw [range_uIndex]
      by_contra hn
      have hz := AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported'.mp hp e hn
      exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp he) hz
    refine ⟨AddMonoidAlgebra.comapDomain uIndex uIndex_injective p, ?_⟩
    exact AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_comapDomain hs uIndex_injective

    intro e he
    change q.coeff.mapDomain vIndex e = 0
    exact Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range q.coeff e (by simpa [range_vIndex] using he)
  · intro hp
    have hs : (p.coeff.support : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) ⊆ Set.range vIndex := by
      intro e he
      rw [range_vIndex]
      by_contra hn
      have hz := AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_supported'.mp hp e hn
      exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp he) hz
    refine ⟨AddMonoidAlgebra.comapDomain vIndex vIndex_injective p, ?_⟩
    exact AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_comapDomain hs vIndex_injective

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearChange_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearChange_X (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (i : Fin 3) :
    linearChange A (X i) = linearForm (A i)
proof: := by simp [linearChange]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearChange_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearChange_C (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (r : R) :
    linearChange A (C r) = C r
proof: := by simp [linearChange]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearForm_one_row
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearForm_one_row (i : Fin 3) :
    linearForm ((1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) i) = X i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [linearForm, Matrix.one_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearChange_linearForm
statement:
theorem linearChange_linearForm (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) (v : Fin 3 → R) :
    linearChange A (linearForm v) = linearForm (fun k => ∑ j, v j * A j k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [linearForm, map_sum, map_mul, linearChange_C, linearChange_X,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  congr 1
  funext k
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearChange_comp
statement:
theorem linearChange_comp (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) :
    (linearChange A).comp (linearChange B) = linearChange (B * A)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, linearChange_X, linearChange_linearForm]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearChange_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearChange_one :
    linearChange (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) = AlgHom.id R (Aux R)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.directional_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem directional_X (f : Fin 3 → R) (i : Fin 3) :
    directional f (X i) = C (f i)
proof: := by simp [directional]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.directional_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem directional_C (f : Fin 3 → R) (r : R) :
    directional f (C r) = 0
proof: := by simp

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.directional_eq_sum
statement:
theorem directional_eq_sum (f : Fin 3 → R) :
    directional f = ∑ i, f i • pderiv i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply derivation_ext
  intro j
  simp [directional, Pi.single_apply]
  exact C_eq_smul_one

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.directional_linearForm
statement:
@[simp] theorem directional_linearForm (f v : Fin 3 → R) :
    directional f (linearForm v) = C (∑ i, f i * v i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    directional f (linearForm v) = ∑ i, C (v i) * C (f i) := by
      simp [linearForm, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul]
    _ = C (∑ i, f i * v i) := by
      rw [map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [← map_mul, mul_comm]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.directional_linearChange
statement:
theorem directional_linearChange (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (hA : ∀ i, ∑ j, f j * A i j = if i = 0 then 1 else 0)
    (P : Aux R) :
    directional f (linearChange A P) = linearChange A (pderiv 0 P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r => simp
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp [hP, hQ]
  | mul_X P i hP =>
    simp only [map_mul, Derivation.leibniz, linearChange_X, directional_linearForm,
      hA, pderiv_X, Pi.single_apply, map_add, smul_eq_mul, hP]
    split_ifs <;> simp [mul_comm]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryRestriction_embedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryRestriction_embedding (P : Binary R) :
    binaryRestriction (binaryEmbedding P) = P
proof:
:= by
  have h : binaryRestriction.comp binaryEmbedding = AlgHom.id R (Binary R) := by
    ext i
    simp [binaryRestriction, binaryEmbedding]
  exact congrArg (fun h : Binary R →ₐ[R] Binary R => h P) h

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.zeroFirst_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroFirst_monomial (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    zeroFirst (monomial s r) = if s 0 = 0 then monomial s r else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcomp : binaryEmbedding.comp binaryRestriction =
      (aeval (fun i : Fin 3 => if i = 0 then 0 else X i) : Aux R →ₐ[R] Aux R) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simp [binaryEmbedding, binaryRestriction]
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, binaryRestriction, aeval_X]
      change rename Fin.succ (X (0 : Fin 2) : Binary R) = X (1 : Fin 3)
      simp
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, binaryRestriction, aeval_X]
      change rename Fin.succ (X (1 : Fin 2) : Binary R) = X (2 : Fin 3)
      simp
  change (binaryEmbedding.comp binaryRestriction) (monomial s r) = _
  rw [hcomp]
  rw [aeval_def, eval₂_monomial, Finsupp.prod_fintype]
  swap
  · simp
  change C r * (∏ i : Fin 3, (if i = 0 then 0 else X i) ^ s i) = _
  by_cases hs : s 0 = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left hs, MvPolynomial.monomial_eq, Finsupp.prod_fintype]
    swap
    · simp
    congr 1
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [hs]
    · simp [hi0]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hs]
    have hz : (∏ i : Fin 3, (if i = 0 then 0 else (X i : Aux R)) ^ s i) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin 3))
      simp [zero_pow hs]
    rw [hz, mul_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.integrateFirst_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem integrateFirst_monomial (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    integrateFirst (K := K) (monomial s r) =
      monomial (s + Finsupp.single 0 1)
        (r * algebraMap K R (((s 0 + 1 : ℕ) : K)⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  have hb := (basisMonomials (Fin 3) R).constr_basis R
    (fun t => algebraMap K R (((t 0 + 1 : ℕ) : K)⁻¹) •
      (monomial (t + Finsupp.single 0 1) 1 : Aux R)) s
  change integrateFirst (K := K) (monomial s 1) = _ at hb
  have hr : monomial s r = r • (monomial s 1 : Aux R) := by simp [smul_monomial]
  rw [hr, map_smul, hb, smul_smul, smul_monomial]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.integrateFirst_pderiv_add_zeroFirst
statement:
theorem integrateFirst_pderiv_add_zeroFirst (P : Aux R) :
    integrateFirst (K := K) (pderiv 0 P) + zeroFirst P = P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add P Q hP hQ =>
    simp only [map_add]
    rw [add_add_add_comm, hP, hQ]
  | monomial s r =>
    rw [pderiv_monomial, integrateFirst_monomial, zeroFirst_monomial]
    by_cases hs : s 0 = 0
    · simp [hs]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hs, add_zero]
      have hle : Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 3) 1 ≤ s :=
        Finsupp.single_le_iff.mpr (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hs)
      have hexp : s - Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 0 1 = s :=
        tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle
      have hn : (s - Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 3) 1 : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) 0 + 1 = s 0 := by
        rw [Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
        omega
      rw [hexp, hn]
      congr 1
      have hcast : (s 0 : K) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hs
      calc
        (r * (s 0 : R)) * algebraMap K R ((s 0 : K)⁻¹) =
            r * algebraMap K R ((s 0 : K) * (s 0 : K)⁻¹) := by
          rw [map_mul, map_natCast]
          ring
        _ = r := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hcast, map_one, mul_one]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.first_derivative_split
statement:
theorem first_derivative_split :
    (integrateFirst (K := K)).comp (pderiv (R := R) (0 : Fin 3)).toLinearMap +
      zeroFirst = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro P
  exact integrateFirst_pderiv_add_zeroFirst (K := K) P

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.pderiv_binaryEmbedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem pderiv_binaryEmbedding (P : Binary R) :
    pderiv (0 : Fin 3) (binaryEmbedding P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r => simp [binaryEmbedding]
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp [hP, hQ]
  | mul_X P i hP =>
    have hx : binaryEmbedding (X i : Binary R) = (X i.succ : Aux R) := by simp [binaryEmbedding]
    rw [map_mul, pderiv_mul, hP, hx, zero_mul, zero_add,
      pderiv_X_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i), mul_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBinaryRestriction_embedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorBinaryRestriction_embedding (P : BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorBinaryRestriction (tensorBinaryEmbedding P) = P
proof:
:= by
  have h : tensorBinaryRestriction.comp tensorBinaryEmbedding =
      (LinearMap.id : BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M) →ₗ[R] BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M)) := by
    apply TensorProduct.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro P
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro m
    simp [tensorBinaryRestriction, tensorBinaryEmbedding]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h P

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensorBinaryEmbedding_injective
statement:
theorem tensorBinaryEmbedding_injective :
    Function.Injective (tensorBinaryEmbedding (R := R) (M := M))
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q h
  simpa using congrArg (tensorBinaryRestriction (R := R) (M := M)) h

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_first_derivative_split
statement:
theorem tensor_first_derivative_split (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    (integrateFirst (K := K)).rTensor M ((pderiv (R := R) (0 : Fin 3)).toLinearMap.rTensor M P) +
      tensorBinaryEmbedding (tensorBinaryRestriction P) = P
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun L : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R => L.rTensor M)
    (first_derivative_split (K := K) (R := R))
  simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_add, LinearMap.rTensor_comp, LinearMap.rTensor_id] at h
  have hP := LinearMap.congr_fun h P
  simpa [zeroFirst, tensorBinaryEmbedding, tensorBinaryRestriction,
    LinearMap.rTensor_comp] using hP

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_pderiv_kernel
statement:
theorem tensor_pderiv_kernel (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    (pderiv (R := R) (0 : Fin 3)).toLinearMap.rTensor M P = 0 ↔
      ∃! Q : BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M), tensorBinaryEmbedding Q = P
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ((pderiv (R := R) (0 : Fin 3)).toLinearMap.rTensor M).comp
      tensorBinaryEmbedding = 0 := by
    apply TensorProduct.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro Q
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro m
    simp [tensorBinaryEmbedding]
  constructor
  · intro hP
    have hsplit := tensor_first_derivative_split (K := K) P
    rw [hP, map_zero, zero_add] at hsplit
    exact ⟨tensorBinaryRestriction P, hsplit, fun Q hQ =>
      tensorBinaryEmbedding_injective (hQ.trans hsplit.symm)⟩
  · rintro ⟨Q, rfl, hQ⟩
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hz Q

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_directional_kernel
statement:
theorem tensor_directional_kernel
    (f : Fin 3 → R) (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (hAB : A * B = 1) (hBA : B * A = 1)
    (hA : ∀ i, ∑ j, f j * A i j = if i = 0 then 1 else 0)
    (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorDirectional f P = 0 ↔
      ∃! Q : BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M), kernelEmbedding A Q = P
proof:
:= by
  let E := (linearChangeEquiv A B hAB hBA).toLinearEquiv.rTensor M
  have hchain : (tensorDirectional f).comp E.toLinearMap =
      E.toLinearMap.comp ((pderiv (R := R) (0 : Fin 3)).toLinearMap.rTensor M) := by
    apply TensorProduct.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro Q
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro m
    change directional f (linearChange A Q) ⊗ₜ[R] m =
      linearChange A (pderiv 0 Q) ⊗ₜ[R] m
    rw [directional_linearChange f A hA]
  have hemb : ∀ Q, kernelEmbedding A Q = E (tensorBinaryEmbedding Q) := by
    intro Q
    rfl
  have hker : tensorDirectional f P = 0 ↔
      (pderiv (R := R) (0 : Fin 3)).toLinearMap.rTensor M (E.symm P) = 0 := by
    have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun hchain (E.symm P)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hc
    change tensorDirectional f (E (E.symm P)) =
      E ((pderiv (R := R) (0 : Fin 3)).toLinearMap.rTensor M (E.symm P)) at hc
    rw [E.apply_symm_apply] at hc
    rw [hc]
    exact E.map_eq_zero_iff
  rw [hker, tensor_pderiv_kernel (K := K)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨Q, hQ, huniq⟩
    dsimp only at hQ huniq ⊢
    refine ⟨Q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change kernelEmbedding A Q = P
      rw [hemb, hQ, E.apply_symm_apply]
    · intro Q' hQ'
      apply huniq
      apply E.injective
      rw [← hemb, hQ', E.apply_symm_apply]
  · rintro ⟨Q, hQ, huniq⟩
    dsimp only at hQ huniq ⊢
    refine ⟨Q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply E.injective
      rw [← hemb, hQ, E.apply_symm_apply]
    · intro Q' hQ'
      apply huniq
      rw [hemb, hQ', E.apply_symm_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearSubstitution_homogeneous
statement:
theorem linearSubstitution_homogeneous
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R)
    (hφ : ∀ i, (φ (X i)).IsHomogeneous 1)
    {n : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial σ R} (hP : P.IsHomogeneous n) :
    (φ P).IsHomogeneous n
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_unique φ]
  simpa only [one_mul] using hP.aeval (φ ∘ X) hφ

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearSubstitution_homogeneousComponent
statement:
theorem linearSubstitution_homogeneousComponent
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R)
    (hφ : ∀ i, (φ (X i)).IsHomogeneous 1)
    (n : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    homogeneousComponent n (φ P) = φ (homogeneousComponent n P)
proof:
:= by
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp only [map_add, hP, hQ]
  | monomial s r =>
    have hp : (monomial s r : MvPolynomial σ R).IsHomogeneous s.degree :=
      isHomogeneous_monomial r rfl
    rw [homogeneousComponent_of_mem (linearSubstitution_homogeneous φ hφ hp),
      homogeneousComponent_of_mem hp]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearForm_homogeneous
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearForm_homogeneous (v : Fin 3 → R) :
    (linearForm v).IsHomogeneous 1
proof:
:=
  IsHomogeneous.sum _ _ _ (fun _i _ => isHomogeneous_C_mul_X _ _)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.linearChange_homogeneous
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearChange_homogeneous (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    {n : ℕ} {P : Aux R} (hP : P.IsHomogeneous n) :
    (linearChange A P).IsHomogeneous n
proof:
:=
  linearSubstitution_homogeneous (linearChange A) (by intro i; simp) hP

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryRestriction_X_homogeneous
statement:
theorem binaryRestriction_X_homogeneous (i : Fin 3) :
    (binaryRestriction (R := R) (X i)).IsHomogeneous 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · simpa [binaryRestriction] using (isHomogeneous_zero (σ := Fin 2) R 1)
  · simpa [binaryRestriction] using (isHomogeneous_X R j)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.binaryEmbedding_X_homogeneous
statement:
theorem binaryEmbedding_X_homogeneous (i : Fin 2) :
    (binaryEmbedding (R := R) (X i)).IsHomogeneous 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [binaryEmbedding] using (isHomogeneous_X R i.succ)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_linearSubstitution_homogeneous
statement:
theorem tensor_linearSubstitution_homogeneous
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R)
    (hφ : ∀ i, (φ (X i)).IsHomogeneous 1)
    {n : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] M} (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    TensorHomogeneous n (φ.toLinearMap.rTensor M P)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (homogeneousComponent n).comp φ.toLinearMap =
      φ.toLinearMap.comp (homogeneousComponent n) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro Q
    exact linearSubstitution_homogeneousComponent φ hφ n Q
  have ht := congrArg (fun L : MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial τ R => L.rTensor M) hc
  rw [LinearMap.rTensor_comp, LinearMap.rTensor_comp] at ht
  have htP := LinearMap.congr_fun ht P
  dsimp only [TensorHomogeneous, LinearMap.comp_apply] at hP ⊢
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, hP] using htP

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.kernelCoordinates_embedding
statement:
theorem kernelCoordinates_embedding (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (hAB : A * B = 1) (Q : BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    kernelCoordinates B (kernelEmbedding A Q) = Q
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (kernelCoordinates (M := M) B).comp (kernelEmbedding A) = LinearMap.id := by
    apply TensorProduct.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro P
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro m
    change binaryRestriction (linearChange B (linearChange A (binaryEmbedding P))) ⊗ₜ[R] m =
      P ⊗ₜ[R] m
    have hab : linearChange B (linearChange A (binaryEmbedding P)) = binaryEmbedding P := by
      have h := congrArg (fun L : Aux R →ₐ[R] Aux R => L (binaryEmbedding P))
        (linearChange_comp B A)
      simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply, hAB, linearChange_one, AlgHom.id_apply] using h
    rw [hab, binaryRestriction_embedding]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hs Q

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.kernelCoordinates_homogeneous
statement:
theorem kernelCoordinates_homogeneous (B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    {n : ℕ} {P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)} (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    TensorHomogeneous n (kernelCoordinates B P)
proof:
:= by
  exact tensor_linearSubstitution_homogeneous binaryRestriction
    binaryRestriction_X_homogeneous
    (tensor_linearSubstitution_homogeneous (linearChange B) (by intro i; simp) hP)

name: ChoppedPlane.SymmetricDerivative.tensor_directional_homogeneous_kernel
statement:
theorem tensor_directional_homogeneous_kernel
    (f : Fin 3 → R) (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (hAB : A * B = 1) (hBA : B * A = 1)
    (hA : ∀ i, ∑ j, f j * A i j = if i = 0 then 1 else 0)
    {n : ℕ} (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) :
    tensorDirectional f P = 0 ↔
      ∃! Q : BinaryTensor (R := R) (M := M),
        TensorHomogeneous n Q ∧ kernelEmbedding A Q = P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hD
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, huniq⟩ := (tensor_directional_kernel (K := K) f A B hAB hBA hA P).mp hD
    dsimp only at hQ huniq
    have hcoord : kernelCoordinates B P = Q := by
      rw [← hQ]
      exact kernelCoordinates_embedding A B hAB Q
    refine ⟨Q, ⟨?_, hQ⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hcoord]
      exact kernelCoordinates_homogeneous B hP
    · intro Q' hQ'
      exact huniq Q' hQ'.2
  · rintro ⟨Q, hQ, huniq⟩
    apply (tensor_directional_kernel (K := K) f A B hAB hBA hA P).mpr
    refine ⟨Q, hQ.2, ?_⟩
    intro Q' hQ'
    have hcoord : kernelCoordinates B P = Q' := by
      rw [← hQ']
      exact kernelCoordinates_embedding A B hAB Q'
    have hhom : TensorHomogeneous n Q' := by
      rw [← hcoord]
      exact kernelCoordinates_homogeneous B hP
    exact huniq Q' ⟨hhom, hQ'⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.rowMatrixVal_ferrersSeedRowMatrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowMatrixVal_ferrersSeedRowMatrix (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ)
    (α β : Ferrers.RootIndex δ → K) :
    rowMatrixVal δ (ferrersSeedRowMatrix δ α β) = Ferrers.seedMatrix δ α β
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.ferrers_universalInfinity_degree_cut_principal_open
statement:
theorem ferrers_universalInfinity_degree_cut_principal_open
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (α β : Ferrers.RootIndex δ → K) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial (RowMatrixParameter δ) K,
      eval (rowMatrixCoordinates δ (ferrersSeedRowMatrix δ α β)) D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ u, eval u D ≠ 0 → ∀ f : Forms K 2 (2 * ∑ i, δ i),
        f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal (universalInfinityMatrix δ u)
proof:
:= by
  apply universalInfinity_degree_cut_principal_open δ (2 * ∑ i, δ i)
    (ferrersSeedRowMatrix δ α β)
  simpa only [rowMatrixVal_ferrersSeedRowMatrix] using
    Ferrers.seed_infinity_gradedCofactorMap_surjective δ α β

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cubicLinearFactors_homogeneous
statement:
theorem cubicLinearFactors_homogeneous (q : K) (i : Fin 3) :
    (cubicLinearFactors q i).IsHomogeneous 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · exact (isHomogeneous_X K 0).add (isHomogeneous_X K 1)
  · exact (isHomogeneous_X K 0).add ((isHomogeneous_X K 1).C_mul q)
  · exact (isHomogeneous_X K 0).add ((isHomogeneous_X K 1).C_mul (q ^ 2))

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileFactors_homogeneous
statement:
theorem profileFactors_homogeneous (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (i : Fin 3) :
    (profileFactors q s i).IsHomogeneous (profileFactorDegrees s i)
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> fin_cases i
  · exact cubicLinearFactors_homogeneous q 0
  · exact cubicLinearFactors_homogeneous q 1
  · exact cubicLinearFactors_homogeneous q 2
  · exact cubicLinearFactors_homogeneous q 0
  · exact isHomogeneous_one (Fin 2) K
  · exact (cubicLinearFactors_homogeneous q 1).mul (cubicLinearFactors_homogeneous q 2)
  · exact isHomogeneous_one (Fin 2) K
  · exact cubicLinearFactors_homogeneous q 1
  · exact (cubicLinearFactors_homogeneous q 0).mul (cubicLinearFactors_homogeneous q 2)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.homogeneous_mul_mem_signedForms
proof:
:= by
  apply (mem_signedForms_iff_component_self (t + d) (p * q)).mpr
  rw [signedComponent_mul_form t p q hp, signedComponent_self t ⟨q, hq⟩]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weighted_mul_mem_signedForms
statement:
theorem weighted_mul_mem_signedForms {d wsrc wtarget k : ℕ} {t : ℤ}
    {p q : BinaryRing K} (hp : p.IsHomogeneous d)
    (hq : q ∈ signedForms K 2 (t - wsrc))
    (hdegree : (d : ℤ) + wtarget = (k : ℤ) + wsrc) :
    p * q ∈ signedForms K 2 (t + k - wtarget)
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : t - wsrc + d = t + k - wtarget := by omega
  rw [← hshift]
  exact homogeneous_mul_mem_signedForms hp hq

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedProfileZ_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedProfileZ_val (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℤ)
    (m : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) t) :
    gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) (t + 1) (gradedProfileZ q s t m) =
      cyclicZ (profileFactors q s) (gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) t m)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedProfileZDual_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedProfileZDual_val (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℤ)
    (m : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s) t) :
    gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) (t + 1) (gradedProfileZDual q s t m) =
      cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s) (gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) t m)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.finrank_binaryForms
statement: theorem finrank_binaryForms (n : ℕ) : finrank K (Forms K 2 n) = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_forms, show 2 + n - 1 = n + 1 by omega,
    ← Nat.choose_symm (by omega : n ≤ n + 1)]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.finrank_signedBinaryForms
statement:
theorem finrank_signedBinaryForms (t : ℤ) :
    finrank K (signedForms K 2 t) = (t + 1).toNat
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t
  · rw [signedForms, ite_eq_left ht, finrank_binaryForms]
    omega
  · rw [signedForms, ite_eq_right ht]
    simp only [finrank_bot]
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.finrank_gradedBinaryVector
statement:
theorem finrank_gradedBinaryVector (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (t : ℤ) :
    finrank K (GradedBinaryVector (K := K) w t) =
      ∑ i, (t - w i + 1).toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_pi_fintype]
  simp only [finrank_signedBinaryForms]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.finrank_gradedBinaryVector_int
statement:
theorem finrank_gradedBinaryVector_int (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (t : ℤ) :
    (finrank K (GradedBinaryVector (K := K) w t) : ℤ) =
      ∑ i, max (t - w i + 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_gradedBinaryVector, Nat.cast_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.finrank_gradedProfile
statement:
theorem finrank_gradedProfile (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℤ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (finrank K (GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) t) : ℤ) =
      3 * t + 3 - profileIndex s
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_gradedBinaryVector_int]
  cases s <;> simp [generatorWeights, profileIndex, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.finrank_gradedProfileDual
statement:
theorem finrank_gradedProfileDual (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℤ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    (finrank K (GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s) t) : ℤ) =
      3 * t - 3 + profileIndex s
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_gradedBinaryVector_int]
  cases s <;> simp [dualGeneratorWeights, generatorWeights, profileIndex,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.finrank_gradedProfile_nat
statement:
theorem finrank_gradedProfile_nat (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℕ) :
    finrank K (GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) (t : ℤ)) =
      3 * t + 3 - profileIndex s
proof:
:= by
  have hi : profileIndex s ≤ 2 := by cases s <;> decide
  have h := finrank_gradedProfile (K := K) s (t : ℤ) (by omega)
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.finrank_gradedProfileDual_succ
statement:
theorem finrank_gradedProfileDual_succ (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℕ) :
    finrank K (GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s) ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
      3 * t + profileIndex s
proof:
:= by
  have h := finrank_gradedProfileDual (K := K) s ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (by omega)
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileCriticalDifferential_injective
statement:
theorem profileCriticalDifferential_injective
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (operatorDifferential (gradedProfileOperators q s (r : ℤ))
      (profileCriticalDegree s r))
proof:
:= by
  apply profileDifferential_injective q hq s (r : ℤ) (profileCriticalDegree s r)
  intro k
  have hm : (profileMultiplicity s : ℤ) = 3 - (profileIndex s : ℤ) := by
    cases s <;> rfl
  simpa only [hm, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using profile_right_degree_bound s r k

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileCriticalDualDifferential_injective
statement:
theorem profileCriticalDualDifferential_injective
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℕ)
    (hn : 0 < profileCriticalDegree s r) :
    Function.Injective (operatorDifferential
      (gradedProfileDualOperators q s ((profileCriticalDegree s r : ℤ) - (r : ℤ)))
      (profileCriticalDegree s r - 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply profileDualDifferential_injective q hq s
    ((profileCriticalDegree s r : ℤ) - (r : ℤ)) (profileCriticalDegree s r - 1)
  intro k
  have hm : (profileMultiplicity s : ℤ) = 3 - (profileIndex s : ℤ) := by
    cases s <;> rfl
  have hn' : ((profileCriticalDegree s r - 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      (profileCriticalDegree s r : ℤ) := by omega
  simpa only [hm, hn'] using profile_left_dual_degree_bound s r k

name: ChoppedPlane.chopEqualsPointPiece_iff_hilbert_eq
statement:
theorem chopEqualsPointPiece_iff_hilbert_eq (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    ChopEqualsPointPiece K a d (d + e) ↔
      choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) = pointHilbertFunction K a (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact choppedHilbertFunction_eq_point_of_piece_eq a
  · intro hdim
    have h₁ := (generatedProducts (d := d) (pointDegreeSpace K a d) e).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
    have h₂ := (pointDegreePiece K a (d + e)).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
    rw [generated_finrank_eq_hilbertFunction _ (pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous a) e] at h₁
    change pointHilbertFunction K a (d + e) + _ = _ at h₂
    change generatedHilbertFunction _ _ = _ at hdim
    have hrank : finrank K (generatedProducts (d := d) (pointDegreeSpace K a d) e) =
        finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a (d + e)) := by omega
    have hEq := Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq
      (generatedProducts_le_pointDegreePiece (d := d) (e := e) a) hrank
    intro f
    rw [show f.val ∈ choppedIdeal K a d ↔
      f ∈ generatedProducts (d := d) (pointDegreeSpace K a d) e from
        form_mem_ideal_iff e _ (pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous a) f]
    rw [hEq]
    exact (homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff a f).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreeSpace_eq_chop_of_piece_eq
statement:
theorem pointDegreeSpace_eq_chop_of_piece_eq {t : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (h : ChopEqualsPointPiece K a d t) :
    pointDegreeSpace K a t = idealDegreeSpace (choppedIdeal K a d) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointDegreeSpace_eq_idealDegreeSpace]
  ext P
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hhom,hmem⟩
    exact ⟨hhom,(h ⟨P,hhom⟩).mpr hmem⟩
  · rintro ⟨hhom,hmem⟩
    exact ⟨hhom,(h ⟨P,hhom⟩).mp hmem⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.chopEqualsPointPiece_above
statement:
theorem chopEqualsPointPiece_above {q : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hq : d + 1 ≤ q) (hs : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d))
    (hbase : ChopEqualsPointPiece K a d q) :
    ∀ t, q ≤ t → ChopEqualsPointPiece K a d t
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj := pointEvaluation_surjective_of_le a hs (show d ≤ q - 1 by omega)
  have hall := pointDegreeSpace_eq_of_degree_eq a (by omega : 1 ≤ q) hsurj
    (choppedIdeal K a d) (choppedIdeal_le_pointIdeal a)
    (pointDegreeSpace_eq_chop_of_piece_eq a hbase)
  intro t ht f
  have heq := hall t ht
  rw [pointDegreeSpace_eq_idealDegreeSpace] at heq
  have hh := congrArg (fun U : Submodule K (Poly K 3) => f.val ∈ U) heq
  simpa [idealDegreeSpace,f.property] using hh.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.intermediate_max_eq_point_iff
proof:
:= by
  let r := N d - p
  have hpr : N d - r = p := by dsimp [r]; omega
  have hcast : ((N d - r : ℕ) : ℤ) = (N d : ℤ) - (r : ℤ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (show r ≤ N d by dsimp [r]; omega)]
  have hformula := hilbert_max_nat_identity (d := d) (r := r)
    (show r ≤ N d by dsimp [r]; omega) e
  rw [hpr,← hcast,hpr] at hformula
  have hsign := residual_nonpos_iff_cutoff_le (d := d) (r := r) hr he
  constructor
  · intro hmax
    have hres : residual d r e ≤ 0 := by rw [hmax] at hformula; omega
    exact hsign.mp hres
  · intro hcut
    have hres := hsign.mpr hcut
    have hmax : max (residual d r e) 0 = 0 := max_eq_right hres
    rw [hmax] at hformula
    dsimp [r] at hformula
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_above_intermediate
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_above_intermediate {p d e : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hp : p < N d) (hpoint : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p) :
    pointHilbertFunction K a (d + e) = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [hpoint,min_eq_right]
  exact hp.le.trans (by dsimp [N]; exact Nat.choose_le_choose 2 (by omega))

name: ChoppedPlane.mainConclusion_of_intermediate_formula
statement:
theorem mainConclusion_of_intermediate_formula {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d) (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p)
    (hdist : DistinctPoints K a)
    (hpoint : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p)
    (hchop : ∀ e, choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) =
      max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e)) : MainConclusion K a d
proof:
:= by
  have hrd : N d - p ≤ d := (generator_count_bounds (by omega) hlo hhi).2
  refine ⟨hdist,hpoint,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro t
    by_cases ht : t < d
    · rw [choppedHilbertFunction_below_degree a ht]
      simp [expectedChoppedHilbertFunction,ht,N]
    · obtain ⟨e,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (by omega : d ≤ t)
      rw [hchop]
      simp only [expectedChoppedHilbertFunction,ht,ite_false,
        not_le.mpr hhi,not_le.mpr hlo]
      have hr2 : ¬ N d - p ≤ 2 := by omega
      simp only [hr2, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  · intro hh
    omega
  · intro hh
    omega
  · intro _ _
    dsimp only
    constructor
    · intro hh
      omega
    · intro _
      refine ⟨cutoff_lt_degree hd hr hrd,?_⟩
      intro e he
      rw [chopEqualsPointPiece_iff_hilbert_eq,hchop,
        pointHilbertFunction_above_intermediate a hhi hpoint]
      exact intermediate_max_eq_point_iff hhi hr he

name: ChoppedPlane.intermediate_formula_of_finite_witness
statement:
theorem intermediate_formula_of_finite_witness {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hhi : p < N d) (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p)
    (hpoint : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p)
    (hs : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d))
    (hfinite : ∀ e, e ≤ cutoff d (N d - p) →
      choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) = max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e)) :
    ∀ e, choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) = max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e)
proof:
:= by
  have hcut : max p (N (d + cutoff d (N d - p)) -
      (N d - p) * N (cutoff d (N d - p))) = p :=
    (intermediate_max_eq_point_iff hhi hr (cutoff_pos d (N d - p))).mpr le_rfl
  have hbase : ChopEqualsPointPiece K a d (d + cutoff d (N d - p)) := by
    apply (chopEqualsPointPiece_iff_hilbert_eq a).mpr
    rw [hfinite _ le_rfl,hcut,pointHilbertFunction_above_intermediate a hhi hpoint]
  have hfill := chopEqualsPointPiece_above a
    (by have hh := cutoff_pos d (N d - p); omega) hs hbase
  intro e
  by_cases he : e ≤ cutoff d (N d - p)
  · exact hfinite e he
  · have hce : cutoff d (N d - p) ≤ e := by omega
    have hepos : 1 ≤ e := (cutoff_pos d (N d - p)).trans hce
    rw [choppedHilbertFunction_eq_point_of_piece_eq a (hfill _ (by omega)),
      pointHilbertFunction_above_intermediate a hhi hpoint,
      (intermediate_max_eq_point_iff hhi hr hepos).mpr hce]

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_intermediate_of_witness
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_intermediate_of_witness [CharZero K]
    (d p : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d)
    (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p) (a₀ : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hs : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a₀ d))
    (hwitness : ∀ e, e ≤ cutoff d (N d - p) →
      choppedHilbertFunction a₀ d (d + e) = max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e)) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c := cutoff d (N d - p)
  choose D hD hupper using fun i : Fin (c + 1) =>
    choppedHilbertFunction_principal_upper a₀ hs i.val
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hgeneral⟩ := generic_pointHilbertFunction (K := K) p
  let E := G * ∏ i, D i
  have hne : E ≠ 0 := by
    apply mul_ne_zero
    · obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hG
      intro hz
      simp only [hz,map_zero] at ha
      exact ha rfl
    · apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
      intro i _ hz
      have hh := hD i
      simp only [hz,map_zero] at hh
      exact hh rfl
  have hex : ∃ a : PointCoordinates K p, eval a E ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hne (MvPolynomial.funext h)
  refine ⟨E,hex,?_⟩
  intro a ha
  have hparts : eval a G ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, eval a (D i) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [E,map_mul,map_prod,mul_ne_zero_iff,Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff,
      Finset.mem_univ,forall_true_left] using ha
  obtain ⟨hdist,hpoint⟩ := hgeneral a hparts.1
  have hpoint' : ∀ t, pointHilbertFunction K a t = min (N t) p := by
    simpa only [N] using hpoint
  have hsa : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d) :=
    (hupper ⟨0,by omega⟩ a (hparts.2 ⟨0,by omega⟩)).1
  have hfinite : ∀ e, e ≤ cutoff d (N d - p) →
      choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e) = max p (N (d + e) - (N d - p) * N e) := by
    intro e he
    have hi : e < c + 1 := by dsimp [c]; omega
    have hu := (hupper ⟨e,hi⟩ a (hparts.2 ⟨e,hi⟩)).2
    rw [hwitness e he] at hu
    have hpd : pointHilbertFunction K a d = p := by
      rw [hpoint',min_eq_right hhi.le]
    have hk : finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = N d - p := by
      rw [pointDegreePiece_finrank,hpd]
      rfl
    have hl := choppedHilbertFunction_lower_bounds (d := d) (e := e) a
    rw [pointHilbertFunction_above_intermediate a hhi hpoint',hk] at hl
    exact le_antisymm hu hl
  exact mainConclusion_of_intermediate_formula a hd hlo hhi hr hdist hpoint'
    (intermediate_formula_of_finite_witness a hhi hr hpoint' hsa hfinite)

name: ChoppedPlane.IsPolynomialFamily.finite_pi
statement:
theorem IsPolynomialFamily.finite_pi {f : (ι → K) → J → V}
    (hf : ∀ j, IsPolynomialFamily (fun a => f a j)) : IsPolynomialFamily f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := IsPolynomialFamily.sum (fun j =>
    (hf j).linear_comp (LinearMap.single K (fun _ : J => V) j))
  convert h using 1
  funext a j
  simp [LinearMap.single_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.traceForm_eq_zero_of_nilpotent
statement:
theorem traceForm_eq_zero_of_nilpotent {x : A} (hx : IsNilpotent x) (y : A) :
    Algebra.traceForm K A x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.traceForm_apply]
  exact (Algebra.isNilpotent_trace_of_isNilpotent
    ((Commute.all x y).isNilpotent_mul_right hx)).eq_zero

name: ChoppedPlane.isReduced_of_traceForm_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem isReduced_of_traceForm_nondegenerate
    (h : (Algebra.traceForm K A).Nondegenerate) : IsReduced A
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_⟩
  exact h.1 x (fun y => traceForm_eq_zero_of_nilpotent hx y)

name: ChoppedPlane.isReduced_of_traceForm_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isReduced_of_traceForm_det_ne_zero [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    (b : Basis J K A)
    (h : ((Algebra.traceForm K A).toMatrix b).det ≠ 0) : IsReduced A
proof:
:=
  isReduced_of_traceForm_nondegenerate
    (LinearMap.BilinForm.nondegenerate_of_det_ne_zero (Algebra.traceForm K A) b h)

name: ChoppedPlane.algebra_trace_pi
statement:
theorem algebra_trace_pi [Fintype J] (x : J → K) :
    Algebra.trace K (J → K) x = ∑ j, x j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Algebra.trace_eq_matrix_trace (Pi.basisFun K J), Matrix.trace]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  change Algebra.leftMulMatrix (Pi.basisFun K J) x j j = x j
  rw [Algebra.leftMulMatrix_eq_repr_mul, Pi.basisFun_repr]
  simp [Pi.basisFun_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.algebra_traceForm_pi
statement:
theorem algebra_traceForm_pi [Fintype J] (x y : J → K) :
    Algebra.traceForm K (J → K) x y = ∑ j, x j * y j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.traceForm_apply, algebra_trace_pi]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.algebra_traceForm_pi_matrix
statement:
theorem algebra_traceForm_pi_matrix [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] :
    (Algebra.traceForm K (J → K)).toMatrix (Pi.basisFun K J) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix_apply, algebra_traceForm_pi]
  simp [Pi.basisFun_apply, Pi.single_apply, mul_ite, Matrix.one_apply, eq_comm]

name: ChoppedPlane.algebra_traceForm_pi_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem algebra_traceForm_pi_nondegenerate [Fintype J] :
    (Algebra.traceForm K (J → K)).Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply LinearMap.BilinForm.nondegenerate_of_det_ne_zero
    (Algebra.traceForm K (J → K)) (Pi.basisFun K J)
  rw [algebra_traceForm_pi_matrix, Matrix.det_one]
  exact one_ne_zero

name: ChoppedPlane.algebra_traceForm_equiv
statement:
theorem algebra_traceForm_equiv {A' : Type*} [CommRing A'] [Algebra K A']
    (e : A ≃ₐ[K] A') (x y : A) :
    Algebra.traceForm K A' (e x) (e y) = Algebra.traceForm K A x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.traceForm_apply, ← map_mul, Algebra.trace_eq_of_algEquiv,
    Algebra.traceForm_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.traceForm_nondegenerate_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem traceForm_nondegenerate_of_algEquiv {A' : Type*} [CommRing A'] [Algebra K A']
    (e : A ≃ₐ[K] A') (h : (Algebra.traceForm K A').Nondegenerate) :
    (Algebra.traceForm K A).Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    apply e.injective
    rw [map_zero]
    apply h.1 (e x)
    intro y
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := e.surjective y
    rw [algebra_traceForm_equiv]
    exact hx z
  · intro y hy
    apply e.injective
    rw [map_zero]
    apply h.2 (e y)
    intro x
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := e.surjective x
    rw [algebra_traceForm_equiv]
    exact hy z

name: ChoppedPlane.traceForm_nondegenerate_of_split
statement:
theorem traceForm_nondegenerate_of_split [Fintype J] (e : A ≃ₐ[K] (J → K)) :
    (Algebra.traceForm K A).Nondegenerate
proof:
:=
  traceForm_nondegenerate_of_algEquiv e algebra_traceForm_pi_nondegenerate

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_below_degree
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_below_degree (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t < d) :
    choppedHilbertFunction a d t = (t + 2).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := generatedHilbertFunction_below_degree t ht (pointDegreeSpace K a d)
    (pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous a)
  simpa [choppedHilbertFunction, show 3 + t - 1 = t + 2 by omega,
    ← Nat.choose_symm (by omega : t ≤ t + 2)] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.generatedProducts_le_pointDegreePiece
statement:
theorem generatedProducts_le_pointDegreePiece (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    generatedProducts (d := d) (pointDegreeSpace K a d) e ≤
      pointDegreePiece K a (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  apply (homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff a f).mp
  apply choppedIdeal_le_pointIdeal a
  exact (form_mem_ideal_iff e _ (pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous a) f).mpr hf

name: ChoppedPlane.pointHilbertFunction_le_choppedHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem pointHilbertFunction_le_choppedHilbertFunction (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    pointHilbertFunction K a (d + e) ≤ choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  have hle := Submodule.finrank_mono (generatedProducts_le_pointDegreePiece (d := d) (e := e) a)
  have h₁ := (generatedProducts (d := d) (pointDegreeSpace K a d) e).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  have h₂ := (pointDegreePiece K a (d + e)).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  rw [generated_finrank_eq_hilbertFunction _ (pointDegreeSpace_homogeneous a) e] at h₁
  change _ + _ = _ at h₂
  change _ ≤ generatedHilbertFunction _ _
  dsimp [pointHilbertFunction]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.single_generator_hilbertFunction
statement:
theorem single_generator_hilbertFunction (f : Forms K 3 d) (hf : f.val ≠ 0) :
    generatedHilbertFunction (Submodule.span K {f.val}) (d + e) =
      (d + e + 2).choose 2 - (e + 2).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  let q : Fin 1 → Forms K 3 d := fun _ => f
  have hq : generatorSpace q = Submodule.span K {f.val} := by
    ext x
    simp [generatorSpace, q]
  have hdim : finrank K (LinearMap.range (multiplication (e := e) q)) = (e + 2).choose 2 := by
    have hi : Function.Injective (multiplication (e := e) q) := by
      intro a b hab
      have he : (a 0 : Forms K 3 e) = b 0 := by
        apply mulForm_injective f hf
        simpa [multiplication, q] using hab
      funext i
      have : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simpa [this] using he
    rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hi]
    simp [Module.finrank_pi_fintype, finrank_plane_forms]
  have h := generatedHilbertFunction_add_rank (e := e) q
  rw [hq, hdim, finrank_plane_forms] at h
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreePiece_finrank
statement:
theorem pointDegreePiece_finrank (a : PointCoordinates K p) (d : ℕ) :
    finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) =
      (d + 2).choose 2 - pointHilbertFunction K a d
proof:
:= by
  have h := (pointDegreePiece K a d).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  rw [finrank_plane_forms] at h
  change pointHilbertFunction K a d + _ = _ at h
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective
statement:
theorem choppedIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hi : Function.Injective (pointEvaluation K a d)) : choppedIdeal K a d = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [choppedIdeal, pointDegreeSpace, pointDegreePiece, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hi]

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedIdeal_eq_bot_of_pointHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem choppedIdeal_eq_bot_of_pointHilbertFunction (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hh : pointHilbertFunction K a d = (d + 2).choose 2) : choppedIdeal K a d = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply choppedIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective a
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  apply Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp
  change finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) = 0
  rw [pointDegreePiece_finrank, hh, Nat.sub_self]

name: ChoppedPlane.generatedHilbertFunction_bot
statement:
theorem generatedHilbertFunction_bot (n t : ℕ) :
    generatedHilbertFunction (⊥ : Submodule K (Poly K n)) t = (n + t - 1).choose t
proof:
:= by
  exact generatedHilbertFunction_below_degree (d := t + 1) t (by omega) ⊥ bot_le

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_of_injective
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_of_injective (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hi : Function.Injective (pointEvaluation K a d)) (t : ℕ) :
    choppedHilbertFunction a d t = (t + 2).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb : pointDegreeSpace K a d = ⊥ := by
    simp [pointDegreeSpace, pointDegreePiece, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hi]
  change generatedHilbertFunction _ _ = _
  rw [hb, generatedHilbertFunction_bot]
  rw [show 3 + t - 1 = t + 2 by omega, ← Nat.choose_symm (by omega : t ≤ t + 2)]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_degree_generators
statement:
theorem exists_degree_generators (a : PointCoordinates K p) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : Fin (finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d)) → Forms K 3 d,
      generatorSpace q = pointDegreeSpace K a d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Module.Free K (pointDegreePiece K a d) :=
    Module.Free.of_divisionRing K ↥(pointDegreePiece K a d)
  let b := Module.finBasis K (pointDegreePiece K a d)
  let q := fun i => (b i).val
  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨q i, (b i).property, rfl⟩
  · rintro f ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := b.mem_submodule_iff'.mp hg
    apply (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun K).mpr
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun z : Forms K 3 d => z.val) hc
    simpa [q, b, Submodule.coe_sum] using h.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.choppedHilbertFunction_lower_bounds
statement:
theorem choppedHilbertFunction_lower_bounds (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    max (pointHilbertFunction K a (d + e))
      ((d + e + 2).choose 2 -
        finrank K (pointDegreePiece K a d) * (e + 2).choose 2) ≤
      choppedHilbertFunction a d (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_degree_generators a d
  apply max_le
  · exact pointHilbertFunction_le_choppedHilbertFunction a
  · have h := generatedHilbertFunction_lower_bound (e := e) q
    rw [hq, finrank_plane_forms, finrank_plane_forms] at h
    exact h

name: ChoppedPlane.regular_pair_of_relPrime
statement:
theorem regular_pair_of_relPrime {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [DecompositionMonoid R] (f g : R) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hcop : IsRelPrime f g)
    (hproper : Ideal.ofList [f,g] ≠ ⊤) :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular R [f,g]
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : IsSMulRegular R f := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro x hx
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hx).resolve_left hf
  have hsecond : IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop f R) g := by
    apply (isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem (f • (⊤ : Submodule R R)) g).mpr
    intro x hx
    rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists] at hx ⊢
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hey⟩ := hx
    have hdiv : f ∣ g * x := ⟨y, by simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hey.symm⟩
    obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdiv
    exact ⟨q,Submodule.mem_top,by simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hq.symm⟩
  refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
  · apply (RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff R f [g]).mpr
    refine ⟨hfirst,?_⟩
    exact (RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff (QuotSMulTop f R) g).mpr hsecond
  · intro h
    apply hproper
    simpa only [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top] using h.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_eval_origin_eq_zero
statement:
theorem homogeneous_eval_origin_eq_zero {K : Type*} [Field K] {n d : ℕ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (f : Forms K n d) : MvPolynomial.eval (fun _ => 0) f.val = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := homogeneous_eval_scale f.property (fun _ => (0 : K)) 0
  simpa [zero_pow (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hd)] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_regular_pair
statement:
theorem homogeneous_regular_pair {K : Type*} [Field K] {n d : ℕ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (f g : Forms K n d) (hf : f.val ≠ 0)
    (hcop : IsRelPrime f.val g.val) :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Poly K n) [f.val,g.val]
proof:
:= by
  apply regular_pair_of_relPrime f.val g.val hf hcop
  intro htop
  have hle : Ideal.ofList [f.val,g.val] ≤ RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.eval (fun _ => 0)) := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro p hp
    simp at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl
    · exact homogeneous_eval_origin_eq_zero hd f
    · exact homogeneous_eval_origin_eq_zero hd g
  have h1 := hle (htop ▸ (Submodule.mem_top : (1 : Poly K n) ∈ ⊤))
  exact one_ne_zero (by simpa only [RingHom.mem_ker, map_one] using h1)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_scalar_transpose
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_scalar_transpose [Fintype ι] (w : ι → K)
    (c : BinaryLaurent K) (q p : ι → BinaryLaurent K) :
    vectorResidueFunctional w q (fun i => c * p i) =
      vectorResidueFunctional w (fun i => c * q i) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [vectorResidueFunctional_apply, vectorResidueFunctional_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm (q i) c]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.freeNegativePart_mem_negativeGrade_of_overlap
statement:
theorem freeNegativePart_mem_negativeGrade_of_overlap (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι)
    (hp : p ∈ LaurentChartComplex.overlapGrade (fun i => 2 - g i) (-r)) :
    freeNegativePart p ∈ negativeGrade (K := K) g r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Finsupp.mem_supported K _).mpr
  rintro ⟨i,e⟩ he
  have hn : freeNegativePart p (i,e) ≠ 0 := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp he
  rw [freeNegativePart_apply] at hn
  split_ifs at hn with hneg
  · have hdeg := (Finsupp.mem_supported K p).mp hp (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hn)
    exact ⟨hneg.1,hneg.2,hdeg⟩
  · exact False.elim (hn rfl)

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.negativeGrade_mem_overlap
statement:
theorem negativeGrade_mem_overlap (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (p : negativeGrade (K := K) g r) :
    p.val ∈ LaurentChartComplex.overlapGrade (fun i => 2 - g i) (-r)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Finsupp.mem_supported K p.val).mpr
  intro e he
  exact ((Finsupp.mem_supported K p.val).mp p.property he).2.2

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profilePositiveOperators_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem profilePositiveOperators_val (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ)
    (i : Fin 3) (p : positiveGrade (K := K) (fun j => (generatorWeights s j : ℤ)) r) :
    (profilePositiveOperators q s r i p).val = rawLaurentProfileOperators q s i p.val
proof:
:= by
  let m := (gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv (generatorWeights s) r).symm p
  have hm : gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv (generatorWeights s) r m = p :=
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  change (gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv (generatorWeights s) (r+1)
    (gradedProfileOperators q s r i m)).val = _
  fin_cases i
  · change (gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv (generatorWeights s) (r+1)
      (gradedBinaryCoordinate 0 (generatorWeights s) r m)).val = laurentScalar U p.val
    rw [gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv_coordinate, binaryLaurentEmbedding_X_zero, hm]
  · change (gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv (generatorWeights s) (r+1)
      (gradedBinaryCoordinate 1 (generatorWeights s) r m)).val = laurentScalar V p.val
    rw [gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv_coordinate, binaryLaurentEmbedding_X_one, hm]
  · change (gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv (generatorWeights s) (r+1)
      (gradedProfileZ q s r m)).val = laurentCyclicZ q s p.val
    rw [gradedBinaryLaurentEquiv_Z, hm]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.dualGeneratorWeights_int
statement:
theorem dualGeneratorWeights_int (s : CubicProfile) :
    (fun i => (dualGeneratorWeights s i : ℤ)) =
      (fun i => 2 - (generatorWeights s i : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  cases s <;> fin_cases i <;> norm_num [dualGeneratorWeights, generatorWeights]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.rawLaurentProfileDualOperators_mem_overlapGrade
statement:
theorem rawLaurentProfileDualOperators_mem_overlapGrade (q : K) (s : CubicProfile)
    (k : ℤ) (i : Fin 3) (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3))
    (hp : p ∈ overlapGrade (fun j => 2 - (generatorWeights s j : ℤ)) k) :
    rawLaurentProfileDualOperators q s i p ∈
      overlapGrade (fun j => 2 - (generatorWeights s j : ℤ)) (k+1)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · exact laurentScalar_mem_overlapGrade U 1 U_mem_polynomialLaurentGrade _ k p hp
  · exact laurentScalar_mem_overlapGrade V 1 V_mem_polynomialLaurentGrade _ k p hp
  · rw [← dualGeneratorWeights_int] at hp ⊢
    exact laurentCyclicZDual_mem_overlapGrade q s k p hp

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileNegativeOperators_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem profileNegativeOperators_val (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : negativeGrade (K := K) (fun j => (generatorWeights s j : ℤ)) (r+1)) :
    (profileNegativeOperators q hq s r i p).val =
      freeNegativePart (rawLaurentProfileDualOperators q s i p.val)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileOperators_residue_adjoint
statement:
theorem profileOperators_residue_adjoint (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (i : Fin 3)
    (d : negativeGrade (K := K) (fun j => (generatorWeights s j : ℤ)) (r+1))
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) (fun j => (generatorWeights s j : ℤ)) r) :
    residuePair (fun j => (generatorWeights s j : ℤ)) (r+1) d
        (profilePositiveOperators q s r i p) =
      residuePair (fun j => (generatorWeights s j : ℤ)) r
        (profileNegativeOperators q hq s r i d) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [residuePair_eq_vectorResidue, residuePair_eq_vectorResidue,
    profilePositiveOperators_val, profileNegativeOperators_val,
    vectorResidueFunctional_freeNegativePart]
  fin_cases i
  · change vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ => (1 : K)) (freeLaurentEquiv d.val)
        (freeLaurentEquiv (laurentScalar U p.val)) =
      vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ => (1 : K)) (freeLaurentEquiv (laurentScalar U d.val))
        (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)
    have hscalar (a : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3)) :
        freeLaurentEquiv (laurentScalar U a) = fun j => U * freeLaurentEquiv a j :=
      funext (freeLaurentEquiv_laurentScalar U a)
    rw [hscalar, hscalar]
    exact vectorResidueFunctional_scalar_transpose (fun _ : Fin 3 => (1 : K)) U _ _
  · change vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ => (1 : K)) (freeLaurentEquiv d.val)
        (freeLaurentEquiv (laurentScalar V p.val)) =
      vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ => (1 : K)) (freeLaurentEquiv (laurentScalar V d.val))
        (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)
    have hscalar (a : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3)) :
        freeLaurentEquiv (laurentScalar V a) = fun j => V * freeLaurentEquiv a j :=
      funext (freeLaurentEquiv_laurentScalar V a)
    rw [hscalar, hscalar]
    exact vectorResidueFunctional_scalar_transpose (fun _ : Fin 3 => (1 : K)) V _ _
  · change vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ => (1 : K)) (freeLaurentEquiv d.val)
        (freeLaurentEquiv (laurentCyclicZ q s p.val)) =
      vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ => (1 : K))
        (freeLaurentEquiv (laurentCyclicZDual q s d.val)) (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)
    rw [freeLaurentEquiv_laurentCyclicZ, freeLaurentEquiv_laurentCyclicZDual]
    exact vectorResidueFunctional_cyclic_transpose (1 : K) _ _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.rawLaurentProfileDualOperators_chart_action
statement:
theorem rawLaurentProfileDualOperators_chart_action
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) :
    letI
proof:
:= chartDualModuleStructure (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) q hq s
    letI := cyclicModuleScalarTower (K := K)
      (binaryChartLaurentMap (binaryCubic K))
      (chartDualZ binaryChartLaurentMap q s)
      (chartDualZ_cube binaryChartLaurentMap q hq s)
    ∀ (i : Fin 3) (p : FreeLaurent K (Fin 3)),
      freeLaurentEquiv (rawLaurentProfileDualOperators q s i p) =
        scalarAction (K := K) (chartLinearForm (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) i)
          (freeLaurentEquiv p) := by
  let := chartDualModuleStructure (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) q hq s
  let := cyclicModuleScalarTower (K := K)
    (binaryChartLaurentMap (binaryCubic K))
    (chartDualZ binaryChartLaurentMap q s)
    (chartDualZ_cube binaryChartLaurentMap q hq s)
  intro i p
  rw [scalarAction_apply]
  fin_cases i
  · change freeLaurentEquiv (laurentScalar U p) =
      cyclicCoefficientHom _ (binaryChartLaurentMap (binaryU K)) • freeLaurentEquiv p
    rw [cyclicModule_coefficient_smul, binaryChartLaurentMap_binaryU]
    funext j
    simp only [freeLaurentEquiv_laurentScalar, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  · change freeLaurentEquiv (laurentScalar V p) =
      cyclicCoefficientHom _ (binaryChartLaurentMap (binaryV K)) • freeLaurentEquiv p
    rw [cyclicModule_coefficient_smul, binaryChartLaurentMap_binaryV]
    funext j
    simp only [freeLaurentEquiv_laurentScalar, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  · change freeLaurentEquiv (laurentCyclicZDual q s p) = cyclicRoot _ • freeLaurentEquiv p
    rw [cyclicModule_root_smul, freeLaurentEquiv_laurentCyclicZDual]
    rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileNegativeOperators_chart_action
statement:
theorem profileNegativeOperators_chart_action
    (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) :
    letI
proof:
:= chartDualModuleStructure (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) q hq s
    letI := cyclicModuleScalarTower (K := K)
      (binaryChartLaurentMap (binaryCubic K))
      (chartDualZ binaryChartLaurentMap q s)
      (chartDualZ_cube binaryChartLaurentMap q hq s)
    ∀ (i : Fin 3)
      (p : negativeGrade (K := K) (fun j => (generatorWeights s j : ℤ)) (r+1)),
      freeLaurentEquiv (profileNegativeOperators q hq s r i p).val =
        fun j => negativePart
          (scalarAction (K := K) (chartLinearForm (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) i)
            (freeLaurentEquiv p.val) j) := by
  let := chartDualModuleStructure (binaryChartLaurentMap (K := K)) q hq s
  let := cyclicModuleScalarTower (K := K)
    (binaryChartLaurentMap (binaryCubic K))
    (chartDualZ binaryChartLaurentMap q s)
    (chartDualZ_cube binaryChartLaurentMap q hq s)
  intro i p
  rw [profileNegativeOperators_val]
  funext j
  rw [freeLaurentEquiv_negativePart, rawLaurentProfileDualOperators_chart_action q hq s]

name: ChoppedPlane.card_maximalSpectrum_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem card_maximalSpectrum_eq_finrank :
    Nat.card (MaximalSpectrum A) = Module.finrank K A
proof:
:= by
  let : IsArtinianRing A := IsArtinianRing.of_finite K A
  let := Fintype.ofFinite (MaximalSpectrum A)
  simpa using (finiteReducedAlgebraEquiv (K := K) (A := A)).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVectorBaseChange_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedVectorBaseChange_apply (φ : A →+* A')
    (ρ : Fin 3 → A') (m : Fin 3 → A) (i : Fin 3) :
    weightedVectorBaseChange φ ρ m i = φ (m i) * ρ i
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVectorBaseChange_injective
statement:
theorem weightedVectorBaseChange_injective [IsDomain A']
    (φ : A →+* A') (hφ : Function.Injective φ) (ρ : Fin 3 → A')
    (hρ : ∀ i, ρ i ≠ 0) : Function.Injective (weightedVectorBaseChange φ ρ)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h
  funext i
  apply hφ
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ (hρ i) (congrFun h i)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVectorBaseChange_cyclicZ
statement:
theorem weightedVectorBaseChange_cyclicZ
    (φ : A →+* A') (γ : Fin 3 → A) (γ' ρ : Fin 3 → A') (H : A')
    (h : ∀ i, φ (γ i) * ρ (cyclicNext i) = H * γ' i * ρ i)
    (m : Fin 3 → A) :
    weightedVectorBaseChange φ ρ (cyclicZ γ m) =
      H • cyclicZ γ' (weightedVectorBaseChange φ ρ m)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  have h0 := h 0
  have h1 := h 1
  have h2 := h 2
  change φ (γ 0) * ρ 1 = H * γ' 0 * ρ 0 at h0
  change φ (γ 1) * ρ 2 = H * γ' 1 * ρ 1 at h1
  change φ (γ 2) * ρ 0 = H * γ' 2 * ρ 2 at h2
  fin_cases i
  · change φ (γ 2 * m 2) * ρ 0 = H * (γ' 2 * (φ (m 2) * ρ 2))
    rw [map_mul]
    calc
      _ = (φ (γ 2) * ρ 0) * φ (m 2) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [h2]; ring
  · change φ (γ 0 * m 0) * ρ 1 = H * (γ' 0 * (φ (m 0) * ρ 0))
    rw [map_mul]
    calc
      _ = (φ (γ 0) * ρ 1) * φ (m 0) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [h0]; ring
  · change φ (γ 1 * m 1) * ρ 2 = H * (γ' 1 * (φ (m 1) * ρ 1))
    rw [map_mul]
    calc
      _ = (φ (γ 1) * ρ 2) * φ (m 1) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [h1]; ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVectorBaseChange_cyclicZDual
statement:
theorem weightedVectorBaseChange_cyclicZDual
    (φ : A →+* A') (γ : Fin 3 → A) (γ' ρ : Fin 3 → A') (H : A')
    (h : ∀ i, φ (γ i) * ρ i = H * γ' i * ρ (cyclicNext i))
    (m : Fin 3 → A) :
    weightedVectorBaseChange φ ρ (cyclicZDual γ m) =
      H • cyclicZDual γ' (weightedVectorBaseChange φ ρ m)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  have h0 := h 0
  have h1 := h 1
  have h2 := h 2
  change φ (γ 0) * ρ 0 = H * γ' 0 * ρ 1 at h0
  change φ (γ 1) * ρ 1 = H * γ' 1 * ρ 2 at h1
  change φ (γ 2) * ρ 2 = H * γ' 2 * ρ 0 at h2
  fin_cases i
  · change φ (γ 0 * m 1) * ρ 0 = H * (γ' 0 * (φ (m 1) * ρ 1))
    rw [map_mul]
    calc
      _ = (φ (γ 0) * ρ 0) * φ (m 1) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [h0]; ring
  · change φ (γ 1 * m 2) * ρ 1 = H * (γ' 1 * (φ (m 2) * ρ 2))
    rw [map_mul]
    calc
      _ = (φ (γ 1) * ρ 1) * φ (m 2) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [h1]; ring
  · change φ (γ 2 * m 0) * ρ 2 = H * (γ' 2 * (φ (m 0) * ρ 0))
    rw [map_mul]
    calc
      _ = (φ (γ 2) * ρ 2) * φ (m 0) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [h2]; ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom_root
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom_root (φ : A →+* A') (F : A) (F' H : A')
    (hF : φ F = F' * H ^ 3) :
    cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom φ F F' H hF (cyclicRoot F) =
      cyclicCoefficientHom F' H * cyclicRoot F'
proof:
:= by
  simp [cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom, cyclicRoot]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom_coefficient
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom_coefficient
    (φ : A →+* A') (F : A) (F' H : A') (hF : φ F = F' * H ^ 3) (a : A) :
    cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom φ F F' H hF (cyclicCoefficientHom F a) =
      cyclicCoefficientHom F' (φ a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom, cyclicCoefficientHom]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicActionHom_scaledBaseChange_polynomial
statement:
theorem cyclicActionHom_scaledBaseChange_polynomial
    (φ : A →+* A') (F : A) (F' H : A') (hF : φ F = F' * H ^ 3)
    (Z' : Module.End A' (Fin 3 → A')) (hZ' : Z' ^ 3 = F' • 1)
    (p : Polynomial A) :
    cyclicActionHom F' Z' hZ'
      (cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom φ F F' H hF
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {cyclicCubicEquation F}) p)) =
      Polynomial.aeval (H • Z') (p.map φ)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, Polynomial.map_add, hp, hq]
  | monomial n a =>
    simp [cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom, Polynomial.aeval_monomial,
      cyclicActionHom_coefficient, cyclicActionHom_root,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicActionHom_scaledBaseChange
statement:
theorem cyclicActionHom_scaledBaseChange
    (φ : A →+* A') (F : A) (F' H : A') (hF : φ F = F' * H ^ 3)
    (T : (Fin 3 → A) →ₛₗ[φ] (Fin 3 → A'))
    (Z : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A)) (Z' : Module.End A' (Fin 3 → A'))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = F • 1) (hZ' : Z' ^ 3 = F' • 1)
    (hT : ∀ m, T (Z m) = H • Z' (T m))
    (r : CyclicCubicRing A F) (m : Fin 3 → A) :
    T (cyclicActionHom F Z hZ r m) =
      cyclicActionHom F' Z' hZ' (cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom φ F F' H hF r) (T m)
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' r ?_
  intro p
  change T (cyclicActionHom F Z hZ
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {cyclicCubicEquation F}) p) m) =
    cyclicActionHom F' Z' hZ' (cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom φ F F' H hF
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {cyclicCubicEquation F}) p)) (T m)
  rw [cyclicActionHom_scaledBaseChange_polynomial]
  change T (Polynomial.aeval Z p m) = Polynomial.aeval (H • Z') (p.map φ) (T m)
  exact semilinear_polynomial_aeval φ T Z (H • Z') hT p m

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicModuleScaledBaseChange_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclicModuleScaledBaseChange_apply
    (φ : A →+* A') (F : A) (F' H : A') (hF : φ F = F' * H ^ 3)
    (T : (Fin 3 → A) →ₛₗ[φ] (Fin 3 → A'))
    (Z : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A)) (Z' : Module.End A' (Fin 3 → A'))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = F • 1) (hZ' : Z' ^ 3 = F' • 1)
    (hT : ∀ m, T (Z m) = H • Z' (T m)) (m : Fin 3 → A) :
    cyclicModuleScaledBaseChange φ F F' H hF T Z Z' hZ hZ' hT m = T m
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profilePullbackWeights_intertwine
statement:
theorem profilePullbackWeights_intertwine (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (i : Fin 3) :
    cyclicProfileCoefficients (quarticU u v) (quarticV u v) q s i *
      profilePullbackWeights u v q s (cyclicNext i) =
    (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * cyclicProfileCoefficients u v q s i *
      profilePullbackWeights u v q s i
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | degreeThree =>
    fin_cases i
    · change (quarticU u v + quarticV u v) * weightOne u v q =
        (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (u+v) * weightZero u v q
      convert (intertwiner_zero u v q hq).symm using 1 <;> ring
    · change (quarticU u v + q * quarticV u v) * weightTwo u v q =
        (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (u+q*v) * weightOne u v q
      convert (intertwiner_one u v q hq).symm using 1 <;> ring
    · change (quarticU u v + q^2 * quarticV u v) * weightZero u v q =
        (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * (u+q^2*v) * weightTwo u v q
      convert (intertwiner_two u v q hq).symm using 1 <;> ring
  | degreeTwo =>
    have h := shifted_two_intertwiners u v q hq
    dsimp at h
    fin_cases i
    · convert h.1.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profilePullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
    · convert h.2.1.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profilePullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
    · convert h.2.2.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profilePullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
  | degreeOne =>
    have h := shifted_one_intertwiners u v q hq
    dsimp at h
    fin_cases i
    · convert h.1.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profilePullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
    · convert h.2.1.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profilePullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
    · convert h.2.2.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profilePullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDualPullbackWeights_intertwine
statement:
theorem profileDualPullbackWeights_intertwine (u v q : A) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (i : Fin 3) :
    cyclicProfileCoefficients (quarticU u v) (quarticV u v) q s i *
      profileDualPullbackWeights u v q s i =
    (u ^ 3 - v ^ 3) * cyclicProfileCoefficients u v q s i *
      profileDualPullbackWeights u v q s (cyclicNext i)
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | degreeThree =>
    have h := dual_intertwiners u v q hq
    dsimp at h
    fin_cases i
    · convert h.2.1.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profileDualPullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
    · convert h.2.2.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profileDualPullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
    · convert h.1.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profileDualPullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
  | degreeTwo =>
