    have h := shifted_two_dual_intertwiners u v q hq
    dsimp at h
    fin_cases i
    · convert h.2.1.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profileDualPullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
    · convert h.2.2.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profileDualPullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
    · convert h.1.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profileDualPullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
  | degreeOne =>
    have h := shifted_one_dual_intertwiners u v q hq
    dsimp at h
    fin_cases i
    · convert h.2.1.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profileDualPullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
    · convert h.2.2.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profileDualPullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring
    · convert h.1.symm using 1 <;>
        dsimp [cyclicProfileCoefficients, profileDualPullbackWeights, cyclicNext] <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.coefficientWeightEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coefficientWeightEquiv_apply [Finite ι] (w : ι → K)
    (hw : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0) (p : ι →₀ K) (i : ι) :
    coefficientWeightEquiv w hw p i = w i * p i
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.weightedNegativeCoordinates_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedNegativeCoordinates_apply [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (w : ι → K) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0) (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g r)
    (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    weightedNegativeCoordinates g r w hw q e = w e.val.1 * q.val (complementIndex g r e).val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.weightedResiduePair_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedResiduePair_basis [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (w : ι → K) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0) (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g r)
    (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    weightedResiduePair g r w hw q (positiveBasis g r e) =
      w e.val.1 * q.val (complementIndex g r e).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (positiveBasis g r).toDualEquiv
    ((positiveCoordinates g r).symm (weightedNegativeCoordinates g r w hw q))
    (positiveBasis g r e) = _
  rw [Basis.toDualEquiv_apply, Basis.toDual_apply_left]
  change positiveCoordinates g r
    ((positiveCoordinates g r).symm (weightedNegativeCoordinates g r w hw q)) e = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact weightedNegativeCoordinates_apply g r w hw q e

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.weightedResiduePair_shift
statement:
theorem weightedResiduePair_shift [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (m : ℕ × ℕ)
    (w : ι → K) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g (r+m.1+m.2)) (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    weightedResiduePair g (r+m.1+m.2) w hw q (positiveShift g r m p) =
      weightedResiduePair g r w hw (negativeShift g r m q) p
proof:
:= by
  have h : (weightedResiduePair g (r+m.1+m.2) w hw q).comp (positiveShift g r m) =
      weightedResiduePair g r w hw (negativeShift g r m q) := by
    apply (positiveBasis g r).ext
    intro e
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, positiveShift_basis, weightedResiduePair_basis,
      weightedResiduePair_basis, negativeShift_apply]
    have hn : -1 - e.val.2.1 < 0 ∧ -1 - e.val.2.2 < 0 := by
      obtain ⟨ha,hb,hab⟩ := e.property
      omega
    change w e.val.1 * q.val (e.val.1,(-1-(e.val.2.1+m.1),-1-(e.val.2.2+m.2))) =
      w e.val.1 * (if -1-e.val.2.1 < 0 ∧ -1-e.val.2.2 < 0 then
        q.val (e.val.1,((-1-e.val.2.1)-m.1,(-1-e.val.2.2)-m.2)) else 0)
    rw [ite_eq_left hn]
    exact congrArg (fun z : ℤ × ℤ => w e.val.1 * q.val (e.val.1,z))
      (Prod.ext (by omega) (by omega))
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h p

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.freeLaurentEquiv_shift_mul
statement:
theorem freeLaurentEquiv_shift_mul [Finite ι] (m : ℤ × ℤ)
    (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (i : ι) :
    freeLaurentEquiv (shift m p) i =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single m 1 * freeLaurentEquiv p i
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [freeLaurentEquiv_coeff, shift_apply,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply, one_mul]
  exact congrArg (fun z : ℤ × ℤ => p (i,z)) (Prod.ext (by simp; omega) (by simp; omega))

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.freeLaurentEquiv_negativePart
statement:
theorem freeLaurentEquiv_negativePart [Finite ι] (p : FreeLaurent K ι) (i : ι) :
    freeLaurentEquiv (freeNegativePart p) i = negativePart (freeLaurentEquiv p i)
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryFactorialWeight_ne_zero
statement:
theorem auxiliaryFactorialWeight_ne_zero [CharZero K] (n : ℕ)
    (i : J × Sym (Fin 3) n) : auxiliaryFactorialWeight (K := K) n i ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight_ne_zero K _

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryResiduePair_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem auxiliaryResiduePair_basis [Finite J] [CharZero K]
    (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) (auxiliaryGeneratorWeights g n) r)
    (e : PositiveIndex (auxiliaryGeneratorWeights g n) r) :
    auxiliaryResiduePair g r n q (positiveBasis (auxiliaryGeneratorWeights g n) r e) =
      ChoppedPlane.factorialWeight K (SymmetricDerivative.homogeneousTensorExponent n e.val.1.2) *
        q.val (complementIndex (auxiliaryGeneratorWeights g n) r e).val
proof:
:=
  weightedResiduePair_basis _ _ _ _ _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.positiveRow_points_choppedHilbertFunction
statement:
theorem positiveRow_points_choppedHilbertFunction
    {r a : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (B : HomogeneousRowMatrix L (positiveRowProfile r a))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B))
    (z : PointCoordinates L (N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r))
    (hpieces : ∀ t, pointDegreePiece L z t =
      idealFormPiece (maximalMinorIdeal (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B)) t)
    (hmax : ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank (positiveLinearBlock hr B) t) (e : ℕ) :
    choppedHilbertFunction z (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a)
        (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + e) =
      max (N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r)
        (N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + e) - r * N e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d := positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a
  let h := (positiveRowColumns_rows r a hr).symm
  let hB := positiveRowMatrix_standard_homogeneous B
  have hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r (positiveRowColumns r a) i = d + 2 := by
    rw [sum_standardRowDegrees h]
    dsimp [d, positiveRowGeneratorDegree]
    omega
  have hrow := rowQuadraticChop_hilbertFunction
    (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B) h hB hprimitive hdegree e
    (positiveRowLinearBlock_maximalRank hr B hmax e)
  rw [← choppedIdeal_eq_quadraticMinorIdeal
    (rowMatrixVal (positiveRowProfile r a) B) h hB hdegree z hpieces,
    idealQuotientHilbertFunction_choppedIdeal] at hrow
  rw [← minorHilbertFunction_nat] at hrow
  have hf := positiveRow_minorHilbertFunction_formula hr B hprimitive ((d + e : ℕ) : ℤ)
  have hge : ¬ ((d + e : ℕ) : ℤ) < (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a : ℤ) := by
    dsimp [d]
    omega
  rw [ite_eq_right hge] at hf
  rw [hf] at hrow
  obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := positiveRow_counts (a := a) hr
  have hblock := block_dimension_identity d r e
  dsimp [d] at hblock
  rw [ha, hc] at hblock
  rw [hblock] at hrow
  have hle : r ≤ N d := by
    have hd : r ≤ d + 1 := by dsimp [d, positiveRowGeneratorDegree]; omega
    exact hd.trans (N_ge_degree_add_one d)
  have hformula := hilbert_max_nat_identity hle e
  dsimp [d] at hrow hformula
  exact_mod_cast hrow.trans hformula.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_positive_of_extension_linear_witness
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_positive_of_extension_linear_witness
    [CharZero K] [Infinite L] [IsAlgClosed L]
    (k : K →+* L) (d p : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d) (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p)
    (ha : 0 < aCount d (N d - p))
    (hw : ∃ M : LinearMatrix L (aCount d (N d - p)).toNat
        (positiveRowColumns (N d - p) (aCount d (N d - p)).toNat),
      ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank M t) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r := N d - p
  let a := (aCount d r).toNat
  have hr' : 2 ≤ r := by dsimp [r]; omega
  have ha' : (a : ℤ) = aCount d r :=
    Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by change 0 ≤ aCount d (N d - p); omega)
  have hdegree : positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a = d := by
    dsimp [positiveRowGeneratorDegree, aCount] at ha' ⊢
    omega
  have hcount : N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r = p := by
    rw [hdegree]
    dsimp [r]
    omega
  obtain ⟨B, z, hprimitive, _, hpieces, hmax, hs, _⟩ :=
    positiveRow_exists_point_matrix_witness (K := L) (a := a) hr' hw
  let z' : PointCoordinates L p := castPointCoordinates hcount z
  have hs' : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation L z' d) := by
    rw [← hdegree]
    simpa only [z', surjective_castPointCoordinates] using hs
  apply genericChoppedConclusion_of_extension_witnesses k d p hd hlo hhi hr
  intro e _
  refine ⟨z', hs', ?_⟩
  have hf := positiveRow_points_choppedHilbertFunction (by omega : 0 < r)
    B hprimitive z hpieces hmax e
  have hleft := congrArg₂ (fun b t => choppedHilbertFunction z b t)
    hdegree (congrArg (fun b => b + e) hdegree)
  have hright :
      max (N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a) - r)
        (N (positiveRowGeneratorDegree r a + e) - r * N e) =
      max p (N (d + e) - r * N e) := by
    rw [hcount, hdegree]
  have hf' := hleft.symm.trans (hf.trans hright)
  rw [show choppedHilbertFunction z' d (d + e) = choppedHilbertFunction z d (d + e) from
    choppedHilbertFunction_castPointCoordinates hcount z d (d + e), hf']

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_positive_of_linear_witness
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_positive_of_linear_witness [CharZero K]
    (d p : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d) (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p)
    (ha : 0 < aCount d (N d - p))
    (hw : ∃ M : LinearMatrix (AlgebraicClosure K) (aCount d (N d - p)).toNat
        (positiveRowColumns (N d - p) (aCount d (N d - p)).toNat),
      ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank M t) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d p
proof:
:=
  genericChoppedConclusion_positive_of_extension_linear_witness
    (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)) d p hd hlo hhi hr ha hw

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_positive_of_uniform_linear_witness
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_positive_of_uniform_linear_witness [CharZero K]
    (hlinear : ∀ a c : ℕ, a < c → 2 ≤ c - a →
      ∃ M : LinearMatrix (AlgebraicClosure K) a c,
        ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank M t)
    (d p : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (hlo : N (d - 1) < p) (hhi : p < N d) (hr : 3 ≤ N d - p)
    (ha : 0 < aCount d (N d - p)) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d p
proof:
:= by
  apply genericChoppedConclusion_positive_of_linear_witness d p hd hlo hhi hr ha
  apply hlinear
  · unfold positiveRowColumns
    omega
  · unfold positiveRowColumns
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVector_zero
statement:
theorem weightedVector_zero (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (t : ℤ) :
    WeightedVector (K := K) w t 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  exact (signedForms K 2 _).zero_mem

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVector_add
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  exact (signedForms K 2 _).add_mem (hm i) (hn i)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVector_neg
statement:
theorem weightedVector_neg {w : Fin 3 → ℕ} {t : ℤ} {m : BinaryVector K}
    (hm : WeightedVector w t m) : WeightedVector w t (-m)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  exact (signedForms K 2 _).neg_mem (hm i)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVector_sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using weightedVector_zero w t
  | @insert i s hi hs =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
    exact weightedVector_add (hm i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s))
      (hs (fun j hj => hm j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVector_binary_smul
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  change b * m i ∈ signedForms K 2 (t + d - w i)
  have h := homogeneous_mul_mem_signedForms hb (hm i)
  convert h using 1
  congr 1
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVector_profileZ
proof:
:= by
  let m' : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) t := fun i => ⟨m i, hm i⟩
  intro i
  exact (gradedProfileZ q s t m' i).property

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVector_profileZDual
statement:
theorem weightedVector_profileZDual (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) {t : ℤ}
    {m : BinaryVector K} (hm : WeightedVector (dualGeneratorWeights s) t m) :
    WeightedVector (dualGeneratorWeights s) (t + 1)
      (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s) m)
proof:
:= by
  let m' : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s) t := fun i => ⟨m i, hm i⟩
  intro i
  exact (gradedProfileZDual q s t m' i).property

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedScalar_zero
statement:
theorem weightedScalar_zero (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    WeightedScalar F w d 0
proof:
:= by
  intro t m hm
  rw [Module.zero_smul (R := CyclicCubicRing (BinaryRing K) F) m]
  exact weightedVector_zero w (t + d)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedScalar_add
proof:
:= by
  intro t m hm
  rw [add_smul]
  exact weightedVector_add (hr t m hm) (hs t m hm)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedScalar_neg
statement:
theorem weightedScalar_neg {w : Fin 3 → ℕ} {d : ℤ} {r : CyclicCubicRing (BinaryRing K) F}
    (hr : WeightedScalar F w d r) : WeightedScalar F w d (-r)
proof:
:= by
  intro t m hm
  rw [neg_smul]
  exact weightedVector_neg (hr t m hm)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedScalar_one
statement: theorem weightedScalar_one (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) : WeightedScalar F w 0 1
proof:
:= by
  intro t m hm
  simpa using hm

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedScalar_mul
proof:
:= by
  intro t m hm
  rw [mul_smul]
  have h := hr (t + e) (s • m) (hs t m hm)
  simpa only [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedScalar_sum
proof:
:= by
  intro t m hm
  rw [Finset.sum_smul]
  exact weightedVector_sum s (fun i hi => hr i hi t m hm)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedScalar_pow
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using weightedScalar_one F w
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ]
    convert weightedScalar_mul F ih hr using 1
    push_cast
    ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedScalar_coefficient
proof:
:= by
  intro t m hm
  rw [hcoeff]
  exact weightedVector_binary_smul hb hm

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedScalar_root
statement:
theorem weightedScalar_root (w : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hgraded : ∀ (t : ℤ) (m : BinaryVector K), WeightedVector w t m →
      WeightedVector w (t + 1) (Z m)) :
    WeightedScalar F w 1 (cyclicRoot F)
proof:
:= by
  intro t m hm
  rw [hroot]
  exact hgraded t m hm

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedPolynomial_mul
proof:
:= by
  intro α
  classical
  rw [coeff_mul]
  exact weightedScalar_sum F _
    (fun x _ => weightedScalar_mul F (hp x.1) (hq x.2))

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedPolynomial_one
statement:
theorem weightedPolynomial_one (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) :
    WeightedPolynomial F w 0 1
proof:
:= by
  intro α
  classical
  by_cases h : α = 0
  · subst α
    simpa using weightedScalar_one F w
  · simpa [coeff_one, h, Ne.symm h] using weightedScalar_zero F w 0

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedPolynomial_pow
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using weightedPolynomial_one F w
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ]
    convert weightedPolynomial_mul F ih hp using 1
    push_cast
    ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedPolynomial_linearForm
proof:
:= by
  intro α
  classical
  simp only [linearForm, coeff_sum]
  apply weightedScalar_sum F
  intro i _
  rw [C_mul_X_eq_monomial, coeff_monomial]
  split_ifs
  · exact ha i
  · exact weightedScalar_zero F w d

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedPolynomial_quadraticOne
statement:
theorem weightedPolynomial_quadraticOne (w : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hgraded : ∀ (t : ℤ) (m : BinaryVector K), WeightedVector w t m →
      WeightedVector w (t + 1) (Z m)) :
    WeightedPolynomial F w 2
      (linearForm (quadraticOne (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryU K))
        (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryV K)) (cyclicRoot F)))
proof:
:= by
  apply weightedPolynomial_linearForm F (w := w) (d := 2)
  have hu : WeightedScalar F w 1 (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryU K)) :=
    weightedScalar_coefficient F hcoeff (isHomogeneous_X K 0)
  have hv : WeightedScalar F w 1 (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryV K)) :=
    weightedScalar_coefficient F hcoeff (isHomogeneous_X K 1)
  have hz := weightedScalar_root F Z hroot w hgraded
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact weightedScalar_mul F hv hz
  · exact weightedScalar_mul F hz hu
  · exact weightedScalar_mul F hu hv

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedPolynomial_quadraticTwo
statement:
theorem weightedPolynomial_quadraticTwo (w : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hgraded : ∀ (t : ℤ) (m : BinaryVector K), WeightedVector w t m →
      WeightedVector w (t + 1) (Z m)) :
    WeightedPolynomial F w 2
      (linearForm (quadraticTwo (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryU K))
        (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryV K)) (cyclicRoot F)))
proof:
:= by
  apply weightedPolynomial_linearForm F (w := w) (d := 2)
  have hu : WeightedScalar F w 1 (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryU K)) :=
    weightedScalar_coefficient F hcoeff (isHomogeneous_X K 0)
  have hv : WeightedScalar F w 1 (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryV K)) :=
    weightedScalar_coefficient F hcoeff (isHomogeneous_X K 1)
  have hz := weightedScalar_root F Z hroot w hgraded
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact weightedScalar_pow F hu 2
  · exact weightedScalar_pow F hv 2
  · exact weightedScalar_neg F (weightedScalar_pow F hz 2)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedPolynomial_quadraticSymmetric
statement:
theorem weightedPolynomial_quadraticSymmetric (w : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hgraded : ∀ (t : ℤ) (m : BinaryVector K), WeightedVector w t m →
      WeightedVector w (t + 1) (Z m)) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    WeightedPolynomial F w (2 * n)
      (linearForm (quadraticOne (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryU K))
          (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryV K)) (cyclicRoot F)) ^ (j : ℕ) *
        linearForm (quadraticTwo (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryU K))
          (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryV K)) (cyclicRoot F)) ^ (n - j))
proof:
:= by
  have h := weightedPolynomial_mul F
    (weightedPolynomial_pow F (weightedPolynomial_quadraticOne F Z hcoeff hroot w hgraded) j)
    (weightedPolynomial_pow F (weightedPolynomial_quadraticTwo F Z hcoeff hroot w hgraded) (n - j))
  convert h using 1
  have hj : (j : ℕ) ≤ n := by omega
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVector_basis
statement:
theorem weightedVector_basis (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (k : Fin 3) :
    WeightedVector (K := K) w (w k) (Pi.single k 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  by_cases h : k = i
  · subst i
    simp only [Pi.single_eq_same, sub_self]
    change (1 : BinaryRing K) ∈ Forms K 2 0
    exact isHomogeneous_one (Fin 2) K
  · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm h)]
    exact (signedForms K 2 _).zero_mem

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quadraticSymmetric_coefficient_degree
statement:
theorem quadraticSymmetric_coefficient_degree (w : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hgraded : ∀ (t : ℤ) (m : BinaryVector K), WeightedVector w t m →
      WeightedVector w (t + 1) (Z m)) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i k : Fin 3) :
    tensorCoefficients
      ((linearForm (quadraticOne (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryU K))
          (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryV K)) (cyclicRoot F)) ^ (j : ℕ) *
        linearForm (quadraticTwo (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryU K))
          (cyclicCoefficientHom F (binaryV K)) (cyclicRoot F)) ^ (n - j)) ⊗ₜ[CyclicCubicRing (BinaryRing K) F]
          (Pi.single k (1 : BinaryRing K) : BinaryVector K)) α i ∈
      signedForms K 2 (2 * n + w k - w i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorCoefficients_tmul]
  have h := weightedPolynomial_quadraticSymmetric F Z hcoeff hroot w hgraded n j α
      (w k) (Pi.single k 1) (weightedVector_basis w k) i
  convert h using 1
  congr 1
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclic_quadraticSymmetric_coefficient_degree
statement:
theorem cyclic_quadraticSymmetric_coefficient_degree
    (F : BinaryRing K) (Z : End (BinaryRing K) (BinaryVector K))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = F • 1) (w : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hgraded : ∀ (t : ℤ) (m : BinaryVector K), WeightedVector w t m →
      WeightedVector w (t + 1) (Z m)) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i k : Fin 3) :
    letI
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure F Z hZ
    (((quadraticSymmetricPolynomial F n j).coeff α •
        (Pi.single k (1 : BinaryRing K) : BinaryVector K)) : BinaryVector K) i ∈
      signedForms K 2 (2 * n + w k - w i) := by
  let _ := cyclicModuleStructure F Z hZ
  simpa only [quadraticSymmetricPolynomial, tensorCoefficients_tmul] using
    quadraticSymmetric_coefficient_degree F Z
      (cyclicModule_coefficient_smul F Z hZ) (cyclicModule_root_smul F Z hZ)
      w hgraded n j α i k

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profile_quadraticSymmetric_coefficient_degree
statement:
theorem profile_quadraticSymmetric_coefficient_degree (q : K)
    (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile)
    (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i k : Fin 3) :
    letI
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZ (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZ_cube q hq s)
    (((quadraticSymmetricPolynomial (binaryCubic K) n j).coeff α •
        (Pi.single k (1 : BinaryRing K) : BinaryVector K)) : BinaryVector K) i ∈
      signedForms K 2 (2 * n + generatorWeights s k - generatorWeights s i) := by
  apply cyclic_quadraticSymmetric_coefficient_degree
  intro t m hm
  exact weightedVector_profileZ q s hm

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDual_quadraticSymmetric_coefficient_degree
statement:
theorem profileDual_quadraticSymmetric_coefficient_degree (q : K)
    (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0) (s : CubicProfile)
    (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i k : Fin 3) :
    letI
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZDual_cube q hq s)
    (((quadraticSymmetricPolynomial (binaryCubic K) n j).coeff α •
        (Pi.single k (1 : BinaryRing K) : BinaryVector K)) : BinaryVector K) i ∈
      signedForms K 2 (2 * n + dualGeneratorWeights s k - dualGeneratorWeights s i) := by
  apply cyclic_quadraticSymmetric_coefficient_degree
  intro t m hm
  exact weightedVector_profileZDual q s hm

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneousComponent_mul_degree_one_succ
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mul_degree_one_succ
    {z : MvPolynomial σ K} (hz : z.IsHomogeneous 1)
    (n : ℕ) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    homogeneousComponent (n + 1) (z * g) = z * homogeneousComponent n g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction g using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial d c =>
    have hg : (monomial d c : MvPolynomial σ K).IsHomogeneous d.degree :=
      isHomogeneous_monomial c rfl
    have hzg := hz.mul hg
    simp only [homogeneousComponent_of_mem hzg, homogeneousComponent_of_mem hg]
    have heq : (n + 1 = 1 + d.degree) ↔ (n = d.degree) := by omega
    simp only [heq, mul_ite, mul_zero]
  | add g h hg hh =>
    simp only [mul_add, map_add, hg, hh]

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneousComponent_mul_degree_one_zero
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mul_degree_one_zero
    {z : MvPolynomial σ K} (hz : z.IsHomogeneous 1)
    (g : MvPolynomial σ K) : homogeneousComponent 0 (z * g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction g using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial d c =>
    have hg : (monomial d c : MvPolynomial σ K).IsHomogeneous d.degree :=
      isHomogeneous_monomial c rfl
    rw [homogeneousComponent_of_mem (m := 0) (hz.mul hg)]
    simp [show 0 ≠ 1 + d.degree by omega]
  | add g h hg hh =>
    simp only [mul_add, map_add, hg, hh, add_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_mem_of_sub_coordinate_one_mul
statement:
theorem homogeneous_mem_of_sub_coordinate_one_mul
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule σ K))
    {z : MvPolynomial σ K} (hz : z.IsHomogeneous 1)
    (hsat : ∀ p, z * p ∈ I → p ∈ I)
    {t : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ K} (hf : f.IsHomogeneous t)
    (g : MvPolynomial σ K) (hh : f - (z - 1) * g ∈ I) : f ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : homogeneousComponent 0 g + homogeneousComponent 0 f ∈ I := by
    have h := homogeneousComponent_mem_of_mem hI hh 0
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, map_sub, map_sub,
      homogeneousComponent_mul_degree_one_zero hz] at h
    convert h using 1
    ring
  have hrec (n : ℕ) : homogeneousComponent (n + 1) g -
      z * homogeneousComponent n g + homogeneousComponent (n + 1) f ∈ I := by
    have h := homogeneousComponent_mem_of_mem hI hh (n + 1)
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, map_sub, map_sub,
      homogeneousComponent_mul_degree_one_succ hz] at h
    convert h using 1
    ring
  have hupper : ∀ n, t ≤ n → homogeneousComponent n g ∈ I := by
    apply Nat.strong_decreasing_induction
    · refine ⟨g.totalDegree, fun m hm _ => ?_⟩
      rw [homogeneousComponent_eq_zero m g hm]
      exact I.zero_mem
    · intro n ih hn
      have hnext := ih (n + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      have hfn : homogeneousComponent (n + 1) f = 0 := by
        rw [homogeneousComponent_of_mem hf]
        simp [show n + 1 ≠ t by omega]
      have hr := hrec n
      rw [hfn, add_zero] at hr
      apply hsat
      have h := I.sub_mem hnext hr
      convert h using 1
      ring
  have hlow : ∀ n, n < t → homogeneousComponent n g ∈ I := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro hn
      have hfn : homogeneousComponent 0 f = 0 := by
        rw [homogeneousComponent_of_mem hf]
        simp [show 0 ≠ t by omega]
      simpa only [hfn, add_zero] using hbase
    | succ n ih =>
      intro hn
      have hprev := I.mul_mem_left z (ih (by omega))
      have hfn : homogeneousComponent (n + 1) f = 0 := by
        rw [homogeneousComponent_of_mem hf]
        simp [show n + 1 ≠ t by omega]
      have hr := hrec n
      rw [hfn, add_zero] at hr
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using I.add_mem hr hprev
  cases t with
  | zero =>
    have h := I.sub_mem hbase (hupper 0 le_rfl)
    rw [homogeneousComponent_eq_self hf] at h
    convert h using 1
    ring
  | succ n =>
    have h := I.add_mem (I.sub_mem (hrec n) (hupper (n + 1) le_rfl))
      (I.mul_mem_left z (hlow n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))
    rw [homogeneousComponent_eq_self hf] at h
    convert h using 1
    ring

name: ChoppedPlane.affineDehom_mem_map_iff
statement:
theorem affineDehom_mem_map_iff
    (I : Ideal (Poly K 3))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) K))
    (hsat : ∀ p, (X 2 : Poly K 3) * p ∈ I → p ∈ I)
    {t : ℕ} {f : Poly K 3} (hf : f.IsHomogeneous t) :
    affineDehom f ∈ I.map (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom ↔ f ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ :=
      (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom
        affineDehom_surjective).mp h
    have hdiff : (X 2 - 1 : Poly K 3) ∣ f - h :=
      (affineDehom_eq_iff f h).mp heq.symm
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hdiff
    apply homogeneous_mem_of_sub_coordinate_one_mul I hI (isHomogeneous_X K (2 : Fin 3)) hsat hf g
    have hfg : f - (X 2 - 1) * g = h := by
      rw [← hg]
      ring
    rwa [hfg]
  · intro h
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (affineDehom (K := K)).toRingHom h

name: ChoppedPlane.signedForms_nat
statement: @[simp] theorem signedForms_nat (t : ℕ) : signedForms K n t = Forms K n t
proof:
:= by
  simp [signedForms]

name: ChoppedPlane.signedComponent_nat
statement:
@[simp] theorem signedComponent_nat (t : ℕ) :
    (signedComponent (K := K) (n := n) t) = homogeneousComponent t
proof:
:= by
  simp [signedComponent]

name: ChoppedPlane.signedComponent_mem
statement:
theorem signedComponent_mem (t : ℤ) (f : Poly K n) :
    signedComponent t f ∈ signedForms K n t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t
  · simpa [signedComponent, signedForms, ht] using homogeneousComponent_mem t.toNat f
  · simp [signedComponent, signedForms, ht]

name: ChoppedPlane.signedComponent_self
statement:
theorem signedComponent_self (t : ℤ) (f : signedForms K n t) :
    signedComponent t f.val = f.val
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t
  · have hf : f.val.IsHomogeneous t.toNat := by simpa [signedForms, ht] using f.property
    simpa [signedComponent, ht] using homogeneousComponent_eq_self hf
  · have hf : f.val = 0 := by simpa [signedForms, ht] using f.property
    simp [signedComponent, ht, hf]

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_signedForms_iff_component_self
statement:
theorem mem_signedForms_iff_component_self (t : ℤ) (f : Poly K n) :
    f ∈ signedForms K n t ↔ signedComponent t f = f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact signedComponent_self t ⟨f, h⟩
  · intro h
    exact h ▸ signedComponent_mem t f

name: ChoppedPlane.signedComponent_mul_form
statement:
theorem signedComponent_mul_form (t : ℤ) {δ : ℕ} (f p : Poly K n)
    (hf : f.IsHomogeneous δ) :
    signedComponent (t + δ) (f * p) = f * signedComponent t p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t
  · have hsum : 0 ≤ t + (δ : ℤ) := by omega
    have hnat : (t + (δ : ℤ)).toNat = δ + t.toNat := by omega
    simp only [signedComponent, ht, hsum, ite_true, hnat]
    exact homogeneousComponent_mul_form t.toNat f p hf
  · have htneg : t < 0 := by omega
    by_cases hsum : 0 ≤ t + (δ : ℤ)
    · have hsmall : (t + (δ : ℤ)).toNat < δ := by omega
      simp only [signedComponent, ht, hsum, ite_true, ite_false, LinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero]
      exact homogeneousComponent_mul_eq_zero_of_lt _ hsmall f p hf
    · simp [signedComponent, ht, hsum]

name: ChoppedPlane.signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_total
statement:
theorem signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_total
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i))
    (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (signedMaximalMinor B i).IsHomogeneous ((∑ j, δ j) - δ i)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ∑ j, δ j = δ i + ∑ j : Fin c, δ (i.succAbove j) :=
    Fin.sum_univ_succAbove δ i
  have hminor := maximalMinor_homogeneous B δ hB i
  rw [hsum, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hconst : ((-1 : Poly K n) ^ i.val).IsHomogeneous 0 := by
    simpa using (isHomogeneous_C (σ := Fin n) (-1 : K)).pow i.val
  simpa [signedMaximalMinor] using hconst.mul hminor

name: ChoppedPlane.rowFormsComponent_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowFormsComponent_val (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (e : ℤ)
    (v : Fin m → Poly K n) (i : Fin m) :
    (rowFormsComponent δ e v i).val = signedComponent (e + δ i) (v i)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.rowFormsComponent_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowFormsComponent_self (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (e : ℤ)
    (v : rowForms K n δ e) : rowFormsComponent δ e (rowFormsVal v) = v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact signedComponent_self _ (v i)

name: ChoppedPlane.signedComponent_mulVec
statement:
theorem signedComponent_mulVec
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i))
    (e : ℤ) (w : Fin c → Poly K n) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    signedComponent (e + δ i) (B.mulVec w i) =
      B.mulVec (fun j => signedComponent e (w j)) i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact signedComponent_mul_form e (B i j) (w j) (hB i j)

name: ChoppedPlane.gradedMatrixMap_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedMatrixMap_val
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i))
    (e : ℤ) (w : Fin c → signedForms K n e) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (gradedMatrixMap B δ hB e w i).val = B.mulVec (fun j => (w j).val) i
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.signedComponent_cofactorMap
statement:
theorem signedComponent_cofactorMap
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i))
    (e : ℤ) (v : Fin (c + 1) → Poly K n) :
    signedComponent (e + ∑ i, δ i) (cofactorMap B v) =
      cofactorMap B (rowFormsVal (rowFormsComponent δ e v))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cofactorMap_apply, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hle : δ i ≤ ∑ j, δ j := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le (δ j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have heq : e + (∑ j, δ j : ℕ) = (e + δ i) + ((∑ j, δ j : ℕ) - δ i : ℕ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hle]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact signedComponent_mul_form (e + δ i) (signedMaximalMinor B i) (v i)
    (signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_total B δ hB i)

name: ChoppedPlane.gradedCofactorMap_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedCofactorMap_val
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i))
    (e : ℤ) (v : rowForms K n δ e) :
    (gradedCofactorMap B δ hB e v).val = cofactorMap B (rowFormsVal v)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.graded_ker_cofactor_eq_range
statement:
theorem graded_ker_cofactor_eq_range
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (gradedCofactorMap B δ hB e).ker = (gradedMatrixMap B δ hB e).range
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro v hv
    have hpoly : rowFormsVal v ∈ (cofactorMap B).ker := by
      have h := congrArg Subtype.val hv
      exact h
    rw [ker_cofactorMap_eq_range B hprimitive] at hpoly
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hpoly
    change B.mulVec w = rowFormsVal v at hw
    let u : Fin c → signedForms K n e :=
      fun j => ⟨signedComponent e (w j), signedComponent_mem _ _⟩
    refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
    funext i
    apply Subtype.ext
    change B.mulVec (fun j => signedComponent e (w j)) i = (v i).val
    rw [← signedComponent_mulVec B δ hB, hw]
    exact signedComponent_self _ (v i)
  · rintro v ⟨w, rfl⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact cofactorMap_mulVec B (fun j => (w j).val)

name: ChoppedPlane.gradedMatrixMap_injective
statement:
theorem gradedMatrixMap_injective
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (gradedMatrixMap B δ hB e)
proof:
:= by
  intro w u h
  have hpoly : B.mulVec (fun j => (w j).val) = B.mulVec (fun j => (u j).val) := by
    exact congrArg rowFormsVal h
  have hcoeff := mulVec_injective_of_primitive B hprimitive hpoly
  funext j
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrFun hcoeff j

name: ChoppedPlane.gradedCofactorMap_range_eq_idealPiece
statement:
theorem gradedCofactorMap_range_eq_idealPiece
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i)) (e : ℤ) :
    (gradedCofactorMap B δ hB e).range = gradedMinorIdealPiece B δ e
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro f ⟨v, rfl⟩
    change cofactorMap B (rowFormsVal v) ∈ maximalMinorIdeal B
    change cofactorMap B (rowFormsVal v) ∈
      Submodule.span (Poly K n) (Set.range (signedMaximalMinor B))
    rw [← cofactorMap_range_eq_span]
    exact ⟨rowFormsVal v, rfl⟩
  · intro f hf
    have hfpoly : f.val ∈ (cofactorMap B).range := by
      rw [cofactorMap_range_eq_span]
      exact hf
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hfpoly
    refine ⟨rowFormsComponent δ e v, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change cofactorMap B (rowFormsVal (rowFormsComponent δ e v)) = f.val
    rw [← signedComponent_cofactorMap B δ hB, hv]
    exact signedComponent_self _ f

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_signedPlaneForms
statement:
theorem finrank_signedPlaneForms (t : ℤ) :
    (finrank K (signedForms K 3 t) : ℤ) = N₂ t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t
  · rw [signedForms, ite_eq_left ht]
    simp [N₂, ht, finrank_plane_forms, N]
  · rw [signedForms, ite_eq_right ht]
    simp [N₂, ht]

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_rowPlaneForms
statement:
theorem finrank_rowPlaneForms (δ : Fin m → ℕ) (e : ℤ) :
    (finrank K (rowForms K 3 δ e) : ℤ) = ∑ i, N₂ (e + δ i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_pi_fintype, Nat.cast_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact finrank_signedPlaneForms (e + δ i)

name: ChoppedPlane.gradedMinorIdealPiece_finrank
statement:
theorem gradedMinorIdealPiece_finrank
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (finrank K (gradedMinorIdealPiece B δ e) : ℤ) =
      (∑ i, N₂ (e + δ i)) - (c : ℤ) * N₂ e
proof:
:= by
  have hdim := (gradedCofactorMap B δ hB e).finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [graded_ker_cofactor_eq_range B δ hB hprimitive,
    LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (gradedMatrixMap_injective B δ hB hprimitive e),
    gradedCofactorMap_range_eq_idealPiece B δ hB] at hdim
  have hsrc : (finrank K (Fin c → signedForms K 3 e) : ℤ) = (c : ℤ) * N₂ e := by
    rw [Module.finrank_pi_fintype]
    simp [finrank_signedPlaneForms]
  have hcast := congrArg (fun j : ℕ => (j : ℤ)) hdim
  rw [Nat.cast_add, hsrc, finrank_rowPlaneForms] at hcast
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.gradedMinorQuotient_finrank
statement:
theorem gradedMinorQuotient_finrank
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (finrank K ((signedForms K 3 (e + ∑ i, δ i)) ⧸ gradedMinorIdealPiece B δ e) : ℤ) =
      N₂ (e + ∑ i, δ i) - (∑ i, N₂ (e + δ i)) + (c : ℤ) * N₂ e
proof:
:= by
  have h := (gradedMinorIdealPiece B δ e).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  have hcast := congrArg (fun j : ℕ => (j : ℤ)) h
  rw [Nat.cast_add, finrank_signedPlaneForms,
    gradedMinorIdealPiece_finrank B δ hB hprimitive] at hcast
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.minorFormToRingQuotient_ker
statement:
theorem minorFormToRingQuotient_ker
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (e : ℤ) :
    (minorFormToRingQuotient B (e + ∑ i, δ i)).ker = gradedMinorIdealPiece B δ e
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalMinorIdeal B) f.val = 0 ↔ f.val ∈ maximalMinorIdeal B
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem

name: ChoppedPlane.minorHilbertFunction_formula
statement:
theorem minorHilbertFunction_formula
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (minorHilbertFunction B (e + ∑ i, δ i) : ℤ) =
      N₂ (e + ∑ i, δ i) - (∑ i, N₂ (e + δ i)) + (c : ℤ) * N₂ e
proof:
:= by
  have h := (minorFormToRingQuotient B (e + ∑ i, δ i)).quotKerEquivRange.finrank_eq
  rw [minorFormToRingQuotient_ker] at h
  dsimp only [minorHilbertFunction]
  rw [← h]
  exact gradedMinorQuotient_finrank B δ hB hprimitive e

name: ChoppedPlane.minorHilbertFunction_at_degree
statement:
theorem minorHilbertFunction_at_degree
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3))
    (δ : Fin (c + 1) → ℕ) (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (t : ℤ) :
    (minorHilbertFunction B t : ℤ) = N₂ t -
      (∑ i, N₂ (t - (∑ j, δ j) + δ i)) + (c : ℤ) * N₂ (t - ∑ i, δ i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := minorHilbertFunction_formula B δ hB hprimitive (t - ∑ i, δ i)
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticCubicHom_profileDirection
statement:
theorem quarticCubicHom_profileDirection :
    (fun i => quarticCubicHom (K := K) (profileDirection (K := K) i)) =
      quarticRow (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryU K))
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryV K)) (cyclicRoot (binaryCubic K))
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · simp [profileDirection, quarticCubicHom, quarticRow, quarticU, map_ofNat]
  · simp [profileDirection, quarticCubicHom, quarticRow, quarticV, map_ofNat]
    ring
  · simp [profileDirection, quarticCubicHom, quarticRow, quarticZ, quarticRootMultiplier]
    ring

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVector_profilePullback
statement:
theorem weightedVector_profilePullback (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) {t : ℤ}
    {m : BinaryVector K} (hm : WeightedVector (generatorWeights s) t m) :
    WeightedVector (generatorWeights s) (4 * t + profileMultiplicity s)
      (profilePullback q s m)
proof:
:= by
  let m' : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) t := fun i => ⟨m i, hm i⟩
  intro i
  exact (gradedProfilePullback q s t m' i).property

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedVector_profileDualPullback
statement:
theorem weightedVector_profileDualPullback (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) {t : ℤ}
    {m : BinaryVector K} (hm : WeightedVector (dualGeneratorWeights s) t m) :
    WeightedVector (dualGeneratorWeights s) (4 * t - profileMultiplicity s)
      (profileDualPullback q s m)
proof:
:= by
  let m' : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s) t := fun i => ⟨m i, hm i⟩
  intro i
  exact (gradedProfileDualPullback q s t m' i).property

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profile_directional_kernel_zero
statement:
theorem profile_directional_kernel_zero (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (n : ℕ) (t : ℤ)
    (ht : ∀ k : Fin 3, 4 * t + profileMultiplicity s <
      2 * (n : ℤ) + (generatorWeights s k : ℤ)) :
    letI
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZ (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZ_cube q hq s)
    ∀ (P : AuxTensor (R := CyclicCubicRing (BinaryRing K) (binaryCubic K))
        (M := BinaryVector K)), TensorHomogeneous n P →
      (∀ (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3), tensorCoefficients P α i ∈
        signedForms K 2 (t - generatorWeights s i)) →
      tensorDirectional (profileDirection (K := K)) P = 0 → P = 0 := by
  let _ := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZ (profileFactors q s))
    (profileZ_cube q hq s)
  intro P haux hweighted hδ
  let ψ := profileModulePullback q hq s
  let P' := tensorBaseChange ψ P
  have haux' : TensorHomogeneous n P' := tensorBaseChange_homogeneous ψ haux
  have hweighted' : ∀ (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3), tensorCoefficients P' α i ∈
      signedForms K 2 (4 * t + profileMultiplicity s - generatorWeights s i) := by
    intro α i
    rw [tensorCoefficients_baseChange]
    exact weightedVector_profilePullback q s (hweighted α) i
  have hδ' : tensorDirectional (quarticRow
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryU K))
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryV K))
        (cyclicRoot (binaryCubic K))) P' = 0 := by
    have h := tensorBaseChange_directional ψ (profileDirection (K := K)) P
    rw [hδ, (tensorBaseChange ψ).map_zero, quarticCubicHom_profileDirection] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hzero : P' = 0 := quartic_profile_kernel_zero q hq s false n
    (4 * t + profileMultiplicity s) ht P' haux' hweighted' hδ'
  apply tensorBaseChange_injective ψ (profilePullback_injective q s)
  exact hzero.trans (tensorBaseChange ψ).map_zero.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDual_directional_kernel_zero
statement:
theorem profileDual_directional_kernel_zero (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (n : ℕ) (t : ℤ)
    (ht : ∀ k : Fin 3, 4 * t - profileMultiplicity s <
      2 * (n : ℤ) + (dualGeneratorWeights s k : ℤ)) :
    letI
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZDual_cube q hq s)
    ∀ (P : AuxTensor (R := CyclicCubicRing (BinaryRing K) (binaryCubic K))
        (M := BinaryVector K)), TensorHomogeneous n P →
      (∀ (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3), tensorCoefficients P α i ∈
        signedForms K 2 (t - dualGeneratorWeights s i)) →
      tensorDirectional (profileDirection (K := K)) P = 0 → P = 0 := by
  let _ := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s))
    (profileZDual_cube q hq s)
  intro P haux hweighted hδ
  let ψ := profileDualModulePullback q hq s
  let P' := tensorBaseChange ψ P
  have haux' : TensorHomogeneous n P' := tensorBaseChange_homogeneous ψ haux
  have hweighted' : ∀ (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3), tensorCoefficients P' α i ∈
      signedForms K 2 (4 * t - profileMultiplicity s - dualGeneratorWeights s i) := by
    intro α i
    rw [tensorCoefficients_baseChange]
    exact weightedVector_profileDualPullback q s (hweighted α) i
  have hδ' : tensorDirectional (quarticRow
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryU K))
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryV K))
        (cyclicRoot (binaryCubic K))) P' = 0 := by
    have h := tensorBaseChange_directional ψ (profileDirection (K := K)) P
    rw [hδ, (tensorBaseChange ψ).map_zero, quarticCubicHom_profileDirection] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hzero : P' = 0 := quartic_profile_kernel_zero q hq s true n
    (4 * t - profileMultiplicity s) ht P' haux' hweighted' hδ'
  apply tensorBaseChange_injective ψ (profileDualPullback_injective q s)
  exact hzero.trans (tensorBaseChange ψ).map_zero.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridEvaluation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineGridEvaluation_apply (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (P : K[X][Y]) (ij : Fin m × Fin n) :
    affineGridEvaluation α β P ij = P.evalEval (α ij.1) (β ij.2)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.coordinatePolynomial_dvd_of_eval_zero
statement:
theorem coordinatePolynomial_dvd_of_eval_zero (α : Fin m → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (P : K[X]) (hP : ∀ i, P.eval (α i) = 0) :
    coordinatePolynomial α ∣ P
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst m
    simp [coordinatePolynomial]
  have hf := coordinatePolynomial_monic α
  have hf1 : coordinatePolynomial α ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hd := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree h
    simp only [coordinatePolynomial_natDegree, natDegree_one] at hd
    exact hm hd
  apply (modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd hf).mp
  apply eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero _ hα
  · intro i
    change eval₂ (RingHom.id K) (α i) (P %ₘ coordinatePolynomial α) = 0
    rw [eval₂_modByMonic_eq_self_of_root]
    · simpa only [eval₂_id] using hP i
    · simpa only [eval₂_id] using coordinatePolynomial_eval α i
  · simpa only [coordinatePolynomial_natDegree, Fintype.card_fin] using
      natDegree_modByMonic_lt P hf hf1

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridIdeal_le_evaluation_ker
statement:
theorem affineGridIdeal_le_evaluation_ker (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K) :
    affineGridIdeal α β ≤ RingHom.ker (affineGridEvaluation α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  rintro P (rfl | rfl)
  · change affineGridEvaluation α β (firstEquation α) = 0
    ext ij
    simp [firstEquation, evalEval_C]
  · change affineGridEvaluation α β (secondEquation β) = 0
    ext ij
    simp [secondEquation, evalEval_map_C]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridEvaluation_ker
statement:
theorem affineGridEvaluation_ker (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    RingHom.ker (affineGridEvaluation α β) = affineGridIdeal α β
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ (affineGridIdeal_le_evaluation_ker α β)
  intro P hP
  have hv : ∀ i j, P.evalEval (α i) (β j) = 0 := by
    intro i j
    exact congrFun hP (i, j)
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    have h1 : (1 : K[X][Y]) ∈ affineGridIdeal α β := by
      have := Ideal.subset_span (show secondEquation β ∈
        ({firstEquation α, secondEquation β} : Set K[X][Y]) by simp)
      simpa [affineGridIdeal, secondEquation, coordinatePolynomial] using this
    simpa only [mul_one] using (affineGridIdeal α β).mul_mem_left P h1
  let G := secondEquation β
  let Q := P %ₘ G
  have hG : G.Monic := (coordinatePolynomial_monic β).map C
  have hGdegree : G.natDegree = n := by
    exact (coordinatePolynomial_monic β).natDegree_map C |>.trans
      (coordinatePolynomial_natDegree β)
  have hG1 : G ≠ 1 := by
    intro hh
    have hdegree := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree hh
    simp only [hGdegree, natDegree_one] at hdegree
    exact hn hdegree
  have hQdegree : Q.natDegree < n := by
    simpa only [hGdegree] using natDegree_modByMonic_lt P hG hG1
  have hQeval : ∀ i j, Q.evalEval (α i) (β j) = 0 := by
    intro i j
    change evalEval (α i) (β j) (P %ₘ G) = 0
    rw [← eval₂_evalRingHom]
    rw [eval₂_modByMonic_eq_self_of_root]
    · simpa only [eval₂_evalRingHom] using hv i j
    · rw [eval₂_evalRingHom]
      change (secondEquation β).evalEval (α i) (β j) = 0
      simp [secondEquation, evalEval_map_C]
  have hQmap (i : Fin m) : Q.map (evalRingHom (α i)) = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero _ hβ
    · intro j
      simpa only [map_evalRingHom_eval] using hQeval i j
    · simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using lt_of_le_of_lt natDegree_map_le hQdegree
  have hFQ : firstEquation α ∣ Q := by
    apply (C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff _ Q).mpr
    intro j
    apply coordinatePolynomial_dvd_of_eval_zero α hα
    intro i
    have hh := congrArg (fun q : K[X] => q.coeff j) (hQmap i)
    simpa only [coeff_map, coeff_zero, coe_evalRingHom] using hh
  have hQmem : Q ∈ affineGridIdeal α β := by
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hFQ
    rw [hq]
    exact (affineGridIdeal α β).mul_mem_right q (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
  have hGmem : G * (P /ₘ G) ∈ affineGridIdeal α β :=
    (affineGridIdeal α β).mul_mem_right _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp [G]))
  rw [← modByMonic_add_div P G]
  exact (affineGridIdeal α β).add_mem hQmem hGmem

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridEvaluation_surjective
statement:
theorem affineGridEvaluation_surjective (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Function.Surjective (affineGridEvaluation α β)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro v
  let L : Fin m → K[X] := fun i =>
    Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ α (Pi.single i 1)
  let H : Fin m → K[X] := fun i =>
    Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ β (fun j => v (i, j))
  let P : K[X][Y] := ∑ i, C (L i) * (H i).map C
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  ext ij
  obtain ⟨k, l⟩ := ij
  change P.evalEval (α k) (β l) = v (k, l)
  simp only [P, evalEval_finsetSum, evalEval_mul, evalEval_C, evalEval_map_C]
  have hL (i : Fin m) : (L i).eval (α k) = (Pi.single i (1 : K) : Fin m → K) k := by
    simpa only [L] using Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node
      (Pi.single i (1 : K) : Fin m → K) hα.injOn (Finset.mem_univ k)
  have hH (i : Fin m) : (H i).eval (β l) = v (i, l) := by
    exact Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node (fun j => v (i, j))
      hβ.injOn (Finset.mem_univ l)
  simp_rw [hL, hH]
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single k]
  · simp
  · intro i hi
    simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hi.symm]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridQuotient_reduced
statement:
theorem affineGridQuotient_reduced (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    IsReduced (K[X][Y] ⧸ affineGridIdeal α β)
proof:
:=
  isReduced_of_injective (affineGridQuotientEquiv α β hα hβ)
    (affineGridQuotientEquiv α β hα hβ).injective

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_ideal_of_vanish_on_selected
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_of_vanish_on_selected (e : R →+* (ι → K))
    (he : Function.Surjective e) (I : Ideal R) (hker : RingHom.ker e ≤ I)
    (S : Set ι) (hsep : ∀ x, x ∉ S → ∃ g ∈ I, e g x ≠ 0)
    (f : R) (hf : ∀ x ∈ S, e f x = 0) : f ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ x, ∃ g : R, g ∈ I ∧ (x ∉ S → e g x ≠ 0) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ S
    · exact ⟨0, I.zero_mem, fun h => (h hx).elim⟩
    · obtain ⟨g, hg, hge⟩ := hsep x hx
      exact ⟨g, hg, fun _ => hge⟩
  choose g hg hge using hex
  choose q hq using fun x => he (Pi.single x (e f x / e (g x) x))
  let P : R := ∑ x, q x * g x
  have hP : P ∈ I := by
    apply I.sum_mem
    intro x _
    exact I.mul_mem_left (q x) (hg x)
  have hPe : e P = e f := by
    ext x
    simp only [P, map_sum, Finset.sum_apply, map_mul, Pi.mul_apply]
    rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single x]
    · rw [hq]
      simp only [Pi.single_eq_same]
      by_cases hx : x ∈ S
      · simp [hf x hx]
      · exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hge x hx)
    · intro y hy
      rw [hq]
      simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hy.symm]
  have hdiff : f - P ∈ I := by
    apply hker
    change e (f - P) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hPe, sub_self]
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using I.add_mem hdiff hP

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_ideal_iff_vanish_on_selected
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_iff_vanish_on_selected (e : R →+* (ι → K))
    (he : Function.Surjective e) (I : Ideal R) (hker : RingHom.ker e ≤ I)
    (S : Set ι) (hvan : ∀ g ∈ I, ∀ x ∈ S, e g x = 0)
    (hsep : ∀ x, x ∉ S → ∃ g ∈ I, e g x ≠ 0) (f : R) :
    f ∈ I ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, e f x = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hf => hvan f hf, mem_ideal_of_vanish_on_selected e he I hker S hsep f⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.isRadical_of_surjective_pi_kernel_le
statement:
theorem isRadical_of_surjective_pi_kernel_le (e : R →+* (ι → K))
    (he : Function.Surjective e) (I : Ideal R) (hker : RingHom.ker e ≤ I) :
    I.IsRadical
proof:
:= by
  apply (I.isRadical_iff_pow_one_lt 2 (by norm_num)).mpr
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := he (fun x => (e f x)⁻¹)
  have hdiff : f - f ^ 2 * q ∈ I := by
    apply hker
    change e (f - f ^ 2 * q) = 0
    ext x
    simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply, hq,
      Pi.zero_apply]
    by_cases hx : e f x = 0
    · simp [hx]
    · rw [pow_two, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx, mul_one, sub_self]
  have hprod : f ^ 2 * q ∈ I := I.mul_mem_right q hf
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using I.add_mem hdiff hprod

name: ChoppedPlane.quotient_reduced_of_surjective_pi_kernel_le
statement:
theorem quotient_reduced_of_surjective_pi_kernel_le (e : R →+* (ι → K))
    (he : Function.Surjective e) (I : Ideal R) (hker : RingHom.ker e ≤ I) :
    IsReduced (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:=
  (I.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced).mp
    (isRadical_of_surjective_pi_kernel_le e he I hker)

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.quotient_reduced_of_affineGridIdeal_le
statement:
theorem quotient_reduced_of_affineGridIdeal_le (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (I : Ideal K[X][Y]) (hI : affineGridIdeal α β ≤ I) : IsReduced (K[X][Y] ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  apply quotient_reduced_of_surjective_pi_kernel_le (affineGridEvaluation α β)
    (affineGridEvaluation_surjective α β hα hβ) I
  rwa [affineGridEvaluation_ker α β hα hβ]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.equivMvPolynomial_firstEquation
statement:
@[simp] theorem equivMvPolynomial_firstEquation (α : Fin m → K) :
    Bivariate.equivMvPolynomial K (firstEquation α) = affineFirstProduct α
proof:
:= by
  simp [firstEquation, coordinatePolynomial, affineFirstProduct, map_prod]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.equivMvPolynomial_secondEquation
statement:
@[simp] theorem equivMvPolynomial_secondEquation (β : Fin n → K) :
    Bivariate.equivMvPolynomial K (secondEquation β) = affineSecondProduct β
proof:
:= by
  simp [secondEquation, coordinatePolynomial, affineSecondProduct, Polynomial.map_prod, map_prod]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.equivMvPolynomial_map_affineGridIdeal
statement:
theorem equivMvPolynomial_map_affineGridIdeal (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K) :
    (affineGridIdeal α β).map (Bivariate.equivMvPolynomial K).toRingHom =
      mvAffineGridIdeal α β
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineGridIdeal, Ideal.map_span]
  simp [mvAffineGridIdeal]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem mvAffineGridEvaluation_apply (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) (ij : Fin m × Fin n) :
    mvAffineGridEvaluation α β P ij =
      MvPolynomial.eval ![α ij.1, β ij.2] P
proof:
:= by
  let e := Bivariate.equivMvPolynomial K
  have h : (evalEvalRingHom (α ij.1) (β ij.2)).comp e.symm.toRingHom =
      MvPolynomial.eval ![α ij.1, β ij.2] := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      simp [e]
    · intro i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e]
  exact congrArg (fun φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →+* K => φ P) h

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_surjective
statement:
theorem mvAffineGridEvaluation_surjective (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Function.Surjective (mvAffineGridEvaluation α β)
proof:
:=
  (affineGridEvaluation_surjective α β hα hβ).comp
    (Bivariate.equivMvPolynomial K).symm.surjective

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.mvAffineGridEvaluation_ker
statement:
theorem mvAffineGridEvaluation_ker (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    RingHom.ker (mvAffineGridEvaluation α β) = mvAffineGridIdeal α β
proof:
:= by
  rw [mvAffineGridEvaluation, ← RingHom.comap_ker, affineGridEvaluation_ker α β hα hβ]
  calc
    _ = (affineGridIdeal α β).map (Bivariate.equivMvPolynomial K).toRingHom :=
      (Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv (Bivariate.equivMvPolynomial K).toRingEquiv).symm
    _ = mvAffineGridIdeal α β := equivMvPolynomial_map_affineGridIdeal α β

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.quotient_reduced_of_mvAffineGridIdeal_le
statement:
theorem quotient_reduced_of_mvAffineGridIdeal_le (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)) (hI : mvAffineGridIdeal α β ≤ I) :
    IsReduced (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  apply quotient_reduced_of_surjective_pi_kernel_le (mvAffineGridEvaluation α β)
    (mvAffineGridEvaluation_surjective α β hα hβ) I
  rwa [mvAffineGridEvaluation_ker α β hα hβ]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridQuotient_finite
statement:
theorem affineGridQuotient_finite (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Module.Finite K (K[X][Y] ⧸ affineGridIdeal α β)
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.of_surjective (affineGridQuotientAlgEquiv α β hα hβ).symm.toLinearMap
    (affineGridQuotientAlgEquiv α β hα hβ).symm.surjective

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.affineGridQuotient_finrank
statement:
theorem affineGridQuotient_finrank (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Module.finrank K (K[X][Y] ⧸ affineGridIdeal α β) = m * n
proof:
:= by
  rw [(affineGridQuotientAlgEquiv α β hα hβ).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq]
  simp [Fintype.card_prod]

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.mvAffineGridQuotient_finite
statement:
theorem mvAffineGridQuotient_finite (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Module.Finite K (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ⧸ mvAffineGridIdeal α β)
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.of_surjective (mvAffineGridQuotientAlgEquiv α β hα hβ).symm.toLinearMap
    (mvAffineGridQuotientAlgEquiv α β hα hβ).symm.surjective

name: ChoppedPlane.Grid.mvAffineGridQuotient_finrank
statement:
theorem mvAffineGridQuotient_finrank (α : Fin m → K) (β : Fin n → K)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β) :
    Module.finrank K (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ⧸ mvAffineGridIdeal α β) = m * n
proof:
:= by
  rw [(mvAffineGridQuotientAlgEquiv α β hα hβ).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq]
  simp [Fintype.card_prod]

name: ChoppedPlane.basis_transport_val
statement:
private theorem basis_transport_val {M ι : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    {P Q : Submodule K M} (h : P = Q) (b : Basis ι K Q) (i : ι) :
    (Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun W : Submodule K M => Basis ι K W) h) b i).val = (b i).val
proof:
:= by
  subst P
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.formsBasis_val_monomial
statement:
theorem formsBasis_val_monomial (i : Sym (Fin n) d) :
    (formsBasis K n d i).val = monomial (exponentEquiv n d i).val 1
proof:
:= by
  let b := (MvPolynomial.basisRestrictSupport K {e : Fin n →₀ ℕ | e.degree = d}).reindex
    (exponentEquiv n d).symm
  have h : Forms K n d = MvPolynomial.restrictSupport K {e : Fin n →₀ ℕ | e.degree = d} :=
    homogeneousSubmodule_eq_finsupp_supported (Fin n) K d
  have hval : (formsBasis K n d i).val = (b i).val :=
    basis_transport_val K h b i
  rw [hval]
  simp only [b, Basis.reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_symm]
  change ((AddMonoidAlgebra.supportedEquivFinsupp {e : Fin n →₀ ℕ | e.degree = d}).symm
    (Finsupp.single (exponentEquiv n d i) 1)).val = _
  simp [AddMonoidAlgebra.supportedEquivFinsupp]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.formsBasis_map
statement:
theorem formsBasis_map {L : Type*} [Field L] (k : K →+* L) (i : Sym (Fin n) d) :
    MvPolynomial.map k (formsBasis K n d i).val = (formsBasis L n d i).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [formsBasis_val_monomial, formsBasis_val_monomial]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_forms
statement: theorem finrank_forms : finrank K (Forms K n d) = (n + d - 1).choose d
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (formsBasis K n d), Sym.card_sym_eq_choose]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_plane_forms
statement: theorem finrank_plane_forms : finrank K (Forms K 3 d) = (d + 2).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_forms]
  have h : 3 + d - 1 = d + 2 := by omega
  rw [h, ← Nat.choose_symm (by omega : d ≤ d + 2)]
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.mulForm_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem mulForm_val (f : Forms K n d) (a : Forms K n e) :
    (mulForm f a).val = f.val * a.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.mulForm_injective
statement:
theorem mulForm_injective (f : Forms K n d) (hf : f.val ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (mulForm (e := e) f)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hf (congrArg Subtype.val hab)

name: ChoppedPlane.forms_mul_forms
statement: theorem forms_mul_forms : Forms K n d * Forms K n e = Forms K n (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Forms K n d * Forms K n e = Forms K n 1 ^ d * Forms K n 1 ^ e := by
      simp only [Forms, MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_one_pow]
    _ = Forms K n 1 ^ (d + e) := (pow_add _ d e).symm
    _ = Forms K n (d + e) := MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_one_pow K (d + e)

name: ChoppedPlane.evaluationLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluationLinear_apply (x : Fin n → K) (f : Forms K n d) :
    evaluationLinear K n d x f = MvPolynomial.eval x f.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_eval₂_scale
statement:
theorem homogeneous_eval₂_scale {σ R T : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring T]
    {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ} (hf : f.IsHomogeneous d)
    (k : R →+* T) (x : σ → T) (a : T) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂ k (fun i => a * x i) f =
      a ^ d * MvPolynomial.eval₂ k x f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro u hu
  simp only [mul_pow, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  rw [← hf.degree_eq_sum_deg_support hu]
  ac_rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_eval_scale
statement:
theorem homogeneous_eval_scale {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ} (hf : f.IsHomogeneous d)
    (x : σ → R) (a : R) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => a * x i) f = a ^ d * MvPolynomial.eval x f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [MvPolynomial.eval_eq, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro u hu
  simp only [mul_pow, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  rw [← hf.degree_eq_sum_deg_support hu]
  ac_rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_eval_scale_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneous_eval_scale_eq_zero_iff {σ R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [IsDomain R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ}
    (hf : f.IsHomogeneous d) (x : σ → R) {a : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => a * x i) f = 0 ↔ MvPolynomial.eval x f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneous_eval_scale hf x a]
  simp only [mul_eq_zero, pow_ne_zero d ha, false_or]

name: ChoppedPlane.ferrersDeletedRow_before
statement:
theorem ferrersDeletedRow_before (f g : Fin (c + 1) → R) (k : Fin (c + 1))
    (i j : Fin c) (hi : i.val < k.val) :
    ferrersDeletedRow f g k i j =
      if i.val = j.val then f i.castSucc else if i.val = j.val + 1 then g i.castSucc else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ferrersDeletedRow, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Fin.succAbove_of_castSucc_lt]
  · rfl
  · exact hi

name: ChoppedPlane.ferrersDeletedRow_after
statement:
theorem ferrersDeletedRow_after (f g : Fin (c + 1) → R) (k : Fin (c + 1))
    (i j : Fin c) (hi : ¬i.val < k.val) :
    ferrersDeletedRow f g k i j =
      if i.val + 1 = j.val then f i.succ else if i.val = j.val then g i.succ else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ferrersDeletedRow, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc]
  · simp [ferrersBidiagonal]
  · exact Nat.le_of_not_gt hi

name: ChoppedPlane.ferrersDeletedRow_det_subtype
statement:
theorem ferrersDeletedRow_det_subtype (f g : Fin (c + 1) → R) (k : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (ferrersDeletedRow f g k).det =
      (∏ i : {i : Fin c // i.val < k.val}, f i.val.castSucc) *
      (∏ i : {i : Fin c // ¬i.val < k.val}, g i.val.succ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A := ferrersDeletedRow f g k
  let p : Fin c → Prop := fun i => i.val < k.val
  have hsplit : ∀ i, ¬p i → ∀ j, p j → A i j = 0 := by
    intro i hi j hj
    change ferrersDeletedRow f g k i j = 0
    rw [ferrersDeletedRow_after f g k i j hi]
    simp only [p] at hj
    have hij : i.val ≠ j.val := by omega
    have hij' : i.val + 1 ≠ j.val := by omega
    simp [hij, hij']
  rw [Matrix.twoBlockTriangular_det A p hsplit]
  have hleft : (A.toSquareBlockProp p).IsLowerTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    change ferrersDeletedRow f g k i.val j.val = 0
    rw [ferrersDeletedRow_before f g k i.val j.val i.property]
    have hijv : i.val.val < j.val.val := hij
    have hne : i.val.val ≠ j.val.val := by omega
    have hne' : i.val.val ≠ j.val.val + 1 := by omega
    simp [hne, hne']
  have hright : (A.toSquareBlockProp (fun i => ¬p i)).IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    change ferrersDeletedRow f g k i.val j.val = 0
    rw [ferrersDeletedRow_after f g k i.val j.val i.property]
    have hijv : j.val.val < i.val.val := hij
    have hne : i.val.val ≠ j.val.val := by omega
    have hne' : i.val.val + 1 ≠ j.val.val := by omega
    simp [hne, hne']
  rw [Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular _ hleft, Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular hright]
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    change ferrersDeletedRow f g k i.val i.val = f i.val.castSucc
    rw [ferrersDeletedRow_before f g k i.val i.val i.property]
    simp
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    change ferrersDeletedRow f g k i.val i.val = g i.val.succ
    rw [ferrersDeletedRow_after f g k i.val i.val i.property]
    simp

name: ChoppedPlane.ferrersDeletedRow_det
statement:
theorem ferrersDeletedRow_det (f g : Fin (c + 1) → R) (k : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (ferrersDeletedRow f g k).det =
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => i.val < k.val), f i) *
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => k.val < i.val), g i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [ferrersDeletedRow_det_subtype]
  congr 1
  · rw [Fintype.prod_equiv (ferrersBeforeRowEquiv k)
      (fun i => f i.val.castSucc) (fun i => f i.val) (fun _ => rfl)]
    exact (Finset.prod_subtype _ (by simp) f).symm
  · rw [Fintype.prod_equiv (ferrersAfterRowEquiv k)
      (fun i => g i.val.succ) (fun i => g i.val) (fun _ => rfl)]
    exact (Finset.prod_subtype _ (by simp) g).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.ferrersSignedCofactor_eq
statement:
theorem ferrersSignedCofactor_eq (f g : Fin (c + 1) → R) (k : Fin (c + 1)) :
    ferrersSignedCofactor f g k = (-1) ^ k.val *
      ((∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => i.val < k.val), f i) *
       (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (c + 1) => k.val < i.val), g i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ferrersSignedCofactor, ferrersDeletedRow_det]

name: ChoppedPlane.matrix_det_map
statement:
theorem matrix_det_map {R S j : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Fintype j] [DecidableEq j] (k : R →+* S) (A : Matrix j j R) :
    (A.map k).det = k A.det
proof: := (k.map_det A).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_rank_minor
statement:
theorem exists_rank_minor (A : Matrix m n K) :
    ∃ (rows : Fin A.rank → m) (cols : Fin A.rank → n),
      (A.submatrix rows cols).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex := Submodule.exists_fun_fin_finrank_span_eq K (Set.range A.col)
  rw [← A.rank_eq_finrank_span_cols] at hex
  obtain ⟨v, hv, _hspan, hli⟩ := hex
  choose cols hcols using hv
  let B : Matrix m (Fin A.rank) K := A.submatrix id cols
  have hBli : LinearIndependent K B.col := by
    have heq : B.col = v := by funext i j; exact congrFun (hcols i) j
    rw [heq]
    exact hli
  have hBrank : B.rank = A.rank := by
    rw [B.rank_eq_finrank_span_cols, finrank_span_eq_card hBli, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hexrow := Submodule.exists_fun_fin_finrank_span_eq K (Set.range B.row)
  rw [← B.rank_eq_finrank_span_row, hBrank] at hexrow
  obtain ⟨w, hw, _hwspan, hwli⟩ := hexrow
  choose rows hrows using hw
  refine ⟨rows, cols, ?_⟩
  have hrow : (A.submatrix rows cols).row = w := by
    funext i j
    exact congrFun (hrows i) j
  have hunit : IsUnit (A.submatrix rows cols) :=
    Matrix.linearIndependent_rows_iff_isUnit.mp (hrow.symm ▸ hwli)
  exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hunit |>.ne_zero

name: ChoppedPlane.matrix_rank_map_field
statement:
theorem matrix_rank_map_field (k : K →+* L) (A : Matrix m n K) :
    (A.map k).rank = A.rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨rows, cols, hminor⟩ := exists_rank_minor (A.map k)
    have hminorK : (A.submatrix rows cols).det ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      apply hminor
      rw [show (A.map k).submatrix rows cols = (A.submatrix rows cols).map k by rfl,
        matrix_det_map, hz, map_zero]
    have hh := Matrix.rank_submatrix_le A rows cols
    rwa [Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hminorK, Fintype.card_fin] at hh
  · obtain ⟨rows, cols, hminor⟩ := exists_rank_minor A
    have hminorL : ((A.map k).submatrix rows cols).det ≠ 0 := by
      rw [show (A.map k).submatrix rows cols = (A.submatrix rows cols).map k by rfl,
        matrix_det_map]
      exact fun hz => hminor (k.injective (by simpa using hz))
    have hh := Matrix.rank_submatrix_le (A.map k) rows cols
    rwa [Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hminorL, Fintype.card_fin] at hh

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomialMatrixEval_submatrix
statement:
theorem polynomialMatrixEval_submatrix {r : ℕ} (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → L)
    (A : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) (rows : Fin r → m) (cols : Fin r → n) :
    (polynomialMatrixEval k a A).submatrix rows cols =
      (A.submatrix rows cols).map (eval₂Hom k a)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomialMatrixEval_map_parameter
statement:
theorem polynomialMatrixEval_map_parameter (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → K)
    (A : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    polynomialMatrixEval k (k ∘ a) A =
      (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a A).map k
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  exact (eval₂_comp k a (A i j)).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomialMatrixEval_rank_map_parameter
statement:
theorem polynomialMatrixEval_rank_map_parameter (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → K)
    (A : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    (polynomialMatrixEval k (k ∘ a) A).rank =
      (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a A).rank
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomialMatrixEval_map_parameter, matrix_rank_map_field]

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_matrix_rank_descent
statement:
theorem polynomial_matrix_rank_descent [Infinite K] (k : K →+* L)
    (A : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) (a₀ : ι → L) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, (∃ a : ι → K, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a : ι → K, eval a D ≠ 0 →
        (polynomialMatrixEval k a₀ A).rank ≤
          (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a A).rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨rows, cols, hminor⟩ := exists_rank_minor (polynomialMatrixEval k a₀ A)
  let D := (A.submatrix rows cols).det
  have hD : D ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hminor
    rw [polynomialMatrixEval_submatrix, matrix_det_map]
    change eval₂Hom k a₀ D = 0
    rw [hz, map_zero]
  have hex : ∃ a : ι → K, eval a D ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! hz
    exact hD (MvPolynomial.funext hz)
  refine ⟨D, hex, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  have hminorK : ((polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a A).submatrix rows cols).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [polynomialMatrixEval_submatrix, matrix_det_map]
    exact ha
  have hh := Matrix.rank_submatrix_le (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a A) rows cols
  rwa [Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hminorK, Fintype.card_fin] at hh

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_matrix_ranks_descent
statement:
theorem polynomial_matrix_ranks_descent [Infinite K]
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] {rows cols : J → Type*}
    [∀ j, Fintype (rows j)] [∀ j, Fintype (cols j)]
    (k : K →+* L) (A : ∀ j, Matrix (rows j) (cols j) (MvPolynomial ι K))
    (a₀ : J → ι → L) (Q : MvPolynomial ι K) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, (∃ a : ι → K, eval a D ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a : ι → K, eval a D ≠ 0 → eval a Q ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ j, (polynomialMatrixEval k (a₀ j) (A j)).rank ≤
          (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a (A j)).rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose D hD hprop using fun j => polynomial_matrix_rank_descent k (A j) (a₀ j)
  have hne (j : J) : D j ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hD j
    simp only [hz, map_zero, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false] at ha
  have hprod : Q * ∏ j, D j ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero hQ (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j _ => hne j))
  have hex : ∃ a : ι → K, eval a (Q * ∏ j, D j) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! hz
    exact hprod (MvPolynomial.funext hz)
  refine ⟨Q * ∏ j, D j, hex, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  have hparts : eval a Q ≠ 0 ∧ ∏ j, eval a (D j) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_mul, map_prod, mul_ne_zero_iff] using ha
  refine ⟨hparts.1, fun j => hprop j a ?_⟩
  exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mp hparts.2 j (Finset.mem_univ j)

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_matrix_kernel_chart
statement:
theorem exists_matrix_kernel_chart [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (E : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) (a₀ : ι → K)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a₀ E).mulVecLin) :
    ∃ S : Matrix n m (MvPolynomial ι K), eval a₀ (E * S).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  let E₀ := polynomialMatrixEval (RingHom.id K) a₀ E
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := E₀.mulVecLin.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj)
  let S₀ : Matrix n m K := LinearMap.toMatrix' s
  have hprod₀ : E₀ * S₀ = 1 := by
    apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
    rw [Matrix.toLin'_mul, Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix', Matrix.toLin'_one]
    exact hs
  let S : Matrix n m (MvPolynomial ι K) := S₀.map C
  have hS : S.map (eval a₀) = S₀ := by
    ext i j
    simp [S]
  have hprod : (E * S).map (eval a₀) = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.map_mul, hS]
    exact hprod₀
  refine ⟨S, ?_⟩
  rw [(eval a₀).map_det]
  change ((E * S).map (eval a₀)).det = 1
  rw [hprod, Matrix.det_one]

name: ChoppedPlane.matrixKernelChart_range_ker
statement:
theorem matrixKernelChart_range_ker [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (E : Matrix m n K) (S : Matrix n m K) (hdet : (E * S).det ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.range (matrixKernelChart E S).mulVecLin = LinearMap.ker E.mulVecLin ∧
      Function.Surjective E.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  let T := E * S
  let c := T.det
  have hright (u : m → K) : E.mulVecLin (S.mulVecLin (T.adjugate.mulVecLin u)) = c • u := by
    change E *ᵥ (S *ᵥ (T.adjugate *ᵥ u)) = c • u
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    change (T * T.adjugate) *ᵥ u = _
    rw [Matrix.mul_adjugate, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hC (v : n → K) : (matrixKernelChart E S).mulVecLin v =
      c • v - S.mulVecLin (T.adjugate.mulVecLin (E.mulVecLin v)) := by
    simp only [matrixKernelChart, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.sub_mulVec,
      Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, T, c]
  have hker : LinearMap.range (matrixKernelChart E S).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.ker E.mulVecLin := by
    rintro _ ⟨v,rfl⟩
    change E.mulVecLin ((matrixKernelChart E S).mulVecLin v) = 0
    rw [hC, map_sub, map_smul, hright, sub_self]
  have hfix (v : n → K) (hv : v ∈ LinearMap.ker E.mulVecLin) :
      (matrixKernelChart E S).mulVecLin v = c • v := by
    rw [hC, show E.mulVecLin v = 0 from hv]
    simp
  refine ⟨le_antisymm hker ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    refine ⟨c⁻¹ • v, ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul, hfix v hv, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hdet, one_smul]
  · intro u
    refine ⟨c⁻¹ • S.mulVecLin (T.adjugate.mulVecLin u), ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul, hright, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hdet, one_smul]

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomialMatrixEval_kernelChart
statement:
theorem polynomialMatrixEval_kernelChart [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → L)
    (E : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) (S : Matrix n m (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    polynomialMatrixEval k a (matrixKernelChart E S) =
      matrixKernelChart (polynomialMatrixEval k a E) (polynomialMatrixEval k a S)
proof:
:= by
  let f := eval₂Hom k a
  change (matrixKernelChart E S).map f = matrixKernelChart (E.map f) (S.map f)
  have hmul : (E * S).map f = E.map f * S.map f := by
    exact Matrix.map_mul
  have hadj : (E * S).adjugate.map f = ((E * S).map f).adjugate := f.map_adjugate _
  have hchart : (matrixKernelChart E S).map f =
      f ((E * S).det) • (1 : Matrix n n L) - S.map f * (E * S).adjugate.map f * E.map f := by
    ext i j
    simp only [matrixKernelChart, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, map_sub,
      Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, Matrix.one_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp only [map_one, map_zero, Matrix.mul_apply, map_sum,
      map_mul, Matrix.map_apply]
  rw [hchart, hadj, ← matrix_det_map f (E * S), hmul]
  rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomial_kernel_chart_baseChange
statement:
theorem polynomial_kernel_chart_baseChange [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (k : K →+* L) (a : ι → L)
    (E : Matrix m n (MvPolynomial ι K)) (S : Matrix n m (MvPolynomial ι K))
    (hdet : eval₂ k a (E * S).det ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.range (polynomialMatrixEval k a (matrixKernelChart E S)).mulVecLin =
      LinearMap.ker (polynomialMatrixEval k a E).mulVecLin ∧
      Function.Surjective (polynomialMatrixEval k a E).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomialMatrixEval_kernelChart]
  apply matrixKernelChart_range_ker
  have hm : (polynomialMatrixEval k a E * polynomialMatrixEval k a S) =
      (E * S).map (eval₂Hom k a) := by
    exact Matrix.map_mul.symm
  rw [hm, matrix_det_map]
  exact hdet

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryLaurentEmbedding_eq_mapDomain
statement:
theorem binaryLaurentEmbedding_eq_mapDomain :
    binaryLaurentEmbedding (K := K) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom K K binaryLaurentExponent
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · change binaryLaurentEmbedding (X (0 : Fin 2) : BinaryRing K) = _
    rw [binaryLaurentEmbedding_X_zero (K := K)]
    change U = AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain binaryLaurentExponent
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (Finsupp.single 0 1) 1)
    simp [binaryLaurentExponent, U]
  · change binaryLaurentEmbedding (X (1 : Fin 2) : BinaryRing K) = _
    rw [binaryLaurentEmbedding_X_one (K := K)]
    change V = AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain binaryLaurentExponent
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (Finsupp.single 1 1) 1)
    simp [binaryLaurentExponent, V]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryLaurentEmbedding_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryLaurentEmbedding_monomial (s : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (c : K) :
    binaryLaurentEmbedding (monomial s c) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single ((s 0 : ℤ), (s 1 : ℤ)) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [binaryLaurentEmbedding_eq_mapDomain]
  change AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain binaryLaurentExponent (AddMonoidAlgebra.single s c) = _
  simp [binaryLaurentExponent]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.freeLaurentEquiv_vectorLaurentEmbedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeLaurentEquiv_vectorLaurentEmbedding (m : BinaryVector K)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    freeLaurentEquiv (vectorLaurentEmbedding m) i = binaryLaurentEmbedding (m i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vectorLaurentEmbedding]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryVectorCoefficients_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryVectorCoefficients_single (i : Fin 3) (s : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (c : K) :
    binaryVectorCoefficients (Pi.single i (monomial s c)) = Finsupp.single (i, s) c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ⟨j,t⟩
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst j
    simp [binaryVectorCoefficients_apply, coeff_monomial, Finsupp.single_apply]
  · simp [binaryVectorCoefficients_apply, hj]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryVectorCoefficients_symm_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryVectorCoefficients_symm_single
    (i : Fin 3) (s : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (c : K) :
    binaryVectorCoefficients.symm (Finsupp.single (i, s) c) = Pi.single i (monomial s c)
proof:
:= by
  apply binaryVectorCoefficients.injective
  simp

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryVectorLaurent_eq_vectorLaurentEmbedding
statement:
theorem binaryVectorLaurent_eq_vectorLaurentEmbedding :
    binaryVectorLaurent (K := K) = vectorLaurentEmbedding
proof:
:= by
  have h : (binaryVectorLaurent (K := K)).comp binaryVectorCoefficients.symm.toLinearMap =
      vectorLaurentEmbedding.comp binaryVectorCoefficients.symm.toLinearMap := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    rintro ⟨i,s⟩ c
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap,
      binaryVectorCoefficients_symm_single]
    apply freeLaurentEquiv.injective
    funext j
    ext e
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
