      simp [binaryVectorLaurent, binaryVectorExponent,
        freeLaurentEquiv_coeff, Finsupp.single_apply]
    · simp [binaryVectorLaurent, binaryVectorExponent,
        freeLaurentEquiv_coeff, hj]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  have hm := LinearMap.congr_fun h (binaryVectorCoefficients m)
  simpa using hm

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.freeLaurentEquiv_binaryVectorLaurent
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeLaurentEquiv_binaryVectorLaurent (m : BinaryVector K) (i : Fin 3) :
    freeLaurentEquiv (binaryVectorLaurent m) i = binaryLaurentEmbedding (m i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [binaryVectorLaurent_eq_vectorLaurentEmbedding]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv_adjoint
statement:
theorem auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv_adjoint [Finite J] [CharZero K]
    (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (T : Fin 3 → positiveGrade (K := K) g r →ₗ[K] positiveGrade (K := K) g (r + 1))
    (L : Fin 3 → negativeGrade (K := K) g (r + 1) →ₗ[K] negativeGrade (K := K) g r)
    (h : ∀ i q p, residuePair g (r + 1) q (T i p) = residuePair g r (L i q) p)
    (t : ℕ) (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → negativeGrade (K := K) g (r + 1))
    (p : Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv g r (t + 1)
        (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K) L t q) p =
      auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv g (r + 1) t q
        (operatorDifferential (K := K) T t p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv_apply, auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv_apply]
  symm
  unfold auxiliaryCoefficientPair
  simp only [operatorDifferential_coeff, auxiliaryOperatorMultiply_apply,
    map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b hb
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [h]
  calc
    _ = (factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) *
        (pderiv i (monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) 1 : Poly K 3)).coeff
          (homogeneousTensorExponent t s)) * residuePair g r (L i (q s)) (p b) := by ring
    _ = (factorialWeight K (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b) *
        (X i * monomial (homogeneousTensorExponent t s) 1 : Poly K 3).coeff
          (homogeneousTensorExponent (t + 1) b)) * residuePair g r (L i (q s)) (p b) := by
      rw [factorialWeight_pderiv_monomial_pair]
    _ = _ := by ring

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_auxiliaryMultiply_injective
statement:
theorem operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_auxiliaryMultiply_injective
    [Finite J] [CharZero K] (g : J → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (T : Fin 3 → positiveGrade (K := K) g r →ₗ[K] positiveGrade (K := K) g (r + 1))
    (L : Fin 3 → negativeGrade (K := K) g (r + 1) →ₗ[K] negativeGrade (K := K) g r)
    (h : ∀ i q p, residuePair g (r + 1) q (T i p) = residuePair g r (L i q) p)
    (t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential (K := K) (V := positiveGrade (K := K) g r) (W := positiveGrade (K := K) g (r + 1)) T t) ↔
      Function.Injective (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K) (W' := negativeGrade (K := K) g (r + 1)) (V' := negativeGrade (K := K) g r) L t)
proof:
:= by
  let E := auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv (K := K) g (r + 1) t
  let F := auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv (K := K) g r (t + 1)
  have hadj (q : Sym (Fin 3) t → negativeGrade (K := K) g (r + 1)) :
      F (auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K) (W' := negativeGrade (K := K) g (r + 1)) (V' := negativeGrade (K := K) g r) L t q) = (operatorDifferential (K := K) (V := positiveGrade (K := K) g r) (W := positiveGrade (K := K) g (r + 1)) T t).dualMap (E q) :=
    LinearMap.ext fun p => auxiliaryCoefficientResidueDualEquiv_adjoint g r T L h t q p
  constructor
  · intro hD q q' hq
    apply E.injective
    apply LinearMap.dualMap_injective_of_surjective hD
    rw [← hadj, ← hadj, hq]
  · intro hL
    apply (LinearMap.dualMap_injective_iff (K := K)
      (V₁ := Sym (Fin 3) (t + 1) → positiveGrade (K := K) g r)
      (V₂ := Sym (Fin 3) t → positiveGrade (K := K) g (r + 1)) (f :=
      operatorDifferential (K := K) (V := positiveGrade (K := K) g r)
        (W := positiveGrade (K := K) g (r + 1)) T t)).mp
    intro φ ψ hφ
    obtain ⟨q,rfl⟩ := E.surjective φ
    obtain ⟨q',rfl⟩ := E.surjective ψ
    have hq : auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K) (W' := negativeGrade (K := K) g (r + 1)) (V' := negativeGrade (K := K) g r) L t q = auxiliaryOperatorMultiply (K := K) (W' := negativeGrade (K := K) g (r + 1)) (V' := negativeGrade (K := K) g r) L t q' := by
      apply F.injective
      rw [hadj, hadj]
      exact hφ
    exact congrArg E (hL hq)

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_comap_subtype_of_le
statement:
theorem finrank_comap_subtype_of_le {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (J I : Submodule K V) (hJI : J ≤ I) :
    finrank K (J.comap I.subtype) = finrank K J
proof:
:= by
  have h := (I.equivSubtypeMap (J.comap I.subtype)).finrank_eq
  rw [Submodule.map_comap_subtype, inf_eq_right.mpr hJI] at h
  exact h

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_quotient_eq_quotient_add_nested
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_eq_quotient_add_nested {V : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Module.Finite K V]
    (J I : Submodule K V) (hJI : J ≤ I) :
    finrank K (V ⧸ J) = finrank K (V ⧸ I) +
      finrank K (I ⧸ J.comap I.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  have hJ := J.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  have hI := I.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  have hquot := (J.comap I.subtype).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  rw [finrank_comap_subtype_of_le J I hJI] at hquot
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_nested_quotient_int
statement:
theorem finrank_nested_quotient_int {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Module.Finite K V] (J I : Submodule K V) (hJI : J ≤ I) :
    (finrank K (I ⧸ J.comap I.subtype) : ℤ) =
      (finrank K I : ℤ) - (finrank K J : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (J.comap I.subtype).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  rw [finrank_comap_subtype_of_le J I hJI] at h
  have hc := congrArg (fun j : ℕ => (j : ℤ)) h
  rw [Nat.cast_add] at hc
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.finrank_quotient_eq_quotient_add_nested_int
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_eq_quotient_add_nested_int {V : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Module.Finite K V]
    (J I : Submodule K V) (hJI : J ≤ I) :
    (finrank K (V ⧸ J) : ℤ) = (finrank K (V ⧸ I) : ℤ) +
      (finrank K (I ⧸ J.comap I.subtype) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast finrank_quotient_eq_quotient_add_nested J I hJI

statement:

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixBlock_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearMatrixBlock_left {a₁ a₂ c₁ c₂ t : ℕ}
    (L₁ : LinearMatrix K a₁ c₁) (L₂ : LinearMatrix K a₂ c₂)
    (v : MatrixSource K (c₁+c₂) t) (i : Fin a₁) :
    linearMatrixMap (linearMatrixBlock L₁ L₂) t v (Fin.castAdd a₂ i) =
      linearMatrixMap L₁ t (fun j => v (Fin.castAdd c₂ j)) i
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [linearMatrixMap_val, linearMatrixBlock, Fin.sum_univ_add]

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixBlock_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearMatrixBlock_right {a₁ a₂ c₁ c₂ t : ℕ}
    (L₁ : LinearMatrix K a₁ c₁) (L₂ : LinearMatrix K a₂ c₂)
    (v : MatrixSource K (c₁+c₂) t) (i : Fin a₂) :
    linearMatrixMap (linearMatrixBlock L₁ L₂) t v (Fin.natAdd a₁ i) =
      linearMatrixMap L₂ t (fun j => v (Fin.natAdd c₁ j)) i
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixBlock_injective
statement:
theorem linearMatrixBlock_injective {a₁ a₂ c₁ c₂ t : ℕ}
    (L₁ : LinearMatrix K a₁ c₁) (L₂ : LinearMatrix K a₂ c₂)
    (h₁ : Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap L₁ t))
    (h₂ : Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap L₂ t)) :
    Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap (linearMatrixBlock L₁ L₂) t)
proof:
:= by
  intro v w h
  have hleft : (fun j : Fin c₁ => v (Fin.castAdd c₂ j)) =
      (fun j : Fin c₁ => w (Fin.castAdd c₂ j)) := by
    apply h₁
    funext i
    simpa only [linearMatrixBlock_left] using congrFun h (Fin.castAdd a₂ i)
  have hright : (fun j : Fin c₂ => v (Fin.natAdd c₁ j)) =
      (fun j : Fin c₂ => w (Fin.natAdd c₁ j)) := by
    apply h₂
    funext i
    simpa only [linearMatrixBlock_right] using congrFun h (Fin.natAdd a₁ i)
  funext j
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := finSumFinEquiv.surjective j
  cases j with
  | inl j => simpa using congrFun hleft j
  | inr j => simpa using congrFun hright j

name: ChoppedPlane.linearMatrixBlock_surjective
statement:
theorem linearMatrixBlock_surjective {a₁ a₂ c₁ c₂ t : ℕ}
    (L₁ : LinearMatrix K a₁ c₁) (L₂ : LinearMatrix K a₂ c₂)
    (h₁ : Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L₁ t))
    (h₂ : Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L₂ t)) :
    Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap (linearMatrixBlock L₁ L₂) t)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨v₁, hv₁⟩ := h₁ (fun i => y (Fin.castAdd a₂ i))
  obtain ⟨v₂, hv₂⟩ := h₂ (fun i => y (Fin.natAdd a₁ i))
  let v : MatrixSource K (c₁+c₂) t :=
    fun j => Sum.elim v₁ v₂ (finSumFinEquiv.symm j)
  refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
  funext i
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := finSumFinEquiv.surjective i
  cases i with
  | inl i => simpa [v] using congrFun hv₁ i
  | inr i => simpa [v] using congrFun hv₂ i

name: ChoppedPlane.toeplitzMatrix_surjective_at_or_above
statement:
theorem toeplitzMatrix_surjective_at_or_above {a t : ℕ} (hat : a ≤ t + 1) :
    Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap (toeplitzMatrix K a) t)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : 0 < a
  · apply (linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_surjective (toeplitzMatrix K a) t
      ((matrixTarget_le_source_iff K a (a+2) t).mpr (by nlinarith))).mp
    exact toeplitzMatrix_maximalRank ha t
  · have ha0 : a = 0 := by omega
    subst a
    intro y
    exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_balanced_toeplitz_blocks
statement:
theorem exists_balanced_toeplitz_blocks (q m r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ q) :
    ∃ L : LinearMatrix K (q*m+r) (q*m+r+2*q),
      (∀ t, t < m → Function.Injective (linearMatrixMap L t)) ∧
      (∀ t, m ≤ t → Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L t))
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing r with
  | zero =>
      have hr0 : r = 0 := by omega
      subst r
      refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro t ht v w h
        funext i
        have hi := i.isLt
        omega
      · intro t ht y
        refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
        funext i
        have hi := i.isLt
        omega
  | succ q ih =>
      cases r with
      | zero =>
          obtain ⟨L, hinj, hsurj⟩ := ih 0 (by omega)
          have hrow : (q+1)*m+0 = m+(q*m+0) := by ring
          rw [hrow]
          have hcol : m+(q*m+0)+2*(q+1) = (m+2)+(q*m+0+2*q) := by ring
          rw [hcol]
          refine ⟨linearMatrixBlock (toeplitzMatrix K m) L, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro t ht
            exact linearMatrixBlock_injective _ _ (toeplitzMatrix_injective ht)
              (hinj t ht)
          · intro t ht
            exact linearMatrixBlock_surjective _ _
              (toeplitzMatrix_surjective_at_or_above (by omega)) (hsurj t ht)
      | succ r =>
          obtain ⟨L, hinj, hsurj⟩ := ih r (by omega)
          have hrow : (q+1)*m+(r+1) = (m+1)+(q*m+r) := by ring
          rw [hrow]
          have hcol : (m+1)+(q*m+r)+2*(q+1) = (m+1+2)+(q*m+r+2*q) := by ring
          rw [hcol]
          refine ⟨linearMatrixBlock (toeplitzMatrix K (m+1)) L, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro t ht
            exact linearMatrixBlock_injective _ _ (toeplitzMatrix_injective (by omega))
              (hinj t ht)
          · intro t ht
            exact linearMatrixBlock_surjective _ _
              (toeplitzMatrix_surjective_at_or_above (by omega)) (hsurj t ht)

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_even_extra_columns_maximalRank
statement:
theorem exists_even_extra_columns_maximalRank (a q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ L : LinearMatrix K a (a+2*q), ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:= by
  have hdecomp : q*(a/q)+(a%q) = a := by
    have h := Nat.mod_add_div a q
    omega
  have hex := exists_balanced_toeplitz_blocks (K := K) q (a/q) (a%q)
    (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt a hq))
  rw [hdecomp] at hex
  obtain ⟨L, hinj, hsurj⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨L, ?_⟩
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t < a/q
  · exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_injective L t (hinj t ht)
  · exact linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective L t (hsurj t (by omega))

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_many_columns_maximalRank
statement:
theorem exists_many_columns_maximalRank (a c : ℕ) (hac : 3*a ≤ c) :
    ∃ L : LinearMatrix K a c, ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : 0 < a
  · have hex := exists_even_extra_columns_maximalRank (K := K) a a ha
    have hthree : a+2*a = 3*a := by omega
    rw [hthree] at hex
    obtain ⟨L, hmax⟩ := hex
    have hsurj0 : Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L 0) := by
      apply (linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_surjective L 0
        ((matrixTarget_le_source_iff K a (3*a) 0).mpr (by omega))).mp
      exact hmax 0
    have hsurj : ∀ t, Function.Surjective (linearMatrixMap L t) :=
      fun t => linearMatrixMap_surjective_upward L (Nat.zero_le t) hsurj0
    have hc : c = 3*a+(c-3*a) := by omega
    rw [hc]
    let Z : LinearMatrix K 0 (c-3*a) := 0
    refine ⟨linearMatrixBlock L Z, ?_⟩
    intro t
    apply linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective
    apply linearMatrixBlock_surjective L Z (hsurj t)
    intro y
    exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  · have ha0 : a = 0 := by omega
    subst a
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    intro t
    apply linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective
    intro y
    exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticCyclicZ_cube
statement:
theorem quarticCyclicZ_cube {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (dual : Bool) (γ : Fin 3 → A) :
    quarticCyclicZ dual γ ^ 3 = (γ 0 * γ 1 * γ 2) • 1
proof:
:= by
  cases dual
  · exact cyclicZ_cube γ
  · exact cyclicZDual_cube γ

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticCyclicZ_baseChange
statement:
theorem quarticCyclicZ_baseChange {A A' : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing A']
    (φ : A →+* A') (dual : Bool) (γ : Fin 3 → A) (m : Fin 3 → A) :
    cyclicVectorBaseChange φ (quarticCyclicZ dual γ m) =
      quarticCyclicZ dual (fun i => φ (γ i)) (cyclicVectorBaseChange φ m)
proof:
:= by
  cases dual
  · exact cyclicZ_baseChange φ γ m
  · exact cyclicZDual_baseChange φ γ m

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticU_binary_ne_zero
statement:
theorem quarticU_binary_ne_zero :
    quarticU (binaryU K) (binaryV K) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (eval ![1,0]) h
  simp [quarticU, binaryU, binaryV] at he

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticV_binary_ne_zero
statement:
theorem quarticV_binary_ne_zero :
    quarticV (binaryU K) (binaryV K) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (eval ![0,1]) h
  simp [quarticV, binaryU, binaryV] at he

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quartic_cyclic_kernel_descends
statement:
theorem quartic_cyclic_kernel_descends (dual : Bool) (γ : Fin 3 → BinaryRing K)
    (hγ : γ 0 * γ 1 * γ 2 = binaryCubic K) :
    let Z
proof:
:= quarticCyclicZ dual γ
    let hZ : Z ^ 3 = binaryCubic K • 1 := (quarticCyclicZ_cube dual γ).trans (by rw [hγ])
    let := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) Z hZ
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (P : AuxTensor (R := CyclicCubicRing (BinaryRing K) (binaryCubic K))
        (M := BinaryVector K)), TensorHomogeneous n P →
      tensorDirectional (quarticRow
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryU K))
        (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryV K))
        (cyclicRoot (binaryCubic K))) P = 0 →
      ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → BinaryVector K,
        kernelSynthesis (quarticKernelMatrixU
          (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryU K))
          (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryV K))
          (cyclicRoot (binaryCubic K)) 0) n c = P := by
  dsimp only
  let B := BinaryRing K
  let F := FractionRing B
  let φ : B →+* F := algebraMap B F
  let Z := quarticCyclicZ dual γ
  let Z' := quarticCyclicZ dual (fun i => φ (γ i))
  have hZ : Z ^ 3 = binaryCubic K • 1 :=
    (quarticCyclicZ_cube dual γ).trans (by rw [hγ])
  have hZ' : Z' ^ 3 = φ (binaryCubic K) • 1 := by
    rw [quarticCyclicZ_cube]
    congr 1
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, hγ]
  let := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) Z hZ
  intro n P hP hδ
  exact quartic_kernel_descends (K := F) (F := F)
    (binaryU K) (binaryV K) Z Z' hZ hZ'
    (quarticCyclicZ_baseChange φ dual γ)
    quarticU_binary_ne_zero quarticV_binary_ne_zero quartic_binary_relPrime P hP hδ

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_kernelProductSpace
statement:
theorem mem_kernelProductSpace (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] T)
    (Q : Submodule K V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ Q) (w : W) :
    B v w ∈ kernelProductSpace B Q
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨v, hv, w, rfl⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProductSpace_mono
statement:
theorem kernelProductSpace_mono (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] T)
    {P Q : Submodule K V} (h : P ≤ Q) :
    kernelProductSpace B P ≤ kernelProductSpace B Q
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨v, hv, w, rfl⟩
  exact mem_kernelProductSpace B Q (h hv) w

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProductMap_apply
statement:
theorem kernelProductMap_apply (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] T)
    (q : J → V) (w : J → W) :
    kernelProductMap B q w = ∑ j, B (q j) (w j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [kernelProductMap]

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProductMap_single
statement:
theorem kernelProductMap_single [DecidableEq J] (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] T)
    (q : J → V) (j : J) (w : W) :
    kernelProductMap B q (Pi.single j w) = B (q j) w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [kernelProductMap_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro i _ hi
    simp [hi]
  · simp

name: ChoppedPlane.range_kernelProductMap_le
statement:
theorem range_kernelProductMap_le (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] T)
    (q : J → V) (Q : Submodule K V) (hq : ∀ j, q j ∈ Q) :
    LinearMap.range (kernelProductMap B q) ≤ kernelProductSpace B Q
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  rw [kernelProductMap_apply]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ => mem_kernelProductSpace B Q (hq j) (w j)

name: ChoppedPlane.range_kernelProductMap_eq
statement:
theorem range_kernelProductMap_eq (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] T)
    (q : J → V) (Q : Submodule K V)
    (hq : Submodule.span K (Set.range q) = Q) :
    LinearMap.range (kernelProductMap B q) = kernelProductSpace B Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply range_kernelProductMap_le
    intro j
    rw [← hq]
    exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self j)
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, w, rfl⟩
    rw [← hq] at hv
    induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      rcases hx with ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨Pi.single j w, kernelProductMap_single B q j w⟩
    | zero =>
      simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      change B (x + y) w ∈ LinearMap.range (kernelProductMap B q)
      rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx =>
      change B (c • x) w ∈ LinearMap.range (kernelProductMap B q)
      rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: ChoppedPlane.isPolynomialFamily_kernelProductMap
statement:
theorem isPolynomialFamily_kernelProductMap [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] T)
    (q : J → (ι → K) → V) (hq : ∀ j, IsPolynomialFamily (q j)) :
    IsPolynomialFamily (fun a => kernelProductMap B (fun j => q j a))
proof:
:= by
  apply isPolynomialFamily_linearMap
  intro w
  have h := IsPolynomialFamily.sum fun j =>
    (hq j).linear_comp (B.flip (w j))
  simpa only [kernelProductMap_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProduct_polynomial_principal_open
statement:
theorem kernelProduct_polynomial_principal_open
    [FiniteDimensional K W] [FiniteDimensional K T]
    (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] T) (E : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] U))
    (q : J → (ι → K) → V) (hqpoly : ∀ j, IsPolynomialFamily (q j))
    (hqker : ∀ a j, q j a ∈ LinearMap.ker (E a))
    (a₀ : ι → K)
    (hqspan : Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun j => q j a₀)) = LinearMap.ker (E a₀)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
      finrank K (kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a₀))) ≤
        finrank K (kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a)))
proof:
:= by
  let A : (ι → K) → ((J → W) →ₗ[K] T) :=
    fun a => kernelProductMap B (fun j => q j a)
  obtain ⟨D, hD, h⟩ := rank_polynomial_principal_open A
    (isPolynomialFamily_kernelProductMap B q hqpoly) a₀
  refine ⟨D, hD, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  have h₀ : LinearMap.range (A a₀) = kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a₀)) :=
    range_kernelProductMap_eq B _ _ hqspan
  have hle : LinearMap.range (A a) ≤ kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a)) :=
    range_kernelProductMap_le B _ _ (hqker a)
  rw [← h₀]
  exact (h a ha).trans (Submodule.finrank_mono hle)

name: ChoppedPlane.kernelProduct_range_polynomial_principal_open
statement:
theorem kernelProduct_range_polynomial_principal_open
    {S : Type*} [AddCommGroup S] [Module K S] [FiniteDimensional K S]
    [FiniteDimensional K W] [FiniteDimensional K T]
    (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] T) (E : (ι → K) → (V →ₗ[K] U))
    (C : (ι → K) → (S →ₗ[K] V)) (hC : IsPolynomialFamily C)
    (hCker : ∀ a, LinearMap.range (C a) ≤ LinearMap.ker (E a))
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hC₀ : LinearMap.range (C a₀) = LinearMap.ker (E a₀)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 →
      finrank K (kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a₀))) ≤
        finrank K (kernelProductSpace B (LinearMap.ker (E a)))
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.finBasis K S
  let q : Fin (finrank K S) → (ι → K) → V := fun j a => C a (b j)
  have hqpoly (j) : IsPolynomialFamily (q j) :=
    hC.linear_comp (LinearMap.applyₗ (R := K) (M₂ := V) (b j))
  have hqker (a) (j) : q j a ∈ LinearMap.ker (E a) :=
    hCker a ⟨b j, rfl⟩
  have hqspan : Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun j => q j a₀)) =
      LinearMap.ker (E a₀) := by
    rw [← hC₀, ← Submodule.map_top, ← b.span_eq, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  exact kernelProduct_polynomial_principal_open B E q hqpoly hqker a₀ hqspan

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_div_x
statement:
theorem homogeneous_div_x {t : ℕ} (p : Poly K 3)
    (hp : p.IsHomogeneous (t + 1)) :
    (p.divMonomial (Finsupp.single 0 1)).IsHomogeneous t
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have hcoeff : p.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 1 + e) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [coeff_divMonomial] using he
  have hdeg : (Finsupp.single 0 1 + e).degree = t + 1 := by
    simpa only [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one, Pi.one_def] using hp hcoeff
  have hedeg : e.degree = t := by
    simp only [map_add, Finsupp.degree_single] at hdeg
    omega
  simpa only [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one, Pi.one_def] using hedeg

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_zero_of_x_dvd
statement:
theorem homogeneous_zero_of_x_dvd (p : Poly K 3)
    (hp : p.IsHomogeneous 0) (hdiv : X 0 ∣ p) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  by_cases he : e = 0
  · subst e
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hdiv
    simp [coeff_X_mul']
  · simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] using
      hp.coeff_eq_zero (fun hd => he ((Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff e).mp hd))

name: ChoppedPlane.x_mul_div_of_x_dvd
statement:
theorem x_mul_div_of_x_dvd (p : Poly K 3) (hdiv : X 0 ∣ p) :
    X 0 * p.divMonomial (Finsupp.single 0 1) = p
proof:
:= by
  have hmod := (X_dvd_iff_modMonomial_eq_zero).mp hdiv
  simpa only [hmod, add_zero] using p.divMonomial_add_modMonomial_single 0

name: ChoppedPlane.signed_homogeneous_vector_zero_of_lower_degree
statement:
theorem signed_homogeneous_vector_zero_of_lower_degree
    (B : Matrix ι κ (Poly K n)) (δ : ι → κ → ℤ) (t : ι → ℤ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, B i j ∈ signedForms K n (δ i j))
    (ht : ∀ i j, t i < δ i j)
    (f : ι → Poly K n) (hf : ∀ i, f i ∈ signedForms K n (t i))
    (v : κ → Poly K n) (h : B.mulVec v = f) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : 0 ≤ t i
  · have hfi : (f i).IsHomogeneous (t i).toNat := by
      simpa [signedForms, hi] using hf i
    have heq := congrArg (homogeneousComponent (t i).toNat) (congrFun h i)
    rw [homogeneousComponent_eq_self hfi] at heq
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, map_sum] at heq
    have hz (j : κ) : homogeneousComponent (t i).toNat (B i j * v j) = 0 := by
      by_cases hj : 0 ≤ δ i j
      · have hbij : (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ i j).toNat := by
          simpa [signedForms, hj] using hB i j
        exact homogeneousComponent_mul_eq_zero_of_lt _ (by have := ht i j; omega) _ _ hbij
      · have hbzero : B i j = 0 := by
          simpa only [signedForms, ite_eq_right hj, Submodule.mem_bot] using hB i j
        simp only [hbzero, zero_mul, map_zero]
    simpa only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using heq.symm
  · simpa only [signedForms, ite_eq_right hi, Submodule.mem_bot, Pi.zero_apply] using hf i

name: ChoppedPlane.weighted_homogeneous_vector_zero_of_lower_degree
statement:
theorem weighted_homogeneous_vector_zero_of_lower_degree
    (B : Matrix ι κ (Poly K n)) (w : ι → ℤ) (degree : κ → ℤ) (t : ℤ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, B i j ∈ signedForms K n (degree j - w i))
    (ht : ∀ j, t < degree j)
    (f : ι → Poly K n) (hf : ∀ i, f i ∈ signedForms K n (t - w i))
    (v : κ → Poly K n) (h : B.mulVec v = f) : f = 0
proof:
:=
  signed_homogeneous_vector_zero_of_lower_degree B (fun i j => degree j - w i)
    (fun i => t - w i) hB (fun i j => by have := ht j; omega) f hf v h

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.directional_linearChange_zero
statement:
theorem directional_linearChange_zero (f : Fin 3 → R)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R)
    (hA : ∀ i, ∑ j, f j * A i j = 0) (P : Aux R) :
    directional f (linearChange A P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r => simp
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp [hP, hQ]
  | mul_X P i hP =>
    simp [map_mul, Derivation.leibniz, hP, directional_linearForm, hA]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.directional_cross_zero
statement:
theorem directional_cross_zero (u v z : R) (P : Aux R) :
    directional ![u,v,z] (linearChange (crossMatrix u v z) P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply directional_linearChange_zero
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [crossMatrix, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.linearChange_cross_linearForm_zero
statement:
theorem linearChange_cross_linearForm_zero (u v z : R) :
    linearChange (crossMatrix u v z) (linearForm ![u,v,z]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearChange_linearForm]
  have h : (fun k => ∑ j, ![u,v,z] j * crossMatrix u v z j k) = 0 := by
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;> simp [crossMatrix, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
  rw [h]
  simp [linearForm]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensorDirectional_cross_zero
statement:
theorem tensorDirectional_cross_zero (u v z : R)
    (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorDirectional ![u,v,z] (tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z) P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction P using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul Q m =>
    simp [tensorDirectional, tensorChange, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, directional_cross_zero]
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp [hP, hQ]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteDirectional_cross_zero
statement:
theorem finiteDirectional_cross_zero (u v z : R) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) (n + 1) → M) :
    finiteDirectional ![u,v,z] n (finiteCross (crossMatrix u v z) (n + 1) c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector n
    (tensorDirectional ![u,v,z]
      (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (n + 1)
        (finiteCross (crossMatrix u v z) (n + 1) c))) = 0
  rw [synthesis_finiteCross, tensorDirectional_cross_zero]
  exact (homogeneousTensorCoefficientMap n).map_zero

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensorChange_cross_multiply_zero
statement:
theorem tensorChange_cross_multiply_zero (u v z : R)
    (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z) (tensorMultiplyLinear ![u,v,z] P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction P using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul Q m =>
    simp [tensorChange, tensorMultiplyLinear, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
      linearChange_cross_linearForm_zero]
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp [hP, hQ]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.finiteCross_multiply_zero
statement:
theorem finiteCross_multiply_zero (u v z : R) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → M) :
    finiteCross (crossMatrix u v z) (n + 1) (finiteMultiply ![u,v,z] n c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change homogeneousTensorCoefficientVector (n + 1)
    (tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z)
      (homogeneousTensorSynthesis (n + 1) (finiteMultiply ![u,v,z] n c))) = 0
  rw [synthesis_finiteMultiply, tensorChange_cross_multiply_zero]
  exact (homogeneousTensorCoefficientMap (n + 1)).map_zero

name: ChoppedPlane.odd_block_row_budget
statement:
theorem odd_block_row_budget (a k m : ℕ)
    (hlow : (2*k+3)*m ≤ 2*a) (hhigh : 2*a < (2*k+3)*(m+1)) :
    ∃ A r : ℕ, r ≤ k ∧ a = A + (k*m+r) ∧
      3*m ≤ 2*A ∧ 2*A ≤ 3*(m+1)
proof:
:= by
  let lo := (3*m+1)/2
  let hi := 3*(m+1)/2
  have halow : k*m+lo ≤ a := by
    have h : 2*(k*m)+3*m ≤ 2*a := by nlinarith [hlow]
    dsimp [lo]
    omega
  have hahigh : a ≤ k*m+k+hi := by
    have h : 2*a < 2*(k*m)+2*k+3*m+3 := by nlinarith [hhigh]
    dsimp [hi]
    omega
  have hlohi : lo ≤ hi := by dsimp [lo, hi]; omega
  let A := max lo (a-(k*m+k))
  have hAlo : lo ≤ A := le_max_left _ _
  have hAhi : A ≤ hi := by dsimp [A]; omega
  have hAa : k*m+A ≤ a := by dsimp [A]; omega
  let r := a-(k*m+A)
  refine ⟨A, r, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [r, A]
    omega
  · dsimp [r]
    omega
  · dsimp [lo] at hAlo
    omega
  · dsimp [hi] at hAhi
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_odd_extra_columns_maximalRank_of_three
statement:
theorem exists_odd_extra_columns_maximalRank_of_three
    (hthree : ∀ A : ℕ, ∃ L : LinearMatrix K A (A+3),
      ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t)
    (a k : ℕ) :
    ∃ L : LinearMatrix K a (a+(2*k+3)),
      ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:= by
  let m := 2*a/(2*k+3)
  have hlo : (2*k+3)*m ≤ 2*a := by
    dsimp [m]
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_mul_le_self (2*a) (2*k+3)
  have hhi : 2*a < (2*k+3)*(m+1) := by
    dsimp [m]
    exact Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (2*a) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨A, r, hr, ha, hAlo, hAhi⟩ := odd_block_row_budget a k m hlo hhi
  obtain ⟨L₃, hmax₃⟩ := hthree A
  obtain ⟨L₂, hinj₂, hsurj₂⟩ := exists_balanced_toeplitz_blocks (K := K) k m r hr
  have hcol : a+(2*k+3) = (A+3)+(k*m+r+2*k) := by omega
  rw [hcol, ha]
  refine ⟨linearMatrixBlock L₃ L₂, ?_⟩
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t < m
  · apply linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_injective
    apply linearMatrixBlock_injective
    · apply (linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_injective L₃ t
        ((matrixSource_le_target_iff K A (A+3) t).mpr ?_)).mp (hmax₃ t)
      have h : 3*(t+1) ≤ 2*A := by omega
      nlinarith
    · exact hinj₂ t ht
  · apply linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective
    apply linearMatrixBlock_surjective
    · apply (linearMatrixMaximalRank_iff_surjective L₃ t
        ((matrixTarget_le_source_iff K A (A+3) t).mpr ?_)).mp (hmax₃ t)
      have h : 2*A ≤ 3*(t+1) := by omega
      nlinarith
    · exact hsurj₂ t (by omega)

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_linearMatrix_maximalRank_of_three
statement:
theorem exists_linearMatrix_maximalRank_of_three
    (hthree : ∀ A : ℕ, ∃ L : LinearMatrix K A (A+3),
      ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t)
    (a c : ℕ) (hac : a < c) (hgap : 2 ≤ c-a) :
    ∃ L : LinearMatrix K a c, ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:= by
  have hc : c = a+(c-a) := by omega
  by_cases heven : (c-a)%2 = 0
  · have h : c = a+2*((c-a)/2) := by omega
    rw [h]
    exact exists_even_extra_columns_maximalRank a ((c-a)/2) (by omega)
  · have h : c = a+(2*((c-a-3)/2)+3) := by omega
    rw [h]
    exact exists_odd_extra_columns_maximalRank_of_three hthree a ((c-a-3)/2)

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_vector_zero_of_lower_degree
statement:
theorem homogeneous_vector_zero_of_lower_degree
    (B : Matrix ι κ (Poly K n)) (δ : κ → ℕ) (t : ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (δ j))
    (ht : ∀ j, t < δ j)
    (f : ι → Poly K n) (hf : ∀ i, (f i).IsHomogeneous t)
    (v : κ → Poly K n) (h : B.mulVec v = f) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  have heq := congrArg (homogeneousComponent t) (congrFun h i)
  rw [homogeneousComponent_eq_self (hf i)] at heq
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, map_sum] at heq
  have hz : ∀ j, homogeneousComponent t (B i j * v j) = 0 :=
    fun j => homogeneousComponent_mul_eq_zero_of_lt t (ht j) _ _ (hB i j)
  simpa only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using heq.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.homogeneous_sum_zero_of_lower_degree
statement:
theorem homogeneous_sum_zero_of_lower_degree
    (B : κ → ι → Poly K n) (δ : κ → ℕ) (t : ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B j i).IsHomogeneous (δ j))
    (ht : ∀ j, t < δ j)
    (f : ι → Poly K n) (hf : ∀ i, (f i).IsHomogeneous t)
    (v : κ → Poly K n) (h : ∀ i, ∑ j, B j i * v j = f i) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact homogeneous_vector_zero_of_lower_degree (fun i j => B j i) δ t hB ht f hf v
    (funext h)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.finiteDirectionalSynthesis_weighted
statement:
theorem finiteDirectionalSynthesis_weighted
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Module R (BinaryVector K)]
    (w : Fin 3 → ℕ) (r : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Sym (Fin 3) n → GradedBinaryVector (K := K) w r)
    (α : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    tensorCoefficients (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (R := R)
      (gradedBinaryVectorVal w r) n c) α i ∈ signedForms K 2 (r-w i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hα : α.degree = n
  · obtain ⟨b,rfl⟩ := exists_homogeneousTensorExponent n α hα
    rw [finiteDirectionalSynthesis_coefficient]
    exact (c b i).property
  · rw [(tensorHomogeneous_iff_coefficients n _).mp
      (finiteDirectionalSynthesis_homogeneous (R := R) (gradedBinaryVectorVal w r) n c) α hα]
    exact (signedForms K 2 (r-w i)).zero_mem

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedProfileOperators_direction
statement:
theorem gradedProfileOperators_direction (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℤ) :
    letI
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZ (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZ_cube q hq s)
    ∀ (i : Fin 3) (m : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) t),
      gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) (t+1) (gradedProfileOperators q s t i m) =
        profileDirection (K := K) i • gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) t m := by
  letI := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZ (profileFactors q s))
    (profileZ_cube q hq s)
  intro i m
  fin_cases i
  · change binaryU K • gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) t m =
      cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryU K) • gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) t m
    exact (cyclicModule_coefficient_smul (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZ (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZ_cube q hq s) (binaryU K) _).symm
  · change binaryV K • gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) t m =
      cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryV K) • gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) t m
    exact (cyclicModule_coefficient_smul (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZ (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZ_cube q hq s) (binaryV K) _).symm
  · change cyclicZ (profileFactors q s) (gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) t m) =
      cyclicRoot (binaryCubic K) • gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) t m
    exact (cyclicModule_root_smul (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZ (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZ_cube q hq s) _).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedProfileDualOperators_direction
statement:
theorem gradedProfileDualOperators_direction (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℤ) :
    letI
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZDual_cube q hq s)
    ∀ (i : Fin 3) (m : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s) t),
      gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) (t+1) (gradedProfileDualOperators q s t i m) =
        profileDirection (K := K) i • gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) t m := by
  letI := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s))
    (profileZDual_cube q hq s)
  intro i m
  fin_cases i
  · change binaryU K • gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) t m =
      cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryU K) • gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) t m
    exact (cyclicModule_coefficient_smul (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZDual_cube q hq s) (binaryU K) _).symm
  · change binaryV K • gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) t m =
      cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (binaryV K) • gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) t m
    exact (cyclicModule_coefficient_smul (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZDual_cube q hq s) (binaryV K) _).symm
  · change cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s) (gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) t m) =
      cyclicRoot (binaryCubic K) • gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) t m
    exact (cyclicModule_root_smul (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZDual_cube q hq s) _).symm

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDifferential_tensor_eq
statement:
theorem profileDifferential_tensor_eq (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    letI
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZ (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZ_cube q hq s)
    ∀ c : Sym (Fin 3) (t+1) → GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) r,
      tensorDirectional (profileDirection (K := K))
        (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) r) (t+1) c) =
      finiteDirectionalSynthesis (gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) (r+1)) t
        (operatorDifferential (gradedProfileOperators q s r) t c) := by
  letI := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZ (profileFactors q s))
    (profileZ_cube q hq s)
  intro c
  exact finiteDirectionalSynthesis_derivative _ _ _ _
    (gradedProfileOperators_direction q hq s r) t c

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDualDifferential_tensor_eq
statement:
theorem profileDualDifferential_tensor_eq (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    letI
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s))
      (profileZDual_cube q hq s)
    ∀ c : Sym (Fin 3) (t+1) → GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s) r,
      tensorDirectional (profileDirection (K := K))
        (finiteDirectionalSynthesis (gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) r) (t+1) c) =
      finiteDirectionalSynthesis (gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) (r+1)) t
        (operatorDifferential (gradedProfileDualOperators q s r) t c) := by
  letI := cyclicModuleStructure (binaryCubic K) (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s))
    (profileZDual_cube q hq s)
  intro c
  exact finiteDirectionalSynthesis_derivative _ _ _ _
    (gradedProfileDualOperators_direction q hq s r) t c

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_idealDegreeSpace
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_idealDegreeSpace {n d : ℕ} (I : Ideal (Poly K n)) (f : Poly K n) :
    f ∈ idealDegreeSpace I d ↔ f.IsHomogeneous d ∧ f ∈ I
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.idealDegreeSpace_mul_forms_le
statement:
theorem idealDegreeSpace_mul_forms_le {n d e : ℕ} (I : Ideal (Poly K n)) :
    idealDegreeSpace I d * Forms K n e ≤ idealDegreeSpace I (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.mul_le.mpr
  intro f hf g hg
  exact ⟨hf.1.mul hg, Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hf.2⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.forms_mul_ideal_le
statement:
theorem forms_mul_ideal_le {n d : ℕ} (I : Ideal (Poly K n)) :
    Forms K n d * I.restrictScalars K ≤ I.restrictScalars K
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.mul_le.mpr
  intro f hf g hg
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hg

name: ChoppedPlane.idealDegreeSpace_le_of_recurrence
statement:
theorem idealDegreeSpace_le_of_recurrence {n q : ℕ}
    (I J : Ideal (Poly K n))
    (hbase : idealDegreeSpace I q ≤ J.restrictScalars K)
    (hrec : ∀ d, q ≤ d → idealDegreeSpace I (d + 1) ≤
      Forms K n 1 * idealDegreeSpace I d) :
    ∀ d, q ≤ d → idealDegreeSpace I d ≤ J.restrictScalars K
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hd
  induction e with
  | zero => simpa using hbase
  | succ e ih =>
    apply (hrec (q + e) (by omega)).trans
    have hprod : Forms K n 1 * idealDegreeSpace I (q + e) ≤
        Forms K n 1 * J.restrictScalars K := by
      apply Submodule.mul_le.mpr
      intro f hf g hg
      exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul hf (ih (by omega) hg)
    exact hprod.trans (forms_mul_ideal_le J)

name: ChoppedPlane.idealDegreeSpace_eq_of_recurrence
statement:
theorem idealDegreeSpace_eq_of_recurrence {n q : ℕ}
    (I J : Ideal (Poly K n)) (hJI : J ≤ I)
    (hbase : idealDegreeSpace I q = idealDegreeSpace J q)
    (hrec : ∀ d, q ≤ d → idealDegreeSpace I (d + 1) ≤
      Forms K n 1 * idealDegreeSpace I d) :
    ∀ d, q ≤ d → idealDegreeSpace I d = idealDegreeSpace J d
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_inf inf_le_left
      (idealDegreeSpace_le_of_recurrence I J
        (hbase ▸ inf_le_right) hrec d hd)
  · exact inf_le_inf_left _ hJI

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreeSpace_eq_idealDegreeSpace
statement:
theorem pointDegreeSpace_eq_idealDegreeSpace {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p) :
    pointDegreeSpace K a d = idealDegreeSpace (pointIdeal K a) d
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g.property, (homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff a g).mpr hg⟩
  · intro hf
    exact ⟨⟨f, hf.1⟩, (homogeneous_mem_pointIdeal_iff a ⟨f, hf.1⟩).mp hf.2, rfl⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.pointEvaluation_surjective_add
statement:
theorem pointEvaluation_surjective_add {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d)) (e : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a (d + e))
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hsurj v
  refine ⟨⟨f.val * X 2 ^ e, f.property.mul (isHomogeneous_X_pow 2 e)⟩, ?_⟩
  ext i
  simpa [pointEvaluation_apply, chartPoint, map_mul] using congrFun hf i

name: ChoppedPlane.pointEvaluation_surjective_of_le
statement:
theorem pointEvaluation_surjective_of_le {p d t : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a d)) (hdt : d ≤ t) :
    Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hdt
  exact pointEvaluation_surjective_add a hsurj e

name: ChoppedPlane.coordinateForms_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateForms_val (i : Fin 3) :
    (coordinateForms (K := K) i).val = X i
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.exists_coordinate_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_coordinate_decomposition (d : ℕ) (f : Forms K 3 (d + 1)) :
    ∃ b : Fin 3 → Forms K 3 d, f.val = ∑ i, X i * (b i).val
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : generatorSpace (coordinateForms (K := K)) = Forms K 3 1 := by
    simpa [generatorSpace, coordinateForms] using
      (homogeneousSubmodule_one_eq_span_X (σ := Fin 3) (R := K)).symm
  have hmem : f.val ∈ LinearMap.range ((Forms K 3 (1 + d)).subtype.comp
      (multiplication (e := d) (coordinateForms (K := K)))) := by
    rw [range_ambient_multiplication, hgen, forms_mul_forms]
    simp [Nat.add_comm]
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hmem
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hb
  change (multiplication (e := d) (coordinateForms (K := K)) b).val = f.val at hb
  rw [multiplication_val] at hb
  simpa using hb.symm

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_pointDegreeSpace
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_pointDegreeSpace {p d : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (f : Poly K 3) :
    f ∈ pointDegreeSpace K a d ↔ f.IsHomogeneous d ∧
      ∀ i, eval (chartPoint K a i) f = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g.property, (mem_pointDegreePiece a g).mp hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨hf, heval⟩
    exact ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, (mem_pointDegreePiece a ⟨f, hf⟩).mpr heval, rfl⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreeSpace_succ_eq
statement:
theorem pointDegreeSpace_succ_eq {p t : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a t)) :
    pointDegreeSpace K a (t + 2) =
      Forms K 3 1 * pointDegreeSpace K a (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    obtain ⟨hfhom, hfeval⟩ := (mem_pointDegreeSpace a f).mp hf
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_coordinate_decomposition (t + 1) ⟨f, hfhom⟩
    change f = ∑ i, X i * (b i).val at hb
    obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ := hsurj (pointEvaluation K a (t + 1) (b 0))
    obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁⟩ := hsurj (pointEvaluation K a (t + 1) (b 1))
    let c₀ : Poly K 3 := (b 0).val - X 2 * g₀.val
    let c₁ : Poly K 3 := (b 1).val - X 2 * g₁.val
    let c₂ : Poly K 3 := (b 2).val + X 0 * g₀.val + X 1 * g₁.val
    have he₀ (i : Fin p) : eval (chartPoint K a i) g₀.val =
        eval (chartPoint K a i) (b 0).val := congrFun hg₀ i
    have he₁ (i : Fin p) : eval (chartPoint K a i) g₁.val =
        eval (chartPoint K a i) (b 1).val := congrFun hg₁ i
    have hc₀ : c₀ ∈ pointDegreeSpace K a (t + 1) := by
      apply (mem_pointDegreeSpace a c₀).mpr
      constructor
      · exact (b 0).property.sub (by simpa [Nat.add_comm] using
          (isHomogeneous_X K (2 : Fin 3)).mul g₀.property)
      · intro i
        simp only [c₀, map_sub, map_mul, eval_X]
        rw [show chartPoint K a i 2 = 1 by simp [chartPoint], one_mul, he₀ i, sub_self]
    have hc₁ : c₁ ∈ pointDegreeSpace K a (t + 1) := by
      apply (mem_pointDegreeSpace a c₁).mpr
      constructor
      · exact (b 1).property.sub (by simpa [Nat.add_comm] using
          (isHomogeneous_X K (2 : Fin 3)).mul g₁.property)
      · intro i
        simp only [c₁, map_sub, map_mul, eval_X]
        rw [show chartPoint K a i 2 = 1 by simp [chartPoint], one_mul, he₁ i, sub_self]
    have hc₂ : c₂ ∈ pointDegreeSpace K a (t + 1) := by
      apply (mem_pointDegreeSpace a c₂).mpr
      constructor
      · exact ((b 2).property.add (by simpa [Nat.add_comm] using
          (isHomogeneous_X K (0 : Fin 3)).mul g₀.property)).add
          (by simpa [Nat.add_comm] using
          (isHomogeneous_X K (1 : Fin 3)).mul g₁.property)
      · intro i
        have h := hfeval i
        rw [hb, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h
        simp only [map_add, map_mul, eval_X] at h
        simp only [c₂, map_add, map_mul, eval_X, he₀ i, he₁ i]
        simp [chartPoint] at h ⊢
        linear_combination h
    have hid : f = X 0 * c₀ + X 1 * c₁ + X 2 * c₂ := by
      rw [hb, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      dsimp [c₀, c₁, c₂]
      ring
    rw [hid]
    apply Submodule.add_mem
    · apply Submodule.add_mem
      · exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (isHomogeneous_X K 0) hc₀
      · exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (isHomogeneous_X K 1) hc₁
    · exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (isHomogeneous_X K 2) hc₂
  · rw [pointDegreeSpace_eq_idealDegreeSpace, pointDegreeSpace_eq_idealDegreeSpace,
      mul_comm]
    simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using
      idealDegreeSpace_mul_forms_le (d := t + 1) (e := 1) (pointIdeal K a)

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreeSpace_recurrence
statement:
theorem pointDegreeSpace_recurrence {p q : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a (q - 1)))
    (d : ℕ) (hqd : q ≤ d) :
    pointDegreeSpace K a (d + 1) = Forms K 3 1 * pointDegreeSpace K a d
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 1 ≤ d := hq.trans hqd
  have hs := pointEvaluation_surjective_of_le a hsurj
    (show q - 1 ≤ d - 1 by omega)
  have hh := pointDegreeSpace_succ_eq a hs
  simpa [show d - 1 + 1 = d by omega, show d - 1 + 2 = d + 1 by omega] using hh

name: ChoppedPlane.pointDegreeSpace_eq_of_degree_eq
statement:
theorem pointDegreeSpace_eq_of_degree_eq {p q : ℕ} (a : PointCoordinates K p)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (pointEvaluation K a (q - 1)))
    (J : Ideal (Poly K 3)) (hJI : J ≤ pointIdeal K a)
    (hbase : pointDegreeSpace K a q = idealDegreeSpace J q) :
    ∀ d, q ≤ d → pointDegreeSpace K a d = idealDegreeSpace J d
proof:
:= by
  have hrec : ∀ d, q ≤ d → idealDegreeSpace (pointIdeal K a) (d + 1) ≤
      Forms K 3 1 * idealDegreeSpace (pointIdeal K a) d := by
    intro d hd
    rw [← pointDegreeSpace_eq_idealDegreeSpace, ← pointDegreeSpace_eq_idealDegreeSpace]
    exact (pointDegreeSpace_recurrence a hq hsurj d hd).le
  intro d hd
  rw [pointDegreeSpace_eq_idealDegreeSpace]
  exact idealDegreeSpace_eq_of_recurrence (pointIdeal K a) J hJI
    (by rwa [← pointDegreeSpace_eq_idealDegreeSpace]) hrec d hd

name: ChoppedPlane.linear_cech_vanishing_iff
statement:
theorem linear_cech_vanishing_iff
    (dA : A₁ →ₗ[R] A₂) (dB : B₁ →ₗ[R] B₂)
    (l₁ : A₁ →ₗ[R] B₁) (l₂ : A₂ →ₗ[R] B₂)
    (hcomm : ∀ a, dB (l₁ a) = l₂ (dA a))
    (hdB : Function.Injective dB) (hl₂ : Function.Injective l₂) :
    (∀ a, l₂ a ∈ LinearMap.range dB → a ∈ LinearMap.range dA) ↔
      (∀ b, dB b ∈ LinearMap.range l₂ → b ∈ LinearMap.range l₁)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h b hb
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hb
    have hla : l₂ a ∈ LinearMap.range dB := ⟨b, ha.symm⟩
    obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁⟩ := h a hla
    refine ⟨a₁, hdB ?_⟩
    calc
      dB (l₁ a₁) = l₂ (dA a₁) := hcomm a₁
      _ = l₂ a := congrArg l₂ ha₁
      _ = dB b := ha
  · intro h a ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ha
    have hdb : dB b ∈ LinearMap.range l₂ := ⟨a, hb.symm⟩
    obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁⟩ := h b hdb
    refine ⟨a₁, hl₂ ?_⟩
    calc
      l₂ (dA a₁) = dB (l₁ a₁) := (hcomm a₁).symm
      _ = dB b := congrArg dB ha₁
      _ = l₂ a := hb

name: ChoppedPlane.linear_cech_cross_descent
statement:
theorem linear_cech_cross_descent
    (dA : A₁ →ₗ[R] A₂) (dB : B₁ →ₗ[R] B₂)
    (l₁ : A₁ →ₗ[R] B₁) (l₂ : A₂ →ₗ[R] B₂)
    (q₁ : B₁ →ₗ[R] C₁) (q₂ : B₂ →ₗ[R] C₂) (dC : C₁ →ₗ[R] C₂)
    (hcomm : ∀ a, dB (l₁ a) = l₂ (dA a))
    (hcross : ∀ b, dC (q₁ b) = q₂ (dB b))
    (hdB : Function.Injective dB) (hl₂ : Function.Injective l₂)
    (hdC : Function.Injective dC)
    (hker₁ : LinearMap.ker q₁ = LinearMap.range l₁)
    (hzero₂ : ∀ a, q₂ (l₂ a) = 0) :
    ∀ a, l₂ a ∈ LinearMap.range dB → a ∈ LinearMap.range dA
proof:
:= by
  apply (linear_cech_vanishing_iff dA dB l₁ l₂ hcomm hdB hl₂).mpr
  intro b hb
  rw [← hker₁, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  apply hdC
  rw [hcross, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hb
  rw [← ha]
  exact hzero₂ a

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.quotientCoordinates_inverse
statement:
theorem quotientCoordinates_inverse (u v z a : R) (hua : u * a = 1) :
    quotientCoordinates u v z * quotientCoordinatesInv v z a = 1 ∧
      quotientCoordinatesInv v z a * quotientCoordinates u v z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hau : a * u = 1 := by simpa [mul_comm] using hua
  constructor <;> ext i j <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [quotientCoordinates, quotientCoordinatesInv, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_three, ← mul_assoc, hua, hau]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.crossKernelCoordinates_inverse
statement:
theorem crossKernelCoordinates_inverse (u v z a : R) (hua : u * a = 1) :
    crossKernelCoordinates u v z a * crossKernelCoordinatesInv u v z a = 1 ∧
      crossKernelCoordinatesInv u v z a * crossKernelCoordinates u v z a = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hau : a * u = 1 := by simpa [mul_comm] using hua
  constructor <;> ext i j <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [crossKernelCoordinates, crossKernelCoordinatesInv, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_three, hua, hau] <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.crossKernelCoordinates_derivative
statement:
theorem crossKernelCoordinates_derivative (u v z a : R) (hua : u * a = 1) :
    ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ j, (![u,v,z] : Fin 3 → R) j *
      crossKernelCoordinates u v z a i j = if i = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [crossKernelCoordinates, Fin.sum_univ_three, hua] <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.zeroFirst_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroFirst_X (i : Fin 3) :
    zeroFirst (X i : Aux R) = if i = 0 then 0 else X i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show (X i : Aux R) = monomial (Finsupp.single i 1) 1 from rfl,
    zeroFirst_monomial]
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    simp
  · simp [hi, Ne.symm hi]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.zeroFirst_asLinearChange
statement:
theorem zeroFirst_asLinearChange :
    (zeroFirst : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R) =
      (linearChange firstProjectionMatrix).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h : binaryEmbedding.comp binaryRestriction =
      (linearChange firstProjectionMatrix : Aux R →ₐ[R] Aux R) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro i
    change zeroFirst (X i : Aux R) = linearChange firstProjectionMatrix (X i)
    rw [zeroFirst_X, linearChange_X]
    fin_cases i <;> simp [firstProjectionMatrix, linearForm, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  exact congrArg AlgHom.toLinearMap h

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.cross_projection_factorization
statement:
theorem cross_projection_factorization (u v z a : R) :
    ((linearChange (crossMatrix u v z)).toLinearMap).comp
      (linearChange (quotientCoordinates u v z)).toLinearMap =
    ((linearChange (crossKernelCoordinates u v z a)).toLinearMap).comp
      zeroFirst
proof:
:= by
  have hm : quotientCoordinates u v z * crossMatrix u v z =
      firstProjectionMatrix * crossKernelCoordinates u v z a := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [quotientCoordinates, crossMatrix, firstProjectionMatrix,
        crossKernelCoordinates, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
  rw [zeroFirst_asLinearChange]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro P
  change ((linearChange (crossMatrix u v z)).comp
      (linearChange (quotientCoordinates u v z))) P =
    ((linearChange (crossKernelCoordinates u v z a)).comp
      (linearChange firstProjectionMatrix)) P
  rw [linearChange_comp, linearChange_comp, hm]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.quotientCoordinatesV_inverse
statement:
theorem quotientCoordinatesV_inverse (u v z a : R) (hva : v * a = 1) :
    quotientCoordinatesV u v z * quotientCoordinatesVInv u z a = 1 ∧
      quotientCoordinatesVInv u z a * quotientCoordinatesV u v z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hav : a * v = 1 := by simpa [mul_comm] using hva
  constructor <;> ext i j <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [quotientCoordinatesV, quotientCoordinatesVInv, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_three, ← mul_assoc, hva, hav]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.crossKernelCoordinatesV_inverse
statement:
theorem crossKernelCoordinatesV_inverse (u v z a : R) (hva : v * a = 1) :
    crossKernelCoordinatesV u v z a * crossKernelCoordinatesVInv u v z a = 1 ∧
      crossKernelCoordinatesVInv u v z a * crossKernelCoordinatesV u v z a = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hav : a * v = 1 := by simpa [mul_comm] using hva
  constructor <;> ext i j <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [crossKernelCoordinatesV, crossKernelCoordinatesVInv, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_three, hva, hav] <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.crossKernelCoordinatesV_derivative
statement:
theorem crossKernelCoordinatesV_derivative (u v z a : R) (hva : v * a = 1) :
    ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ j, (![u,v,z] : Fin 3 → R) j *
      crossKernelCoordinatesV u v z a i j = if i = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [crossKernelCoordinatesV, Fin.sum_univ_three, hva] <;> ring

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.cross_projection_factorizationV
statement:
theorem cross_projection_factorizationV (u v z a : R) :
    ((linearChange (crossMatrix u v z)).toLinearMap).comp
      (linearChange (quotientCoordinatesV u v z)).toLinearMap =
    ((linearChange (crossKernelCoordinatesV u v z a)).toLinearMap).comp
      zeroFirst
proof:
:= by
  have hm : quotientCoordinatesV u v z * crossMatrix u v z =
      firstProjectionMatrix * crossKernelCoordinatesV u v z a := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [quotientCoordinatesV, crossMatrix, firstProjectionMatrix,
        crossKernelCoordinatesV, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
  rw [zeroFirst_asLinearChange]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro P
  change ((linearChange (crossMatrix u v z)).comp
      (linearChange (quotientCoordinatesV u v z))) P =
    ((linearChange (crossKernelCoordinatesV u v z a)).comp
      (linearChange firstProjectionMatrix)) P
  rw [linearChange_comp, linearChange_comp, hm]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.zeroFirst_coeff
statement:
theorem zeroFirst_coeff (P : Aux R) (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    (zeroFirst P).coeff s = if s 0 = 0 then P.coeff s else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add P Q hP hQ =>
    rw [map_add]
    change (zeroFirst P).coeff s + (zeroFirst Q).coeff s =
      if s 0 = 0 then P.coeff s + Q.coeff s else 0
    rw [hP, hQ]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | monomial t r =>
    by_cases hts : t = s
    · subst t
      by_cases hs : s 0 = 0 <;> simp [zeroFirst_monomial, hs]
    · by_cases ht : t 0 = 0 <;> by_cases hs : s 0 = 0 <;>
        simp [zeroFirst_monomial, ht, hs, coeff_monomial, hts]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.zeroFirst_eq_modMonomial
statement:
theorem zeroFirst_eq_modMonomial (P : Aux R) :
    zeroFirst P = P.modMonomial (Finsupp.single 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rw [zeroFirst_coeff]
  by_cases hs : s 0 = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left hs, coeff_modMonomial_of_not_le]
    simp [Finsupp.single_le_iff, hs]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hs, coeff_modMonomial_of_le]
    exact Finsupp.single_le_iff.mpr (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hs)

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.multiplyFirst_divideFirst_add_zeroFirst
statement:
theorem multiplyFirst_divideFirst_add_zeroFirst (P : Aux R) :
    multiplyFirst (divideFirst P) + zeroFirst P = P
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroFirst_eq_modMonomial]
  exact P.divMonomial_add_modMonomial_single 0

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.divideFirst_multiplyFirst
statement:
@[simp] theorem divideFirst_multiplyFirst (P : Aux R) :
    divideFirst (multiplyFirst P) = P
proof:
:= by
  change (X 0 * P).divMonomial (Finsupp.single 0 1) = P
  simpa only [X] using divMonomial_monomial_mul (Finsupp.single 0 1) P

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.zeroFirst_multiplyFirst
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroFirst_multiplyFirst (P : Aux R) :
    zeroFirst (multiplyFirst P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change binaryEmbedding (R := R)
    (binaryRestriction (R := R) ((X (0 : Fin 3) : Aux R) * P)) = 0
  rw [map_mul]
  have hx : binaryRestriction (X (0 : Fin 3) : Aux R) = 0 := by
    simp [binaryRestriction]
  rw [hx, zero_mul, map_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.divideFirst_homogeneousComponent
statement:
theorem divideFirst_homogeneousComponent (n : ℕ) (P : Aux R) :
    homogeneousComponent n (divideFirst P) =
      divideFirst (homogeneousComponent (n + 1) P)
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  change (homogeneousComponent n
      (P.divMonomial (Finsupp.single 0 1))).coeff s =
    ((homogeneousComponent (n + 1) P).divMonomial (Finsupp.single 0 1)).coeff s
  simp only [coeff_homogeneousComponent, coeff_divMonomial]
  have hd : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 3) 1 + s).degree = s.degree + 1 := by
    simp [add_comm]
  simp [hd]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensor_first_variable_split
statement:
theorem tensor_first_variable_split (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorMultiplyFirst (tensorDivideFirst P) + tensorZeroFirst P = P
proof:
:= by
  have hs : multiplyFirst.comp divideFirst + (zeroFirst : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R) =
      LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro P
    exact multiplyFirst_divideFirst_add_zeroFirst P
  have ht := congrArg (fun L : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R => L.rTensor M) hs
  simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_add, LinearMap.rTensor_comp, LinearMap.rTensor_id] at ht
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun ht P

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensor_divideFirst_multiplyFirst
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensor_divideFirst_multiplyFirst (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorDivideFirst (tensorMultiplyFirst P) = P
proof:
:= by
  have hs : divideFirst.comp (multiplyFirst : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R) = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro P
    exact divideFirst_multiplyFirst P
  have ht := congrArg (fun L : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R => L.rTensor M) hs
  simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_comp, LinearMap.rTensor_id] at ht
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun ht P

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensor_zeroFirst_multiplyFirst
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensor_zeroFirst_multiplyFirst (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorZeroFirst (tensorMultiplyFirst P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : zeroFirst.comp (multiplyFirst : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R) = 0 := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro P
    exact zeroFirst_multiplyFirst P
  have ht := congrArg (fun L : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R => L.rTensor M) hs
  simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_comp, LinearMap.rTensor_zero] at ht
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun ht P

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensor_zeroFirst_kernel
statement:
theorem tensor_zeroFirst_kernel (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorZeroFirst P = 0 ↔ P ∈ LinearMap.range tensorMultiplyFirst
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hP
    refine ⟨tensorDivideFirst P, ?_⟩
    simpa [hP] using tensor_first_variable_split P
  · rintro ⟨Q, rfl⟩
    exact tensor_zeroFirst_multiplyFirst Q

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensor_multiplyFirst_injective
statement:
theorem tensor_multiplyFirst_injective :
    Function.Injective (tensorMultiplyFirst (R := R) (M := M))
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q h
  simpa using congrArg (tensorDivideFirst (R := R) (M := M)) h

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensor_cross_projection_factorization
statement:
theorem tensor_cross_projection_factorization (u v z a : R) :
    (tensorChange (M := M) (crossMatrix u v z)).comp
      (tensorChange (quotientCoordinates u v z)) =
    (tensorChange (crossKernelCoordinates u v z a)).comp tensorZeroFirst
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun L : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R => L.rTensor M)
    (cross_projection_factorization u v z a)
  simpa [tensorChange, tensorZeroFirst, LinearMap.rTensor_comp] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensor_quotientCoordinates_multiplyFirst
statement:
theorem tensor_quotientCoordinates_multiplyFirst (u v z : R) :
    (tensorChange (M := M) (quotientCoordinates u v z)).comp tensorMultiplyFirst =
      (tensorMultiplyLinear ![u,v,z]).comp
        (tensorChange (quotientCoordinates u v z))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (linearChange (quotientCoordinates u v z)).toLinearMap.comp multiplyFirst =
      (LinearMap.mulLeft R (linearForm ![u,v,z])).comp
        (linearChange (quotientCoordinates u v z)).toLinearMap := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro P
    change linearChange (quotientCoordinates u v z) ((X (0 : Fin 3) : Aux R) * P) =
      linearForm ![u,v,z] * linearChange (quotientCoordinates u v z) P
    rw [map_mul, linearChange_X]
    rfl
  have ht := congrArg (fun L : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R => L.rTensor M) h
  simpa [tensorChange, tensorMultiplyFirst, tensorMultiplyLinear,
    LinearMap.rTensor_comp] using ht

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensorZeroFirst_eq_binaryProjection
statement:
theorem tensorZeroFirst_eq_binaryProjection (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorZeroFirst P = tensorBinaryEmbedding (tensorBinaryRestriction P)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.rTensor_comp M binaryEmbedding.toLinearMap
    (binaryRestriction.toLinearMap : Aux R →ₗ[R] Binary R)
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h P

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensorDivideFirst_homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  have h : (homogeneousComponent n).comp (divideFirst : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R) =
      divideFirst.comp (homogeneousComponent (n + 1)) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro Q
    exact divideFirst_homogeneousComponent n Q
  have ht := congrArg (fun L : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R => L.rTensor M) h
  simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_comp] at ht
  have htP := LinearMap.congr_fun ht P
  dsimp only [TensorHomogeneous, tensorDivideFirst, LinearMap.comp_apply] at hP ⊢
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, hP] using htP

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensorChange_homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  exact tensor_linearSubstitution_homogeneous (linearChange A) (by intro i; simp) hP

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensor_cross_kernel
statement:
theorem tensor_cross_kernel (u v z a : R) (hua : u * a = 1)
    (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z) P = 0 ↔
      P ∈ LinearMap.range (tensorMultiplyLinear ![u,v,z])
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hDD', hD'D⟩ := quotientCoordinates_inverse u v z a hua
  obtain ⟨hHH', hH'H⟩ := crossKernelCoordinates_inverse u v z a hua
  let ED := (linearChangeEquiv (quotientCoordinates u v z)
    (quotientCoordinatesInv v z a) hDD' hD'D).toLinearEquiv.rTensor M
  let EH := (linearChangeEquiv (crossKernelCoordinates u v z a)
    (crossKernelCoordinatesInv u v z a) hHH' hH'H).toLinearEquiv.rTensor M
  have hcross : ∀ Q, tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z) (ED Q) = EH (tensorZeroFirst Q) :=
    fun Q => LinearMap.congr_fun (tensor_cross_projection_factorization u v z a) Q
  have hmul : ∀ Q, ED (tensorMultiplyFirst Q) = tensorMultiplyLinear ![u,v,z] (ED Q) :=
    fun Q => LinearMap.congr_fun (tensor_quotientCoordinates_multiplyFirst u v z) Q
  constructor
  · intro hP
    have hz : tensorZeroFirst (ED.symm P) = 0 := by
      apply EH.injective
      rw [← hcross, ED.apply_symm_apply, hP, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := (tensor_zeroFirst_kernel (ED.symm P)).mp hz
    refine ⟨ED Q, ?_⟩
    rw [← hmul, hQ, ED.apply_symm_apply]
  · rintro ⟨Q, rfl⟩
    have heq : tensorMultiplyLinear ![u,v,z] Q =
        ED (tensorMultiplyFirst (ED.symm Q)) := by
      rw [hmul, ED.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [heq, hcross, tensor_zeroFirst_multiplyFirst, map_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensorMultiplyLinear_injective
statement:
theorem tensorMultiplyLinear_injective (u v z a : R) (hua : u * a = 1) :
    Function.Injective (tensorMultiplyLinear (M := M) ![u,v,z])
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hDD', hD'D⟩ := quotientCoordinates_inverse u v z a hua
  let ED := (linearChangeEquiv (quotientCoordinates u v z)
    (quotientCoordinatesInv v z a) hDD' hD'D).toLinearEquiv.rTensor M
  have hmul : ∀ Q, ED (tensorMultiplyFirst Q) = tensorMultiplyLinear ![u,v,z] (ED Q) :=
    fun Q => LinearMap.congr_fun (tensor_quotientCoordinates_multiplyFirst u v z) Q
  intro P Q h
  apply ED.symm.injective
  apply tensor_multiplyFirst_injective
  apply ED.injective
  rw [hmul, hmul, ED.apply_symm_apply, ED.apply_symm_apply]
  exact h

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.CrossPresentation.cross_projection
statement:
theorem cross_projection (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z) (T.quotientEquiv P) =
      T.kernelEquiv (tensorZeroFirst P)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun L : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R => L.rTensor M)
    T.projection_factorization
  simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_comp] at h
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h P

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.CrossPresentation.quotient_multiplyFirst
statement:
theorem quotient_multiplyFirst (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    T.quotientEquiv (tensorMultiplyFirst P) =
      tensorMultiplyLinear ![u,v,z] (T.quotientEquiv P)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (linearChange T.quotient).toLinearMap.comp multiplyFirst =
      (LinearMap.mulLeft R (linearForm ![u,v,z])).comp
        (linearChange T.quotient).toLinearMap := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro Q
    change linearChange T.quotient ((X (0 : Fin 3) : Aux R) * Q) =
      linearForm ![u,v,z] * linearChange T.quotient Q
    rw [map_mul, linearChange_X, T.quotient_first]
  have ht := congrArg (fun L : Aux R →ₗ[R] Aux R => L.rTensor M) h
  simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_comp] at ht
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun ht P

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.CrossPresentation.quotient_homogeneous
statement:
theorem quotient_homogeneous {n : ℕ} {P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)}
    (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) : TensorHomogeneous n (T.quotientEquiv P)
proof:
:=
  tensorChange_homogeneous T.quotient hP

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.CrossPresentation.quotient_symm_homogeneous
statement:
theorem quotient_symm_homogeneous {n : ℕ} {P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)}
    (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P) : TensorHomogeneous n (T.quotientEquiv.symm P)
proof:
:=
  tensorChange_homogeneous T.quotientInv hP

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.CrossPresentation.cross_kernel
statement:
theorem cross_kernel (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z) P = 0 ↔
      P ∈ LinearMap.range (tensorMultiplyLinear ![u,v,z])
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hP
    have hz : tensorZeroFirst (T.quotientEquiv.symm P) = 0 := by
      apply T.kernelEquiv.injective
      rw [← T.cross_projection, T.quotientEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hP, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := (tensor_zeroFirst_kernel (T.quotientEquiv.symm P)).mp hz
    refine ⟨T.quotientEquiv Q, ?_⟩
    rw [← T.quotient_multiplyFirst, hQ, T.quotientEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  · rintro ⟨Q, rfl⟩
    have heq : tensorMultiplyLinear ![u,v,z] Q =
        T.quotientEquiv (tensorMultiplyFirst (T.quotientEquiv.symm Q)) := by
      rw [T.quotient_multiplyFirst, T.quotientEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [heq, T.cross_projection, tensor_zeroFirst_multiplyFirst, map_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.CrossPresentation.cross_kernel_homogeneous
statement:
theorem cross_kernel_homogeneous {n : ℕ}
    {P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)} (hP : TensorHomogeneous (n + 1) P)
    (hcross : tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z) P = 0) :
    ∃ Q, TensorHomogeneous n Q ∧ tensorMultiplyLinear ![u,v,z] Q = P
proof:
:= by
  have hz : tensorZeroFirst (T.quotientEquiv.symm P) = 0 := by
    apply T.kernelEquiv.injective
    rw [← T.cross_projection, T.quotientEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hcross, map_zero]
  refine ⟨T.quotientEquiv (tensorDivideFirst (T.quotientEquiv.symm P)),
    T.quotient_homogeneous (tensorDivideFirst_homogeneous
      (T.quotient_symm_homogeneous hP)), ?_⟩
  rw [← T.quotient_multiplyFirst]
  have hsplit := tensor_first_variable_split (T.quotientEquiv.symm P)
  rw [hz, add_zero] at hsplit
  rw [hsplit, T.quotientEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.CrossPresentation.multiply_injective
statement:
theorem multiply_injective :
    Function.Injective (tensorMultiplyLinear (M := M) ![u,v,z])
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q h
  apply T.quotientEquiv.symm.injective
  apply tensor_multiplyFirst_injective
  apply T.quotientEquiv.injective
  rw [T.quotient_multiplyFirst, T.quotient_multiplyFirst,
    T.quotientEquiv.apply_symm_apply, T.quotientEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact h

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.CrossPresentation.cross_range_homogeneous
statement:
theorem cross_range_homogeneous {n : ℕ}
    {P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)} (hP : TensorHomogeneous n P)
    (hdP : tensorDirectional ![u,v,z] P = 0) :
    ∃ Q, TensorHomogeneous n Q ∧ tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z) Q = P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, huniq⟩ := tensor_directional_homogeneous_kernel
    (K := K) (M := M) ![u,v,z] T.kernel T.kernelInv
    T.kernel_mul_inv T.kernel_inv_mul T.kernel_derivative P hP |>.mp hdP
  refine ⟨T.quotientEquiv (tensorBinaryEmbedding Q),
    T.quotient_homogeneous (tensor_linearSubstitution_homogeneous binaryEmbedding
      binaryEmbedding_X_homogeneous hQ.1), ?_⟩
  rw [T.cross_projection, tensorZeroFirst_eq_binaryProjection,
    tensorBinaryRestriction_embedding]
  exact hQ.2

name: ChoppedPlane.FiniteCech.tensor_cross_range
statement:
theorem tensor_cross_range (u v z a : R) (hua : u * a = 1)
    (P : AuxTensor (R := R) (M := M)) :
    P ∈ LinearMap.range (tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z)) ↔
      tensorDirectional ![u,v,z] P = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hDD', hD'D⟩ := quotientCoordinates_inverse u v z a hua
  obtain ⟨hHH', hH'H⟩ := crossKernelCoordinates_inverse u v z a hua
  let ED := (linearChangeEquiv (quotientCoordinates u v z)
    (quotientCoordinatesInv v z a) hDD' hD'D).toLinearEquiv.rTensor M
  have hcross : ∀ Q, tensorChange (crossMatrix u v z) (ED Q) =
      tensorChange (crossKernelCoordinates u v z a) (tensorZeroFirst Q) :=
    fun Q => LinearMap.congr_fun (tensor_cross_projection_factorization u v z a) Q
  have hker := tensor_directional_kernel (K := K) (M := M) ![u,v,z]
    (crossKernelCoordinates u v z a) (crossKernelCoordinatesInv u v z a)
    hHH' hH'H (crossKernelCoordinates_derivative u v z a hua)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨Q, rfl⟩
    apply (hker _).mpr
    refine ⟨tensorBinaryRestriction (ED.symm Q), ?_, ?_⟩
    · change tensorChange (crossKernelCoordinates u v z a)
          (tensorBinaryEmbedding (tensorBinaryRestriction (ED.symm Q))) = _
      rw [← tensorZeroFirst_eq_binaryProjection, ← hcross, ED.apply_symm_apply]
    · intro Q' hQ'
      have hHinj : Function.Injective
          (tensorChange (crossKernelCoordinates u v z a) (M := M)) :=
        ((linearChangeEquiv (crossKernelCoordinates u v z a)
          (crossKernelCoordinatesInv u v z a) hHH' hH'H).toLinearEquiv.rTensor M).injective
      apply tensorBinaryEmbedding_injective
      apply hHinj
      change kernelEmbedding (crossKernelCoordinates u v z a) Q' = _
      rw [hQ']
      rw [← ED.apply_symm_apply Q, hcross, tensorZeroFirst_eq_binaryProjection]
      simp only [ED.symm_apply_apply]
  · intro hP
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, huniq⟩ := (hker P).mp hP
    refine ⟨ED (tensorBinaryEmbedding Q), ?_⟩
    rw [hcross, tensorZeroFirst_eq_binaryProjection, tensorBinaryRestriction_embedding]
    exact hQ

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selected_card_eq_diagonal_add_pairs
statement:
theorem selected_card_eq_diagonal_add_pairs (ε : Fin c → ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = (∑ i, ε i ^ 2) + Ferrers.weightedPairs ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [selected_card]
  let w := fun ij : Fin c × Fin c => ε ij.1 * ε ij.2
  have hpoint (ij : Fin c × Fin c) :
      (if ij.1 ≤ ij.2 then w ij else 0) =
      (if ij.1 = ij.2 then ε ij.1 ^ 2 else 0) +
      (if ij.1 < ij.2 then w ij else 0) := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy ij.1 ij.2 with h | h | h
    · simp [h, le_of_lt h, ne_of_lt h]
    · simp [h, w, pow_two]
    · simp [not_le_of_gt h, ne_of_gt h, not_lt_of_gt h]
  have hweak : (∑ ij : Fin c × Fin c, if ij.1 ≤ ij.2 then w ij else 0) =
      ∑ ij : {ij : Fin c × Fin c // ij.1 ≤ ij.2}, w ij.val := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    exact Finset.sum_subtype _ (by simp) _
  have hdiag : (∑ ij : Fin c × Fin c, if ij.1 = ij.2 then ε ij.1 ^ 2 else 0) =
      ∑ i, ε i ^ 2 := by simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  have hlt : (∑ ij : Fin c × Fin c, if ij.1 < ij.2 then w ij else 0) =
      Ferrers.weightedPairs ε := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    exact Finset.sum_subtype _ (by simp) _
  change (∑ ij : {ij : Fin c × Fin c // ij.1 ≤ ij.2}, w ij.val) = _
  rw [← hweak]
  calc
    _ = ∑ ij : Fin c × Fin c,
      ((if ij.1 = ij.2 then ε ij.1 ^ 2 else 0) +
       (if ij.1 < ij.2 then w ij else 0)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro ij _
      exact hpoint ij
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hdiag, hlt]

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selected_card_square
statement:
theorem selected_card_square (ε : Fin c → ℕ) :
    2 * Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = (∑ i, ε i) ^ 2 + (∑ i, ε i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [selected_card_eq_diagonal_add_pairs]
  have h := Ferrers.weightedPairs_square ε
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selected_card_of_sums
statement:
theorem selected_card_of_sums (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (d r q : ℕ)
    (hsum : (∑ i, ε i) = d)
    (hsquares : (∑ i, ε i ^ 2) = d + 2 * q)
    (hq : q + r = d + 1) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = (d + 2).choose 2 - r
proof:
:= by
  have hsq := selected_card_square ε
  rw [hsum, hsquares] at hsq
  have hN : 2 * N d = (d + 1) * (d + 2) := by exact_mod_cast twice_N d
  have hcount : Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) + r = N d := by nlinarith
  change Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = N d - r
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.selected_card_one_two
statement:
theorem selected_card_one_two (ε : Fin c → ℕ) (hε : ∀ j, ε j = 1 ∨ ε j = 2) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex ε) = N (∑ j, ε j) - (c + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => ε j = 2)).card
  have hpoint (j : Fin c) : ε j = 1 + (if ε j = 2 then 1 else 0) := by
    rcases hε j with hj | hj <;> simp [hj]
  have hsum : (∑ j, ε j) = c + q := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ j : Fin c, (1 + (if ε j = 2 then 1 else 0)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        exact hpoint j
      _ = _ := by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, q]
  have hsquarepoint (j : Fin c) :
      ε j ^ 2 = ε j + 2 * (if ε j = 2 then 1 else 0) := by
    rcases hε j with hj | hj <;> simp [hj]
  have hsquares : (∑ j, ε j ^ 2) = (∑ j, ε j) + 2 * q := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ j : Fin c, (ε j + 2 * (if ε j = 2 then 1 else 0)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        exact hsquarepoint j
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        simp [q]
  apply selected_card_of_sums ε (∑ j, ε j) (c + 1) q rfl hsquares
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.columnProfile_pos
statement: theorem columnProfile_pos (c q : ℕ) (i : Fin c) : 0 < columnProfile c q i
proof:
:= by
  unfold columnProfile
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.columnProfile_sum
statement:
theorem columnProfile_sum (c q : ℕ) (hq : q ≤ c) :
    (∑ i, columnProfile c q i) = c + q
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (q + (c - q)) ≃ Fin c := finCongr (by omega)
  have he (i : Fin (q + (c - q))) :
      Ferrers.positiveProfile q (c - q) i = columnProfile c q (e i) := by
    simp [Ferrers.positiveProfile, columnProfile, e]
  have h := Fintype.sum_equiv e (Ferrers.positiveProfile q (c - q)) (columnProfile c q) he
  rw [Ferrers.positiveProfile_sum] at h
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.columnProfile_square_sum
statement:
theorem columnProfile_square_sum (c q : ℕ) (hq : q ≤ c) :
    (∑ i, columnProfile c q i ^ 2) = c + 3 * q
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (q + (c - q)) ≃ Fin c := finCongr (by omega)
  have he (i : Fin (q + (c - q))) :
      Ferrers.positiveProfile q (c - q) i ^ 2 = columnProfile c q (e i) ^ 2 := by
    simp [Ferrers.positiveProfile, columnProfile, e]
  have h := Fintype.sum_equiv e (fun i => Ferrers.positiveProfile q (c - q) i ^ 2)
    (fun i => columnProfile c q i ^ 2) he
  rw [Ferrers.positiveProfile_square_sum] at h
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.ColumnFerrers.columnProfile_selected_card
statement:
theorem columnProfile_selected_card {d r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hupper : r ≤ d + 1)
    (hlower : d + 2 ≤ 2 * r) :
    Fintype.card (SelectedIndex (columnProfile (r - 1) (d + 1 - r))) =
      (d + 2).choose 2 - r
proof:
:= by
  have hq : d + 1 - r ≤ r - 1 := by omega
  apply selected_card_of_sums _ d r (d + 1 - r)
  · rw [columnProfile_sum _ _ hq]
    omega
  · rw [columnProfile_square_sum _ _ hq]
    omega
  · omega

name: ChoppedPlane.standardRowDegrees_quadratic
statement:
@[simp] theorem standardRowDegrees_quadratic (h : r + a = c + 1) (i : Fin r) :
    standardRowDegrees r c (quadraticRow h i) = 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [standardRowDegrees, quadraticRow]

name: ChoppedPlane.standardRowDegrees_linear
statement:
@[simp] theorem standardRowDegrees_linear (h : r + a = c + 1) (i : Fin a) :
    standardRowDegrees r c (linearRow h i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [standardRowDegrees, linearRow]

name: ChoppedPlane.quadratic_row_shift
statement:
@[simp] theorem quadratic_row_shift (h : r + a = c + 1) (e : ℤ) (i : Fin r) :
    e - 2 + standardRowDegrees r c (quadraticRow h i) = e
proof:
:= by
  rw [standardRowDegrees_quadratic]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.linear_row_shift
statement:
@[simp] theorem linear_row_shift (h : r + a = c + 1) (e : ℤ) (i : Fin a) :
    e - 2 + standardRowDegrees r c (linearRow h i) = e - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [standardRowDegrees_linear]
  ring

name: ChoppedPlane.row_cases
statement:
theorem row_cases (h : r + a = c + 1) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (∃ j : Fin r, quadraticRow h j = i) ∨ (∃ j : Fin a, linearRow h j = i)
proof:
:= by
  let k : Fin (r + a) := Fin.cast h.symm i
  have hk : Fin.cast h k = i := by ext; rfl
  by_cases hi : k.val < r
  · left
    refine ⟨⟨k.val, hi⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    rfl
  · right
    refine ⟨⟨k.val - r, by have := k.isLt; omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    change r + (i.val - r) = i.val
    have hkr : r ≤ i.val := by simpa [k] using (show r ≤ k.val by omega)
    omega

name: ChoppedPlane.standardRowSplitMap_bijective
statement:
theorem standardRowSplitMap_bijective (h : r + a = c + 1) (e : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (standardRowSplitMap (K := K) (n := n) h e)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro v w hvw
    funext i
    apply Subtype.ext
    rcases row_cases h i with ⟨j, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · exact congrArg (fun q => (q.1 j).val) hvw
    · exact congrArg (fun q => (q.2 j).val) hvw
  · rintro ⟨v, w⟩
    let f : Fin (c + 1) → Poly K n := fun i =>
      Fin.addCases (fun j => (v j).val) (fun j => (w j).val) (Fin.cast h.symm i)
    have hf (i : Fin (c + 1)) : f i ∈ signedForms K n (e - 2 + standardRowDegrees r c i) := by
      rcases row_cases h i with ⟨j, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, rfl⟩
      · rw [quadratic_row_shift]
        simp [f, quadraticRow]
      · rw [linear_row_shift]
        simp [f, linearRow]
    refine ⟨fun i => ⟨f i, hf i⟩, ?_⟩
