    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [standardRowSplitMap, f, quadraticRow]
    · funext i
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [standardRowSplitMap, f, linearRow]

name: ChoppedPlane.splitCofactorMap_surjective
statement:
theorem splitCofactorMap_surjective
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i)) (e : ℤ) :
    Function.Surjective (splitCofactorMap B h hB e)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := y.property
  refine ⟨standardRowSplitEquiv h e v, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change gradedCofactorMap B (standardRowDegrees r c) hB (e - 2)
    ((standardRowSplitEquiv h e).symm (standardRowSplitEquiv h e v)) = y.val
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using hv

name: ChoppedPlane.splitCofactorMap_ker
statement:
theorem splitCofactorMap_ker
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ) :
    (splitCofactorMap B h hB e).ker = (splitRelationMap B h hB e).range
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hker : (standardRowSplitEquiv h e).symm v ∈
        (gradedCofactorMap B (standardRowDegrees r c) hB (e - 2)).ker := by
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hv
    rw [graded_ker_cofactor_eq_range B (standardRowDegrees r c) hB hprimitive] at hker
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hker
    refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
    apply (standardRowSplitEquiv h e).symm.injective
    simpa [splitRelationMap] using hw
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hzero : gradedMatrixMap B (standardRowDegrees r c) hB (e - 2) w ∈
        (gradedCofactorMap B (standardRowDegrees r c) hB (e - 2)).ker := by
      rw [graded_ker_cofactor_eq_range B (standardRowDegrees r c) hB hprimitive]
      exact ⟨w, rfl⟩
    change gradedCofactorMap B (standardRowDegrees r c) hB (e - 2)
      ((standardRowSplitEquiv h e).symm
        (standardRowSplitEquiv h e (gradedMatrixMap B (standardRowDegrees r c) hB (e - 2) w))) = 0
    simpa only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, LinearMap.mem_ker] using hzero

name: ChoppedPlane.rowLinearBlockMap_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowLinearBlockMap_val
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    (e : ℤ) (w : Fin c → signedForms K n (e - 2)) (i : Fin a) :
    (rowLinearBlockMap B h hB e w i).val = ∑ j, B (linearRow h i) j * (w j).val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.rowChopQuotient_finrank_of_maximalRank
statement:
theorem rowChopQuotient_finrank_of_maximalRank
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3))
    (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B) (e : ℤ)
    (hmax : finrank K (rowLinearBlockMap B h hB e).range =
      min (finrank K (Fin c → signedForms K 3 (e - 2)))
        (finrank K (Fin a → signedForms K 3 (e - 1)))) :
    (finrank K (linearMapChoppedQuotient (K := K) (V := Fin r → signedForms K 3 e) (W := Fin a → signedForms K 3 (e - 1)) (M := rowCofactorImage (r := r) B hB e) (splitCofactorMap B h hB e)) : ℤ) =
      max ((a : ℤ) * N₂ (e - 1) - (c : ℤ) * N₂ (e - 2)) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [(rowChopQuotientEquivLinearCokernel B h hB hprimitive e).finrank_eq, Submodule.finrank_quotient, hmax]
  have hnat : ∀ n m : ℕ, ((n - min m n : ℕ) : ℤ) = max ((n : ℤ) - m) 0 := by
    intro n m
    have heq : n - min m n = n - m := by omega
    rw [heq]
    have hcast := cast_max_sub 0 n m
    simpa only [max_eq_right (Nat.zero_le (n - m)), Nat.cast_zero, max_comm] using hcast
  rw [hnat]
  have hdim (k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) : (finrank K (Fin k → signedForms K 3 t) : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) * N₂ t := by
    rw [Module.finrank_pi_fintype]
    simp [finrank_signedPlaneForms]
  rw [hdim, hdim]

name: ChoppedPlane.sum_standard_rows
statement:
theorem sum_standard_rows {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (h : r + a = c + 1) (f : Fin (c + 1) → M) :
    (∑ i, f i) = (∑ i : Fin r, f (quadraticRow h i)) +
      ∑ i : Fin a, f (linearRow h i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ i, f i) = ∑ i : Fin (r + a), f (Fin.cast h i) := (Fin.sum_congr' f h).symm
    _ = _ := Fin.sum_univ_add _

name: ChoppedPlane.sum_standardRowDegrees
statement:
theorem sum_standardRowDegrees (h : r + a = c + 1) :
    ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = 2 * r + a
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_standard_rows h]
  simp
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.quadraticMinorSpace_idealSpan
statement:
theorem quadraticMinorSpace_idealSpan
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (h : r + a = c + 1) :
    Ideal.span (quadraticMinorSpace B h : Set (Poly K n)) = quadraticMinorIdeal B h
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_span_of_tower K (Poly K n) _

name: ChoppedPlane.quadraticMinorIdeal_le_maximalMinorIdeal
statement:
theorem quadraticMinorIdeal_le_maximalMinorIdeal
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (h : r + a = c + 1) :
    quadraticMinorIdeal B h ≤ maximalMinorIdeal B
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨quadraticRow h i, rfl⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.quadraticMinor_homogeneous
statement:
theorem quadraticMinor_homogeneous
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d + 2) (i : Fin r) :
    (signedMaximalMinor B (quadraticRow h i)).IsHomogeneous d
proof:
:= by
  simpa [hdegree] using
    signedMaximalMinor_homogeneous_total B (standardRowDegrees r c) hB (quadraticRow h i)

name: ChoppedPlane.quadraticMinorSpace_homogeneous
statement:
theorem quadraticMinorSpace_homogeneous
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d + 2) :
    quadraticMinorSpace B h ≤ Forms K n d
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact quadraticMinor_homogeneous B h hB hdegree i

name: ChoppedPlane.splitCofactorMap_quadratic_val
statement:
theorem splitCofactorMap_quadratic_val
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    (e : ℤ) (v : Fin r → signedForms K n e) :
    (splitCofactorMap B h hB e (v, 0)).val.val =
      ∑ i : Fin r, signedMaximalMinor B (quadraticRow h i) * (v i).val
proof:
:= by
  let E := standardRowSplitEquiv (K := K) (n := n) h e
  have htop (i : Fin r) : ((E.symm (v, 0)) (quadraticRow h i)).val = (v i).val :=
    congrArg (fun q => (q.1 i).val) (E.apply_symm_apply (v, 0))
  have hbottom (i : Fin a) : ((E.symm (v, 0)) (linearRow h i)).val = 0 :=
    congrArg (fun q => (q.2 i).val) (E.apply_symm_apply (v, 0))
  change cofactorMap B (rowFormsVal (E.symm (v, 0))) = _
  rw [cofactorMap_apply, sum_standard_rows h]
  simp only [rowFormsVal, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, htop, hbottom,
    mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]

name: ChoppedPlane.finitePolynomialCombination_apply
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.finitePolynomialCombination_range
statement:
theorem finitePolynomialCombination_range {q : ℕ} (g : Fin q → Poly K n) :
    (finitePolynomialCombination g).range = Ideal.span (Set.range g)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro f ⟨v, rfl⟩
    change (∑ i, g i * v i) ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range g)
    apply Ideal.sum_mem
    intro i _
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Pi.single i 1, ?_⟩
    simp [Pi.single_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.mem_rowChoppedSubmodule_iff
statement:
theorem mem_rowChoppedSubmodule_iff
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d + 2)
    (e : ℤ) (f : rowCofactorImage (r := r) B hB e) :
    f ∈ choppedSubmodule (K := K) (M := rowCofactorImage (r := r) B hB e) (splitCofactorMap B h hB e) ↔
      f.val.val ∈ quadraticMinorIdeal B h
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    change splitCofactorMap B h hB e (v, 0) = f at hv
    have hpoly := congrArg (fun q : rowCofactorImage (r := r) B hB e => q.val.val) hv
    rw [splitCofactorMap_quadratic_val] at hpoly
    rw [← hpoly]
    apply Ideal.sum_mem
    intro i _
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · intro hf
    let g : Fin r → Poly K n := fun i => signedMaximalMinor B (quadraticRow h i)
    have hfcomb : f.val.val ∈ (finitePolynomialCombination g).range := by
      rw [finitePolynomialCombination_range]
      exact hf
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hfcomb
    have hproj : (∑ i, g i * signedComponent e (v i)) = f.val.val := by
      have ht : e - 2 + (∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i : ℕ) = e + (d : ℤ) := by
        rw [hdegree]
        push_cast
        ring
      calc
        (∑ i, g i * signedComponent e (v i)) =
            signedComponent (e + d) (finitePolynomialCombination g v) := by
          simp only [finitePolynomialCombination_apply, map_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          exact (signedComponent_mul_form e (g i) (v i)
            (quadraticMinor_homogeneous B h hB hdegree i)).symm
        _ = signedComponent (e + d) f.val.val := by rw [hv]
        _ = f.val.val := by
          rw [← ht]
          exact signedComponent_self _ f.val
    let w : Fin r → signedForms K n e := fun i => ⟨signedComponent e (v i), signedComponent_mem _ _⟩
    refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (splitCofactorMap B h hB e (w, 0)).val.val = f.val.val
    rw [splitCofactorMap_quadratic_val]
    exact hproj

name: ChoppedPlane.rowCofactorImageEquivSignedIdeal_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowCofactorImageEquivSignedIdeal_val
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n))
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i)) (e : ℤ)
    (f : rowCofactorImage (r := r) B hB e) :
    (rowCofactorImageEquivSignedIdeal B hB e f).val.val = f.val.val
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.rowCofactorImageEquivSignedIdeal_map_chopped
statement:
theorem rowCofactorImageEquivSignedIdeal_map_chopped
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K n)) (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d + 2) (e : ℤ) :
    (choppedSubmodule (K := K) (M := rowCofactorImage (r := r) B hB e)
      (splitCofactorMap B h hB e)).map
        (rowCofactorImageEquivSignedIdeal B hB e).toLinearMap =
      (signedIdealPiece (quadraticMinorIdeal B h)
        (e - 2 + ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i)).comap
          (signedIdealPiece (maximalMinorIdeal B)
            (e - 2 + ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i)).subtype
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact (mem_rowChoppedSubmodule_iff B h hB hdegree e g).mp hg
  · intro hf
    let g := (rowCofactorImageEquivSignedIdeal B hB e).symm f
    refine ⟨g, ?_, (rowCofactorImageEquivSignedIdeal B hB e).apply_symm_apply f⟩
    exact (mem_rowChoppedSubmodule_iff B h hB hdegree e g).mpr hf

name: ChoppedPlane.rowIdealResidual_finrank_of_maximalRank
statement:
theorem rowIdealResidual_finrank_of_maximalRank
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B)
    {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d + 2) (e : ℕ)
    (hmax : finrank K (rowLinearBlockMap B h hB e).range =
      min (finrank K (Fin c → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 2)))
        (finrank K (Fin a → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 1)))) :
    (finrank K (idealResidualPiece (quadraticMinorIdeal B h)
      (maximalMinorIdeal B) (d + e)) : ℤ) =
      max ((a : ℤ) * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 1) - (c : ℤ) * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 2)) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [(rowIdealResidualNatEquivLinearCokernel B h hB hprimitive hdegree e).finrank_eq,
    Submodule.finrank_quotient, hmax]
  have hnat : ∀ n m : ℕ, ((n - min m n : ℕ) : ℤ) = max ((n : ℤ) - m) 0 := by
    intro n m
    have heq : n - min m n = n - m := by omega
    rw [heq]
    have hcast := cast_max_sub 0 n m
    simpa only [max_eq_right (Nat.zero_le (n - m)), Nat.cast_zero, max_comm] using hcast
  rw [hnat]
  have hdim (k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) : (finrank K (Fin k → signedForms K 3 t) : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) * N₂ t := by
    rw [Module.finrank_pi_fintype]
    simp [finrank_signedPlaneForms]
  rw [hdim, hdim]

name: ChoppedPlane.rowQuadraticChop_hilbertFunction
statement:
theorem rowQuadraticChop_hilbertFunction
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B)
    {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d + 2) (e : ℕ)
    (hmax : finrank K (rowLinearBlockMap B h hB e).range =
      min (finrank K (Fin c → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 2)))
        (finrank K (Fin a → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 1)))) :
    (idealQuotientHilbertFunction (quadraticMinorIdeal B h) (d + e) : ℤ) =
      (idealQuotientHilbertFunction (maximalMinorIdeal B) (d + e) : ℤ) +
      max ((a : ℤ) * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 1) - (c : ℤ) * N₂ ((e : ℤ) - 2)) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealQuotientHilbertFunction_eq_add_residual_int _ _
    (quadraticMinorIdeal_le_maximalMinorIdeal B h)]
  rw [rowIdealResidual_finrank_of_maximalRank B h hB hprimitive hdegree e hmax]

name: ChoppedPlane.standardRowProfile_counts
statement:
theorem standardRowProfile_counts (h : r + a = c + 1)
    {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d + 2) :
    (a : ℤ) = aCount d r ∧ (c : ℤ) = cCount d r
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : 2 * r + a = d + 2 := by
    rw [← sum_standardRowDegrees h]
    exact hdegree
  dsimp [aCount, cCount]
  omega

name: ChoppedPlane.rowIdealResidual_finrank_eq_residual
statement:
theorem rowIdealResidual_finrank_eq_residual
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B)
    {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d + 2) (e : ℕ)
    (hmax : finrank K (rowLinearBlockMap B h hB e).range =
      min (finrank K (Fin c → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 2)))
        (finrank K (Fin a → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 1)))) :
    (finrank K (idealResidualPiece (quadraticMinorIdeal B h)
      (maximalMinorIdeal B) (d + e)) : ℤ) = max (residual d r e) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowIdealResidual_finrank_of_maximalRank B h hB hprimitive hdegree e hmax]
  obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := standardRowProfile_counts h hdegree
  rw [ha, hc, block_dimension_identity]

name: ChoppedPlane.rowQuadraticChop_hilbertFunction_residual
statement:
theorem rowQuadraticChop_hilbertFunction_residual
    (B : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) (Poly K 3)) (h : r + a = c + 1)
    (hB : ∀ i j, (B i j).IsHomogeneous (standardRowDegrees r c i))
    (hprimitive : PrimitiveMaximalMinors B)
    {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∑ i, standardRowDegrees r c i = d + 2) (e : ℕ)
    (hmax : finrank K (rowLinearBlockMap B h hB e).range =
      min (finrank K (Fin c → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 2)))
        (finrank K (Fin a → signedForms K 3 ((e : ℤ) - 1)))) :
    (idealQuotientHilbertFunction (quadraticMinorIdeal B h) (d + e) : ℤ) =
      (idealQuotientHilbertFunction (maximalMinorIdeal B) (d + e) : ℤ) +
      max (residual d r e) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowQuadraticChop_hilbertFunction B h hB hprimitive hdegree e hmax]
  obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := standardRowProfile_counts h hdegree
  rw [ha, hc, block_dimension_identity]

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomialTraceGram_specialize_scaled
statement:
theorem polynomialTraceGram_specialize_scaled
    (M : κ → Matrix κ κ (MvPolynomial ι K))
    (a : ι → K) (h : K)
    (hM : ∀ i, (M i).map (eval a) = h • Algebra.leftMulMatrix (b a) (b a i)) :
    (polynomialTraceGram M).map (eval a) =
      (h * h) • (Algebra.traceForm K (A a)).toMatrix (b a)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.map_apply]
  change eval a ((M i * M j).trace) =
    (h * h) • ((Algebra.traceForm K (A a)).toMatrix (b a) i j)
  rw [AddMonoidHom.map_trace (eval a), Matrix.map_mul (f := eval a), hM i, hM j,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul, Matrix.trace_smul]
  have hm : Algebra.leftMulMatrix (b a) (b a i * b a j) =
      Algebra.leftMulMatrix (b a) (b a i) * Algebra.leftMulMatrix (b a) (b a j) :=
    map_mul (Algebra.leftMulMatrix (b a)) _ _
  rw [← hm, ← Algebra.trace_eq_matrix_trace (b a), Algebra.traceForm_toMatrix]

name: ChoppedPlane.polynomialTraceDiscriminant_specialize_scaled
statement:
theorem polynomialTraceDiscriminant_specialize_scaled
    (M : κ → Matrix κ κ (MvPolynomial ι K))
    (a : ι → K) (h : K)
    (hM : ∀ i, (M i).map (eval a) = h • Algebra.leftMulMatrix (b a) (b a i)) :
    eval a (polynomialTraceDiscriminant M) =
      (h * h) ^ Fintype.card κ * ((Algebra.traceForm K (A a)).toMatrix (b a)).det
proof:
:= by
  unfold polynomialTraceDiscriminant
  rw [(eval a).map_det]
  change ((polynomialTraceGram M).map (eval a)).det = _
  rw [polynomialTraceGram_specialize_scaled A b M a h hM, Matrix.det_smul]

name: ChoppedPlane.reduced_principal_open_of_split_scaled
statement:
theorem reduced_principal_open_of_split_scaled
    (M : κ → Matrix κ κ (MvPolynomial ι K)) (H : MvPolynomial ι K)
    (hM : ∀ a, eval a H ≠ 0 → ∀ i,
      (M i).map (eval a) = (eval a H) • Algebra.leftMulMatrix (b a) (b a i))
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hH₀ : eval a₀ H ≠ 0)
    (e : A a₀ ≃ₐ[K] (κ → K)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → IsReduced (A a)
proof:
:= by
  let G := polynomialTraceDiscriminant M
  have hdet₀ : ((Algebra.traceForm K (A a₀)).toMatrix (b a₀)).det ≠ 0 :=
    (LinearMap.BilinForm.nondegenerate_iff_det_ne_zero (b a₀)).mp
      (traceForm_nondegenerate_of_split e)
  have hG₀ : eval a₀ G ≠ 0 := by
    change eval a₀ (polynomialTraceDiscriminant M) ≠ 0
    rw [polynomialTraceDiscriminant_specialize_scaled A b M a₀ (eval a₀ H) (hM a₀ hH₀)]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (mul_ne_zero hH₀ hH₀)) hdet₀
  refine ⟨H * G, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [map_mul] using mul_ne_zero hH₀ hG₀
  · intro a ha
    have hparts : eval a H ≠ 0 ∧ eval a G ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [map_mul, mul_ne_zero_iff] using ha
    have hGa := hparts.2
    change eval a (polynomialTraceDiscriminant M) ≠ 0 at hGa
    rw [polynomialTraceDiscriminant_specialize_scaled A b M a (eval a H)
      (hM a hparts.1)] at hGa
    exact isReduced_of_traceForm_det_ne_zero (b a) (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hGa).2

name: ChoppedPlane.reduced_principal_open_of_split
statement:
theorem reduced_principal_open_of_split
    (M : κ → Matrix κ κ (MvPolynomial ι K))
    (hM : ∀ a i, (M i).map (eval a) = Algebra.leftMulMatrix (b a) (b a i))
    (a₀ : ι → K) (e : A a₀ ≃ₐ[K] (κ → K)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → IsReduced (A a)
proof:
:= by
  apply reduced_principal_open_of_split_scaled A b M 1
  · intro a _ i
    simpa only [map_one, one_smul] using hM a i
  · simp
  · exact e

name: ChoppedPlane.reduced_principal_open_of_split_chart
statement:
theorem reduced_principal_open_of_split_chart
    (M : κ → Matrix κ κ (MvPolynomial ι K)) (H : MvPolynomial ι K)
    (bChart : ∀ a, eval a H ≠ 0 → Basis κ K (A a))
    (hM : ∀ a (ha : eval a H ≠ 0) i,
      (M i).map (eval a) = (eval a H) • Algebra.leftMulMatrix (bChart a ha) (bChart a ha i))
    (a₀ : ι → K) (hH₀ : eval a₀ H ≠ 0)
    (e : A a₀ ≃ₐ[K] (κ → K)) :
    ∃ D : MvPolynomial ι K, eval a₀ D ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, eval a D ≠ 0 → IsReduced (A a)
proof:
:= by
  let G := polynomialTraceDiscriminant M
  have hdet₀ : ((Algebra.traceForm K (A a₀)).toMatrix (bChart a₀ hH₀)).det ≠ 0 :=
    (LinearMap.BilinForm.nondegenerate_iff_det_ne_zero (bChart a₀ hH₀)).mp
      (traceForm_nondegenerate_of_split e)
  have hG₀ : eval a₀ G ≠ 0 := by
    change eval a₀ (polynomialTraceDiscriminant M) ≠ 0
    rw [polynomialTraceDiscriminant_specialize_scaled (fun _ : ι → K => A a₀)
      (fun _ => bChart a₀ hH₀) M a₀ (eval a₀ H) (hM a₀ hH₀)]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (mul_ne_zero hH₀ hH₀)) hdet₀
  refine ⟨H * G, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [map_mul] using mul_ne_zero hH₀ hG₀
  · intro a ha
    have hparts : eval a H ≠ 0 ∧ eval a G ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [map_mul, mul_ne_zero_iff] using ha
    have hGa := hparts.2
    change eval a (polynomialTraceDiscriminant M) ≠ 0 at hGa
    rw [polynomialTraceDiscriminant_specialize_scaled (fun _ : ι → K => A a)
      (fun _ => bChart a hparts.1) M a (eval a H) (hM a hparts.1)] at hGa
    exact isReduced_of_traceForm_det_ne_zero (bChart a hparts.1) (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hGa).2

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.residueCoefficient_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem residueCoefficient_apply (p : BinaryLaurent K) :
    residueCoefficient p = p.coeff (-1,-1)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_apply
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_apply [Fintype ι] (w : ι → K)
    (q p : ι → BinaryLaurent K) :
    vectorResidueFunctional w q p =
      ∑ i : ι, w i * (q i * p i).coeff (-1,-1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold vectorResidueFunctional
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, residueCoefficient_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr
  · ext i
    simp
  · intro i hi
    rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.freeLaurentEquiv_positiveBasis
statement:
theorem freeLaurentEquiv_positiveBasis [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (e : PositiveIndex g r) (i : ι) :
    freeLaurentEquiv (positiveBasis (K := K) g r e).val i =
      if e.val.1 = i then AddMonoidAlgebra.single e.val.2 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hi : e.val.1 = i
  · subst i
    ext z
    simp [positiveBasis_val, Finsupp.single_apply, Prod.ext_iff]
  · ext z
    simp [positiveBasis_val, Finsupp.single_apply, Prod.ext_iff, hi]

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_basis
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_basis [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (w : ι → K) (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g r) (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv q.val)
      (freeLaurentEquiv (positiveBasis g r e).val) =
      w e.val.1 * q.val (complementIndex g r e).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  rw [vectorResidueFunctional_apply]
  simp only [freeLaurentEquiv_positiveBasis]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single e.val.1]
  · simp [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_apply, complementIndex]
    left
    exact congrArg (fun z : ℤ × ℤ => q.val (e.val.1,z))
      (Prod.ext (by simp [sub_eq_add_neg]) (by simp [sub_eq_add_neg]))
  · intro i hi hne
    simp [Ne.symm hne]
  · simp

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.weightedResiduePair_eq_vectorResidue
statement:
theorem weightedResiduePair_eq_vectorResidue [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (w : ι → K) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0)
    (q : negativeGrade (K := K) g r) (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    weightedResiduePair g r w hw q p =
      vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv q.val) (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)
proof:
:= by
  have h : weightedResiduePair g r w hw q =
      (vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv q.val)).comp
        ((freeLaurentEquiv (K := K)).toLinearMap.comp (positiveGrade g r).subtype) := by
    apply (positiveBasis g r).ext
    intro e
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      Submodule.subtype_apply, weightedResiduePair_basis, vectorResidueFunctional_basis]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h p

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_cyclic_transpose
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_cyclic_transpose (c : K)
    (γ m q : Fin 3 → BinaryLaurent K) :
    vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ : Fin 3 => c) q (QWeyl.cyclicZ γ m) =
      vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ : Fin 3 => c) (QWeyl.cyclicZDual γ q) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [vectorResidueFunctional_apply, vectorResidueFunctional_apply]
  have h := congrArg (fun p : BinaryLaurent K => c * p.coeff (-1,-1))
    (QWeyl.cyclic_pairing_transpose γ m q)
  simpa [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm] using h

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_cubic
statement:
theorem quarticSubstitution_cubic :
    quarticSubstitution K (binaryCubic K) =
      binaryCubic K * quarticRootMultiplier (K := K) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  simpa [binaryCubic, quarticRootMultiplier] using
    quartic_binary_cubic (binaryU K) (binaryV K)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticCubicHom_root
statement:
@[simp] theorem quarticCubicHom_root :
    quarticCubicHom (K := K) (cyclicRoot (binaryCubic K)) =
      cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) quarticRootMultiplier * cyclicRoot (binaryCubic K)
proof:
:=
  cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom_root _ _ _ _ _

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticCubicHom_coefficient
statement:
@[simp] theorem quarticCubicHom_coefficient (b : BinaryRing K) :
    quarticCubicHom (K := K) (cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) b) =
      cyclicCoefficientHom (binaryCubic K) (quarticSubstitution K b)
proof:
:=
  cyclicScaledBaseChangeHom_coefficient _ _ _ _ _ b

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileFactors_eq_cyclicCoefficients
statement:
theorem profileFactors_eq_cyclicCoefficients (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) :
    profileFactors q s = cyclicProfileCoefficients (binaryU K) (binaryV K) (C q) s
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  cases s <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [profileFactors, cubicLinearFactors, cyclicProfileCoefficients, map_pow]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_profileFactors
statement:
theorem quarticSubstitution_profileFactors (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (i : Fin 3) :
    quarticSubstitution K (profileFactors q s i) =
      cyclicProfileCoefficients (quarticU (binaryU K) (binaryV K))
        (quarticV (binaryU K) (binaryV K)) (C q) s i
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [profileFactors, cubicLinearFactors, cyclicProfileCoefficients, map_pow]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profilePullback_intertwines
statement:
theorem profilePullback_intertwines (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (m : BinaryVector K) :
    profilePullback q s (cyclicZ (profileFactors q s) m) =
      quarticRootMultiplier (K := K) • cyclicZ (profileFactors q s) (profilePullback q s m)
proof:
:= by
  refine weightedVectorBaseChange_cyclicZ (quarticSubstitution K).toRingHom
    (profileFactors q s) (profileFactors q s) (binaryProfilePullbackWeights q s)
    (quarticRootMultiplier (K := K)) ?_ m
  intro i
  have hq' : (C q : BinaryRing K) ^ 2 + C q + 1 = 0 := by
    simpa using congrArg (C : K →+* BinaryRing K) hq
  change quarticSubstitution K (profileFactors q s i) *
    binaryProfilePullbackWeights q s (cyclicNext i) = _
  rw [quarticSubstitution_profileFactors, profileFactors_eq_cyclicCoefficients]
  simpa only [binaryProfilePullbackWeights, quarticRootMultiplier] using
    profilePullbackWeights_intertwine (binaryU K) (binaryV K) (C q) hq' s i

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDualPullback_intertwines
statement:
theorem profileDualPullback_intertwines (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (m : BinaryVector K) :
    profileDualPullback q s (cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s) m) =
      quarticRootMultiplier (K := K) • cyclicZDual (profileFactors q s) (profileDualPullback q s m)
proof:
:= by
  refine weightedVectorBaseChange_cyclicZDual (quarticSubstitution K).toRingHom
    (profileFactors q s) (profileFactors q s) (binaryProfileDualPullbackWeights q s)
    (quarticRootMultiplier (K := K)) ?_ m
  intro i
  have hq' : (C q : BinaryRing K) ^ 2 + C q + 1 = 0 := by
    simpa using congrArg (C : K →+* BinaryRing K) hq
  change quarticSubstitution K (profileFactors q s i) *
    binaryProfileDualPullbackWeights q s i = _
  rw [quarticSubstitution_profileFactors, profileFactors_eq_cyclicCoefficients]
  simpa only [binaryProfileDualPullbackWeights, quarticRootMultiplier] using
    profileDualPullbackWeights_intertwine (binaryU K) (binaryV K) (C q) hq' s i

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileModulePullback_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem profileModulePullback_apply (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (m : BinaryVector K) :
    profileModulePullback q hq s m = profilePullback q s m

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDualModulePullback_apply

@[simp] theorem profileDualModulePullback_apply (q : K) (hq : q ^ 2 + q + 1 = 0)
    (s : CubicProfile) (m : BinaryVector K) :

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryLinearDifference_ne_zero
statement:
theorem binaryLinearDifference_ne_zero (q : K) :
    binaryU K - C q * binaryV K ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (MvPolynomial.eval ![(1 : K), 0]) h
  simp [binaryU, binaryV] at he

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryProfilePullbackWeights_ne_zero
statement:
theorem binaryProfilePullbackWeights_ne_zero (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (i : Fin 3) :
    binaryProfilePullbackWeights q s i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := binaryLinearDifference_ne_zero (K := K) 1
  have h1 := binaryLinearDifference_ne_zero (K := K) q
  have h2 := binaryLinearDifference_ne_zero (K := K) (q ^ 2)
  simp only [map_one, one_mul] at h0
  rw [map_pow] at h2
  cases s <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [binaryProfilePullbackWeights, profilePullbackWeights, weightZero, weightOne,
      weightTwo, h0, h1, h2]

theorem binaryProfileDualPullbackWeights_ne_zero (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (i : Fin 3) :

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profilePullback_injective
statement:
theorem profilePullback_injective [CharZero K] (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) :
    Function.Injective (profilePullback q s)
proof:
:=
  weightedVectorBaseChange_injective _ quarticSubstitution_injective _
    (binaryProfilePullbackWeights_ne_zero q s)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileDualPullback_injective
statement:
theorem profileDualPullback_injective [CharZero K] (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) :
    Function.Injective (profileDualPullback q s)
proof:
:=
  weightedVectorBaseChange_injective _ quarticSubstitution_injective _
    (binaryProfileDualPullbackWeights_ne_zero q s)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryLinearDifference_homogeneous
statement:
theorem binaryLinearDifference_homogeneous (q : K) :
    (binaryU K - C q * binaryV K).IsHomogeneous 1
proof:
:=
  (isHomogeneous_X K 0).sub ((isHomogeneous_X K 1).C_mul q)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryProfilePullbackWeights_homogeneous
statement:
theorem binaryProfilePullbackWeights_homogeneous (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (i : Fin 3) :
    (binaryProfilePullbackWeights q s i).IsHomogeneous (pullbackWeightDegrees s i)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (binaryU K - binaryV K).IsHomogeneous 1 :=
    (isHomogeneous_X K 0).sub (isHomogeneous_X K 1)
  have h1 := binaryLinearDifference_homogeneous (K := K) q
  have h2 := binaryLinearDifference_homogeneous (K := K) (q ^ 2)
  rw [map_pow] at h2
  cases s <;> fin_cases i
  · exact (h0.pow 2).mul h1
  · exact (h1.pow 2).mul h2
  · exact (h2.pow 2).mul h0
  · exact h0.pow 2
  · exact h1.mul h2
  · exact ((h2.pow 2).mul h0).mul (h1.pow 2)
  · exact h1
  · exact (h0.mul (h1.pow 2)).mul h2
  · exact (h0.pow 2).mul (h2.pow 2)

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.binaryProfileDualPullbackWeights_homogeneous
statement:
theorem binaryProfileDualPullbackWeights_homogeneous (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (i : Fin 3) :
    (binaryProfileDualPullbackWeights q s i).IsHomogeneous (dualPullbackWeightDegrees s i)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (binaryU K - binaryV K).IsHomogeneous 1 :=
    (isHomogeneous_X K 0).sub (isHomogeneous_X K 1)
  have h1 := binaryLinearDifference_homogeneous (K := K) q
  have h2 := binaryLinearDifference_homogeneous (K := K) (q ^ 2)
  rw [map_pow] at h2
  cases s <;> fin_cases i
  · exact h1.mul (h2.pow 2)
  · exact h2.mul (h0.pow 2)
  · exact h0.mul (h1.pow 2)
  · exact (h1.pow 2).mul (h2.pow 2)
  · exact (h1.mul h2).mul (h0.pow 2)
  · exact h0
  · exact ((h0.pow 2).mul h1).mul (h2.pow 2)
  · exact h0.mul h2
  · exact h1.pow 2

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.quarticSubstitution_mem_signedForms
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t
  · have h4 : 0 ≤ 4 * t := by omega
    have hf : p.IsHomogeneous t.toNat := by simpa [signedForms, ht] using hp
    have hnat : (4 * t).toNat = 4 * t.toNat := by omega
    simpa [signedForms, h4, hnat] using quarticSubstitution_homogeneous hf
  · have hp0 : p = 0 := by simpa [signedForms, ht] using hp
    simp [hp0]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.weightedQuarticLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedQuarticLinear_apply (ρ : Fin 3 → BinaryRing K)
    (m : BinaryVector K) (i : Fin 3) :
    weightedQuarticLinear ρ m i = quarticSubstitution K (m i) * ρ i
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedProfilePullback_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedProfilePullback_val (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℤ)
    (m : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (generatorWeights s) t) :
    gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) (4*t+profileMultiplicity s)
      (gradedProfilePullback q s t m) =
    profilePullback q s (gradedBinaryVectorVal (generatorWeights s) t m)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedProfileDualPullback_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedProfileDualPullback_val (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℤ)
    (m : GradedBinaryVector (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s) t) :
    gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) (4*t-profileMultiplicity s)
      (gradedProfileDualPullback q s t m) =
    profileDualPullback q s (gradedBinaryVectorVal (dualGeneratorWeights s) t m)
proof: := rfl

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedProfilePullback_injective
statement:
theorem gradedProfilePullback_injective [CharZero K] (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (gradedProfilePullback (K := K) q s t)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h
  apply gradedBinaryVectorVal_injective (generatorWeights s) t
  apply profilePullback_injective q s
  simpa using congrArg (gradedBinaryVectorVal (K := K) (generatorWeights s)
    (4*t+profileMultiplicity s)) h

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.gradedProfileDualPullback_injective
statement:
theorem gradedProfileDualPullback_injective [CharZero K] (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (t : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (gradedProfileDualPullback (K := K) q s t)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h
  apply gradedBinaryVectorVal_injective (dualGeneratorWeights s) t
  apply profileDualPullback_injective q s
  simpa using congrArg (gradedBinaryVectorVal (K := K) (dualGeneratorWeights s)
    (4*t-profileMultiplicity s)) h

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.cyclicModule_algebraMap_smul
statement:
theorem cyclicModule_algebraMap_smul (F : A) (Z : Module.End A (Fin 3 → A))
    (hZ : Z ^ 3 = F • 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= cyclicModuleStructure F Z hZ
    ∀ (k : K) (m : Fin 3 → A),
      algebraMap K (CyclicCubicRing A F) k • m = k • m := by
  intro k m
  change cyclicActionHom F Z hZ (cyclicCoefficientHom F (algebraMap K A k)) m = k • m
  rw [cyclicActionHom_coefficient]
  funext i
  simp [Algebra.smul_def, Module.algebraMap_end_apply]

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_of_uniform_linear_witness
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_of_uniform_linear_witness [CharZero K]
    (hlinear : UniformLinearMatrixWitness K)
    (d p : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlo : p ≤ N (d - 1)
  · exact genericChoppedConclusion_outside_intermediate d p (by omega) (Or.inl hlo)
  by_cases hhi : N d ≤ p
  · exact genericChoppedConclusion_outside_intermediate d p (by omega) (Or.inr hhi)
  have hlo' : N (d - 1) < p := by omega
  have hhi' : p < N d := by omega
  by_cases hr1 : N d - p = 1
  · exact genericChoppedConclusion_one_generator (K := K) (by omega) hp hlo' hhi' hr1
  by_cases hr2 : N d - p = 2
  · exact genericChoppedConclusion_two_generator (K := K) hd hp hlo' hhi' hr2
  have hr : 3 ≤ N d - p := by omega
  by_cases ha : aCount d (N d - p) ≤ 0
  · exact genericChoppedConclusion_nonpositive d p hd hlo' hhi' hr ha
  · exact genericChoppedConclusion_positive_of_uniform_linear_witness
      hlinear d p hd hlo' hhi' hr (by omega)

name: ChoppedPlane.mainStatement_of_uniform_linear_witness
statement:
theorem mainStatement_of_uniform_linear_witness
    (hlinear : ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [CharZero K], UniformLinearMatrixWitness K) :
    MainStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro K _ _ d p hd hp
  exact genericChoppedConclusion_of_uniform_linear_witness (hlinear K) d p hd hp

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_degree_one
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_degree_one [CharZero K]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) : GenericChoppedConclusion K 1 p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlo : p ≤ N (1 - 1)
  · exact genericChoppedConclusion_outside_intermediate 1 p (by decide) (Or.inl hlo)
  by_cases hhi : N 1 ≤ p
  · exact genericChoppedConclusion_outside_intermediate 1 p (by decide) (Or.inr hhi)
  have hlo' : N (1 - 1) < p := by omega
  have hhi' : p < N 1 := by omega
  have hr : N 1 - p = 1 := by
    norm_num [N] at hlo' hhi' ⊢
    omega
  exact genericChoppedConclusion_one_generator (K := K) (by decide) hp hlo' hhi' hr

name: ChoppedPlane.genericChoppedConclusion_positive_degree_of_uniform_linear_witness
statement:
theorem genericChoppedConclusion_positive_degree_of_uniform_linear_witness
    [CharZero K] (hlinear : UniformLinearMatrixWitness K)
    (d p : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    GenericChoppedConclusion K d p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd1 : d = 1
  · subst d
    exact genericChoppedConclusion_degree_one p hp
  · exact genericChoppedConclusion_of_uniform_linear_witness hlinear d p (by omega) hp

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileLinearMatrix_criticalTwist
statement:
theorem profileLinearMatrix_criticalTwist (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℕ) :
    linearMatrixCriticalTwist (profileRows s r) (profileRows s r+3) =
      profileCriticalDegree s r
proof:
:= by
  simp [linearMatrixCriticalTwist, profileCriticalDegree]

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.profileLinearMatrix_maximalRank_of_differential_checks
statement:
theorem profileLinearMatrix_maximalRank_of_differential_checks [CharZero K]
    (q : K) (s : CubicProfile) (r : ℕ)
    (hright : Function.Injective (operatorDifferential
      (gradedProfileOperators q s (r : ℤ)) (profileCriticalDegree s r)))
    (hleft : 0 < profileCriticalDegree s r → Function.Surjective (operatorDifferential
      (gradedProfileOperators q s (r : ℤ)) (profileCriticalDegree s r-1))) :
    ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank (profileLinearMatrix q s r) t
proof:
:= by
  apply linearMatrixMaximalRank_all_of_numeric_critical_checks _ (by omega)
  · rw [profileLinearMatrix_criticalTwist]
    intro hpos
    apply linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_injective
    exact (operatorDifferential_surjective_iff_linearMatrixMap_injective
      (profileSourceBasis s r) (profileTargetBasis s r)
      (gradedProfileOperators q s (r : ℤ)) (profileCriticalDegree s r-1)).mp (hleft hpos)
  · rw [profileLinearMatrix_criticalTwist]
    apply linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective
    exact (operatorDifferential_injective_iff_linearMatrixMap_surjective
      (profileSourceBasis s r) (profileTargetBasis s r)
      (gradedProfileOperators q s (r : ℤ)) (profileCriticalDegree s r)).mp hright

name: ChoppedPlane.QWeyl.exists_three_extra_columns_maximalRank_of_profile_matrices
statement:
theorem exists_three_extra_columns_maximalRank_of_profile_matrices
    (q : K) (hprofiles : ∀ s : CubicProfile, ∀ r : ℕ,
      ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank (profileLinearMatrix q s r) t) (a : ℕ) :
    ∃ L : LinearMatrix K a (a+3), ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : 0 < a
  · obtain ⟨s, r, h⟩ := exists_profileRows a ha
    have hex : ∃ L : LinearMatrix K (profileRows s r) (profileRows s r+3),
        ∀ t, LinearMatrixMaximalRank L t := ⟨profileLinearMatrix q s r, hprofiles s r⟩
    rwa [h] at hex
  · have h : a = 0 := by omega
    subst a
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    intro t
    apply linearMatrixMaximalRank_of_surjective
    intro y
    exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_basis_free
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_basis_free [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (w : ι → K) (q : FreeLaurent K ι) (e : PositiveIndex g r) :
    vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv q)
      (freeLaurentEquiv (positiveBasis g r e).val) =
      w e.val.1 * q (complementIndex g r e).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  rw [vectorResidueFunctional_apply]
  simp only [freeLaurentEquiv_positiveBasis]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single e.val.1]
  · simp [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_apply, complementIndex]
    left
    exact congrArg (fun z : ℤ × ℤ => q (e.val.1,z))
      (Prod.ext (by simp [sub_eq_add_neg]) (by simp [sub_eq_add_neg]))
  · intro i hi hne
    simp [Ne.symm hne]
  · simp

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_freeNegativePart
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_freeNegativePart [Finite ι]
    (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (w : ι → K) (q : FreeLaurent K ι)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv (freeNegativePart q)) (freeLaurentEquiv p.val) =
      vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv q) (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv (freeNegativePart q))).comp
      ((freeLaurentEquiv (K := K)).toLinearMap.comp (positiveGrade g r).subtype) =
      (vectorResidueFunctional w (freeLaurentEquiv q)).comp
        ((freeLaurentEquiv (K := K)).toLinearMap.comp (positiveGrade g r).subtype) := by
    apply (positiveBasis g r).ext
    intro e
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Submodule.subtype_apply,
      vectorResidueFunctional_basis_free]
    have hn : -1-e.val.2.1 < 0 ∧ -1-e.val.2.2 < 0 := by
      obtain ⟨ha,hb,hab⟩ := e.property
      omega
    change w e.val.1 * freeNegativePart q (e.val.1,(-1-e.val.2.1,-1-e.val.2.2)) = _
    rw [freeNegativePart_apply, ite_eq_left hn]
    rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h p

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_componentNegativePart
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_componentNegativePart [Finite ι]
    (g : ι → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (w : ι → K) (q : ι → BinaryLaurent K)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    vectorResidueFunctional w (fun i => negativePart (q i)) (freeLaurentEquiv p.val) =
      vectorResidueFunctional w q (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)
proof:
:= by
  have h := vectorResidueFunctional_freeNegativePart g r w (freeLaurentEquiv.symm q) p
  have he : freeLaurentEquiv (freeNegativePart (freeLaurentEquiv.symm q)) =
      fun i => negativePart (q i) := by
    funext i
    rw [freeLaurentEquiv_negativePart]
    exact congrArg (fun f : ι → BinaryLaurent K => negativePart (f i))
      (freeLaurentEquiv.apply_symm_apply q)
  rw [he, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h

name: ChoppedPlane.LaurentPairing.vectorResidueFunctional_projected_cyclic_transpose
statement:
theorem vectorResidueFunctional_projected_cyclic_transpose
    (g : Fin 3 → ℤ) (r : ℤ) (c : K) (γ q : Fin 3 → BinaryLaurent K)
    (p : positiveGrade (K := K) g r) :
    vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ : Fin 3 => c) q (QWeyl.cyclicZ γ (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)) =
      vectorResidueFunctional (fun _ : Fin 3 => c)
        (fun i => negativePart (QWeyl.cyclicZDual γ q i)) (freeLaurentEquiv p.val)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vectorResidueFunctional_cyclic_transpose]
  exact (vectorResidueFunctional_componentNegativePart g r (fun _ => c) _ p).symm
